reviews.author: Jamie R
reviews.title: We can’t wait to go back!
reviews.text:
Our group had 12 people total made up of three families with quite a few small children. From the moment we arrived, Omar at reception made it very clear that they intended for us to have a wonderful vacation and if there were any issues at all, we should message them right away so they could fix it. This was extremely helpful because the resort app isn’t the best, so being able to communicate through WhatsApp made everything much easier. We were also upgraded to a room with an ocean view which was totally unexpected and appreciated! Whenever we had questions or something wasn’t quite right, staff handled it immediately.

The Mayan events were absolutely incredible; we attended a sunset energy ritual, cacao ceremony and the pre-Hispanic show. The individuals were so kind and took the time to explain the meaning behind all of the steps. 

The new water slides were perfect for our group of kids that were ages 6-9. The water slide pool is a little deep so kids that are not strong swimmers will likely need water wings or swim vest. Our kids went to the kid’s club and loved making a craft and the piñata - typically we do not put our kids in the kids club at any resort but felt safe enough to allow them to go at the Paradisus.

The staff throughout the entire resort were absolutely incredible. Someone was always offering to help when they walked by. 

The rooms were beautiful, with no musty smells or excess moisture. We didn’t need Damp Rid like we’ve had to use at other resorts. Every bathroom throughout the resort was SPOTLESS and smelled so clean. There was constantly someone cleaning and maintaining the bathrooms.

The customer service at this hotel was unlike anything we’ve ever experienced. These staff members truly made a huge impact on our vacation:

Jesus, Giovanni, and Marurico from the entertainment team were awesome. Jesus was especially incredible with our kids. He had so much patience while teaching us how to make dream catchers. After we mentioned we had missed a craft we were really looking forward to because the app listed the wrong time, he actually went out of his way to make sure we still got to do it. He also made sure we knew about all the fun activities so we wouldn’t miss anything. We were so glad we met him.

Guadeloupe, who worked by the kids’ pool, took care of us every day, remembered our favourite drinks, and genuinely made us feel looked after. Our kids adored her and were so sad to say goodbye.

Antonio at the bar near the snack bar was always making us laugh and checking to make sure we were enjoying our drinks.

Anahi, Rosalinda, Perla, and Norma at the ice cream/coffee bar were wonderful. They were amazing about checking ingredients so we knew which treats were safe for us to have.

A huge thank you Jesus who put us in touch with Diego and Adrianna who were wonderful and made sure our large group had restaurant reservations every night.

Jenny, our concierge, was always quick to answer questions and was especially helpful arranging late checkout.

Omar at reception answered every question we had during check-in and throughout the week whenever we saw him.

Armando at the Mexican restaurant was our favourite server of the entire trip. He was hilarious, made excellent food recommendations, and constantly checked to make sure we were enjoying our meals.

Nathaniel, the manager at the Mexican restaurant, bent over backwards to make sure our kids had meals they enjoyed and that they weren’t waiting too long for food.

Alonso, Alberto, and Antonio at the snack bar always checked ingredients for us and made our nachos exactly the way we liked them.

Rudolpho, Geraldo, Armando, and Candelario at the buffet always made sure we had a large enough table for our whole group. They also remembered that some of us couldn’t have dairy and consistently made sure almond milk was available for us, which was such a thoughtful touch.

This resort genuinely exceeded our expectations in every way. The cleanliness, customer service, attention to detail, and kindness from the staff made this one of the best vacations we’ve ever had

reviews.author: Laura
reviews.title: Central Location-read full review for an honest opinion
reviews.text:
The honest truth (Pro's & Con's)
Location to resort
Around a 10 min drive from the Cancun Airport.
Very central to allot of drug stores, shopping, Mc Donalds.

Check in
-Rooms not ready till 3pm (Take a later flight to avoid any delays if you can)
-Delayed & unorganized on the front desk (We did not get into our room till 4:30)
-Front desk staff are friendly & did try to upgrade us but gave us the wrong room Category, so we ended up waiting again.
-Be aware this resort charges a hotel tax. ($85 US I believe)
-Huge shout out to David one of our Fav bell boys.  He is super friendly & was always willing to help us. 

Rooms
-Clean & spacious.  (We had 2 double beds)
-Noise level in room was little to none.
-Tv in room only 1 English Channel.  (This we found not great)
-Cover the drain in the bathroom as it can off gas a sewer smell. (Under the sink)
-Beds were very hard & the pillows went flat over a night.  (We made the best of it)
-Mini fridge was stocked daily (Nespresso coffee maker in room as well)
-Rooms were cleaned daily. (No complaints)
-We had a room facing the main road.

Beach/Ocean/Pools
-3 pools on the property
-Amazing white sand & beautiful water.  (White sand bar, walk for miles)
-Lacking beach chairs
-Seaweed gets cleaned daily no issues. (8am normally) 
-Note the seaweed can change depending on weather/wind etc.
-Very clean pools & surrounding areas/grounds.
-Lacking beach chairs.  Get up early to reserve one or you'll be out of luck (6-6:30am)

Entertainment
-We found this was lacking a bit but they were very open for new suggestions.
-Met some amazing team members mid week.  (See bellow for names)
-These staff members went out of their way to make our week better. 
(Daniel, Giovani, Pablo, Mauricio). 

Pool bars
-Great variety of alcohol/pop etc
-Always provided bottled water/fresh fruit etc if needed.
-We loved the pool bar by the main buffet (Great bartender)

Food/Buffet/A La carte/Coffee Bar
-Book the A La carte ASAP (9am hospitality desk)
-A large variety of food @ the main buffet. 
-No organization or direction for food, people would just butt right in front of you to grab food.  (A bit frustrating for people with manors) 
-Sadly all the hot food on the buffet stations (pre made) were cold 95% of the time,
we avoided anything that was not made to order because of this issue.
-Always have a very large selection of fruits, cheese, deserts, breads etc.
Nespresso coffee bar-very friendly staff & great selection.  (Ice Cream was our fav)
-The Italian restaurant was honestly the best one on property.  (Yummy fresh food)

Room Service
-Food came in a timely manner but showed up cold. (Only used this service once)

Overall feel!!
This resort is very clean & comfortable but they still have many kinks to work out to be perfect!  "Truly your vacation is what you make it"
The staff try to help you in anyway they can.  If you are looking for a perfect beach well this is your resort!!  
Overall I would travel back to this resort as we never really had any major issues and we can't wait to see you all again.

reviews.author: PickiTraveller
reviews.title: PickiTraveller REVIEW - Hi everyone :)  MISS YOU ALL !
reviews.text:
WAITERS / BARTENDERS / COFFEE BAR - I want to say - My Goodness these are the BEST PEOPLE at the hotel !!!

JORGE FROM LEMONFISH - Jorge greeted us with a SMILE.  Always asked if we had any allergies even though we went to eat there multiple times.  He made us feel welcome and comfortable for every meal he served us.  Jorge is quick on his feet, nice to talk to and very kind and warm.  He knows the ingredients of every single item on the menu, how Amazing !  When you get to LEMONFISH ASK FOR JORGE, THE WAITER !

ALEJANDRO (ALEX) FROM COFFEE BAR - Alex knew my special coffee order before I ordered it and called me by my name (same name as his mother's name).  Alex was so friendly and nice to talk to.  We shared some really great stories every morning at 8am.  He expected me there at least by 8am to serve me.  They have sandwiches for late night snack and coffee/tea needs.  AND THEY ARE OPEN 24 HOURS.  Keep up your friendly disposition, ALEX.  You are a great asset to the hotel.

SALVADOR BARTENDER GINGER BAR 1 - Made some awesome & unusual Drinks and Shots - thank you for our B52 shots, Salvador, and for your nice conversations at the restaurant one evening.  Salvador is an experienced bartender and knows what he is doing.  LOOK FOR SALVADOR - Salvador is the bars and bar restaurants.

AMAYRANI (AMY) MY HOSTESS MALVA BUFFET - Daily greetings from AMY saying my name was a special touch from her (she only saw me 1x and remembered my name the whole time I was there).  It was a great start to my day seeing her cheerful face, that I looked forward to eating there.   She made my mornings bright.  LOOK FOR AMY WHEN YOU CHECK IN TO MALVA.

RAFAEL MY WAITER MALVA BUFFET - Always had my sparkling drink ready at my table after I got my morning omelette.  RAFAEL IS A HARD WORKER AT MALVA.  

DINO & GLADYS FROM GINGER BAR 1 - DINO BARTENDER was always nice to us and served us our special cocktails.  GLADYS was helpful and friendly.

KARINA & ABRAHAM from GINGER BAR 2 - KARINA is one of the first people we met at any of the Bars.  Always friendly and remembered our drinks day after day.  Our glass was never empty.  Karina, thank you for helping with the birthday celebration.  Abraham was helpful and friendly.  When you get to GINGER BAR 2 ASK FOR KARINA.  

GUADENCIO BEACH WAITER - Had a very unique whistle and made my time at the beach very pleasant.  You always knew when he was coming around when you heard his distinctive whistle.

I LOVE YOU ALL AND BEST OF LUCK TO YOU.  I TRULY HOPE TO SEE YOU ALL IN CANCUN AGAIN SOON.  YOUR FRIEND FOREVER,      💕  PICKITRAVELLER. 💕

I have posted pictures of everyone I spoke about here.  We left the resort on May 10, 2025.

ROOM - We were enjoying the room lagoon view until the Monday (our 3rd day), Construction going on in the room above us.  I complained 3 times during the week  about the dust, cement and plaster all over our balcony and chairs which made the balcony ABSOLUTELY USELESS.  The construction continued in the room above during our entire vacation.  We didn't have water one afternoon when we went to the room at 3pm !  They didn't notify us of our water shutdown, no tub, sink, toilet water.  We had to walk to the front desk because our phone was not working.  The multiple visits to the front desk took time away from our precious vacation in paradise.

Our ROOM faced the Front of the hotel view which is passed the parking lot with lagoon in the distance which was not a big deal - beautiful sunsets from this side not on the ocean side.  Pretty quiet during the day; however, far in the distance you can hear the pumping of the music from the disco in the distance at 2am onwards.  If you put the air conditioner on at full speed at night it drowns out the sound, somewhat.

HALLWAYS - Room service delivery food trays all around the floor of various rooms with fleas on them.  They are left there for multiple days and nobody removes them.  We had to let the front desk know multiple times.  The hotel is HUUUGE but this doesn't excuse the unsanitary conditions.

FOOD / ALL INCLUSIVE - Very different choices from buffet to mediterranean to italian to asian.  Great tasty food, lots of deserts and fruits and salads.   
LOBSTER IS NOT included in the All-Inclusive Plan. 
Top Shelf and certain cocktails ARE NOT included in the All-Inclusive Plan.

BALI BEDS - You cannot use them unless you pay $250 per day.  You get 1 Lobster with purchase of a Bali Bed.  

STAIRS - Stairs everywhere !  Inside and Outside.  Stairs leading to the pool, stairs leading to the beach.

BEACH - SPARKLING TURQUOISE WATER !

I won't be coming back to this hotel unfortunately, although we made some really good friends with the waiters, bartenders and coffee team and would love to see them all again.  They will all be displaced due to the CLOSING of the hotel on June 1, 2025 due to major hotel renovations.  Some of the staff will be moved to other Melia hotels but most chose to look for jobs elsewhere.     So sad :(

reviews.author: Mark L
reviews.title: Superb stay!!
reviews.text: The absolute best resort in Cancun but it wouldn't be the best without it's staff...Galdino is A1 the best concierge,goes out of his way for everyone. Omar my 5 Guys guy,Emanuel for his conversation, Jose our man with the plan,Oscar,Miguel,Javier,Jacob,Valeria,Caesar,Gemma,Gabriela at Sante and the pool that never missed a beat.Julio at the Reserve Cafe always kind and courteous, Alexandro and Luiz at the pool bar..oooha oooha..the best.Karina and Abraham at Ginger bar...and last but not least the 1st face we see at the reception bar..Oscar with the ice cold Sol..Thank you to everyone for the best vacation and hope to see you all again after the renovations ❤️❤️❤️

reviews.author: elenalazro00
reviews.title: Un sueño desde el primer dia
reviews.text: Desde que llegamos a Paradisus fue todo un sueño. Gracias en especial a Emmanuel, por su hospitalidad y estar atento desde el primer dia y hacer de este viaje una experiencia inolvidable. Una gran mención tambien a Roberto de Agua Marina y a Dani, Bryan, Say y Uriel del equipo de animación. Ojalá volver muy pronto. Gracias!!!!

reviews.author: Jason M
reviews.title: Karina and Abraham excellent !!!
reviews.text:
Karina and Abraham from ginger 2  they are the best of the best.
The best experience I’ve had here at the hotel! Just not in this areas but all the areas in this hotel!  Most wonderful people by far!!!  They will give you open arms and treat you like family!!

reviews.author: Rodrigo P
reviews.title: Amazing Experience! Amazing Staffs :)
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus - RESERVE for two weeks. The experience was brilliant. The hotel has a monumental structure and has a phenomenal team. Our concierge Galdino, the person in charge of the pool David, the waiters, especially Lorena and Gemma, were fundamental in making this trip one of the best of our lives. We hope to return soon.

reviews.author: AnnaKSingapore
reviews.title: One of the best holidays ever!
reviews.text: Probably one of the best holidays we have ever been on! The hotel is beautiful inside and out, and it is located on a stunning beach. The level of service from all the staff is exceptional and the food delicious in all the restaurants. The hotel is spotless throughout and grounds are beautifully maintained. There are so many activities going on for all ages every day. It's a very fun-filled family-friendly hotel, but also has a separate adult area. All in all, I cannot recommend it highly enough and would love to go again.

reviews.author: nadia alejandra a
reviews.title: Una visita al paraíso. Una aventura con los mejores amigos de la vida. Después de 30 años de amistad
reviews.text: Fue lo máximo. Lugar hermoso y además la atención maravillosa. Te hacían sentir muy bien. La atención del hotel excelente. Gabriela y Luis bartender excelentes. Solo que la discoteca cerraba muy temprano. La comida riquísima y con mucha variedad.

reviews.author: Isidora R
reviews.title: Si buscas tranquilidad, limpieza, alto nivel en alimentación asociado a variedad y estilo gourmet. Elige Paradisus
reviews.text:
amo el hotel. Es cuarta vez que voy y jamás decepciona. El nivel de las comidas, bebidas y servicio es de alto standard.
Siempre esta el tema de muy poco entretenimiento nocturno pero eso ha sido siempre así. Todo lo demás es maravilloso.
Lo recomiendo al 100 %.
Gaby de The reserve es siempre maravillosa,
luis del bar de the reserve y César, también siempre atienden de manera alegre y personalizada.
En ginger bar karina siempre destaca, y en general todo el personal de ese lugar.

reviews.author: Mobile701958
reviews.title: Buena experiencia en el beach club!
reviews.text:
Hola,
  Me gustó mucho el lugar, buena ubicación y fácil de acceder. 
El menú tenía opciones limitadas pero muy rico todo: Nos atendió Brayan en el club de playa Kanna, muy buen servicio y la playa muy linda el azul del mar esta muy lindo.
Lo pasamos súper bien.

reviews.author: Teri D
reviews.title: Paradises Cancun
reviews.text:
Jose Garcia at Capella restaurant  assisted us with amazing dinner choices.  The food was excellent and his 
Fun personality added to the experience.
Abraham at the Ginger bar is always excellent.  His mixology expertise has us trying new and wonderful drinks every time we visit.

reviews.author: Sky0279
reviews.title: Cena en restaurante Lemon Fish
reviews.text:
La comida fue más que excelente.
Agradezco la disposición de los Chefs Mario y Karen para adaptarse a mis condiciones de salud y ofrecerme una deliciosa cena especial que yo pudiera consumir.
Igualmente al mesero Jorge en el restaurante Lemon Fish qué me ofreció opciones hasta lograr algo que pudiera comer. Además es sumamente amable y respetuoso.
Gracias y ¡Felicidades!

reviews.author: rafaela m
reviews.title: cancun paradisus
reviews.text: club de playa kanna con todo respeto. ya no es el mismo que antes. pésimo servicio, el bar tender, tarda para hacerte  una bebida,  y te atiende con malas ganas, la verdad no recomiendo kanna para pasar el día .yo iba una vez al mes ,antes te trataban con amabilidad las bebidas salían perfectas rico , subieron el precio es para que el servicio del bar es rápido y con calidad ,pagamos 1890 por personas, el servicio muy mal..,,,,,,....

reviews.author: Cristinaeto
reviews.title: Si no eres socio black, no vengas a Meliá
reviews.text:
Discriminación a socios que no tienen categoría black, vinimos con dos familias amigas, todos socios, y uno de nuestros amigos es categoría círculo, ellos pueden pedir una botella de vino, cuando pedimos más copas para hacer un brindis  por este viaje, se nos negaron y nos dijeron que solo Los de la categoría superior podían tomar de este vino, nos negaron 3 copas, me parece insólito humillante por decirlo menos, que no se pueda comparten una botella de vino. Solo pedimos 1 botella para 5 personas, no pedimos más que eso!!! Se le sugirió al socio ir a tomar la botella a su habitación y así se la podía tomar solo !!! 
Pedimos una entrada de langostinos, y solo trajeron platos para ellos. Los socios que tenían ese beneficio. Una vergüenza tremenda, ya no podemos comer con nuestros amigos y compartir la misma mesa??? Ellos deberían comer en su habitación  por que tienen un menú especial ??? Terrible he incómodo momento vivimos hoy !!!! Un día familiar terminó es una humillación para el socio y todos los que estábamos en la
Mesa.

reviews.author: Emma C
reviews.title: Yummy foods, come here!!
reviews.text: I went with my friends and Carlos was the best server!! Food was 10/10, everything is delicious! I got the tacos which were really good and yummy and so did my friends!!! Carlos was incredibly nice the entire time, very great service all around!

reviews.author: Mia L
reviews.title: Carlos the server
reviews.text: Carlos gave us great service at lunch at the Mexican restaurant. He was extremely accommodating and very patient with all of us. Pleasant dining experience and made sure we had very quick and speedy service. He went out of his way to make sure we had everything we wanted. Never an empty drink.

reviews.author: Jana R
reviews.title: Favorite for Cancun Girls Trip
reviews.text: My favorite part of visiting Paradisus Cancun is the staff! My friends & I have been coming for several years & have always had a great experience. Rodrigo takes care of us at the pool, Uriel kept us grooving, Abraham, Katrina & Javier are our besties for evening cocktails. Daniel hands down, entertainer of the year!! Above & beyond & we can’t wait to come back after renovations to see our friends again! Jose set the bar for concierge & Carlos has consistently taken care of us & we couldn’t be happier. Thank you for the memories & good times. ❤️ Adios, hasta la proxima.

reviews.author: Sebastian R
reviews.title: Un catre de cama y mal servicio
reviews.text: La atención es mala , la mitad de las cosas no están incluidas , el bar cierra a las 11 (no hay nada abierto después de esa hora nunca ví algo así). Nos dieron. Un catre para la tercer persona adulta que incluía la reserva. Todo es bastante flojo excepto las instalaciones que son hermosas.

reviews.author: Anna Z
reviews.title: Melia Paradisus has the best night life on resort!
reviews.text:
Abraham, Katrina and Javier at the Ginger Bar make the night!  The service, the specialty cocktails and personal care are top notch!

Daniel as MC makes the evening so enjoyable!
Uriel on the music keeps you dancing and shaking’!

Come back every year - can’t wait for Spring 2027!

reviews.author: Dorian M
reviews.title: Super servicio
reviews.text: Carlos y gladys en el ginger bar los mejores, me encanto sus servicio volveria a venir por ellos fueron super amables, las habitaciones y todo el servicio la verdad volvere pronto y siempre espero a encontrar a los chicos del bar muy amables :)

reviews.author: Domenico L
reviews.title: Absolute Paradise at Paradisus!!
reviews.text:
We stayed at Paradisus Cancun for 10 nights on the reserve side.
From the start to the end all the staff was kind,friendly and helpful!
A really nice touch was a small birthday cake and a bottle of sparkling wine in our room for our birthday.
Generally, the restaurants had the best food. The buffet was really hit and miss.
Also, our concierge, Christian Hernandez, was really amazing! Always updating us for the daily entertainment programme of the hotel, making the restaurant reservations in advance so we have the chance to try every single one, and he gave us restaurant recommendations for outside of the hotel when we wanted to dine out.
We had a really good experience and we are definitely coming back.
Thank you, paradisus staff 😀

reviews.author: Toni A
reviews.title: Immer wieder gerne
reviews.text:
Perfekter Aufenthalt – Absolut empfehlenswert!

Ich hatte einen wunderbaren Aufenthalt im Paradisus Cancun und kann es nur weiterempfehlen! Schon beim Check-in wurden wir herzlich empfangen und das Personal war stets freundlich und hilfsbereit. Spezielles Dankeschön an Hrn. Golzalo Dueñas (Guest Service), immer hilfs- und auskunftsbereit.

Das Zimmer war sauber, modern eingerichtet und sehr komfortabel – besonders das Bett war unglaublich bequem! Auch das Badezimmer war makellos und gut ausgestattet. Die Lage des Hotels ist perfekt, alles ist gut erreichbar.

Das Essen war hervorragend, mit einer großen Auswahl an frischen und leckeren Speisen.

Ein großes Dankeschön an das gesamte Team für den großartigen Service.

reviews.author: Haley B
reviews.title: DANNY MACIAS is awesome
reviews.text: Stayed here for spring break with our moms and the overall experience was good but Danny Macias who work within the activities was over the top awesome! He was so willing to help us and make sure our whole group had a blast (18 people) with making bracelets and aqua aerobics!

reviews.author: Brandi V
reviews.title: Amazing Experiance
reviews.text:
Amazing experience at Paradisus, exceptional dinner service and atmosphere at Sal with Daniel and Carlos. Food is amazing and service is second to none for an All Inclusive.
Recommend 1000%. You will not be disappointed in your decision.

reviews.author: Logan R
reviews.title: Massage
reviews.text: Excellent massage and relaxing environment. Was the perfect ending to our trip. My daughter and I both enjoyed our services!Thank you so much for the wonderful experience! Highly recommend visiting the spa and would definitely return!!

reviews.author: Isabella B
reviews.title: Awesome time
reviews.text: Amazing ! Danny flow was amazing. With Mr.white ! Sexc sexc sexc! Super fun water aerobic with a great experience at paridusus. Amazing time with Danny flow super fun shower a great time! Sexy sexy sexy all the time. Also had a great workout super fun!

reviews.author: Hannah F
reviews.title: spring break
reviews.text: 5 out of 5 it was the best trip ever. Luis is the best bartender ever we love him!!! We love him he is the best ever he is so sweet and the nicest ever. he is the most wonderful server in the world he has been bringing me drinks all day and i’ve given him lots of tips Bar kanda is the place to be!!!

reviews.author: Lily G
reviews.title: Incredible, worth it, book it babe
reviews.text: Absolutely speechless. Treated like royalty. The staff is incredible! Beautiful resort. Luis at kanna bar and George at the buffet are my new best friends!💗 From the moment we arrived we got treated like royalty and the service was excellent. Highly recommend Sal steakhouse

reviews.author: bella d
reviews.title: Great Service!
reviews.text:
¡Luis en el bar de la playa Kanna y Carlos en el bar de la piscina son, sin duda, los mejores bartenders del resort! Luis es una persona increíblemente divertida, su energía es contagiosa y siempre crea un ambiente vibrante y alegre en el bar. Ya sea preparando un cóctel exclusivo o simplemente conversando, hace que cada momento sea especial y memorable. Carlos, por otro lado, es el ejemplo perfecto de un excelente servicio. Es muy atento y siempre está un paso adelante, anticipándose a las necesidades de los huéspedes con una sonrisa. Su atención al detalle y su servicio personalizado nos hicieron sentir como VIPs durante toda nuestra estadía. Tanto Luis como Carlos van más allá para asegurarse de que todos estén disfrutando al máximo. No son solo bartenders; son una parte fundamental de lo que hace tan increíble la experiencia en el resort. Si buscas un servicio excepcional, ellos son los indicados. ¡10/10, totalmente recomendado! (ENGLISH) 

Luis at the Kanna beach bar and Carlos at the swim-up pool bar are truly the best bartenders at the resort! Luis is an absolute blast — his energy is infectious, always bringing a fun, vibrant atmosphere to the bar. Whether it's a signature drink or a simple chat, he makes every moment feel special and memorable. Carlos, on the other hand, is the epitome of excellent service. He’s incredibly accommodating, always anticipating guests' needs with a smile. His attention to detail and personalized service made us feel like VIPs throughout our stay. Both Luis and Carlos go above and beyond to ensure everyone is having a great time. They are not just bartenders; they’re an integral part of what makes the resort experience so amazing. If you're looking for exceptional service, they are the ones to visit. 10/10 would absolutely recommend!

reviews.author: Jordyn R
reviews.title: amazing experience
reviews.text: Jorge and Miguel from lemon fish were excellent!! Best service ever!! Fast service. Great drinks and overall a warming atmosphere. Love Paradisus and will be returning soon due to the amazing faculty that is staffed here!! And a big shout out to the chef Mario for preparing fantastic dishes :)!

reviews.author: jackieag43
reviews.title: Excellent Resort
reviews.text: If you want to relax, feel pampered, eat drink and be merry, go to Paradisus Cancun. Rodolfo will take good care of you. But not just Rodolfo - the staff in  the restaurants Malvo,, Cappello and Sante.  Too many names to list. The rooms are very comfortable and the resort itself is very welcoming.

reviews.author: Donald
reviews.title: Paradisus was great but Christian is the man
reviews.text: The resort and staff were super! My personal concierge, Mr. Christian went above and beyond all expectations. He was so friendly and attentive. I never had to worry about a thing. Every time I go back I need him with me. I highly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Robin H
reviews.title: Great vacation at Club Melia Paradisus
reviews.text:
We, (my husband and I and a friend) stayed again at the Club Melia Paradisus in Cancun, from 2/8-2/15/2025.  It did not disappoint!  We had a wonderful time.  The resort is very clean, and our rooms, 1112 and 1114, were very comfortable.  Housekeeping kept us supplied with ample towels and our rooms were stocked daily with water and drinks.  This year, we had to make reservations for the specialty restaurants which we did not have to do in the past.  But, we were able to eat at the ones we wanted to without much problem.  The resort was much more crowded than in the past, which caused people to have to get up early to get chairs by the pool and beach.  I want to acknowledge some of our favorite waiters and bartenders, who always went above and beyond with awesome service:

Iran at Sante and Lemon Fish
Melvin at Capella
Sergio and Wilber at Agua Marina
Karina and Carlos at Ginger Sports bar
Jorge and Daniel at Lemon Fish
Pasquale and Roberto at Malva

All in all, it was a great vacation and hope to return again.

reviews.author: Nicole S
reviews.title: We love it
reviews.text:
If you are going to stay at the Paradisus Cancun, the reserve section of the hotel is the best place to go. The staff is fantastic and goes out of their way to make sure you have what you need. We look forward to eating breakfast at the outside restaurant overlooking the ocean each morning. I was only disappointed about the lack of a beach area in front of the reserve section. You can walk down to the other section, and they had more space, but it was hard to find a chair. If you are looking for a hotel that provides active nightlife, this isn't the hotel for you. 
Highlights: Heated Pool, Excellent Service, Great Food, Top shelf alcohol, and they have Coors light.

reviews.author: Sharon P
reviews.title: Paradise at Paridisus!
reviews.text: A beautiful resort that we have been to many times being club Meliá members for 20 years. In all this time we have to say that Rodolfo was the best concierge we ever had. Attentive, proactive and most importantly helped solved a few concerns our friends had about their room quickly and efficiently. Cornelio at the cabana bed rentals was also excellent! Thank you for an amazing vacation!!

reviews.author: Companion565349
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation at the Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Overall the service and facilities are excellent. We were particularly impressed with housekeeping, our concierge Roldolpho and our bali bed provider Cornelio. The only problem was the maintenance of the building. Our friends room had a water leak that went on for days without action. Later they had a problem with cockroaches, perhaps due to the moisture in the room.

reviews.author: Elizabeth K
reviews.title: Birthdays Celebration at Paradisus Camcun
reviews.text:
The experience was fabulous from beginning to end. The Hotel is immaculate and all were professional and personable making us feel welcomed.
Enrique went above and beyond guiding us every step of our vacation, a treasure.
Miguel assisted us at the Cabana, making ours days poolside heavenly.
Highly recommend all to vacation at Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: Susan d
reviews.title: Once again Enrique was a pleasure
reviews.text: Enrique was our concierge and was so pleasant , helpful throughout the whole time we were there 4 days . He made all reservations and everything he explained was wonderful and went off beautifully. He is a very nice, caring,efficient young man . It was a pleasure to have him as our quide

reviews.author: Ziatenna
reviews.title: Sun sand pool food and Enrique!
reviews.text:
Beautiful hotel - we could not have been more pleased and pampered. Fabulous pools and of course the beach and cancun water speak for themselves. The food choices are endless and quite good for an all-inclusive. Top  shelf liquor at your disposal and all of the staff were remarkable, so very kind and helpful (we kept getting lost as this property is immense) 
We especially want to acknowledge Enrique, our concierge server, who went to great lengths to ensure we had everything we could need or want to make this vacation as lovely as it was.
Special thanks to him for all his professional and personal touches. He is truly an asset to Paradisus Cancun!!

reviews.author: Carmen L
reviews.title: Best experience ever.
reviews.text: The best experience was to have our own concierge Enrique. He made me feel like royalty and I’m booking again to the same place for the holidays. I loved everything . The cabanas, the food, the drinks, top of the line . The beds , the pillows and most of all all the extras touches.

reviews.author: Julia D
reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text: We had the most wonderful and relaxing time here! We had everything we could have wanted and were able to fully relax enjoy. Our concierge Enrique was so attentive and helpful, we felt like princesses. He helped us with all of our reservations on the first day, advised us well on what we needed to know, and was so kind. The pools are amazing, the folks working there are hard working and polite, the drinks were so fun, the food was great. I would love to come back!

reviews.author: Sara M
reviews.title: Wonderful stay at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay at Paradisus Cancun and chose the all-inclusive option. Obviously the location is idyllic, but beyond that, the service, food, amenities, and overall ambiance was exceptional. We stayed in the Melia members area, which was quiet and removed from the main hustle and bustle of the hotel. The members area also has its own espresso bar, manned by Luz, one of the nicest, friendliest people we met during our stay. The spa was wonderful and the escape rooms were very fun (extra charges for both of those). Highly recommend this resort if you’re traveling to Cancun!

reviews.author: d0cpag
reviews.title: Carole et Michel
reviews.text:
Tout parfait sauf manque de chaises sur la plage en face coté adulte, trop de BaliBed
Service réparation très rapide (toilette, coffre-fort)

reviews.author: Sheba Y
reviews.title: HEAVEN ON EARTH!!!! MUST GO
reviews.text:
We had an incredible experience, as always! We visited for our friend's bachelorette trip and stayed in the Reserve section, where the service exceeded all expectations. Cristian, our concierge, was amazing—he made everything incredibly smooth and stress-free, explaining everything clearly and with such warmth. The food and service here are top-notch, and it's clear they go above and beyond to care for each guest. We especially enjoyed breakfast at Sante at the Reserve every morning, with its stunning views and delicious chilaquiles. A big thank you to Miguel and Valeria at the pool, as well as Luis and Alejandro at the pool bar, for making our days so special. Ricardo at Ginger Bar was fantastic. RICARDO RICARDO !!!!!

Everyone made our stay unforgettable and we will be back for the grand reopening next year !!!!

reviews.author: M S
reviews.title: Awesome Weekend
reviews.text: Paradisus is a beautiful resort with awesome service. We stayed on the adults only side for a friends birthday and it was truly excellent. The staff was incredible. Waitress Valeria and all the staff at Sante were so immensely kind. They made great recommendations for dining. Destination concierge Christian really made it special. He made sure to let me know all the great things that were included like the day beds, hydrotherapy and sunset cruise. He helped our group of 10 to make reservations and even decorated the dinner table my friends birthday. Christian really went above and beyond and am so grateful for his commitment to making our trip memorable.

reviews.author: FellowTraveler56355
reviews.title: Fun times at Paradisus
reviews.text: Amazing! Had the most amazing time in Paradisus Cancun.  The ocean views were dreamy.  The entertainment staff was on point.  Latin night was so much fun!!! Had a blast dancing every night. On our last day Uriel and Bryan made our day with our honeydew melon gifts.  They were so sweet and attentive. Will definitely be back!!!

reviews.author: deewaldron
reviews.title: NEVER A DISAPPOINTMENT!!!
reviews.text: Wonderful girls trip!!  I took a friend with me on a trip to Paradisus.  I have been several times but she has never been.  It was a relaxing and fun trip.  Food was very good, service excellent.  If I had one complaint, it was that the resort is not handicapped accessible.  Lots of stairs with NO RAILINGS.  Hopefully this will be corrected with the planned full renovation.  A SPECIAL COMPLIMENT to RODOLFO , our concierge who was efficient and had everything done which we requested and always stopped by to insure that we didn’t need anything.  We have had good concierges and bad ones as we travel alot and he was one of the best!!!  DAVID at the Adult pool area in the Reserve section was also wonderful with a warm welcome and great service!   Looking forward to our next trip.  No disappointment here!!!!

reviews.author: Trish Q
reviews.title: Great vacation to relax and unwind
reviews.text: Resort is well maintained and clean. The food from the buffet is yummy and has healthy options. Staff and servers are very accommodating and friendly. Get family concierge if there isnt much price difference and maximize the benefits. Christian was a wonderful assistant. Would recommend.

reviews.author: Alexis T
reviews.title: Great Girls Trip
reviews.text: Paradisus is an amazing resort with friends, family, or as a couple! Came for a bachelorette - I had the best time. The food is amazing for an all inclusive and the drinks actually have alcohol. The resort is also beautiful. Definitely worth the price.

reviews.author: Maria R
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancún is a beautiful hotel in front of the beach with five pyramids and several good restaurants.
reviews.text:
All restaurants were excellent except for Flora that served us raw and cold octopus. 
Besides, the best plates required an extra charge. If you’re advertising an All Inclusive, it should be ALL.
There were several employees that went out of their way to help us. Ex: Charly Encinas. 
He was always available to make sure our stay was going smoothly. 
Ramiro and Johnny were very good waiters for breakfast.

reviews.author: Linda V
reviews.title: “We’ll Be Back” to the Paradisus
reviews.text: The ‘room with a view’ was amazing!  The staff was so friendly and attentive. They quickly became ‘friends’ that you said ‘Hola’ to in passing and hoped their day was going good too. Our concierge Enrique was top notch and made our stay memorable.  Bartender Luis at The Reserve Pool Bar was a blast and made our daily ‘mini beers’ a staple to start the day off right!  Our pool guys , Victor and David , were the best! Especially when dealing with an injury one of our group had,  and they made hanging out at the pool, a blast! We can’t thank Yolanda at check-in, Gabriella and Lorena at the Reserve Atrium Cafe, and the boys at Sante, a huge thanks for making our stay an absolute pleasure. Too many to mention but definitely a reason to go back to The Paradisus Cancun!  Muchas Gracias 🫶🏻

reviews.author: Nestor R
reviews.title: Excelente estancia
reviews.text: Excelente hotel, excelente los alimentos, muy ricos personal super amable, muy bonita playa, todos los restaurantes de nuestro agrado, solo faltan maas camastros porque a las 8 am ya estaban todos apartados, de ahí en fuera todo excelente

reviews.author: Areen A
reviews.title: Amazing service
reviews.text: The service and hospitality at this hotel were outstanding! The staff was incredibly friendly, attentive, and made every moment feel special. The rooms were comfortable and well maintained. Highly recommended! Rommel was amazing. His professionalism was very welcoming and appreciated.

reviews.author: Rob R
reviews.title: Meliá is my favorite resort in Mexico!
reviews.text: Fantastic resort. The staff were amazing and my concierge Chris was very helpful with making my arrangements while on property. The restaurants were fantastic, especially the Lemon Fish. The pools were clean and the views were great. We used the Otium tours to plan our excursions and I recommend them too.

reviews.author: Elia C
reviews.title: Una gran experiencia
reviews.text: Nuestra estancia en el hotel fue genial! La habitación con vistas al mar era espectacular. Tiene diferentes opciones de restaurantes, todos los que probamos muy buenos. Todo el personal muy amable y atento, en especial Alicia y Emma. Volvería!

reviews.author: Andrea T
reviews.title: Kanna excelente lugar
reviews.text: Kanna es un lugar increíble para pasar el día, la playa hermosa y todo el staff con la mejor disposición para ayudarte y que pases un muy buen rato. Todos son muy amables y amigables pero en especial Oscar y José nos trataron estupendo, son los mejores :)

reviews.author: Inma Inma
reviews.title: Un acierto
reviews.text:
Hemos pasado unos días en esta maravilla de hotel. Nuestra reserva era en la zona solo adultos. Desde nuestra llegada hasta el último momento nos hemos sentido como en casa y queremos agradecer en especial a Emmanuel Salias que estuvo pendiente todo el tiempo e hizo que nuestra estancia fuese inolvidable. 
Las vistas de la habitación, un lujo. Los espectáculos, actividades (mencionar a Néstor) y la comida también denotan que piensan en cada detalle.
Esperamos volver.

reviews.author: BoardingPass316815
reviews.title: Wonderful week away escaping the polar vortex!
reviews.text:
Had a fantastic stay at Paradisus Cancun! The food, staff, and location were all wonderful, making for a truly enjoyable trip. I’m sad to hear they’ll be closing for renovations in May—I know I won’t be able to afford this place once it reopens!

We decided to upgrade to The Reserve upon arrival, and it was absolutely worth it. The adults-only side offers a more exclusive experience, including a dedicated concierge to help plan your stay. Enrique, our concierge, was amazing—he took care of all our dinner reservations, helped connect us with a rep to book our tour to Chichen Itza, and even arranged a complimentary catamaran sunset cruise and free hydrotherapy at the spa.

Overall, it was a perfect mix of fun, rest, and relaxation. I would definitely come back!

reviews.author: Carmel A
reviews.title: Absolutely Beautiful!!!
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun exceeded my expectations! I've travelled extensively to many AI resorts, and this was one of my favorites. After reading some poor reviews, I was slightly concerned, but there was nothing to worry about! I will preface this review by mentioning that we upgraded to the Reserve, Adult's Only section and I would highly recommend this. 

The resort itself is gorgeous with high ceilings, running water, greenery and relaxing smells wafting through the air. Upon arriving, we were ushered off to a private check-in where we were encouraged to begin enjoying a cocktail and charcuterie snacks in the atrium while waiting. What a feeling of indulgence after the flight and transfer! Check-in was quick and seamless, after which our personal concierge (Mario) booked our restaurant reservations, bali beds and sunset cruise (included for Reserve guests) for the week. Mario would also provide daily updates on WhatsApp to remind us what was scheduled.

Our room was a Sunset view in building 5 - Reserve section. I know some reviews mentioned outdated and/or poor rooms, but ours was lovely. It was comfortable, well equipped and the shower had fantastic water pressure with hot water on demand! One note, when staying on the sunset side, some previous reviews complained about hearing bass thumping all through the night from a nightclub across the street. We could hear this if we happened to wake up and listened for it, but it did not cause us issues at all. In all honesty, the air conditioning in our room was louder. If you are somebody that needs total silence when you sleep, I'd recommend bringing earplugs. 

The next thing I will mention is the food, which was wonderful! We consider ourselves "foodies" and thought the presentation and taste was outstanding. Not every dish was our favorite, but that can happen anywhere, and I did my research before coming to ask others what their favorite appetizers, entree's and desserts were. Each restaurant was distinctive ,uniquely decorated, and very elegant. We belong to a dinner club, and often mentioned that what we were presented with was "dinner club worthy" Lol. We dined at Lemon Fish, Sante, Sal Steak Cave (also included for Reserve guests), Capella, Augamarina and Cielo. All were good, but Lemon Fish, Sante, Sal's and Cielo were my favorite in terms of food. Sante and Agamarina also got high marks for being outside with outstanding views. The menu is available via a QR code when you sit down, although you can get view full listing of menus on the Melia app to plan before hand. Most menu items are included, and the ones that are "extra charge" are clearly noted. I saw complaints about this as well, but virtually every resort offers upgrades for those that wish and the food/drink that was included was fabulous in my opinion. I will mention that we only ate in the main buffet once (dinner on the first night), and thought it was pretty average. Had we eaten there all week, this might be a different review. Each morning, we had breakfast and lunch in the reserve's atrium or Sante (the outdoor restaurant for reserve guests). The menus were varied and the breakfasts were absolutely delicious - extra bacon and mimosa's each morning - no problem! 

In fact, nothing seemed to be a problem at Paradisus. The staff in the reserve section was awesome, providing attentive restaurant and poolside service. Every expression of gratitude was met with "It's my pleasure". They were always smiling and gracious. I would like to highlight Louis and Lorena in the atrium, Cesar, Valeria and Fernardo at Sante and Victor and David, the pool concierges. Each one of them was delightful and made sure we were comfortable and satisfied. When staying in the reserve section, our concierge was able to reserve a poolside bali bed twice during the week. For the other days, you can put your name on a waiting list the day before you'd like it. We were lucky and were given beds for the entire week. Not only did Victor and David try to get us beds side by side with the other couple we traveled with, but they'd set us up each day and make sure we were comfortable. No sooner would you lay down, when one of the Sante servers mentioned above would come to see if they could bring a drink. The staff was really amazing. 

There was varied evening entertainment, but it seemed mostly geared to families, and my one recommendation would be to have a lounge with bands or singers that focuses on more laid back, adult entertainment. I've really enjoyed this at other resorts and it was the one thing I did miss a bit. There's nothing like a fabulous dinner followed by a nightcap with music.

The beautiful pool was heated and and the ocean/sand was absolutely stunning. This leads me to my only drawback of the vacation which was the weather. It was cloudy/rainy and very windy for most days we were there, which prevented us from enjoying the beach as much as I would have liked. Although this was disappointing, it certainly wasn't the resort's fault, and the staff really tried their best to make up for it by asking if their was anything they could bring to make us more comfortable. Food and drinks galore!!

I realize that had we not stayed in the Reserve section, we might have a different view of the rooms and resort itself. I understand that Paradisus Cancun will be closing for a year in June to complete renovations and upgrades. However, when they open again, I'd really love to go back!

reviews.author: mauricio k
reviews.title: Avoid this place. Must have reservations. Concierge service is terrible. Pools are freezing cold
reviews.text:
Worst place to stay in cancun. Having come to cancun for 20 years and staying at every level of hotel, all inclusive or a la carte, and this is by far the worst experience. All restaurants, except the crappy buffet, are reservation only. Which means, you have an early dinner, look for a cool place to grab a bite at 10 that is completely empty, NOPE they can't seat you. Mind you, they close at 11. There isn't a soul inside, there is nowhere else to go because the 4 other restaurants say the same thing. You can't eat anywhere without a reservation, hard stop.  Our check in happened at 5 first day, the "concierge" closes at 5, they're the only person who can book you anywhere. So your SOL, you're literally going to go home without getting seated at a restaurant.
Room service isn't bad, takes 90 minutes at least
Bars all close at 2300. Room service can't take you drinks after 2300

Ordered drinks at the bar, they swished some tap water in the cup after someone else had used, no soap, no washing. Great way to catch something unexpected and very disappointing.

This place really is terrible
Poorly organized, poorly run. The app doesn't work
The beach isn't swimmable.
The pools aren't heated. They're un-swimmable unless you enjoy 65 degrees water
You can't eat without a reservation.
The concierge that you pay for is a joke. Only available "9-4". Waste of $$
The rooms are run down. This place is shutting down in june allegedly, and rightly so. Hopefully they don't open back up because this really is a terrible use of your money. 0/5. Awful experience
The ONLY saving grace is a handful of the staff, the majority are honestly terrible. Joan was awesome to helping us get a table, armando at the luggage check in was excellent, but the one who really saved us this trip was Gaudencio. He made the experience bearable. His counterpart Francisco en la playa was also excellent. These are the people who make the hotel and made it bearable. If you can't cancel your reservation and you're stuck at this place, find these people and tip them because they will treat you excellently

reviews.author: Tristan H
reviews.title: Relaxing
reviews.text: We just stayed 5 days here and it was absolutely beautiful. We upgraded to the reserve side on check in and couldn’t have been happier. We got assigned Enrique as our concierge. He went above and beyond to make sure we were taken care of. Only downside we found is there is not a lot of activities or nightlife for adults on the resort.

reviews.author: Art G
reviews.title: Pleasant trip
reviews.text:
Service is wonderful.  We were in The Reserve area.  Luis. Lalo and Oscar were the best.  

The only negative is the extra charges to upgrade food.  If you pay for the upgrade it should be included.

Hotel needs updating but very clean and well maintained

reviews.author: Betsy_w61
reviews.title: Excellent dining experience
reviews.text:
Juan at Aqua marine provided an exceptional dining experience.
His recommendations were very helpful and delicious 
He suggested items for every course 
Service was well paced and gracious  by all of our servers 
I highly recommend visiting this restaurant

reviews.author: Jeanette M
reviews.title: Amazing 100/10
reviews.text: We went to Blue Agave for a birthday dinner. Our waiter Melvin Samuel was very friendly and attentive to our needs, staff was also very friendly. The food was very good, I ordered mexican tacos, ordered dessert, and had tequila, Highly recommend.

reviews.author: G M
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Best experience I had, came for a birthday and they were amazing. Samuel the server at Blue Agave was very good. They are very attentive and make sure you have everything you need for a good experience. I would recommend checking this place out

reviews.author: Diana P
reviews.title: An excellent resort experience.
reviews.text: I can’t say enough how beautiful this resort is. Beach is terrific and the ambiance of the building is stunning. Beds are comfy, showers are great. The food at Flora is stellar and the hostess Fanny was attentive and checked on us. Fanny was the best, most professional server. Was here with four girlfriends on a ‘decade trip- 50 and 60! Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Collette L
reviews.title: Hydrotherapy
reviews.text: Cristina made the spa experience so relaxing and enjoyable! The hydrotherapy rooms were the perfect end to a long day at the pool and included steam rooms and pools. I definitely recommend booking a session when you visit the Paradisus resort in Cancun.

reviews.author: douglife j
reviews.title: Paradisus holtel food so good

This has been.   one of the best experiences at a resort thus far in my travel endeavors.                                   A.                         +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++±+++++++++++++++++

reviews.author: Howard E
reviews.title: Wonderful place
reviews.text:
Our 6 th visit to Paradisus Cancun.  The staff makes it great.  David,  Victor And Galdino made our stay the best it can be.
We will return after reservations in June. 
Look  for Gabriella by the pool. 
 Recommend to stay in the Reserve , adults only section. A vacation made easy.

reviews.author: Nomad710986
reviews.title: Always enjoy our visit to Paraise!
reviews.text:
Don’t read the bad reviews. They have nothing to complain about. Go stay at the Reserve and enjoy. Shout out to Victor abd David who take care of the pool and Bali beds. Make you feel like kings and queens. 
Food was very good but service was exceptional. They can’t do enough. Pascual, Josue, Gabriela and Valeria stand out. Galadino is an incredible concierge. 
Don’t hesitate come stay !

reviews.author: Liv
reviews.title: good experience
reviews.text:
This place was absolutely gorgeous. The inside was stunning with it's high ceiling and creating a tropical paradise with plants hanging down from the floors. The beach was wonderful and it seemed like we have the cleanest beach when I walked around. 

I was not happy with the transportation service. It was hard to understand who do I call and/or email getting their free taxi service to and from the airport. They were slow to respond on weekends. They were not flexible if flights have changed. And they could not understand my friend and I were traveling with two separate flights. My flight got cancelled but my friend was able to get to Mexico. I had to pay for my own taxi ride because of the short notice and change. 

I recommend making a reservation at the seafood restaurant Agua Marina restaurant. 

Staff was very friendly except for the Otium taxi people when I arrived to the airport after my flight was cancelled. They were unhelpful and not friendly at all.

reviews.author: Oliver S
reviews.title: Los cafés estaban muy ricos
reviews.text: La señora Perla de la Cafetería fue muy amable. Siempre se aseguró de darnos el mejor servicio posible, el café estaba muy rico y los postres estaban deliciosos.  Además Luis fue nuestro mesero en LemonFish y nos brindó un servicio excelente. Es un muchacho muy atento y amable. Deberían de contratar más gente como ellos quienes nos hacen sentir bienvenidos.

reviews.author: Road141945
reviews.title: The greatest place to dine.
reviews.text: Our best experience in dining was at the Celio Italian restaurant.  Wilson was our Waiter and caused our experience to be the greatest. When you go there tell him Rick sent you.  He's the best waiter at this location, he catered to our every need and gave us great advise.

reviews.author: ChaineBlais
reviews.title: Ne correspond pas du tout à un 4 1/2
reviews.text: Vraiment déçu, nous avions payé plus pour avoir plus, mais avons eu beaucoup moins. La chambre n'était pas propre et ne correspondait pas aux photos publiées, entres autres, la douche dans le bain qui est peint en blanc, une seule chaise sur la terrasse, saleté sur les interrupteurs et la table. Piscine plus tranquille accessible seulement le matin et en début de pm, on nous a expulsé de cette piscine 5 jours sur 7 vers 14/15h pour préparer des fêtes privées du soir. Des serviettes qui traînent partout en tas parterre pour les deux premiers jours, ça s’est replacé après mais la première impression était gâchée. Pas assez de chaise et de parasol autour des piscines, les gens se volent les parasols. Vomis dans la piscine, 3 employés sont venus constater mais n'ont rien fait pour ramasser, même chose pour des bris de fournitures au courant de la semaine, ils constatent mais ne réparent pas. Piscine principale a brisé mais bien qu'elle ait réouvert, le niveau d'eau est resté plus bas que les conduits de filtration. Plusieurs soirs avec Party privés à l'extérieur ne donnant pas accès à l'espace extérieur et aussi à un des restaurants. Un braisé de bœuf servi avec un morceau contenant 100% de gras. Nous avons voulu assister à la réunion de Transat mais le représentant n'a pas fait la réunion planifiée, nous l'avons su lorsque nous attentions à l'endroit convenu avec un autre couple, il nous a contacté que par texto.

reviews.author: Stephanie S
reviews.title: ¡Lo repetiría mil veces!
reviews.text: Una de las mejores experiencias que he tenido, superó completamente mis expectativas. El lugar es increíble y todo durante mi estadía fue impecable. Resalto la calidad, atención y amabilidad del equipo de Guest Service. Cuento los días para volver.

reviews.author: astridbiebers
reviews.title: Muy malo
reviews.text: Los servicios son malos, los que te atienden atienden mal, la comida es mala y cierran muy temprano.

reviews.author: Luis Jesús L
reviews.title: Excelente staff y servicio
reviews.text: Excelente servicio de los chicos de atención al cliente, aclararon todas mis dudas y consiguieron muchas soluciones para mi familia y muy buenas recomendaciones en restaurantes, vistas inmejorables de la bahía, muy buen servicio en kanna. Sin duda repetiremos.

reviews.author: Shweta
reviews.title: Extremely cold water!!  Missing evening entertainment for young adults.
reviews.text: The resort is good and the beach is beautiful.  The pools have extremely cold freezing water which are not comfortable.   We took day pass to neighboring resort Hilton and loved it...all the pools are heated , lots of water activities and people enjoying the pools Disspointing.  Also the website brass about night life...other than few kids shows there's no entertainment for teenagers and young adults.

reviews.author: Elizabeth J
reviews.title: First time in paradise
reviews.text: Amazing time!! Staff was so helpful! We upgraded to the reserve and think it’s worth it the additional cost. Enrique our concierge  helped us with everything and booked our restaurants/activities. The whole team is amazing and sweet. Will definitely return

reviews.author: Vanessa M
reviews.title: Sal steakhouse
reviews.text:
We went to Sal Steakhouse throughout our stay. Rudi, our waiter was amazing and gave us great customer service and was great! It was my friends birthday and he bought out a variety of desserts with sparklers!
Went through the menu in detail and made the experience a good one!

reviews.author: Samira M
reviews.title: Restaurante Malva Cenas
reviews.text: Me encanto todoo la comida y el servicio además que le cantaron cumpleaños feliz🫶🏻 los mosos Ivónn y alberto súper amables! recomiendo el lugar por la ambientación y la atención en todo momento🫶🏻🫶🏻🫶🏻🫶🏻🫶🏻🫶🏻🫶🏻🫶🏻🫶🏻🫶🏻🫶🏻🫶🏻

reviews.author: Nicka B
reviews.title: Beautiful resort!
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful, and had a wonderful fragrance throughout the property.   My concierge Enrique was awesome and very attentive.  He even made sure I had beautiful decorations for my birthday.  Great staff, food, and drinks! Special shout out to Julio at the reserve bar & Oscar! I am a Meliá member so I’ll definitely be back! PS. If you’re traveling without kids, book the reserve all adult side!

reviews.author: Alex B
reviews.title: Awesome experience at Paradisius Cancun
reviews.text: I had an amazing time at Paradisus Cancun! The resort is stunning, with beautiful views and top-notch service. A highlight of my trip was enjoying delicious drinks prepared by Carlos at the bar—his skill and friendly attitude truly elevated the experience. From the relaxing atmosphere to the excellent hospitality, it was unforgettable. I can’t wait to return!

reviews.author: Seaside36643261901
reviews.title: Paradisius
reviews.text: The bar close the main pool is a unique experience with Carlos and his team! They all know what they do and make me happy each time I going see them. To all people who's looking to have fun with a handsome service there is your place! Leave your appreciation!

reviews.author: Mary Z.
reviews.title: Behemoth of Mediocrity.
reviews.text:
If you want the Instagram pictures and are willing to pay up the @55 for it, this could be your spot. Friends and I stayed for 4+ days for an event and would not willingly return. 

PROS: Beautiful views, in-person staff is very attentive, convenient, for relaxation

CONS: Broken rooms, unresponsive staff through the app/online, incredibly mediocre food and watered down drinks, not good for work

- Hot water was not available upon check in, had to speak to the front desk about it
- Toilet seat did not fit the porcelain throne (I really did try to make it fit, but this detail was missed) 
- Missing shower hooks so shower curtain was only half of what it could be, so water spilled everywhere. This was resolved through in-person complaining at the front desk. 
- Body wash was empty upon check in
- Cracks in the tub that moved upon placing weight on it 
- They recommended you utilise their app/online to request amenities and service but   all the requests went no where and stuff was never delivered/fixed. It was only fixed once I walked back to the front desk to discuss our requests
- The food. THE FOOD. :( Not worth it if your palette is any bit refined. For USA, if you're from either of the coasts, this is not up to your standards. If you're from middle America, you could think this is pretty good. Flavour for a lot of the restaurants was bland and they sometimes compensated for it by making other dishes incredibly salty. High school me would have been impressed because everything tasted like college me prepared it. Adult me was very disappointed and our group of friends also confirmed this. 
- Outlets are nowhere near the placement of desks/tables and the lighting did not light up desks/tables, quite useless for work purposes 
- Personal preference, why have spaces for decor but not have anything in them? Our room had an empty shelves so we brought in our own decoration to fill it. 

For a supposed 5 star hotel, I expected better. Now I know better.

reviews.author: 960rafael
reviews.title: Muy mala actitud del personal
reviews.text: Muy poco personal para atender las áreas , poco tecnología para hacer reservas de la cenas , personal con mala actitud en general y nada colaborativos  , pocos camastros y no hay meseros en las áreas de alberca y/o playa , muchos pagos extras para acceder a algún lugar para estar en la playa . En general el hotel ya está viejo , aunque si están limpias las áreas . Horarios reducidos en los bares .

reviews.author: Sukyoung L
reviews.title: Good .Friendly. Good for Family
reviews.text: One restaurant that is Cielo, which is serving for classic mexican dish .Most people very friendly also special sence they have .Who has  birthday friends celebrated by them . .Especially Odon whose works he was very nice for us .Thank you Odon

reviews.author: Dee P
reviews.title: LEMON FISH Restaurant
reviews.text: Thank you to Jesus, our wonderful waiter for our dinner at Lemon Fish. Professional service. Great menu. Jesus greeted us with a smile, accommodated our meal requests. Love the ambiance of this restaurant.   Make sure to book it during your stay.

reviews.author: Mirella M
reviews.title: Jesus at Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Jesus at Lemon Fish was an amazing and helpful waiter !! The food was delicious and Jesus made our stay wonderful. Very clean waiter… with a great smile and laugh. Cheers to Jesus ! Thank you Jesus…  you are the best ! We will be back this week to visit our new friend !

reviews.author: Sabrina S
reviews.title: Best time in Mexico <3
reviews.text: We had the best times, the adults only are was so relaxing the service was very good especially Miguel was the best waiter ever, he always took care of us and our drinks ! Very nice beach and drinks and good activities. We love to come back very soon!

reviews.author: Kayleigh S
reviews.title: Amazing winter break
reviews.text:
We came to Paradisus to get some winter sun and we were not disappointed. The service was great from start to finish. 

We arrived relatively late and were told that our room with two beds had been given away. This is a disappointing start as we were offered a room with only one bed which didn’t work for us at all. When we went down to complain, Oscar could not have been more helpful and got us moved into a double room the next day. there really isn’t a bad view in the hotel (you get the sunrise and sunset on either side). However, if you’re a reserve guest and an early riser I would recommend the sea view. The maids were great and kept our room very tidy and our mini fridge well stocked. 

We spent a lot of time at the reserve pool and the team there were great! The waiters kept us well watered with drinks all day. The pool team is great too, they always made sure that we had enough towels and that we had an umbrella if we needed it. I did a few of the activities in the day which were well run too - the Mayan blessing was a real highlight. 

The food was generally fantastic! Agua Marina was a real highlight - I ordered the Lobster tail and it was divine! We had some mixed experiences at the buffet - but did not go often enough as we wanted to make use of the restaurants on offer. On Thanksgiving, the hotel hosted a surf and turf night which was so amazing - five courses of amazing food and fantastic ambiance. 

We did the sunset tour on offer as part of the hotel and it was great! We got this for free as part of our package and it was great to see the lagoon. 

A special thanks goes out to Rossana - our concierge during our stay. She was always prompt and so so helpful. She really helped to make the experience. We were told she was the best - and they were right! 

¡Muchas gracias!

reviews.author: Giuditta G
reviews.title: Warning: the hotel is closing for 2+ years so the service is currently TERRIBLE!!!
reviews.text:
I don’t usually leave negative reviews but I actually want to help families and hard working people SAVE their hard earned money! Do NOT book this hotel. We found out the company is renovating and going to CLOSE in May 2025 for renovations. They have let go of staff, their service is absolutely terrible not just ok but TERRIBLE. They tell you to get things yourself. We even upgraded to the adults only side and it was still terrible service. The rooms on the regular side are sub par - our upgrade was much nicer. Also they don’t ask you if you want more food at restaurants, they want you to just leave. You can tell the staff isn’t happy except LUIS the bartender whose always awesome. The staff is trained to give you less. There’s always options of upgrades on the menus to pay for. They have overpriced everything to make a dollar. They no longer care if patrons are happy since they’re closing down and they just want to take as much as they can get before closing down and becoming a new place. It’s literally a joke. The hydro spa was a nice surprise at least. The food was NOT TASTY at all! It’s so suprising because my friend stayed in March at Grand Park Royale cancun it was incredible service, infinity pool, amazing service - and great great food. Very upscale and awesome. The room service was also great but at this hotel it was disgusting. Oh and the nightlife is so disappointing here. No shows. No teams to guide us to other things. It was so random people were so bored at night. It was just super strange all around. Thank God there was good weather and wonderful beach. 

I really feel bad for families that are going to spend a premium to stay here only to experience all of this and just wanted to share to try to help families pick a different place. 

Apparently the reviews previously are good because it WAS spectacular before. But now before they close they really don’t care anymore at all. Save your money. Invest it where you’ll have wonderful food and service.

reviews.author: Ina W
reviews.title: Top Urlaub
reviews.text: Guter Service, sehr freundliche Mitarbeiter. Besonders Miguel hat sich gut um uns gekümmert. Essen war immer sehr lecker. Große Auswahl an verschiedenen Restaurants. Insgesamt hatten wir einen super tollen und erholsamen Urlaub und würden immer wieder herkommen.

reviews.author: NIka
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text:
An amazing time at Paradisus, I was celebrating a milestone birthday without my twin, we reached out to different hotels and couldn’t find the right person to help. We finally got a hold of Hernandez who was our events coordinator. He went above and beyond. He was patient with every demand and ask we made. When we finally met him in person he was even more attentive. He made my sister and I feel special and was crucial
To our even being a success. I would go back here and would 1000 percent recommend not just the hotel but If you are having an event ask for Hernandez Omar. He was amazing. Thank you for your excellent attention to detail.

reviews.author: Michelle S
reviews.title: Thank you Ernesto!
reviews.text:
We came here on our trip to Cancun and went to Lemon Fish on our last night. Our server Ernesto at Lemon Fish was very  attentive and understanding to our questions about the different cuisines! He made us laugh too! 

As for the food, it  was delicious and fresh. 10/10 would recommend for people to come to Lemon Fish! 

Y gracias Ernesto!

reviews.author: kevin g
reviews.title: Increíble
reviews.text: El hotel es increíble e inmenso, se preocupa mucho por el tema del medio ambiente de ahí que hayan unas cuantas reglas para fumadores. El personal es muy atento y servicial, las actividades están divertidas y tiene una variedad de restaurantes para poder elegir, únicamente hay que reservar. 100% recomendable.

reviews.author: Julie C
reviews.title: Best service ever
reviews.text: The waiters are so friendly and helpful. I love their attitudes and hospitality. In the reserve look for Miguel, Bernardo and Yamil. Of course jose and Charlie ((jc) are one of a kind. Juts love the hotel staff!!!! And the view is pure paradise!

reviews.author: Steve R
reviews.title: Paradisus Paradise
reviews.text: The shining stars at the Paradisus Cancun are the people that work there.  Yvonne and Alberto at Malva Dinner were exceptional and one of the reasons we keep going back.  Ignacio at Malva breakfast is another fabulous employee.  Always request him at breakfast.  If you are spending time at the main pool, Jose and Balthazar rock it.  What a great time.  The food and amenities are very good but it's the staff that brings it home.

reviews.author: Laura N
reviews.title: Fine Mexican Dining
reviews.text:
Dinner at Cielo was fantastic and Mesro made it even better. Mesro was extremely attentive to our needs and offered suggestions to fit our tastes. 
The atmosphere and music was perfect for dinner and complementary to the food. 
I highly recommend

reviews.author: Fabiola T
reviews.title: Excelente atención
reviews.text: Jorge Ramires y Miguel nos atendieron súper bien excelente quedamos encantados con su atención y sobretodo con los chefs que nos cocinaron súper rico Karen Marcos de Lenin Fish regresaríamos mil veces más a este hotel su personal es súper atento

reviews.author: Santiago G
reviews.title: Restaurantes maravillosos
reviews.text: Lemon fish excelente restaurante muy buen servicio!!!! Ernesto magnífico mesero la comida no decepciona y buena variedad de sabores!!!………………………………………… ………………………… …………………………………… ………………………… …………………………………… ………………………… …………………………………… …………………………

reviews.author: Jaime C
reviews.title: The best culinary experience
reviews.text:
Dinner at Lemon Fish at Melia Cancun was the best culinary experiences I’ve had. Jorge and Miguel were amazing hosts and provided superior customer service. I travel for food and even while being indecisive about my meal all suggested dishes were so good and equally pleasing to the eye!

It was a  all around great experience with food, drink, customer service and ambiance. Special cudos to the chefs who prepared these creative amazing dishes.  Dinner at Lemon Fish Melia Cancun was definitely the highlight in of my trip. 5+ stars!!!

Thanks Jorge for making it a great night!

reviews.author: Escape15676559177
reviews.title: Cumpleaños en cancun
reviews.text: Restaurant Mañva del.hotel paradisus cancun. Muy buena comida y la  Atencion de ivonn y Albetp anfotriones excelentes. Festejando cumpleaños con un delicipso pastel de almendra.  Gracias por la tencion recibida y su amabilidad. Recomendado.ampliamente.

reviews.author: mn10qtm
reviews.title: Simplemente perfecto!
reviews.text: El hotel es maravilloso, la zona The Reserve con vistas al mar y el amanecer es espectacular, la playa es maravillosa, el azul turquesa con arena blanca... perfecto. Pero sin duda nos enamoró el servicio y el personal, todos los hoteles a partir de ahora seran poco tras haber estado aquí... David (pool concierge) y Jacob (Santé) en la piscina The Reserve hicieron nuestros días perfectos, pero sin duda Emmanuel es nuestro motivo para querer volver a este hotel mil veces más, desde antes de llegar y durante toda nuestra estancia no ha podido ser más amable y tratarnos fenomenal, jamás podremos agradecerle lo suficiente!! Cualquier mínimo detalle. Sin olvidarnos en general de todo el equipo de Paradisus Cancún que son maravillosos, Astrid y Alicia, Diego García y todo el team es el valor más grande que tiene este hotel, no tenemos palabras para expresarlo, sois geniales!! Mil millones de gracias.

reviews.author: Aya R
reviews.title: Awesome service
reviews.text: Lemon and Fish is a fantastic restaurant! George and Miguel offer exceptional service, always hospitable and attentive to every detail. The chefs are incredibly skilled, delivering amazing dishes with fresh flavors. Every visit feels special thanks to the great atmosphere and team. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Paola A
reviews.title: deliciosas bebidas sin alcohol despite ley de romero y albahaca, muchas gracias por el servicio y excelente por huracán!
reviews.text: muchas gracias por las bebidas en mocktails en el sport bar de abraham, a pesar de ley seca por la contingencia nos pudieron preparar bebidas deliciosas sin alcohol, de romero y albahaca, muchas gracias por el servicio y excelente servicio!!

reviews.author: Lindsey M
reviews.title: The best Resort Experience
reviews.text: Where to even began… the Paradisus Resort will be definitely my top number one pick for a resort to stay at in Cancun. Reason being is the food, scenery, and most of all the staff.  Starting with Oscar, Bernardo, Victor, Jacob, and  our wonderful bartender Luis, these men have the most wonderful energy, personality, always smiling, made us feel at home, and just all  around made us want to book our next trip here. We definitely will miss them! Yamil, was the smiling face you see in the morning when walking to get your coffee from him on the adult side, who was absolutely fantastic. Gabby and Salvadore at Ginger 2 Bar, if you want laughter and wonderful drinks they are the ones you need to go too! They are the nighttime life who truly takes care of you. And last but not least you have Arce our server at lemon fish, genuine care and just all around phenomenal! We love this resort and will miss it a ton!!!!

reviews.author: André C
reviews.title: Cielo restaurante
reviews.text: Comida espetacular especialmente o cordeiro que junto com as quesadillas fazem uma combinação fantástica. Fomos atendidos pelo Moisés que foi um garçom excelente com extrema simpatia e agilidade, auxiliando nos pedidos dos pratos e em suas explicações

reviews.author: Suzanne V
reviews.title: Otra vacación memorable en el paradisus Cancún
reviews.text:
Este es nuestro 5to año consecutivo que vamos a este hotel con amigos, este año eramos 10 pero otros años hemos sido mas. La comida y el servicio son espectaculares y por eso hemos repetidos tantas veces. De verdad nos atienden super bien.
¡Toda nuestra estadía fue increible!
Astrid de "guest experience" nos trató excelente.  
Giovanni siempre pendiente que la experiencia en cada restaurante fuera de nuestro agrado. 
Cada momento del día era especial. 
El café de la mañana, y el de la tarde, en el Nespresso café con Alejandro y Fer, ellos siempre alegres y simpáticos. 
Los desayunos variados y super ricos en Malva con personas como Ramiro, Ygnacio, Ariadna, Rafael y Calendario ocupándose de que todo estuviera como nos gusta. 
El nuevo restaurante Flora, nos encantó el primer día asi que repetimos, ahi Cinthia, Fanny y Tere nos complacieron divinamente.
También probamos el restaurante Santé y la comida fue deliciosa y Bernardo super atento y cordial.
En el restaurante Cielo, el chef David y el mesero super amables y muy buena la comida.
En la playa, Jhandi y Gaudencio muy buen servicio a pesar del calor y el largo recorrido para obtener las bebidas. 
En el área de la piscina, Roberto y Laura nos atendían para el almuerzo y/o snacks de la tarde, no se puede ser mas amable y servicial. 
En Lemon fish Jesús nos atendió con mucho entusiasmo después de un día encerrados debido a "Helene". 
Todos los días ibamos a ver lo que pudieramos de los shows variados y al final ibamos al ginger bar, ahi Gabby y sus compañeros, con su sonrisa y actitud siempre positiva nos atendiendieron y ella sabia exactamente lo que cada uno de nuestro grupo de 10 personas quería.
El hotel, principalmente en la parte de afuera de los edificios ya necesitan un poco de mantenimiento. Los cuartos muy bien como siempre. Hubo mucha lluvia debido al paso de la tormenta tropical "Helene" y entró mucha agua al hotel. Sin embargo, el staff del hotel trabajó muy duro para solucionar los problemas, De verdad que se notó como todos hicieron los que les tocaba y mas para solucionar problemas y el jueves despues de la tormenta todo de vuelta a la normalidad debido al esfuerzo del staff.
¡Nos sentimos realmente de vacaciones!

reviews.author: Jo L
reviews.title: Lemonfish Restaurant
reviews.text: The restaurant, Lemonfish, was really good we got the green shrimp ceviche, some sushi rolls,  the shibuya short rib, and pork ribs, and the sweet corn panna cotta, all delicious!! JESUS was our server and he was so lovely and attentive. Great service and great food!

reviews.author: Suzete O
reviews.title: Hotel lindo, porém internamente bastante danificado. Equipe de restaurantes muito cansados e sem a simpatia que tem os M
reviews.text: Minha terceira vez em Cancún. Hotel lindo, necessitando de muitíssimos reparos. Muy débil o atendimento dos funcionários.muitos estavam  Mal humorados, cara feia, reclamones. Quede encantada com a equipe de Guest servicié Israel , me trató com muitíssima atenção e resolveu tudo que lhe pedi. Simplesmente me fizeram sentir mais atendidas e me deram a atenção que todo turista merece.

reviews.author: Patricia P
reviews.title: Ginger bar 2. The best bar for everybody.🥂
reviews.text: The best bartender in the resort!! I recommend Gabby and salvador from the ginger bar. Those guys are amazing. They made our vacation the BEST!!! The best drinks🍻🍹🥤. Hopefully come soon and see the same bartender and the same waitress.!!!

reviews.author: Alexandra A
