reviews.title: Dinner at Cielo
reviews.text:
Samuel was our server at Cielo and was fabulous! Great food, great atmosphere and Samuel was so attentive! He made sure that we were enjoying everything and made our experience fabulous. We’ll be back! 
Paradisus has been the most amazing resort!

reviews.author: Ginnie M
reviews.title: Such attentive staff!
reviews.text:
Samuel at Cielo was incredible. Made our last night so special. And the food at Cielo was the best at the resort. 

Try out the corn and the lamb dish, and ask for a spicy margarita. Everyone is so friendly and welcoming throughout our stay, including Didier at the pool who made our whole stay and days by the pool perfect.

reviews.author: Gabriela P
reviews.title: Excelente atención y playa increíble
reviews.text:
Excelente servicio! En Especial Gaudencio y Ghandy en la playa y Laura y Roberto en la alberca. 
Y increíbles las atenciones de Astrid y Giovanni. Increíbles vacaciones con amigos. 
El mar espectacular y sin sargazo. Buena comida y buen servicio.

reviews.author: susant123787
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun was Paradise?
reviews.text: You never know what to expect when you try a new resort.  Being a frequent traveler, I can tell you this resort did not disappoint. The all-inclusive fee was one of the lowest I've seen, so I was skeptical, but OMG all 8 restaurants had tremendous selections that were just mouthwatering.  The liquor served was all name brand and poured with a heavy hand.  Did I mention the Gelato Bar and Personal pan pizza/Calzone restaurant poolside?  Pool service, providing food and drinks, around the huge pools was amazing.  There was also a 24-hour coffee bar with tasty pastries/sandwiches and a sports bar.  Nightly entertainment and daily craft activities added to the fun.  Our suite was huge with a bedroom, 2 full bathrooms, kitchen, living room, and 3 balconies (one with a jacuzzi).  The mini bar was stocked daily with beer, soda, water and snacks that could be tailored to your preferences.  I could go on and on, but I will conclude with saying the staff is a real gem of this resort.  They all treat everyone like royalty.  Ramiro, one of the breakfast buffet waiters actually carried our plates of food to our table, pulled out our chairs, and kept the mimosas coming.  Ignacio also one of our breakfast buffet waiters was always very cordial and helpful.  Some of the poolside waiters that took good care of us were Laura, Irinia and Asuncion.  Karina at the Ginger bar was most accommodating.  Shame on me that I didn't get more names, as I said everyone was just great!

reviews.author: tatiana b
reviews.title: No recomiendo este hotel
reviews.text:
No fue positiva la estancia en este hotel. 
Realmente es un hotel que para lo que cuesta está muy descuidado. 
No tiene aire acondicionado en el hotel, solo en la habitación y eso que muy regular. 
Hace un calor impresionante todo el tiempo y no prenden para nada el AC
La comida no me gustó , las habitaciones están Viejas y la ducha muy horrible, se moja todo el baño cuando se abre. 
Todo lo cierran 11:00 pm.  No hay donde tomar algo. 
No recomiendo para nada este hotel. No volveré,

reviews.author: Genna H
reviews.title: Incredible place to stay!
reviews.text: We had the best time! So many incredible people work here, we always had great service, the food was always delicious, vibes were great, and all employees are so kind! Special shout outs to - Raddai, Ian, Carlos, Orlando, Inez, Daniel, and Leo. Couldn't recommend it enough!

reviews.author: Yazmin Anaís Z
reviews.title: El servicio ha sido pésimo.
reviews.text:
La experiencia ha sido pésima, el trato del personal del hotel hacia mí y mis amigas ha sido lamentable. Hemos tenido demasiados problemas con este hotel. 
Dañaron nuestro coche y no se quieren hacer responsables, nos pusieron un brazalete que tiene menos beneficios que el que realmente adquirimos y ahora no nos hacen el cambio de brazalete para gozar de los beneficios que sí pagamos.

Sí, el hotel es bellísimo pero pagar tanto dinero para no gozar de casi ningún beneficio no es algo satisfactorio.
Constantemente pedimos ayuda con los problemas que se volvieron repetitivos  y nadie nos ha ayudado hasta hoy.
Todos dicen que tomarán el caso para ver que se pude hacer pero hasta este momento no nos resuelven nada. 

Llegamos el domingo 15 de septiembre de 2024 y ya pedimos nuestro rembolso de los días restantes ya que pagamos hasta el día 22 de septiembre de 2024 y siguen sin darnos una respuesta. Nosotras ya no queremos estar aqui, el personal es demasiado horrible y nadie te explica nada.
 Nos acercamos con un muchacho que dice ser el gerente de socios (porque cabe mencionar que tenenos una membresía, somos socias del hotel y aún así nos tratan así) Pero ser socios de este hotel no vale la pena, él nos dijo que lo único que podíamos hacer era poner una reseña en esta app y escribimos aquí para que a nadie más le pase lo que a nosotras.

reviews.author: Alex B
reviews.title: Great Dinner At The Lemon With Jorge
reviews.text: Incredibly tasty dinner and Jorge’s service was incredible! He curated a delicious ensemble of food. The tuna tacos were the best and the green shrimp ceviche is highly recommended. The service and ambiance was outstanding and the breeze made it feel like you were on the ocean.

reviews.author: Alfonso J
reviews.title: El mejor servicio en toda mi experiencia hotelera, desde que llegue, todos gan sido super atentos en todas las areas, pe
reviews.text: El mejor servicio en toda mi experiencia hotelera, desde que llegue, todos gan sido super atentos en todas las areas, pero quisera felicitar  shade que me atendió en la cena en el restaurante Flora, donde me resolvio todas mis dudas e incluso me dionrecomendaciones para cenar, simplemente excepcional!!

reviews.author: LordEthan
reviews.title: UK Review - Important points for British travellers with ALLERGENS
reviews.text:
This review is primarily for British/UK travellers as we have different needs/wants when travelling abroad. 

To start you’re welcomed with tequila shot and asked if you’re celebrating anything. If you are they’ll offer a voucher book for massages and food options for things outside of the package you’ve already paid for. The catch is that the next morning before you’ve seen the hotel or experience the hotel in any depth you have to sit through a timeshare presentation. I won’t bore you with the details but it’s a 20 year commitment costing about 40k for a one week holiday once a year. Whether or not you think it’s worth your time to sit through this, the timing was horrible as not only are you jet lagged, they’re asking for a deposit of 3-5k immediately and then a monthly payment of about £200-500. That is insane. 

The hotel itself is fine, there’s an option to get the ‘reserve’ package which upgrades your room and allows you to another part of the pool area and one or two other restaurants. It costs about $50 USD per night extra and to be honest it’s absolutely not worth it unless the hotel is super busy which it wasn’t when we went. 

THE FOOD. 

The hotel has a good number of decent restaurants to choose from. It also has a buffet and this is where the experience really is disappointing. The breakfast and lunch food is either lukewarm or cold. It is never hot. It was always lukewarm or cold. Even the fried foods were cold. Like not even remotely warm to the touch. 

Also you’re asked if you have any allergies. One of us had a nut allergy and although we told the staff that we had a nut allergy, on SEVERAL occasions we were brought food with almonds or pistachios and had to send it back so I cannot recommend this place if you have a severe food allergy. It’s simply not safe. The food is not labeled correctly and the staff don’t understand that a nut allergy means all nuts can be dangerous. 

If you can get over the constant upselling (I respect the hustle) it’s a decent hotel but they make you feel a little bit ‘less than’ sometimes.

reviews.author: Angel
reviews.title: Increíble experiencia
reviews.text: Durante mi estancia en Paradisus Cancún, tuve el placer de disfrutar varias tardes inolvidables en el restaurante Sante, ubicado a la orilla de la playa. La experiencia fue simplemente increíble, en gran parte gracias a la atención de Jacob Díaz, quien se aseguró de que cada visita fuera perfecta. Su amabilidad y conocimiento de la gastronomía hicieron que cada recomendación fuera un acierto. El ambiente relajado junto al mar, combinado con la deliciosa cocina y el servicio impecable de Jacob, hicieron que cada comida fuera un verdadero placer. Si buscan una experiencia culinaria excepcional en Cancún, Sante es el lugar, y Jacob es quien se encargará de hacerla memorable. ¡Volveré sin duda!

reviews.author: Diana M
reviews.title: Lemon fish
reviews.text:
Excelente servicio por parte de Arce en restaurant Lemon Fish, la comida está deliciosa y la recomiendo ampliamente.
En esta ocasión pedi un salmón y un postre con chocolate que tiene un sabor inigualable. Definitivamente volvería a cenar aquí mil veces

reviews.author: Thaís M
reviews.title: Lemon fish restaurante
reviews.text:
Experiência gastronomica maravilhosa, comida otima, vários drinks e atendimento excepcional! Jorge e Miguel são sensacionais, nos atenderam super bem a noite toda!
As chefes Karen e Silvia cozinham maravilhosamente bem!
Experimentem!!!

reviews.author: Alexandre C
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Jorge and Miguel are the best, very friendly and efficient guys! Very great expeirencie. The meals and the drinks were superb. We had tequila and a gift beer as a gift at the end.  Thank you for the experience. Karen and Silvia also nailed it ate the kitchen!

reviews.author: CARLOS IVAN D
reviews.title: Flora espectacular
reviews.text: El restaurante flora tienes la mejor experiencia culinaria. Los alimentos de alta cocina. El personal es una maravilla. Santos tiene el mejor servicio, una calidez y cordialidad que hace la experiencia única así como todo el personal como Fanny y la capitana. El mejor restaurante de especialidad.

reviews.author: Georgina C
reviews.title: Great service at Blueagave
reviews.text: Blueagave is a Mexican restaurant at the hotel Paradisus. My friends and I received great service from our server Alberto. Very friendly, attentive and accomodating. Great beef tacos and loved the guava mojito. If you love spicy sauces try their haberno and also their garlic harbeno olive sauce. Paired great with the tacos.

reviews.author: Kellie M
reviews.title: Lemon Fish Restaurant
reviews.text: The food was excellent and the atmosphere was delightful. Very cozy. The short rib was absolutely amazing and service was wonderful. We had sushi, green shrimp ceviche, tacu tacu, and short rib Nikkei. All was fantastic. No complaints. Shout out to Arce, our server!!

reviews.author: ekim805
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: The Lemon Fish Restaurant was very delicious. I had the best experience. The server Daniel went above and beyond and made my experience phenomenal. I would highly recommend this restaurant and would highly recommend you ask Daniel to serve you!

reviews.author: Shiekia W
reviews.title: Live band karaoke
reviews.text: Live band Karaoke was excellent. Eduardo was go encouraging and fun and the band was amazing!  We sang on our first night there and Eduardo sang right along with us because he knew we were nervous. Uriel, on the entertainment team was also so welcoming. I would advise embracing the nerves and singing in front of strangers lol

reviews.author: SergiR
reviews.title: Restaurante Cielo genial!
reviews.text: Cenando en el restaurante Cielo en el hotel Melia Paradisus, nos han atendido genial, en especial Melvin, un encanto. Volveremos. Un autentico restaurante mejicano. Los tacos muy buenos, y la resra de platos también. Un gran descubrimiento.

reviews.author: Shanelle E
reviews.title: Girls trip to Cancun, Mexico Sept. 2024
reviews.text: The holiday was honestly perfect! The resort has 9 different restaurants so every night was something different, all delicious! The waiters were sooo friendly, taught us Spanish words and always checked for additional things that weren’t on the menu. They cleaned the room every day without fail and replaced all the drinks with abundance. Raddai and Laila in the entertainment team were amazing! They were soo friendly and welcoming!  Honestly all in all our holiday was amazing and it wouldn’t have been as great without all the staff in the hotel!

reviews.author: Kimberly M
reviews.title: Fabulous for ladies trip or family trip
reviews.text:
We were on a Ladies trip and stayed in the All-Inclusive Reserve Adults Only area.  It was so fun and relaxing.  There are 5 pyramids and we were in pyramid 5.  Most of the restaurants are in pyramid 3.  As a Reserve client, you have access to the entire resort. You also have a concierge.  Our concierge was Rocio and she was fantastic!  She booked our massages, specific restaurants, any reservation that we needed.  I wanted ice and it arrived 10 minutes after contacting Rocio. I would definitely request her when we go again.

We had a bali bed everyday we were there.  Out best attendant was Valeria.  She was kind, funny and very attentive.

There were many activities during our stay.  You could join the activities or just enjoy the ocean breeze and top shelf cocktails.  They do have classic American sodas,  excellent tequila, Jameson whiskey, Ketel One, Grey Goose, etc.   

There were having issues with the A/C in certain parts of the resort but our room was fine.  The room was nice and the bathroom was large and came with all the amenities needed for a stay.  There was a refrigerator stocked and a snack tray in the room.

We definitely will go back and I want to take my family for a long weekend trip.

reviews.author: Johnzags
reviews.title: Birthday trip
reviews.text: We spent my wifes birthday @ our favorite place in the world, Paradisus Cancun. Our butler Galdy went out of his way to make my wifes birthday a memorable experience.  The room was decorated perfectly and the small gifts were really amazing. Galdy has been our butler and now our friend for several years now and he reslly goes above and beyond for his guests. Cheers to Galdy and the entire crew @ Paradisus cancun for always making our visits so amazing!

reviews.author: Mo K
reviews.title: Great place thanks to Oscar and Victor.
reviews.text: We have been to Cancun so many times . We absolutely loved the Reserve section at the hotel . Oscar from Santee restaurant and pool area made our trip so worth while he and Victor at the cabana towel area they are the reason we will come back again and will recommend the hotel . The blue agave and santee were our favorite places to eat .

reviews.author: Elva B
reviews.title: Cena japonesa peruana
reviews.text: Ernesto y Marco hicieron de la experiencia de la cena inolvidable excelente servicio y comida deliciosa pedimos comida de 3 tiempos, las entradas deliciosas el salmon y beef de excelente calidad 100 recomendable terminamos con el postre de pastel de chocolate y mancha deliciosos tambien

reviews.author: Jaime C
reviews.title: Atención al cliente
reviews.text: Buena y dedicada atención  en el hotel, sobre todo en el restaurante Lemon&Fish. Mención especial al servicio prestado por Arce. Buena organización y buena comida japonesa y peruana. Arce en concreto ha sido muy servicial toda la noche atento por como nos sentíamos y como nos estaba pareciendo la comida

reviews.author: lorenzo m
reviews.title: El mejor camarero
reviews.text:
El servicio de Arce fue el mejor de todo el hotel. Muy atento amable y muy buena persona. El restaurante muy bonito y espectacular.
Lo que menos me justo la habitación triple. Muy vieja y algo estropeada.
Y la ducha con muy poco caudal de agua y los locales cierran muy pronto.

reviews.author: Geovanni F
reviews.title: Espectacular
reviews.text:
En general el hotel es agradable, el acceso es fácil y rápido a todas las áreas (a pesar de que es grande). 
La comida es muy buena, el buffet malva tiene opciones para todos los gustos.
Nos tocó buena época para visitar, el mar estaba hermoso y con los colores que impresionaban. Hubo diferentes espectáculos y música pero lo que más disfruté fue un día que hicieron un karaoke con músicos, es la primera vez que veo eso y sin duda me divertí demasiado. 
Todo el personal tiene una excelente actitud sin duda recomiendo este hotel, los animadores a diferencia de otros hoteles son respetuosos y agradables.

reviews.author: Jacqui O
reviews.title: Lo mejor de lo mejor🫶💗😜
reviews.text: Visitamos Paradisus Cancún y conocí a Jhonatan el mejor bartender del resort. Igual quiero dar gracias a Gaby y Karina del mismo bar. Son los mejores. Lo que hace que unas vacaciones sean excelentes es conocer personas como estos chicos. Gracias por todo

reviews.author: Daydream14131043458
reviews.title: Friendly Staff
reviews.text:
We stayed for 5 nights and had a great time. 

Stayed in a Sunset View Room - Pyramid 2(Non-Reserve), and was nervous due to the negative reviews I was reading prior to coming. However, we didn’t face any big issues during our stay.

Our rooms did have minor issues like one of the light bulbs going out, but nothing that ruins our experience. 

Housekeeping made sure our room was clean and tidy everyday. 

The coffee corner was convenient with very pleasant staff. The line does get long but we opted to come in earlier to avoid the rush of guests. The same goes for the morning buffet. We avoided the wait by waking up a little earlier. 

Shoutout to the employees at the ginger bar Gabriela, Abby, Jonathan, Corina, and Everisto. They showed great hospitality and made sure that we were served despite how busy it got. If you want to have a good time, Gabriela, Abby and Jonathan works so well together and makes sure you’re smiling. 

Overall, we would come back again. 
The staff were very friendly. Especially Gabriela, who made my group of friends feel extra special.

reviews.author: Mackenzie M
reviews.title: We had the best time!!!
reviews.text: We booked the adult only reserve side of the resort and it was incredible. Completely different vibe than the other side of the hotel. Food & staff were amazing! We especially loved Alejandro & Christian! Will definitely recommend this place to friends!

reviews.author: Aniria C
reviews.title: Súper recomendado
reviews.text:
Excelente servicio por parte del señor Gaudencio, instalaciones súper limpias y comida deliciosa en Kanna beach club
Pedimos un aguachile y pulpo tardando, además las bebidas son de excelente calidad
Solo tengo cosas buenas que decir de este lugar y que deben visitarlo!

reviews.author: Nataly P
reviews.title: July 2024 Review
reviews.text: I enjoyed my week stay at Paradisus Cancun. There were a few workers that really made the stay enjoyable like Alfredo, Alberto, Orlando, and the bell boys.  The service these guys provided was excellent! They were the best!!! The top three restaurant options which I enjoyed were Malva, Blue Agave, and Cappella. I will say that the breakfast and lunch selections at Malva is better than the dinner selections. I really liked how this hotel had a night life. The shows and musicians were amazing. This hotel is beautiful, but the rooms do need some work. Our bathroom knob was broken, our couch had a stain, and our main door has some carvings. Overall, I had a good experience at this hotel.

reviews.author: Leah S
reviews.title: So beautiful and fun!
reviews.text: My friends and I came here for my bachelorette party! We stayed in the adult only Reserve section and it was incredible. There was a ton of fun and so much to do during the day and a little bit of nightlife. One night we went on a sunset cruise in the lagoon and it was the most fun ever!! The staff at the hotel were all so sweet and gave the absolute best service. Even in the heat, staff were there for us with whatever we needed at all times. It felt like we were VIP and living a luxury life. We had our own concierge, Rossana, who helped us to book anything we needed. This was truly a luxe experience and you will not regret choosing this hotel for your trip to Cancun!

reviews.author: Alise U
reviews.title: Great Service beautiful resort
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paridisus Reserve side and had Iran as our concierge. Iran was so attentive and passionate about providing great service and did an amazing job ensuring we had all we needed during our stay!
Thanks Iran and all the staff at Paradisus!

reviews.author: Taylor S
reviews.title: Jorge was amazing!
reviews.text: Jorge was amazing! He had great recommendations and surprised us with a few things. The salmon nigiri was a crowd favorite. I would recommend ordering a lot of appetizers and sushi before your entree as the entrees are a bit small but we expected that. Had a great night!

reviews.author: Ricardo Arellano
reviews.title: De mis mejores experiencias
reviews.text:
Omar y Jorge de Lemon fish, una atención increíble. Siempre al pendiente y hacen todo lo posible por brindarte la mejor experiencia. De igual forma Iran el sommelier encantador! Al pendiente y nos brindó una atención espectacular. 

En general todo el personal del hotel nos sorprendió, siempre atentos y pendientes de brindarnos la mejor experiencia. 

Gracias paradisus cancun!

reviews.author: Nora G
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: The hotel was very clean, and Limberth helped me plan my activities and what restaurants I should try with my family. It was a great experience. I will recommend this hotel to any of my friends who will be visiting Cancun. Resort overall is beautiful with amazing ocean views.

reviews.author: Jennifer G
reviews.title: Awesome stay
reviews.text: I loved my stay here and they made my birthday really special. Irán helped me plan my activities and what restaurants I should try with my friends. It was a peaceful and calming stay. I will recommend this hotel to any of my friends who will be visiting Cancun.

reviews.author: Isidora R
reviews.title: Lo único malo es la hora en que termina la música del DJ . Muy temprano se acaba todo
reviews.text:
karina y gaby de ginger bar son las mejores.
Las queremos mucho.
También Artemio y Jonathan.
Hacen que la experiencia sea la
mejor de todas.
Volveremos de seguro.
Nos atendieron muy bien, atentas y siempre intentando que lo pasemos lo mejor posible.

reviews.author: Jacobo M
reviews.title: Excelente ginger 2
reviews.text:
Doña Karina excelenteeee, Jhonatan y Artemio de ginger 2 estuvieron excelentes  . La playa estuvo muy bueba y el servicio de doña Karina mucho mejor
Y johony y el cuate muy serviciales y sobre todo muy profesionales en todos los aspectos. Quería agradecerles por todo

reviews.author: jmann8072023
reviews.title: Book it!  Ask for Rocio as Concierge!
reviews.text:
4th time here in less than 2 years. Fell in love with the place. Our regular concierge Rocio is an absolute gem!!  Her picture pops up when you google 'customer service!'  She makes booking extra reservations easy!  Even knows the best spots outside the resort. Meliá has a great membership program and offers deals to book via the app which has saved us thousands of dollars. Always stay Nikte/reserve!  Building 5 is adults only and you'll appreciate the quiet relaxing sleep. The food is great. Especially the Ginger bar. I believe it was Abraham that was able to fully customize our favorite drinks based on what we felt like drinking. Crazy good. Luis at the Sante bar is the best beach bar keep. There are too many good things to say about this place. It's like a second home to my family and I. We love it here. Ty Rocio for always making it 5x better than expected. We are already booked again for Nov this year.
Best restaurant for dinner is undoubtedly Capella; get the short ribs and arancini.  Best lunch is blue agave; get the Cochinita taco and you'll eat 5 more.  If you leave the resort, ask Rocio to book you a sunset dinner at Ryoshi!  It is some of the best food on Isla Cancun. Worth the cost. Also the spa is awesome. I recommend the sauna/steam room and cold plunge. Wow. Intense wake up call!  Make sure to bring a chug cap yeti water bottle; ideal for the pool.

Also for those complaining about seaweed, go to the mountains and complain about the snow!!!  This is a gulf front resort!!!  There will be seaweed occasionally bc it's on the sea!  Go in November if you want perfectly clear water no seaweed. Duh. The beach here is beautiful.

reviews.author: ROMAN S
reviews.title: Best staff, food and cabana’s
reviews.text: Went today to Kanna BEACHCLUB. Very nice service from all the staff. The food, staff and cabana’s were really good. If you want to have a good day to chill or have a drink on the beach, go to this beachclub. Definitely recommend this to everyone.

reviews.author: Haico77
reviews.title: 100% recommendation!
reviews.text: Perfecto, david y alberto son los mejores de esta playa. Kanna beach club is really really nice. You need to go here for sure. Muy bien porque David me pones muchas bebidas. El ocean es azul, really nice! Thanks thanks thanks thanks!!!✨✨✨✨✨✨✨

reviews.author: Eddie G
reviews.title: Mucho éxito
reviews.text:
Me gusto el Zumba. Uriel era muy chistos y con mucho energía. También Irán muy buena gente y servicio excelente.

I liked Zumba. Uriel was very funny and very energetic. Our concierge Iran was very good people and provided excellent service.

reviews.author: Emma S
reviews.title: David was the best!
reviews.text: David was the best! Cute beach club, not super rowdy which was perfect for our group. The water was beautiful, and the cabanas were perfect! The fish tacos were so yummy, and the drinks were also good. Definitely would recommend for those looking for a more relaxing and family friendly beach club.

reviews.author: Kyle G
reviews.title: Great time!!
reviews.text: David was an amazing server and helped our group have a great time. I will definitely return and next time I come I will be sure to ask for him to help me. The beach was beautiful and had big waves to go swimming in. Me and my group couldn’t recommend enough!

reviews.author: Faustino O
reviews.title: El mejor bar(ginger bar)🥃🍷😋
reviews.text: Nos la pasamos de maravilla. Conocimos a Gaby, Karina y a Gladys. Ellas son las mejores meseras, se encuentran en el ginger bar. Espero verlas en mi próximo viaje, son verdaderamente increíbles. En ese bar vas a probar las mejores bebidas. Gracias por todas las atenciones. Me voy muy contento de este hot l. Lo recomiendo mucho.😊😊

reviews.author: Jessica V
reviews.title: Luis barcana!
reviews.text: Luis barcana is amazing! Great service and such a fun person to talk to! It was very hot here during the time my friends and I went and every shot we took he iced it before! Such a relaxing area. Loved sitting swings! Luis is so attentive! I highly recommend coming here! I have nothing but great things to say

reviews.author: Natalia
reviews.title: Skip this place
reviews.text:
I wouldn't recommend Paradisus Cancun. Having stayed at their Playa del Carmen branch, I found it to be vastly superior in terms of room amenities, treatment, and professionalism.

To start, upon arrival, I had a birthday room upgrade, but Enrique tried to charge me extra despite the promotion clearly stating the upgrade was at no additional cost. The manager, David, claimed it was subject to availability and couldn't accommodate the upgrade, even though two members of my party received upgrades without any vouchers, both before and after my check-in. The lack of professionalism was evident throughout.

A few days later, my sister had a major slip and fall due to a leak from the roof. Overall, it was an unpleasant stay, and I won't be returning to the Paradisus Cancun location.

reviews.author: wendy96boop
reviews.title: Exelente equipo y el hotel es hermoso todo el personal muy amable y la comida muy deliciosa. Quede muy satisfecha
reviews.text: Les recomiendo pasar ahí unas vacaciones inolvidables todo es muy bonito y un exelente servicio de todo el personal

reviews.author: Alejandro C
reviews.title: Excelente cena
reviews.text: Lo mejor gracias a Francisco se la rifoooooo muy bien con las fotos y. Videos y siempre nos estuvo cuidando es un buen Appe el sabrá de lo que hablo Gracias por esa noche tan divertida es un crack........nos vemos en la próxima año señores saludos

reviews.author: Yessica X
reviews.title: Buena experiencia. 🤩
reviews.text:
Fue una buena experiencia en el restaurante,el mesero Francisco ha sido muy amable y atento en todo. 
10/10 a los platillos. 
El platillo de la noche,fue el aguachile verde de camarón,una delicia en el menú. 
Buena cena en el restaurante Lemon Fish,lo recomiendo ampliamente

reviews.author: Jenna G
reviews.title: I just don’t know.. I’m speechless
reviews.text:
I contemplated writing a review but I wouldn’t want anybody to experience what I did.
Pros - Lily, she is one of the most accommodating and responsive associates I came across here. She is the reason why I didn’t leave on my second day here.
The food is okay, it’s not terrible.
The beach area is beyond kept and beautiful, the waves are rough here though so if you like to swim at the beach then this isn’t for you.
Amenities are good
The smell of the reserve area was everything
The sunset cruise was included free of charge
This hotel is aesthetically gorgeous.
Cons -
We arrived early to check in (11a) and were told to wait 4 hours for our room…… requested a Manager and never talked to one, I practically had to get up and find one… never found one, I then met Lily and expressed my concern.
The quality of food and food options.
There are up charges all throughout the hotel which negatively impacted my experience. We were incorrectly charged for 2 drinks at Cielo, which was about $55. (Picture below)
The staff basically ignored us at the pool area
The pool is very WARM and low in elevation
The drinks are not top shelf, just full of sugar. They have bars with top shelf but will charge you about $20 per shot. They have coconuts at the Beach and charge you $10 for these and only have coconut water????
My room was so HOT (80°F precisely), we called on maintenance 4 times throughout our stay and had to request fans. We couldn’t even leave our window open.
The property could use updating
The adults steakhouse has minimal options with subpar food, the best food was honestly the pool restaurant and Mexican.
There is no beach attendant??
They advertised cabanas to be included with The Reserve but this solely means pool cabanas and They must be reserved 24 hours in advance, the beach view are $160 and you have to buy a food package… at a resort?? ALSO they have 6 whole chairs that lay flat for tanning, the rest are permanently adjusted at an angle.
The towels in the bathroom are ROUGH
Oh, also transportation is not included as advertised on their website so expect $100+
There was an issue also with my room upgrade, I requested and paid for an ocean view with 2 beds. I was then emailed and quoted a lower price by their in house reservation team and they did not offer a refund or credit for the difference I paid.. instead I was charged for the upgrade a second time upon checking Out and They practically held us and held our transportation until this was resolved. I showed the emails, receipts, and conversation but was treated less than human.
I mean I could go on for days.
Overall, I would not stay here again or recommend it. There are hotels that check boxes of all necessities needed to enjoy your stay. (This is coming from someone who’s traveled to Mexico over 20 times). Expect a bill at check out… even though this is a all inclusive resort.

reviews.author: LAURA A
reviews.title: Mala
reviews.text:
1. El elevador no tiene aire acondicionado y es un horno.
2. No cuentan con sombrillas suficientes en las albercas, 5 en toda la piscina y es sumamente molesto.
3. Todas las amenidades se acaban a las 11 y es no hay algún lugar para distraerse.
4. Los conectores para la luz no son suficientes y los que hay no funcionan.
5. Meseros en la piscina no son los necesarios para todos los huéspedes.
6. Cobran todas las camas que cubren del sol.

reviews.author: lmparkhill64
reviews.title: Great girls trip
reviews.text: Incredible service - the staff was outstanding.  The food was very good and consistent.  Excellent service!!!  The overall resort needs updating but all the staff makes up for the older hotel!.  Wonderful girls trip!! The entertainment was also wonderful.

reviews.author: Cynthia D
reviews.title: Fin de semana perfecto
reviews.text: Todo de maravilla. Excelente fin de semana. Fui a celebrar mi cumpleaños con amigos y nos encantó. Gracias para el joven Alonso guest service servicio impecable siempre atento a las necesidades. De igual manera la concierge Irán. Volveremos

reviews.author: Rocio R
reviews.title: Best staff & crew
reviews.text:
We stay at Melia Paradisus when in Cancun. We continue to stay because of the exceptional customer service from our concierge, Violeta. Thank you for setting up our anniversary photography session, our dinners, and always being available to answer our never ending questions.  The quick and speedy service of Cesar & Moises at the Reserve, who go above and beyond to make our vacation fun and relaxing.  We also like to thank Gaby & Valeria at Sante for always providing top notch service as well and Luis at the bar! Thank you for the delicious drinks and a variety of liquor to choose from in the Reserve. We continue coming back because their service is like no other. 
On this trip, we dined at the their new restaurant Flora. When we heard it was Organic, we were hesitant to try but thank God we did, that we went twice for dinner. The salmon was cooked perfectly and the presentation was nicely done thanks to Chef Jose and the tomato soup,(my husband got it twice) it was the chefs kiss. We got to meet the chef Jose as well and give him our praises.   The manager Tere and hostess Fanny made us feel so welcomed and special as we were celebrating our anniversary. They brought us a cake with a firework candle. We can't thank them enough and our wonderful waiter Alex.  He was quick and caring and checked on us often if we needed anything else or more wine.  We hope Flora stays as a main  restaurant in the hotel.  
We always enjoy the atmosphere and food at Sal, the staff was great as well!  Our reservation was at 8pm for a group of 8 and got served at 10pm so I thought the timing was to long by the time we got our main course. I didn't expect to eat that late but might of been the group setting but in the future we will schedule a 6 or 7pm time for dinner. I would highly recommend staying on the reserve -adults only side at Paradisus.  We will continue to stay and keep inviting our friends with us. Thank you all again! Xoxo Rocio & Daniel

reviews.author: Brandi R
reviews.title: Loved our stay at Paradisus Cancún!
reviews.text:
What an amazing adventure! The ambiance was incredible and the food…well, damn, just exquisite! 

Joorge and Chef Marcos at LemonFish gave us the most amazing dining experience. We ate there multiple times on our trip. Do not miss this spot!!

reviews.author: Jamison C
reviews.title: A Magic Vacation courtesy of Paradisus
reviews.text:
What a truly magical experience it was to come vacation for a week at the Paradisus Cancun. We came here for a music festival and have found our forever vacation spot. Some places have beautiful views, some places have wonderful drinks and food, but not all places have the excellent service and people that the Paradisus has! 

The Blue Agave has the most excellent authentic Mexican cuisine one could find south of the border, and the people who work there made it so much better! Shoutout to our waiter Atilano and his partner Cesar, manager Andrina, hostess Patricia, and the chef making the magic happen, Anibal! 

Special thanks to the Santè Restaurant as well, they truly gave us an unforgettable night on our last day, and it was thanks to them we made many friends that will last a lifetime over a bottle of Patron. I cannot thank Nathaniel, Axel, Estefani, and Esaul for a true night of gastronomic experience amid the crashing waves of the ocean. Ask for Nathaniel when you arrive!! He will blow you away. 

Thank you, Paradisus. And a heartfelt thank you to the people that make this place magical.

reviews.author: Jarrett M
reviews.title: Go to Santé restaurant!
reviews.text: If you stay here, go with the reserve and enjoy Axel, Nathaneal, Esaul over at Santé. 5 star experience, 5 star service, 5 star food.

reviews.author: Niall S
reviews.title: Best hotel in Cancun
reviews.text:
This is without a doubt the most luxurious hotel I have ever been lucky enough to stay in.
The amount of restaurants, shops, bars etc. that were on offer were fantastic.

The food was delicious and the staff were all fantastic!

Being so close to the beach was brilliant, and the pools were amazing! everything was so clean.

I would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone travelling to Cancun!

5 Stars

reviews.author: Jimye17
reviews.title: coffee
reviews.text: every year gets better, love it here at the paradisus 🥰🥰 two of my favorite people were my loves that made my coffee every day, alejandro and fernando !! such great service 🩷😊 beautiful views, rainfall water showers, beds are super comfy and i love listening to the ocean while falling asleep.

reviews.author: Claire W
reviews.title: Great tropical vacation!
reviews.text: Went for a festival at this resort. Overall had a great time. The rooms are slightly outdated. Beaches and pools are beautiful. Staff was extremely friendly even with all the chaos at the resort. Food was good. Gerardo, Reynaldo, Manuel provided A+ service in the buffet.

reviews.author: kaitlyn h
reviews.title: Lucas is the best server
reviews.text: We were here for a weekend and went to Cielo twice! We went our first night just because we got in late and had the best time. Lucas was a great server, we’re celebrating our anniversary and he made us feel so special. We made some friends and brought them with us the last night and requested Lucas to be our server. He is so nice and fun, he also explains the menu if you have any questions!

reviews.author: Bintu T
reviews.text: Didier, Hector, Edwardo, Abraham have  the best service made our trip an amazing experience!! Go se them for the best time

reviews.author: EB
reviews.title: Excelente mi estadía en Paradisus Cancún
reviews.text:
Mi reciente visita fue maravillosa, mi habitación estaba impecable y la cama súper cómoda, tanto que no me quería levantar; tomé un baño relajante en el jacuzzi junto con una copa de vino para relajarme, una experiencia encantadora. 
Lo mejor fue Sante, que  tiene una vista al mar increíble, además que el servicio y la comida fue espectacular. Les recomiendo el ceviche. 
El servicio de Fernando Sandoval y Emmanuel fue súper profesional, me llenaron de atenciones. Sin duda alguna regresaré pronto.

reviews.author: Mitzi M
reviews.title: Experiencia The Reserve
reviews.text:
Nos hospedamos en The Reserve con 4 amigos y fue una gran experiencia. Nuestra concierge Irán Mendoza fue muy amable y proactiva, siempre ayudó con todas nuestras solicitudes.
Estuvimos festejando mi cumpleaños, y antes de que entregaran la habitación Irán se encargó de decorarla y dejarme una linda sorpresa.
Moisés y Gaby en la piscina de The Reserve fueron muy atentos y sin duda hicieron nuestra experiencia muy grata.

reviews.author: Jesus Chávez
reviews.title: El mejor lugar para vacacionar
reviews.text:
Sin duda Paradisus cancun by melía el mejor hotel.
Nuestra estancia fue de lujo 
Recomendación del Reserve 
Todo el staff muy amable y servicial

reviews.author: Selena H
reviews.title: Beautiful ♡
reviews.text:
Food was great, with different a la carte options to chose from. Rooms were comfortable and spacious. Double bed was a little smaller than standard but still comfotable. Seperate water closet provided more privacy and shower water pressure was constant and warm. 
Beach was clean (very little seaweed in the mornings and light accumulation during the day). Could use more loungers on the beach and/or free cabanas you don't have to pay $200 UDS/day for (maybe up to a quarter of the price without the extra cabana perks & services..??) 
However, the Kanna bar lounge was a great alternative if you don't mind being off the sand and  bit closer to the beverages. This is where we spent most days. The Kanna staff was great, especially our go-to girl Karina, who made sure our drinks were always full and made just right! She was really friendly and would always greet us even when we were away from our usual spot (renamed by us Karina Lounge). Make sure to ask for her ♡  

Overall great stay and beautiful hotel!

reviews.author: Sightseer59062972064
reviews.title: Birthday trip of 2024
reviews.text: I went for my best friend’s birthday and it was just an amazing time. The whole entire staff was welcoming and respectful. The guest service representative  Melissa was very helpful in regards to decorating the room for my best friend’s special day. The food was also great so many restaurants/selections. The servers in the international buffet, Richer and Alfredo were my favs!! They went above and beyond for us. I was in awe on how they catered to me and treated us like royalty. The resort is beautiful, so many activities to do. The rooms are nice with a balcony. I would definitely go again.

reviews.author: Cesar R
reviews.title: Calidad de servicio excelente,
reviews.text:
Me impresiono el nivel de servicio desde el ingreso al hotel, la atención es muy personalizada y muy atentos, siempre resolvieron todas mis dudas y el nivel de respuesta fue inmediato.
La comodidad de las habitaciones es maravillosa y la comida que ofrecen en los restaurantes es de primer nivel 10/10. Una magnifica atención de Emmanuel y Fernando fueron muy amables y profesionales.

Sin duda regresaría cada vez que visite Cancún.

reviews.author: Tasha 😘
reviews.title: Best All Inclusive Trip Ever!
reviews.text:
Last week we took a girls trip to Cancun after lots of research we decided to go with Paradisus. It was more than worth it! The beauty of the ocean along with the water being so warm and blue was amazing! The pools were great too even tho 90% of the time we were in the reserve pool (the foam party was a blast). 
The customer service is crazy nothing like I ever experienced before. Our concierge George who is originally from Serbia took very good care of us, checked on us daily, and made sure everything we needed was taken care of. He is so kind and helps make our experience what it was. Everyone needs a George! Ceci from reception was so sweet and helpful as well, she made us feel so welcome we all loved her. And lastly Oscar the server at the reserve pool was so kind and more than helpful and got us more than we needed as always. 
I hope that many others get the experience me and girls had! It was definitely a vacation we will never forget and that everyone deserves!

reviews.author: Jacqui C
reviews.title: Lovely time at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Had the best time at Paradisus Cancun. The resort was lovely and the staff were amazing. Especial Stef our personal concierge who made sure we had reservations at all the restaurants we wanted and the servers at the adults only pool bar who took great care of us each day.

reviews.author: Denise S
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisius
reviews.text: Overall, the resort was exceptional. Didier and.Flor we’re very good at what they did and made us feel welcome at the pool every day with exceptional service. Our rooms were comfy, cozy, and connected, which was a nice bonus, Malva rhe  morning buffet was always delicious and full of variety, the entertainment in the bar was fun, the entire complex was immaculately, Mexican restaurants were delicious, The Italian had exceptional, Burrata  and calamari, aqua marina had really good lunches and dinners. It was a favourite of ours for the entire trip.. I wouldn’t hesitate to come back here again and bring my entire family to enjoy the paradise at Paradisius.

reviews.author: Sarah G
reviews.title: Not the best value for money
reviews.text: When we arrived we had really high hopes of spending new year at this hotel. I was left disappointed by the hotel not allowing bookings for evening meals. We stayed for 9 nights & got in to only 1 restaurant that we actually wanted to visit. We spent so much time being told they were fully booked come back in 90/120 minutes ect it just became a joke. I’ve spent much less on other holidays & got a far better service. The food also isn’t Amazing some of it was good but nothing to write home about. Most of the staff were lovely to be fair always happy to bring you drinks while we were chilling in the reserve area. (Adults only) our concierge was hopeless to be honest don’t know what he actually did. The information we asked for we never received. The manager walked round one morning to chat to the guests who all seemed to have the same complaints but not sure anything was done about it. Don’t think I would visit again as you’re paying 5* money but getting 3 star service @ best.

reviews.author: Asante B
reviews.title: Bartender was great!
reviews.text:
Erick made great drinks! He was kind and also made a considerable effort to find us a drink we’d like since the bar ran out of the particular drink that we like.

He did a great job of this as we tried our drinks and it was amazing. If given the option, I recommend Erick!

reviews.author: Chase B
reviews.title: Servicio excelente y personas muy amables!!
reviews.text: ¡La pasé muy bien con los amigos y los camareros fueron fantásticos! Las habitaciones son súper bonitas y la gente es genial aquí. ¡El ambiente divertido y los trabajadores de aquí solo mejoraron el viaje con lo agradables que eran!  ¡Karina y Salvador en el Swing Bar son los mejores!

reviews.author: Elizabeth R
reviews.title: Cesar at Blue Agave
reviews.text: Cesar at Blue Agave was absolutely the best. He was helpful and fun and kept us having the best time. He had great recommendations for which foods to try and didn’t bat an eye at how many times we ordered more guacamole! (Side note, the guacamole is very good!!) He deserves a raise and some recognition asap!

reviews.author: Jeannie R
reviews.title: Top-notch poolside service
reviews.text: Our poolside bar service was exceptional. The bartender Juan Manuel and server Rodrigo, went out of their way to make us feel welcome and valued. The drinks were delicious and they anticipated our every need. They made this trip into a first-class experience.

reviews.author: Nancy K
reviews.title: Coffee and hot showers hard to get
reviews.text:
The hotel is visually beautiful.  I loved that it is not done in that dark neo-dungeon style that is so popular now. Instead, there are hanging plants and natural materials that make the environment very welcoming.

The staff is very friendly and helpful.  The food was also good, ranging from good to excellent.  However, they need to work on labeling foods for gluten and vegan.  The male waiters did not care about gluten, but the female wait staff were more in tune to the requirements of someone with celiac disease.  The hotel needs to really work on labelling the foods on the menu and in the buffet for gluten and vegan.

If your idea of a vacation is to relax with a cup of coffee or tea on your beautiful porch in the morning then don’t stay here.  There is no coffee maker in the room, and you have to go all the way down to the first floor and stand in a long line to get a cup of coffee.  The hotel should put big coffee urns and muffins on each floor, or coffee makers in each room.

If you like a hot shower before dinner, don’t stay here.  The shower at 5 pm was not even slightly warm.  It was cool.

There are 8 floors and 4 elevators in building 3 but most of the time one or two of the elevators were not working.  Someone pointed out the head maintenance person as he snuck by and I told him both of the elevators in one bank were stranded on two floors, but he did not care.  He just made a face, said they were busy, and hurried into the staff room.

There are not enough electrical outlets in the bedroom for charging and the one outlet that was not hidden looked spongy and improvised (room 3427).  It was difficult to get a charger to stay in it.

While we were there a ceiling panel at the entrance to the beach fell on a woman and she was bloody and appeared injured.

This hotel does not need to renovate the decor, that would be a waste of money.  But the infrastructure is badly in need of updating and the head maintenance guy might need to be replaced.

reviews.author: Abner C
reviews.title: Not the best place.
reviews.text: The place is nice but the pool crew next to the reserve is very disrespectful. I’m Latino and they only care to serve white Americans or white Spanish people. One of them even told me a sex joke to verify my sexual orientation and was a bad experience if you’re on vacation.

reviews.author: Anthony A
reviews.title: Recommend Paradisus Cancún
reviews.text: This is my wife’s and I second trip to Paradisus Cancun and our visit was exceptional. Rooms were very clean and excellent hospitality. A shoot out to Karina at Kannanight for the over the top customer service, exceptional drink recommendations and a lovely personality to match her services to our group of 7. I would highly recommend the hotel, food and guest services.

reviews.author: Noah A
reviews.title: Amazing service at paradisus
reviews.text: Amazing service, food, drinks and all. The service was extraordinary for Karina from Kanna noche, she deserves a raise more then anyone else. Food was absolutely amazing. Drinks were quickly made and always delicious. Service was amazing and their English impeccable given it’s not their first language.

reviews.author: Brooklyn F
reviews.title: L
reviews.text: Karina and christian from kanna night are the best bartenders here!!! Came back night after night just to hang out with them! Plz go see them when you are here, it’s the best. They give the best service possible. Truly amazing. Cannot wait to come back and see them!!!

reviews.author: Maria S
reviews.title: El MEJOR restaurante de nuestra estancia!!!
reviews.text: Un GRAN restaurante! No hagan caso a lo de que es un restaurante “vegano”. La comida excepcional y el servicio aún mejor! Cinthia, Fanny y Alex en especial!! Estuvo todo tan delicioso que repetimos 2 noches seguidas (hubieran sido más pero el viaje llegó a su fin). Nos trataron muy cariñosamente todas las noches y nos dieron un postre especial para nuestra última noche. Una pena no haber probado Flora antes! Tienen cosas veganas pero no es para nada un “restaurante vegano”, hay de todo!! El mejor restaurante de todo el hotel.

reviews.author: Sofía G
reviews.title: Restaurante Flora Paradisus Cancún
reviews.text: El restaurante Flora es una maravilla,  la hostess Fanny es muy amable, atendiendo con una, Alex y Cynthia son un encanto, siempre atentos para cuando se te acaba la bebida ofrecerte otra y dando conversación. La comida está muy buena, la sopa de tomate y el pulpo son de lo mejor que he comido, de todos los restaurantes de Paradisus Cancún es el que más nos gustó. En general son profesionales muy detallistas, hasta nos pusieron unas velitas de despedida en nuestro último día. Si vuelvo al Paradisus repetiría sin dudar.

reviews.author: Suzy I
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel, Service needs work.
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at the Paradisus Cancun Hotel and I have some thoughts. First off, the hotel itself is gorgeous. The grounds look amazing and the ocean view is really nice. But that's where most of the good stuff ends.

The main problem is that there aren't enough people working there for all the guests. It felt like they couldn't help us much because they were always busy or just not around.

For example, they say they have a pool concierge, but don't expect much. They won't set up your beach or pool chair. Finding a seat is all on you. This led to a lot of guests grabbing more chairs than they needed and no one from the hotel did anything about it. We even had to wake up super early to get chairs, but then other guests would just take them. And there weren't enough umbrellas, which was a big issue for some of us who needed shade. We tried talking to the staff about it, but didn't get much help. One staff member (Luis) even told us to just steal someone else's chair! Then, a manager Ignacio came and when the server was explaining to him what was going on - he rolled his eyes and told him to ignore us in Spanish and walked away. I was really surprised. This has never happened to me at any hotel before. 

Other guests had the same problem with chairs and not enough towels. Sometimes there was only one person taking orders by the pool, and they said they couldn't take our order.

Check-in was another headache. It took forever, and there were lots of people waiting behind us too.

Eating here was tough as well. You can't book tables at the restaurants, so we had to wait a long time to get a table for our group of 8. 

Some staff members were nice, but a lot of them didn't seem too happy to help or answer questions. It's a shame because the hotel is truly beautiful. But the service, or lack of it, really made our trip less enjoyable.

I don't like giving bad reviews, but I think if the hotel worked on these issues, staying here would be so much better.

reviews.author: Taylor C
reviews.title: A Beautiful Stay to Remember
reviews.text: From arriving to end, our stay was wonderful!! Upon arriving at concierge, Rocio greeted us and showed us a wonderful time during our stay! I was there celebrating my birthday with my friend and Rocio decorated our room very beautifully. She was very thoughtful and attentive along with the rest of the staff. Would definitely return and definitely recommend this resort to others as well!!

reviews.author: ejuarez2024
reviews.title: Excelente hotel
reviews.text: El lugar me pareció muy genial, los meseros y bartender muy amables, quedé satisfecho con sus servicios. El mini bar excelente, aunque hicieron falta más bebidas (para uno que quiere seguirla), en general, un muy buen lugar para disfrutar de las vacaciones.

reviews.author: Crystal O
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun was an amazing experience
reviews.text:
Rocio was absolutely amazing! She was so incredibly kind and made sure that we were well taken care of. She also set up the cutest birthday celebration for my friend.

The views are incredible and the dining experience is unmatched. Customer service was spectacular. Everyone regardless of if we knew them was so kind and friendly and always made sure we were well accommodated.

reviews.author: Amy K
reviews.title: Amazing!!! Highly recommend
reviews.text: Amazing!  Love this.  Girls getaway.  Fabulous service, food, accommodations, activities.  Did the adults only Reserve experience.  Separate pool, restaurant & bar, beach area.  So good!  Miguel at pool bar Reserve experience & Jose as the concierge are both 5stars+.  Fabulous!!

reviews.author: Brittany W
reviews.title: The perfect girls' getaway!
reviews.text: What a gorgeous resort! Starting from the first day, service was impeccable. I stayed with friends in the adults-only Reserve section, which was worth the upgrade. The views from the beach and pool were stunning. We were able to secure cabanas easily as part of the Reserve upgrade. The rooms had plenty of space and were cleaned thoroughly every morning. The downstairs restaurant in the Reserve section was perfect for breakfast, snacks and coffee throughout the day. Hydrotherapy at the YHI spa was included with our package and it was so restorative after a day in the sun. Restaurant-wise, our favorites were Blue Agave and Agua Marina - just super fresh and delicious food! Our concierge Stef was amazing and everywhere we went the service was top-notch. Shoutouts specifically to Stef, Gabriella, Victor, Oscar, Cesar, Miguel and Luis! We had a fabulous girls' trip and wouldn't hesitate to recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Alaina T
reviews.title: Highly recommend staying at this resort
reviews.text: The workers were all so nice and amazing! Especially Alejandro and all the coffee bar workers! The food was great the pool was great. Everything was great. Recommend for anyone who is planning on taking a trip to Mexico. Melia hotels are the best!!

reviews.author: Darlene C
reviews.title: Exceptional Customer Service!
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancún exceeded my expectations. From the moment I stepped into the luxurious lobby, I was greeted with warm smiles and impeccable hospitality. A special thank you to Cesar, Moises, Diego, Esmeralda, Julio, Iran, Alejandro, and Joel De La Cruz for your exceptional service!!! You guys made me feel incredibly grateful and truly taken care of! Your genuine enthusiasm set the tone for an unforgettable experience!  The resort's stunning architecture and beautifully landscaped gardens created a tranquil and serene atmosphere.

reviews.author: Evan N
reviews.title: Paradise Cancún Restaurants
reviews.text: Paradise Cancun was a great stay. I enjoyed the restaurants, especially the tacos at blue agave and the great service and food at Sante. Axel did a group job waiting on us and his fellow staff did as well. They gave us free shots and were all very entertaining

reviews.author: Cristina b
reviews.title: Maravillosa
reviews.text:
Es un hotel estupendo para pasar unos días inolvidables descansando.
Juan Manuel, bartender de la piscina el mejor!!!! El trato y la atención que pone a su trabajo es una maravilla.
Repetiría sin duda!!

reviews.author: henar g
reviews.title: muy buen hotel
reviews.text:
Hotel muy bueno, todo el personal son un encanto, siempre con la sonrisa en la cara, te ayudan en todo lo que necesites, encantadores.
El hotel está genial, la comida toda muy rica y mucha variedad.
La playa fascinante, aunque no pudimos bañarnos, pero por que estaba el tiempo muy revuelto y las olas entraban con mucha fuerza. Todo genial

reviews.author: Saumei L
reviews.title: Si son jóvenes no vayan (20s-30s)
reviews.text: Separe el hotel all inclusive adults only reserve experience. Y la verdad que no tuvo nada de lujo ni de 5 estrellas. El servicio al menos de nuestro concierge fue pésimo. El estado de las habitaciones mal, tiempo de espera más de las 3 (hora del check in) para que nos dieran las habitaciones mal. No les recomiendo para nada el restaurante SAL. PÉSIMO servicio y demoraron 2 horas en servirnos la comida que estaba normal. En tema de bebidas, ofrecen cocteles diluidos, shots diluidos y licores premium inexistentes. La zona de la posiciona era el 90% adultos de mayor edad, y no ponian ni música alta.  no había vida nocturna en el hotel y el único karaoke/sports bar con DJ cerraban temprano y el servicio del bar fue terrible.

reviews.author: María C
reviews.title: Hermosa estadía
reviews.text:
¡Tuvimos una hermosa estadía! Las instalaciones muy cómodas, espaciosas. Albercas con barra, restaurantes variados
Destaco sobre todo la atención del personal, Francisco del restoran Malva fue muy atento y servicial con nosotros.
Elisabeth quien nos dio una clase de meditación, también super amable y cálida 
El hotel está súper bien, agradable y familiar se nota el esfuerzo por brindar un buen servicio. ¡Volveremos sin duda!

reviews.author: kasolira4
reviews.title: La sección reserve no vale la pena
reviews.text: Desde el momento del check-in, nos prometieron dos habitaciones dobles, pero nos asignaron una king y una doble. A pesar de tener un "personal concierge", nunca respondía a nuestros mensajes. La calidad de las habitaciones dejaba mucho que desear: una de ellas no tenía puerta de baño y una cortina estaba rota. La comida en general era insatisfactoria, especialmente en el restaurante Sal, donde esperamos 30 minutos por el pan de cortesía y 2 horas por la carne, la cual llegó mal cocida en todos los términos (algunos estaban medio hechos y otros muy poco hechos). Nunca recibimos el alcohol "premium" que se suponía estaba incluido, ni siquiera nos lo ofrecieron. A pesar de pedir varias veces que rellenaran los nespresso pods negros (que contenían cafeína), nunca lo hicieron. Además, en el segundo día, tuvimos que pedir que limpiaran la habitación porque ya eran las 5 de la tarde y nadie lo había hecho

reviews.author: Kelsey W
reviews.title: Kanna night the best bar
reviews.text: Karina and Christian from kanna night are the best bartenders! So accommodating and attentive! Other staff is also very welcoming and willing to go above and beyond. Absolutely wonderful place to stay. Very clean and easy to communicate between staff members.

reviews.author: Paige L
reviews.title: Thank you Cesar. Muchas gracias!
reviews.text: Cesar did an amazing job ! We loved our experience. The dining expwrience was anazing and he helped us with everything. Always making sure we had what we needed as far as food and drinks. I was able to practice my spanish. I am very grateful. Thank you!

reviews.author: Alejandra T
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text:
We came with another couple for 6 days and 5 nights. Our trip started off a little bit rocky when we arrived to our room and saw that while it was decent, it certainly does not look like what is advertised on the website. We booked a junior suite with a lagoon view, upon entering we noticed that the cloth headboard above the bed had multiple dead flies smeared on it, the bathroom was not thoroughly cleaned, the AC turned off every ten minutes and would only restart if we turned it back on, and our lagoon view was non existent. We had large plantain palms covering our view and blocking the natural light from coming in as well as having no patio furniture on the balcony. I expressed our concerns to Raphael at reception where he apologized and offered to upgrade us the next night to an ocean view for a discounted rate. He was very attentive to our concerns and seemed genuine in his willingness to resolve our issue. He mentioned to me that someone would be in contact with us in the next days to resolve the issues we had encountered and to make it up to us. Unfortunately that never occurred and it seems like the hotels internal communications are a bit disorganized as no one could confirm that this incident had even occurred when I brought it to their attention. However our new room had a stunning view and a jet bath on the balcony which was a very pleasant surprise and definitely elevated our stay. 

The food was the highlight of our trip as I find it rare to find quality food at all inclusive resorts. I have been staying at Melia hotels for years and my expectations are always high, but nevertheless the food here does not disappoint. Our favorites were Cielo which offers delicious Mexican cuisine, Agua Marina that has delicious and fresh seafood, we ate both lunch and dinner here and I would even go back a third time. Lemon Fish was also great with a nice ambiance as well. We did not stay at the Reserve so we didn’t get to check out those restaurants, but we in no way felt like we missed out or that the other restaurants weren’t up to par. 

The pools are very clean and offer guests the ability to choose the environment best suited for their stay, we loved the adults only pool which was heated and a little more secluded from the other pools. Over in the main pool Rodrigo was amazing and extremely attentive since our first day there. He made time fly over at the wet bar and we definitely enjoyed our time with him. Down at the beach Gaudencio continuously went above and beyond to make sure we were taken care of and that our drinks were never empty. 

Overall we really enjoyed our stay here and would come back in a couple of years if the rooms get a little bit of a facelift. This resort is great for both younger couples and families alike as everyone has the room and amenities to fit the needs of their trip. The staff here is attentive and friendly and stands out among other resorts in the area.

reviews.author: nick b
reviews.title: Kanna night the best bar☺️
reviews.text: Karina and Christian from kanna night!!! Great time, went with friends. They were great bartenders. They were happy and created a great vibe and comfortable atmosphere. They also let us on Aux to play music which was great. Thank you both of you

reviews.author: kaiden t
reviews.title: Kanna night the best bar!!!
reviews.text: Wonderful experience with Karina and Christian from kanna night . Excited to see them all tomorrow! The tiki bar is the best place to experience drinks near the water. Great music and great drinks to keep the night rolling. The most magnificent experience ever.

reviews.author: ALC LTD
reviews.title: Sjjaiaksoskaoalabsakakakkaosmskskdnwkaksnskoamzjsowksjsiwkajaiajksjsjsjaiamskakamaoalakakskskaksksiakakaoakasjkskaksksks
reviews.text: Cinthia was amazing!!!! Flora restaurant was soooo delicious!! I would highly recommend coming to this restaurant! The hotel is clean and modern! The staff are polite and helpful! The adults only pool wasn't so pleasant! Was pretty dirty but other than that amazing hotel

reviews.author: Emiliano c
reviews.title: Paradises
reviews.text: Blue agave food was amazing!!! Cesar gave us the best service ever!! Pool was great and the beach was beautiful. So many food options and the rooms aren’t amazing but def get the job done. Definitely recommend staying here whether it’s with friends, family, or a couples trip.

reviews.author: Jolie E
reviews.title: Incredible stay
reviews.text: My friends and I had an incredible time at Paradisus Cancun! It was our first visit, and we were thoroughly impressed with our experience. The entire staff was exceptionally kind and helpful, with special thanks to our concierge, Galdino, for his outstanding assistance. Felipe was also incredibly helpful, and especially Jose, who went above and beyond to show us incredible hospitality. The hotel itself is stunning, and the staff truly made our stay memorable. We would definitely come back again next time!

reviews.author: Claudia C
reviews.title: The absolute BEST!!!
reviews.text: This is our second trip to Paradisus Cancun and we will be back time and time again no doubt! The hotel itself is beautiful but what makes the experience is the outstanding staff!! We were a group of 10 and all the staff we encountered definitely went above and beyond for us. Huge shoutout to Didi, he’s an absolute gem and was incredibly attentive both days we used the cabanas. Abraham blew us away with the extraordinary drinks he makes! We were so happy to see Salvador and Karina again from last year, they definitely make your time at the beach bar a blast! For our final dinner we definitely appreciated Osvaldo, Melvin, Kenia and Victor for making it so memorable. And for our final breakfast together, Martin was awesome. Huge thank you to everyone at Paradisus Cancun that made our trip so incredible!!

reviews.author: Omayra C
reviews.title: Excelente servicio
reviews.text:
Visitamos el Hotel Paradisus Cancún en México. 
Al  llegar al Hotel el recibimiento fue como haber llegado a casa.  En todo momento recibimos un servicio especial.   Iran Mendoza fue la encargada de enseñarnos las facilidades, agendar actividades, cenas y hasta el transporte de regreso.   El manager del hotel, el Sr. Diego Díaz  y todo su personal hicieron de nuestra estadía una inolvidable .  El servicio en cada uno de los restaurantes es único y especial con una variedad de platos típicos e internacionales.  Gracias Moises, César, Diego, Esmeralda , Julio, Alejandro y Joel De Jesús (el guero) por un servicio de excelencia y hacernos sentir como en familia.

reviews.author: Blanca T
reviews.title: Total relaxation
reviews.text:
This resort is amazing. Our family has been coming here for years now. The rooms are clean. The service is great!  Can’t beat all inclusive. I like that you can stay at the Reserve section and totally relax or join the family on the family/children area as well. 
When people asks us for a hotel recommendation in Cancun, we say Paradisus. It’s paradise!

reviews.author: Lori L
reviews.title: Great February Trip with Family and Friends!!!
reviews.text:
My friends and I just spent a week at Paradisus.  It was a wonderful time. The employees at the Reserve go out of their way for you. Our butler Galdino could not have been any better.  His attention to detail was amazing.  The two pool concierges Nicole and Victor always had our Bali beds ready for us.  The staff at the pool  (Moses, Joel and many more sorry I can’t think of everyone’s name, always was there getting us anything we wanted.  

Also, we can’t forget about Liliana at the Spa. Her massages are one of a kind.
  We all felt very spoiled while we were there.  All of us enjoyed our time so much we are headed back in May.    If you are thinking of visiting, go ,  you won’t regret it.

reviews.author: Cindy G
reviews.title: Galdino Rocks!
reviews.text: Galdino is the most amazing butler. He goes above and beyond every time we go. He makes sure our rooms, reservations and or activities are set. He communicates before we arrive and comes to see us every day to make sure we are happy. Could not ask for a better experience from him.

reviews.author: Daniel E
reviews.title: Bed bugs worst experience ever
reviews.text: Thank god my vacation has come to an end. I have been all over the world travelling and I have never had a worse experience both with staff and cleanliness in my life. Please see attached photos of my arms and hands after night one(bed bugs) I was itchy all week. The staff is absolutely horrible. The managers laugh and smirk at you the entire time you try and talk to them while lying through their teeth. Nicole at the adult only pool bar could be the rudest person I have ever met. Stay as far away from this place as possible u less you want to look like you had chicken pox all week.

reviews.author: Kenny E
reviews.title: Bed bugs and HORRIBLE Staff!
reviews.text:
Beware of this resort!  There are bed bugs in the rooms (see attached pictures) and the staff are amongst the rudest staff that I have ever seen.  I have been to many high end resorts and the staff at the Paradisus is by far the worst.  They try and upcharge you whenever they can and will call security on you if you try and talk to them.

There are only about 50 chairs next to the main pool at a resort with 2,000 rooms.  If you do not wake up at 5am to secure a chair then you will never get one.  The food is average at best and everything shuts down at 11pm.  There is no nightlife at this resort whatsoever and is the most boring place to be after dinner.  If you like going to bed at 8pm then this resort is perfect.

The pool concierge, Nicole, at the adults only section (the reserve) is one of the worst human beings alive.  She constantly screams at guests, has absolutely no respect and tries to get people kicked off the resort for no reason.  How she still has a job is a mystery in itself.  

The spa staff will get you in trouble if you use the change room to get changed in and will write a report on you if you get naked to change into your bathing suit.  

I would never go to this resort again even if I was paid to go there.  It is unorganized, under staffed and an absolute disaster.  I am a professional in my late thirties and I highly suggest you book another place in Cancun to stay at - take my word for it.

reviews.author: Lecia
reviews.title: Beach Bliss
reviews.text:
We had an amazing time at Paradisus Cancun. The beach was absolutely perfect--no rocks, soft sand and easy to swim in the warm water. We even got to see baby turtles hatching on the beach!! We had a great experience at the cabanas. 

We also loved the restaurants and of course, the buffet. Gerardo Fernando Martin were all extremely helpful, bringing us everything we could possibly wish even before we could ask. Thank you for a great trip!

reviews.author: biki_ma
reviews.title: Take this cat to the vet!!!!!
reviews.text:
The resort cat Daisy is sick with upper respiratory infection and this was reported multiple times by me and different ppl to the front desk and supervisor Angelica but I doubt they will do anything about it. 
They use this cat as mascot of the resort but don’t care for her, they don’t feed her nor take her to the vet.
This morning she stopped eating completely, I hope she won’t die but she will if they don’t take her to the vet.
Heartless people, only running after $$$

reviews.author: Infane J
reviews.title: A must Visit
reviews.text: Karina and Salvador from Kanna. I enjoyed the time we spent at the resort and the drinks and hospitality was top notch. I don’t write reviews often but when the customer service is good I feel I have to. I recommend this establishment any time you are in Cancun!!

reviews.author: Kristen
reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text: Had a great stay at Paradissus. Beautiful beach. Clean rooms. Comfy beds. Loved Karina and Salvador at the Kanna bar, best bartenders at the resort. Armando, Daniel and Ignacio always did an amazing job at the buffet. Very attentive, kind and funny. Remembered us everytime we came in. Food was great.

reviews.author: Claudia P
reviews.title: Mejor tiempo en Cancún - Paradisus
reviews.text: Salvadore y Karina fueron los mejores bartenders. Lo pasamos super bien en el Paradisus Cancun.  Fabulous time due to the best service. Kanna Noche was amazing - we will definitely be here again. The drinks and shots were awesome and we made new friends.

reviews.author: Mávil Méndez C
reviews.title: La mejor experiencia
reviews.text: Todo hermoso, llegamos y en lo que estaba nuestra habitación nos dejaron estar dentro de las instalaciones, comer, alberca y todo, muy delicioso todo, comida y bebidas, en especial Salvador y Karina en Kanna, te consiguen todo para beber a gusto y pasarla bien

reviews.author: Juan Antonio N
reviews.title: El mejor open bar de paradisus cancun en la noche
reviews.text: Karina y salvador de kanna noche son a todoo dar! Regresamos al mismo bar 3 veces!! Platicamos super a gusto con ellos nos escucharon, opinaron con toda confianza y asi ed como nos gusta, luego luego se nota cuando es una platica falsa y esta no lo fue! Gracias!!

reviews.author: Alex L
reviews.title: Experiencia inolvidable
reviews.text: La mejor atención que pueden dar se da en el bar kanna de noche es Salvador y Karina, son muy buenas personas y se rifan en lo que hacen, para mí ha sido la mejor experiencia que he tenido desde la pandemia en hoteles all inclusive. Un gusto conocerlos

reviews.author: Fearless03831540054
reviews.title: Experiencia en el
reviews.text: Karina y salvador de kanna noche muy buen servicio y muy buena actitud al atendernos , sin duda volvería al lugar y que ellos nos atiendan de la misma manera , nos hicieron sentir como en casa y muy contentos respecto al servicio del lugar , muchas gracias

reviews.author: Shannon C
reviews.title: Love this resort
reviews.text: Definitely would return to this resort!  In the main restaurant Armando, Ignacio and Richer were amazing.  Recognized us whenever we went in and took great care of us . The Nespresso bar started our day out perfectly with the help of Alejandro & Fernando.   Loved how many options were in the gym as well . The buffet food always changed up which was nice and the Italian restaurant did not disappoint

reviews.author: Sightseer35842099089
reviews.title: Rocio is the BEST concierge!!!!
reviews.text:
We spent 7 days at this property and our concierge Rocio was amazing!!!!
YES!!!! AMAZING!!!! 

She made our trip so easy and helped us all week long with celebrating my sister's 60th birthday and my husband and I celebrated our 24th Anniversary.  She was a joy to be around and became a friend. :) We loved having Rocio be a part of our families week stay.  There were 11 adults and one 7 year year old in our group.

Martin, one of the restaurant managers was awesome!!! He was there every day and so nice.  At the Sante restaurant the crab cakes were wonderful.  The Sea Bass was also so fresh & fluffy.  We truly enjoyed our week.  

We also had a 75 minute couples massage and my massage therapist Liliana was fantastic!!!! Very relaxing and she was a sweetheart.  

This property was very enjoyable.  It is a large property and we stayed on the Reserve - Adults only side but we figured out the property by day 5. :)

reviews.author: Flavia M
reviews.title: El hotel soñado
reviews.text: Reservé en el área de solo adultos que tiene un precio elevado pero vale la pena si quieres sentirte muy a gusto y tranquila! El conserje Andrés fue muy muy atento. Hice todas todas las actividades y me lleve un montón de recuerdos y baile también muy divertidos. Los chicos de entretenimiento fueron quienes pusieron más onda. Luego la comida muy buena en línea general. El agua del mar en esa parte de Cancún es maravillosa no hay nada de sargazo. La habitación muy linda con vista al mar. Recomiendo a las personas que están acostumbradas a cenar tarde que no se confíen porq se te pasa el tiempo y no conseguís. Las personas son muy amables todas!!!

reviews.author: Mel P
reviews.title: Best Vacay Ever
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun completely stands up to its name!  The hotel is beautiful, the atriums are lust with plants and trees making you feel like you are strolling through the rainforest!  What makes this resort stand above all others is its staff!!! Customer service like I have never experienced!  Moises at the reserve pool took exceptional care of us and always kept us laughing!  Oscar made sure we had chairs on the beach…even our last day!  Caesar introduced us to Mango Tangos on our day we had a pool cabana!  Luis (the pool bar tender) made us the best drinks and surprised us the last day with a drink in a cantaloupe made like the cutest penguin!!!  I can’t forget the spa days with Lorena and William—best massage ever!!!  My friend has been 5 times and although this was my first—I will most defiantly be back!!!

reviews.author: Rafael L
reviews.title: Ginger Bar lo maximo!!
reviews.text: el mejor servicio en el ginger bar, recomiendo que visiten el bar en las tardes, abraham siempre tendra una bebida para sorprenderlos, el hotel es muy bonito y la comida de los restaurantes con buen sabor. 100% recomendado el ginger por la tarde. muchas gracias abraham.

reviews.author: Sergio A
reviews.title: GRACIAS POR TODO CÉSAR (restaurante mexicano)
reviews.text: En el restaurante mexicano, César, el mejor, se lució, es lo mejor que me ha pasado desde que llegué aquí, tiene una hospitalidad 10/10,yo de ustedes le doy tips y no solo eso, pero también un aumento o mejor aún, que lo hagan el gerente, porque? Porque la gerente de hoy, la que tiene una camisa blanca, el 17 de febrero del 2024, de portó muy mal, nefasto a mi parecer, paupérrimo servicio al cliente, el cliente siempre tiene la razón y César me hizo entenderlo, pero esta señora se negó a nuestro placer y no nos hizo nada más que daño a todo nuestro grupo y peor aún, a mi salud mental y al resto del grupo que nos acompañaba. Por otro lado, Felipe, el cubano, no solo es uno de los mejores chefs que me ha servido, sino una de las personas con los corazones más grandes que he conocido, un gran amigo para el recuerdo

reviews.author: Joseph R
reviews.title: Bar Time at Sante
