reviews.text: Sofinia was the best bartender we had at the resort. He provided us extensive bar expertise at Sante while playing cards woth our friends. Attention to detail was his strong point and listened to our drink orders. He went above and beyond on all things.

reviews.author: Jorge R
reviews.title: Lemon Fish - Omar
reviews.text: Excelente servicio en el Lemon Fish por parte de Omar, súper recomendable! Muy rica comida, fusión peruana asiática. Una de tantas opciones para cenar. Excelente atención por parte del gerente. Martes 13 de febrero.  Vengan, no se van a arrepentir!

reviews.author: Antoniorodriguez92
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: El mejor restaurante del hotel sin duda. Fusion japonés/peruano. Destacar los sushis y nigiris, son una delicia. La atencion del personal también muy buena, profesionales y atentos. En especial Jorge que fue nuestro camarero la ultima noche y Boris (gerente) que ambos días nos dio un gran recibimiento.

reviews.author: Jeanne D
reviews.title: Thank you Melia Paradisius!
reviews.text: Service is amazing, special mention for Luis, bar tender, Rene capitan, Luis Concierge,  Alberto and Oxte. They are so kind. Food is insane. Beaches are the most beautiful I’ve ever seen! Thank you very much for everything, we’ll come back for sure!

reviews.author: Leila Papaux
reviews.title: Paradis Kanna
reviews.text:
Le service est incroyable, les gens tellement gentil. Une vraie touche de paradis dans notre quotidien!!
Une appréciation particulière pour Luis, Rene Capitán, Luis, Alberto, Oxte 
Ils sont toujours là pour nous et s’assurent que nous passions un bon moment.

reviews.author: Robin H
reviews.title: Great vacation at Club Melia Paradisus
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Club Melia Paradisus in Cancun again this year (Jan 27-Feb 3).  It was a great vacation.  It did not disappoint.  The resort is showing some wear and tear.  Our rooms were in the Club Melia building (1316 and 1317).  Outside our rooms, there was severe condensation coming from the vents in the ceiling which required a huge laundry cart and multiple pads to absorb the water.  It truly was a safety hazard due to water on the tile flooring.  Other than that, we had no other issues.

Our rooms were very clean and the beds were super comfortable.  Bathrooms were fine but the faucets (sink and shower head) could use a good descaling.  Housekeeping was terrific and kept us fully stocked with towels.

The food was excellent at Lemon Fish and Capella and we ate at those two restaurants most of the time.  The food at Sante and Agua Marina restaurants was also very good.  We had lunch daily at Agua Marina and breakfast daily at Malva.
Malva was the least impressive because other than the omelet station, the hot items were just repurposed leftover food from the night before.  

I would like to give a heads up and big thank you to the following people who went out of their way to make our stay really enjoyable.  

Agua Marina lunch - Carlos and Antonio
Agua Marina dinner - Antonio
Lemon Fish dinner - Jorge, Daniel and Iran 
Sante - Roberto, manager, Monserrat, hostess, and Axel, server
Capella dinner - Jose and Jesus, servers, and Karely, hostess
Ginger Bar - Luz  
Malva - Candelario and Fernando 

I wish I had the name of the server on the beach in front of the Agua Marina restaurant to give him props, but I don't.  He remembered our drinks daily without even having to ask.

All in all, it was a fantastic trip and I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Dreamer40940942273
reviews.title: The resort was very nice, relaxing and the service was great. Would recommend to others!
reviews.text:
The service was excellent at the Paradisus Cancun on the adults only side. Our server by the pool Gabriella was excellent and our concierge Rocío was absolutely amazing!!! We were with a large group and she was so accommodating and helped with everything we asked! She even went the extra mile to decorate our friend’s room for her birthday.  

Isabella and Gemma were also excellent in the spa!!

The resort was very nice and clean and service was fast! The food was hit or miss but bc it was AI you can just order something else.

reviews.author: Ric J
reviews.title: Carders served it up big!
reviews.text: The pillows are the fluffiest I’ve ever felt! Caesar was great he suggested some great menu items. Unfortunately the didn’t have Caesar salad or Caesar to drink. The tacos were great and the drinks were flowing all night long. I worth paying for the meal at an all inclusive resort.

reviews.author: Scenic731814
reviews.title: Lo bueno y no tan bueno
reviews.text:
Lo mejor son las personas. Malva atendidos  por Ivonne en la mañana y Francisco capitán.
Lo peor el pan dulce, pan francés y mini hotcakes del buffet. Muy malita la masa, bonita presentación, sabor no mucho.
Lo demás muy bueno mucha variedad.

reviews.author: Karine T
reviews.title: Hôtel infesté de coquerelles
reviews.text: Coquerelles dans ma chambre et dans le lobby qui est entouré des restaurants. Nourriture du buffet le soir très passable, meme qualité que Cuba. Piscines très sales. Manque de chaises à la piscine et à la plage, il faut payer 250$ par jour pour tous les lits de plage ou de psicine qui sont vides. Vol retardé. Valise perdue. Les photos des chambres sur les sites ne correspondent pas du tout à celles aur place. Tres vieux et tout brise (pognées de porte, porte du balcon etc.. Hotel très désuet qui ne mérite pas ses 5 etoiles. Seuls points positifs sont : le personnel sur place viennent nous voir touts les 5 minutes pour les drink, la plage est superbe, lobby très beau, bon café et l'animation le.soir est bien.

reviews.author: Navigator53670784910
reviews.title: Great hotel with amazing staff!
reviews.text: The resort was lovely. So many different activities and restaurants to choose from. Our group stayed at the adult only Reserve portion and highly recommend. Diego Torres was our concierge and did an amazing job of making sure our needs were met and that our stay was relaxing. Cannot wait to come back!

reviews.author: mariana f
reviews.title: EXCELENTE EXPERIENCIA
reviews.text:
Instaciones: excelente, amplias y limpias. Un lobby hermoso. Una piscina de ensueños, bien mantenida. Las habitaciones son comodas, pero no tienen un solo cuadro, adorno, o algo que las haga especial. El techo alto, es como muy grande para lo que tiene el dormitorio.
Servicio: buena predisposicion las 24 hs. Tener en cuenta que los camareros trabajan con propinas, no te van a tratar mal si no les das, pero esperan ese dinero para poder sumar a su sueldo (escaso).
Grupo de animacion: calculo que no tienen porque nunca los vi. No se organizo ninguna actividad en la playa. A la noche hubo algunos espectaculos, asisti solo a uno de magia. Y dos noches de las que tuve, no hubo nada.
Comida: buena variedad, mariscos, pescados, pollo, carne, frutas, unos ricos jugos, licuados (lo detallo porque antes de hospedarme en este hotel estuve unos dias en Paradisus Los Cayos - Santa Maria y el servicio de comidas fue un muy escaso). Variedad de bebidas.

reviews.author: Wendy M
reviews.title: Wedding Vacation 2 in 1! Best time ever!
reviews.text: I booked my wedding and stay at this resort this weekend. This was my first time seeing it and coming in person and I will tell you I was very happy and in love with this place. We were attended very warmly and the staff was very attentive to our needs and to the rest of my guest who stayed here for the wedding. My wedding coordinator Melania K was amazing! She is very patient, kind and will go above and beyond to satisfy her customer. I broke my nails the day before my wedding and she was hunting down a nail tech for me that is how amazing she is! I also want to state this because it impacted how amazing my wedding was. On my wedding day the weather was pretty bad not only was it raining but the wind was horrible, 17 MPH and due to the weather conditions we had to move the wedding indoors. Melania still made my vision happen and I am forever grateful to her! Everyone had an amazing time. Also Abraham I’m which we met at Kannq bar outside by the beach, from the moment we met him (wedding party) we fell in love with him. He kept us going! We partied and had a great time so I requested him to be my bartender at the wedding bc we all wanted him to be part of it and let me tell you once again he did not fail, he definitely showed up and he also celebrated with us. We hope that when we go back we get to see him again! Thank you so much Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: Sofiya J
reviews.title: Relaxing bachelorette weekend
reviews.text: Our stay at Paradisus was nothing short of amazing. The resort was beautiful and peaceful and they had a gorgeous beach. The food was great, the staff were extra careful about allergies and the resort had more than enough options to accommodate our group’s dietary restrictions.  A special mention for our waiter Alberto at Malva who went above and beyond to make our stay enjoyable! Can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Shaya T
reviews.title: Paradisus Vacation
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort, clean grounds, good food, great pools, good rooms, and beaches and amazing staff! Abraham at the Kanna Bar was very kind and made the experience great! 
The entire resort smells amazing and feels like a spa oasis
10/10 would recommend a visit to this resort!

reviews.author: Susan D
reviews.title: Lovely family vacation!!! Would def return this resort again!
reviews.text:
Loved this resort. Amazing service and staff!  Everyone was always smiling and willing to help. We went with a few small children so we ate at the buffet a lot, good variety everyday! Was happy that you can just walk into any a la carts, makes dining a lot easier for kids.

The only con I would say is that there is no separate space for the nightly entertainment, we were on the floor above the lobby bar and every night it was so loud. If you have small children, I’d recommend a room in the further building.

reviews.author: Kathleen F
reviews.title: Beach Bar was a highlight!
reviews.text: Great service at Kanna beach bar. Abraham and Karina are the best! Also excellent service at the adults only pool. Victor hooked us up with chairs and cabanas every day. Food was mediocre and room didn’t have outlets by the bed which was not ideal.  Overall had a great time for a long weekend.

reviews.author: Virginia H
reviews.title: Mi experiencia fue maravillosa
reviews.text: Martin, Fernando y Gerardo son los mejores!! Hicieron que mi desayuno fuera espectacular!! Me hicieron sentir a mi y a mis amigas como en casa. Todo el hotel tiene diferentes ambientes que te hacen tener una experiencia única e inolvidable. Definitivamente me sentí en el paraíso. El aire que se respira y la energía de este lugar es mágica.

reviews.author: Carolyn P
reviews.title: Bella experiencia
reviews.text: Martin, Fernando y Gerardo son súper amables, te hacen tener una experiencia súper linda y te hacen sentirte muy bien. Excelente servicio en todo el hotel, nada negativo que decir. La comida estaba riquísima y fresca. Las habitaciones y el hotel en general súper limpio y con buen olor. Hermosa playa y piscina con servicio de comida a tu sillón incluido. Volveré.

reviews.author: Erika B
reviews.title: Great time!
reviews.text: Had a great experience! The food was delicious and fresh, they had great activities and a good drink selection. Abraham (night bartender) at Kanna bar was great and so helpful. He made us some wonderful shots! Ian at the swim up bar was also great 👍🏻

reviews.author: mrdesigntravel
reviews.title: 100% recomendado , estancia perfecta , comida deliciosa y variada
reviews.text: Atención de 10, servicio impecable , platos deliciosos y bien elaborados . Muy recomendado . Los restaurantes de la noche ofrecen platos a la carta muy buenos . Atención del personal excelente .es mi segunda estancia en el hotel y mi quinta en Cancún , pero seguiría escogiendo Paradisus.

reviews.author: GrandTour54076959312

reviews.text:
Beautiful resorts 
Was here for a wedding 
Everything was fantastic 
Would definitely come back

Full service and very kind servers.

reviews.title: Wedding time!

reviews.author: Destination561035

reviews.author: cipriano e

reviews.text: Gemma y Guadalupe nos dieron una muy buena experiencia en masaje, atentas y muy relajante. Muy amables desde principio hasta el final  yo en 41 años no avía tenido un masaje pero después de esta buena experiencia lo volveré hacer

reviews.author: M D
reviews.title: Highly Recommend Staying at the Reserve
reviews.text: We had a great time with a large group as the staff was all very kind and accommodating. Highly recommend staying at the Reserve section of the hotel for a relaxing vacation. Special thank you to Stelian for taking care of all of us and making our experience extra special!

reviews.author: elizabeth h
reviews.title: Must upgrade to Reserve!
reviews.text:
This is my second time staying at the Paradisus in the Reserve section (adults only). I decided to return after spending a heavenly honeymoon here back in Feb 2014. 10 years later and the hotel and reserve experience was better than ever. The highlights include:

1) coming in December was the best decision as the weather is mild and the hotel is beautifully decorated for the Winter holidays.
2) the beach was crystal blue everyday and the sand was free of sarghum. The view from our oceanfront suite was stunning.
3) the reserve perks were worth the extra expense, but especially the concierge service which either improved significantly in the past 10 years or we just got the best Concierge, Diego Torres!!! He gave us the best advice for daily dining, spa, and other experiences. He would surprise us with treats everyday, come check on us by the pool consistently and would even walk us down to dinner. I would definitely trust him in terms of ideal times for dining and spa reservations. He may be the best part of the trip and we can’t wait to request him in the near future. 
4) the spa was great and I recommend getting a massage!!
5) the new steakhouse (another reserve perk) that replaced the Michelin star Enzo was really good and a must try!
6) the rooms were great and service staff in general were all very responsive and friendly.
Some challenges that I hope get addressed before we return:

1) the reservation system that existed 10 years ago was replaced by walk ins only (except for the steakhouse) and basically if you don’t wait in a line at 5pm (doors open at 5:30) you risk not only getting seated when they open but then get placed on a list that can leave you waiting for hours before having dinner. This meant we ate the same food (the seafood restaurant in tower 1) two nights in a row in a resort with 10 restaurants! The poolside menu is also pretty limited and late night dining is also limited to room service. Overall, this system could use some improvement to make what was otherwise a perfect vacation.
2) you need to reserve your pool chairs before 9am everyday or risk having nowhere to put your belongings for pool days. If you maxed out on your two daybed reservations per room per stay, good luck with getting a daybed. We were lucky that for a 4 day, 5 night trip with 4 ppl and 2 rooms we were able to book one bed for everyday of our stay. Honestly the weather was so mild we didn’t really use them like we would have if it was much warmer. 

Overall, we not only plan on returning next year, we will be staying in the reserve section and requesting Diego Torres again!!

reviews.author: aavv2016
reviews.title: A memorable experience!
reviews.text: We enjoyed a memorable four day vacation at the Paradisus Reserve. Our check-in was smooth despite a significant flight delay and our beach view rooms were stunning. We were greeted by our concierge, Diego, who went above and beyond to make sure we enjoyed our stay. He was attentive, friendly, resourceful and thoughtful! We feel fortunate to have met him. Oscar was our go-to guy at the coffee bar and cabana service. He ensured we had everything we needed and provided great drink recommendations. Julio served the best tea and tequila. The entire staff was wonderful! Uriel was our spinning instructor — he hyped us up with his fun energy. The food overall was great, however, we did no eat at the buffet, except for one time for breakfast. Securing a table at the restaurants is very tricky unless you’re willing to stand in line at 5:30 for a table. The wait times are over an hour and only the steak house accepts reservations. Our overall experience was better than expected and we plan to return soon.

reviews.author: Micaela F
reviews.title: Los mejores

reviews.text: Muy buen servicio de parte de Gaby,Karinna y Abraham en el gingerbar se portaron de maravilla con nosotros y nos sirvieron muy buenos tragos la calidad del servicio impresionante muy buena Gracias por el buen serivicio VIVAAA MEXICOOO!!!! 🍻🍻🇲🇽🍻

reviews.author: Reina R

reviews.text:
Muy buen hotel! Muchas actividades y amenidades. La atención de todos muy buena :) 

La comida muy rica tiene muchos restaurantes para escoger y especialmente la atención de George el Concierge y de Brenda la Concierge de grupos fue excelente!!

reviews.author: Kathy R
reviews.title: VALERIA!!
reviews.text: Valeria is our favorite server - we enjoyed the 5 meals we spent with her.  Her restaurant is by the adults-only pool.  Try the ceviche and hummus.  We will miss her, until next time! Thank you, Valeria!

reviews.author: Giulia M

reviews.text: Muy ricos los tragos de Gaby, karina y Abraham. Nos la hemos pasado genial con ellos en el Ginger. Soy muy amigables y tienen un excelente servicio. Te la vas a pasar súper con ellos. Gracias por toooodo chicos. Nos quedamos encantados.🥰🥰

reviews.author: Camila C
reviews.title: Paradisus el mejor hotel en cancun
reviews.text: Gaby, Karina y Abraham son los mejores, pasamos genial con ellos en el ginger. Son muy buen onda y amigables y tienen excelente servicio, gracias por todo.❤️. Esperemos verlos pronto de nuevo. Para más diversión🥰

reviews.author: Jesus R
reviews.title: La mejor experiencia que nunca podré olvidar❤️
reviews.text: La hemos pasado increíble. Agradecida con todo el equipo de paradisíacas. Pero especialmente a Gaby junto a Karina son unas meseras y bartenders espectaculares. Te tratan de maravilla en el ginger (sport bar). Vayan al ginger se la van a pasar genial. Gracias por todo🥂🥳😊👍

reviews.author: Javier A
reviews.title: Trato en Barra
reviews.text: Karina la mesera del Ginger bar se porto muy mal haciendo malos comentarios y tratándonos mal una falta de respeto a mi y a mis amigos y exigió propina haciendo comentarios. Probar cambio de mecero porfas

reviews.author: Amanda D
reviews.title: A great experience!
reviews.text: Paradisus is beautiful! The aesthetic is so unique compared to any resort I’ve stayed in. It’s like a true rainforest. The hotel was clean. The staff were all EXTREMELY friendly. The food was pretty good. Definitely had a lot of cultural Mexican options. The beach was clean, clear, and inviting. Alejandro at the Nespresso counter was so sweet! Me and my friends loved seeing him every day when we stopped by for our lattes. Nim, who worked at the front with check was sooo helpful! She took a personal interest in us to make sure we were satisfied with our room. I would definitely recommend this place :)

reviews.author: Agustín M
reviews.title: Ginger bar. El mejor lugar 😊😊
reviews.text: Gaby en el ginger bar es la mejor. Excelente servicio, excelente actitud y el mejor servicio  que hemos tenido en paradisus es verdaderamente increíble. Por ella nos la pasamos genial. Gracias por todo.🤓🤓

reviews.author: Rodrigo
reviews.title: El mejor en Cancún
reviews.text: La mejor experiencia, año con año, sabes que es calidad cuando no quieres irte el último día y de verdad te hacen sentir que estás en casa, gracias a Roberto, a Fany por mencionar, pero todos logran hacer que tu estancia sea increíble, la comida, el ambiente, la amabilidad con la que te atienden es inigualable

reviews.author: Brendan H
reviews.title: Awesome. Mit excellente
reviews.text: Everything about this place is amazing. Highly recommend! The service people amenities etc are all top notch!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Thank you Jon P, Ati, Fernando, Alfredo, Grisel, Armando, Candelario!!

reviews.author: Maddie L
reviews.title: Love it
reviews.text: Gaby and abraham are the best bartenders I’ve ever experienced. I’ve been all over the world and they are the most positive spirits I’ve seen in years. The whole resort is fun but these two really made the entire trip! I would prefer to go to ginger bar to see and feel their energy than to go to another bar.

reviews.author: Alexandra Rivera
reviews.title: Incredible staff
reviews.text: We love Baltazar!!!!!!! He gave us incredible service all weekend. Everyone was so helpful and sweet. The resort is beautiful, the food was great, but the staff was the best part! We will be back every year!

reviews.author: Evan L
reviews.title: My Favourite Resort in Cancun
reviews.text: Amazing resort, with a great pool and beach area, delicious restaurants, and friendly staff. Irina by the pool gave us the best drink service of my whole trip! We went for Ember Shores 3 years in a row and never left disappointed! Thank you to the entire Paradisus staff :)

reviews.author: Natalie B
reviews.title: Th best time ever !
reviews.text: Request hector everytime!!! He is so helpful and very kind😊 he made my birthday well worth it and the festival every easy to navigate, this is my third year back and I can’t wait to be back for year four !

reviews.author: Elizabeth B
reviews.title: Hector Service
reviews.text: Hector was amazing! You can always count on him to go above and beyond your expectations! Made the trip more than enjoyable, we’ve been 3 years in a row and look forward to seeing him every year! Hope to see him again next year!

reviews.author: Aleksander H
reviews.title: Mejor hotel, Mejor STAFF
reviews.text:
Las perfectas vacaciones, gracias al alojamiento, el STAFF y las actividades ofrecidas.
El Hotel cuenta con muchas variedades de TODO (actividades, comida=más de 7 restaurantes, musica, bares, SPA...), es muy muy limpio, siempre huele bien y la habitacion muy amplia con buena vista.

Gracias a Lilli, concierge, fue siempre atenta, nos contestaba a todas nuestras preguntas cualquier hora, fue un servicio
impecable, muy amable y perfecto.

In GINGER BAR, GRACIAS Y MUCHAS
GRACIAS a Gaby, Corona, Abraham, y
Karina, tenía la mejor experiencia de toda
la estancia. Sentí que los conozco de toda la vida, siempre te reciben con una sonrisa muy grande.
Fueron súper amable, atentos
y sobre todo lo pasaba super bien con ellos.

En SANTE RESTAURANT/BAR, igual que en Ginger,  GrACIAS a los chicos que eran también amables y muy muy atentos.
Gracias al bar men Luis y Alejandro, SIEMPRE nos prepararon cocktails super buenos, y a nuestro gusto, aparte de su amabilidad.

Luego, los chicos del restuarante y la piscina: Cesar, Oscar, Moises (El sapo, que le gusta que se le llama así, es muy gracioso, jejeje) y Valeria, eran siempre atentos y presentes, siempre te preguntan con una sonrisa si te hace falta algo.
