reviews.author: Davíð Ingi
reviews.title: Great time!
reviews.text: Great night out and Jorge showed us a great time! We had amazing shared meal experience and Jorge had his recommendation to the point. I’d recommend the restaurant in a heartbeat. If you like to have some drinks the tequila is out of the world!

reviews.author: Taylor A
reviews.title: Treated like a queen!
reviews.text:
Had a blast, the service is amazing from the moment I stepped out of the taxi. Food is great, drinks are strong. The level of service was made me feel relaxed and worry free. I can't wait to return!!

Highly recommend for your next getaway!

reviews.author: Jane P
reviews.title: Yellow Fish
reviews.text: Lemon fish was a delicious restaurant, one of our favorites.  Our waiter Juan Carlos or J.C. was top notch.  The drinks were great, the salmon was fresh and delicious and the atmosphere was gorgeous! Highly recommend this restaurant!

reviews.author: Andreia Vieira
reviews.title: Hotel maravilhoso mas nem tudo All-inclusive
reviews.text:
O hotel é maravilhoso,  instalações luxuosas , belíssimo. 

 Mas algumas situações não eram esperadas para um resort All-inclusive , 5 estrelas.  

Aluguel das camas da piscina e praia , nada no site informava que eram pagas.  U235 por dia , quase o valor de uma diária no hotel . Percebemos que pra empurrar o aluguel ,  Os funcionários da piscina com falso argumento de vento não deixavam abrir os guarda sois da piscina . Sendo que na outra piscina estavam abertos , ficou claro que estavam forçando todos a ficar no sol , até casais com crianças para ficarem incomodados e aderir ao aluguel,  foi assim por 3 dias,  até que reclamamos com o Guest e os guarda sois foram abertos no quarto dia , ventando igual .  Não havia justificativa para em uma piscina estarem abertos e em outra não. 

Precisam investir em Treinamento de pessoal, os restaurantes em geral não te atendem bem se vc chegar faltando meia hora pra fechar.  Ou seja se vc for assistir algum show e for mais longo ,  como aconteceu e quiser jantar precisa sair antes de terminar. 

Falta de preparo do Guest para atender as solicitações.  Nossa diária tinha incluso o transfer para o aeroporto. 2 dias antes fomos confirmar nossa reserva.  Recebemos um email da recepção com o localizador do transfer , Achamos que estava tudo certo. Na manhã no check-out fomos confirmar.  O funcionário que nos atendeu não encontrou a reserva,  mostramos o email,  ele então ligou pra um lugar passou os dados e fez nova reserva , garantindo que estava tudo correto , pediu pra estarmos na portaria 10 minutos antes. Assim fizemos. Chegamos antes,  fizemos o check-out,  Aguardamos na recepção e nada do transfer.  20 minutos depois nos dirigimos ao funcionário  que nos atendeu naquela manhã e ainda estava no balcão,  e ele então meio que jogou a culpa em nós,  falando que tínhamos que ter procurado as pessoas que estavam organizando no lado de fora . Argumentei que em momento algum ele passou a orientação.  Ele então foi conversar com os responsáveis pelo transporte,  ligaram para a empresa e claramente percebemos que não havia reserva no nosso nome novamente.  Ficaram revisando uma lista e não havia nada no nosso nome . Começamos a ficar aflitos por conta do horário do voo.  O funcionário entrava e saia de uma sala . Então saiu com dinheiro na mão e mandou chamar um taxi pra nós.  

O hotel é maravilhoso mas precisa investir em Treinamento de pessoal e rever a questão do aluguel caríssimo das camas . Ou então não expor  fotos com a camas dando entender que teremos acesso ao conforto.

reviews.author: Curious06479886083
reviews.title: Love this resort!
reviews.text:
A girl's trip to Cancun could not have had a better start!
Our first night at Paradisus Cancun was fantastic! Jorge, Dania and Nurby at Ginger 2 took very good care of us. They made us feel so welcome with their excellent customer service. Jorge, the bartender, came to our table, and not only did he share his knowledge of tequila and history of margaritas, he created a special drink for us that was fragrant, flavorful, and delicious! It was unlike anything we had ever tasted. Dania and Nurby epitomize service with a smile. These ladies were so kind and attentive. They made us feel like VIP guests! Paradisus Cancun is a beautiful resort truly because of these beautiful people!

reviews.author: Javier C
reviews.title: Las mejores vacaciones !
reviews.text: Mi experiencia en el hotel  ha sido de. Maravilla. Conocimos en el ginger bar a Abraham el mixologo, Gaby,Karina. Ellos hicieron de. Nuestras vacaciones algo inolvidable. Gracias por todas sus atenciones. Los quiero muxo😘🥰👭👬.

reviews.author: Que T
reviews.title: Avoid this place at all costs
reviews.text:
The resort was ok - the food is mediocre and none of the restaurants opened/closed at the time that they advertised on their brochures. I paid extra for upgrading my room to The Reserve section which was advertised as the adult-only section. I'm a light sleeper so I did the room upgrade to be in a section without kids to minimize the noise. Based on the map that I was provided at check-in, the Reserve section is shown to be in Tower 5 but I was placed in Tower 3. As the stay went on, I heard screaming children in the rooms next door so it seems that I was not given the room that I paid extra for - this was the first red flag.

The experience that soured my trip was by the front desk staff and the resort's business practices - I felt like I might have gotten scammed. The front desk staff were terrible. The resort seems very dishonest as well - most hotels would automatically provide guests with their folios at check-outs, but this resort did not do so until it was asked. When checking out, I asked for a copy of my folio. The front desk staff replied "Folio for what?" - it's strange for a front desk agent to ask such a question as he was responsible for guest check-ins and check-outs...When he finally provided me with the folio, I noted that I was overcharged for the stay (this was probably why the resort was reluctant to provide folios to guests). I asked for a refund and the front desk staff refused to help. He dismissed my concern and told me that this is how the folio is supposed to look without any further explanation. Since I had to catch my flight, I did not have time to speak to a supervisor. Once I got home, I even re-checked my original booking multiple times and confirmed that I was indeed overcharged. I tried to contact the property regarding my overpayment and no one replied to my messages. When I first booked my reservation, the resort was very responsive regarding buying upgrades, etc. Now that they got my money, they ignored me. As of today, I still have not heard back from them regarding this issue. It's incredibly disturbing and unprofessional - I will not be returning and will not recommend this resort to anyone else. Stay away at all costs.

reviews.author: dlusk889
reviews.title: Great Vacation!
reviews.text: We had an incredible stay at the Paradisus Cancun Resort.  The best part were their staff.  We had two standout employees that made our trip so fun and special. First was GAUDENCIO who was our waiter on the beach. We spent every day in his section. Gaudencio was awesome and so fun!  We even moved to where he was serving on the beach when he took a different section. He was our guy! Second was ARIEL who was involved with many of the activities.  Ariel was also a very fun loving employee.  We will always have wonderful memories of our vacation and time spent with Gaudencio and Ariel.  We would highly recommend the Paradisus for your next vacation getaway!

reviews.author: Sakhawat K
reviews.title: Great times, great vibes
reviews.text: Fantastic all-inclusive resort. My friend and I had the best getaway. A must stay. Highly recommend. The service was exceptional, especially from Abraham the mixology bartender, Sofonias and Gaby in the Ginger Bar!

reviews.author: Katelyn V
reviews.title: Yummy food
reviews.text: We went to blue agave and the tacos were delicious . santos was our waiter and was so nice and helpful. There are so many yummy places to eat here def recommend! Its a great place for vacation as a couple and with friends

reviews.author: Bryan H
reviews.title: Great Mixology class at Ginger bar!
reviews.text: Amazing! Abraham and Lia are amazing  and friendly! The mixology class was so much fun. Both the drinks were educational and delicious. I would highly recommend a stay at the Paradisus Cancun and to spend some time at the Ginger bar where there are activities and great music. Try the coco loco!

reviews.author: Dulce C
reviews.title: Excelente experiencia
reviews.text: Me encantó la experiencia! Excelente opción si buscas relajarte pero también divertirte. El hotel es hermoso y cada detalle lo tienen súper bien cuidado. Mis cosas favoritas fueron la comida y las actividades! Me encanta que los encargados de estas actividades son personas súper entusiasmadas que contagian felicidad y se nota que aman lo que hacen. Amé las clases de baile, actividades en la alberca, el karaoke y la fiesta de antifaces. Sin duda fueron unas vacaciones excelentes!

reviews.author: Anna W
reviews.title: Best vacation spot
reviews.text: Best staff at ginger bar next to the lobby! So friendly, welcoming and amazing staff! Mixologist are the best. They were always willing to have our drinks ready and came back regularly to check in to see how we were doing

reviews.author: Emma K
reviews.title: The best trip, the best staff, the best time🙌🏼
reviews.text: Abraham the mixologist was amazing! I strongly recommend the Ginger Bar! Also the waiters Salvador,  Gabby, Beatriz and Sofonias were beyond amazing! Ask for the margaritas, you won’t be disappointed!!

reviews.author: Natalie A
reviews.title: Amazing experience, thanks to our concierge Jose!
reviews.text: We  had an amazing time at Paradisus Cancun! A huge shoutout to our amazing concierge Jose! He made our stay so and was so attentive. Greatly appreciate all the attention to detail he did to make our friends trip special. Everything about this resort is exquisite, the food to the bar and all the activities they have for anyone to do! This was my friends first time coming to Cancun and we will be back soon!

reviews.author: Matheus Soares
reviews.title: Péssima experiência de check-in
reviews.text: De toda a experiência, o mais grave foi o quarto não estar pronto no horário previsto. Eu tinha um casamento no próprio hotel, e expliquei à equipe que precisava entrar um pouco antes no quarto para me arrumar. Além de não serem flexíveis nisso, o quarto simplesmente não estava pronto no horário. Tive que tomar banho e me arrumar no quarto de um amigo. A equipe do hotel não resolveu meu problema e não demonstrou importância a algo que estava previsto na reserva. Além disso, algumas pessoas forneceram péssimo atendimento e flexibilidade nas opções de alimentação. Honestamente, pelo preço que custa, esperava muito mais serviços, atrações e facilidades no hotel. A sensação é que, além de ter poucas opções, as poucas que existem são cobradas de forma avulsa. Até a sauna é cobrada. Não recomendo a experiência.

reviews.author: Felicia M
reviews.title: Excellent Vacation!
reviews.text: Once again, this resort did not disappoint! We experienced excellent service at the beach, pool and all of the restaurants.  The food was excellent as well, we enjoyed fine dining every evening!  Friendly faces greeted us every morning at the buffet, in the hallways and on the beach.  We have been Club Melia members for a number of years, and look forward to this trip every year.

reviews.author: Carlos G
reviews.title: The best bartender in Cancun
reviews.text: Abraham was the best bartender I have ever ever ever had he needs to be promoted 100% took care of me and my friends every single night til the day we left we absolutely love him and we honestly plan to come back literally just for him we not only gained an amazing experience and a friend here in Cancun Mexico he is an amazing fun time makes everything a 100% better please keep him please ask for him and please tip him we all love him from Carlos, Karina, Natalie, Cinthia, William, and Maria!!!!! We love you Abraham!!!!

reviews.author: Safari661912
reviews.title: Amazing time at the Paradisus
reviews.text:
There is a reason why we keep coming back to the Melia brand and that has to do with the people who are there to make your vacation special. A group of 7 of us just got back from a week at the Paradisus Cancun and it was an amazing time. We got The Reserve upgrade for a great price when we booked back in the spring and I have to say it is so worth it. Having the option of the adult pool and beach was very nice. 

As for the people, I have to point out a few who really made it so special. Oscar and Valeria who worked The Reserve area and restaurant knew us by name and couldn’t do enough to make sure we had what we needed. At the Malva buffet, Alfonso got you smiling first thing in the morning always remembering what we drank from our iced coffees  and various juices. If you go to the sports bar, be sure to find Gaby (my namesake) - it was funny because the first time I walked in during this trip, she came up to me and said how she remembered me from the last time I was there in 2022 (and remembered my name). And I need to mention Gaudencio who served us on the beach. It was quite a trek to shlep drunks but he had us hydrated each time we visited his area. Never had to ask because he was always there with more!

Can’t wait to return next year!

reviews.author: Kevin Z
reviews.title: A great experience with great food!
reviews.text: Paradisus is a wonderful hotel! We had a wonderful time with friends despite the rain (which of course is not the hotel’s fault). There were a few activities that were unfortunately canceled due to weather, but there were still plenty of buffets, pool swimming, and fun indoor activities available. Meals were good - Cielo was easily the best experience and our waiter Moises Morales went above and beyond to make sure that we had a wonderful time. I’m also a bit extra and asked for extra appetizers and entrees, and that was a non-issue (I was hungry, what can I say). We were also interested in the fancy top shelf tequila and Moises brought it over to explain it to us. He went above and beyond and it really elevated our dining experience. Overall… Resort: 4/5 - some areas showing their age but still very clean and well kept, Dining: 5/5 - always available, and Cielo is very good, Towels: 3/5, they kept running out probably due to weather, Weather: 2/5 (not their fault), My phone not working: 1/5 (also not their fault). We had a wonderful time!

reviews.author: Yenifer S
reviews.title: Gracias!
reviews.text: Comimos en el restaurante Malva y la verdad que muy rico! Muchísima variedad En especial Gracias a Ricardo, Arnulfo y Guillermo por la Atención y el detalle de regalo de cumple de nuestra amiga. Saludos

reviews.author: Alan E
reviews.title: Rafael y Carlos de Lemon fish
reviews.text:
Un lugar increible,Excelente atención,calidad muy buena!super recomendable,sin duda volveremos.
Los platos de comida deliciosos.rafael y Carlos muy atentos.
Gracias a todos,gracias al equipo de lemon fish,un ambiente cálido y confortable.

reviews.author: adriana m
reviews.title: Restaurante Lemon fish. Rafael
reviews.text: Excelente servicio! Rafael ,carlos y todo su equipo nos atendieron muy bien! Atentos en todo y muy amables!  Festejamos dos cumpleaños y estuvieron en todos los detalles! Nos vamos muy a gusto y con ganas de volver

reviews.author: LuchoE
reviews.title: Rafael y Carlos de Lemonfish Los mejores
reviews.text: Rafael y Carlos no solo nos atendieron de lujo sino q nos hicieron una gran sorpresa por mi cumpleaños!! Muchas gracias por la excelente atención y hacernos sentir como en casa ! Si van , pidan por ellos !!!

reviews.author: gonzalo dtp
reviews.title: Paseo de amigos en Melia - Cancun
reviews.text:
Lo pasamos increíble, muy buena atención en toda la estadía. Lo.mejor karina de la sección de Kanna!! Muy atenta y divertida, la verdad un amor 🫶. 

Espero volver y lo recomiendo 100% para venir en grupos de amigos o familia

reviews.author: Mong S
reviews.title: We are having a good time with everything here
reviews.text: Good service and friendly staff. They were very helpful. Aurelio was our server at Cappella. He was very nice. He has a good recommendation for our meals. The food was excellent. The atmosphere was cozy and relaxing

reviews.author: Lenabean25
reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text: I would not come here again. We came with a chartered group so we didn’t choose this location. It was okay but nothing special. We had a leak in our room and they said “yeah, just put towel down” and didn’t seem to care. Staff was inattentive and not terribly friendly.  Staff seemed clueless whenever we asked for anything as if it was everyone’s first day working there. Food was very good. Bar was great. Pool was very nice and well maintained. It certainly was not horrible. But I’ve stayed at much better places

reviews.author: Mkgraspa
reviews.title: Lemon Fish, must try!
reviews.text: Lemon Fish was delicious! Jorge our server was super friendly and attentive. Everything from chef Karen, yum! Try the green shrimp ceviche! Lomo lomo was also a hit with our group. We’ll eat here again before we leave.

reviews.author: Sarah L
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Jorge @ Lemon Fish was a wonderful server. Very attentive and made.great suggestions. The green shrimp ceviche was refreshing. Compliments to chef Karen! We ordered both ceviches, the grilled zucchini, short rib tacos,!omo Salgado with tacu tacu

reviews.author: Janice Smith
reviews.title: Wonderful experience at Paradisus Lemon Fish Restaurant
reviews.text:
Had dinner at Lemon Fish Jorge was our server and he was attentive, friendly, and took care of us. We wanted coconut drinks and he made sure we got our coconuts. Paradisus is lucky to have him. 
The food was delicious, thanks to Chef Karen. Everything tasted fresh and presented well.

reviews.author: Alejandra F
reviews.title: Buena experiencia
reviews.text: Es nuestra primera vez en el hotel Paradisus y la hemos pasado estupendo. Conocimos en el Ginger (Sports bar) a Gaby, Nurbi, Abraham y Levi. Son buenas personas, amigables, divertidos. Te hacen sentir como en casa. Mi unica sugerencia es agregar mas conexiones en las habitaciones ya que nos faltaba para cargar dispositivos. Esperemos volver pronto y pasar experiencias inolvidables.

reviews.author: David Smith
reviews.title: Raffel and great sushi
reviews.text:
Raffel provided excellent service to go with the great food and amazing atmosphere.  

Definitely the best sushi I’ve had in Mexico!

Staying at the parradisus hotel.  Great resort.  

If you are looking for a place in cancun come here!

reviews.author: Kenny Lloyd
reviews.title: Book it IMMEDIATELY!!
reviews.text: STELIAN, STELIAN, STELIAN!!!!!!!!!!! The absolute best concierge EVER!!! Request him and your experience just got that much better (no disrespect to the other concierges. He has to come from a room full of greatness!)….As if the property didn’t wow me, the service matched…all the staff was friendly. Like so friendly I got tired of reaching my hand over my heart in return greetings 😂😂. But seriously though, I’m coming back soon. I’m requesting STELIAN, and absorb myself in their warmth!!….and special shout-out to the hydro pool guy. That was AMAZING!!!!…photos taken with iPhone and NO filter!!!

reviews.author: daniel b
reviews.title: My experience
reviews.text: Very good experience, spacious and comfortable rooms, the attention of all the employees is excellent, the buffet meets expectations, but the best without a doubt are its themed restaurants, the Italian, meats, lemon fish, etc. I highlight the attention of Iran (in charge of the restaurants), who always attended to us as if we were his family, without a doubt I would return for him!!!! THANK YOU AND SEE YOU IN LIFE

reviews.author: Chirag B
reviews.title: WORST EXPERIENCE - DONT WASTE YOUR MONEY
reviews.text: If I can give negative stars, I would have done so for this resort. Service was horrible, the food was not up to par. Our entire room got flooded with water due to rain and throughout the resort, there were water leaks from roof. In check-in area, they kept water buckets to collect water! Don't waste your vacation time in this resort. It felt like the employees were trained to say "NO" to everything. Lot of the restaurants were not even open. Drinks were all sugary, no alcohol at all in them. We paid for NIKTE and it was absolute rip off! There was no premium alcohol whatsoever. Breakfast has only 1 restaurant option and the menu is the same. There was 1 bread that was not changed/touched for our entire stay! For this price you can find something better!

reviews.author: Bety F
reviews.title: De mega más
reviews.text:
Excelente vista, la playa es hermosa, es muy grande y limpia; la comida es deliciosa en cualquiera de sus restaurantes.
El servicio está de mega más y todos los meseros y staff son muy amables. La hemos pasado increíble.

reviews.author: Sara F
reviews.title: Lo mejor de paradisus
reviews.text:
Todo excelente la comida riquísima, la atención otro nivel, en el lemon fiji Daniel dainzu nos leyó la mente, recomiendo totalmente, no se arrepentirán. 
Y la vista es de lo mejor de Cancún, no la encontrarán más que en la zona hotelera

reviews.author: elkinmunoz123
reviews.title: SERVICIO CON EL ALMA
reviews.text: Espectacular lugar para descansar,  excelente servicio, comida deliciosa y bastante variedad gastronómica, servicio con el alma y una ubicación perfecta. No tengo ninguna queja, al contrario todo me pareció muy lindo  y volvería sin pensarlo.

reviews.author: Jill M
reviews.title: Great Resort to Unplug and Relax!
reviews.text:
We love the Paradissus Cancun Resort and have been vacationing at this resort for over 25 years.
Most of our time each day is relaxing by the pool! 
The pool staff is great and especially Asuncion and Laura!  Both ladies are awesome and so attentive and friendly.  They make sure we have everything we need and/or want and make us feel extra special!  
We are already looking forward to our next trip in 2024!

reviews.author: Mike T
reviews.title: Lemon Fish is the place to go!
reviews.text: We went to the Lemon Fish restaurant. Jorge was our waiter and he provided some excellent recommendations. Everything was amazing! We somehow made it to desert and again everything was fantastic. Frangelico is excellent with any desert. Thank you to the chefs Mario and Karen for making our meal memorable.

reviews.author: Trip12529762720
reviews.title: Cafe con Carlos
reviews.text: Carlos at the coffee bar when you come from the beach will always meet you with a big smile  and generous service. He clearly loves people and his job which can be hard to find. Definitely recommend finding him and enjoying some brew.

reviews.author: Jen A
reviews.title: Jorge is the best!
reviews.text: Jorge was our server at Lemon Fish and went above and beyond to make our experience so memorable! We were at dinner for nearly three hours and he brought us special plates and gave us tips on what to order. The tuna tacos were incredible, and every sushi roll we tried was delicious. We also had all of the desserts - our favorites were the spiced pineapple and the chocolate cake. 1000% recommend, and if you can get Jorge as your server your experience will be that much better. We ate here twice on our 3-night stay. Get there right when it opens at 6, as it gets busy!

reviews.author: Laura M
reviews.title: Great Service
reviews.text: Rafael at Lemon-Fish was a top notch server! Excellent food and attentive server. Met all our needs and requests. Superb. Every time I turned around there he was, as if by magic, ready to serve, easily the best waiter I have ever had.

reviews.author: Suzanne V
reviews.title: Excelentes vacaciones con amigos, buena comida y un servicio inmejorable
reviews.text: Esta es la 4ta vez que nos quedamos en el Paradidus Cancún. Se notaron unos cambios esta vez pero la experiencia fue incredible como siempre. La comida de este resort, todo incluido, es fantástica y esa es una de las razones por que nuestro grupo de 5 parejas ha decidido regresar durante estos años. Lo otro que nos atrae es la amabilidad y la calidad de la gente que trabaja ahi. Todas las mañanas nos recibían en el restaurant Malva, Candelario, Rafael, Ramiro y Teresa para el desayuno y el servicio era impeccable, estaban pendientes de todos los detalles. En ese restaurant almorzamos un día y Atilano fue muy amable también. Este restaurant es buffet y es muy bueno y variado, para todos los gustos. En el resort tienen un café Nespresso, en las mañanas y a media tarde tomamos café ahi, Ivonn, Alejandro (que a también trabaja en Malva) y Carlos super simpáticos. En el área de la piscina (alberca) Laura estaba siempre pendiente de que no nos faltara nada, super trabajadora y eficiente como en los otros años que habiamos ido. Luis en el bar de la piscina, super comico y eficiente. Casi todos los días almorzamos en el restaurant Agua Marina que tiene una variedad de comidas con pescados y mariscos excelente, la vista inmejorabley alli Kristel y Alex se esmeraban por que todo estuviera a nuestro gusto. Las opciones para la cena son variadas y todas excelentes, uno de los que mas nos gustó fue Cielo, cenamos 2 veces ahi. Comida Mexicana muy buena, el trato personalizado, el Chef David se acercó ambos días a ver si era de nuestro agrado, nos dió información de algunos platos típicos y en compañia de José hicieron nuestras veladas super agradables. Para cerrar nuestros días ibamos a ver los shows y terminabamos en el ginger bar donde tuvimos diferentes temas cada día, noche de neon, los 80, Sociedad secreta y otros mas. Alli Dania, Gaby y Valentín nos atendieron siempre con una sonrisa. Luz en el area de recepción super chevere y se acordaba de nostros de otro años. Todas las tardes jugabamos volleyball. La pasamos super bien otra vez mas. Ya estamos planeando nuestro regreso en el 2024.

reviews.author: Emil D
reviews.title: Sobre el restaurante Sal
reviews.text: La experiencia en el restaurante Sal en México, Cancún, fue muy gratificante; el servicio, sobretodo de Juan Reynoso, impecable. Las cantidades satisfactorias, y la calidad de la comida muy superior a la expectativa. No dejen de visitarlos.

reviews.author: Lissette Nunez
reviews.title: Cena en Sal
reviews.text:
Excelente servicio de Juan en el restaurante Sal.

Muy buenas atenciones del camarero. Nos hizo sentir como en casa. Excelente comida, cortes de carnes premium. Postres espectaculares.
 
El chef Arturo, excelente trabajo.

reviews.author: Araceli
reviews.title: Fall Break @ Paradisus with amazing friends!!  We are Atlanta United
reviews.text:
We are 5 couples and this is our 5th time at Melia Paradisus Cancun.  Great hotel, amazing food, incredible service.  Looking forward to our 6th time on Sep. 2024.  

I want to especially recognize the following people:

- Buffet Malva: Rafael, Candelario, Teresa, Ramiro, Alejandro.
- Front desk BAR: Luz
- Agua Marina: Kristel, Alex
- Cielo: Chef David, José Garcia
- Ginger Bar: Dania, Gaby, Valentín
- Entertainment: Santiago (Santi), Montse
- Pool Bar: Laura, Julio
- Nespresso: Ivonn, Alejandro, Carlos
- Gimnasio: Vanessa
- Guest services: Fernando, Valeria

reviews.author: Daniela R
reviews.title: Excelente estancia
reviews.text: Excelente ambiente en la alberca, fiestas temáticas. Excelente atención de Gaby y Dania en las fiesta temáticas en el Ginger Bar y a Valentin . Ulises 10/10 en la playa , actuvidades como volleyball y fútbol

reviews.author: Loreto Rguez Ruzich
reviews.title: La gente de la piscina nos atendió muy pero muy bien
reviews.text: Las almohadas son muy blandas, el hotel es antiguo pero se mantiene muy bien. La atención del Pool bar es buenísimo Alejandro, Leo, Manuel, Rodrigo, Eduardo, Didier, Elíseo, Cauich, la mejor experiencia

reviews.author: Alberto P
reviews.title: Amazing!!!
reviews.text: Our stay at the hotel was amazing!! Good food, good drinks and amazing customer service. Beatriz that works at the Ginger Bar was very kind and loving, she provided us with an outstanding customer service. Thank you Beatriz from Alberto, Alejandro and Javiel, you’re amazing and you made us feel very special with your kindness and professionalism. Keep it up the good work! 👌🏼

reviews.author: Dream545067
reviews.title: Lovely place
reviews.text: The staff was excellent!! Beautiful views and great food! The beach was lovely with shaded huts and very attentive attendants. The room was nice too. The people all really made the stay though. They all went above and beoynd to make sure we were happy and taken care of!

reviews.author: ELIZABETH C
reviews.title: Gran hotel
reviews.text: Fue una experiencia maravillosa. Fuimos para la despedida de soltera de una amiga y qué increible servicio. Desde el restaurante hasta la playa, todo de ensueño. Ramiro y Alfredo nos atendieron en el buffet de desayuno y fueron tan atentos, amables  y se aseguraron que siempre empezaríamos el día con el pie derecho. Rentamos una cama Bali  en la alberca, y fueron súper detallistas y nos pusieron globos y decoraciones. Desde recepción hasta la salida, El Paradisus excedió mis expectativas. Atte  Carla F. de Alba Navarro

reviews.author: Mariana M
reviews.title: Excelente servicio por parte del mesero Santos en el restaurante blue agave
reviews.text: En general la atención es buena . Son muy atentos , productos de excelente calidad en el hotel . Disfrute mucho de la estancia . Me gustaría tuvieran más meseros porque en el area de bufet no son suficientes .

reviews.author: Isis B M
reviews.title: Rafael en restaurante Lemon fish
reviews.text: El mejor mesero del hotel, muy amable, atento, la comida del lugar súper fresca y rica, probamos casi todos los sushis y aguachile rojo. Nos sirvieron muy rápido a diferencia de los otros restaurantes del hotel 🙈

reviews.author: Cesar M
reviews.title: José fue de lo mejor
reviews.text: Nuestra experiencia con José fue lo mejor. Comimos en el cielo. La comida era excelente. Probamos la birria y las enchiladas y eran genial. Recomendado por mucha gente y con buena razón. Prueba el flan también.

reviews.author: Katrina K
reviews.title: Moises is the man
reviews.text: Moises, Kenia and David were amazing at Cielo! Moises offered great service and made our night fantastic. So amazing! The food was impeccable and the experience was truly unmatched. Moises is the man!

reviews.author: Dmitri L
reviews.title: GRADUACION Y CUMPLEAÑOS INOLVIDABLES
reviews.text:
Simplemente Fenomenal! Altamente recomendado para ir con amigo o en familia... Ubicacion privilegiada, instalaciones de lujo, F & B digno de M *. Clara Cortez organizó todo para una excelente experiencia de graduacion con Cumpleaños.

!No duden en reservar!
Dmitri López

reviews.author: Adrian V
reviews.title: Rafael
reviews.text: Excelente ambiente, ambiente familiar, excelente trato de parte de personal y meseros, comida muy sabrosa. Lugares espaciosos, excelente para fotografías y momentos de relajación, decoración y limpieza excelente.

reviews.author: Maria Isabel G
reviews.title: Excelente experiencia
reviews.text: Una muy buena experiencia. Las instalaciones muy bien, la única pega bañera en el baño; comida rica y por encima de todo destacaría el trato del personal: amabilidad, simpatía, dispuestos siempre a ayudar y hacer la experiencia agradable. Destaco al personal del buffette internacional. La política de conservación de la naturaleza excelente.

reviews.author: Gen A
reviews.title: Great hotel! Amazing service!
reviews.text:
My friends and I had a great time at Paradisus Cancun. The food was great at the buffet, restaurants, and room service. They drinks were good as well and there was a great selection of premium alcohol in the reserve side which I would highly recommend upgrading too. 

I want to give a huge shout out to Luis, Miguel, and Javier who provided amazing service throughout our 4 day stay. They went above and beyond for us. I cant recommend this hotel more and they are a main reason why. You will have a great time here I can guarantee it!

reviews.author: Hilary R
reviews.title: First time here. Actively planning our next trip.
reviews.text: 10’s across the board. The service? Impeccable. The food? Divine. Drinks? Absolutely fantastic. We came for a bachelorette party and are actively planning our next trip. Ask for Gabby at the pool every. single. time. We stayed at The Reserve and it’s worth every penny for the upgrade. I cannot say enough good things about this place and the people and I will absolutely be back.

reviews.author: dawn g
reviews.title: Horrible stay away far away!!!
reviews.text: The worst experience from the moment we checked in.  I’ve been at this hotel when it was the gran Meliá and they should’ve stayed that way because this hotel isn’t worth $100. We stayed in the reserve section, it was a ghost town away from civilization! No swim up bar the bar by the pool closed at 4 while all the other ones are open smh.  We booked two rooms next to each other. We got one room on one floor and the other room on another level. They said they couldn’t give us rooms together because they were booked and there was literally nobody there. We had no air conditioning and our refrigerator didn’t work so we had to move the next day to another room and what a coincidence The room was next to our friends room, where we wanted to be the night before when we checked in. The elevators wasn’t  working. we requested The room to be decorated for my friend’s birthday it never happened. We were supposed to have bottles of champagne in our rooms. Nothing we requested double beds we got a king size bed  The breakfast was horrible. Everything was soggy and cold.  Alcohol drinks were watered down. We had to walk, literally half mile to get to any restaurants in the hotel, or to see a human being. The only good thing about our stay, was our concierge Jose.  I talked with upper management Aaron and told him all of our concerns. I never heard from him after the first night of our stay I’m sure it went in one ear and out the other the hotel looks like it’s going under. The staff is overworked they don’t clean the beach anymore so you can’t see white sand it’s covered with seaweed. The entertainment is a joke! Save your money and go someplace else! Horrible experience and waste of money!!!

reviews.author: Steven F
reviews.title: JORGE AT LEMON FISH
reviews.text: Cancun was amazing!! What made it better was the waiter named Jorge at Lemon Fish in Paradisus Resort. You ask that man for a recommendation he will come back with dishes and drinks that are out of this world

reviews.author: Aaron S
reviews.title: Fantastic service and great poolside food
reviews.text: We had a great time at the resort and Sante had great poolside food. The wings, ceviche, and tacos were all outstanding. We were lucky to have Gaby as our server on our first day and she absolutely made the whole trip. She anticipated all our needs, and would check in on us even on days when we weren't in her section.

reviews.author: Richonn C
reviews.title: Great fun
reviews.text:
Amazing trip filled with new friends, great service. 

First we checked in with Karen a sweetheart the reserve section. She was amazing.

Then Diego was our concierge/go to main man. Incredibly attentive and gave us info on anything we needed.

We had great service from Miguel at Sante bar he was our Bali bed waiter for 2 days and took care of us and make sure we always had Heinekens and ice and waters at all times. Luis at the reserve pool bar was amazing!!!! Oscar as well.

Nicole is the reserve pool Bali bed coordinator. She’s so Awesome, always made sure we had just the bed we wanted and even let us reserve an ocean view Bali bed special.  

Overall this was an amazing trip, I’m so glad my sister recommended it. Room service good wasn’t the greatest but everything else was 10/10.  Can’t wait to come back next year!!

reviews.author: rchedra
reviews.title: Un Hotel para disfrutar como Reyes
reviews.text: Muy buena experiencia y Deliciosa Comida, la atención por parte del personal es muy amigable y en caso de tener un problema buscan solucionarlo cuanto antes, me gusto mucho y lo recomiendo ampliamente a Familias, parejas y amigos.

reviews.author: MarySol
reviews.title: Worst Experience in Cancun
reviews.text: I traveled with a group of 17 people (family and friends) during July 12-16, 2023. Unfortunately, this hotel is the worst I’ve ever stayed at in Cancun, and I have been going to Cancun for over 35+ years. The buffet food is horrible. The Blue Agave restaurant tacos were good and the Lemon Fish sushi was by far the best meal. The only good experience was Eliseo at the pool bar. The customer service was lacking to say the least. The hotel is old and not worth the cost.

reviews.author: Fernanda Z
reviews.title: 10 de 10
reviews.text: Excelente hotel, muy bonito, buena ubicación, cerca de los mejores restaurantes. Muy buena atención por parte de todos los trabajadores del resorte, la limpieza y seguridad excelente. La comida es buena y solo como recomendación, reservar los restaurantes para la cena.

reviews.author: Sergio Javier A
reviews.title: Las mejores vacaciones
reviews.text:
Gaby Karina y Valentin en el Sport Bar son los mejores bartenders de todo cancun ❤️

Espero visitarles de nuevo y repetiria esta experiencia. Son muy amigables y te hacen sentir como en casa. Lo recomiendo a todo el mundo.

reviews.author: Big B
reviews.title: Vacation with the boys
reviews.text: The sports bar is very fun to be at with the waiters and bar tenders named Karwa, gaby, valentin, and gingerz. They did a very good job, there may not be too many places but the sports bar is the place to be here.

reviews.author: Victoria A
reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: This resort is gorgeous !! We had the most relaxing vacation with our friends lounging by the pool or at the swim up bar. I have to mention an excellent service we received through our stay. Our server Didier was amazing !! He treated all of us like a family. Didier and Yvonne (both working by the pool ) made our stay extra special !

reviews.author: Alex A
reviews.title: Increíble
reviews.text: Servicio excelente, especialmente en el "karaoke" Ginger 2 en el cual Karina y sus compañer@s Gabi y Valentín te atienden como si fueras de su propia familia con un trato cercano pero respetuoso y amable, por otra parte el senyor Gualmer se encarga de que no falte jamás nada en la piscina y el trato del mesero José en The Lunch Box es también exquisito, otro restaurante al que no puedes faltar es el de Agua Marina, donde comerás una comida sabrosísima y autóctona, Seney es el chico que se encarga de la cocteleria de la piscina mas pequeña y me enseño con su simpatía a conocer a mi cóctel favorito, por otra parte, felicitar a la cocteleria interior donde Artemio te preparará con mucho gusto cocktails especiales. En el buffet todo esta buenísimo y para mí el Lemon Fish es uno de los mejores restaurantes en cuanto a calidad de comida pero el peor en cuanto a gestión de reservas, algo que tendrían que solucionar urgentemente.

reviews.author: alexmeendoza
reviews.title: EXCELENTE ATENCIÓN
reviews.text:
Tuvimos un descuido mi amigo y yo , cynthia la chava de seguridad y Rossana de guest service nos apoyaron en todo momento , súper atentas y nos brindaron una atención buenísima.

Detalles que te hacen querer volver a hospedarte en el hotel sin lugar a duda.

reviews.author: Dezymona S
reviews.title: Well needed cacatiob
reviews.text: Rafael was our server at Lemon  Fish. He was very polite and helpful.  We had to wait a bit for our food but he assured us thst it would be coming. Go and experience it and ask for Rafael. I would go back.

reviews.author: Conrado Q
reviews.title: Review de Malva
reviews.text: Muchísimas gracias a Eduardo y Martín del restaurante Malva. Vieron que era nuestro cumpleaños y nos dieron champaña y pastel. Muchísimas gracias a los dos por hacer nuestra visita aquí más bonita y inolvidable.

reviews.author: Leidy D
reviews.title: Experiencia en Paradisus
reviews.text:
Excelente experiencia, todo el personal siempre super atento y con ganas de conversar.
En el restaurante The Box Lunch, desde el gerente encargado hasta el mozo, excelente atención.
Asimismo, la noche acústica a cargo de Te Mezcal.

reviews.author: danielle r
reviews.title: Vuelvo!
reviews.text: ¡Habías muchas actividades y buenos lugares para comer! ¡El personal fue muy acogedor y agradable, lo que hizo que mi estancia fuera genial! Especialmente Atilano, Orlando, Gerardo en la lonchera y Guadencio en la playa. Mi representante Joel con Amistar nos ayudó a encontrar excursiones y lugares para ir cerca. ¡Me encantaría volver!

reviews.author: Eun Joo O
reviews.title: Amazing dinner
reviews.text: The lunch box is 10 out of 10. Amazing food and amazing waiter Jhan. I really recommend this place. From starter, entree, desert everything was perfect and delicious. So happy to come here for our dinner night and i want to come back for our next dinner

reviews.author: Alexandra N
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: Hotel was great, staff was helpful, Beautiful view of the ocean . Guendoline Flores from Premium moments did an amazing job facilitating and setting up balloons for my cousins bachelorette party!!!!!!

reviews.author: Alberto D
reviews.title: Experiencia increíble.
reviews.text:
El servicio de Miguel, Jorge y Ricardo fue excelso, la comida espectacular, el lugar increíble. 
Sin duda alguna una experiencia sumamente recomendable. 
Vale la pena vivir la experiencia sobre todo con gente que te ayuda en el transcurso de esta misma.

reviews.author: Michael H
reviews.title: Paradisus resort
reviews.text: Excelente servicio y atencion. Los restaurantes tenian mucho con ids deliciosa y los meseros eran muy amigable y atentos. No tengo quejas, y definitivamente pienso volver en el futuro con mad familiares e amigos.

reviews.author: Lily E
reviews.title: Hotel from hell
reviews.text: HORRRIBLE!!! DO NOT COME HERE!! NO VENGAS AQUI!!!!! I came here with friends in the “Junior Suite” is awful. The entire room looks like a morg. Our first night the dirt on the floor is awful your feet were black if you walked shoeless. Then after asking to switch rooms our ac was broken and spent the entire night sweating. Then when after calling 3 times over the span of 10 hours to come fix it they finally did and it wasn’t fixed. Then the shower and toilet wouldn’t work. Then the celling was peeling and falling on the floor and you could see mold. Then after complaining they finally brought us to our new room where the outlets wouldn’t work and coackroacks spotted. Don’t come here it’s the hotel from hell. The reviews telling u it’s nice are bots.

reviews.author: Juan Luis R
reviews.title: Great calm  experience
reviews.text: Excellent service, very attentive and caring. Also, payed close attention to allergies and requested food to be cooked separately. Food was really good and drinks as well. Desserts were exceptional as well.

reviews.author: Antonio S
reviews.title: Something different
reviews.text: "Jorge, Miguel, and Karen offer an experience that is undeniably distinct. These three individuals have managed to carve out a unique niche with their work that is incomparable. If you're in search of something out of the ordinary, look no further. They demonstrate great synergy, merging their talents to provide an extraordinary and captivating experience. Their collective ingenuity is simply fantastic. You won't be disappointed by venturing off the beaten path with them."

reviews.author: Ryan B
reviews.title: Lacks service standards
reviews.text:
A stream of consciousness:

Eliu - blatantly rude front desk agent. Helped the white guests with a very positive and welcoming attitude. When it was out party's turn he was completely dismissive and rude when it came to questions we had about our room or stay

Other members in our room needed to get new bracelets for our stay, the front desk agent gave them to us without even asking for an ID or a name on the reservation. We even asked if they needed ID and they said no. They just cut the bracelets and gave it to them without really scanning anything. Felt completely unsafe.

Food & Beverage really holding down the fort on service and making people feel welcomed

Raphael & Nathanael - Lunchbox and Lemonfish were amazing!

Liliana at YHI also delivered an excellent service

Service at Sante was amazing

Calling in for room service was really rude and deep sighing whenever we called for food. We were accused of ordering later and the manager asked to see our phone because we were texting and our room phone was broken.  They are uncommunicative and lack proper service standards. 

Sal - I'm not sure. Service is great but half our party was asked to leave to put on shoes because they were wearing sandals, but the white straight parties before and after were also wearing sandals and were not asked to leave even after we brought it up to the staff.

Overall, not BIPOC Queer friendly. Steer clear until they have an actual action plan that is better than whatever apology they have to reply to this post.

Lacking name tags

Mentioned our phone is broken every day and they had not bothered to fix it

Whoever gave this racist and homophobic hotel their five stars needs to be reprimanded as well. I've never been so disrespected at "luxury" hotel in my life. One of the reasons we even felt comfortable booking here was because Melia was supposed to "inclusive."

reviews.author: lucrecitas e
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text:
Un excelente trato de didier en pool bar muy atento
Siempre con un excelente servicio también los que atiende en el hidromasaje las chicas y los chicos muy bien !! La comida muy rica restaurantw de los tacos y el de mariscos muy bien

reviews.author: Ivonne Astrid W
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text:
Toda la comida estubo fantástica, deliciosa, incomparable. Jorge y Miguel son los mejores meseros nos atendieron súper excelente y sus recomendaciones para la comida las mejores.
Los chef Karen y Mario wow tienen magia en sus manos la preparación del sushi estuvo increíble muchas gracias por este maravilloso servicio.

reviews.author: Rachelle C
reviews.title: Girls night out
reviews.text: The food was good and came out rather quickly.  Our waitperson was exactly attentive and even gave us a taste of other specials. The manager even came to our table to introduce himself. I would eat here again. T

reviews.author: Abel M
reviews.title: Familia y amigos
reviews.text:
Me hospede con  mis amigos para un viaje de relajación después de una jornada bastante intensa, la familia paradisus como siempre nos hizo sentir como en casa es nuestra 4ta visita y ya estamos esperando la siguiente. Desayunar en malva y comer unos ricos mejillones en Agua marina son parte fundamental en el día. De igual manera quiero resaltar una persona que en esta visita marco una diferencia enorme con su amabilidad y hospitalidad genuina, la Srita Malinali de guest Service quien con una sonrisa siempre en su rostro estaba más que dispuesta a ayudarnos y a dar el extra! 

Gracias totales!

reviews.author: Monique Pacheco
reviews.title: Ótima opção para famílias, amigos e casais. Sabor da comida nota 10 e excelente atendimento. Bom custo benefício
reviews.text:
A comida e o atendimento são excelentes. De entrada pedimos a salada de beterraba e o polvo, que estavam com tempero e cocção muito bons, e de parados principais, o
Brisket e a costelinha. Sabor e apresentação maravilhosos! Com certeza, vale a pedida!

reviews.author: Karen R
reviews.title: Not as good as it used to be
reviews.text:
This was my 4th time in paradisus cancun and probably my last one .
I used to love coming here because of the great stuff and good food, this time i can’t say the same.
Food isn’t as good as it used to be, staff are not very friendly anymore and it was hard to get a reservation for dinner to the restaurants we wanted to try. and at dinner time It took us more than 20 min to finally be greater. We even convinced some friends to come with us and i know their experience wasn’t what they were expecting.
I’m glad we upgraded to reserve because the only good part about this trip is that we got to see Rene from Kanna area and always makes sure we are having a good time and always so happy to see us. We got to meet Moises and Miguel that took such a good care of us at the reserve area. 
I hope this place goes back to what it used to be because I would love  to come back to see Moises Miguel and Rene.
Thank you guys for been the past part of our trip

reviews.author: Janet R
reviews.title: Wonderful experience
reviews.text: Wow, wow, y wow. What a beautiful resort and what beautiful people they have as staff. My friend and I just got back from staying here a few days and we received the best customer service from everyone working at this resort. Very attentive to all of our needs from the moment we arrived. Rodrigo at the pool took care of us the entire time and went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed and wanted. He was just amazing. We will definitely visit again soon. The food here was great as well. My favorite thing about staying here was all the greenery and smell of essential oils throughout the entire place. It feels like you’re in a spa the entire time!!!

reviews.author: JoefromNYCarea
reviews.title: Truly a relaxing, wonderful way to celebrate a milestone moment or just to get away!!
reviews.text: We've been going for 12+years, having incredible times but this trip some special shout outs for EXCEPTIONAL services- first Violeta our concierge looking over our 4 rooms of or friends, unbelievable food by chef David Tovar, Jenny&Nicole at the Pool, Moses (!!!!), Javier, and Joel at the Pool Cabana with Diego always checking in, and for our delicious breakfast buffet service with Rafael & Ramiro and nights with Dania and Valentin at the Ginger Bar.  Such a wonderful, relaxing and damn good time where all the staff just go above and beyond.  We'll be back soon enough!!  We have gone so often we always feel like we're at home when we walk in to that main pyramid.  Breathtaking!

reviews.author: Natalia B
reviews.title: Gran experiencia en Paradisus. Bonito, trato excelente, comida deliciosa y habitaciones súper cómodas.
reviews.text: Estuve en Paradisus Cancún con tres amigas y fue una experiencia extraordinaria. La comida de los restaurantes era deliciosa, especialmente Lemon Fish, Santé y Aguamarina, y el trato que recibimos de todos fue excelente. A destacar a nuestros concierge Eliu y Victor, el sr. Ricardo (estuvo con nosotras en Lemon Fish), Uriel de animación, y en general, todo el personal. La estancia en The Reserve Nikté fue también un acierto, ya que permite tener un espacio más privado y relajado, tanto gastronómico como en la piscina y el área reservada de alimentos y bebidas. Nos encanta Paradisus y repetiremos!

reviews.author: Piranave C
reviews.title: Amazing would recommend!
reviews.text:
My sis and I had an amazing vacation where we stayed at the beach and pool everyday for hours. 

Guandencio from Kanna was an absolute pleasure and made our stay at the beach more fun and enjoyable. He knew our drink order very quickly and was fun to talk with. 

Martin from Melva made our breakfast and lunch times that much more enjoyable!! He knew our drink order and was very personable. 

It was easy to book excursions. We got to explore around the resort and off the resort. It was a very comfortable stay. Would recommend!

reviews.author: Miranda L
reviews.title: Muy buena atención
reviews.text: muy buen servicio, la gente súper buena onda.Laila, gaudencio y aldahir muy buenas personas.Las actividades me encantaron en especial las bolsitas.Vacaciones inolvidables con personas las mejores personas.Nunca se aburrirán en este hotel.

reviews.author: Sienna P
reviews.title: Gaudencia, Aldhair y Laila!! ❤️
reviews.text: Gaudencio, Aldhair y Laila fueron los que mejor me atendieron! Muy buenas personas y atentos. Hermosa experiencia ya que me hicieron sentir muy cómodos y bienvenidos. Les agradezco desde corazon por hacerme sentir así.

reviews.author: Gia C
reviews.title: Gaudencio fue muy amable al igual que Aldahir  y Laila muy buenas personas con mucha energia super atentos
reviews.text: muy buena atencion sobretodo de Gaudencio, Laila y Aldahir. Hermosa experiencia sintiendonos comodos y bienvenidos. Unas vacaciones inolvidables. Personas super amables agradecidas de corazon con su servicio. Vendria una y mil veces mas. Lugar super recomendado!!

reviews.author: Maria Fe S
reviews.title: Aldahir, gaudencio, laila son los mejores.
reviews.text: Muy buen servicio recibido de Gaudencio, Aldahir y Laila (actividades). Super educados y modestos. Me gusto mucho mi experiencia. Me hicieron sentir muy cómodas y bienvenido. Les agradezco de corazón por hacerme sentir así.

reviews.author: Sandra G
reviews.title: Espectacular
reviews.text: Espectacular hotel. Tiene de todo: piscina, vistas al mar, gran servicio de animación, actividades. El personal es súper amable, especialmente Laila e Uriel del equipo de animación, los concierges Victor e Eliu, y la gente de los restauran te s, especialmente Roberto. Las habitaciones muy limpias y cómodas. Unas grandes vacaciones!

reviews.author: Alejandro O
reviews.title: EMPLOYEES ARE THE BEST
reviews.text: In my honest opinion. I think the workers are what make this place so great. Don’t get me wrong. I love all the amenities/ restaurants/ location. But if I were to say “what’s the best part about this hotel” I would definitely say the employees. The EMPLOYEES are what made me come back. Time and time again.

reviews.author: Alan G
reviews.title: Excelente lugar para vacaciones de descanso
reviews.text: Todo excelente, la estadía muy amena y cómoda, todos los servicios muy amables y Gaudencio, lo más servicial y cordial posible. Las habitaciones muy cómodas, y con gran variedad de atenciones y servicios de comida dentro del hotel. Un gena lugar para vacaciones de descanso.

reviews.author: Anna S
reviews.title: Do recommend
reviews.text:
It’s a large place but don’t be intimidated. The pyramids and floors are clearly marked. Lots of food options and I’m gluten-free so that is really saying something. 
Asucion was our poolside server and she was a pleasure, very professional. She also had to of had a million steps in a day!

reviews.author: Sabrina B
reviews.title: Lemon Fish: great service from Angel, Rafael, and Carlos
reviews.text: We had a great visit to Lemon Fish! The ramen was delicious and our host, Angel, and waiters Rafael and Carlos, were wonderful! We would highly recommend making sure to visit this restaurant when staying at Paradisus. Thank you for a great experience!

reviews.author: Steve C
reviews.title: 5 stars for Pool concierge and staff
reviews.text:
We stayed at the resort for Paradise Blue music festival. We also attended Ember Shores music festival there a few months ago.
Just want to compliment the entire staff on their hospitality and kindness, as well as doing the best they could to keep up with cleanliness and the demands of a sold out resort.
Particularly wanted to highlight the pool team, and pool concierge Luis. He was always present, working hard, was VERY helpful in accommodating us and everyone else. There were many people having issues with umbrellas, cabanas, etc. and Luis and the pool staff really tried to help us understand that the hotel does its best to accommodate everyone, and ensured that we all felt like VIP's
Thanks again, see you next year!
-Steven and Gina Costello

reviews.author: jimyerenee
reviews.title: Paradise Blue Round 2
reviews.text: last year when i visited cancun for this music festival we stayed at the marriott but spent majority of our time here at paradisus. i’m happy to say this year was way more accommodating and overall a better experience staying w paradisus. nothing against marriott, but anytime we needed anything there was always someone readily available and happy to help 24/7. definitely will be back again next year and hopefully sometime sooner :)

reviews.author: Jeremy D
reviews.title: Top Tier Experience
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus Cancun for three nights during Paradise Blue festival. I've never seen workers at a hotel more hospitable and hard-working.  They earned and deserved every tip they received. From the welcoming doormen to the waiters to those quickly squeegeeing the water off the floor by the pool to keep the walkways safe, the consistency of high-quality customer service was unreal. Not one rude or unhelpful interaction the entire stay.  Rooms were cleaned and towels restocked almost within an hour or two of putting up the doorknob sign. Food buffet was tasty and varied enough to not be bored for a few days. The hotel layout can appear maze-like at times due to the similar looks of the towers so navigation can be a bit confusing for the directionally challenged as myself. No fault of the hotel. I would recommend bringing insulated tumblers to pour water bottles into as the bottles are not large.

reviews.author: Brooke D
reviews.title: AMAZING STAFF
reviews.text: The service at this resort was incredible. Anytime we had an issue with anything, the staff was prompt to remedy the issue and never took longer than 5 minutes to have someone at our room. Didi from the pool bar was EXCEPTIONAL. He remembered all of our names and what we liked to drink , regardless of how many people were around. He always made sure to check on us frequently and see if we needed anything else. Jesus at Agua Marina was also another wonderful person and made me laugh so hard. Both of those men will be the main reason that I return to this resort, not only for the experience, but for the hope that I’ll get to see them again.

reviews.author: Daniel S
reviews.title: Lemon fish restaurant
reviews.text:
The staff at Lemon Fish, especially: 
Jorge (waiter), Daniel (Host), Alejandro (bartender) made me feel at home. Could not say enough about their service. 10/10. Love these guys. Stoked. These guys are simply the best to do it.

reviews.author: Mason L
reviews.title: Paradise Blue Experience
reviews.text: Every staff member I have met has been exceptionally helpful and so very kind. Being able to come down to Mexico the first time gave me the most amazing service. At the pool bar Alberto, Daniel, Melin, Chan, and Luis, Gomes all were very kind at the main pool bar and they made sure to take care of us on our extra day here. The staff not just at the pool bar but all over the hotel was so friendly and helpful and was able to help us exceptionally quickly and efficiently. The rooms and the view I got to experience was a the perfect vibe on top of the festival my friends and I were attending. I definitely plan on returning to experience this hotel as long and as often as I can with my friends. The house keeping staff also made it a point to take care of our room and clean it despite the amount of sand and dirt that was tracked in from the beach. I plan to keep coming back on long as I can to the amazing staff and beautiful facilities at least once a year if not more. The only downside was the constant construction work going on around the hotel, however that didn’t impact our experience in any way as they made it a point to keep respectfully out of the way. The only complaint I would have is the slow elevators, especially because on the one side of the main lobby the elevator ended up breaking. Nothing else gives me a reason to complain otherwise. Thank you everyone who took care of us!!

reviews.author: Nicolas P
reviews.title: I will absolutely be coming back and hoping to es all the same servers!! Jessenia and Asunción were my absolute favorite
reviews.text: I had the absolute best experience almost solely due to the attentiveness and consideration of the waiting staff! They went above and beyond to make sure our time was spent completely relaxed and taken care of.

reviews.author: Kali
reviews.title: Paradise Blue 2023
reviews.text: Joel from Sante is the real OG. Always smiling and having a great time. Service is great and the hospitality is unmatched. Tip your service staff please they work very hard and are very accommodating to your needs. Until next year ⚡️❤️

reviews.author: Stephany Foster
reviews.title: Amazing hostess, fast & incredible service
reviews.text: The host at lemon fish was amazing and truly helped make our experience so perfect. We were seated very fast. The host was a polite to us and always smiling. working so hard, i hope that I see him when I return to this resort next year

reviews.author: Jarrett M
reviews.title: Malva service
reviews.text: Malva review: Atilano Manuel Martinez Jannett were absolutely incredible. Such passionate service that you cannot find anywhere in the USA and it is such a treat. Adriana, Liz, Amy, Sury, Fer have all been pleasant and wonderful!!! I’m running out of adjectives but i feel as if i have been treated like family. Will absolutely be back!!

reviews.author: Rosemary A
reviews.title: Cancun 2023 with my BFF
reviews.text: My friend and I stayed at Paradisus Cancun April 15 - 22, 2023.  The location is great and the property is beautiful. This was our 4th trip staying there.  Every year we visit Cancun and look at other resorts  but we always go back to Paradisus. Mainly because of the staff. They are the best. From our concierge Violetta who made all our reservations and attended to our needs, to the staff at the Sante Restaurant in the Reserve section (building 5).  Diego manages a great crew at the Sante Restaurant.  Our friends at the Sante:  Valerie, Gabriella, Miguel, Oscar, Ruben, Moises and Cesar went over and beyond to make our stay as fantastic and wonderful as they could.  No matter what we asked of them they happily provided the best service and always with a smile and pleasant attitude. We have our breakfast and lunch there everyday. When we think of going to another resort and not seeing these people we are sadden and decide to go back. Tell our friends we miss them everyday and looking forward to seeing them next year.

reviews.author: Clarisel
reviews.title: Love love love
reviews.text: We had an amazing time. We were a group of 10 and we all had an amazing experience. All the staff at Paradisus Cancun were amazing. Didier at the main pool was an amazing server to us. He was always attentive to all our needs. Leonardo at the pool bar kept us pump while at the pool. Luis who runs the order of the balinese beds helped us daily with out accommodations. Alberto at the breakfast buffet was always warming and welcoming every morning. Those are a few of many loving staff we encountered during our trip. The only downside about this hotel is that when the “night club” or where they host the dj is beginning to make everyone party the party dies at 12 on the dot and with nothing else to do we have to turn down. Maybe the hours for the dj should be extended for an hour or two. Other than that everything was beyond our expectations.

reviews.author: Paul M

reviews.author: Katie E
reviews.title: Absolutely the BEST!

Sure, the restaurants are delicious, the hotel is luxurious and the views is unbeatable, but the staff is what makes the place special!  Everyone is always pleasant and accommodating and will do anything they can to make your experience memorable.  This trip, there were two people in particular that offered exceptional service and deserved to be recognized. Pascual in the Malva restaurant was exceptional and a smiling face every morning and Aldhair at the beach was the absolute best!  He greeted us every day with a smile (and a drink!), and checked in on us all day long. He was genuinely interested in making sure our vacation was enjoyable and provided amazing service our entire stay.  Can't wait to come back!

reviews.author: 0504Traveller
reviews.title: Average Stay with Poor Service
reviews.text:
I was traveling to Cancun to celebrate a friend’s birthday so we were looking for an all-inclusive hotel that would have good service, good access to the beach and the pool, and overall provide a nice time during our short stay.  I have stayed at Melia properties both in New York (review here) as well as an all-inclusive in Punta Cana and both properties were decent – the all-inclusive was a large property with average food, decent rooms and sub-par service.  This was the expectation I had going into Paradisus, and because of both this expectation as well as we were going for a celebration, I decided to try out the Reserve by Paradisus which is supposed to provide an upgraded service. 

I booked the room through the Melia app as through the app there was a discount in addition to the discounted rates given to MeliaRewards members.  Booking the hotel and selecting the room type was very easy to do through the app so that was very convenient.  Once I booked the room, I contacted the hotel regarding accommodations for the celebrations as well as for transportation.  In other all-inclusive which I have stayed out, transportation has been included but in both Cancun and Punta Cana it was not included.   The hotel recommended a service to use, and I generally go through those recommendations as if there is a delay or something happens, I can contact the hotel with any issue.  During the communication with the hotel, I was also asked to fill out pre-arrival information including special requests.  I filled out the form, connected to the transportation and booked that, and was all set to enjoy my experience in Cancun.

The lack of service continued during the check-in process.  The Paradisus is a large property comprised of many pyramids across a wide land size.  You enter the property through the main pyramid which has a small check-in and check-out section to the left-hand side.  We went in there to check-in and were instructed that because we were reserve, we would check-in at a different pyramid and thus were walked to the Reserve pyramid.  The attendant who walked us through was nice but could not answer any questions and kept repeating “your Reserve agent will answer all the questions”.  The pyramids are designed in a similar fashion with an open layout in the middle, stores, restaurants, or hotel facilities on the ground floor in the middle and guest rooms on the top floors surrounding the open atrium.  The Reserve pyramid is also designed this way with the check-in desks as well as a lounge on the ground floor and guest rooms on the top floor.  The check-in attendant was busy helping someone else when we arrived so they asked us to wait in lounge.  On the ground floor in the open atrium, the Reserve has a lounge which serves complimentary drinks, coffee, tea, as well as heavy snacks.  The lounge was open in morning until mid-evening so you could stop here for breakfast, a late snack, a lite lunch, drinks and snacks or a lite dinner.  There were many tables surrounding the lounge and sitting in the open atrium was very nice and peaceful.  After a little while, the hotel attendant came in and said they were ready to check us in.  
The check-in attendant had zero customer service, was quite rude towards the end, and only wanted to go through their speech and not answer any questions or provide any additional information.  It was not a welcoming nor pleasant process and at the end, we were told that in fact our rooms were not ready and that we would have to wait in the lounge until our concierge came to get us.  I was not aware of this prior but booking with the Reserve comes with a Concierge who is supposed to help and provide tailored assistance through your stay – to this day I am still not sure what their purpose is besides making reservations as many of the questions or requests we made were responded with “you need to contact this person”. 

The Concierge led us to our room which was a standard room with 2 beds – we had originally booked a ‘lagoon view’ but the definition of this was a room facing the busy street with a lagoon way behind it – it was not calming nor soothing so we requested to upgrade to an ocean view.  This upgrade came at a costs, even though the booking had included discounted upgrades and spa credits.  The upgraded room had a large balcony facing the resort and ocean view and it was much better in terms of noise and view.  Both rooms were laid out in the similar fashion and, ironically, both had issues with the room.   As you entered the room, on the left were the closets which contained a safe, places to hang your clothes, slippers, robe, as well as other items.  On the right was the bathroom which contained a sink in the middle and a separate toilet area to the right and a shower to the left – there is supposed to be a sliding door on the bathroom to ensure privacy.  

The bathroom contained refillable bottles with toiletries including hand wash and lotion near the sink and shampoo, body wash, and conditioner in the shower – the shower contained both a handheld and rain shower and while the water pressure was good, the water went everywhere.  The oddest thing about the bathroom was that the shower faced the room and instead of a wall it was a glass partition with a thin sheet covering it – this meant that the person inside the room could see directly into the shower.  I have seen this design in other properties and I am not sure whether this was a design aspect to let light it, but it provides no privacy and is very uncomfortable – we asked that the curtain be doubled to ensure some privacy between the room and the bathroom.  Despite this design flaw, the bathroom was a decent size and had enough amenities and toiletries.

The room itself was also a decent size and contained the following – along the left side was a bench to either site or to store luggage and next to this was a long desk on top and below were drawers as well as a cabinet which contained water, soft drinks, water, and some food items.  Since this is an all-inclusive, most of the contents in the mini-bar were complimentary and should be refilled each day and refilled based on the preference of the client – ours were refilled only upon request and even though it took a couple of calls.  Above the desk was a TV mounted on the wall and finally along the left side was a table with two chairs.  On the right side of the room were the two double beds with a nightstand in the middle – the beds were comfortable and provided a decent night sleep.  There were outlets on the desk and on the nightstand but not next to the beds.  The room size was comfortable for 2 people plus their stuff to comfortable walk around and not be crowded.  The best part about the room was the balcony, which was very large in size, contained two lounge chairs plus a table, and looked out onto both the resort as well as the ocean.  My friend who wanted to layout and hear the ocean got up early and spent the rest of their mornings on the balcony since it was large, peaceful and convenient.

The Paradisus is an all-inclusive which means everything is included and no additional payments or fees are needed – expect for add-ons.  Add-ons included spa services, certain restaurants had additional items which were not included in the all-inclusive, as well as tours and activities needed to be paid for.  There were plenty of restaurants that were included in the all-inclusive including Italian, Latin, Mediterranean, buffets, as well as fast food.   In addition to food, beverages including alcoholic beverages were included in the all-inclusive.  Both my friend and I have dietary restrictions and neither of us had an issue finding something to eat – in fact, this was something we were concerned about but in the end there was a plethora of choices for us.  Most of the information for the restaurants and other activities are included in the app – so you have to download the app to access most of the information; we were not aware of this until the second day so it would’ve been helpful to know this information when we arrived.  Also through the app you can request housekeeping, additional items for the mini-bar, etc so it is extremely important to download the app since this is mainly the way to communicate with staff.

The Paradisus was also a large property so there were plenty of spaces, chairs, and beds available next to the pool and beach.  The Reserve pool is a separate area where it is adults-only and it is supposed to be more exclusive – it was quieter than the regular pool but towards the end of our stay which coincided with the weekend, there were plenty of kids who joined the pool as the staff did not regulate who would come in.  For the Reserve pool, there are beds surrounding the pool which need to be reserved a day in advance and once reserved it is yours for the entire day until you give it up – so you can wander away but if you leave something of yours there or let the staff know that you will be coming back, then they will not give it to anyone.  While this is nice on one side, it does limit the amount of guests who have access to the limited beds.  Also, we were not informed upon arrival that the beds needed to be reserved a day in advance, we only found this out on our second day – again, information that would’ve been helpful in advance.  The large property provided plenty of opportunity and space to enjoy both the pool and beach, as well as walk along the beach and stay within the property boundaries.  

Other amenities on the property include complimentary wi-fi, which was a decent speed and allowed for email and Whatsapp but was slower for YouTube and streaming.   There is also a gym on property but it is a bit further away so we did not access it.  Overall, the Paradisus was a mixed bag.  The positives are the large resort space, the plethora of choices for restaurants, the Reserve lounge, and since the resort was so large it provided quiet areas so the noise wasn’t concentrated into one area.  The negatives are the lack of customer service, the somewhat outdated rooms, lack of a map or clear instructions/details as to what is available and when, as well as communication with the hotel regarding airport access.  Final note, I went for a couple of days and it was at the beginning of the week and left right as the weekend was getting started – there was definitely a different crowd, different vibe, and increase in noise level from when we arrived to when we departed.

reviews.author: Meganne
reviews.title: Relaxing Vacation!
reviews.text:
My friend and I had a wonderful time at this resort! We stayed in the Reserve, which was the best decision (includes premium liquor, access to two additional restaurants, private cabanas with poolside service, access to spa facilities). All facilities were clean and well-kept. Our room was quiet, cool, and comfortable. The other guests in the Reserve were respectful, and we never felt that the property was too crowded. 

Some meals were better than others. I’m vegetarian, and there were options for me at every restaurant. Some restaurants even made special dishes just for me. 

The beaches were gorgeous, and the weather was wonderful. We split our time evenly between the pool and beach. 

The service was overall very good, and the staff was friendly. Joel and Jennifer took great care of us by the Reserve pool. Giovanny and Uriel provided excellent entertainment and activities through our stay. 

Our biggest complaint was in regards to the Meliá app, which contained all the menus, schedules, etc. It was slow and difficult to navigate, but wifi access was good throughout the property.

reviews.author: kdoonan
reviews.title: Risky Place to Stay - Better Options.
reviews.text:
There were so many things that didn’t go right, and a few that were good. 
The Cons. The facility itself is terribly difficult to navigate and the elevators did not work the entire week we were there. Twice, when it appeared to be fixed, we attempted using it and it was very stressful. The unit jerked back and forth, the doors opened and shut repeatedly and in one case it would not ride to the floor we requested, instead riding up and down. Guests were left with the option of climbing starts, we were on the 7th floor, or taking the service elevator in a closed off part of the resort which was gross, dingy, smelled and in a very unattractive area of the hotel. Towards the end of the week, the service elevator began acting badly.  During rainy days, there was significant leakage in the hallways. Staff was working had to clean it up but there was a lot and there were a lot of caution signs. Luckily, we had not issues in our room with water.  I went with a friend and we requested a room with two beds. We confirmed this request on four occasions and were told it would not be a problem. When we arrived, they only had a king.  The hair dryer in the room didn’t work. I requested a replacement multiple times along with more towels and nothing was ever sent (this happened several times over several days.). We were finally moved to a room with two beds, which was much more comfortable and it had a working hair dryer. 
The food was consistently mediocre.  Malva, the main restaurant was essentially and oversized cafeteria. If you attempted breakfast after 9AM the lines to get in were crazy long. If you don’t care a lot about food, you’ll do a okay. If you’re a foodie, you’ll be disappointed. 
The Pros. The rooms were clean and the beds were very comfortable. The staff servers at the the pool and restaurants were always excellent. The spa service was excellent.
Summary. We made the best of it and enjoyed our vacation, but I would suggest finding something else. There are some serious facility problems that would make getting our there a real challenge in an emergency. The rooms in good shape, but the building itself needs a lot of infrastructure repair, especially the elevators. The food was mediocre. The activities were meh. Personally, I think it’s over rated. It’s near impossible to navigate the 5 pyramids, and that along is a really big turnoff and danger in an emergency. I think for the money you could find something else.

reviews.author: Storyteller823365
reviews.title: A little above average hotel experience
reviews.text:

The 1st day Andres made our restaurant reservations and sent them to us on the 2nd day. After that we never really heard from him again until I complained to a manager. So if that is the service you get by staying in the reserve, I would save my money and stay in one of the other towers. The food at Sal's steakhouse was the best food of the week and would highly recommend it. The food in the buffet was not very good at all and really limited on selection. The other restaurants were average at best. All of the servers at all of the bars, pools and restaurants were excellent and worked hard to make sure you had everything you needed. 
Overall a decent trip, but will not be going back.
