reviews.author: Cat G
reviews.title: I Wish They Would They Would Have Told Us
reviews.text:
I would like to start by saying that I do not know the finances behind this trip as another guest on our party payed for the whole trip. Our rating is based solely on the resort itself and not our whole experience. Our review is about the hotel atmosphere, the rooms, the food, and the service, as well as the impact on the other days. 

Day 1: Arrival Day/Check-In
This was the first time we said to each other as a party, "I wish they would have told us," and wasn't the first time we would say this during the trip. When we checked in we first learned that when you book the room, you do not get a choice in the room that you get. They assign you your room and bed type and for most of our party that ended up being doubles even though most of the party were couples and had requesting kings. Only half of our 10 person party got the rooms they wanted. On all of the rooms we were miss booked and they tried playing us in lower tier rooms while still charging us for the deluxe rooms and reserve access. We had all paid for the junior deluxe suites with reserve access and had to bring over the leader of our party to make sure they reinstated our reserve access, which took a lot of arguing. That was the first red flag of our stay. After an entire half an hour of checking in we finally went upstairs to our room with our bellhop and walk in on man in his bathrobe. They had booked us in an occupied room. Luckily my brothers room was a few doors down and when we called and let them know they said we had to go back downstairs and check in again. When we did and they did was laugh at the situation and no one apologized. We went up to our room which was adjacent to the last one and the door would work. The battery of the door was broken. Again we had to call down and it took 20 minutes for security to come and let us in our room. An entire hour just to check in. At this point we had to rush and go to our dinner appointment. But still no apologies and no one ever checked in on us for the remainder of the trip. 

Agua Marina: this dining experience was not only annoying but overall disappointing. In all restaurants in the hotel your menu is the use of a QR code which not only works only half of the time but is also incorrect. Missing descriptions, missing menu items, incorrect description, or just does not open. Getting physical menus took arguing and they would only give 1 for the party of 10 people. Our server was inattentive, did not refill drinks after dinner and never came back to order desserts. I personally did not like my entree could not finish it and was left dissatisfied on my first day.

Day 2: Resort Day
In our first day my partner and I were told if we wanted to get a better room in the reserve area we would have to check on our second day. When we asked about a king bed we were told we would have to check out at 11 and then recheck in at 3pm to see if they was an available king sized room. That would be extremely inconvenient. At the same time we told them our bathroom door would not open and that our AC was not working. It was 80 degrees in our room the whole entire trip. They attempted to fix it twice and once again, never checked in with us.

Malva pt. 1: We decided to sleep in and went down for a later breakfast. Ended up going to Malva and I made a charcuterie plate with a fresh made omelet. We had the green juice for breakfast. I wish they would better labeled the items in the buffet as we didn't know half of what we ate was. Especially the cheeses. The textures were different than what I'm used to and I was surprised that it wasn't cold. Although besides my omelet, the food wasn't hot either.

We booked 5 cabanas in the reserve area for our first day. When we got there discovered they had only booked us for 4 cabanas and had given the other away. They tried moving the other group but we stopped them as that seemed rude to the couple who booked and was incorrectly placed. We had Yamil as a server and ended up being one of the best servers the entire trip. Anytime we walked by he would great us. He recommended their signature cocktail the Mangolele (mango lay lay) which I drank too much of. We had the aguachile and two of the surf and turf platters. I still think it was a wast of $150 for the 2 surf and turf platters and the only think I enjoyed on them was the fried fish. We were very surprised that we came to the Caribbean and they didn't even serve Caribbean lobster for that price. 

We then went to book our spa days for later in the week and learned the second time of "I wish they would have told us" they there was an entire reserve area for us. A bar, a snack bar, a breakfast buffet. 

Malva: this is the main buffet. Highly avoid. I can go into each dining experience. But I'll just say simply, AVOID the cheese and only eat simple proteins. I still have no idea what that "lamb" was supposed to be but it was wrong and gross. At this point in time I am not feeling good at all and consistently had to excuse myself from the part and started having diarrhea. Eventually my partner is having the same experience. 

Day 3: Isla Mujeres
We woke up the next day and almost cancelled our entire day. Both of us feel absolutely disgusting and are still very sick. We were reassured that we would have an easy day. We did not and had to leave the island early. Thankfully our taxi driver was very kind and helpful and drove us to a pharmacy to get Treda. YOU WILL NEED THIS. This saved us. After some rest we felt a lot better and went to our next reservation. The rest of our group stayed at Isla Mujeres instead. At Isla mujeres we found out that another couple had cheese and was not feeling well. Together we decided to avoid the cheese.

Cielo: this was by far my favorite experience although there was a few dishes that didn't excite us we were able to overlook that because of Melvin our amazing server who single handedly helped us feel better about our trip. The chef even came out and took a photo with us and gave us delicious Mexican snacks. I loved almost everything we had except for the elote, because of the cheese, which still did not taste right. Melvin asked if we could review their restaurant and gave us a QR code that linked to Tripadvisor. I was a bit upset because that made me realize as I went through the reviews that they were highly reviewing individual experiences and not the hotel as a whole. Cielo for me gets a separate rating from the hotel with 5/5 stars and would go back just for those desserts. Especially that delicious corn cake!

Day 4: Chichen-Itza
The day starts our by finding our my brother's ordered room service and also have diarrhea. At this point 3 out of the 5 rooms have now had food poisoning from the cheese at the hotel. This was so unfortunate as one of my brothers had a horrible day and missed half of the activities due to being sick. We also ended up missing our dinner reservation to Lemonfish which is unfortunate. My mom got a hold of our concierge and they booked us for a reservation at 9pm at Lunch Box as it was the only place that would take us for dinner. 

Lemonfish: However our other guests that did not go to the ruins with us went and said it's delicious. We called many times trying to make a reservation for another day and were told they do not accept walk-ins and had no reservations available. 

The Lunch Box: first when we get there we find out the concierge messed up the reservation AGAIN and they did not have is on their list. They fixed it and threw some tables together for us but blamed us for the mistake and we're so bitter for the rest of the dinner. Our server was rude and inattentive, we could hear the server and manager talking bad about us behind us. They did not want to provide paper Manus and we were upset when we returned several dishes because they were not as described on the menu. Got made at us because we didn't want to order all the appetizers. Our food came out barely warm. The "wagyu" patty was just a frozen patty you get at McDonald's. 

We ended up being hungry later and ordering room service. I definitely didn't get the wings and got two cheeseburgers... With no cheese. It took about an hour to get it sadly and once again I don't know why they can't make hot food. 

Day 5: Resort Day
At this point I'm time the 4th couple in our family now has food poisoning and we are beginning to learn that there is a lot we don't know about the hotel and what is provided for us. We called again about our AC and were told that if they could fix it they wod move us. After everything we had been though we were not up for moving our rooms 2 days before we were to leave. Again no follow up about the AC and still 80 degrees at 8am.

We went to the spa which was actually amazing. They didn't tell us we needed a bathing suit so I didn't get to enjoy the other parts of the spa, the massage withu partner was nice and we ended up going to the reserve snack area for breakfast. I'm happy we did because this was the first breakfast I didn't feel like I had to worry about

I did the escape room with my mom and she told me that she was now on her 3rd concierge and they kept messing up her reservation. She said we had a reservation for Sal which we were all excited for. You can only go one time included but honestly with the reservation system I can't see how you would be able to go again anyways. 

We went back to the cabanas but we were only able to get 2 out of the 5 cabanas we were promised. You can only reserve cabanas 2 days of your stay but we had difficulty with that. 

Blue Agave: this ended up being my favorite lunch spot. Being able to order individual tacos. I love al pastor and they do it right here. Caramelized with lovely grilled pineapple. Some delicious fresh pineapple. Marco was great and I ended up tipping him $20 just because he was extremely engaging and very helpful and kind. We told the rest of our party about it and they all went on their own time and had a similar experience. 

Sal: Some of our party did not remember the reservation time for Sal. So I called down when they opened and they said our reservation was for 7. We all had thought it was 7:30. My mom calls down and they tell her it's 7:30. The manager ended up being wrong and on their own reservation list it said 7:30 even though he argued with us when we arrived. This was my second favorite meal but everyone else's first favorite meal. From start to finish you cannot go wrong at sal. It is not worth paying extra for the up charged meats or wine. The house wines and free reserve meals are fine but they will try and upsell you proteins by showing you this display of meat until you ask them about how much they are giving you and find out you get 1/4 of the size for about $80 starting point. 

Day 6: Xcaret
We spent the entire day at Xcaret and this solidified that the bad food and rooms was only at this hotel. The food at Xcaret was amazing and so was our experience. We also learned they have resorts on property and if we ever come back to Cancun will stay there and never again with Paradisus or Melia properties.

Day 7: Resort Day
Today the executive chef was here. This was the only day we felt comfortable eating at Malva. However to not risk it we are very simple.proteins, cured meats and simple carbs. Apparently we weren't the only group getting sick as when our fourth couple went in to the shop to buy food poisoning medication they had sold out. 

Cabana day was nice and we ended up having 3 cabanas which was nice. We got Blue agave again and enjoyed some coconut water and fresh coconut. We saw Yamil and by this point knew what we could and could eat at the resort. Try the aguachile in the cabanas.

At this point my mom's concierge called her again and delighted her by saying she got her dinner reservations to Capella. Everyone told her to try Capella at the hotel. However our reservationa were at 6. The last couple who got sick ended up leaving early. This was unrelated as far as they told us so there were only 8 of us. 

Blue Agave: we went here again for lunch with my mom and brother and once again had a wonderful time. I took a risk and tried the lengua, which is something I usually only have at places I really trust and was amazingly surprised they they took care of it. Once again Marco was amazing and also had David with him who was also great. 

Capella: this placed actually pissed me off. So much hype for this place. Again to fight for the menus for our table, our server is bitter and rude. Do not get the artichoke appetizer. It was gross and had the consistency of cat food. The cacio a Pepe salad is just a Caesar with an insulting lack of dressing, when we asked for extra dressing they brought us sour ranch, further confirming our suspicions of the dairy in this hotel. The carpaccio has no acid to cook the beef and we had to ask for limes. Our entrees surprised everyone. Mushroom risotto... With no mushrooms. Pizza with string cheese consistency and no sauce, my pasta didn't have anything I ordered in it. And I told them I could not have dairy and they put cheese on my pasta anyways. The sp called "best" restaurant ended up being the worse. This ended up being the only place we did not tip. 

Room service: we ate half of our food at sal and were left starving by 10. we decided to get room service again. The burger again since it's safe at the "pretzel" dog they didn't have the other night. Again over an hour to get the food. It wasn't till I called at midnight that said its an hour deliver time for food. And hour for a hot dog? Supposedly it was supposed to come on a pretzel bun, sauerkraut and spicy mustard with potato wedges. I got sweetustard, hoagie roll, no sauerkraut and 4 wedge cut potatoes that were inedible since they were still raw? I ate the sausage itself and finalized out last night with further disappointment. 

Day 8: Departure Day
Overall saying in building 3 was loud ALL night every night. They consistently doing maintenance in the middle of the night and we woke up multiple times to the smell of paint thinner and listening to cleaning machines. Those that were in building 4 had a way better experience. 

5/16 of our meals consumed on property did we consider good or edible.

The check out experience was as bad as everyone mentioned. We put a card on file at check in and were told "as soon as you use the card you have to add it again," what does that even mean? We have to add the card to file every time we use the card on file? What a poor excuse. They said that we had to have the servers apply the discounts at each service we used, we never even saw a single check at any establishment. So our party paid several hundred more for no reason. 

We will never stay at a Melia property again and we will never return to Paradisus. If we ever return to Cancun we will stay at a Xcaret property.

reviews.author: Steve
reviews.title: Bali beds for the win
reviews.text:
Relaxing time staying at the reserve.  This is a larger property than I prefer to stay at, but honestly it never felt that big while exploring the property and enjoying some great food and drink. 
My man Cesar at the reserve made the trip! David at lemon fresh made some very creative cocktails and was a wealth of knowledge on wines.

reviews.author: Katelyn L
reviews.title: WENDY!!!!
reviews.text: We recently stayed at the Paradisus in Cancun and had the absolute pleasure of meeting Wendy in the Sports Bar attached to the lounge on the first floor. She totally made our trip, and all 20 of us agreed that she was fantastic and we would love for her to be recognized. Thank you Wendy for such a great few nights in paradise! Get this girl a raise!

reviews.author: Anthony L
reviews.title: Buen tiempo en Malva
reviews.text: El servicing fue excellente. Antonio Tereja y el equipo Pasuual Fueron excellente. Todo Esteba sabroso y rapido. The tempo Aqui estaba tranquilo y el serbeiso fue madaviso. En proxima ves regresamos aqui.

reviews.author: John H
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Wow! A delicious meal. Novices with Japanese food. Thanks to Daniel, our waiter for his patience and explanation of what each dish was. The food was excellent and by far the best in the hotel. Daniel’s service couldn’t have been any better. Will definitely book again before going home. Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Rockgirlca1
reviews.title: Alejandro -Baristta
reviews.text:
Alejandro the best , pleasant happy to serve us latte’s , expresso’s each morning . Always greeted you with a smile . Very efficient in managing the barista bar !

We love him he makes us laugh, and that is a great thing in first thing in the morning

reviews.author: The Audacious Traveler
reviews.title: Paradise in a Resort!
reviews.text: Traveled to Cancun for 4 days and 3 nights. (Sun-Wed)  It was myself and my best friend.  I looked profusely for the perfect hotel for my 46th birthday.  After reading reviews on TripAdvisor, I narrowed it down to about 5 and then prayed and chose the Paradisus. Let me say that it was the best choice!  They treated us like celebrities from start to finish.  Their staff was friendly and accommodating, and our concierge, George was amazing!  We did not leave the resort!  We were going to go to Tulum but it rained that day so we just enjoyed the resort and all of its amenities.  Although we stayed in the junior nikte suite, we were able to partake in activities at the Reserve, the all-adult side.  Every bit of this resort was thought out perfectly.   The variety of restaurants exceeded my expectations.  It's all-inclusive so we made our way to most of the restaurants.  The food was 3.5/5...however, nothing a little salt and pepper couldn't help. Many prior reviews raved about Lemon Fish but I thought it was ok...great ambiance though. The Agua Marina Restaurant was amazing!  They even had some entertainers to come out and dance one night.  I mentioned my birthday when we first arrived and by the end of the meal, they were bringing out a brownie topped with sparklers and singing happy birthday.  My trip was amazing! No complaints! Overall 5/5

reviews.author: Trish
reviews.title: Fantastic customer service
reviews.text: 13 friends and I went to Paradisus Cancun in early February 2023.  Despite not so nice weather (it rained 3 of 4 days), our service at the resort helped to make our stay fun and memorable. One notable person was Wendy. She went out of her way to make us special drinks, to help with hangovers and to be friendly. We also had a great time each night at the "swing" bar. I would recommend this resort, expecially the Reserve side. The extra service and amenities were worth it.

reviews.author: Sara
reviews.title: Too spread out & needs updating but great location
reviews.text:
We had our 2nd annual sisters trip here in Feb 2023. There were 4 of us. 
I do not like the reserve check in process. You leave your luggage at the main lobby door and walk 2 buildings away for reserve check in where they do not immediately serve you a drink! No champagne!! Why?!? We had to wait for our bags to be sent to reserve desk so we cud change! We had already explained to bellman we needed our bags with us, but they wasted our time anyways and took them from us! The reserve desk staff did not follow thru when we asked to have the water checked in one of our rooms-it was cold showers for TWO days!  Our saving grace was Galdino our butler! He was amazing, anything we needed he made it happen to the best of his abilities!! He made sure our sisters birthday was celebrated at the pool!! 
Pool staff & waiters are amazing! Shout out to Cesar, Moises, Joel & Jennifer and many more! 
The activities staff was great too! 
Gym needs a larger space, better equipment, water bottles & air circulation.

reviews.author: Monica C
reviews.title: Rafael Lemon Fish
reviews.text:
Excelente servicio y comida !!! Las sugerencias excelentes, cenamos muy rico. 

Gracias a Rafael el mesero que nos atendió y dio las mejores sugerencias, muy rica la combinación. 

Fue de las cenas más ricas.

reviews.author: Razeena T
reviews.title: Rafael from Lemon Fish
reviews.text: He was amazing and he even gave us a cake for our birthday that we were celebrating. Great service and amazing recommendations for food. Would definitely come here again for our trip in Cancun. Amazing.

reviews.author: Kristen M
reviews.title: Great time at Paradisus!!
reviews.text: Maribel and Axcel were great for activities — really fun with painting the animals. Wendy was the best bartender, so friendly and accommodating at Ginger bar. Also Flora was my favorite waitress at the beach. She was super attentive and lovely

reviews.author: Mary Latham
reviews.title: Painting animals
reviews.text: Great experience with Axcel and Maribel painting! Wendy wonderful waitress at Ginger Bar!!! Very friendly people and great time at a very beautiful beach - would highly recommend a visit to this beautiful island. Flora also lovely at the beach!!

reviews.author: Wendy P
reviews.title: Best service!
reviews.text: Had the most amazing time with a group of girlfriends. The staff was more than hospitable and went out of their way to make sure we were having a god time! Thank you so much to Sergio Cano, Balta, Didier, Elliott, Victor Cahuich, AB, and Martin! Lovely gentleman and an all around perfect vacation experience ❤️

reviews.author: Milad
reviews.title: Sehr sauber super Service. Danke Volleyball Team
reviews.text:
War ein super Resort 
Sehr sauber und super Service Personal. 
Zimmer wurden immer gereinigt und die Sport Aktivitäten am Strand sehr gut 

Danke an Volleyball Team 
Axcel 
Giovanni 
Paula
Bryan 
Alicia
Uriel
Jesus
Abraham

reviews.author: finley1101
reviews.title: Cecilia was the best!!!
reviews.text: Cecilia was amazing!!! Catered to all our needs! Love all her suggestions! Would go back anytime. She anticipated all our needs and made us the best cocktails. She showed us alternate ways and made our stay amazing. She made our visit so great and I hope I meet her I. The future.

reviews.author: Laura T
reviews.title: Best trip ever! George is the BEST
reviews.text: George made our trip last February amazing! He went above and beyond and catered to our every need. Our mini fridge was fully stocked with only our favorite drinks each day. He got our reservations with ease and even escorted us personally to our dinners each night. He arranged all of our private transportation. I recently reached out to plan our next trip in the next few weeks and he is already making my trip wonderful and I haven't even arrived in Cancun yet. FIVE MILLION STARS! The flowers, champagne, rose petals, and chocolate covered strawberries were really the icing on the cake. GEORGE will change your life.

reviews.author: Chamene C
reviews.title: Best dinner
reviews.text: Rafael from Lemon Fish was the best! He was able to provide us with the best dinner experience during my dinner with friends. He was able to explain the best meal options based on what we each preferred within our group.

reviews.author: Jillmarie S
reviews.title: Raphael Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Great service! Excellent food. Very clean.  Fresh sushi and tacos. Everythingon menu was delicious. Greatselection. Chocolate cake was AMAZING.  Would definitely eat here again.  Raphael was great. Drinks were also amazing!

reviews.author: Sightseer41580511215
reviews.title: Far from paradise
reviews.text:
Went for a music festival (Sunsoaked), and can tell you this resort fell short on every expectation. Paid over $3500 for 4 days, food was terrible. Upgraded to "The Reserve" 
 and into a suite after they moved me from the the Fiesta Americana, where i had booked a room with a pool in it. Weren't able to enjoy the real perks as most things need a reservation. The steakhouse (need a reservation and only open while the event was going on). Breakfast was more European style, and not really my thing. Drinks were very much watered down, unless you started tipping heavy (i know, that's the expectation) but for a trip where i spent close to $5k to enjoy, nothing was magical about this resort and i would recommend going anywhere else but the Melia hotels. Staff and location are the 2 thigs i can say were amazing every step of the way. Spend your money at one of the branded hotels, and don't fall for the all-inclusive tag. Suite was large, but i was by myself in the room and really only wanted the pool in my room that i originally reserved. No sorry. No ask to move. Just moved to the reserve and told it was better. I can imagine it was not.

reviews.author: Kassi B
reviews.title: Rafael Lemon Fish
reviews.text: We loved our dinner tonight. Rafael was the BEST! What a wonderful dinner it was!!! We had veggie sushi rolls and the best margaritas! Easy to east here on a vegan diet!  Yum yum yum. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Nathalie F
reviews.title: Prachtige locatie met lief personeel
reviews.text: Hele leuke sfeer buiten bij de zwembaden met live muziek, lekkere cocktails, afwisselend eten en een prachtig uitzicht op zee! Alles is aanwezig om een heerlijke zorgeloze vakantie te hebben in het mooie Mexico.

reviews.author: PERLA F
reviews.title: MEjoReS y extraordinarias vacaciones
reviews.text:
En  el area de la playa fuimos atendidos por gaby, laura y yesenia.

Todo me gusto, el servicio de todos fue excelente de calidad y amable, siempre con una sonrisa, la cortesia es lo notable u la calidad del servicios son personas eficientes, eficaces, con gran valor éticos 

Se recomienda a la administración seles considere  para una mejor olaza o ingresos

reviews.author: Manny D
reviews.title: ¡Gran experiencia!
reviews.text: ¡El servicio de comida que Armando proporcionó fue excepcional! En los pocos días que estuve en el complejo, Arturo y Janet también crearon un ambiente increíble y amigable. ¡Gracias a todos por todo!

reviews.author: BD
reviews.title: Fabulous stay at paradisus cancun!
reviews.text: Paradisus is definitely a 5/5 stars!! It has a great location with the most beautiful beach, water, and pools. The service is incredible just as the food and drinks itself! There are so many options with all fresh ingredients which is exactly what i was hoping for when going to Mexico. The staff is very nice, helpful and all have a very positive attitude 24/7! The hotel is clean and very well organized for young and old. as an example, there is a Nespresso bar but also many children. The pools all have different vibes and i personally loved the one that had a very good dj. I would definitely recommend this place to my friends and go here again.

reviews.author: Suzanne V
reviews.title: Vacations with friends!!
reviews.text:
This was our third year at Paradisus Cancun. It didn’t disappoint us! The rooms are nice and the views breathtaking! The food is excellent in all restaurants. We had lunch every day at the Agua Marina restaurant and we ate in a different restaurant for dinner each night (twice in Lemon Fish and Capella). The service is AMAZING! The staff works so hard to make you feel welcome and they do everything they can so you jut enjoy your vacation. We speak Spanish so we can communicate with everyone but I think they are as nice with everybody! At the beach and the pool area Laura, Luz, Enrique and Jorge took great care of us! Javier did a great job at the Italian restaurant! Armando and his team, at Malva Restaurant, took care of us every morning and knew exactly what we all wanted after the second day! He made us feel special! 
We love this resort, mainly because of the staff and the amazing food!

reviews.author: Junaid Syed
reviews.title: There are better all inclusive hotels. This was my worst experience.
reviews.text: We went to the steak restaurant. The service was poor. Steak was so tough that I couldn’t eat it. The person waiting on us so rude. I have been coming to Cancun for the last 20 years and never had an experience of waiter behave so rudely as well as his manager. First and last time in this hotel. I stayed here because my friend was staying here. They’re a lot better all inclusive hotels in Cancun. Consider other hotels.

reviews.author: Jazzmin R
reviews.title: Best birthday trip ever <3
reviews.text: I am a female in my mid 30's and i came here for the SunSoaked Festival with a couple girl friends for my birthday. i have never been to Cancun, let alone an all inclusive resort. the whole experience was freaking so awesome!!! i just wanted to give a special shout out to a few of the waiters in the buffet hall. THANK YOU GAUDENCIO, JONI & MANUEL. you guys went above and beyond to make my birthday and our stay special!

reviews.author: mohit H
reviews.title: Family visit to cancun
reviews.text: This was our first night at paradisus. We had dinner at cielo restaurant. There were not many vegeterian options but chef David just created perfect surprises just for us based on local cuisine.he just came to us and said to just wait for surprises. Angel started us with perfect martinis . The food was just out of world perfect. This was  one of the best ever Mexican cuisine we had. Apetizers, main course and deserts were just as beautifully served as they tasted.. Manager honorio angle and David were just humble and made it special night. This is an experience we look forward again. Mohit and shilpa

reviews.author: Joan G
reviews.title: I absolutely recommend this resort for families, couples, or friends!
reviews.text: We had the a absolute best service. Pascual, Alfredo, and Teresa went above and beyond to meet our needs. I have been to Mexico 6 times and this is by far the best resort (close to the airport, amenities, service, amazing beds, and an incredible beach!

reviews.author: Thomas N
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Had a great time for my first time in Cancún. Huge thanks to our servers Yest, Atilono, Manuel, Martin, Gerardo, and Eddie for their great service and to the rest of the staff here for the hospitality

reviews.author: Vanessa E
reviews.title: Rafael de Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Lemon Fish es un excelente restaurante! Y apare rafa es un excelente mesero que nos ayudó para la elección de los platos y bebidas! Aparte que muy bueno, paciente y divertido. Me encanto la experiencia!

reviews.author: The Outstanding C
reviews.title: Exceptional staff!
reviews.text: The staff at this hotel are amazing! Every single person went above and beyond for us our entire stay. Guadencio, Joni, and Manuel greeted us for breakfast each morning at the Lunch Box and attended to everything we needed. Didi took care of us at the pool, making sure we always had a drink in hand. Great experience with everyone!

reviews.author: Brianna J
reviews.title: The best hotel for everything!!
reviews.text:
I been in many resorts but never been at one like this one! 
It's amazing!! You have many options to choose what do you want to do, eat and drink!! 
Our favorite part it was the activities with Abraham, Jesus  and saulo!! Abraham was super fun! We loved him! Also the dj night with erick was amazing!! He made the people dance!! Also the buffet malva was delicious!! So don't doubt to come here! I'm sure u will love it!!

reviews.author: debbieelizabeth
reviews.title: My Stay at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: The staff at this resort is absolutely the best. Marva, Armando, Manuel and Janeth Arturo are great. My absolute favorites were Atilano and Francesco at Malvo and Alejandro at the Nespresso bar!! They made  our stay truly wonderful!! Keep up the great job!!

reviews.author: Mahdieh T
reviews.title: Malva Food Bazar
reviews.text:
Alright let me tell you something, if ever you’re doubting on which resort to pick for your travel in Cancun please please take Paradisus, I promise you 100% you would love it!!! 
Now for the food all of them are very great, family friendly, fun for any age, and amazing staff. 
Now let me tell you about Malva Food Bazar… Malva malva malva!! Where should I start with?  You guys are amaziiiing, best food on the planet, serioulsy.. Better than the food itself is the staff at Malva: always welcoming, efficient, fast at serving and helping you, no language barrier, always cheerful and most importantly caring. You will most definitely try Malva and I hope you get lucky enough to be served by Ignacio, Manuel or Atilano. 
Small message for these 3 guys:
1) Atilano always always smile like the way you do, your smile lightens up the whole room :)
2) Manuel your kindness is special and a key to many problems, please hold on to it and never loose it! 
3) Ignacio from the first time my sister and I met you we felt as if you were part of our family. “Trust” is how I can define you in one word. 
I tried to make my message for these 3 best staff at Paradisus as short as I can, but they have way more qualities than that. There was also another girl at front door of Malva who was always very welcoming, but I couldn’t remember her name, if you’re reading this big shoutout to you too for making sure my sister and I get vegetarian food due to our food restrictions. 

I love you Paradisus, I’m already looking ahead to book my next trip here. Muchas gracias :)

reviews.author: Elizabeth G
reviews.title: Lemon Fish restaurant in Paridusis Hotel, Cancun
reviews.text: I would definitely recommend, Lemon Fish in Paradisus Hotel, CancunThe service was amazing! The team of Jorge, Miguel & Alejandro Pat made our experience a very pleasurable & the hospitality was 100% on point.

reviews.author: Marisa R
reviews.title: Lemon Fish at the Paradisus Cancun Resort
reviews.text: Stayed at the Paradisus Cancun Resort and had an amazing dinner and experience at Lemon Fish. Our server Jorge was excellent and recommended amazing dishes. We were able to try practically the whole menu. Miguel was the chef who prepared the amazing food. Alejandro was our mixologist and surprised us with delicious drinks. It was definitely a great way to spend dinner on our last night! Can’t wait to come back.

reviews.author: Devon D
reviews.title: Famiy Vacation
reviews.text: Excellent service, Rodrigo the best server, he always checking you ok. He treated our family like his.  Always ask for Rodrigo. My family and I enjoy the hotel and the service that rodrigo gave us. The best vacation ever.

reviews.author: Explore668247
reviews.title: Pésimo servicio
reviews.text:
Pésimo servicio 
El hotel no tiene el personal suficiente y se tardan horas en traerte una bebida
No son serviciales ni amables, todo es un problema para el personal. No sonríen parece que están enojados 

Muy sucio el hotel, los baños sucios, no cargan los enchufes en el cuarto 

No es un hotel diamente deberían quitarle ese indicador. Muy viejo el hotel y sin mantenimiento.

reviews.author: Myriam B
reviews.title: Lemon Fish - Alexandro and Emmanuel are #1s!
reviews.text: Favorite spot to eat at Paradisus! Lovely experience at Lemon Fish with Alexandro Leon and Emmanuel. Super attentive to food restrictions and they had many vegan options. We felt super welcomed, service was quick and attentive. Would come here every night!

reviews.author: Britt B
reviews.title: The Lemon Fish
reviews.text: The lemon fish was the best restaurant at Paradisus. The food was amazing and the service even better. Specifically, Alejandro and Emanuel were extremely accommodating and proactive in making our dinner experience one to remember. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Mihiri
reviews.title: Lemon fish amazing service!
reviews.text: Alejandro Leon and Emmanuel were wonderful! I’m vegan and they brought me a lot of different options, the veggie roll and lychee sorbet were the best!! This was our group’s favorite restaurant by far!

reviews.author: Kevininhawaii
reviews.title: First timers review here 10k pyramid 1 2BR suite
reviews.text:
Came here for a music festival event.  Got the 10k package for the suites located in Pyramid 1.  It was too far from everything, and only allowed me to hold 6 people.  Food was meh from the main buffet as I felt like it was low quality and just a lot of egg dishes.

The service was great - 5/5 and all of the employees really took care of you.  

I lost my wristband on the last day and they wanted $120, unreal, after all I spent.

The place did look amazing though, and the room was nice for what I paid for. 

I would definitely try and come here again to give it another chance.

Pricing 3/5
Location 3/5
Food 3/5
Service 5/5

Overall 3.5

reviews.author: Ruby D
reviews.title: rafael and nataniel are the best! food was amazing
reviews.text: rafael and nataniel are the best! food was amazing! even thought we had no reservation we came in early enough where they let us sit and have dinner! Had the burger and fries! everything was cooked perfect!

reviews.author: kevin c
reviews.title: Nepresso bar
reviews.text:
Nepresso bar Richard will make sure your coffee and sweet tooth is satisfied. They open early and stay open till late. Got my latte every morning and decaffeinated at night!

One of the things going good for this place!

reviews.author: Erin M
reviews.title: Great service from my week here for work from rest malva, Arika I, ignacio Vazquez and manvci Martinez. Would definitely
reviews.text: Great service from my week here for work from rest malva, Arika I, ignacio Vazquez and manvci Martinez. Would definitely recommend and come back in the future. Food was great. Servers were polite and prompt and always got my chair and door for me.

reviews.author: Katie F
reviews.title: Cancun Dec 2022 Trip
reviews.text: The servers in the hotel, restaurants and pool were extremely friendly and polite. They provided efficient/great service. Special shout out to Ada, Gabriella, and Laura at the beach and pool for their excellent service.

reviews.author: Tbert1991
reviews.title: Beautiful property, friendly staff, stay here!
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful and very well kept. The staff is super friendly and very attentive. Make sure to make reservations early if you want to dine at restaurants  that require them. Came with 6 friends for 3 nights and had a blast. Highly recommend staying here!

reviews.author: Dave G
reviews.title: Dave
reviews.text: Guadencio Joni Manuel is incredibly welcoming, attentive, kind, and efficient. My group was lucky to have him as our server every morning. He made our experience at Paradisus that much better. I would come back again just for his amazing service!

reviews.author: Caroline P
reviews.title: Amazing staff & service
reviews.text: Ignacio, Manuel, and Atilano amongst all the other employees are amazing! They ensure you are having a great time and have everything you need. Would highly recommend coming to this resort. The amenities are great and the food at the restaurants is unbelievable.

reviews.author: Joana C
reviews.title: Best hotel & food experience
reviews.text: The blue agave restaurant in the Paradisus hotel was so amazing! Great tacos and amazing service! Julio, Moises and Angel had the best attitude and hospitality :) definitely will be back to this hotel and blue agave for their authentic Mexican tacos!

reviews.author: simply.nanc
reviews.title: Blue Agave
reviews.text: The food was super wonderful and filling.. Service was prefect.. staff was attentive and made the experience even 10x better!! Can not go wrong with some tacos.. let alone with good company surrounding you.

reviews.author: Jacqueline O
reviews.title: Ember Shores Festival
reviews.text: The staff was amazing! Sergio and Luis (servers by the pool)  took the best care of us! We can’t wait to come back! The festival was wonderful and the resort was beautiful. Drinks top notch! Pure Euphoria!

reviews.author: vincent r
reviews.title: Best time in Cancun
reviews.text: The service was amazing! Sergio (waitor by the pool) was always there to make sure we were okay and had plenty of food and drinks. His service made this experience so much better! He was always there whenever we needed him. I couldn’t thank him for his service enough!

reviews.author: Rodrigo
reviews.title: Mejor experiencia y calidad
reviews.text: El servicio es excelente, Yesenia, Gaby y Seney los tres en el bar de la alberca, no hay servicio que se compare con lo increíble que son, muchas gracias por la atención, esperemos volver pronto y seguir disfrutando la excelencia de servicio. ☺️☺️☺️

reviews.author: Jessica R
reviews.title: Experiencing inolvidables
reviews.text: Le agradezco a todos los chicos por El mejor servivio que nos brindaron en el pool bar,seney gabby y yesenia fueron los mejores. Voy a regresar con mis amigos <3 porque son las mejores para disfruta las vacaciones.

reviews.author: Selena G
reviews.title: Paradisus Ember Shroes
reviews.text: Muy buen servicio, muy amigable. Gabriela, yesenia, y senei nos atendieron muy bien son un equipazo y lo recomiendo a todos . Fueron Las unicas bartenders de paradisus y Las mejores!!! Vengan a visitar al hotel que tiene buffet, cerca de la playa y muy Buena experiencia. 0

reviews.author: Elena N
reviews.title: Malva
reviews.text:
Estuvimos una semana alojados en el hotel Paradisus, un lujazo. 
El hotel espectacular, el personal inmejorable y la comida genial, teníamos muchos restaurantes donde elegir pero sin duda repetimos en Malva principalmente por la atención que recibíamos cada día especialmente de Gaudencio, Joni y Manuel que se portaron fenomenal con todos nosotros y su servicio era siempre de 10!! 
Gracias!!
Ojalá poder volver!!

reviews.author: John P
reviews.title: Thank You Violeta!!
reviews.text: Violeta was our concierge, what a wonderful person who is very easy to work with, she handled all of our restaurant and room needs, and also helping us secure Bali beds on a daily basis. Violeta made our stay so enjoyable!!

reviews.author: priya y
reviews.title: Best experience Ever!
reviews.text: The hotel staff were great! Everyone spoke kindly and were always helpful! Martin, Eddie and Gerardo from Marva Breakfast were so helpful and super kind with their service! Very talkative and and engaging with everyone at the resort!

reviews.author: vandutch101
reviews.title: Lynn Van Adder
reviews.text: This was my second time at this resort and 6th time I have stayed at a Paradisus Resort.   All of them have been great but this was the best.  Our concierge Frida Flores was wonderful we could not have asked for anyone better. She always checked and made sure everything was going well. What an asset to this resort.  Also Jenny by the pool was great always a smile on her face. If you haven’t tried this resort please do you will have a great time with great staff.

reviews.author: Amanda D
reviews.title: Lunch before beach
reviews.text: The tortillas were delicious and the al pastor was out of this world! Service was so kind. Great quick lunch stop before the beach. I had several Paloma’s as well and they were made very well, loved it

reviews.author: Ben F
reviews.title: Food was great, quick, hot, & top quality.  Moises was out waiter
reviews.text: I came here last year & couldn’t wait to come back. The tacos were delicious, & very fresh. Once I came back to Paradisus it was my first stop! Moises was an amazing waiter, & very quick to help us with whatever we needed.

reviews.author: Geneviève L
reviews.title: Quelques déceptions
reviews.text:
Nous avons séjourné 2 couples et 2 enfants en bas âge. L’hôtel offre de nombreux avantages, dont la vue sur la mer et la plage où l’on trouve aisément de l’ombre. La plage était bien pour les enfants. La piscine était belle et bien entretenue. L’hôtel était propre et le personnel serviable et accueillant. 
Malheureusement il est difficile de trouver le repos car on entend la musique de la piscine ou des soirées de partout. 
Le buffet n’est pas ouvert de midi à 13h ni de 17 à 18h, ce qui était problématique avec les enfants. Les restaurants ouvrent aussi à 18h et évidemment avec les réservations nous n’avons pas pu en essayer plusieurs. De plus, en se présentant au buffet à 18h, les grillades n’étaient pas prêtes et donc nous n’avions pas accès. Il y a un seul buffet et donc souvent des files d’attente. La nourriture était bonne, mais les choix limités. 
Il n’était pas toujours aisé d’avoir des serviettes.
Nous avions réservé ensemble (une seule réservation), nous avions demandés des chambres proches, malheureusement 1 pyramide et 4 étages nous séparaient. Il a été impossible de changer de chambre car nous n’étions pas dans la même catégorie de chambre? 
Plusieurs travaux étaient en cours, plusieurs ascenseurs non fonctionnels (moins pratique avec la poussette) et ce n’était pas toujours affiché.
Nous avons eu un beau séjour, mais nous nous attendions à plus d’un 5 étoiles.

reviews.author: Jessica O
reviews.title: La Capella has the best service
reviews.text: We ended our week eating at the Italian restaurant La Capella!! Our server was Fernando and he was absolutely fantastic! He was so accommodating and made our experience a superb one! We asked for some items that were not on the menu and he made it happen! We were never without beverages, bread, etc…and he was so pleasant and wonderful!! Great time great food and top notch service!

reviews.author: Digital M
reviews.title: Una experiencia muy especial!
reviews.text:
El hotel es espectacular! Tienes todo para pasarla muy bien! La comida es increíble! A parte tienes variedad de restaurantes para pasar la noche! Y hacen eventos en la noche!  El servicio también te hace más amena tu estadía! A mi me atendió Antonio Báez y nos colaboro para tener habitaciones cerca con mis amigas y esto nos hizo la estadía más amena! Recomendamos quedarse como mínimo 4 días para que lo puedan conocer y disfrutar bien! Me 
E n c a n t ó! Súper recomendado 
Sigan así por favor!

reviews.author: Sly989898
reviews.title: Relaxing, great food, great staff.
reviews.text:
Great resort! Pool experience was excellent (Ada was our pool service girl and was A+++). LemonFish excellent
Gift shop EXPENSIVE! $44 for sunscreen, $16 deck of cards! Luckily pharmacy across street!

reviews.author: Annie F
reviews.title: The Vacation of a Lifetime with Geovani, Sofonias, Emilio, Roberto, Nurbi, and Emmanuel 😇
reviews.text: This vacation at Club Melia was amazing due to the amazing staff in the Ginger Bar  including Geovani (mi amor) , Sofonias, Emilio, Roberto, Nurbi, and Emmanuel💗 these amazing people made my vacation a vacation of a lifetime! I have never enjoyed someone’s company as much as them! There are not enough words to describe how hardworking, passionate, and special these workers are. I will always remember them and their kindness. They deserve the whole world and deserve a HUGE pay raise. They made these whole experience nothing short of amazing. So thankful for meeting them and for their kindness to us during our vacation.😇 please give them all the kind words they deserve and you are so incredible to have these workers work for you all! Everyone make sure to visit the Ginger lounge for the best DJ ( ERIC) and for the best companions you will find in Mexico!! Also huge praise for Jean Carlo (JC) and Cesar at Lemonfish, we LOVE him. I cannot say enough about these people. Also to include Sergio, Elliot, and Balta at the pool, so kind and always so sweet to us. Thank you so much for making this vacation so memorable.

reviews.author: GoPlaces31488468502
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: Great service from Emanuel and Jorge. Amazing servers and great food. Ate at lemon fish. Will definitely be coming back in the future for more meals. The pineapple desert was my favorite if you wanted any suggestions.

reviews.author: Christian C
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Rafael de lo mejor en servicio. Muy buen atención al servir y cotorreo. Comida estaba de maravilla. Muchas gracias a Rafael por hacer esta cena un experiencia buena. A cualquiera que quiere comer bien y ser atendido igual de bueno, Lemon Fish es el lugar👌

reviews.author: Dharti T
reviews.title: An A+ resort experience!!
reviews.text:
This resort is one of the best we have ever been to. So clean and smells so good when you enter. Staff is friendly everywhere.  
Special mention: Cielo
We are vegetarian and upon consulting the manager Adriana was kind enough to accommodate us. A great thanks to Chef David, he specially made all veggie mexican menu for us. It was delicious 😋. The hostess Karen and our waiter Victor were incredible.  Overall a very memorable experience and a fun trip!

reviews.author: amy m
reviews.title: best servers on the beach
reviews.text: Yesenya & Gaby we’re the best servers that we had while we spent our days at the beach. They knew what we wanted and would always bring doubles of what we were drinking. We were a big group here for a destination wedding and they made our experience 10x better, remembering our names and everything!

reviews.author: 580brodyg
reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort!! Definitely recommend the Reserve upgrade which includes a personal concierge to help with almost anything you would need including dinner reservations-Rafael was our concierge and he checked in every day and made sure we had everything we needed. Reserve upgrade also included the private, adult only pool with comfortable cabanas and amazing poolside service- Miguel & Julio never let us go thirsty! Ian at Cielo 
Rafael and chef Antonio at Lemon Fish
Jesus at Cappella
Leo at Sal Steak Cave

reviews.author: Pioneer55973354728
reviews.title: Best experience in Cancun
reviews.text:
Restaurant Malva.
We had waiters Anilano, Manuel and iGnacia and they were absolutely amazing. They would constantly coming to our table helping us with all our needs. I will definitely be back and will request this team if I can.

reviews.author: Kelly R
reviews.title: Great staff and resort experience
reviews.text: Huge shoutout to the wonderful staff who made our stay top notch!! Frida (Conceirge) Nicole and Jennifer (cabana staff) Axcel (activities) Oscar and Alejandro (wait staff) went above and beyond for us

reviews.author: ke
reviews.title: Viaje de amigas
reviews.text:
Excelente calidad de la comida y mucha variedad. El Spa tiene una atención buenísima, me hice masaje con Liliana súper profesional ! Pasamos delicioso ese día que llovió. 
Solo recomendaría más ambiente en la noche en los bares y espacios del hotel.

reviews.author: Jose L
reviews.title: Hermoso y Único
reviews.text:
Excelente servicio y muy hermoso lugar. Paradisus fue una de nuestras mejores experiencias. 
Especial mención para nuestros meseros favoritos Armando, Ignacio, Reynaldo, Henry y Jesus, "you guys are awesome" Espero verlos una próxima vez. Muchas gracias a todos.

reviews.author: Miriam G
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Excelente restaurante, comida maravilhosa, e o atendente Moises foi muito simpático e atencioso, nos atendeu muito bem.. Recomendo para todos.. Sobremesa de churros maravilhosa.. Tive uma ótima experiência..

reviews.author: Luz R
reviews.title: Girls Trip!!
reviews.text: Returned to this hotel after being here with my daughter in June, but now returned for a girls trip! We had so much fun, the room was amazing the pool and ocean where great!!! And Jesus from entertainment was so awesome! His energy was great!! made sure we where always having fun!! In love with this hotel will be returning soon!!!

reviews.author: Leo L
reviews.title: Los cuartos son amplios y muy limpios, la persona del servicio fue muy eficiente.
reviews.text: Excelente servicio al cliente, good food variedad y muy amigable. Ellos estan pendientes de todo para ayudar ya sea hacerca de comida o de algun otro servicio, sin interes de vender nadA solo por ayudar al cliente.

reviews.author: Juan F
reviews.title: Paradise in Paradisus
reviews.text: My time at Paradisus was nothing short of relaxing and fun. I stayed there with a group of friends, and we all had such a wonderul time! The property is stunning and unlike any other resort l have stayed at before, especially with the beautiful Mayan motifs throughout. The staff showed a strong commitment to providing us with the highest quality experience and service. Big shout out to our host, Frida! She kept us on schedule with friendly reminders about our planned set of activites and dinner reservations. Speaking of dinner, the food at every restaurant was very delicious and offered something for everyone. The entertainment each day was such a treat and such a great exposition of local artistic talent.

reviews.author: kristine p
reviews.title: Best dinner for a party of 11. Thank you Rafael!!!
reviews.text: Rafael is the best server you will ever have. He is the king of servers. This whole trip was made because Rafael brought the best server game to Lemon Fish. If you go there ask for Rafael. He knows top notch service, how to make everyone join in & provide great drinks.

reviews.author: Jose M
reviews.title: Italian paradise
reviews.text: Jesus gave the best service. He was attentive and provided great suggestions. Jesus ensured  we never ran out of any items. He came  back within short periods and made sure our glasses were never empty

reviews.author: Arnaldo B
reviews.title: Lemon fish restaurante
reviews.text: Restaurante muito bonito. Comida saborosa fomos atendidos por rafael que foi muito gentil nos trouxe um pouco de cada prato para provar. Te muito gostoso e bem preparado. E funcionários muito gentis e atenciosos.

reviews.author: Juliana Biehl
reviews.title: Lemon Fish Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Otima comida e atendimento do Rafael. Tacos de atun , ceviche peruano y niguiris de salmon muy buenos! Con certeza volveria a ter esta experiencia maravilhosa! Gracias a todos pela atencion e comida maravilhosa!

reviews.author: Edgard G
reviews.title: Ótimo atendimento Rafael
reviews.text:
Muito prestativo. Meu amigo Rafael. Obrigado 
Excelente ambiente e muito legal. Todos adoramos as comidas típicas mexicanas. 
Diversidades de comidas. Algumas apimentadas , mas nada de mais. Adoramos tudo.

reviews.author: laddr4
reviews.title: LEMON FISH — ask for Cesar y Manuel
reviews.text: Went to lemon fish. Definitely the way to go and prob one of the best restaurants at the Paradisus — HIGHLY RECOMMEND. Plus, Cesar is THE BEST server ever — try to request him (aka demand him) if you go! He alone is worth going there for! Also, Manuel is a great jefe and espresso martini maker 👌🏼

reviews.author: Amy R
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: A beautiful resort but the service is above and beyond. Definitely visit or sit with a table where Miguel and Jorge will be your servers at Lemon Fish. Their attention and recommendations are so on point. They go out of their way to make you feel special and have a wonderful experience.

reviews.author: Travel639103
reviews.title: México mágico aún más mágico gracias a los guardavidas
reviews.text: Los guardavidas Manain Pérez, Jhonny Tejeda y Estefani Pool son los mejores que he encontrado en toda la zona hotelera! Muy buena onda y super amigables, siempre sonriendo, muy atentos y dando el mejor servicio. Me hicieron reír, me enseñaron cosas nuevas y hicieron mis vacaciones más divertidos y mágicos (entre las pláticas, las tortuguitas, la concha del mar y la tabla de surf)! Muchísimas gracias por todo, les deseo lo mejor! Un abrazo fuerte, Pepe

reviews.author: Richard D
reviews.title: Ginger Bar-Sports Bar
reviews.text: Watched the World Series here. Excellent service from Gaby, Geovany & Melisy (Melisa). They found the network carrying it the first night and made sure it was on for the remaining games. The friendly tone they set made us go back all other times!

reviews.author: Maria K
reviews.title: We love Carina at Kanna Bar
reviews.text: Great vacation, Awesome service, Excellent employees in the Lunch Box Restaurant, 24 Hr Espresso Bar, Luz’s service at the beach, fabulous destination for all 12 of us.  Besides all these the highlight of our trip was Kanna Beach Club where we went every night before dinner, get served by Carina bar tender different drinks one better than the other one.  Carina was very sweet, nice and knows her drinks and how to create a great atmosphere for the guests.

reviews.author: Alpaslan T
reviews.title: “Lemon Fish” once in a life time experience…
reviews.text: Best Japanese restaurant  in Cancun. Great atmosphere,  perfect service, tasty food and great experience. Special thanks to Emanuel and Jorge who made our night.  And a very special thanks to Dennise who has been our guardian angel and became a close friend. Really happy to be a part of this experience.

reviews.author: Maria Jesus N
reviews.title: El paraíso en la tierra
reviews.text:
Mi estadía en Paradisus fue simplemente espectacular y eso fue gracias a las excelentes personas que trabajan ahí y sus hermosas y sustentables instalaciones. Partía mis días desayunando en Sante, donde Yamil y Julio me recibían con una sonrisa y excelente disposición. Luego en la piscina principal Ivonne y Eliott muy amablemente me guiaban a la bali para disfrutar del rico sol. Mientras aprovechaba el sol mexicano, Victor, Nallely, Cesar y Balta llegaban con deliciosos tragos y comida en el sector de la piscina principal, para así gozar todos los momentos. También el hotel cuenta con entretenidas actividades para todas las edades, lideradas por los animados Jesús y Keeren, además, la tropa artística se aseguraba de que tu cuerpo se moviera con la música latina.
Ya en la tarde, no había mejor experiencia que ir al stand de Nespresso donde Alejandro y Rich preparaban los mejores cafés. 
En cuanto la comida, los restaurantes Lemon Fish y Cielito son de los mejores, linda decoración y comida deliciosa. El buffet Malva no se quedaba atrás, con Martín, Eduardo y Libertad, quienes me recibieron con mucha alegría.
En la noche, degustar de la coctelería de autor de Pedro en el Ginger Bar, era la mejor manera de terminar e día.
Recomiendo este hotel para todos quienes quieran disfrutar de lo mejor de Cancun, el paraíso en la tierra.

reviews.author: Rocio C
reviews.title: Vacación Cancún
reviews.text: El restaurante sal en el hotel es súper rico y tiene un muy buen servicio. El hotel en general tiene un excelente servicio al cliente y las instalaciones son muy bonitas, cómodas y  muchas cosas que hacer.

reviews.author: maria jesus n
reviews.title: El verdadero paraíso
reviews.text: Excelente clases de Aqua Gym con la amigable Karen y la banda que rockea en la piscina. Una experiencia fenomenal, muy recomendado. Es un lugar para celebrar con familia y amigos, vacaciones o en ocasiones especiales.

reviews.author: Britney C
reviews.title: Service at ParaDisus Cancun
reviews.text: Amazing staff, the whole time three gentlemen by the name of Gaudenaio, Joni and Manuel merged our every food and beverage needs. There was never a time my glass was empty. Treated us with respect and kept checking in on us.

reviews.author: Joan G
reviews.title: Best Experience and Service!
reviews.text: Gaudencio, Joni and Manuel are the BEST. Look for them and they will take care of you. We will look for them when we come back. Funny, entertaining, and service that is fully accommodating. Thank you for the great experience.

reviews.author: Dave C
reviews.title: Great service from the buffet crew and Ginger Bar.
reviews.text: Excellent service from Gaudencio, Noni and Manuel at the buffet. Gabi at The Ginger Bar was excelente as well. Muchas Gracias!!!!  They took great care of us. Me and our friends had a great time during our stay.

reviews.author: Jobel C
reviews.title: Excellent dining and drink serviceservice
reviews.text: Guadencio, Joni and Manuel from the buffet service did an excellent job! Very accommodating, helpful and excellent customer service. They have been assisting us since our first dining. Gabi from Ginger bar was an excellent bartender. She was very helpful and made us feel very special and made our vacation worthwhile.

reviews.author: Zachary Michaël T
reviews.title: Ok resort with some good restaurants
reviews.text:
Some great restaurants, the Limon Fish, a Japanese restaurant is very good. Great service from Jorge and good food by Miguel. Thanks for the evening.
The hotel rooms though is a bit outdated and the bar are closing way too soon! Nothing to do after midnight, no bar, no restaurant, no shows.
The beach is very beautiful but very small.

reviews.author: Philipp S
reviews.title: Great Food at hotel Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
We very much enjoyed all the restaurants and bars of the hotel. Really good food and excellent drinks at the beach and at the pool. 
We wanted to thank especially the breakfast team at MALVA (Armando, Antonio, Ramiro and Alberto) for their excellent service.

reviews.author: SolangeSalguero
reviews.title: Each one of them made me feel this was their own restaurant
reviews.text: I have just come back from a Class - Reunion which this year we held it at this amazing resort.  I have to say I was always so impressed how everyone made us feel.  … it was as if they were the owners!  Attention to detail, sweetness, disposition, and very resolutive ( we were 30 ish people). reviews.author: Sarah W
reviews.title: Facts - Not opinions
reviews.text: Resort is large. It’s about 20 mins from the airport. There is a $15 USD eco tax you have to pay upon checkin. Wifi throughout. Pyramid 3 is the central location for restaurants and entertainment. There’s a few rooms that don’t have balconies because of the design of the hotel. If you want to ensure you have a balcony, make sure you confirm at check in. Balconies are large and extremely private. If you get an ocean view room, the sun will be shining in your room all day long. Lagoon view is much cooler. The rooms are decent and have mostly everything you would need, other than a coffee maker. The bathrooms have bidets. Not many English speaking channels. Your wrist band is your room key. Minimal shelving and drawers in regular rooms. No housecoats or slippers. Mini bar has glass bottles of water, pop, beer and a few snacks. No toiletries in room. Only pump soaps and shampoos. There is a safe in the closet. There is no smoking permitted on the pool deck or in the hotel. You can smoke outside of the doors, on the beach and at the outdoor bar that overlooks the beach. The hotel is eco friendly and doesn’t provide straws. They do provide recyclable cups in the pool area that are washed and reused. The pool is 5ft deep, so beware if you’re short. No sit down snack bar around the pool, but you can order a few snacks from the servers. They do have a small cart that serves small things like burgers, hotdogs and chips. Lots of restaurants to choose from. You can book 2 ala cartes at a time. You pay extra for the steakhouse. There is a $5 charge for room service each time you order. There is no theatre for shows. All entertainment is provided in the lobby area. There is an escape room in pyramid 2 on the ground level (0).

reviews.author: RhiRhi8739
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: I booked Paradisus The Reserve because this is where I stay in DR and I love it.  I was completely disappointed.   The Reserve is building 5.  There is nothing offered in building 5 except a small bar and finger foods with nats flying over them. There is a concierge/butler offered.  I saw her once.  She made dinner reservations at 2 restaurants and I never saw her again.  My traveling companions never met theirs at all.  Building 3 is where you will find all restaurants, the pool and any entertainment offered.   Imagine the walk daily from the upgraded reserve area.  The food was awful.  The beef and pork in the buffet was so tough, we had them make us hamburgers.  One day it was descent/edible.  The breakfast was good.. fresh omelets and mimosas.  The steak house was just ok.  The Italian restaurant was ok but there was no AC and it was very very hot.  I can not tell you anything about the Lemon Fish as we were turned away because we did not have reservations.  The Blue Agave was good however we had to take our menu to the cook and order because we could not find a waiter and I had to literally go behind the bar, go in their cooler and get my own beer.  The only person that provided good service was an older gentleman at the cabanas.  I tipped him 40 dollars because he worked hard to ensure we were taken care of.  Speaking of the cabanas, we had to stand in line to reserve one because our concierge/butler was not to be found.  We had a chilled bottle of champagne left in our room and I thought it would be our night cap only to find it gone when we returned.  I called to see if I could possibly get it back but no luck.  I can say that the place was clean.  I will NEVER book here again.  Completely disappointed and spent a lot of money for nothing.

reviews.author: Cess
reviews.title: MONEY STOLEN IN ROOM. Don’t stay here if you want to feel safe.
reviews.text:
DON’T STAY HERE. YOU CAN GET ROBBED AND THE HOTEL WILL REFUSE TO DO THE RIGHT THING.

We had a reservation for 7 nights at the Paradisus Cancun to handle some business while trying to enjoy a bit of a vacation getaway. Half way through our stay we had left money in our room for a few hours and had $2,000 USD in cash disappear. When we arrived back in our room, the room was reset and our money was gone.  

We tried to talk to security and guest services. They triple checked our room and reassured us they would do an investigation to follow up on what happened and who entered. 

To be honest, for most of our stay we have had really great customer service. From Antonio up at the front desk who helped us move rooms our first day (since our original assigned room did not have a working air conditioner), to every smiling face that laughed and joked with us at the 24hr coffee station, and all the very sweet staff at each restaurant who would remember things about us and would joke with the other visitors children.  We really had enjoyed our first few days at Paradisus. It is hard for us to feel so sad and disappointed in the end when we have tried to be patient and understanding, believing in the due process which they promised us would amount to something. Perhaps we were naive to think that any place would be safe from the dark things that can happen in the world but we did expect better from the hotel in regards to a response to help us cope with our financial loss. You come to a inclusive resort to melt your worries away, not to add to the anxiety we already deal with on a daily basis to even make the dollars to get here.

After 72 hours of patiently waiting for their investigation to be completed , speaking kindly to those every morning at the guest services hoping for an update, I am left in tears of frustration that the only reassurance and compensation they are willing to give us is a voucher for 2 nights to come back to the place that tarnished my first memories of Cancun. Imagine paying for a 6 hour flight round trip from CA to stay 2 nights at a place that literally stole your money. How does that even make sense? We asked for at least 3 days to make it more reasonable.  Their reasoning for the result of the investigation, you ask? Their room staff had worked here for years and so they trust them. That’s the whole investigation, justification and conclusion.

We tried to resolve this with them directly but as you can imagine they are protecting their staff and hotel. We understand it is a business and like I told Christian the supervisor at guest services and Astrid the guest services supervisor who assisted us in trying to recoup some kind of compensation for our loss, that we also worked very very hard to even make this trip happen and saved all we could hoping to have a vacation we would remember for a lifetime. We know they work very hard too.

All I will remember now, is not the music at the bars and dancing with the performers, the great dishes at the restaurants, or excellent service from everyone else we had interacted with. But instead the frustration of coming everyday to speak with them when I would rather have been at the beach, the hurt of dealing with people who originally told us they would do nothing, and the last 2 days of our trip that we spent almost begging for them to do more than shoo us away and tell us to forget about it.  I’ll always remember all the tears, the deflation of walking to our room trying to figure out how we could swallow and  recover from this loss, and the shock we first had when we came and couldn’t find it.

In the end all we have is a hotel voucher for 2 nights with the expectation we will have to spend even more money to even make it a reasonable trip, coming all the way from California. Please don’t spend your money here. Pick a different hotel, there are so many other beautiful places in Cancun. Behind all the nice things at Paradisus, there are so many things that can happen that you’d never expect and they will do little to nothing about. This is a warning to all my fellow travelers. And to Paradisus - do better, no one wants to leave a vacation in tears.

reviews.author: Silvia Lujan
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Excelente hotel, excelente comida y atención de todo el personal, en especial de Arnulfo, Ramiro y Teresa, realmente servicio excepcional de ellos. Muchas gracias porque hicieron de nuestra estancia algo inolvidable

reviews.author: tony c
reviews.title: The best vacation
reviews.text:
Saul made sure we were informed of all activities and encourage us to try things we would not have tried otherwise. He came around multiple times to make sure we knew what was going on.

Only thing we would like is to have music at the reserve area and have better music options, reggaeton,Bachata or some better hype music.

reviews.author: Rachel A
reviews.title: Gemma and YHISpa
reviews.text: Gemma at the YHISpa is wonderful. She ensured that both of services were to my satisfaction and also tended to post  my service time with detox suggestions and self care recommendations. I definitely recommend her and the YHISpa at Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: Isamia0715
reviews.title: Didi Is The Best
reviews.text: Didi at poolside was such a great experience. He was very attentive and friendly. Always checking in and making sure we had everything we needed at all times. Make sure you ask for DiDi at the main pool

reviews.author: Jessica S
reviews.title: Lemon fish
reviews.text: Lemon fish was great! Our server, Rafael, was great as well. He made numerous recommendations for us to try at dinner and we enjoyed all of them very much. He also made dessert recommendations for us, which was delicious as well. We had a great time and will be back !!

reviews.author: Anderson A
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text: Excelente servicio y muy amables y atentos en todo momento, los chicos de animación muy buen trabajo, las mejores vacaciones volvería sin duda alguna, felicitaciones a todo el personal de paradisus cancun 🇲🇽❤️

reviews.author: Ionut
reviews.title: Todo perfecto
reviews.text: Tuvimos unas vacaciones de ensueño. El hotel supera las expectativas. Los empleados super atentos y dedicados al cliente. La actividades marravillosas , el primer dia el voleibol en la playa con jesus nos encanto , y el ultimo dia nos lo hemos pasado super guay con lisy en la actividad “pinta tu sombrero” (lisy super maja y atenta con nosotros) 😃Volveremos seguro a repetir en el futuro🤗

reviews.author: Mitchell Randulich
reviews.title: PARADISUS CANCÚN!!
reviews.text: Paradisus possibly best place in the game. Get yourself to Aqua Marina and get served by jesus and henry, dynamic duo right there! Place is amazing, and a fantastic experience from top to bottom! Drinks are great, food is better, weather is warm!! Love it here!

reviews.author: Bayo D
reviews.title: Excellent Service
reviews.text: Went to Paradisis Hotel for a destination wedding and had the pleasure of having Samuel Sosa be our lunch and dinner server he was excellent throughout the week. He kept tabs on us and made sure we were looked after. He gave us good advice on what activities and places we should visit based on our tastes. He was lively, energetic and respectful. He was definitely one of the highlights of the trip and when I come back to Mexico, I look forward to seeing him again.

reviews.author: Destinee M
reviews.title: Amazing graduation trip
reviews.text: Where do I even start, I could go on and on about everyone I met. As soon as I walked in I knew I was going to have an amazing trip. From the service at the front desk with Antonio who made everything possible for me to have the best time to celebrate me and my friends graduation. Then to having Saul always keep us updated on the activities happening within the resort and if not he always made sure to bring it to us if we missed it then Jesus always making sure we were having an amazing time always bringing a smile and laugh to our faces to Erick who always made sure to play the music we wanted to hear and being an amazing DJ. Also Brandon who always came around to us to offer us some of the best deals that gave us the best nights of our lives. I’m thankful for every moment I was given because of this resort and I can’t wait to go back, it felt like home.

reviews.author: Gustavo G
reviews.title: El mejor hotel
reviews.text: La pasamos de maravilla en nuestra estancia, Henry nos atendió en aquamarina y Excelente servicio. Ginger con el dj Erick nos puso la mejor música. Volvería de nuevo, las instalaciones son excelentes y la comida fue la mejor.

reviews.author: Gilka

He went above and beyond while I went to dinner, me being a very picky eater, after asking him about having chicken wings because I had eaten them before, he stated that they were not available, but he can go make them for me fresh!! Excelente SERVICIO! You have to go visit Oscar Chan!!

reviews.author: Karleene D
reviews.title: Lemon Fish

Aqua Marina have great drinks and food, the manager was very nice and Henry offer great drinks options, which was very helpful. I highly recommend this place and I will definitely be coming back.

reviews.author: BettinaCancunQuenn
reviews.title: 60th Birthday Celebration week!
reviews.text:
Just spent 7 days at the Paradisus in Cancun.
I decided to upgrade to the Reserve when we arrived. That was the best decision I could have made.
We had our own private Butler Freddy that took care of everything for us, even personally decorated our room and brought us champagne and strawberries. He was texting me everyday asking what he could do for us.
He reserved us Bali beds that faced the ocean. The service at the pool was amazing.
The Reserve side is much quieter and adults only. It was just what I needed. 
The Fiesta night was the best night with authentic food and entertainment you don’t want to miss. I have been staying at the Paradisus for the past 30 years.
The only disappointment I had was the buffet food was not as good as in past years,
Service throughout the resort is amazing and staff is all so kind and helpful. I highly recommend to upgrade to the Reserve side of the hotel and request Freddy.
I can’t wait to come back.

Bettina OBrien
Kansas City, Mo

They provided kindness, fun and generosity of their time as they shared activities like volleyball, painting, mixology, yoga and stretching with us. Thanks to them and the hotel.

reviews.author: Jackie M
reviews.title: Lemon Fish

reviews.author: Ivan P
reviews.title: Personal de 10 y un hotel increible
reviews.text:
Fuimos 5 amigos, 

La gente del hotel la mejor que me he encontrado, el servicio siempre atento, preocupado por lo que necesitaríamos.

Hacer una mención especial a Jesús de animación, que nos trato como si fuéramos amigos. Siempre animando,con actividades y ayudándonos en lo que necesitábamos ( aunque no estuviera dentro de su trabajo).
Sin duda una persona de 10, tanto en lo personal como en lo profesional.
Y a Daniel de asistencia, que se encargó de ayudarnos con todas las gestiones del hotel, enseñándonos las cosas.
Espero que les vaya muy bien a los dos.

En cuanto al hotel, nos encantó la visita, un hotel de lujo en una de las mejores zonas de Cancún, con unas vistas espectaculares.
Probablemente repitamos con la misma compañía para nuestro próximo destino.

reviews.author: Romi G
reviews.title: Comida i servicio excelente

reviews.author: Cynthia
reviews.title: An honest review
reviews.text: We had booked a group of 14 in February and we all booked Reserve Level.  When we arrived we were disappointed we were in different towers and had to forgo certain things to be in the same tower.  Some were never able to be booked in the same tower and were seperate from the group. We were not offered a welcome drink and had to ask on our own which was disappointing.  Our concierge Galdino did work to make our stay amazing so we all did appreciate his attention to us and the staff in general went out of their way to make the birthday girl feel special.  Nicole and Jennifer at the reserve pool are wonderful and truly worked to accommodate us all week, they were amazing.  The team working at Sante and around the pool were so attentive, Moses, Ruben, Valeria, Joel, Julio, Yamil, Oscar and Diego took great care of us! The restaurants,  Cielo and Lemon Fish were the best and the staff at both were truly spectacular! The biggest disappointment was Capelli, not that the food wasn't delicious but that we were told we could only oder an appetizer and a salad but not both.  It was so bizarre that they were so adamant that we could basically not order what we wanted and that was such a turn off.  Blue Agave was also fantastic and the guys were amazing, great experience.   Aqua Marina was meh...and Lunch Box was probably the least favorite.  I personally never ate at the buffet so can not give any review.  Sante was were we ate breakfast everyday and had the lobster lunch twice (EXTRA CHARGE) but we knew that and it was not a disappointment.  Overall the rooms to me were mediocre.  The snacks offered in the room were geared I feel to kids, oreos, m&ms and chips, and not worthy to call a reserve mini bar in my opinion.  And I think I got turn down service once my entire trip which again for reserve level was actually a disappointment as well.  I felt there was no real sense of that "extra touch" .  And the snacks in the reserve level in tower 5 were also mediocre, just really nothing special.  The resort overall is hot, the restaurants that are not air conditioned are hot. Yes we went in July but it was so warm to eat dinner, Cappelli was the worst since it's the main atrium at the bottom with very little air flow.  So the resort is beautiful and green but it comes at a cost and that's comfort from the heat. Overall the entertainment was boring.  Activities team was pretty unengaging and honestly seemed very "cheap".  The swim up bar had kids sitting and climbing all over the place and that was a total turn off.  So we stayed in the reserve pool.  Sadly the only time it was super lively there was the time they had water aerobics and the one time during the week we had the DJ.  So it's very quiet and I felt  could be livelier.  Overall it's a beautiful resort with some amazing aspects.  But if I came to Cancun again I would not chose this resort unfortunately because it just seemed mediocre overall despite the entire team who work so very hard to make it special.

reviews.author: Ali M

reviews.author: Cecmatos
