We had everything on the menu and there was nothing that we did not like.

reviews.author: Suzanne W
reviews.title: Lemon Fish is a MUST!
reviews.text: We had an amazing meal at Lemon Fish! Excellent service. Jorge took incredible care of us. Mario and Karen are wonderful chefs. We tasted a little of every dish and it was all delicious! Short rib tacos are the best! Ricardo is the best bartender, ask for the Ricardo special! Thank you!

reviews.author: Eusamama
reviews.title: Dinner im Lemon Fish
reviews.text:
Der Start mit dem Service ist harzig gewesen, doch nach 20 Min warten ist es losgegangen und unser Kellner Jorge ist in Fahrt gekommen😊 und hat uns mit guten Gips bedient - Danke!
Alles was wir bestellt haben, schmeckte sehr gut -was bis anhin schon so war (wir waren bereits zum 4. Mal dort). Die Speisen werden frisch zubereitet und schön dekoriert/präsentiert. Ein Dank geht ebenfalls den Chefs Mario y Karen.

Als Negatives gibt es zu erwähnen, dass es reinregnete und es in den Teller tropfte😒. Und in den einzelnen Essbereichen war es frisch ( die Ventilatoren sind hoch eingestellt).

Auf jeden Fall kann ich den Lemon Fish wärmstens empfehlen.👍☺️

reviews.author: Yash P
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: I went there with my wife who loves seafood. I am a vegetarian so I wasn’t expecting much. But i was pleasantly surprised when my server Jorge y Miguel listened to my needs and not only went to the kitchen to confirm they could accommodate me, but also got me a special surprise for main course. Chef Karen y Antonio whipped up one of the best skewers and spring rolls I have ever had. It was beyond amazing. I would highly recommend the place and these people!

reviews.author: Emma S
reviews.title: cappella restaurant
reviews.text: Our waiter Jose Luis Ayala was an amazing server with his captain as Carlos Chay. Our experience here was very nice as we were taken care of to ever extent. The food and atmosphere was also really nice. I can say this is by far the best dinner we’ve had here and what really made it special was the service we were given. Make sure to ask for Jose Luis, he was phenomenal.

reviews.author: Katheryn S
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: All employees were wonderful and made us all feel welcome & at home! Beautiful hotel, amazing food & awesome environment. Really enjoyed the spa! Angles and Lendor did amazing! Really overall recommend this hotel. Will definitely be back soon!

reviews.author: Raine V
reviews.title: Lemonfish
reviews.text: Jorge and Miguel were our wonderful servers and they went above and beyond making our experience here amazing. The food was prepared by Karen and Salma and it was so impressive. Pansa llena y corazón contenta!

reviews.author: Sylvia K
reviews.title: Paradisus is wonderful
reviews.text: Miguel Marcan at guest services was so helpful and kind. He called to confirm our airport shuttle for us and we are so grateful for his assistance. You could not ask for any better customer service. He is the best.

reviews.author: Janet F
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Nuestro mesero fue Rafael y nos dio excelente servicio. Definitivamente recomiendo que visiten este restaurante con Rafael. Fue una experiencia nueva para nosotros y tuvo mucha paciencia explicándonos todos. El mejor restaurante de el hotel paradisus.

reviews.author: Glenda O
reviews.title: Excelente servicio y gastronomía
reviews.text: La atención de Alejandro Camelo fue excelente sus sugerencias en platillos y hacer de nuestra visita una experiencia única. Todo el staff fue súper atento y amable. Les recomendamos pedir platillos al centro para poder probar la mayor cantidad de sabores disponibles.

reviews.author: Edilson C
reviews.title: Malva pm
reviews.text:
Muito bom atendimento por Rafael e Alejandro y cristel. Comida boa e ambiente agradável. Gostei 👍 vou retornar.
Edilson from Brasil...9 vezes em Paradisus Cancun e voltarei pelo menos mais 9...eu amo ❤️ Paradisus e seus funcionários.

reviews.author: Nicole C
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: incredible food, wonderful service. Lemon Fish is right in the middle of the resort, it’s a beautiful location. Sushi, beef tips, rice, panela cheese, everything's delicious. Thank you Rafael Cime for your attention! Beautiful experience 💯

reviews.author: corrinarg
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Great time at Lemon Fish! We received excellent service from Rafael! We enjoyed delicious sushi and received special treatment for our gluten frèe friend. And Randy made the best "Liz" Cosmo! Would rcommend! 💗💗

reviews.author: Brittany L
reviews.title: Lemon fish
reviews.text: Rafael Cime was a awesome server. He was very attentive to what I wanted. He made great menu suggestions and was overall very welcoming. He even recommended a new drink that is now my favorite. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Paula Alejandra R
reviews.title: La mejor experiencia
reviews.text: Mi experiencia en el hotel Paradisus Cancún fue increíble, no solo por las instalaciones del hotel, sino también por la comida que fue increíble, las piscinas, el acceso a la playa,  las actividades que hay por hacer y lo mejor de este hotel es la atención de absolutamente todas las personas, en especial de los meseros y quiero resaltar al señor Oscar, el cuál tuvo una excelente hospitalidad con nosotros, nos dió excelentes recomendaciones, fue super amable y eso permitió que la estadía fuera perfecta, recomiendo ampliamente este hotel porque no en cualquier lugar te vas a sentir tan bien atendido y cómodo, 10/10 gracias señor Oscar

reviews.author: Alejandra C
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Oscar el encargado de las actividades es un ser humano excepcional! Con amabilidad nos recomendo dónde comprar souvenirs! El personal en el restaurante malva fue excelente! No obstante las habitaciones pueden mejorar su reparación se fue la luz en un instante y retitaron una toalla que era mía dela habitación

reviews.author: Mercych15
reviews.title: Tequilaaa
reviews.text: Maravilloso servicio al cliente... Todo me encanto sobre todo la cata de tequila muchas gracias a yran por sus explicaciones, me gusta el tequila pero ahora entiendo porque, no se debe tomar por moda, definitivamente es mejor descubrir y encontrar las palabras para describir

reviews.author: Jordan H
reviews.title: Must try!!!
reviews.text:
Best food & experience in Paradisus Cancun & Cancun as a whole!! Must try. Salmon roll was definitely my favorite entre & mango sorbet was a very tasty dessert!! If you like sparkling wine, try their new cocktail: sparkling white wine, lemon juice, gin (you don’t taste the gin) and sugar.

Jorge was a very personal & top notch waiter!

reviews.author: doanhilary
reviews.title: Paradise Blue; amazing service and assistance!
reviews.text: My partner and I stayed at the Paradisus for one week for vacation and Paradise Blue Music Festival! Everything was amazing, the beach was beautiful, food delicious and rooms were clean and well taken care of! Special thank you to Rafael Juarez, for making our trip so seamless and enjoyable! He was very helpful prior to our trip, arranging our dinner reservations for us and checked in with us many times throughout our stay to make sure everything was up to standard. I recommend anyone looking to stay in Cancun to choose Paradisus Resort and contact Rafael for reservation needs and other inquiries; he was so helpful and friendly! Until next year, Paradise Blue.

reviews.author: Lorena J
reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text: Rafael Juarez was the best concierge we’ve ever had! He made everything possible for us and he made sure we had fun during our stay. Thank you Rafael for everything!!! We cannot wait to go back next year!

reviews.author: Sal P
reviews.title: The best experience I’ve ever had in my life.
reviews.text: Frida from the reserve is the absolute best employee in the entire building … every single person we rn toured was kind, accommodating, compassionate, hard working. They CARE here at Paradisus. Our Concierge Frida from the reserve made this one of the most special vacations of my life. I will never stay anywhere but there because of her amazing service!! Dinner .. shows .. whatever you need she is on TOP of it. Thank you so much for everything and we can’t wait to see you again Frida and everyone at Paradisus - Joel in the reserve pool, Cesar in the reserve pool, Valeria, Jennifer and Max. You were all the best service we have ever had!!!! This isn’t good bye - it’s see you SOON! ❤️

reviews.author: Destinee B
reviews.title: Rafael Juarez
reviews.text:
Rafael was amazing. He made sure we had a good time from beginning to end. We were visiting to celebrate a bachelorette party and he made it worth it ! Will definitely be back and requesting Rafael. Rosanegra was so great as well as Mamacita . 

We stayed at the Paridisus Cancun and everything was prestige !

reviews.author: Aaron B
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Rafael is a great server and the food is delicious! The sushi is really good and the ambiance is nice with a very pleasant temperature. I would recommend the ceviche as well as the skewers. And I would recommend Paradisus in general!

reviews.author: Valentina G
reviews.title: The best time ever at Paradise Blue
reviews.text: I went to the festival Paradise Blue at Paradisus. And I have to say this was the best vacation I have ever taken. Especially with the help of my now friend Rafael Juarez! He made sure any questions or concerned were met, I had no worries the whole week knowing he was there! I would 100% be back next year thanks to him!

reviews.author: Joss Arriaga
reviews.title: Best Vacation
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful and the staff is very friendly and always making sure you have everything you need. Rafael Juarez part of the staff of the hotel went out of his way to make sure our stay was nothing but amazing. From the moment we checked in until we checked out, he made sure we had a great time, always checking in with us and providing us everything we needed. If you go there please ask for him and don’t forget to tip staff.

reviews.author: Maxine T
reviews.title: Amazing experience! Will definitely be back!
reviews.text: Orlando Bello and Atilano were extremely friendly and helpful. We had no issues with any of the staff. The experience was smooth the whole 5 days we were here. We are extremely grateful for this experience at Paradisus Cancun!!

reviews.author: Andrea V
reviews.title: Paradise blue
reviews.text:
Que magnifica atención de los empleados que estaban en el bar en la playa 🏖 fueron muy atentos y llevaron mis bebidas hasta con mis amigos ya que yo no podía
Espero que tengan un salario digno PORQUE SIN MANO OBRERA NO HAY RIQUEZA PARA LOS HOTELES 🏨 
Muchas gracias a todos

reviews.author: Lyndsay M
reviews.title: Was nice!
reviews.text: We were very much looking forward to an easy vacay and this hotel was super nice! Food was excellent, beach was amazing and the hotel cleanliness, layout and decor was awesome.  Reason for not leaving five stars was we paid more for VIP experience and there were never enough pool chairs, the service was hit or miss (although we loved Pedro, and Alberto). Would go back but not sure I’d pay for the upgraded experience.  Also note there is no disco on site and everything shuts down at midnight.

reviews.author: Sydney B
reviews.title: Bartenders
reviews.text: We came here for Paradise Blue music festival and went to one bar all weekend all for Esteban and Elisio they were so great to us the whole time and really made our experience even better, thank you to all the staff and everyone who helped make the weekend great! I will say though for the mass quantity of people for food please please cook everything through. A lot of people got sick because food wasn’t  cooked all the way through.

reviews.author: Ariane T
reviews.title: Lemon Fish,  Jorje Ramos
reviews.text: Very efficient and super nice waiter. Made us feel really comfortable and amazing food! Best of the best, I really loved it and had an amazing time. Can’t wait to come again thank you again Jorge. !!!

reviews.author: Amy H
reviews.title: Amazing resort
reviews.text: Absolutely loved this place so much. Would love to give a shout out to one of the bellhops Emil. He was so nice and helped us get into our room a little earlier so we didn't have to leave our bags somewhere.

reviews.author: Tristin H
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Alfredo, Alvaro, Manuel, Henry, Carlos, Francisco made this an amazing trip for me and my friends we can not wait to come back. The whole resort was awesome and respectful it was the best experience I have had.

reviews.author: Stephany Foster
reviews.title: Ignacio Vasquez
reviews.text: This employee made my stay here SO SPECIAL. For him, I will be back next year. I was treated with so much kindness and respect, no resort can compare to how perfect this stay was for us. Very grateful for this employee and hope to see him next year.Estoy muy feliz.

reviews.author: Morgan J
reviews.title: Paradise Blue
reviews.text: Can not thank or appreciate the staff here enough! Paradise Blue was an absolute dream and it wouldn’t have been the most spectacular experience without the incredible staff here. We had Ada for pool service and she was especially amazing!!!

reviews.author: Carlitos M
reviews.title: Restaurante Cappella El mejor
reviews.text:
Enserio, el servicio fue excelente. Nurstro mesero Fernando Santillan nos trajo un ambiente spectacular. Y la comida era bien dilicioso. Lo recomiendo a todos lo que visitan.

Seriously, best customer service I received. The ambience was relaxing and and the food was spot on. Our waiter, Fernando Santillan exceeded my expectations and definitely brought the mood to the scene. I 100% recommend this restaurant to anyone who visits.

reviews.author: Angel M
reviews.title: Restaurante Capella
reviews.text: Tuvimos una excelente experiencia. Mi mesero Fernando Santillan es excelente y da un buen ambiente. Siempre atentó y y da buenas recomendaciones en restaurante y todo cancun. 100% recomendado para todo que visitan.

reviews.author: Ethan H
reviews.title: Beach Bar with the swings
reviews.text: We met Balta when we came down to the bar with swings on the first night of Paradise Blue. He served us with speed and efficiency and quickly became a friend to us!! Balta recognized my friends and I every single day and made us feel at home at the Paradisus. He is the best, and we will be back to paradise!!

reviews.author: Alec
reviews.title: Balta is the man!
reviews.text: Balta, a worker at a bar in Paradisus Cancun, provided us with excellent service and kindness. He made this trip all that much better. And thank you Excision for throwing Paradise Blue! Go find Balta at the beach bar with the swings. He is the best!

reviews.author: Nicole Mangiapane
reviews.title: Thank you
reviews.text:
Great service!! Amazing employees. Very nice and helpful. Alfredo miron, rodrigo, and Martin were exceptional 

We have come here twice now and each time we leave very satisfied. Will be dining in again, soon.

reviews.author: Lauren W
reviews.title: Paradisus is Paradise!
reviews.text: Everything was amazing here, our breakfast buffet servers all week were fantastic - from Gaudencio on Tuesday, Martin on Wednesday, and the three musketeers on Thursday with Eddie, Pascual, and Didi - they kept our mimosas and coffee full and even offered a hangover cure that was very needed. We had an amazing vacation and will be back for more!

reviews.author: Sarah M
reviews.title: Amazing experience !
reviews.text: Violeta was an absolute pleasure. She made our trip so smooth and was very attentive to our needs. We were a large group and she made sure all of us were set up with our Covid tests, got us reservations for dinner every night, and checked in to make sure our trip was going well. So happy to have visited such a beautiful resort and enjoy the perks of being in the reserve.

reviews.author: Brianna M
reviews.title: Violeta was the best!
reviews.text: Such a wonderful experience with her. She made our stay so much easier and felt relaxing since she made all of our reservations. Super friendly and does her job very well. Exceeded my expectations! Would definitely recommend her to anyone else coming to Paradisus.

reviews.author: Shane R
reviews.title: Great service!
reviews.text: Food & drinks were amazing at the Japanese restaurant but the service was even better!  Thank you Alejandro Camelo!  Great suggestions and the after dinner coffee drink was so good!!  The atmosphere was pretty cool too!  Unlike any restaurant I’ve been to.

reviews.author: Samantha L
reviews.title: Girls trip
reviews.text: We loved our time at Paradisus Cancun. It was a girls trip & it couldn’t have been more perfect. The food was great, drinks were great and the service was amazing. My favorite part was the activities each day. Especially the silent party! Jesus from activities was my favorite - I had fun in his water aerobics class! He’s the best!

reviews.author: Raquel M
reviews.title: Jose de recepción es su mejor empleado
reviews.text:
Me instale dos veces en este hotel durante mi estancia en mexico. El hotel es una pasada pero lo que verdaderamente hizo que mi estancia fuera de diez fue Jose, quien me ayudó en un detalle que quería realizarle a unas amigas, me alegro el viaje.
Sin duda fue la persona más resolutiva con la que me encontré, un auténtico 10!

reviews.author: Taylor T
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Rafael is the best!!! 10/10 recommend him! He was super attentive to our needs, and gave great recommendations. He worked super hard to make our group of 11 happy, which is extremely hard to do! Thank you!

reviews.author: Parwani74
reviews.title: Paradisus Malvia buffer
reviews.text: The food is excellent, thanks to Samuel who took care during dinner, Rafael chef who made one of the best tandoori chicken especially for us and Rafael the host who was very accommodating. Don’t forget to tip these guys, they deserve.

reviews.author: Anson Z
reviews.title: Paradisus Stay
reviews.text: We stayed at paradisus for Spring Break and the service was great. We had a great stay and all the amenities were great. Joni, Atilano, Ramiro, Reynaldo, Teresa, and Randy from the buffet took very good care of us.

reviews.author: Maurisa S
reviews.title: Birthday trip
reviews.text:
Horrible is where I will start.
Check-in took forever. You have to reserve a spot to eat at restaurants. All of the food was mediocre, cold and very commercially made.  First room was horrible, old, holes and paints chipped on wall, bed leaned downward where the head rested. Woke up with extreme headache. Had to pay 500.00 to upgrade and was told we would get a personal bar and it was only beer.
Hotel was so damn hot and only relief u had was in your room.
Day of check-out they came 3 times in the morning asking when I would go check-out. But, during the stay only came around 2-3pm to clean room.
Toilet overflowed and they left water all over floor in bathroom and walkway and all over toilet seat. I had to sanitize and clean it myself.
I will never come here again.
This inclusive resort is a scam and joke
Maurisa

reviews.author: Tatiana F
reviews.title: Birthday celebration
reviews.text:
I celebrated my birthday at the hotel and the service was excellent  Diana and Berenice who were my event coordinators they were very attentive to all my questions and needs.
  All staff very friendly, and willing to help.  
100 percent recommended

reviews.author: julio d
reviews.title: Muy déspota el gerente RENE
reviews.text:
Fuimos 6 personas al club de playa, antes di ir marcamos para verificar el precio y nos dijeron que eran $4,900 por 6 personas con una botella de vino y un platillo incluido. 

Cuando llegamos no nos respetaron el precio y el gerente llamado RENÉ dijo- “que tontos, cómo va a costar eso, es imposible. Si fuera así yo invitaría a mis amigos siempre”. 
Burlándose de nosotros, confirmamos con la persona por teléfono y nos volvió a confirmar el precio de $4,900. 

Al final nos hicieron pagar $10,000 por todos porque ya habíamos hecho uso de la instalaciones y ya habíamos pedido bebidas. Y era el mínimo para el day pass. 

Aparte nos querían obligar a pagar una propina del 30% por un pésimo servicio y comida insípida 

NO RECOMIENDO ESTE LUGAR 

Espero que la gente encargada tome cartas en el asunto para que no vuelva a ocurrir esto con este gerente tan grosero

reviews.author: Yasiri N
reviews.title: Fernando the best
reviews.text: Fernando was the best server ever we had the entire trip, he was so attentive and very personable. DEFINITELY recommend going to agua marina in paradisus Cancun !! You won’t regret it, the steak was perfectly cooked and Fernando was on top of every need!

reviews.author: Lina A
reviews.title: Un maravilloso fin de semana con la mejor atencion
reviews.text:
Fue un excelente fin de semana . El hotel maravilloso la atención excelente . El staff siempre dispuesto ayudar , los cuartos muy cómodos y todas las áreas del hotel al aire libre tenían un excelente servicio, los restaurantes muy ricos 
Si planea tener unas vacaciones el paradisus hotel es una excelente elección.

reviews.author: Cristian F

Just one word… 
Outstanding 🤩

Great time , Better Crew and Outstanding Place

Ramiro

reviews.author: Jaymee B

reviews.author: Melissa D

reviews.text: Great food, great service. Thanks Cristian Sanchez for being so attentive. Really liked the tuna tacos and rolls. The desserts are not to be missed, especially the panna cotta. Gorgeous ambiance, of course.

reviews.author: selena l
reviews.title: I stayed at the Paradisus Cancun and it was beyond amazing!!
