Trip was a solid 10/10 🥰 I miss everyone so beyond much and I can’t wait to come back with gifts from Canada 😚🇨🇦😉

reviews.author: Mario M
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Excelente atención y servicio. Destaco la amabilidad y trato cordial del Sr Sánchez Cristian en el restaurante Lemon Fish. La recepción y servicio del Sr Fraga Rodrigo (sub cheff) así como también el trato jovial de su gerente directivo Mainor Espinoza. Todo el hotel y sus empleados se destacan por el servicio excepcional.

reviews.author: Gary H
reviews.title: Lemon Fish at Paradisus is Incredible
reviews.text: Had a phenomenal birthday dinner at Lemon Fish this week. Jorge Ramos and Miguel Villegas went above and beyond to make sure we were taken care of. Would come here every night if I could! Looking forward to our next visit.

reviews.author: Julie T
reviews.title: Pleasure vacation
reviews.text: Amed, Lazaro, Carlos, Javier WERE AMAZING!!!! Definitely need to come here!!! The beef and chorizo quesadillas were amazing!! The hot sauce and smiles from the staff didn't disappoint!! Definitely a MUST VISIT!!!! You won't be disappointed!! See you at Blue Agave!

reviews.author: Carlos L
reviews.title: Las mejores vacaciones
reviews.text: Excelente servicio y la mejor calidad en todo, las instalaciones de lujo con gusto volveria a venir, los empleados muy amables el Sr Amed y Paola de restauran son muy atentos y excepcionales en su ambito

reviews.author: HappinessS
reviews.title: DISAPPOINTING CELEBRATION FOR MY 30TH
reviews.text:
I had high hopes for this hotel because of the reputation (being part of the Melia hotel chain) and it really disappointed me. 

I was there to spend my 30th birthday which I stated in my notes when booking. Upon check in no consideration was made, they made no efforts to make me feel like it was my birthday. Other hotels of this calibre have done a lot more when I’ve noted a celebration. 

However, this wasn’t the main problem, the main problem is I travelled with my partner and we were given two separate beds. I informed the hotel about this as soon as we were shown our room and was literally told "trust me, I promise we will get this sorted straight away". 

We had just come
off a 12 hour flight so went for dinner , and in this time they said they would have it sorted (i.e. we would be in a new room with one bed). When we spoke to the hotel after no update, we were then told it would be sorted the next day as the hotel was fully booked for that night.

The next day came and I was told that the hotel was fully booked, again. 

The day after that I was shown a room in a lower class (which the hotel admitted after) which had two beds AGAIN!! This was very upsetting as on this night, it meant we were late for our dinner reservation for the Mexican restaurant in the hotel. The hotel concierge was made aware and promised they would let them know at restaurant that we would be late because we had outstanding issues to resolve. However when we arrived at the to dine, the manager and staff had no recollection of this, and it was made quite clear that he was doing us a favour if he were to seat us. We were told the restaurant closed at 11pm but when we got there he said it closed at 10pm (we arrived at approx 9.30pm).  Reluctantly with a bit of back and forth we were seated.

The jacuzzi on the balcony was not clean and dated, so we didn’t even use it. 

Our shower drain was blocked and flooded the bathroom. 

There was also a strong sewage smell coming from the bathroom which made the room smell unpleasant. Concierge were told - they said they would provide maintenance - nothing was done. 

The taco restaurant where we ate for lunch didn’t treat our stomachs well the next day either.

Overall: 

The hotel in itself is very nice however the rooms aren’t anything special. The stay at this hotel really did put a downer on the trip, a sad way to spend a birthday.

reviews.author: Mark G
reviews.title: I found the best staff
reviews.text: Orlando with the coffee, aleja in blue agave, and Didier in lunch box. Really appreciated them. Not everyone was helpful but those 3 were incredible. The food was ok and the location was great. Make sure you bring cash to tip people to ensure fast service.

reviews.author: Kristina G
reviews.title: Wonderful experience
reviews.text: Liliana in the Spa  was fantastic! She gave me a massage and was not only phenomenal...she was friendly and very knowledgeable! Highly recommend you visit her if you make it to the resort 👍 The facility was beautiful and clean also.........

reviews.author: Traveler1
reviews.title: Great hotel, amazing stuff!
reviews.text: We were group of 3 friends, we booked 3 nights and extended 1 night more because we had so much fun! The massage is amazing and also the spa facilities, the food is good, mainly the special restaurants. And the most important thing is the stuff, they are all very kind and smile all the time. A special thanks for Rossana the manager how helped us a lot. Strong recommendation!

reviews.author: Anna Z
reviews.title: Buffet
reviews.text: I came here on spring break with a few of my friends and was astonished by the great service provided by Samuel S and Martin! They were constantly very attentive and kind to us the entire trip, making sure we were always accommodated! The food was great, and had many different options for whatever you’re in the mood for! There is a reason we kept returning

reviews.author: Julia W
reviews.title: Beautiful place but service lacking, reserve rooms isn’t reserved.
reviews.text:
This resort has Beautiful grounds and very nice entertainment, but the staff I am not sure as I read all the service is excellent but my friend and I are not being treated like how I remember Cancun as. As soon as we arrived, we were escorted to pyramid 5, to check in with Reserve reception. As soon as we met with the receptionist he acknowledged we were there but we did not feel welcomed and he did not offer even water, I asked him can we please have something to drink because we just waited one  hour for our transfer from the airport, then he acknowledge that we can go to the lobby bar and get a drink and some snacks. Once we get back another person took over as it seems to has which shift, he was much nicer more from there and check us in pyramid 3which wasn’t even in the reserve section, so beware if you book the reserve does not mean you will be staying at reserve towers. We ended up in pyramid three with the spring breakers, the room is a standard room with no tub, and it just is on top floor and gives you access to reserve section.
We We’re told our concierge will contact us, no one has done that and we went down ourselves to make reservation for restaurants. We were told we can only eat in the buffet or the taco place as everywhere else is booked, and they manage to book a reservation the next day. 
I have been to cancun numerous times, I even have stayed in this place before when it was me Cancun, which I got very bad food poisoning. I just don’t see this place with standard five star hotel service, even if we stay at hotels in the area has warmer staff and better service. 
The food in the taco place and buffet is nothing special, buffet doesn’t have much selections, we try to go to the Japanese restaurant since it’s booked up for the rest of the trip, the lady at the front desk was very rude saying you can  wait till 730 reservation cancellation and just left us on the side, never came back and check on us. 8 comes, I go over there and ask her if there’s any cancellation because I see so many empty tables, she tells me these are for 8 o’clock reservation and you can wait another 30 minutes to see if there’s any cancellations. I’ve never experienced this kind of rudeness in Cancun, usually everyone is very accommodating and if they cannot get you in a restaurant they were suggest somewhere for you to eat. I am unsure if everyone is just having a bad day or We are being treated differently because we are a small minority group of 2.
I hope they can adjust how they work with the reserve rooms and clarify. I asked the staff is the rooms are the same they claim they are but I overheard the fifth tower has tubs and Jacuzzis. 
If you are willing to spend more money for a high standard resort this may not meet your standards.
And we have not met our concierge or anyone reached out to help us with anything.
 Everywhere you go seems like you’re bothering them.
Today will be day 2, and I really hope We can get better service.

reviews.author: Eugeniomira
reviews.title: Meliá Paradisus cancun
reviews.text:
La experiencia que hemos pasado en el Meliá Paradisus Cancún ha sido EXCELENTE gracias a tres personas del departamento de Guest Service : Daniel, Miguel y Rosanna y a Moisés de restaurante Santé y no nos olvidos de Maximiliano encargado la camas balinesas y al inolvidable Chef del restaurante Cielo.
También han habido múltiples profesionales anónimos   con mucha empatía hacia personas de nuestra edad.

 Hemos experimentado  el lado obscuro de las vacaciones con la encargada de marketing Marta que no cumplió sus compromisos con nosotros a pesar de hacerle repetidamente un seguimiento por nuestra parte.
 Eugenio Mira, Pilar Jorro y María José Linares 
Hbts 3344/3543

reviews.author: Jade D
reviews.title: Restaurant Malava
reviews.text:
THEY ARE THE BEST!
Orlando bello, Armando, Cristel and Alexis & Martin and Gaudencio were SOOOOO amazing! BEST service, best food, best vibes all around. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a safe, enjoyable  and relaxing get away in paradise, Restaurant Malva is the place to be. I felt very taken care of and they made the stay so much more lovely with their helpful demeanor, friendly attitudes and hard work to make sure I had a good time. 10/10 would come back again :)

reviews.author: Barb Frank
reviews.title: Customer service
reviews.text: A gentlemen at Paradisus guest services was so helpful printing our COVID verification documentation. The stay was amazing. We'll be back for a third time. Loved every minute. So relaxing and spring break for grown ups

reviews.author: Jessie K
reviews.title: Wonderful experience.
reviews.text: We visit Paradisus Cancun often but this trip stood out to us. Everyone was super friendly and welcoming. Gaudencio at the Malva breakfast Buffett made us feel super important every single morning. He always greeted us with a smile and positive attitude. He truly made each morning wonderful. Teresita at the Malva buffet was also a bright spot on our trip. She was always excited to see us and welcomed us to the buffet. We spent most of our days by the beach. Lux was our wonderful server who kept food and drinks coming. Jose always had our Bali bed ready for us in the morning. Elliot was also amazing, always so positive and helpful. The staff really was incredible, it was a tough week with spring break but they always remained positive. Overall this trip was one of the best. Thank you Paradisus Cancun for celebrating our Birthdays with us!

reviews.author: Haleigh A
reviews.title: Best spring break ever! -Thank you Orlando!!
reviews.text: Stayed here for spring break & had the best time ever! Everyone was accommodating & friendly. Especially our favorite bartender ORLANDO who made our vacation so memorable! He made our drinks so fast even though he was so busy and still had time to get to know us. Orlando if you’re reading this te amo mucho! Give this man a raise. Everyone was so friendly and welcoming I wish we could’ve stayed here foreverrrrr. Shoutout Augustin and Raul tambien. Thank you for the memories Paradisus!

reviews.author: Bev T
reviews.title: Fantastic service here!
reviews.text:
Atilano, Orlando Bello, Gaby at pool, the pool bartender!  Awesome service from all. So attentive! 
Had a great 3 days here with friends and colleagues. Recommend the Italian and seafood restaurants. Enjoy!

reviews.author: Sophia R
reviews.title: Lemonfish
reviews.text: Alejandro, Christian, and Hugo were the most amazing waiters ever. Best food in paradisus by far. Such a good experience and the restaurant is beautiful. Ate here two nights in a row and had the most amazing time.

reviews.author: Alayna Foley
reviews.title: Lemon fish visit
reviews.text: We love Christian and Alejandro. The best servers ever and we had the best time with them. They were so personable and kind and got us everything we needed. If you come to paridisus cancun you HAVE to come here. Even if you aren’t staying here you need to come

reviews.author: Cheran W
reviews.title: Awesome!
reviews.text: Janick was an excellent concierge for us! He was very attentive and checked in to make sure everything was okay. He reserved our Bali beds and made beach days hassle free. He also made all of our food reservations. We had a little miscommunication (my fault) so we had to move some reservations around and he was happy to do so and made it work. He makes dreams a reality! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Marie Paola S
reviews.title: Great food, great service!!
reviews.text: Went to Lunch box for dinner. Our server Juan Solis was great, very patient with us. It was such a busy night that night, Juan was sweating his ass off because of how busy it was. He apologized for not being able to take our order on time. But he made up for it at the end. The food was also really good 10/10 recommend coming here for dinner.

reviews.author: Cole K
reviews.title: Saúl
reviews.text: He is a great guy! He’s great at volleyball and lead the st Patrick’s day party well. We will remember Saul forever because he made the trip absolutely amazing. Thank you all for a great trip and cancun is great

reviews.author: Cathy D
reviews.title: Excellent service!
reviews.text: We just completed our spring break stay with our seniors Although we had some hiccups with room assignments and reservations for dinner, I have to say the staff at the pool bar and at the restaurants were amazing!!!! Gaby and Angel were fantastic - so friendly and helpful and very attentive!! They deserve a raise!!!!! The server Orlando in the breakfast buffet had our table waiting for us every morning with our hot tea and coffee ready! Thank you Gaby - we hope to see you next year!!

reviews.author: Fabiana M
reviews.title: Best service
reviews.text:
This is the 4th time I stay at Paradissus…what an amazing experience…concierge Juan was the best, making my friend’s bday so so special…from the moment we checked in, he made our stay the best…thank you Juan….
Diego and Maximilian at the pool were also very attentive. Thank you Paradissus for such an amazing stay…til next year

reviews.author: Jess
reviews.title: Kanna Beach Club!
reviews.text:
The staff at the Kanna Beach Club was amazing! First off you had a gentleman that bartended during the day. I didn’t get his name but he wore suspenders and has worked there for 21 years. He made incredible drinks! His fresh cucumber and jalapeño margarita was incredible!

The afternoon/night staff was so fun and friendly! Gotta give a shout out to Karina and Salvador! We were there for my good friends wedding. They made sure we had everything we needed from thw drinks, shots and can’t forget the hookah!

reviews.author: Zach M
reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.text: Extremely good food, in a beautiful location! Everyone at the resort is very friendly and accommodating. The food is all of good quality and tastes fantastic! Sushi is just what you need after a long day at the beach.

reviews.author: Dax Bordenaro
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: Galdino our reserve concierge made our experience smooth and relaxing. We spent our nights at kanna beach club where Salvador and Korinna took care of us with the amazing service and even better drinks. And can’t forget about Angel at the poolside bar.

reviews.author: simonscornik
reviews.title: Great food, great service
reviews.text: Our waiter Alejandro made our night. Super kind and brought us plenty of samples of sushi and other dishes so that we could celebrate our amigos 22nd bday. Great restaurant and host wish we could have stayed and talked to Alejandro and Christian all night.

reviews.author: Sydney S
reviews.title: Loved Capella at Paradisus Cancun!!!!
reviews.text: Our time spent at Capella was one of our favorites the entire trip! Our waiter, Luis Ayala, made this experience such a lighthearted and enjoyable one that we will not forget! Will for sure be back, 10/10!

reviews.author: C K
reviews.title: Fabulous experience
reviews.text: Paradisus was fantastic altogether. We had a wonderful dinner at Lemonfish, an intimate spot in the center of the lobby with outstanding and friendly service from Rafael. Looking forward to the next time!

reviews.author: Chris B
reviews.title: Best resort I’ve stayed at
reviews.text:
A group of 9 of us had an absolute blast at the Paradisus. By far the best resort I have ever stayed at. Rooms were great, hotel was very clean and the staff we’re always incredible all over the resort

Diana, the groups event planner, was fantastic at checking in to make sure all our reservations and everything went smoothly. Angela was also very helpful in booking our golf out front and making some last minute reservations 

Restaurants were all 10/10 from Blue Agave to Cielo to Lemon fish in the middle. Blue agave had some of the best tacos I’ve ever had. For our large group, each restaurant was able to do a really good spread . We unfortunately didn’t catch many of the servers names but each one was exceptional 

During the day the resort had a great pool bar ( shoutout to Orlando one of the bartenders), volley ball to play, golf at the front of the resort and tons of seats to post up at. At night they had several cool activities - an amazing live band in the bar upstairs, a silent disco one night and some great beach bars where you could rent a hookah in a large booth

Overall an amazing stay and by far the best resort I have stayed at .

reviews.author: Anastasia M
reviews.title: Beautiful vacation!
reviews.text: Paradisus is pure paradise! The staff, food and facilities are outstanding! Norma at check-in, Wen and Fabiola in Guest Services, all concierge staff, Alfredo, Joni and all breakfast staff, Salvador and Karina, Luis and all pool staff, all housekeeping staff and all lunch/dinner restaurant staff have been amazing. If I’m forgetting names, I’m sorry! There are so many staff members to mention by name, because all of the staff are professional, courteous, helpful, hard working and kind. I would absolutely come back to the Paradisus! All you have to do here is relax and enjoy!

reviews.author: Deb S
reviews.title: Debbie S.
reviews.text: Oh Paradisus Cancun lived up to its name! Absolute paradise and some of the nicest people! From Antonio who checked us in and ensured we had an appointment for our massages, to our lovely concierge Violeta and our host at the poolside Maximilian who helped us reserve Bali beds and ensured our time by the pool and ocean was superb! Our waiters at all the restaurants and the buffet were so friendly, professional and attentive!! Armando and Alejandro at the Malva buffet, Carlos at Cielo, Alejandro at Lemon Fish, oh and Moises at the Reserve who helped us enjoy some fabulous surf and turf. Dame was my masseuse for the cocoon body treatment, her hands and touch were magic, the scrub was so refreshing and relaxing, my skin was super soft and smooth! Throughout every day, our room was cleaned spotless and every wish provided for by the cleaning and room service staff. Top notch! And I can’t say enough about Mars at Aquaworld! I had never been snorkeling in the sea, so he helped lead me around and keep me safe while holding onto a life preserver with my life jacket on! I got to see all the coral, fish and underwater statues up close and personal with his expert guidance! And the driver and boat staff for the parasailing were wonderful too! This was a vacation to remember, thank you to Paradisus and their supremo staff!

reviews.author: Eliseu S
reviews.title: O melhor atendimento de Cancún
reviews.text:
Passar férias no Paradisus de Cancún vai além de viver bons momentos, Paradisus é um lugar de fazer amigos! O melhor do México são os mexicanos, um povo carinhoso, gentil e prestativo!!! 
Muito obrigado aos amigos;
Javier Jimenez
Carlos Chay
Victor
Maximiliano (Máxi)
Alejandro
Diego
Denise
Cesar
Joel
Miguel
Norma
Alfredo
Rubens
Valeria

Muchas Gracias!!!

reviews.author: Joe DaSilva
reviews.title: Excelentes vaccaciones
reviews.text: Atendimento excelente, muito simpaticos e atenciosos. Javier Jimenes , juntamente com Carlos Chai, del restaurante Capella, Alexandro Cop, Cesar, Miguel, Diego, Joel, Rubens, Denise, Teresa, Norma, Victor, todos parecendo amigos de longa data. Impossivel lembrar de todos. Volveremos a ka, con certesa!!!

reviews.author: Eli
reviews.title: Lunch Box
reviews.text: Es mi segunda vez y repetí en virtud que cambiaron la carta, me sorprendió, interesante los agregados de sabores autóctonos mexicanos, nos recibió Salma muy simpática y agradable, excelentemente atendidas por Juan durante toda la estadía y supervisión de Guillermo todos ellos 100% recomendables, volveré!!!

reviews.author: Leidy G
reviews.title: Servicio
reviews.text: Me ha parecido el mejor servicio en  malva pm todo, cómida instalaciones atención lo recomendaría 🥳 la atención de Liliana Garcia Verónica Mendoza Daniel  nos ofreció un tequila súper muy recomendado Mejia Rafael

reviews.author: Rong G
reviews.title: Excellent guest service in Paradisus Cancún
reviews.text: Thank you so much Wen who helped me a lot as the personnel in guest service! When I have trouble or questions during my stay in Cancún, she always responded me as soon as she can! Thank you again, for this excellent experience!

reviews.author: Ahna P
reviews.title: The Reserve is worth it!
reviews.text: If you are traveling with no children, upgrading to the reserve is worth it.  Concierge services, adult pool, and great food!  Oscar is an amazing poolside server, who is very attentive.  The sunset cocktail class was also fun!  Also a shout out to Max who works hard to oversee all the Bali beds.

reviews.author: Mike W
reviews.title: Friends Trip
reviews.text: We had a friends trip the last week of February. For the most part everything was awesome. The rooms were kind of dark and our fridge was in the middle of the floor but they were very clean and spacious. The restaurants were very good and the food was delicious. Guadencio (he told us to call him Mr. G) was a great entertainer. Him and the other staff on the patio at the buffet never left our drinks empty. We also rented pool Cabanas for 2 days, which is definitely worth it. We had the absolute pleasure of having Victor Rodriguez assist us not only for our cabana days but also the 2 restaurants we ate at later those nights. All of the staff were wonderful and friendly.

reviews.author: Nora B
reviews.title: Zona The Reserve
reviews.text: SANTE, el resto en playa en zona exclusiva para The Reserve es recomendable, fuimos atendidas por Rubén en el mismo almorzamos muy rico la pesca del día, tragos aceptables, vista espectacular. En playa por Joel y Yamil, ambos muy atentos y amables excelentes y súper simpáticos, la playa 100 recomendable

reviews.author: 662micaelc
reviews.title: The best service and buffet
reviews.text:
Atilano and hes crew of server gave a service as good as we receive back home would recommend!! Everybody is smiling and courteous, you are really taking care of!
You feel like your are important to everybody

reviews.author: Kim A
reviews.title: Paradisus cancun
reviews.text: On a passer une semaine incroyable ici, la nourriture est excellente le service est impeccable. On a créer des liens fort avec les employées! La vue est magnifique et l’hôtel aussi! Tout est très bien entretenu et très propre, merci à tout l’équipe pour ce séjour

reviews.author: EJ792013
reviews.title: Unas vacaciones inmejorables
reviews.text:
Hemos disfrutado 8 noches inolvidables en este hotel maravilloso. Las instalaciones son increíbles, la comida súper variada y abundante. Los restaurantes temáticos un gran acierto. Tanto la ubicación, accesos y comodidad del hotel son dignos de mención. 
Pero sobre todo lo que queremos destacar es el esmerado y superlativo trato que nos han dado a nosotros y por lo que hemos visto a lo demás huéspedes del hotel,  todo el equipo humano del establecimiento. 

En primer lugar y sin ella no hubieran sido unas vacaciones tan increíbles, con mucho cariño queremos mencionar a Rossanna la Guest Service Manager. Una persona, bellísima con gran talento y ha ganado nuestra corazón

Queremos dar nuestras infinitas gracias a todo el equipo del zona del restaurante Sante, liderada por Diego.
No nos olvidaremos nunca de su maravilloso equipo:
Rubén, Valeria, Luis, Moisés, Javier, Joel, Miguel, Yamil, César, Eligió, Oscar, Lorena, José, Julio.

Aún se nos hace la boca agua recordando los excelentes platos del chef de Sante, Alex.

La atención, cordialidad y simpatía de los pool concierge Maxilmiliano y Lucas no tienen precio.

No queremos olvidarnos de algunos miembros más del equipo de restauración del hotel como Edier y Alejandro del Nespresso, Jonathan y Fernando del restaurante italiano, Angel del Blue Agave, Teresita del buffet, Wendy del Ginger.

Hemos pasado muy buenos momentos con  las actividades proporcionadas por Jennifer, un amor de mujer, y por el Mago Fer.

El trato de Raúl en la entrada del hotel consiguiendonos con gran celeridad y simpatía los taxis o la amabilidad de Wendoline de Special Moments caben ser destacadas en puesto enorme en nuestra memoria. 
 
Gracias a Galdino, nuestro concierge, a Luis del Guest service por todo su apoyo, Alexis del The Reserve...

Volveremos muy pronto y milgracias por todo!

reviews.author: Joanna V.
reviews.title: Cappella Restaurante
reviews.text: Comí en Capella en Paradisus Cancún y el servicio y la comida fueron excelentes. Javier Jiménez, mi servidor, y su capitán, Carlos Chay, fueron muy atentos y agradables. Recomiendo encarecidamente Cappella!

reviews.author: Natalia B
reviews.title: ESTANCIA PERFECTA! 💖
reviews.text:
Han sido 8 días inolvidables!! El lugar como bien dice el nombre, es el PARAISO. Lo que más destaca de este lugar sin duda, es su personal. A la llegada, nos atendió Raúl con esa simpatía que tanto le caracteriza y muy amablemente nos guardo el equipaje hasta tener la habitación. Fuimos a hacer el check in y nos atendió Alberto de recepción, muy amable y profesional. Galdino, muy correcto, nos ayudo con todo lo que necesitábamos en nuestra estancia reservas de restaurante, información etc.. Cada mañana ibamos a la Nespresso a por un cortado, nos atendió Edier y Alejandro, especial mención a Edier, increíblemente atento, simpático y gentil. El desayuno es fantástico, en la puerta encontrabas a Teresita, un amor, había tanto para elegir en el desayuno que simplemente querías comerlo todo!  Los chicos que se encargan de las camas balinesas Maxi y Lucas son lo más! Siempre con una sonrisa (se le notaba por los ojos, ya que llevaban la mascarilla en todo momento).  Una vez en la piscina, nos atendía nuestro querido Cesar, tan atento..  Mencionar también a Miguel, Eddie, Joel.. Diego, el encargado del equipo Santé darte la enhorabuena por ese equipazo que es como una familia, al Chef Alex! Por deleitarnos con su magnífica cocina casera típica Mexicana. Como no, nuestra Jennifer que nos entretenía pintando bolsos, sombreros y nos contó esa impactante historia sobre el Ojo de Dios, me encantó! Ángel del restaurante Cielo es un encanto. Carlos, Jonathan y Fernando del restaurante italiano Capella fueron muy atentos y simpáticos. Wendy, que preparaba unos margaritas que quitaban el sentido! Riquísimos! El mago Fer fue toda una sorpresa, impresionantes sus trucos de magia. Luis, el guest experience Cubano tan cercano. Wendolyn, no se puede ser tan cariñosa, nos derretimos contigo, te vimos el día que nos tuvimos que marchar y nos robaste un pedacito del corazón.
Rossana, mil gracias por tu amabilidad, simpatía, trato tan personalizado, no dejaste escapar nada! 
Equipo Paradisus Cancún, mil gracias por hacerme sentir en una burbuja, por haber entregado tanto, por vuestra personalidad, se me ha quedado un trozo de corazón ahí con vosotros. Espero poder volver y veros de nuevo. MI MAS SINCERA ENHORABUENA A TODOS!! 👏 💖

reviews.author: emilc629
reviews.title: Excelencia y Servicio: unas vacaciones increíbles y un personal magnífico! Deseando volver!
reviews.text:
Magnífico Hotel: nos sentimos como en casa.
El mejor staff: atención y excelencia al máximo nivel.
A nuestra llegada Raul nos atendió de maravilla.
Jennifer de actividades nos hizo amenas las mañanas de Bali Bed con su programa de actividades.
El mago Fer nos resultó supremo!
Edier y Alejandro de Nespresso con una gran sonrisa nos prepararon los mejores cafés.
Rossana de Atencion al cliente en The Reserve: la sonrisa del Hotel: enhorabuena a esta gran profesional que estuvo pendiente de todo! Mención especial también a Luís, de su equipo.
Alejandro de Recepción nos atendió en el check in y nos dio unos tips geniales para el viaje.
Galdino, nuestro butler, se encargó de que todo fuera perfecto!
Alex y su equipo de Cocina de Sante: chapeau!!!
El equipo de F&B es de otro planeta: serviciales, amables, hospitalarios y grandes profesionales:
Empezando por Diego (Director de F&B), siguiendo por Joel, Wendy, Cesar y Miguel en Sante y la zona de piscina de the Reserve.
Teresita: fantástica siempre a nuestra llegada a Malva y Sante. Fernando, Jonathan y Carlos en Capella. Angel quien nos sirvió los mejores tacos.
Max y Lucas, los pool Concierge cuidaron de nuestro comfort y comodidad: inmejorables.
Y Güendolin de Premium Moments nos trató como si fuéramos de la familia.

Mil gracias por todo, prometemos volver!!!

reviews.author: Zach A
reviews.title: Visited
reviews.text: The atmosphere is perfecto. We had the mussels and calamari for an appetizer and the shrimp pasta for the main course. The house wine was very good and the food was fantastic and service was better! (Fernando)

reviews.author: Jordan Leh
reviews.title: Visted
reviews.text:
Great food! Grear atmosphere! Great service! Fernando did a great job answering our questions about the menu.

Favorites were the mussels and the octopus salad and ALL the deserts. 

Definitely a place to he sure to eat during your stay at Paradisus.

reviews.author: Ashley B
reviews.title: Kanna Beach Club
reviews.text: Salvador and Karina have this great bar spot down. We came here probably 3-4 times during our stay and it was definitely a mainstay of our trip. Great people and great service coupled with amazing views. Thanks!

reviews.author: Manu C
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancún café
reviews.text:
Great service! All guys are amazing with a great service and good actitud. The food is good! Different types of food. The coffee is good 👍🏼 😎 
Gracias Edier Cab y Manuel Delezma por el servicio y su atención!

reviews.author: CesarC
reviews.title: Staying at The Reserve
reviews.text: Have stayed here a few times. It never disappoints. Staying at The Reserve this week. Service great, as usual. The hotel isn’t super packed, which is nice, and they’ve made some improvements to the property. Shout out to Antonio, at the Reception desk in Pyramid 5 in The Reserve — he has been Uber kind and very welcoming!

reviews.author: Florencia P
reviews.title: Lemonfish
reviews.text: Cristian sanchez como garzon un excelente servicio. Buena comida , atención y disposición.  Divertido amable y muy auténtico.  Muy buena orientación en cuanto al tequila y comidas.!!!!!! Me sorprendió con la sugerencias de los platos, más con los juegos tipos de gin, sobretodo el de fruta que es muy delicioso

reviews.author: Tomás V
reviews.title: Buena atención lemon fish
reviews.text: Muy buena atención y buena onda. Pasamos un muy buen momento con Cristian, hizo agradable la comida, nos siguió la comida perfecta y el postre estuvo tremendo. Muy recomendable para todos los que vengan.

reviews.author: Los N
reviews.title: Vacaciones en grupo de amigos y familia
reviews.text:
Todo excelente, el hotel un lujo la atencion y las instalaciones. Comida variada y muy buena, la atencion de Samuel y Angel en la piscina de primera, y Alan en el desayunador teniendo comensales con celiaquia, todos los dias se ocupo de tener los alimentos adecuados.
Para mejorar, los turnos de comida deberían extenderse un poco mas de las 23 hs. Lo mismo los bares que estan hasta las 24 hs. Entiendo también que deben ser epocas de pandemia.

reviews.author: Geoff B
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: Working with Fabiola at guest services was a pleasure. She was very helpful and knew exactly what I needed! She was very attentive and mindful of my vacation time and got me on my way very quickly!!!!

reviews.author: alexlorena
reviews.title: Perfect location, friendly staff, effortless relaxation!
reviews.text:
My first time visiting any resort and it won’t be my last after the wonderful experience that I had at Paradisus Cancun. 

Shout out to the amazing staff who were hospitable, entertaining, and some of the hardest working people that I’ve ever met. 

Edier and Alejandro served up some delicious coffee and remembered our orders each time we stopped by. 

Saúl led some motivating fitness classes of all different types and made an effort to invite us and inform us whenever we crossed paths. 

Melissa provided us with excellent drink service while we enjoyed some live music by an incredibly talented trio of entertainers at the Ginger Bar. 

Ángeles gave a relaxing massage and body scrub at the Yhi Spa, which has all the perks you could hope for in your spa experience. 

And our friend Elliot at the pool took time to have great conversations with us about Mexico’s culture and offered some fantastic recommendations for places to visit. 

Our rooms were kept immaculate by the house keeping staff and I was impressed by the grounds staff constant maintenance throughout the resort to keep it presentable and functional for it’s guests. 

Overall, Paradisus checked all the boxes that I was hoping for during my vacation and I am so incredibly grateful for the experience.

reviews.author: betha c
reviews.title: Huésped Feliz
reviews.text: Fan número 1 de la cadena. Amo Paradisus Cancún! Me siento como en casa cada vez que voy al hotel. Especialmente Gracias a Rossana y Cynthia por la excelente ATENCION en cada estadía. Espero vernos pronto.

reviews.author: Vinicio H
reviews.title: Increíble servicio y estancia
reviews.text: Excelente el servicio en el hotel y en The Reserve. Excelente atención de Steph y Alexis como encargados de Recepción. El equipo de Recepción de Thé Reserve super bien. Violeta, como Concierge increíble servicio. En general la atención de todos los colaboradores excelente. Gracias.

reviews.author: Jose Luis S
reviews.title: Cancún 2022
reviews.text:
Buenísima atención, me voy con una hermosa experiencia.
Cristel y Martin del restaurante malva

Buena atención del personal, la cena en cielo fue expectacular para mí y todos mis amigos, el servicio de limpieza rapidísimo.

reviews.author: daniel v
reviews.title: Buena visita, amabilidad del personal
reviews.text:
En general muy bien, la atención en los restoranes, especialmente a Eddie, Arturo, martin, didier… en la playa a gaby, flor y dania…. Muta amables y simpáticos…..
Buena variedad de comida y licores (excepto por el perol spritz, que para ser un trago muy común, no tenían).

reviews.author: Roupen B
reviews.title: Wedding Party trip
reviews.text: We had an amazing time on our visit to Cancun! Many of the staff at Paradisus did a fantastic job at helping us relax and enjoy every possible luxury.  We especially appreciated Juan, our personal concierge, who went above and beyond to make recommendations and provide service throughout our entire stay for a most enjoyable trip.  The pool concierge, Max, was very attentive and always happy.  Our waiters at the reserve, Yamil and Rubin, were professional, creative and made it fun. Everyone went above and beyond to give us a luxurious, relaxing and wonderful stay.

reviews.author: Bonzarelli50
reviews.title: A definite destination in Cancun.
reviews.text:
2nd time there, wonderful rooms, wonderful Reserve section for pool.. the restaurants had changed all their menus, not really for the better.
The resort was spotless. Masks as required. Staff amazingly accommodating..
Our concierge Violetta is so very wonderful. Always there when u need her, checking in with us on her days off, making sure we had everything we wanted.We had Violetta inApril when we were there. No one like her . Paradisus is so very lucky to have her. 
Made dinner reservations for us everyday we wanted them. Even made outside restaurant reservations at our request
Max & Lucas at the Reserve pool made sure our balley beds were made up when needed. Max even helped me schedule a tattoo that I requested be done in Cancun.
David was helpful in booking massages. 
The other pool staff for drinks were terrific.
There really are not enough words to describe how wonderful the staff there is. They only want to make your stay the best it can be.

reviews.author: Ava Clenney
reviews.title: Guest services.
reviews.text:
Rosanna and When Warner went beyond what was expected in handling our issues and questions making our vacation most enjoyable. We will return because of them. 
Flor and Gabby were our our beach services help and we’re fantastic

reviews.author: Ariel P
reviews.title: Amazing & relaxing time at Paradisus
reviews.text: I was in Paradisus Cancun For 5 nights with family and friends. Our stay was a stellar experience. The delicious drinks kept flowing and the restaurants were very delicious, clean and the staffing super friendly. Our favorite restaurant was Lemon Fish. We had the best waiter, Cristian Sanchez, who treat us so wonderful and took care of us. He showed us all the food options and made our stay special that we came back a second time. We also rented a cabana for the day. Rene took wonderful care of us there and Coco’s beach club. The hotel is aesthetically pleasing and makes you feel like Royal. The staff was amazing. Muchas gracias Cristian por haber hecho la cenas muy special para nosotros! Fue un verdadero placer!  -Ariel

reviews.author: Bibiana P
reviews.title: Best Vacation Ever!
reviews.text: I had an amazing vacation at Paradisus. My room was clean and cozy. The food at all the restaurants was beyond my expectations. The hotel is beautiful inside. My favorite restaurant was Lemon Fish. The food is amazing. Also, the customer service was the best. Everyone was friendly and very helpful whenever we needed it something. If you ever vacation at Paradisus and dine at Lemon Fish ask for Christian Sanchez… he is absolutely the best in customer service. Also, Veronica was amazing at helping us plan day to day activities and restaurant reservations.

reviews.author: Mario G
reviews.title: AMAZING EXPERIENCE!!!
reviews.text: The service is awesome!! Special thanks to Renee at the beach club and Christian Sanchez at Lemon Fish. So attentive and keep us smiling! The views and the beach are stunning. This is my second time here and I’ll definitely be returning!! The food is unforgettable and the staff are awesome!

reviews.author: Cristinaeto
reviews.title: The lunch box
reviews.text: No puedes faltan a the lunch bóx, comida peruana fusión, comida increíble y excelente atención, meseros muy amables con toda la disposición de atender y complacer todas tus necesidad, los postres increíbles. Sin dudas nos repetiremos este lugar más de una noche

reviews.author: Ikenna I
reviews.title: Vibez
reviews.text: I was here back in August and had an amazing time. We between all the different activities they had in and out of the water and all the food choices my friends and I had a blast. In fact it was so fun we had to do it again and the vibez were on point once again!

reviews.author: Stevie Jo
reviews.title: Best service!!
reviews.text: Everyone is so friendly and helpful! Joni, Atilano, Wendy, they are the best and very fun! The lost and found was very helpful to find some shoes that we thought were stolen. The food is very delicious and the views are incredible!

reviews.author: Rachel M Pruitt
reviews.title: Amazing dinner for two!!!
reviews.text:
Ian y Melvin we’re amazing hosts. They were attentive and delivered everything we asked. The drinks were amazing (Don Juan paired with dessert - don’t miss it!)

We got a sampler of appetizers to start, followed by the octopus and then the lamb tacos with beans and then one of each dessert - tres leches (best I’ve ever had), churro with chocolate ice cream, and a chocolate cake!! 

A 5 star experience with perfect service (not intrusive but always available) and food to delight!!! Don’t miss Cielo when you come to cancun!!!

reviews.author: Pedro V
reviews.title: Hotelzao
reviews.text: Estrutura sensacional, local extremamente organizado e sem falar na limpeza sensacional. Restaurante Blue Agave e o bar Ginger são os melhores locais de todo hotel. No Blue Agave os atendentes são extremamente atenciosos, destaque para Lazaro e para Paola, muy guapa. Em Ginger o destaque vai para Melissa, também muy guapa e atenciosa. Pode jogar bilhar e beber tranquilamente enquanto assiste seu jogo preferido de basquete ou futebol.

reviews.author: Lynn P
reviews.title: Staff is excellent
reviews.text: This was our second time visiting Melia Paradisus Cancun and it was just as amazing as the first time. Pascual and Alejandro (Alex) from Malva Good Bazaar , Sofonia from Ginger Bar, Sergio from the main poolside are our favorites!! The resort amenities are clean and kept up really well.  The food is amazing! Definitely quickly becoming one of our favorite resorts!!

reviews.author: Tim W
reviews.title: Best Al Pastor Tacos ever
reviews.text: Thank you Lazaro Anibal David Javier for the amazing food. Had the Al Pastor tacos at Blueagave taco bar at Paradisus Luxury Resort. Had lunch with my wife and best friends Jeremy and Stacy Foresee. We will eat there again.

reviews.author: Felipe A
reviews.title: Experiencia fantastica
reviews.text:
Muito bom!
Otimo atendimento, dança, bebidas, animação, ambiente agradável, ótimos momentos.
Sr. Agustin muito atencioso!
Bebidas muito bem feitas e tudo me agradou.
Tambem gostei muito do espaco, vários restaurantes. 
Voltarei co. Certeza

reviews.author: Anthony S
reviews.title: We will be back!
reviews.text: Great people! Great time! Axcel was one of the many excellent people that made our trip wonderful. They could not be any nicer to us. My wife has food allergies. They asked, listened and prepared meals without hesitation for her. Once there we asked about upgrading our room. Got a gorgeous newly renovated room . Well worth the money. Made our stay that much nicer. Highly recommend this place if not for the abundance of food & alcohol but for the workers that really makes the difference between a  good and a great time.

reviews.author: Taylor L
reviews.title: Lunchbox
reviews.text: THE BEST FOOD!!! Mouth watering shrimp and tuna!!! Angel is accommodating and tells you all his favorites! I would def recommend this place when staying at Paradisus, I honestly might stop back before I leave

reviews.author: Samanta P
reviews.title: Un oasis en medio de un hotel!
reviews.text: Lemon Fish es el restaurante en el centro del hotel. Una fusión peruana y japonesa. Todo muy rico y esta incluido en el all inclusive. El ambiente es muy acogedor y no parece que estes en un hotel. Especial mención a Rafael!! Super amigable y servicial!!

reviews.author: Houston C
reviews.title: Friend Trip
reviews.text:
Great service all around. Perfect experience.
Oscar at the pool was fantastic. Was alway on top of providing drinks and food in a timely manner.
Juan the concierge helped us in many ways make our trip perfect.

reviews.author: Nomad769648
reviews.title: Best group visit!
reviews.text: We had the most incredible trip with our group of friends! The facility was gorgeous and food delicious! Maximilliano helped us get the best Bali beds at the reserve pool. Oscar, Moses, and Yaxmil were incredible waiters at the reserve pool throughout our trip and were the most accommodating! Juan did a great job as our group concierge. Overall this was a fantastic experience and our only complaint was that we couldn’t stay longer! Cannot wait to come back!

reviews.author: JEF
reviews.title: Huge complex with ok food.
reviews.text:
The hotel is nice.  The food is basically the same in all restaurants. Power was out from 9:30am to 7:30pm Sunday.  No elevators working.  We were on the 7th floor.  
This was all inclusive but  some wines were an extra charge.  Be careful if you have fish allergies in the Lemon Tree.

reviews.author: Noemi O
reviews.title: Vaccaciones relajante!
reviews.text: Didier en el restaurante Malva fue excelente!! Siempre atentivo, con una sonrisa! Le recomendamos ir a Malva y visitar a Didier! El restaurant estava bien limpio! Todos bien amables! Comida delisiosa!! Regresarios por el servicio de Didi!

reviews.author: Mitchell B
reviews.title: Mr Mitchell Bryk
reviews.text: The waitstaff went above and beyond with every meal. Building personal relationships means the world when traveling. 100/10 experience, Pascual Y Alfredo thank you so much for your outstanding hospitality!

reviews.author: Joyce S
reviews.title: Fun in cancun
reviews.text:
Juan was very friendly
He wa
s alot of fun and very pleasant.

Axcel was alot of fun and made our trip extra special  he shared information with us and always spoke whenever he saw us .made us feel at home

reviews.author: Michael D
reviews.title: The Reserve is a must!
reviews.text:
Great experience! Juan in the Reserve was great! Highly recommend staying in The Reserve section. Juan booked our dinner reservations, got snacks and was there for any of our requests. The spa was great. Pool is huge and quiet. Food is great! The Italian restaurant was our favorite. We did not book any excursions but we could have as they offered them several times. Beach is kind of small, but still beautiful.

Staying in The Reserve we got a comply Bali Bed everday!

reviews.author: Amanda R
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: The staff is so amazing and helpful here, but, especially Daniel Mis and Rosana in Guest Services. Daniel was kind, caring, sympathetic and extremely helpful. Even on his day off, he made sure to help and address any concerns or questions we had. He truly  goes above and beyond to deliver amazing service. Highly recommend this hotel for your stay as they will make sure you are happy and comfortable at all times!

reviews.author: Sophia F
reviews.title: Great service and fun times!
reviews.text: Servicio Espectacular!!! Bernardo, Orlando and every single server we had were amazing! Don't think twice to visit Paradisus Cancun! Food was delicious everywhere we ate and rooms were comfy. More than anything - amazing service.

reviews.author: maria s
reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text:
Resort was beautiful, very clean. 
Room was beautiful with great view. 
The Buffet was outrageously delicious.. everyday breakfast lunch and dinner they was such a great assortment of food fresh warm.  Such a great variety of food.. 
The bar khana was a nice touch. The view of the ocean was breath taking.. the service was great.. Katrina and Manuel were great.. pleasant. 
Ginger bar where all the entertainment was held was nice.. again the bartenders were awesome!!! Wendy was amazing…. She is definitely a huge + at that bar… quick, pleasant, such a sweetheart…

Things that would have been nice to have was some Latin music, Mexican singers.

reviews.author: fantini_jr
reviews.title: Hotel lindo, limpo, cheiroso mas com poucas atrações, divertimentos noturnos e pouca estrutura de praia.
reviews.text: Passei o reveillon com esposa e amigos no hotel,  hotel lindo maravilhoso, limpeza e paisagem nota 10, agora se tratando de animação, estrutura de praia, diversão noturna é muito fraco de verdade, quem quer curtir as férias esquece Paradisus, agora quem quer descansar 100% pode se hospedar!

reviews.author: Liam C
reviews.title: The best experience
reviews.text: This hotel is awesome. Specially Fabiola; Angela and Wen Wagner. They assistme and now I know what I want to do in Tulum!! Thanks girls!!! The food is delicious. All the staff is very happy. Definitely I will come back here!!!

reviews.author: Victoria G
reviews.title: Wonderful Staff
reviews.text: The staff is just excellent! Dider, Raul, gaudencio and Alejandro treated me like royalty everytime I asked them for anything! Hard working staff! This hotel/experience was worth every single bit of the money. I will be returning very soon!!!

reviews.author: TravelBug_YYZ
reviews.title: Impressive property but disappointing food experience
reviews.text:
Pros:
- Amazing location right on the beach
- Beautiful  pools, very clean, nice cabanas
- Clean rooms and all buildings are nice and clean
- Very helpful and friendly staff
- Nice breakfast, lunch and dinner buffet restaurant Lunch Box. This place was our saving grace during the trip
- Average seafood restaurant Enso
- Average taco place  Blue Agave

Cons:
- Food at all restaurants was bad bad bad taste wise. I really wonder who is approving this food in this nice resort 
- Extremely disappointed with food overall. And we were group of 5 who have travelled the world and experienced food around the world so we know what great food is like. Food at Paradisus is underwhelming.
- We had booked Jr Suite but given mediocre room upon checkin in main building 3 which is noisy and under renovation. We were asked to pay 700 USD for room upgrade and this was on top of expensive price we paid while booking. Not a pleasant experience to pay more to get decent room
- Evening/Night activities limited. Nothing impressive as such or even good enough to have fun evening. The entertainment room in building 3 is very small. Can barely host all the people
- Only 1 billiards table and 1 foosball table for such a big resort resulting in long wait times to play at the table in the evening

Overall quite disappointing experience. Very unlikely to repeat in future.

reviews.author: Alejandra Michele
reviews.title: Waste of time and money
reviews.text: Don’t do it y’all. This resort is basically a D level cruise ship on dry land. It’s next to impossible to make dinner reservations (which are oddly required in order to eat?) - super inconvenient and defeats the purpose of ‘all inclusive.’ Maybe they are trying to do guests a favor bc the food is disgusting (even room service). Everything remotely worth your time is an up charge - also the vibe of the building is dated and corporate, and there are more kids than adults. The front desk staff are unhelpful for basic requests… they are generally nice but have no power to problem solve… there is legitimately no upside here.

reviews.author: zaietsaleks
reviews.title: Ничего особенного!
reviews.text:
Увы, но отель не стоит потраченных денег.
Отсутствие шезлонгов на пляже разочаровало полностью. 
The Reserve вообще не соответствует названию. Очень впечатлило разнообразие растительности в средине гостиницы.

reviews.author: Oana B
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun wedding and honeymoon
reviews.text: We had such an amazing experience for our wedding and stay at this hotel. Ana Juarez, our wedding coordinator was excellent, Candy our wedding decorator did an amazing job and also David our DJ kept our party going. We had almost 50 ppl and everyone had the best time ever. The hotel staff are very kind and helpful, the property is very clean and continuously maintained. We couldn’t brag more about this experience. Thank you again for such a wonderful time❤️

reviews.author: Gregory
reviews.title: Prime dining experience!
reviews.text: Chef prepared fantastic authentic Mexican cuisine. Reminded us of childhood memories of grandparents home Mexican cooking. Victor was very attentive in his service and assured all our needs for the meal were fulfilled. Highly recommend this restaurant. The entire staff were delightful in their service.

reviews.author: Travel Tony
reviews.title: Cappella Restaurant
reviews.text: This has been the best service we have received at this resort. Javier Nunez was the best server at this resort & we tried all of it. Thank you manager Carlos Chay for checking in on us. Amazing!!!!!!

reviews.author: Huong V
reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my stay at Paradisus, the hotel staff was very kind and helpful. There was a lot of fun activities such volleyball, water polo, tequila tasting, silk dancing, wine and canvas painting, ect. The activities staff (Mayra, Saul, and Augustine) was very nice and make the activities fun and more enjoyable.

reviews.author: Maria B
reviews.title: Ember Shores Weekend
reviews.text: Such an amazing resort. All employees were so accommodating and attentive. Asunción was the sweetest, she made sure we were taken care of the entire time at the pool, and always had a smile on her face. Juan at Lunchbox was on top of our table and made our experience the best for our reservation. If we ever went back to Cancun for just a nonfestival trip we would definitely stay here! Thank you Paradisus!

reviews.author: Gina V
reviews.title: Amateur
reviews.text: We had a phenomenal time during our stay at Paradisus Cancun, the staff was amazing and very attentive. Ignacio, Bernardo, Orlando & Mulva were especially welcoming for our dinning experience throughout our trip! Will come back because of the staff!

reviews.author: Diego S
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun was everything we could've asked for!
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus Cancun for a music event called Ember Shores. The resort was beautiful, the rooms were gorgeous, and the amenities were awesome. The best thing about the resort was definitely the staff. Martin and Guadencio (I think I wrote that wrong) at The Lunch Box buffet were amazing, and helped us with whatever we needed. Julio from the reserve bar/bar area was also extremely friendly. He made us feel welcome the minute we got there, and was so genuine. I'd definitely come back just to interact with the staff again. Overall, best time I've ever had.

reviews.author: Nick W
reviews.title: Ember Shores
reviews.text: I was there for a music festival and resort was beautiful, set up was very nice and reservation restaurants were unique with great food. I also went down every morning to the breakfast buffet (Malvo).. went straight to the friendliest, attentive, personable, hard working waiters ive ever met. Want to especially say thank you for their service and hospitality - Pascual and Alfredo (mosquito) first shift workers!!

reviews.author: James
reviews.title: Ember Shores Event
reviews.text:
I'm torn between 5 star and a 1 star, because the staff, location, and potential was amazing but the entire event (Ember Shores) was a sh!t show. Not sure who to blame, but my group and i wasted hours upon hours just on trying to get the right rooms, because our suites which we paid top $$$ for were all double booked. During the event, multiple restaurants were closed and required advanced reservations despite seats available.

Again, not very happy with the event, but the resort was amazing. Special shout-out to Fabiola who took the time to help me and each of my friends (12 total, 3 suites between us). We were getting the run around from everyone else, but she made an effort to resolve our problem when no one else did.

reviews.author: anthony b
reviews.title: Cielo Carlos birthday dinner
reviews.text: Amazing service. Carlos is the best server I have ever experienced in my entire life. It was so amazing that I brought my best friends here to experience the 5 star service that we received. Carlos should be taken care of. You should realize he is amazing for your business. He made my experience and I will come here years to come just from the Carlos experience at Cielo.

reviews.author: Lily R
reviews.title: Loveddd our stay here!
reviews.text: We stayed for a weekend for Ember Shores Festival. We had the best time here, the staff were all so kind and helpful. Breakfast was fire - shout out to Joni, Fernando & Anilto for always keeping our cups full.

reviews.author: Melanie S
reviews.title: Had a wonderful time at Ember Shore at the Paradisus!
reviews.text: Atilano and all the staff were wonderful during our stay for Ember Shores. There were a lot of people staying here for the festival and they were very accommodating. I would definitely come back for another event or just for a relaxing vacation. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: rhettduggan
reviews.title: First Time Visiting
reviews.text: Great resort for a getaway in cancun! The buffet offers all kinds of cheeses and meats that you wouldn’t expect for an all inclusive. I’d recommend visiting if you’re younger and looking to meet new people. English was great all around the resort, everyone understood us very well. If you go to the buffet make sure to tip Didier well, he had the tequilas rolling and I never saw the bottom of a glass.

reviews.author: Mandyp
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text: The rooms and resort are clean and beautiful. Food was good. The staff are very accommodating especially moises our waiter around the pool and pool concierge maximiliano. Moises was very on top of things and we wanted for nothing. Maximiliano always made sure we had our palapa on days we wanted 1.  George our concierge took care of all our reservations and was very helpful with any questions we had. All the staff were great but most of all our breakfast at the reserve and day staff at reserve pool were fabulous. Also a shout out to Valeria at breakfast.  Was a nice holiday thankyou to all the staff at paradisus.

reviews.author: Ale1472019
reviews.title: Viaje de reencuentro 30 personas increíble!
reviews.text: Fue un viaje grupal de 30 personas. Nos quedamos en The Reserve y nos atendieron como unas reinas. El desayuno en el restaurante Sante era increíble, con la súper atención de Moises y Jhonny. El restaurante italiano delicioso. El servicio a la playa también espectacular, los meseros nos acercaban los tragos y la comida con muchísima paciencia.

reviews.author: ROSANA V
reviews.title: La preocupación de las personas a cargo hace la diferencia
reviews.text: Estuve en un viaje de reencuentro con un grupo de amigas y nos asignaron a Djordge como nuestro conserje particular. Fue genial este acompañamiento porque Djordge estuvo muy pendiente de todo lo que necesitamos, desde temas administrativos (pruebas covid, movilidad al aeropuerto, atenciones de emergencia) hasta separarnos una mesa en el restaurante italiano que en mi opinión es el mejor. Recomiendo que si tienen el servicio de conserje lo aprovechen al máximo porque les hará la estancia mucho más agradable. Por lo demás todo muy bien con el hotel, las habitaciones muy cómodas, el servicio de limpieza muy atento, y las instalaciones muy adecuadas para un viaje de ocio.

reviews.author: David C
reviews.title: 7 noches de ensueño
reviews.text:
No tengo otra palabra que, maravilloso, para describir nuestra estancia en este precioso lugar.
El resort es una maravilla, no te falta de nada, 7 restaurantes cada uno con su temática especial, probamos casi todos, reservando cada noche en uno distinto y no sabríamos elegir a cuál es mejor ♥️.
El personal hace todo lo posible, en un esfuerzo incansable por ofrecerte la mejor experiencia.
Quisiera destacar el sobre esfuerzo por hacernos nuestra estancia simplemente perfecta de las siguientes personas, aunque todo el personal hace una gran labor.

Personal de limpieza, por encontrarnos nuestra habitación simplemente perfecta.

Rafael restaurante Enso, siempre pendiente que no nos faltara nada en nuestra cena

Amed blue agave, súper simpático dispuesto siempre a ayudarte.

Carlos cielo, muy atento a cada detalle en nuestra cena.

Diego la reserva, el manager de la zona The Reserve, no pudo estar más pendiente a nosotros, nos preparó una de sus mejores bali beds, justo frente al Mar, nos hizo un recorrido por todo el recinto, desde el rincón de mixología hasta nuestra comida en Santé, de la cual salimos más que encantados.

Daniela, nuestro ángel durante nuestra estancia, siempre pendiente a nosotros, que no nos faltaran las reservas en los restaurantes, recomendándonos excursiones, cosas que hacer por la zona, ayudándonos en todo momento, toda una joya.

Helvia, un encanto, tuvimos el placer de poder conocerla y hacer que nuestra experiencia subiera al máximo nivel, súper cercana, atenta a nosotros, dándonos buenas recomendaciones de todo, y haciéndonos la estancia simplemente perfecta, sigue brillando así Helvia.♥️

reviews.author: Maripi74
reviews.title: Amazing  25 years school reunion!!
reviews.text:
We just finished a stay with my school friends after a 25 year reunion. We enjoyed the drinks and nibbles in this area specially the chocolate covered strawberries. Cynthia Blanco was the groups manager and she was helpful making sure it was all in place and checking on us a few times during our stay. She was very easy to contact and her speedy responses to all my questions make this stay smoothly and enjoyable. Aaron and Violeta was our concierge, they contact us throughout or stay making sure our bookings were dealt with . They helped us when needed and checked on us every day to ask if we needed anything. We also enjoyed a few days in Kanna Beach club. Rene was so helpful organising this for us- he was kind and attentive and always made us feel special even though he was mega busy with a full club on that day. His staff, Manuel, Juan, Balta, Luis are some of the most fun and enjoyable workers I have met. The food made by the chef in Kanna beach club was exceptional specially tacos of cochinita Pibil!!!. Thank you guys!. . Diego in Sante! He was just amazing, he made sure we had the best attention, and tables ready not matter how may or what time for our massive group. He was so accommodating, friendly and professional. He speaks highly of his staff Maria (Hostess) , Ruben
,, Valeria, Luis, Moises, Javier, Joel, Miguel, Alex (chef),Cesar, Eligio, Jhonny,Josue,Julio, Yamil & Oscar ( spoiled us so much), Maxilmiliano and Lucas you got us the best Bali bed and such a pleasure to meet you! Diego you rock!! And every meal in Sante was special! Thank you all so
Much!

reviews.author: Jocelyn Allen
reviews.title: Estuvo bien, ciertos puntos a mejorar
reviews.text:
Me hospedé en este hotel del 19 al 23 de noviembre con un grupo de amigas del colegio que nos reencontramos luego de muchos años. Ya antes me había hospedado en este hotel antes de pandemia y si he notado que su servicio y atención al cliente ha bajado. Tuvimos que esperar un buen rato al momento de nuestro check-in, no tenían las habitaciones armadas según solicitud y nos pasaban de una persona a otra. Otro punto es la calidad/sazón de la comida en algunos restaurantes (Lunch Box / Enso) donde muchas no disfrutaron sus platos.
Adicionalmente nosotras pagamos un monto extra por estar en The Reserve pero ahí ya no hay casi playa así que tuvimos que alquilar balinesas para poder disfrutar mejor de la playa, este punto no me parece justo si ya estábamos pagando más. El resto de días fuimos a la playa a la que van los que pagan menos en el hotel. 
Finalmente, el tema de las actividades, mejorar las mezclas/Setlist del DJ en el bar y sería ideal que se extienda un poco más la hora de cierre o buscar más opciones de lugares para divertirse en las noches que no interfieran en el sueño de los huéspedes, quizás un espacio al aire libre (donde actualmente está el bar, se calienta mucho y no fluye mucho aire). Espero mis comentarios sean de utilidad para otras personas y para que el hotel pueda seguir mejorando.

reviews.author: Jody TD
reviews.title: Our Wedding in Paradise
reviews.text: We were supposed to have our wedding in November 2020, but of course that had to be postponed until early Nov 2021. Everyone at the resort was extremely understanding and accommodating throughout our entire wedding planning and trip. All of the staff are very friendly and attentive. Our wedding coordinator after the wedding was postponed was Ana, and she was friendly, accommodating, and went out of her way to make sure we were happy. Sometimes we didn’t get an email response for awhile, but a few weeks out from our wedding she was much more responsive through text. We had 65 guests and Ana made sure that our ceremony and cocktail hour was perfect. Unfortunately, it started raining right before our outdoor reception, but she quickly arranged to move our reception into the ballroom. Overall, we had a wonderful experience and were very happy on our wedding day and throughout the trip! The resort is absolutely beautiful.

reviews.author: Oliver R
reviews.title: Great hotel and staff who went out of their way to help. Very average food.
reviews.text: Great hotel with a narrow but nice beach. The staff were exceptionally friendly (shout out to Richier who served us coffee every morning - he was amazing!). Buffet and taco restos were awesome. The reservation restos we’re at best average but mostly poor.

reviews.author: amoureuse1976
reviews.title: Malva restaurant - Paradisus Cancun review
reviews.text: Joni, Gaudencio and Atilano in Malva restaurant were great. Their service was exceptional. Very friendly. Buffet style service with different choices. But friendly people are the best about the hotel.   They are attentive and remember the small details that make a difference.

reviews.author: llabrada
reviews.title: Second time
reviews.text: This was our second time on Paradisus, had a great time as before. To me, is the people there the ones that make your vacations shine. Julio at the pool bar was great to us with his service, advices on what to do and where to go. Check in takes a long time, I'd suggest more terminals and employees as needed. There's construction going on during the day, but on those ours we were out on the pool or the beach. Reservation to some restaurants is hard to get, but for a couple or 4 person group, walk to the restaurants and talk to the people there, we were a much larger group and got in the lunch box and in enzo. Took the small boat and snorkeling tour just across the street and enjoyed it too.

reviews.author: Vacaylove
reviews.title: The staff is quite special
reviews.text: We had a really lovely vacation at Paradisus- primarily because of the staff! There were 2 people that truly made our stay AMAZING!!! When you eat breakfast, sit outside and request ALFREDO ALVARO. What a perfect way to start your day. He is so happy, has an incredible memory and does his job while singing through the day. He was the best!!! We also had the sweetest and most attentive server at the main pool- ASUNCION. She made our days by the pool so amazing. The activities team is also so fun- check the schedules so you don’t miss out -Thank you for a great trip!!!

reviews.author: Natalia N
reviews.title: La mejor experiencia en Paradisus

reviews.author: Belmarie Palen
reviews.title: Excellent service

reviews.author: Angelica D
reviews.title: Excelente club de playa
reviews.text: Nos habian recomendado el club por su excelente servicio y por su playa, y no nos quedaron mal. Buen ambiente con música de fondo y la playa muy bonita. Como estábamos conociendo fuimos a otros club de playa y tuvimos que volver a repetir porque la atención no fue igual así que felicidades. Esperamos visitarlos muy pronto... Parada segura en Cancún

reviews.author: Isabella M
reviews.title: Great place!
reviews.text: Most of the reviews I read stated that check in took awhile, I found that to be true but everyone who worked with us was super friendly so it didn’t seem like such a big deal. We arrived around 12 and the got our room ready in about 30 minutes, we ate in the mean time. Throughout our whole stay I noticed that the staff was exceptionally friendly, helpful, and hardworking. We had a security guard help us get water at 1:30 in the morning, not something that seems to be his job but he was very happy to help. A shout out to Saul, Myra and Axcel, the staff who are in charge of activities, they were so great and friendly and we had so much fun playing the different sports with them and doing the activities and just getting to know them and hanging out with them. Another shout-out to Wendy one of the waitresses working at the inside portion of ginger bar. We enjoyed our stay and didn’t really have any complaints. They are doing construction in the middle of the main building currently but we were right by it on the 6th floor and it did not cause any interruptions as you could barely hear it from your room. Overall a really great stay.

reviews.author: SKB
reviews.title: Amazing vacation at Paradisus Cancun!
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun was a great place. The service is impeccable. For breakfast we went to Malva buffet and our servers were Eddie, Armando, Alexis, Janeth, Martin, Bernardo, and Blanca. Every one of them was very attentive, always gave service with a smile and went out of their way to make sure we were more than accomodated.

At the Ginger bar, we had Gaby who hand crafted a special cucumber margarita for us, which was delicious! The servers at the Ginger bar were effecient without sacrificing the quality of the drinks. 

When checking in, we had Stephany who is the epitome of service with a smile. When we had a few questions about the room categories, she explained everything thoroughly and even gave us a mini-tour to help us make the best decision for us. 

Pool/beach service was great as well. Our server Manuel took our orders on the beach and always returned  quickly with anything we wanted. 

We also went to the YHI Spa which was a very relaxing experience. Our massage therapists Liliana and Daniela were very attentive and made sure we were comfortable and relaxed the whole time. 

The service and staff here at Paradisus Cancun are phenomenal and we will be returning in the future!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Padilla
reviews.title: aquí probé el mejor postre de mi vida
reviews.text: solo estuvimos un par de días y el hotel categoría reserve y es muy bonito para disfrutar, relajarse y comer todo el tiempo, el personal es muy amable, no recuerdo el nombre de todos los que nos atendieron pero mencionaré que Javier Diez nos llevó uno de los mejores postres que hemos probado en la vida, es el postre samsa, delicioso, la combinación de sabores es extraordinaria, también agradecemos a Valeria, María, Luis y Josue que nos atendieron de maravilla pero destacamos a Javier Diez que fue rápido en atendernos con amabilidad. dejó foto del postre, las habitaciones son lindas también, nos tocó vista a la laguna muy bonita, y las chicas de animación nos enseñaron  a hacer un paisaje con los dedos.

reviews.author: royalicius
reviews.title: The absolute best all inclusive experience!
reviews.text:
As soon as you walk into the lobby of the Paradisus Resort you can tell there’s good vibes all around. Not only because of the state of the art infrastructure of the hotel and the high-end, high quality furniture and decoration, but especially because of the top notch service from its staff. 

I’ve had the pleasure to stay at a few all-inclusive resorts in other countries in the Caribbean, and I have to say the staff at the Paradisus hotel has been by far, the absolute best customer service experience of any resort so far. Here’s a few highlights:

- Karina from the G bar: Karina provides a level of customer service that is only topped by her incredible people skills. She is the epitome of the word service. She made my boyfriend and I feel at home, she went out of her way to make sure the two of us had a positive experience at the hotel party, bringing us and our friends our drinks at a speed that was unlike anything I have ever seen. Always with a positive attitude and with words of care. If there’s one thing we took away from our trip, it was her incredible people skills and service. We can’t wait to come back next year and do it all again, and that’s in great part thanks to her absolutely incredible service.

-Alfredo from the capella Italian restaurant: on our last night, our group of friends decided to make a reservation at the one restaurant we hadn’t tried yet, and boy were we in for a treat! As soon as we shared with Alfredo that was our last night at the restaurant, he took it upon himself to create the most unbelievable dinning experience we had on our entire trip. From bringing tons of appetizers for us to try before we even ordered any, all the way to bringing a couple of superior quality bottles to our table (on the house!) to celebrate our last night at the resort. Alfredo was one of the best servers we had on our trip and also contributed to our feeling of satisfaction and eagerness to return next year.

Eddie from the buffet/fuego restaurant: Eddie was one of those people who exudes kindness. Something that in our opinion is absolutely a must in customer service. He made sure we were having a positive experience by checking in on our table often, quickly bringing anything additional thing we ordered, topping up our drinks, you name it. His kindness made us all feel at home and also contributed to making Paradisus an unbelievable experience.

Other highlights of the trip were the very high quality food (none of us got sick), the DELICIOUS drinks, how accommodating every single staff member was, the clean pools, the massages, the team at the guest service desk and their helpfulness with some mailing things we needed. 

Paradisus was an incredible experience and I guarantee that by the end of it, you will feel that every penny was so very worth the experience. Definitely the type of experience where investing in creating unforgettable memories outweighs any other type of cost. You will not regret booking your vacation here.

reviews.author: Frankie D
reviews.title: A must resort to stay at in Cancun 100%
reviews.text:
Beautiful place & excellent services. Top notch, worth every dollar spent. Everything was great from arriving with Raul taking care of our luggages- Sarah at check in for going above and beyond to help us and explained everything since it’s our group first time in Cancun/ Paradisus. All the restaurants were excellent- Jonathan at Fuego is your go to man, Carina at Ginger, Alfredo at Cappella are all grate and so courteous and welcoming. There are so many staff and they all were great but we had our favourite hence the specific names shout out. The resort is beautiful and great but the staff was truly what made this even more special. They made us feel so welcome and like old friends. Very attentive and polite and kind. 

One thing worth mentioning is Covid protocol for anyone worries about that. The staff constantly cleaning and always wearing masks. I’ve observed staff interacting with each other and when no guests were around and they still had their masks on. 

Nothing bad to say about this place. Please definitely check out Paradisus if you come to Cancun… and just enjoy everything this place has to offer

reviews.author: Mariangela
reviews.title: Recomendadisimo
reviews.text: Excelente experiencia en el paradisus, comida de primera, servicio increíble, espacios del hotel muy hermosos. Actualmente se encuentran remodelando el restaurante que está en el centro del hotel, sin embargo no genera molestias en lo general. Nos quedamos en una habitación doble sencilla, se nota que es una habitación antigua y que por lo que veo se encuentran en remodelación de estas para actualizarlas, tuvimos solo un problema con el aire el cual no se pudo solucionar y por decisión personal decidimos no aceptar el cambio de habitación, muy amablemente nos ofrecieron compensar las molestias por lo que agradecemos el gran servicio. Especial mención para el equipo del lobby quienes nos ayudaron con el pcr de regreso (wen, fabi, fernanda, Carlos) y a todo el increíble grupo de atención de los restaurantes son muchos los nombres así que los felicito a todos por igual.
