reviews.text:
El Paradisus en un super lugar para relajarse y disfrutar entre amigos. Las instalaciones estan increíbles y la atención del personal es espectacular,  sobre todo si van a desayunar o vomer en el restuarabge Malva, pidan que los atienda Alfredo Alvaroz, Alexis Ozuna y Janeth porque su atención es aun mas especial Son super atentos  desde que te sientas te preguntan que quieres de tomar y en vez de que vayas al buffet, te ofrecen pedirlo por uno para evitarque te pares y esperes tu turno sobre todo al.pedir los omelettes. Ademas durante todo el tiempo se sercioran que estes a gusto con la comida y que no te haga falta nada. Tambien en la alberca, si ellos estan de turno ahi, te ariendenbde una manera especial que contrasta frente al resto de los demás. Todo el tiempo mantienen una gran actitud positiva y no se cansan de estar seguros que uno disfrute y no le haga falta nada.
Ñññ!!

reviews.author: Hildeliza L
reviews.title: Trabajo y amigos
reviews.text: La verdad el hotel paradisus esta increíble pero la atención de Alfredo Álvaro, se Alexis Osuna y de Janeth fue los mejor de todo el viaje , no solo nos atendieron increíble en la alberca si no en el restaurante Malva hicieron de nuestros desayunos y comidas , amenas, y súper divertidas, además si uno está a gusto la comida sabe mejor y ellos son unos grandes elementos !!!!! Los felicito por esa actitud de servicio y humanismo !!!

reviews.author: Verónica G
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text: Todo está excelente,la atención y servicio. Lo único que sugiero es que las camas de las habitaciones sean diferentes,son súper increíblemente blandas y duele la espalda, y que usen mas el aire acondicionado

reviews.author: Christina M
reviews.title: Отель с ужасным сервисом и отношением
reviews.text: Отдыхали в отеле 5 ночей, специально заплатили за опцию The Reserve, которая, как обещает Melia, позволяет получить эксклюзивный сервис. В итоге: постоянные проблемы с бронированием лежаков, приходишь к началу работы пляжа, как уже все занято, когда и как они успевают - не понятно. Наша батлер нам никак не помогала, а под конец и вообще заболела, никого не оставив вместо себя. Постоянно возникали какие то проблемы и никого из сотрудников нельзя было найти на месте. Вода из душа вытекала в комнату, воду приносили только после звонка в рум-сервис. Рестораны для ужина невозможно было забронировать - fully booked, а по факту была куча свободных мест. Зарядные слоты в номере работают только если не выключать свет в коридоре. Ещё один минус - это пляж. Очень узкая пляжная линия, расположенная под сильным уклоном. Ну то есть нормально лежать на шезлонгах невозможно, буквально стекаешь вниз. Море бесподобное, волшебно неонового цвета, просто сказка. Но купаться в нем невозможно -  очень сильные волны, которые с виду кажутся небольшими. Дело в течении. Я зашла в воду и пыталась поплавать, меня за 20 секунд унесло в глубину и я не могла выбраться. Моя подруга стала звать на помощь, но звать было некого, так как спасателей не было, а персонал из ресторана постоял посмотрел и ушёл. Халатность сотрудников отеля в итоге чуть не стоила мне жизни))) По всему отелю приторный токсический запах какого то благовоние. Категорически не рекомендую этот отель. Они оборзели, как и многие сетевые, американцы явно их разбаловали.

reviews.author: Amber A
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: Arturo and Martin are the best servers they made dinning so wonderful and great. This resort I highly recommend they go way and beyond to make you feel good! Martin and Arturo gracia por todo!!!! Thanks

reviews.author: Jennifer W
reviews.title: Bringing Sexty Back!
reviews.text: Christian Sanchez was excellent server at dinner buffet! Clean, fresh, great selection of food. Alejandro Cob and Carlos Chay also made the stay great! Housekeeping did a great job of keeping room immaculate. Resort is clean, pools very nice, and beach water and sand so nice! Perfect vacation for sisters 60th birthday party and girlfriend trip!

reviews.author: Paula D
reviews.title: Going home
reviews.text: It has been 2 years since visiting Melia and it was as beautiful as ever.  Our butler, Jose was wonderful, met all needs.  Accommodations were beautiful, ocean front and spacious.  So happy to be traveling again.  Will, soon plan another trip to this wonderful resort.  Our favorite redtaurant was Ensi, can't wait to go back.  The octopus was excellent.

reviews.author: Malcolm Cutlar
reviews.title: Greatest time ever !
reviews.text: The hotel itself was amazing.The architecture and staff was amazing! Axcel, Saul, & Julio (part of the entertainment staff) were great and helped us not even want to leave the resort. 10/10 would come back very soon!

reviews.author: Renate Vuorinen
reviews.title: Wunderschönen Urlaub gehabt
reviews.text:
Das Meer war sehr schön, leider viele hohe Wellen zu dieser Zeit.
Der Strand war Sauber, aber leider fast keine Liegen da.
Am Pool gab es genug Liegen. Service an den Liegen gab es auch!!
Cocktails egal was, aber das ist hier in Mexiko allgemein so, mit viel Crushice!!
Zimmer war Sauber.
Im Malva Restaurant war alles Top, reichlich Auswahl an Essen, und alle Kellner sehr Freundlich und superlieb.
Wirklich das Gesamte Personal war sehr bemüht.

reviews.author: Erik S
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: Esta muy bueno el hotel y comida le agradezco al mesero Eddie maya que nos atendió muy bien del principio hasta final, nos en el bar Pool uno no nos atendía de una manera adecuada pero todo lo de más excelente.

reviews.author: RODRIGO P
reviews.title: Excelente!!
reviews.text: Localização é ótima, a vista espetacular, os quartos muito aconchegantes e amplos. O Hotel tem uma arquitetura especial com muito verde e tudo é grandioso. O atendimento muito bom em especial ao sr Ramirez, Orlando e Edgar que nos atenderam muito bem no café da manhã. Na piscina o ambiente é muito bacana com ótimo atendimento da Laura e Manoel que não nos deixou faltar nada.

reviews.author: Alain V
reviews.title: The Reserve recomendado 100%
reviews.text: Hemos pasado una estancia muy a gusto, nos hospedamos en el área The Reserve, Ruth fue nuestra concierge, siempre estaba al pendiente de nosotros, lo que queríamos hacer y nos ayudó a organizar nuetro covid test. Sofos en el bar ginger nos atendió muy bien también, les recomiendo el dribk de pepino y mezcal, buenísimos. Cenamos en Mole, allí nos atendieron el chef, hugo, ricardo, gaby y un mesero, pido dosculpas pues no recuerdo su nombre. Por las tardes hay tacos en el blue agave también muy recomendado. Si les gustan los mariscos recomiendo enzo que además tiene miy biena vista al mar. Jennifer de actividades nls enseñó a hacer unas pulseras, sin duda esperamos volver pronto.

reviews.author: Kyle
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Wendy at the ginger bar 2  is amazing! She is sweet and so fantastic ! I’d come here again just to see her! Wendy really cares about her guests. The environment is amazing and I want to come here again!

reviews.author: Jackson T
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Had a great stay at paradisus. The staff all are so generous, kind, and fun (particularly Antonio, Wendy, Raphael, David, Hugo, Daniela, and many others). The food and drink were all good. We particularly enjoyed Fuego.

reviews.author: Rafi M Green
reviews.title: ¡Nos ha encantado! Loved it!
reviews.text:
¡Excelente hotel! 

Vinimos a celebrar mi cumpleaños y no podemos agradecer lo suficiente a todo el equipo por cuidarnos tanto. 

Empezando por Ruth, nuestra Concierge quien nos recibió y asistió con nuestras solicitudes.

Súper Luis Ramirez por mimarnos en el Spa. Los masajes buenísimos, nos relajamos mucho.

También a Fares, Ricardo, Sophonias, Hugo, Wendy y todo equipo de AyB por tanta variedad y opciones de calidad, desde los drinks del bar Ginger (los mejores), los cafés del Nesspresso corner a la cata de tequila privada en nuestra cena en el restaurante Mole. ¡Eso sí es superar las expectativas!

Y como no, gracias al Chef David de Mole que nos preparó unas entradas variadas riquísimas y unos platillos de delicia. No se pierdan el Chamorro, es Im-pre-sio-nan-te.

En la piscina nos alegró compartir un momento con Jennifer de Actividades quien nos enseñó a hacer unas pulseritas que luego nos llevamos de recuerdo.

Y por supuesto a la gran Helvia que coordinó hasta el más mínimo detalle de nuestra estancia. Mil mil gracias de todo corazón ❤ 

¡Sin duda volveremos!

reviews.author: Shealyn K
reviews.title: Best customer service experience EVER, even without the Reserve
reviews.text:
My friends and I stayed at the Paradisus from August 29th to September 3rd, and we cannot say ENOUGH amazing things about our vacation. Firstly, we are 4 late 20s, early 30s travelers, and decided to skip out on The Reserve upgrade, as it was out of our price range. With the level of service we received, you would have thought we paid extra and then some! Every step of the way, staff made us feel so special. My birthday was halfway through the trip, and I felt like I was surrounded by old friends and family. Saul, from the activities team, Antonio at the swim up bar, and Didi at the pool went above and beyond to make myself and my friends feel special! They even surprised me with a cake. One of us has a gluten allergy, and was always given food options to make sure she ate a great meal. The food at each restaurant was delicious, and we were able to easily make reservations at each one. We loved Blue Agave, Capella, Enso, and The Malva buffet was always delicious for breakfast, lunch and dinner. We loved playing volleyball in the pool, the wine and painting event at sunset, and water aerobics in the morning. There was always something fun for us to do. The Yhi Spa was amazing, and David was so helpful with us scheduling our massages. He made sure to see us later in the day and made sure we had an enjoyable time. My relaxation massage with Daniela was INCREDIBLE. I would recommend this hotel to everyone, and can’t wait to plan a trip back again. We wanted to thank the following staff members, for making our vacation the best:
Axcel - activities
Saul - activities
Alfredo - buffet
Alejandro - buffet 
Didi - pool
Sergio - pool
Dael - activities 
Antonio -swim up
Gilberto -capella
David - spa
Carlos-blue agave
Daniela - masseuse 
Esteban -buffet
Luis - buffet
Martin - buffet
Gladys - buffet

There were so many more staff members that went above and beyond. I truly don’t have one bad thing to say about this resort at all! I can only imagine the level of service you’d receive if you booked the Reserve Upgrade, but if you can’t afford it, don’t worry. You’ll still have the most amazing vacation. Thanks for everything!!

reviews.author: Jeanine D
reviews.title: Girls Trip
reviews.text: I planned a girls trip with 7 of my friends just needing a get away. Transportation was a mess. So no matter if you confirm and send the confirmation email with flights and arrival times. You’re not ok. And your friend is going to be left at the airport. Expect check in to be about an hour, even with the reserve which is suppose to be exclusive. You’re not going to be able to have a reservation at the restaurants for the first couple of nights because your concierge going to be reactive and not proactive. When it comes activities like tequila tasting and wine tasting you’ll be turned away. If you’re a black minority just don’t, but the waiters and waitresses staff are phenomenal.

reviews.author: Josiv K
reviews.title: Clean and Friendly but....
reviews.text: The resort is nice however the buffet is terrible. Food in general is ok.. not the best Ive had in Mexico. Night life is non existent. You need to go outside of the resort to have some fun. Air-conditioning in the room is terrible. They should tint the glass so that the sun is not beaming down and having to keep the blinds closed to get the room to be cooler. What's the point of a great view if the room is roasting? Pool is fun and the staff is very friendly. The best meal I had was at the pool side amenities. We went to the steak house for my friends birthday and it was very overpriced. Food was really good but for what I had I paid much less at a very high quality establishment in the USA. Construction is 6 days a week in the hotel which I understand but a little annoyed. Good resort but not 5 star... I'd say close to a 3.5 star. Food needs to be better, more entertainment, and better AC in the rooms. I hope to come back someday and have a better experience.

reviews.author: Raquel G
reviews.title: Amazing staff
reviews.text: I was very pleased with our stay. We were in Paradisus Cancun to celebrate our 40 birthday. The staff made us feel at home and safe. They were extremely attentive. Rafael, our butler had excellent recommendations and took care of reservations for dinner and Covid test. Diego, Max and the rest of pool staff were very pleasant and professional as well. 5/5 ⭐️

reviews.author: Missnicky007
reviews.title: Amazing Employees!
reviews.text:
We were just here for my 40th birthday! The very first day, the very first people we met outside were Saul and Axcel, the activities directors. KILLING it with poolside Zumba! We weren’t at the pool for 10 mins before they were both IN THE POOL and playing volleyball with my group & I. Our 9 year old was never a second thought to them. They included her in everything like: doing magic card tricks & making her bracelets, they even did the obstacle course/went down the slide with her about 1,000 times. Then on our last night they met up with us to give her a special gift. These guys worked so hard each day not just for my family/group, but for everyone. They made us feel incredibly important and I feel like our whole trip was exponentially better because they were so fantastic. Thank you, from the bottom of my newly 40 year old heart 🥰

Also, the sommelier Hugo at Cappella was fantastic! He gave my husband a private lesson on red wine that was so professional, everyone at the table was impressed at his extensive knowledge. He even brought out a bottle to show that was from an original vine from the 1500’s!

reviews.author: Felipe L
reviews.title: My wedding
reviews.text:
Everything Perfect Ana! Thank you

Thank you Orlando bar tender ginger!

Everything perfect!
All foods, drinks, patty’s.
I appreciate all you guys. 

I will be back soon.
Gracias mi amigos!
 
Muitas gracias

reviews.author: Cora B
reviews.title: Super Satisfeita!
reviews.text: Hotel Novo,ótima comida,boa limpeza, agradecer aos funcionários q se destacaram Ruben , max, lucas, diego, Moisés, yamil, Joel josue, Javier, Maria, Oscar, Alfredo Augusto, Christian, Miguel , Giovani

reviews.author: Brock T
reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: Axcel and Saul were great and amazing magic. This place is a place you need to visit.  Very clean and friendly! The amenities here make it relaxing, entertaining and one of my favorite vacation destinations! I will definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: Nicole T
reviews.title: Entertainment
reviews.text: Had a great first night! Axcel and saul had awesome card tricks and entertaining vibes! Interested in coming back to see what else they have in store! The resort is amazing with all the amenities it has to offer!

reviews.author: Cody H
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text: Staff in fantastic! Axcel and Saul entertained us with card tricks while we were having drinks. The food is amazing, the rooms are clean and you can’t beat the views! I stayed with friends for 5 nights and I am definitely coming back!

reviews.author: Eric R
reviews.title: Tremenda estadía en Paradisus
reviews.text:
Comida super buena, a buen precio. Bebidas muy frescas un servicio excelente. Pregunten por Lazaro en Blue Agave
y por Orlando Bello en Malva. Se encargaran de ustedes. Muchas actividades durante el dia. La vista al mar es preciosa. Les recomiendo hacer las reservaciones de los restaurantes desde el dia antes ya que se llenan. Los cuartos son un poco antiguos pero en muy buena condición. Vengan con ropa fresca ya que hace mucho calor.

reviews.author: Paola Ortiz
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Lázaro del restaurante Blue Agave y Orlando Bello dieron un poco excelente servicio. La pasamos muy bien en nuestra estadía. El staff es extremadamente servicial en todo el hotel, la comida y las amenidades excelentes. Definitivamente volvemos pronto.

reviews.author: Kenia Lindda
reviews.title: Birthday trip
reviews.text: Rafael Juarez and the rest of the team who works for Paradius Melia in Cancun are the best people! Rafael did everything to make our stay the best time of our lives! Thanks Rafael for your attention with me and my crew! I hope to see you soon!!’

reviews.author: Karen H
reviews.title: Lack of AC ruins what could be a great hotel!
reviews.text:
I stayed at the Paradisus in late July 2021.  The hotel is beautiful, but there is no air conditioning in most of the hotel! The rooms have it, but it is not very good. If you like a cool room, you will still be hot. Honestly, it really ruined the trip. A vacation should be relaxing, but we were sweating all the time! You couldn’t even shop in the gift shops without dying from the heat! Dinner at Cappella was so nice - lovely restaurant, good food, violinist was great - but we had to eat and go, no lingering for another glass of wine. Too hot’ I walked around with a battery operated fan, but i was still melting! This is just really unacceptable for a luxury hotel. I read the reviews complaining about the lack of AC about a week before I left, but it was too late then. I would never return to this hotel unless they had AC throughout the hotel. They also need to provide a map of the property and information on the restaurants and a schedule of the show. They just tell you to use the App which does not work and is not user friendly. We had no idea what shows were available. The sargassum was terrible. They do try to remove it from the beach, but it wasn’t really possible to go in the water. I saw very few people in the water. I imagined sitting on a beautiful beach during this vacation, but sadly, I wasn’t able to enjoy the beach and spent my time at the pool instead. The view is still gorgeous, but it was just very disappointing. 

On the positive side, the hotel is beautiful, the pool is nice, and most of the staff that we encountered were great! Francisco, who served us drinks at the pool, was very personable and remembered our names. Alfredo, who served us at Malvo a few times, was great as well. I feel for the staff who works so hard in the heat serving drinks outside, and there is no relief from the heat inside the hotel either! Tip them well, they so deserve it! We left a piece of luggage at the airport, and the concierge (I think her name was Wen) was incredibly helpful! She also helped us get reservations for dinner (the app does not work).  We met Augustin, who entertained us with magic tricks while we waited for one of the shows to start. Charming young man who spoke excellent English. I suspect he will be running the place one day!

reviews.author: Dazymay28
reviews.title: Great Service!
reviews.text:
We recently visited Paradisus Cancun and had a great stay. It was our third time back the hotel, but this time the service was better than ever! Specifically we enjoyed our nights at the newly renovated sports bar. The drinks were delicious and the servers were beyond incredible. Sofonia, Wendy, and Pedro all went above an beyond and provided the best service and cocktails. They really did everything they could to guarantee we had a great time. Additionally, we visited the Ginger bar several times and Karina and Geovani also were amazing! They made sure we had drinks and service whenever we needed. 

Since we stayed in the Reserve section, we were assigned a butler. We were so lucky to have Violeta. Out of all our trips to different places with butlers, she was absolutely the best we have ever had! She made sure we always had dinner reservations, spa reservations, and everything we needed. She even surprises us with delicious treats and drinks in the room. 

Overall we had a great trip to Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: fredarag0ni
reviews.title: Experiência incrível
reviews.text: Foram 7 dias muito confortáveis e extremamente agradáveis em todos os sentidos, comida ótima, ótimos ambientes, um atendimento de muita qualidade. Recomendo demais tanto para passar uns dias com a família, como para ir sozinho ou com amigos!!!

reviews.author: Sivia
reviews.title: Excellent Service and Seafood
reviews.text:
I have stayed at this all-inclusive several times as a club melia member.  This recent trip involved excellent service from most of the staff and amazingly fresh sashimi, sushi, and ceviche at Enso.  Firstly, Asuncion is our favorite beach service worker.  They all work their tails off, but my friend and I just love her.  We look for her each time we go and situate ourselves in whatever section she is working in (beach/pool). 

Also, we love the bali beds there.  The two gentlemen that were taking care of the bali beds and pool area were Josue and Eliot.  They were wonderful.  We felt taken care of and enjoyed talking with them both.  

Our concierge was Jose and he was probably the best one we have had.   Very friendly and helpful.  

We had some strange issues: no bottle opener in one room and never got one after telling reception. You need one for your water bottles.  Also, my hot and cold water was switched around and it wasn’t obvious.  My friend got locked out of his kitchen area (?).  The most frustrating thing was trying to get fridge restocked.  Due to covid, you had to request what used to be done daily, then wait in your room.  You never knew how long it would take, so it was a pain.  One time it took me 45 min to get it done.   The second time, the employee (Alfonso?) loaded us up with drinks and chips so we wouldn’t have to call and wait every time we needed something.  That helped a lot.  

Although it looks like some travelers loved Mole, we did not like this new menu they have.  I loved the old one.  I actually did not like me food.  This is a first.  I love Mexican food, but when they try to make it gourmet, the dishes taste strange to me.  The pineapple and goat cheese combo was not tasty.  I went for mole.  I got mole salad.  It had no taste of mole, whatsoever.   I have spent a fair amount of time in Mexico over the last 30 years and I did not like the dishes at Mole this time around.  But Enso’s was out of this world.  We ended up choosing Enso’s for most of our meals.  

Something else new was that, as a club member you already pay a lot, and yet they had it set up where you felt obliged to tip everyone you came in contact with, and you had to come into contact with more people for everything!   That makes it even more expensive.  It seemed set up to be this way.  It made me wonder how well the staff is/is not being paid.  There was literally competition in the buffet to get people to sit in a particular server’s section.  You had to request drinks, but could go up to buffet for food.  You used to be able to get your own juice.  

Everyone that worked there wore masks ALL THE TIME.   Most visitors also followed the rules, and they provided the antigen test for free at the resort.  It was easy.  

Again, the staff was EXCELLENT and the Seafood at Enso’s was fresh.

reviews.author: Sandra S
reviews.title: AMAZING ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
reviews.text:
My family and I had the pleasure of staying at Paradisus Cancun last month and let me just say we all had an amazing time. Everyone was so friendly and helpful. The food was delicious 😋. They had daily activities for the guest. The staff always went above and beyond to make sure you were taken care of. 
A special thank you to Aaron our personal butler during our stay. Ivonne and Jesus the pool area staff thank you. To the hotel sommelier Iran thank you so much for taking such good care of us especially our last night at Molé. Chef Diego and Rigoberto thank and you.

reviews.author: Veronica H
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: This has been the best all inclusive experience I’ve had so far. All the staff was super friendly and nice. Specifically the restaurant servers. The best that served us were Armando Balam and Ignacio Vazquez during the breakfast time. They really went above and beyond each morning to serve my friend, our daughters and myself. We look forward to returning next year and my husband and I are looking into staying in Cartagena this upcoming February 2022.

reviews.author: Hey C
reviews.title: Pros and cons
reviews.text: Very nice rooms and hotel, biggest concern is that there is little air conditioning. I was sweating almost the entire time. The pools are amazing and I would recommend the jungle tour excursion it’s very fun. There is lots of seaweed but it’s manageable.

reviews.author: Roberto T
reviews.title: Great time in Paradise
reviews.text: Great room , very clean and the best ocean view . Food was above par for an all inclusive. Mole and Blue Agave and La Palapa were our favorite . Top shelf liquors in all bars . Do the upgrade to reserve. It worth every penny . The best of all was the top notch service. Our concierge Violeta was always on top of everything , including dinner reservations and COVID test. Special mention to Maximiliano (Max) the pool concierge,  and all the team from la Palapa . Thanks to Diego the manager and all the servers in particular Moisés , Javier, Eligio and Yadiel . Last but not least Andy the mixiologist with her mimosas at breakfast. Hope to be back soon .

reviews.author: Ati M
reviews.title: Una experiencia inolvidable
reviews.text:
Fuimos al Paradisus Cancun en un grupo de 48 personas por 6 dias. Todo estuvo excelente, atencion, habitaciones, servicio en la playa, y lo mejor de todo, la gastronomia del hotel. Tuvimos la oportunidad de probar todos los restaurantes y es imposible elegir en cual comimos mejor. 
Por otro lado, la limpieza del hotel, protocolos sanitarios y el aroma que esta presente en todos los espacios, todo 10 puntos. Recomiendo a cualqueira a que visite este hermoso hotel.

reviews.author: scarabrose81
reviews.title: Reserves a HUGE letdown
reviews.text:
Reserve is a complete letdown. I’ve stayed two times prior when the offered Royal Service. This time will be my last. Reserve is a joke in comparison. We did our check in on building 5 which is the reserve pyramid. Then we were taken from that location and placed in building 3 the main pyramid. Nightly shows echoed all the way up every night until 11. Small things that I appreciated before staying with Royal Service are no longer there. There is no longer Thierry Mugler bathing products. It’s dollar store quality shampoo and conditioner on pumps in the shower. Gross.  No note pads or pens in room. I had to call DAILY to get mini bar refills on water. Also butler service was NOT good this time. I had to contact her daily to find out about reservations. Her response sorry I’m very busy. She met with me in person one day and brought her “supervisor” I thought to go over my dissapointment about the room situation. Oh no, he was a time share guy. I told him no I’m not interested while laying in my bali bed with my mother and he came across hostile saying how can I say no when I do not hear him out? Literally blocking my Mother and in until I said we have heard enough goodbye. How tacky!  The pool as mentioned before is showing it’s age also the beach service is not as good as in the past. I’ve in the past referred many friends to this resort but in no way could I do that anymore. Unfortunately my last time at ANY Melia owned resort. 
On a positive the waitstaff around the Reserve pool were amazing and attentive as were the bellboys.  There are too many amazing options in Mexico for resorts so I’ll be moving on which is sad as I try to stay brand loyal. Save your money move elsewhere

reviews.author: Tami F
reviews.title: Vow Renewal - Best Wedding Coordinator
reviews.text: We celebrated our Anniversary by renewing our vows on the beach. This trip could have been a disaster if it wasn’t for Ana, the wedding coordinator. She made everything perfect for the day of the ceremony and helped me with everything else throughout our stay! She was absolutely amazing!!!!! 🤍

reviews.author: jonze
reviews.title: Well below expectations
reviews.text:
We came to Cancun with our family for our friends 40th birthday celebration. When we arrived we were greeting by the hostess and escorted to the exclusive Reseve at Paradisus part of the resort. Our reservations were for 2 rooms on the reserve side of the hotel. When making the reservation we also requested to be in rooms near or other same floor as our friends. At checkin we were informed that they could not accommodate the request to close to our friends on the Reseve side of the resort. We would also have to be in rooms separate from our 4 children. Once in our rooms we were interested in excursions. Our butler informed us the there were discounts available if we willing to sit through an hour long presentation of the Melia Circle group, Melia's timeshare program.  My wife and I agreed to the presentation. We figured our kids could hangout with our friends for the hour and we could save some money on the Xcaret tickets for a family of 6. As you can probably guess the presentation was longer than 1 hour, more like 2 and half hours. That wasn't a big deal because we were told that the discount would be 2 for price of 1 and 20% discount on children tickets. So the 2 1/2 hours lost in the presentation would pay for itself in the huge discounts we were expecting.  Once we arrived at the Otium desk to purchase the Xcaret tickets we were then informed that discount was only 2 for 1 for presentation attendees and that our 15 year old daughters are considered adults and we would have to pay full price for their tickets. My wife and I were very upset by the misleading information. The Otium representative said this was possibly misunderstanding on our part because they has never been a discount for any person that did not attend the presentation. 

The day of the excursion everyone was in the lobby looking for there excursion group. Announcements for the busses was being made at the door of hotel lobby by people with very thick accents and no microphone. I found my tour representative showed her my name on her clipboard and she asked me if I had my receipt. I told that my wife had the piece of paper and was walking towards us the Xcaret bus driver said something the Otium representative and walked off. Shortly after driver walked off I realized that the Xcaret bus had left me and my family

reviews.author: angie
reviews.title: Cancun
reviews.text: Vacation. Augustine was great. He made the whole trip fun.   We had some issues early on but our travel agent got us free massages and the staff payed a lot of attention to us to make up for our issued and

reviews.author: Karl W
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text:
This place is great! I want to thank the severs, chef and the manager. Had a great time at Malva. We’re vegetarian and they catered to us. 

By name, we need to thank Alfredo,  Veronica, David (chef) and Carlos (manager). Went above and beyond. 

Also,  try a dry red wine blend from Mexico. It’s excellent. 

Thank you! Great first night!!!!

reviews.author: Brittany N
reviews.title: Great Girls Trip!
reviews.text: This was our third time coming to Paradisus. We come back for one main reason……the people!  We have always stayed in The Reserve (formally Royal Service) so that we have access to the adults only section and restaurant, Lapalapa.  While children are allowed in the Reserve area, now this wasn’t a deal breaker since they are not allowed in the restaurant and adult pool. I have no problem with kids as I am a mother myself, but this is the vacation I go on with my friends and leave the kids at home so I enjoy adult time.  The one area I wish management would look at would be only housing guests of the Reserve in building five. We were first assigned a room in building three. We stayed for one night and went and asked to be moved to building five where we had stayed in previous years. They accommodated us and were very nice about us moving. There is nothing wrong with building three we just enjoy the calm atmosphere of building five and being right at all the amenities of the reserve (lounge for before dinner drinks, close to pool and Laplapa).  Like I said we were moved for our second night with no problem, but it we will definitely request this next time booking.  Our butler was Djordge who was so kind and so professional!  He booked our reservations for dinner, Bali beds, COVID tests, and even moved our luggage himself when we switched rooms. He checked on us everyday and made sure we had everything we needed in our room. He was wonderful!  We are a group of girls that go on vacation for the pool and the service we received at Lapalapa and the adult pool was AMAZING!  Everyone is so friendly, hospitable, and go out of their way to get you anything and everything you could possibly want!  The manager Diego, servers Oscar, Moises, Valeria, Jhony, Reuben, Julio, Josue (and I’m sure I’m missing a couple) exceeded any expectations we had for service!  Even if they were not our servers for the day they would make sure we had anything we needed, and most of the time had a drink or whatever we needed before we asked for it!  I can’t say enough about their kindness and their service. We all were so sad to have to leave them as we felt we had made friends on vacation. So I’m closing I will say this is the place is wonderful if you want a relaxing vacation where you are absolutely catered to!  The biggest asset of this resort is without a doubt its staff!

reviews.author: Maria G
reviews.title: Customer service Wendalyn
reviews.text: Very helpful and nice! She helped us book reservations and schedule our covid test. She was very patient throughout of check-in process. I definitely recommend her service to anyone who visits paradisus hotel.

reviews.author: Konavzky
reviews.title: Just need to improve their Check In process. It takes forever
reviews.text: It was a great place to stay. Friendly staff. Server from the Buffet Mr. Christian is really awesome. The only problem we had encountered is the check in process; it took forever. But, overall it’s a great and clean resort; food and drinks are great as well. 😀

reviews.author: Tianna D
reviews.title: Soni!!!
reviews.text: Soni was our butler for this trip and she was absolutely the most amazing person we have ever encountered. she was so welcoming, helpful and caring and we had the best time because of her. I recommend Soni to anyone who stays at Paradisus:)

reviews.author: Pathfinder751032
reviews.title: Francisco is the best
reviews.text: Francisco at the Paradisus Cancun is the most amazing server I’ve had. He is great at what he does. He remembered me after the first day and said hello to me every day. I spent my time on the beach just to be in his area. Thank you for everything Francisco. You are a great and amazing person and you took care of us so well. Thank you so much. I will be back because of you.

reviews.author: Jen H
reviews.title: Wonderful stay thanks to incredible staff and a beautiful hotel
reviews.text:
Myself and my sister stayed in for 15 days in May. We were of course a little nervous travelling with Covid and restrictions but from the moment we entered Paradisus we felt safe. All the Covid protocols in place made us feel very secure yet they were not over the top - masks worn indoors by everyone & outdoors also by staff, temperature checks coming in and when entering restaurants and every part of the hotel was shining! 

The hotel itself, the setting, the decor, the rooms, the pools, the beach were all beautiful and absolutely 5 star but the fantastic food and the incredible staff is what made the holiday so wonderful for us. Every meal we had was delicious and every staff member we met were fantastic. Everyone went above and beyond. 

My sister has some challenging food allergies (vegan and allergic to garlic and onion) but the staff were incredible looking after her and making her delicious food every time! Mario the chef in the Malva restaurant at lunch time was exceptional in the food he prepared! My sister is still talking about the delicious quesadillas she had so often! 

At breakfast and lunch we always had Martin Arsenal and Orlando Bello looking after us and they were both brilliant. Always checking in to see if we needed anything and no ask was too big! 

For dinner we dined a lot between Vento the Italian and Malva the buffet. Carlos the manager in Malva looked after us so well and always ensured my sister had a delicious meal! 
In Vento we saw Hugo the manager almost every night! He took such good care of us and we loved arriving to Vento to tell Hugo about some of the funny adventures we got up to each day! Most nights we ordered Italian food but not from the menu and Hugo made sure it was no problem. Cristian the chef in Vento made sure whatever food we wanted was always delicious and always greeted us with the biggest smile (behind his mask) and a big wave! 
There were two more people we saw almost daily that made our stay so special! Agustin in the activities who we loved to chat with and got to learn multiple card tricks from - he got us involved in lots of activities going on! Agustin checked in on us every day and helped involve us in any activities going on and was always sure to have a chat and make us laugh. Through all the activities he became a really friend to us! 
Alejandro was our butler who looked after us for the two weeks and he helped with everything from restaurant reservations and Bali bed reservations to general questions we had on the hotel, the area etc and was such a friendly face to check in on us everyday! 

Thank you all for making our stay so wonderful! We look forward to returning very very soon!

reviews.author: Ahna P
reviews.title: The Reserve at Paradisus is worth it!
reviews.text: Paradisus will not disappoint.  The Reserve is worth the money.  Ruben, Yamil, and Cesar on the Reserve side are top notch!  Also the margarita class/cocktail classes were great, along with the adult finger painting.  These are worth the break from the pool to attend.  Strongly recommend staying here.

reviews.author: Amanda D
reviews.title: Senior Trip
reviews.text:
This review is non reserve,  group of 27 high school seniors and parent (s). We had a total of 13 rooms all in tower 3. Most of us had lagoon view, which for our needs was perfect, we were rarely in the room. The rooms were nice, beds comfy and housekeeping was very good. We did have problems with our safe several times and finally gave up using it.

We had teen boys who consume massive amounts of food and they never lacked for food. The drinks were good, but could be inconsistent, so had to find our favorite bar tenders and tip them well. The staff here is absolutely fabulous.

The Nespresso bar was amazing and the barista went above and beyond. The gelato shop was also a hit.

We enjoyed the nightly entertainment and appreciated them adding the DJ night since the nightclubs were closed.

We thought non motorized sports were included. And maybe they are (across the street at Aquaworld) but due to Covid we couldn’t use them.

We used the excursion desk for two excursions and they were helpful getting our large group taken care of.

The beach is beautiful and the beach drink and food service was amazing. The surf was rough the entire time we were there, and the lifeguard said it always was. If you are going for swims in the ocean, this is not going to be your place.

This place is top notch.... no complaints.

reviews.author: Jade J
reviews.title: Paradisus makes you feel like one in a million!
reviews.text:
I traveled here to celebrate my birthday and college graduation with my best friend. We booked the week of due to awful customer service at Live Aqua Beach Resort Cancun (beware). My expectations of Paradisus were low given how large it is and how many guests they must handle. I was WRONG. This was one of the best vacations I have ever had! 

From the moment we walked into the hotel the staff made sure to meet out every need. Even if you aren’t in VIP they treat you like their most honored guest. We sat poolside and had delicious meals brought to us, as well as drinks. The food at this place is incredible, there’s no other word for it. I highly recommend the Japanese place (I forget the name). You’d think that Mexico isn’t a place to get delicious sushi, but you’d be wrong! Although the sushi was the standout, every meal we had was delicious including the buffet. We were constantly attended to, even when restaurants were packed. It is hard not to feel special at the Paradisus. Drinks were slightly watered down, but if you ask for an extra shot they are more than happy to oblige. When I mentioned it was my birthday, they were quick to bring out top shelf champagne. 

We booked three excursions through the hotel: the day long boat trip to Isla Mujeres, parasailing, and jet skiing (Wave runner). These were booked through a company called Aqua World. All I can say is that they made sure everything was perfect. For all three excursions we spent $140 USD per person, a great deal. We LOVED the Isla Mujeres trip and all our excursions. Aqua World has such helpful and friendly staff, it’s no wonder Paradisus works with them. I highly recommend booking excursions with them. 

I can’t say enough positive things about this hotel and our stay there. Although we were first time guests, I am certain we will be returning!

reviews.author: Pedro R
reviews.title: Maravilloso!
reviews.text:
He estado 4 noches en el hotel Paradisus y todo ha estado perfecto! Desde la habitacion muy agradable, hasta la piscina, los bares y restaurantes. Comida y bebida muy buenas!
Y muchas gracias a Aaron, Violeta y Raul concierge del club por su disponibilidad y simpatia!

reviews.author: Jesenia Q
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: fifth time in this resort, the service excellent, big shout out to these crew members that go above and beyond to make feel like royalty: Malva buffet( Christian and Orlando), from Bahna (Esteban) pool side (Jesus & DD)  also to Saul & Agustin.

reviews.author: Gina O
reviews.title: Todos los meseros de Paradisus!
reviews.text: Todos de meseros de Paradisus son lo maximo. Cuando lleguen, vayan con Alfredo, Armando y Antonio. Ellos siempre fueron muy atentos y amables. Trabajan muy duro! Gracias por atendernos muy bien y ayudarnos a tener un bonito viaje

reviews.author: Shawn Andrea
reviews.title: Paradise in Cancun
reviews.text: We spent 11 fabulous days at Paradisus Cancun All Inclusive resort. We opted for the Royal Service which is the adults only section of the resort and includes a butler. This section of the resort has a private pool and restaurant that’s only for the guest in that section. The resort in its entirety is fantastic. It was at 40% capacity and was the most excellent experience I’ve had traveling in 2020 to date. Following Covid safety guidelines were their top priority. There are multiple restaurants to choose from, all excellent. Our butler Hector was top notch. “Let me cater to you” should be his motto. “At your service” is just that. They will spoil and pamper you. Unpack your luggage, iron your clothes, he meticulously arranged my personal shopping (I gave him a list and it was done), made our dinning reservations, helped select our meals (gluten free vegetarian), room service for our daily breakfast, want something that’s not on the menu...just ask, they’ll do their best to accommodate you, reserved our Bali bed daily, they even rolled out the red carpet for our makeup artist who wasn’t a guest at the resort. I highly recommend Paradisus Cancun. I’ve stayed in every section of this resort including the one bedroom time share section and the standard rooms. This resort is family friendly. I saw a few families with  kids having a blast but it was mostly couples and friend groups.

reviews.author: JHQ
reviews.title: Hands down
reviews.text:
The Beach is one of the most beautiful I have seen in my life. The hotel is clean. We were deeply impressed at the hospitality and kindness of the entire staff at La Palapa. Josue, Ruben, Moises, Cesar, Oscar, Valeria, Diego were truly incredible.   They worked and worked and worked. They were incredibly attentive and always with a smile. I did not see them rest one time and we were in the Reserve beach area for days. They are high quality employees and even more impressive is the character and kindness shown so consistently.  

Maximilian working in the Reserve area was also helpful, knowledgeable and eager to help. 

David from the spa took time to ask about our day and was a genuinely great guy. 

Mauricio came to us late at night and brought us towels when towels were already put away for the night. He was incredibly kind and went way out of his way. He expressed to us that he did not want us to get cold after spending time in the water. 

The quality of an organization is always found in the character of its employees. We want to thank you all for being so kind and friendly and genuinely good people. I hope these people are recognized for going above and beyond for us. 

Love to you from Robert Beverly and Jennifer Quinn

reviews.author: Victor_reviews
reviews.title: The best beach club at Cancun!
reviews.text: By far the best spot to ha g out with friends or family! From The minute you arrive you are welcomed by the staff who will guide you to your Bali bed in front of the blue waters! The food is amazing and the drinks selections is spectacular! Víctor Cauich que as our bar served and he made sure he was always paying attention to our needs, he made suggestions, and even special drinks! The place to be if you want to have fun with friends, family or just relax! 100% a great atmosphere! I revoked you reserve in advance.

reviews.author: Nancy González
reviews.title: Excelente atención 😍
reviews.text:
Me hospedé en The Reserve by Paradisus en abril 2021 y fue una experiencia única!!! 
Muchas felicidades a todo el equipo de meseros ( César, Valeria, Moisés, Josué, Miguel, Yamil, Xavier)
junto con su capitán Diego, así como Diego nuestro mayordomo.
Hicieron de mi estadía la mejor, súper atendida, cada detalle que tuvieron hacía nosotras, definitivamente regreso el próximo  año.
La calidad de las comidas y bebidas excelentes.
Servicio y atención de otro nivel 🙏🏻😍 muchas gracias!!!
Me encantó conocerlos a todos, son unas personas súper lindas.

reviews.author: Chi d
reviews.title: Super Strand!
reviews.text: Super Service am Strand von Yesenia und Laura. Danke vielmals. Die Bewirtung war einfach perfekt und wir geniessen eine wunderbare Zeit hier. Super schöner Strand und einfach perfekt hier. Was will man mehr?

reviews.author: Planet Jess
reviews.title: Girls Trip
reviews.text:
10000% recommend best girls trip ever - gorgeous hotel and very helpful staff!! 
Esteban and Elliot are the very best! I wouldn’t want another hotel for my vacation! You must stay Barbara. Xxxxxx 

10000% recommend best girls trip ever - gorgeous hotel and very helpful staff!! 
Esteban and Elliot are the very best! I wouldn’t want another hotel for my vacation! You must stay Barbara.

reviews.author: Lynnette   Berr... M
reviews.title: The staff is doing a phenomenal job!!
reviews.text:
Diego, Moises, Miguel, Luis, Rueben, Josua and Oscar have all made such an amazing impression with their dedication to making our stay as relaxing as possible. 
Johnathon at Fuego made a great impression. 
Siri was our concierge and did a great job answering all of our questions.

reviews.author: Bonzarelli50
reviews.title: Get away during Covid
reviews.text:
Melia Paradisus Cancun was an experience of a lifetime. From the minute we arrived staff was friendly, helpful. Facility was immaculate in every restaurant, pool areas, extremely CDC compliant. Staff masked. Temperatures taken before entering buffet area. Standing behind a dotted line awaiting staff to serve you anything wanted. 
Our Concierge Violeta, with her assistant Aaron could not have been anymore accommodating or helpful, from our last minute dinner reservation changes to sending someone a rep to help us schedule our Swimming with the Dolphins adventure . Even on Violeta’s day off was she available for help. We were so sorry we could not say goodbye in person.
The pool staff, Lucas & Max were also very helpful always having our BALI BEDS ready each morning with plenty of towels & lounge chairs for the sun.. & floaties. The idea that our Covid test was given right on the property & again arranged by Violeta with not one single glitch.
David was terrific in scheduling our amazing Massages.

Moses, Michael  & other pool servers were terrific also/.
Our rooms were kept in order everyday.
Restaurants were good, Italian a favorite. LaPalapa for lunches excellent. Again, any request was accomplshed.
To finalize my review, best of any resort i have visited in Mexico. Would return in a heartbeat & hope to get back next year.I have stayed at many Mexico resorts.
With Covid being active, we were extremely comfortable feeling very safe during our stay.

reviews.author: Kevin O
reviews.title: Great resort, great people, great time
reviews.text:
Had a wonderful stay here. Moises was the best host I've ever had at any restaurant  or resort in my life. He set the standard. Diego his manager was excellent  as well, went above and beyond for all 10 people I came with. Stayed in the reserve and had pleasure of being serviced by Javier, Oscar, Valeria, and Yamil. Very personable people that made my week stay here amazing. They all take the protocols serious and were wearing their masks the entire time correctly. It was always a pleasure and joy to see them everyday working and helping all customers in Reserve. Beach beds in reserve section was such a great time we ended up staying there the whole day with Moises and the others consistently assisting us to make sure we had all we needed. 

Food here was phenomenal.  Best resort food I have ever had and they give you end less options. Team went above and beyond to also help me understand where best to eat and what to try. 

Rene and Sergio at Kanna beach club were wonderful as well. Made whole day there great. 

Edier in fuego restaurant made my whole week enjoyable with his exemplary  service. He managed our whole table and his section phenomenally. 

Main thing that sets this place apart is their service to you. Only reaso I gave them 4/5 is because of the front desk/concierge. first day i spent nearly 2 hours trying to deal with them and it was just such a slow/inefficient  process. They take too long and arent properly staffed in this department. If you have no key issues or come in when nobody else is checking in, then you will face none of these issues. That is the only negative thing I have to say but again, best resort I have ever been to and I will come back consistently.

reviews.author: Jose L
reviews.title: Mejor lugar para relajarse
reviews.text: Ginger bar at paradisus cancun..es lo mejor de lo mejor..gracias karina, Gaby, Giovani, sency y en especial a Jesenia. Muy amables, muy buen equipo les visitaba noche tras noches, pues se convirtió en mi lugar favorito..

reviews.author: Smtalkgrl
reviews.title: Birthday getaway
reviews.text: Our butler Rodolfo was amazing. He catered to our needs and those of our friends who were traveling with us.  He was the highlight of the resort.  We were disappointed that we were not in an adult only “Reserve” area. We were however given access to adult only areas.  I believe that was a misrepresentation of what “Reserve” represents.  I also felt that the check in /orientation presentation lacked. Had it not been for our butler Rodolfo who answered many questions for us we would have been lost.  Aside from that the resort offered great views, friendly staff and plenty amenities. If we were looking for a family friendly resort this is one we would consider.

reviews.author: JSW
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel & Excellent Service!
reviews.text: Hotel is huge with so many wonderful amenities. Recommend upgrading to Reserve. Our trip was made so perfect and seamless thanks to our amazing concierge Rodolfo. He went above and beyond and took great care of us. We wanted to experience a local restaurant outside of the hotel and he booked us a place that was not only walking distance but had delicious food & spectacular view/shows. Ignacio & Aurelio, were so attentive at the buffet breakfast and took time to chat with us. The entire staff at the resort were accommodating and always so friendly. The restaurants were good, but my favorites were Vento & Enso.  Make reservations for Vento when upon arrival, they fill up fast. Rodolfo was able to work some magic and get us in.  Will definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Andre S
reviews.title: A GREAT EXPERIENCE
reviews.text: I was a guest at the paradisus hotel from April 9th to the 12th I loved the resort the staff was great and one in particular radalfo was great very polite tended to all of our needs checked up on us everyday and gave us alot of different ideas to do in cancun.the hotel is beautiful loved the beach,music, the beds, pool,food everything was great definitely will be back in August

reviews.author: scandsc
reviews.title: Ah-mazing
reviews.text:
Paradises is a brilliant gem. Cancun is a must see. The sand is soft and beautiful. The resort has wonderful people. The food is top notch. I am a bit of a health nut and I have been able to manage my diet while here. I brought my own protein to have them make in a smoothie and they have very happily accommodated me. They have a latte bar, I do wish they had alternate milk than cows milk, but Richer, the attendant has been a delight to see every morning. So many more smiling faces that I need to get their names. 
Overall a very nice experience. I have walked the beach both ways for a mile and I will say this place by far has the best beach front. With the chairs and the shade under the very sturdy “huts”. Next time I come I will most likely spend the extra for the Reserve with your own butler that makes reservations for you for dinner and shows you are the grounds. Getting everything ready for your day at the pool. But even without that, you are very well taken care of here. You will not regret the beautiful pools and the welcoming staff.

reviews.author: Ba Goit
reviews.title: Best Hotel to stay in Cancun!
reviews.text:
We loved our stay at Paradisus to celebrate our birthday in Cancun. All the staff members have been courteous and friendly during our whole stay of two weeks! We booked the Laguna Suite which was so spacious and very clean with a beautiful view.

A special thank you goes out to the tremendous service of: Abel, Victor, Augusti, Ismael, Omar, Abigail, Orlando, Joel, Jaime and Jonathan.
Thank you all for your hospitality and making us feel home to this beautiful place.

We can also recommend to visit the restaurants they offer at the hotel with the amazing and delicious food and drinks.
They are all grateful if you tip them any amount just to let them know that your appreciated they’re service.
We are definitely planning to come back!☺️

reviews.author: Connor D
reviews.title: So much fun !!! Nicolas was phenomenal. Rigoberto & Raphael were AMAZING! My girlfriend & I loved everyone here.
reviews.text: We will be swearing by this place the rest of our vacation. Thank you to Nicolas, Rigoberto & Raphael again for being so great to us! VIVA LA MEXICO !!!!!! Everyone should come here at least one day of their trip to the beautiful Cancun.

reviews.author: Stay790128
reviews.title: Amazing Trip and Service!
reviews.text: I stayed at Paradisus Cancun to celebrate my friend’s 22nd Birthday. This was our first girls trip and it was absolutely the best decision we’ve made all year! I recommend staying with the Reserve. Our personal Butler Ceci booked all of  our dinner reservations, covid test, and a special birthday celebration for my friend. We even had a complementary photo shoot! Yamil, Cesar, and Miguel were amazing and they made sure to surprise us with new delicious drinks while lounging on the beach. The bellhop David was very efficient and took great care of our bags. The resort was immaculate and they took covid safety restrictions very seriously. Our stay was amazing and there was so many delicious food options. I highly recommend!

reviews.author: MZ8
reviews.title: Muy buena expericencia
reviews.text:
Gran servicio gran comida y muy Agusto! Rodolfo Villanueva un gran Butler 

Si volvería seguro! 

Cancún es un paradisíaco lugar y aquí lo disfruté al cien por ciento 

Alimentos y bebidas top! 

Hasta la próxima

reviews.author: Ella W
reviews.title: Best vacation!
reviews.text: All because of the great customer service, this trip was made amazing. Aside from the beautiful scenery, beach and fun activities the relationships the workers formed with the customers was so great. Specifically at The Ginger Bar, Salvador, Gaby, Karina, Sofonra, Luis and Jeny. They made all my friends and I feel very welcomed and made our stay that much more fun. Their prompt service, and friendliness contributed to the overall wonderful stay at Paradisus, Cancun. Attached is just one of many pictures with the staff, this one features Salvador.

reviews.author: Desiree Nazir
reviews.title: Felicitaciones!
reviews.text:
A pesar de que coincidimos con los spring breakers, los cuales estaban descontrolados gritando en las noches, despertando a los demás huéspedes, sin usar mascarillas durante todo el tiempo y nadie les decía nada, no puedo dejar de destacar el servicio del hotel. Demasiado simpaticos y con una gran disposición a ayudar a nuestras inquietudes y alergias alimentarias.
Quiero mencionar especialmente a Omar del restaurant Vento, quien nos atendió excepcionalmente y ayudo con las alergias y atenciones especiales que necesitábamos.
Melvin y Diego de Mole, los cuales también nos dieron una atención maravillosa e hicieron nuestra estancia en Mole muy grata y especial! 
Tbn quiero destacar a Alis y Antonio (no estoy segura si son de Fuego o de Malva, pero nos atendieron en la terraza de Malva en el horario de almuerzo) y también hicieron de nuestra estadía un placer.
Por último, siempre hay cosas por mejorar, como la atención del personal en el snack de la piscina, y cosas básicas en el buffet, si bien la comida es rica, faltan acompañamientos y básicos más allá de la ensalada esto en el almuerzo, ya que en la noche nada que decir! 
En cuanto a los protocolos Covid, estaba todo muy ordenado, limpio, desinfectado. Alcohol gel en todas partes, para entrar a los restaurantes te toman la temperatura y además todo te lo sirven (no esta permitido el auto servicio).

En general, es un hotel que mega recomiendo, pero no para época de spring break!

reviews.author: Gaby_scl
reviews.title: Me encanta Paradisus y seguiré repitiendo
reviews.text:
Siempre elijo Paradisus en mis viajes al caribe y no falla.
El servicio es excelente y los protocolos por covid son muy buenos. Si bien en algunos lugares es débil (como el snack de la piscina), en la mayoría se nota un trabajo dedicado y amable con los huéspedes.
La limpieza, check-in, reservas de restaurantes y room service funcionan perfecto. También cumplen con tener las marcas internacionales y de buen nivel que espero en un bar de un hotel de este precio.
Destaco el servicio de Melvin y Diego en el restaurant Mole, Omar en Vento, Alis y Christian (chef) en Malva, Antonio en el bar de la piscina, Miguel en el check-in y Jorge en reservaciones. Todos demostraron tener la mejor actitud de servicio y me ayudaron en cada comida a encontrar la mejor opción para mi intolerancia alimentaria.
En las cosas por mejorar, creo que en un hotel de este precio deberían cuidar el descanso y tranquilidad de todos los huéspedes, lo cual no es posible si aceptan tal nivel de pasajeros en Spring Break, los cuales no respetan los espacios comunes y el de los demás.
No se si es por pandemia o ha ocurrido antes, pero un día en mi estadía se terminó el tequila en todos los bares y creo que es algo básico para un hotel en México.
En general siempre repetiría esta cadena de hoteles, pero lo pensaría dos veces si mi viaje es en época de Spring Break.

reviews.author: Syeda T
reviews.title: So Amazing!
reviews.text: My friends and I came to Paradisus for a short 4 day trip. The hotel itself is gorgeous and looks truly like paradise. There are great day and night activities. The food is great, I recommend the Fuego restaurant. The restaurant manager, Guillermo, was super friendly and attentive. The hotel staff as a whole is wonderful, kind and incredibly respectful, especially Abel, Alejandro, and Luis! We loved our stay and hope to be back soon!

reviews.author: angelnatanael
reviews.title: Excelente hotel
reviews.text: Muy buen servicio desde la llegada hasta la salida muy bonitas las habitaciones y todas sus instalaciones el personal muy amable y atento en todo excelente 100% recomendable para ir en amigos y familia

reviews.author: Michelle U
reviews.title: Birthday trip
reviews.text: Stayed at Paradisus (the reserve) for 7 nights and everything was excellent. Our butler Violeta was awesome and she stayed in touch every day of our stay making sure we were receiving the best quality of service. She was extremely helpful and attentive. We will definitely be back soon!

reviews.author: Leslie B
reviews.title: Restaurant Mole!
reviews.text: Carlos and Melvin are wonderful!  Excellent service!   They did a great job with dinner and our service all evening. We enjoyed watching the special coffee be made and how nice they were all for our table.

reviews.author: Amina S
reviews.title: Ms
reviews.text: Esteban was amazing! He made my experience at Bana so memorable. He even did something special for my birthday. 10/10 will definitely be coming back and requesting Esteban. We highly recommend coming!

reviews.author: Juan G
reviews.title: Pésimo hotel, pésima atención de recepción.
reviews.text:
Estoy alojado en este hotel hace una semana con 5 amigos. La habitación que solicité es vista mar. Solicite un cambio de habitación debido a lo lejos que quedaba de la pirámide central y debido a que el baño necesita de mantencion. La segunda habitación que recibí tiene problemas con el ventanal de la terraza ya que se filtra el aire por ambos costados al estar descuadrada. Por otra parte, el estanque del wc también tiene una filtración y cae el agua hasta formar una gran posa. Reporté esto en recepción y después de 24 horas aún no se han pronunciado al respecto. El valor de la habitación no es menor para tener que soportar este tipo de situaciones  y que el hotel no se haga responsable, pero para querer hacer cargos extra no dudan. Quisieron cobrarme por una limpieza profunda  “por el olor a cigarro” que la mucama había reportado siendo que jamas fumamos en la habitación.
Punto aparte son los precios por los servicios que brinda el hotel, que definitivamente son exorbitados. Tratan de vender vinos en la cena a un precio excesivo, en la playa te cobran 180 dólares por un camastro, en el spa cobran 150 dólares por un masaje, ofrecen tours con descuentos solo a cambio de hacerte parte de una membresia y así podría seguir enumerando. 
Viajo mucho y suelo hospedarme en la cadena RIU, pero por esta vez quise darle una oportunidad al Paradisus Cancun. Después de esta experiencia, definitivamente NO RECOMIENDO ESTE HOTEL. Lo único rescatable es la infraestructura pero no vale la pena ni el dinero.

reviews.author: Nayatzin S
reviews.title: Servicio en Malva - Food Bazar
reviews.text: La comida y el servicio es excelente.  Visitamos diario para el desayuno y comes muy agusto con unas vistas increíbles.  Nuestros meseros Atilano, Alejandro y Vicente nos dieron un servicio estupendo, siempre muy atentos y amables.  Todos hacen su trabajo con gusto y muchas ganas y eso hace tu experiencia mucho más especial.  Gracias a todos por haber hecho nuestras vacaciones mucho más lindas.

reviews.author: comercialelut
reviews.title: Buen fin de semana
reviews.text: Excelente las instalaciones el aseo y la atención, la comida y las bebidas exquisitas. Los servicios de piscina jacuzzi y playa espectaculares. Los tours y actividades geniales y con todas las normas.

reviews.author: Jesus Montes
reviews.title: Cancun trip
reviews.text: Excelente servicio por parte de Christian Lovera durante los desayunos al igual durante todas las cenas toda la comida fue de lo mejor y el hotes super recomendado excelente servicio de todo el personal

reviews.author: AKIS86
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: I stayed @Paradisus with my friend for one week and it was amazing. Check in was nice and smooth, staff was friendly, food was delicious and we got free upgrade from a very nice manager Andria who went above and beyond to make sure our stay is most comfortable and memorable. Room was amazing! I will be recommending Paradisus to all my friends. Huge thanks to Andria and all the staff, it was great experience and we’ll be back for sure!

reviews.author: Sunshine260189
reviews.title: Great service!
reviews.text: perfect service! we loved Alejandro, Julio and Pascual our serves! The breakfast was the best here, it was a massive buffet with everything you can ask for from Mexican specialities to continental breakfast.

reviews.author: Lvngher_bstlfe
reviews.title: Kudos Melia
reviews.text:
This was my first visit to Mexico. My friends and I were celebrating our birthdays. We were actually reserved at another hotel,  but they were not finished with their renovations so they moved us to Paradisus. Wow, so glad they did!

PROS:
Unique style hotel with plush greenery inside and a koi pond in the lobby which made the atmosphere very relaxing. 

Service! The staff here were excellent,  attentive, and helpful. Two out of the six of us work in the hospitality and hotel industry. Our standards are high and exceeded our expectations. 

Experience! There was nightly entertainment from silent DJ parties to dance techno battles. If fitness is your jam, you could participate in boot camp on the beach,  or yoga on the water. We had a great time. 

CONS:
The food wasn't the best. There are 6 or 7 inclusive restaurants. Breakfast at Fuego was consistent. Outside of that, for this foodie the selections were sub par. We even dined at the only steakhouse that wasn't inclusive. The crab legs were too salty, but the service as always was excellent. 

I have to acknowledge Alfredo and Amayrani at Fuego for their consistent level of service and kindness. I was there almost every day, Amayrani learned my name and that special touch makes a difference. Alfredo was my 1st server upon arrival. My room wasn't ready and he was really sweetand patient. If I went to another restaurant he would be there. You can tell he loves what he does!

Lastly,  we went Superbowl weekend and during the Pandemic. I appreciate their safety protocols, mask requirements, and they offered COVID-19 testing onsite. 

Next stop Paradisus Riveria Maya or Paradisus Playa del Carmen. I'm hooked on Melia!

reviews.author: Regia F
reviews.title: Ferias
reviews.text:
Experiência maravilhosa, hotel perfeito serviço impecável , funcionários atenciosos e nosso maiordomo perfeito (José) muito prestativo e simpático. 
Comida do hotel excelente, acomodações amplas muito limpo. Voltaremos com certeza.

reviews.author: Thor Pitt
reviews.title: Stay Away
reviews.text:
So I stayed there before and while hotel is good, getting your refund is almost impossible. After the Corona, they closed the hotel and told us that we would be getting refunds in 2-3  months.

Now it's a year later and after countless calls, emails, they still haven't processed my refund.

In times of travel restrictions and possible closures and delays, avoid this hotel. You will NEVER get your money back.

reviews.author: Manal S
reviews.title: Fuego -Joel rojano
reviews.text: Joel rojano is the best waiter ever!! He’s here for dinner time. He made sure our experience for dinner was nice and smooth and accommodated to our needs. I high Reccomend requesting for him ahead of time!!  Oh and he makes the besttttttttt alcoholic drinks :)

reviews.author: Valdez A
reviews.title: Mole - Restaurant
reviews.text: What a great experience at the Mole restaurant in Paradisus! Carlos was very nice, attentive and hospitable. Will definitely come back! Highly recommend asking for him as your waiter. The food was delicious!

reviews.author: jaira c
reviews.title: Girls trip
reviews.text: Went to Paradisus with my girls for a weekend of relaxation and fun. The boys at the pool, bartenders and cabana Cornelio, Julio, Samuel, Rene, Miguel to name a few and the restaurants were so great, the reserve waiter Cesar was amazing. And the front desk, Julian, Christian, and Andria were also great. The best part was the doctor who did our covid test to return to the USA, Dr. Misael Morales, he was gentle and made an uncomfortable situation very comfortable, not to mention he was hot!

reviews.author: Korey
reviews.title: Amazing as always
reviews.text: This is our home away from home. Been a Melia fan for almost a decade and don’t see that changing. They are the best at customer service, consistency, and overall quality. When we want a break, we immediately book Melia bc we know we can relax and not worry about anything. Sandra, Melina, and our butler Violeta made our stay over Christmas truly outstanding. We’ll be back soon!

reviews.author: Maria K
reviews.title: So nice!

The host Rodolfo helped me greatly with making reservations at restaurants, settling the appointment to doctor in order to be tested on coronavirus. He did a really good job and carried out everything on time! Thank him for making my vacation amazing and unforgettable!

reviews.author: Clarisel
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: We loved our stay! This is our second time at Paradisus Cancun and we loved it even more than the first time. From checkin in to the beach, to the pool. The food was out of this world. Every single restaurant was espectacular. The waiters were friendly, attentive and on top of our every need. A big thanks to our waiters Orlando and ALfredo who were always there for our every need both at breakfast and at Mole Restaurant. Excellent resort overall, this won’t be our last time here.

reviews.author: Kela G
reviews.title: Amazing dinner!

reviews.author: Molly Sledge

reviews.text: This resort far exceeded my expectations from the moment I check in and until I left for home. The staff is so attentive to all the guests. Max was amazing in taking care of cabanas and pool beds. The food is wonderful as well. Planning my next trip to this wonderful resort.

reviews.author: Denise F
reviews.title: Rodolpho our butler!
reviews.text: Rodolpho gave amazing customer service! He was always attentive and available. Resort was beautiful. We did Reserve service and it was worth every penny. Good food big selection. Willing to make any drink with the good stuff! Will be going back!

reviews.author: Mandy R
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: Great resort!  Great service, pool service was amazing, Miguel, Oscar and Ruben were extremely attentive!  Omar at Vento was awesome!  Max at the pool provided top notch customer service.  Rodolfo was great as our butler!  He meet our every need.

reviews.author: mirella1199
reviews.title: Relaxing Time
reviews.text: Absolutely a great trip, had the best coordinator Rodolfo!! Booked everything for us, checked up on us. Everything we needed was addressed by our great Rodolfo. We had an amazing and calming vacation. Will definitely return and Rodolfo will be requested again.

reviews.author: Regina L
reviews.title: Great hospitality
reviews.text: Great service, wonderful atmosphere beautiful music and the best host RaFael ! Patient and understanding & to top it off Delicious foods, it’s Paradise with itself ! This is my 1st time but it’s certainly not my last.

reviews.author: Michelle N
reviews.title: WONDERFUL experience!
reviews.text: The staff at Paradisus go ABOVE and beyond to help your every need. It felt very COVID safe and they followed all protocols. I want to give a VERY special thanks to Cesar, Manual and Karina for making our trip amazing. Also wanted to mention Oscar, DiDi and Max were wonderful as well. We were in the reserve section, the food there is AMAZING, the best all inclusive food I’ve experienced at La Palapa.

reviews.author: Ricardo Oliveira
reviews.title: Avaliação Juan - Fuego
reviews.text: Juan é um excelente profissional! Nunca fui tão bem atendido, eu e meus amigos nos sentimos muito bem com o atendimento. Estamos muito satisfeitos e com certeza vamos indicar para outras pessoas visitarem.

reviews.author: KarlixNataren
reviews.title: Increíble fin de semana largo!!!
reviews.text:
Desde la habitación tan encantadora, hasta el servicio de Julio, Gaudencio, Alex en Malva, hicieron del fin de semana largo toda una gran experiencia! La comida deliciosa, los drinks más ricos y la Pool party con el DJ poniendo a tono la fiesta!! 
No duden en visitar Paradisus Cancún para una gran escapada o vacaciones!! Gracias a Alejandra Reyes y Patricia de reservaciones por ayudarnos con todo!

reviews.author: Mauricio F
reviews.title: Irritable servicio telefónico
reviews.text: Olvidé una camisa en mi habitación al salir el día 1ro de enero de 2021. Al llamar a la operadora para que me comunique con alguien que pudiera ayudarme, fueron 2 llamadas de 5 minutos de espera en linea cada una (adjunto screenshot), lo cual es bastante molesto, finalmente en el tercer intento pude comunicarme con Guest service, con una chica bastante amable y servicial llamada Aiko. El tema de la camisa está pendiente pero al menos parece que le están dando seguimiento ya. Este detallito arruina mi estadía la cual fue muy buena, el hotel en sí es bastante disfrutable, la comida es buena y el servicio más destacable fue en el buffet del desayuno y alrededor de la piscina con la mesera ASU. Esta reseña sería de 5 estrellas si no fuera por el detalle de la espera tan tediosa al teléfono, por ese motivo doy una estrella para que realmente hagan algo al respecto.

reviews.author: Chellie K
reviews.title: Rodolfo our host
reviews.text: I highly recommend Rodolfo from Paradisus as your host! He was fun and very helpful! He tended to all our needs and answered all of our questions! (No matter how silly 😂) He made a point to text us every day, even on his day off!! He would also finding us daily to visit in person! ❤️

reviews.author: Rogerio C
reviews.title: Excelente atendimento
reviews.text:
Cheguei no paradisus e desde o começo fui muito bem atendido por todos , local organizado ,quartos limpos ,muitas coisas pra fazer , comida muito boa e ótima localização todos os funcionários muito atenciosos.
Em particular quem for pode procurar pelo Cristhian Morales / Front Desk atendimento de excelência qualidade.

reviews.author: Lontina F
