reviews.text: I love it !!!! Thank for everything !!!! ❤️😘😊.... and love dj eddy and Saul from activity this is amazing hotel for visit I enjoy everything here thanks for the attention and I recommend this hotel come here it’s great

reviews.author: deleon080919
reviews.title: Experiencia
reviews.text: Experiencia paradisus fue muy agradable el personal del hotel muy amable incluyendo a los guardavidas , excelente muy contentas y regresaremos. La comida que más disfrute el reataurante japonez super rico. El resturante italiano no cumplio mis expectaticas pero todo muy bien.

reviews.author: Murray H
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus
reviews.text: We'll be back. Had a really good time with our stay here. 5 Stars to all the great staff. Rene at poolside bar. Raphael at Bana. Ati Alfredo and Orlando each day at breakfast all were fantastic hosts. Jamal at Enso thanks for watching out for my allergies.

reviews.author: Candelaria R
reviews.title: Fiesta
reviews.text: Me gusto el ambiente de avenue bar la música de dj eddy muy buena fiesta para mi graduación a mi y a mis amigas las actividades con Saúl queremos  seguir disfrutando de este hotel hasta el último día gracias por el buen ambiente.

reviews.author: Regina
reviews.title: Las mejores vacaciones
reviews.text: Excelente hotel, muy buen servicio y calidad, la música de Eddy muy buena y las actividades de Saul muy entretenidas y divertidas de todo tipo, 100% recomendado muy buen servicio en todo y todo en excelentes condiciones

reviews.author: Mara
reviews.title: Amazing experience and vacation
reviews.text: Welcoming atmosphere and people. Saul and eddy are great employees. Enjoyed Spanish and dancing lessons. Amazing massage, interactive activities, quality service, thankful to meet amazing people. Quality and happy employees.

reviews.author: Dreahawk
reviews.title: Best Vacation Ever!
reviews.text: I stayed for one week along with my best friend. This was literally the best vacation ever, there are so many different restaurants to choose from, all the food was absolutely delicious. I also had a massage at the spa it was the best massage I’ve ever had in my life!. The resort staff was excellent especially Galdino! I was hesitant about traveling during Covid, but the resort staff was constantly cleaning and spraying elevator buttons and the staircase handles. It was great to see that being done. I had a fabulous time and I cannot wait to go back!

reviews.author: Maria B
reviews.title: Great service!
reviews.text: Our experience was wonderful at Enzo! We had incredible service from Raphael, Louis, and Nicholas. They were all great servers. The food was wonderful. Appetizers and main courses were delicious. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Cole
reviews.title: Mehhhh - Wouldn’t recommend or go back
reviews.text:
Resort overall is beautiful with amazing ocean views and clean beaches. We stayed at the grand reserve ocean view, the best part of the room being the ocean view & huge porcelain bathtub. The beds were VERY VERY uncomfortable and we got bit by some kind of bugs. The room’s mini bar was not automatically stocked daily and we had to call. Room service food was gross & barely edible. 

The overall resort food was mediocre at best, the highlight being the breakfast buffets. The dinners were not very good at all. Bana did however have good sushi. The house alcohol was watered down, the wines were not good, I recommend sticking to beer as your safest bet.

Rodolfo our butler was amazing & provided us with above & beyond service!!! Service on the beach under the Palapa’s was fantastic as well! 

The YHI spa was also great! I recommend Gemma, as she gave the most relaxing message! Take into consideration that no place on the property has a hot tub, not even the spa which is supposed to.... The water is Luke warm at best. 

Overall for the price of this all inclusive I would recommend just staying at a regular resort and venturing out to other restaurants to eat. We ate at Crabhouse and Fred’s seafood both were fantastic and across the street. We stayed at a Meliá in Dominican Republic and felt that the rooms were cleaner and comfier and that the food there overall was MUCH better than the Paradisus. This was a bit of a let down for us. Would not go back.

reviews.author: auroradorothy
reviews.title: Amazing Customer Service
reviews.text: We stayed at the Reserve - definitely worth the difference in price especially if you want to be in the Adults Only side AND have a butler. Our butler was Rodolfo and he was extremely accommodating and responsive to our requests! I highly recommend requesting Rodolfo for anyone staying at the Reserve - you won’t be disappointed!

reviews.author: Aiden
reviews.title: Amazing stay
reviews.text: Phenomenal time at Paradisus Cancun, biggest highlights were food at Mole and especially the service from Rodolfo and the rest of the staff. Highly recommend! Great pool and beach options, the Reserve is worth checking out for the additional access, privacy, and amenities.

reviews.author: Jose Zamora

reviews.author: malfre26
reviews.title: Paradisus excepcional
reviews.text: Estoy más que agradecido con mi estadía en el paradisus cancun,desde que nos bajamos del taxi en la puerta todo fue perfecto,todo el personal muy atento y amable,el check in fue exelente.ahorra quiero agradecer por el trabajo de mi mayor domo rodolfo así como de violeta.en todo momento fui tratado con respeto y amabilidad,respondieron todas mis preguntas y se ocuparon de que todo estuviera perfecto.no creo que mis vacaciones hubieran sido iguales sin su apoyo y servicio.son profesionales y súper agradables llenos de detalles para que sus clientes estén al 100% satisfechos. Gracias infinitas nos vemos pronto.tambien agradecer a sandra que en todo momento me apoyo en la reserva y más cosas que necesite.exelente colaboradora así que mis respetos para todo el colectivo.me sentí realmente en vacaciones y feliz.desde ya cliente fijo.muchas bendiciones para todos. Graciassssss

reviews.author: Sadia K

At the Restaurant Enzo the food was AMAZING!!! And so was the hospitality. Especially Roger & Louis. Highly recommended!! 
Staring from the api’s to main course. The coconut ice cream was delicious!!!!

reviews.author: Becky

reviews.text: Salvador was awesome!! Him, Karina and Sofonias all did such an amazing job serving drinks quickly and they were all so delicious. reviews.author: Cacao lady

reviews.author: Donna B
reviews.title: Excellent time and very safe!
reviews.text: Had a wonderful stay at the hotel and felt very safe. The hotels attention to detail, and safety of all its guests is impeccable. Want to give a shout out to our awesome butler, Hector! reviews.author: Daniel Vazquez
reviews.title: Birthday party
reviews.text: We had an excellent experience at all inclusive hotel. People are so friendly and the service is a top level hotel. Totally recommended. I loved the way you make a restaurant reservation. Technology is well implemented

reviews.author: Jorge GC
reviews.title: Excelent service
reviews.text: We had a great time! Service, food and drinks are great! We had a personal concierge who helped us since the first day and explained us how the hotel worked. The rooms were great and the room service too.

reviews.author: Jose V
reviews.title: Service
reviews.text: Julian O. at the check-in... 10/10 service. The man is hilarious and is extremely helpful. Highly recommended!! We encountered absolutely no problems with our check in and service. Julian makes you feel excited to be here! Great job!!

reviews.author: Bella B

reviews.author: Ana López
reviews.title: Excelente servicio
reviews.text: El hotel es muy bonito, el servicio, la atención de TODO el personal es muy  amable, recomiendo este lugar,gracias  a los meseros atilano,  pascual,  Juan, yamil TODOS, el servicio de habitación,  la recepción,  check in fue rápido

reviews.author: Madalyn B

reviews.author: Shelby E

reviews.text: Went to this resort for a friends 30th birthday. Eadier, alajandro, and pascual were all amazing and the highlight of our day. They always knew what we needed even before we asked. Breakfast was always a treat!

reviews.author: Alexandria S

I had an amazing time!!

reviews.author: Joanna

reviews.text: I just want to say that we had an Awesome time at the Paradisus Cancun. Everyone was very nice, Especially Cesar and Rode they made sure that we were having a time. They went above and beyond, superior customer service!!! I also want to add that the nice men that work at the Nepresso counter were great as well, always added extra happiness to my cup of coffee. I can't express enough how great this experience was.

reviews.author: Letisha G
reviews.title: Girls Weekend
reviews.text: Had an amazing weekend and the best send off with the great service provided my Rode and Cesar. Rodé was an amazing host and made sure we were well taken care of. Cesar was a great server and made sure the drinks kept on coming ;) Thank you again!

reviews.author: Claudia J
reviews.title: Best Time of 2020
reviews.text:
The food,atmosphere,the staff and location was simply perfect. We stayed at the Reserve and the experience was superb. Dining a la carte service was fast. Shout out to Miguel our waiter at lapalapa, Salvador he had us couple  nights at Avenue Bar. Everyone was super attentive HUGE HUGE thanks to Rode our butler he was EXCELLENT!! We arrived late than anticipated/starving and he personally booked us at last minute for lunch waited for us to be fed to continue with our check in,very attentive, He helped us plan a day trip to playa Norte everything was magical I’ve visited Cancun  this was by far my best experience.
THANK you all we will be back soon.

reviews.author: Mauricio E
reviews.title: Hangover party
reviews.text: Excelente hotel , buenas medidas de bioseguridad , excelente atencion de todo el personal en  especial la de nuestro mayordomo asignado "Rode" .. El hotel lindisimo , la comida y la barra de licores cumplio con todas mis expectativas

reviews.author: Laura A
reviews.title: Las mejores vocaciones
reviews.text:
Estuvimos en el hotel entre el 6 y el 10 de noviembre eramos un grupo de 6 personas y tuvimos más de lo que pensábamos. En esta oportunidad nos fuimos por The Reserve, la mejor opción si quieres algo más exclusivo, empezando por el check in en una zona privada, ahi nos presentaron a RODER, nuestra ayuda para todo siempre fue una excelente comunicación, solo teníamos que preocuparnos por divertirnos.

Roder nos ayudó con cada reservación, si en algún momento necesitábamos algún tipo de servicio adicional siempre estuvo disponible para nosotros.

Al principio de nuestro viaje estábamos preocupados por el tema del COVID19 pero al llegar y ver todos los protocolos pudimos estar cómodos y sin preocupaciones puedes encontrar gel antibacterial y tapetes desinfectantes alrededor de todo el hotel, cada uno de los integrantes del staff del hotel estaban comprometidos con nuestra salud.

La comida en cada restaurante tiene un 10, puedes encontrar desde comida mexicana en restaurantes como blue agave y Mole hasta asiática con una variedad de sushi y rolls increíbles.

El servicio siempre fue cinco estrellas.

No hay duda que es una de las mejores vacaciones que he tenido

reviews.author: Ron Agudelo
reviews.title: Best vacation
reviews.text: My friends and I stayed for four days and we had our best vacation the hotel is beautiful and the attention was excellent especially from our butler Rodek he helped us en every request that we had and every single employee treat us very well definitely we will back again and hopefully soon

reviews.author: Vanessa A
reviews.title: Excelente experiencia
reviews.text: Un lugar para volver, la atención es increíble, te hacen sentir como en casa, los espacios hermosos y que mejor que la compañía y asesoría de Rode, el encargado de hacer nuestros días muy especiales. Tomamos la estadía para seis personas (3 habitaciones con vista a la laguna) en la categoría Reserve y no nos arrepentimos ni un minuto, obtuvimos un gran servicio, acceso a todos los espacios, bebidas ilimitadas, la comida con la variedad y al momento que queríamos. La playa estaba hermosa y el clima estuvo a nuestro favor.

reviews.author: Cynthia Jasmine
reviews.title: Salida de amigos!!
reviews.text: Un paraíso!! Todo estuvo espectacular. Todas las atenciones de los trabajadores, muy amables y dispuestos en ayudar. En especial Nuestro mayordomo Rodolfo, súper profesional y atento a todo lo que necesitábamos. Gracias por todas sus atenciones !!! Regresamos pronto primero dios!

reviews.author: Euddy B
reviews.title: Cancún 2020
reviews.text: Waoooo Primera vez que salgo de los Estados Unidos de vacaciones & fueron las mejores de mi vida, gracias por las atenciones & gracias a Rodolfo Mayordomo the Reserve, nos hizo todo más fácil & cómodo.

reviews.author: Gorrell
reviews.title: Excellent Service
reviews.text:
We traveled with 2 other couples and we all really enjoyed this resort.
We had standard rooms and we never felt like we were missing out or limited by not upgrading to Royal Service.
We ate at all of the a la cartes and enjoyed them. The Mexican was our least favourite. We really liked how they suggested family style dining at the restaurants to allow you to try everything. The service was fantastic. Jimmy at Vento and Veronica at Bana stood out.
We did not go to the steakhouse. It seems odd to pay the same as someone visiting the restaurant when you’re at an all inclusive.
If you are sensitive to scents, then this might not be the resort for you. There are very strong scents used in many areas.
Everyone that works here is very friendly and each one will take the time to say hello or good morning.
The batteries in the key card thing on the door stopped working. The manager happened to be walking by and stayed there with us while it was getting fixed.
We would definitely return.

reviews.author: Victoria Hall
reviews.title: Favorite vacation
reviews.text: We’ve had such a great time in Cancún and have felt like we chosen the best resort. If you find yourself in Paradisus, you MUST visit Roger in the Enso. He will take such good care of you and ensure you have the best experience for dinner!

reviews.author: Barb Frank
reviews.title: Spectacular views
reviews.text: Beautiful resort with very catering staff. Wonderful Malva buffet all day. Had Alfredo as a waiter every day and he was wonderful. Leticia took care of us poolside. Could sit at the pool but look out at the Carribean so best of both worlds.

reviews.author: Caleigh H
reviews.title: Amazing resort!!
reviews.text: My friends and I went to paradisus for our spring break and had an amazing time. Julio, Saul and Augustin from the outdoor activities staff made sure we were entertained all day and had great things to do by the pool. Ricardo and Francisco from the restaurant and bar staff really took care of us. We would definitely come back another time!

reviews.author: Ves
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Disappointed with the resort. We had a cockroach in our room. No one bothered to check in to see how our stay was, bathroom by the beach was closed for 2 days due to plumbing issues.  They had a steak house there that was extra$$$, including alcoholic drinks and lounge beds on the beach were also extra.  Food was nothing spectacular and staff could have been friendlier.  I would definitely not come back.

reviews.author: Don W
reviews.title: Another great 10 days
reviews.text:
For our third year in a row and our 5th time at this resort, we had a great time. Giovani is an amazing bartender, who has remembered us over the years, Sevey is great, the two Luis at the main pool bar, Caude at Mava has been catering to us for years. Thanks to our concierge Jose, front desk Ismael and the folks in Circle, Victor, Sandy, Bianca and Adrian.

See you all next year for a family reunion.

reviews.author: Cindy F
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: Spent 9 days at the Paradisius with friends. Resort was clean and beautiful. Staff was exceptional. Everyone went out of there way to make sure you had everything you needed. Food however was not great. Buffett foods were always cold. Reservation restaurants were much better. Vento and Fuego had wonderful menus, but not much to choose from. Entertainment was always outside, so acts were hard to see and sometimes weather could be a distraction. Good resort for the money.

reviews.author: Tayo
reviews.title: The food is not great and service could be better.
reviews.text:
The dinners were consistently below par and with the exception of a Peruvian gem of a restaurant called Fuego, I  would’ve had no joy as far as lunches and dinners are concerned. 

The second con was the frequent up-selling tactics of some of the restaurant employees.  I feel that they need to be re-trained. They come on too hard and are obvious in being overly eager. 

The last con is that for the first time in my life I was propositioned to buy some cocaine as I was at the beach. I’m not sure what can be done to prevent this from happening as far as security is concerned but it’s a bit scary that there’s nothing in place to prevent that type of person from accessing the hotel’s beach area. In the very least, there are families with kids to protect. 

On a positive note, the hotel architecture and infrastructure are just fantastic. Just a beautifully amazing place to take-in aesthetically.

We stayed at the Royal Service garm of the hotel and so we were provided with a butler called Alex. He was good. He was helpful, knowledgable, resourceful and patient. Funnily enough, I spoke to another couple who also spoke well of him.

The buffet breakfast was always well stocked with a lot of variety. No complaints.

reviews.author: anidda659344
reviews.title: Ne vaut pas le prix
reviews.text: Établissement reste figé dans les années 90. Les chambres ont besoin d’une grande rénovation, les salles de bains sont vétustes avec de vieux rideaux de douche en tissu, les baignoires sont vieilles et sales, pas assez de lumière, pas de prises électriques à côté des lits, les toilettes sont également vétustes avec de nombreuses remontées d’égouts et une odeur nauséabonde qui nous a empêché de dormir ainsi que la musique qui faisait trembler les murs! Nous avons été obligé de changer de chambre et de bâtiment car ce dernier était envahi par cette odeur masquée par de l’encens! La décoration est has been et n’a rien d’un 5 étoiles de 2020. La restauration n’est pas innovante, recyclage des aliments de repas en repas, si vous n’êtes pas VIP vous ne pouvez pas prendre de matelas lits sur la plage sauf paiement de 50 US$ Ce qui est scandaleux quand vous payez la nuit 430€! Heureusement que le personnel demeure sympathique malgré le manque d’effectif qui les paralysent. Il faudrait soit effectuer des travaux pour refaire votre hôtel à neuf soit baisser considérablement les prix!

reviews.author: jgoldie
reviews.title: Gorgeous resort
reviews.text: This is a beautiful resort inside & out. Great staff always friendly and helpful. We have been coming here for 20+ years and love it. The check in process for member services is brutal 30 min + to check in & 30 min + to check out. This needs to be changed....Who wants to spend that kind of time on vacation??? It should be a few minutes for check in & out. The hotel guest can check in & out quickly..why can't members??? This NEEDS to change......They have entertainment every night. Which is usually pretty good. Although this week it was hard to see. We miss the Michael Jackson show they usually have. It would be nice if they had chairs around the pool to see the shows... the high tables should be set way back... they block the view for everyone else. This is in the hotel zone right next to the JW Marriott.  It's about 20min from the airport. The pools are beautiful.  There is a swim up bar. The beach is huge. There could be more chairs & umbrellas around the pool so people don't take other people's chairs & umbrellas. I saw other vacationers removing personal stuff from chairs & taking them. Unfortunately there are people from other countries that this is common practice but just maybe if there were enough chairs they wouldn't do it. Always a great vacation & excellent place to stay and one of the most beautiful resorts in Cancun.

reviews.author: Joanne B
reviews.title: Quelle déception
reviews.text: Je suis présentement au Paradisus Cancún!! 1er fois à ce resort mais 4e dans un Paradisus et plus jamais!! Le seul point positif est la plage!! Les resto à la carte aucun choix en fait toute la nourriture est très ordinaire !! La chambre très ordinaire !! Et nous sommes au Club Melia!!! Rien d'intéressant et de wow dans ce resort!! Loin d'un 5 étoiles!! 😡😥

reviews.author: Meg C
reviews.title: Best Resort in Cancun!
reviews.text: Paradisus is by far the most beautiful and entertaining resort in Cancun! The staff go above and beyond to make the guests feel welcome and like friends. Alan, Agustin, and of course our favorite bartender Jimmy are our favorite guys! We come every year with a large group and I look forward to it more and more each time. Thank you for the wonderful stay, see you soon! 😊

reviews.author: matthew H
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text:
Food was impressive considering it is all inclusive. On par with Marriotts I have stayed at in Hawaii. Royal service staff is excellent. Our butler Alex was awesome and Rosana always went out of her way to make sure we were happy. Ask for Victor and Eddie by the pool, very attentive and great attitudes. Aaron by the pool always had us set up with towels and checked on us to make sure we were happy. Coco beach bar is great and Victor the bartender made that experience even better.

Planning on coming back with my wife in a few months.

reviews.author: Katherine P
reviews.title: Bigger isn’t always better — but it’s still fun
reviews.text:
We just came back from Paradisus as a group of 12 family and friends to celebrate my husband’s 30th birthday. I generally try to read reviews and become familiar with “things to know” ahead of a trip. Knowing dinner reservations would be hard, I asked about booking ahead of time...we were told this wasn’t allowed (I get that). I also inquired about having our five rooms be considered to be in the same pyramid (we had separate bookings) but received no response or an attempt to see if that was possible. So, our party was spread across the five pyramids. 

In short, we struggled to get a dinner reservation for half of our stay. Guest services tried to help with dinner the second night when we were striking out and “booked” us for 9pm at Mole. We waited for this late dinner with an infant and toddler, only to have Mole tell us they didn’t have the reservation. It took some obnoxious insistence on our part — and luckily, some proof that we weren’t mistaken — for some accommodations to be made. The remaining nights we booked without issue at Enso and Ibiro. Luis at Ibiro was exceptional!

Check-in was kind of slow (which is tough when you’ve arrived and are trying to salvage some beach time at 2pm) and they couldn’t find one room’s second occupant on file — when she booked directly with the hotel as an add-on and made payment. When WE found her information and showed the emails and confirmations, they ended up putting two strangers in our group with a king bed which wasn’t great. Fortunately, they were able to switch rooms for the remaining three nights. But, their new room had construction nearby, beginning around 8am. :-/

We had another couple with two children have to switch rooms twice over a four night stay — the first time, quick ant-like bugs were crawling all over by their mini fridge and into their bags after that late dinner. The second time, water was leaking from their bathroom ceiling all over the floor. The second move they were upgraded to an ocean view.

These were annoying hiccups and I felt responsible since I found the place and asked people to celebrate with us. I honestly just think the hotel is so big, these issues are bound to happen to a portion with people’s stays. The remaining three rooms in our party didn’t have issues.

With that said, Christian from Guest Services pulled through and helped make the stay MUCH better the second half. ALSO, the hotel is really grand and stunning and food is above average for an all inclusive. The pool and beach are incredible. And, the beach cabanas are so fun! Even with these hiccups, there’s no way you can’t have an amazing time unless you’re a wet blanket. :-) Many guests from our party would return, and despite some of the mess-ups, I probably would, too. Some particularly friendly staff help make you feel at home.

I just wish I was back!

reviews.author: FrequentFlier639583
reviews.title: Excelente hotel lo disfrutas mucho.
reviews.text: Magnifico lugar para la familia o amigos, todos muy amables y la calidad del servicio y comida está al 100! Volvería a ir a ese hotel, casi ni hay necesidad de salirte a buscar otro lugar ahí lo tiene todo

reviews.author: El Duque
reviews.title: No vuelvo ni regalado.
reviews.text:
Tuvimos problemas desde el principio.

La estancia nos la habían regalado unos amigos y según llegamos a la puerta nos dicen que tenemos que presentar la tarjeta con la que se hizo la compra. Para empezar, la reserva se había hecho a través de PayPal, por lo que es una tarjeta digital que no se puede presentar e independientemente al ser un regalo no teníamos la identificación. Todo esto se resumió en que tuvimos que adelantar sobre 1.000 Euros como si estuviéramos haciendo la reserva en el momento y tardaron al rededor de 15 días en verificar que había sido por PayPal y devolvernos nuestro dinero.
A todo esto cabe destacar lo impertinentes que eran los que nos estaban atendiendo en la recepción.

Las habitaciones no están mal, pero un poco pequeñas.

La comida por lo general bastante desastre tanto en el buffet como en los restaurantes. 

No vuelvo ahí ni aunque me lo regalen, nunca mejor dicho.

reviews.author: bruna a
reviews.title: Instalaciones súper
reviews.text: Instalaciones impresionantes, playa maravillosa, muchas gracias a Bernardo Pérez de piso que nos ha ayudado a la instalación de una cama extra en la habitación. Desafortunadamente el servicio no ha sido lo que me esperaba, el equipo de recepción no está bastante formado sobre el programa melia rewards y sobre las posibles peticiones de los huéspedes, hay mucho margen de mejora.

reviews.author: Vanessa Y
reviews.title: Las mejores vacaciones en paradisus
reviews.text:
Me encanto la estancia en este gran hotel. Ame su habitación que es una cosa preciosa , los restaurantes están súper ricos y la comida súper variada, el servicio es excelente y muuuuy rápido. Pero me voy muy emocionada y agradecida con el equipo de animación el encargado de el grupo de adolescentes fue siempre el mejor en cuanto a tiempos y actividades Saul Zárate .
Julio de actividades fue súper amable y atento y los tiempos se acomodan para todos . E llevo un gran sabor de boca con estos chicos . Sin dejar a un lado los shows que fueron fantásticos ,estoy enamorada del de acrobacias

reviews.author: GoPlaces574689
reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text: The Paradiusis hotel royal service all inclusive was excellent. We really enjoyed our stay and Alex our coordinator was very friendly, helpful and always very willing to help us enjoy our stay. The amenities were awesome. We would definitely come back.

reviews.author: Sarah D
reviews.title: Royal service
reviews.text:
This is our second stay at this resort. The first was our wedding (amazing, review posted for those interested) this stay solidified our decision to continue to come back to this resort! Royal service is wonderful although I couldn’t imagine having a bad time if you tried here. Rode our butler has been great! Always checking in to see if we need anything and making sure our stay in nothing short of perfection! Highly recommend him if you are traveling here and staying royal service.

Food is delicious and plentiful. Beach is amazing and needs to be seen to really understand just how beautiful it really is. Lots of beach chairs and cabanas for shade. The pools are great and fun with the drinks never running dry!

Royal service allows you to have private check in, private pool and beach, butler service and so much more! Adults only as well if you aren’t traveling with children and appreciate the quiet 😉
Overall it would be hard to imagine anything better than Paradisus Cancun! We highly recommend it and can’t wait to stay for our 3rd time!

reviews.author: Tom
reviews.title: Royal service
reviews.text: Royal service is the way to go! Rode as our butler tops things off! Awesome guy always taking the time to chat and make sure there’s nothing we need! We will definitely be staying here again! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Roberto P
reviews.title: Muito ruim
reviews.text:
Compramos o pacote All Inclusive, no entanto, nos deparamos com uma enormidade de serviços pagos, e não fomos informados disto.
Para conseguir um serviço de qualidade, era preciso pagar por eles, já que os serviços incluídos no pacote All Inclusive eram de má qualidade. 
Os restaurantes incluídos no All Inclusive são de péssima qualidade, com péssimo atendimento e comida ruim. 
Os elevadores cheiram mal, no entanto, a limpeza dos quartos é muito boa.
O único serviço bem prestado foi o do café da manhã do Blueagave, e no bar da piscina, locais onde os funcionários são super dispostos, simpáticos e atenciosos.
As cadeiras da piscina e da praia incluídas no All Inclusive são insuficientes para a demanda, exigindo que o hóspede adquira a diária de um dos bangalôs, que custa 150 dólares. Sendo assim, ou o hóspede adquire o bangalô, ou fica de pé, caso não consiga uma vaga nos locais gratuitos, o que é muito desconfortável.
Por fim, ressalto o péssimo atendimento do garçom do restaurante japonês e do atendente Jerry, das toalhas, que inclusive iniciou uma discussão conosco durante uma negociação de um passeio.
Enfim, se não fosse pela praia maravilhosa e pelas belezas naturais do local, a viagem seria muito frustrante.

reviews.author: alfredocX4700HU
reviews.title: In average
reviews.text: The staff at the check-in area and at restaurants generally unwilling to serve us. Asking for 16 people was impossible in all restaurants. Asking to move a table was impossible. Grudgingness in most waiters.

reviews.author: Mauricio B
reviews.title: Não espere um super resort , apenas razoável com instalações mais antigas e muitos colaboradores grosseiros
reviews.text: Hotel mais antigo com vários restaurantes fechados e alguns apenas para sócios do club melia. Alimentação menos que razoável. Colaboradores grosseiros . Vale a pena pela área da piscina, praia , bebidas excelentes e pela Irina  que nos serviu na praia.

reviews.author: Alicia H
reviews.title: Wonderful trip!
reviews.text: I came with my friend, neither of us had done an all-inclusive before, but we will definitely do one again after this! We are already planning our next trip to Paradisus and plan to do Royal Service again!

reviews.author: llj23
reviews.title: First time here and wow.... we loved it!! Royal service is a must do.
reviews.text: The Royal service was worth the upgrade! Cyndi our butler did a superb job booking us reservations for dinner and getting our garments cleaned and ironed. Having Cyndi made us feel special and took care of us so we could recharge and relax! Cyndi was thoughtful and professional!!!

reviews.author: joaofsp
reviews.title: Bom
reviews.text: Hotel bom, porém os restaurantes não estavam funcionando pelo menos a metade e falta um pouco de treinamento  dos funcionários principalmente dos garços para os hóspedes, mais no mais a experiência  foi muito boa

reviews.author: Charly Ibañez
reviews.title: Viaje de 40 años
reviews.text: El hotel es muy bueno en líneas generales, creo que podría mejorar un poco la calidad y variedad de los alimentos en el buffet y la climatización de las áreas comunes, hacia calor en ellas. Lo demás impecable! El saldo en general es positivo y lo visitaría nuevamente sin dudarlo. Muy cordial el trato de los empleados.

reviews.author: Becca
reviews.title: Nice staff but loud amplified music at night
reviews.text:
At first we thought the hotel would be great for our trip; however, a couple of nights in loud amplified music was being performed in the hotel central area. It was VERY loud in our room and this wasn’t something the hotel staff had warned us about. This was really obnoxious when we wanted to get enough rest before getting an early start. When we called the front desk to inquire about turning the volume down, they said the music was scheduled to go until 11PM (on a Monday night!) and that we could move rooms. Not sure why that was the best option - to inconvenience paying guests who had already unpacked to move and settled in the room to move? 

Besides the loud music, the hotel was okay but not great, especially considering the expense. The pool and beach are really nice, but be aware that the nice looking Bali beds in the advertising are an extra charge. 

Additionally, the food is hit or miss. La Palapa was quite nice and the grilled food by the pool was great. We liked the sushi restaurant in the middle of the hotel. The burger place by the pool was mediocre at best. The food at Mole and Blue Agave missed the mark. 

Drinks throughout the resort were good and again the staff was very nice. The swim up bar was great! 

Our room was very clean and well kept. Linens and towels were okay quality, but not great. The pillows were also kind of odd. The furniture and decor were pretty outdated. We didn’t have a bad experience, but I wouldn’t recommend this place or come back to it. I think there are probably better resorts in the area for comparable prices.

reviews.author: cathellecarrillo
reviews.title: Treated like Royalty
reviews.text: WOW I cannot tell enough people how happy we are with our experience. We chose Royal Service to for my bday trip. Norma our butler took every single thing we were concerned with and made all our arrangements. She was attentive and overall extraordinary! All of the staff was amazing. Bana was our FAV restaurant,  we tried almost everything ln the menu and it was sooo tasty! Took advantage of the cabana beds included with royal service and the treatment was stellar thanks to Oscar and Orlando! The spa was nice as well, Lulu was super pleasant but the water therapy pools need updating and cleaning. Loved the sauna and mist room. The royal service lobby area was a must stop everytime we passed by. From premium liquor, to iced coffee, meat and cheese platters and desserts i dont know what I loved more. I already miss being there! Cant wait to be back

reviews.author: Andréia F
reviews.title: Experiência Incrível!!!
reviews.text: Desde a localização, segurança, recepção ao chegar ao resort até ao check out, sempre prestativos em todas as informações e situações, restaurantes maravilhosos, na minha opinião o melhor é o restaurante japonês, tudo perfeito...

reviews.author: Luís Gerardo gonzalez
reviews.title: 7 primos y un extraño
reviews.text: La verdad lo mejor que les puedo desir exelente experiencia todo exelente en especial nuestro mayordomo RODÉ exelente persona muy profecional  mil felicidades a todo el personal me la pase como rey y claro que pronto nos veremos por aya

reviews.author: Montaruli
reviews.title: Royal Service
reviews.text: We stayed in Royal Service pyramid 5 on the 4th floor. Our room was beautiful. We had a butter named Rode who was excellent and took care of our every need. We were a large group of 8 with another couple who are owners and not in Royal service. Our Rode went above and beyond to make sure our entire experience was perfect. We were a needy group. He was very professional. The entire Royal service area was amazing. Some of the restaurants were closed for renovations and we were upset but the Royal service group made up for this. We felt we were missing nothing! Daniel is the man! He made sure were treated royally. Julio, Aaron inside royal pyramid, Oscar at la palapa, Manuel one of The Royal service bartender, Josue at the pool or in Royal pyramid, Julio at la palapa, Aron pool concierge ,Valeria at the pool and in Royal service, Moses at the pool or royal service or at la palapa,Christian and Victor at Enzo. I am sure I am forgetting names. These people made the trip special! Moses was one of my very favorites. It is amazing to watch this man work. He knows his stuff!! Because of these people I would definitely come back! The beach was beautiful! The color of the water amazing. We were very happy!

reviews.author: Nacho F
reviews.title: BUEN HOTEL PERO FALLAN MUCHOS DETALLES
reviews.text: Las camas son tremendamente incómodas. El grifo de la ducha estaba roto. Nuestra habitación se llenaba de agua cuando llovía fuerte. Pedimos una cama supletoria que aún estamos esperando que nos manden.

reviews.author: NYQT320
reviews.title: Cancun take two
reviews.text: Came here in March of 2019,loved it so much we became Meliá Club members and couldn’t wait to come back. Jamie Castro was there to set up whatever we needed from Bali beds to spa and dinner reservations. Asunción was our server on the beach. She was amazing and our drinks were never empty. Their are so many others who were so helpful and friendly from room service to getting towels. Danille gave an amazing massage as well. This resort is so well run I look forward to going back again and again!

reviews.author: Allie M
reviews.title: The staff is amazing!
reviews.text: Very clean and beautiful resort. The staff in every part of the resort is amazing. Josè at the Market and Hugo at the pools were extra fantastic! Super sweet, attentive, and fun! The beach is incredible, sand is so soft and the water is unbelievable.

reviews.author: Aline C
reviews.title: Restaurante lindo, mas atendimento deixou a desejar
reviews.text:
O hotel é lindo, as acomodações são mto boas, vista incrível se vc optar pelo quarto com vista para o oceano, mas deixou mto a desejar. 
Optamos pelo quarto com vista para o oceano e pedimos cama king para casal, ao chegar no hotel nos informaram que não tinha mais quartos com cama grande e apenas a de “viúva”, questionei e o recepcionista do hotel me disse que escolhemos o quarto e não a cama. 
O hotel não serve bebida com álcool antes das 11h da manhã, para pedir comida no quarto vc precisa pagar a taxa de 5dolares por cada pedido. 
Funcionários mal humorados
A maioria dos restaurantes precisa de reserva e após sentar, todos precisam pedir juntos, ngm pode atrasar, se alguém atrasa essa pessoa não pode mais pedir.

reviews.author: M.Potter
reviews.title: Great experience with a Melia resort
reviews.text:
Everything was fantastic. The place, although a little bit dated, has such a hospitable staff. That's what you'd expect when you're in an all inclusive resort and they delivered. Every staff introduced to me remembered my name and they'd greet me with such warm smiles whenever they see me. Outside you'll see the exterior of the hotel modeled to look like Chichen Itza, the calendar/temple of the Mayans. As you enter you'll see vines hanging from each balcony surrounding the pyramid-like interior. It is as if you have entered the heart of the jungle. With the comforts of modern technology, shops and restaurants. Exit through the back and you'll be greeted with an amazing view of the blue waters from the Caribbean. 
Blue Agave, the restaurant visited for lunch had good Mexican food. They're menu only consists of three items: 2 types of soup, tacos and quesadillas. I went for lunch and they only served the tacos. Enso, the restaurant I tried for dinner had a buffet and a la Carte menu. Enso is an asian buffet restaurant while the a la carte came from the Market Grill menu(it is closed at night due to renovations,2019) a brazilian fusion restaurant. The buffet at night changes nightly. The a la carte was awesome. My friends were obsessed with the octopus. I was liking the steak cooked to my preference. You can order from the a la carte menu as much as your heart's desire. We went back to Enso both for breakfast and lunch at different days and I can say it was not bad. We also went to the Market grill during lunch time and they offered some good selection of pork, beef, poultry and fish. I'm a meat lover not so much a vegetable eater so I cannot say much about they're vegetable selections. The fish and chicken I like, the beef a little tough and the pork a bit bland for my taste. Mole, a traditional mexican restaurant that offers dinner had awesome plating for a casual dining. They got the concept right. They served food like it was a tasting menu. Appetizers, soups and salads performed well but the mains not so much. We ordered octopus, duck and a meat platter but only the duck had some promise. The octupus was better at Enso. This comes from a person who did not appreciate the strong gamey flavor that was the lamb from the meat platter. Bana, a japanese restaurant that can be missed. If you think this place is good, you've never been to Japan or tasted authentic japanese cuisine. I thought it was edible at the least, my friends did not like the strong fishy flavor and smell that came from their sushi. In other words, the fish wasn't fresh. This is the biggest reason why my rating isn't perfect. We weren't able to try the other restaurants they offered due to time constraints but I wish we did. Tempo is their fine dining experience we missed, and las palapas was another one, overlooking the ocean, was missed because we didnt make the reservation. The drinks at any of the places that offered it was ok though not consistent. Sometimes you'll get the right amount of alcohol sometimes too little, sometimes too strong. I guess being in an all inclusive resort means the bartenders don't need to measure. Finally, the spa. Disclaimer, I didn't expect much about the spa because I've been to other spa and they were awesome at a fraction of a price. Also, I went there just after a water activity which was nauseating. With that said, Yhi spa is spectacular. They have a huge jacuzzi, rainfall shower rooms, sauna and steam room, a spacious lounge with a small snack bar by the jacuzzi, towels and slippers for your comfort, nicely dimmed waiting room while waiting for your massage room to be ready and the massage room itself that has it's own tub and shower room. I haven't even started the massage but I already felt pampered. Then I get to the massage. My masseuse did something and I can't remember anything but me snoring. Kidding. I fell asleep for sure but before I fell asleep from the most relaxing massage. Overall the service from yhi spa is superb if you can afford it. It will knock you back by 85-145usd without the tax. Overall, paradisus cancun is only one of the many hotel resorts offered by Melia but one that should be visited nonetheless for an experience that should be remembered for a long time.

reviews.author: rmorri622268
reviews.title: Cancun October 2019
reviews.text: Royal Service at Paradisus was amazing.  Our butler George was very attentive and provided great service during our stay.  The Spa and beach were just what we needed to create a perfect vacation and break before the holiday madness begins!

reviews.author: Sarah Y
reviews.title: Very Humid, Disappointing Food, Not Worth It
reviews.text:
When we checked in, we did not get a room with two beds as per our initial booking - which was fine but then we asked for a room with a better view to make up for this, which they also did not provide. When we were getting our tour of the facility, it was very clear that the hotel was undergoing construction... the tour guide even mentioned "I hope you were made aware of the fact that we are undergoing construction ahead of time" - we were not. The construction was noisy and the elevators did not work. We were on the third floor which is not so bad but I would hate to know what someone who is elderly or disabled would have done.

The staff was very nice and the bed was comfortable but the hotel was SUPER hot and humid... to the point that we were sweating while we were walking through and even while we were sitting at the restaurants. 

Unfortunately the food at the pool/beach (which was the same restaurant they used for room service) was NOT good... it seemed like everything was frozen. Food always came cold... at the pool/beach and in the room.

The food at the Japanese restaurant inside the hotel was also not good... the sushi did not taste fresh and the rice was hard. The ceviche had a strange consistency.

On a positive note, the traditional Mexican restaurant (Mole) was very good so at least we had one positive food experience.

Overall, I would not recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Meera V
reviews.title: Orlando Bello is the best !!
reviews.text: Make sure you stop by the coffee bar and have Orlando make you a coffee ! He’s is such an amazing person ! He also serves breakfast at Naos. He is very attentive and always gets the order right. An ever smiling face : )

reviews.author: Ginavite
reviews.title: Bah
reviews.text:
Súper normal!
Los cuartos viejos, la comida terrible , los camastros de la playa y de la alberca viejos, incómodos, la atención del personal buena, están remodelando una aérea y desde las 8am empiezan a trabajar si querías levantarte tarde, olvídalo. 
Gracias al mar del caribe y nuestras actividades fuera del hotel, no me voy con mal sabor de boca 😒

reviews.author: alinesiwa
reviews.title: Hotel bonito e confortável, porém, comida e estrutura dos restaurantes deixam a desejar
reviews.text:
O hotel é muito bonito e impactante com seu jardim interno. Os quartos são amplos e a cama bem confortável. O chuveiro é ruim e com pouca pressão. A limpeza tbm deixa um pouco a desejar. Eles deixam uma cafeteira nespresso no quarto, porém  a reposição das capsulas só ocorria qd eu solicitava. 
Piscina bonita, bar molhado ok, praia linda, boa estrutura de guarda-sol e cadeiras (apesar de saber que na alta temporada são difíceis de conseguir). 
E como qualquer resort no Caribe, você só será bem atendido se der gorjeta. 
O ponto mais fraco desse hotel é a comida. Pouca variedade, falta de criatividade e pouco sabor. Apenas dois restaurantes eram climatizados, os demais eram abertos. Então você come e transpira litros e fica bem desconfortável, além de ter que ficar atento pra nenhuma ave chegar no seu prato. 
Eu viajei com meu marido e filho de 7 meses, e por isso, contratamos o upgrade Family Concierge. Eles tem um lounge diferente para checkin e checkout, além de fornecerem mimos e surpresas pra nós ao longo da estadia. Porém, a não ser que seu filho tenha mais de 2 anos não aconselho investir nesse upgrade pq será pouco utilizado como foi o nosso caso.

reviews.author: Felipe V
reviews.title: Excelente todo!
reviews.text: Muy buenas instalaciones, pero por sobre todo el buen servicio del personal. Especialmente a Armando y su equipo del buffet Enso. Siempre muy atentos, muy educados, atentos a todo lo que necesitamos. Muchas gracias, volveremos!!

reviews.author: mafischl
reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: Paradisus is a beautiful resort. It has a couple of really nice pools and the rooms. We stayed in the Royal Service section. We played the nine hole golf course. It was a par 3 course. Not in great condition. Some of the food was delicious. Some just okay. Personally I don't love all inclusive resorts, but as they go this is a pretty nice one.

reviews.author: AustinFelich
reviews.title: NOT AS GOOD AS FIRST TIME
reviews.text:
My wife and I got engaged at the Paradisus in 2016. We had been to other resorts in Cancun and the Paradisus was at the top. We made sure we went back. 

I read a lot of reviews before booking the second time, I should have taken them more seriously. Inside the hotel is very hot, you may not notice it the minute you walk in, but it won’t take long. It’s frustrating after a while. The inside of the resort is absolutely beautiful. The service is great, everyone is very nice. There were a couple workers who kept pushing the 90 minute breakfast to promote their Meliá time share deal. They wouldn’t take no for answer. I acted like I was on my phone multiple times to avoid these couple workers. The food was not as good this time around either. There were a couple restaurants under construction so that made the selection smaller. The breakfast at the two buffets is average at best. The snack bar by the pool had decent food. The wings there were really good and the pizza wasn’t bad. The market grill Brazilian steakhouse was good. The Asian restaurant Bana in the middle and the Mexican restaurant Blue agave were also good. My wife’s and her friends stomach were upset for multiple days. Not sure what it was from. 

The bartenders and waiters/waitresses at the pool were all awesome. Great service. One thing about the pool...the most shallow part is where the bar is, and there are kids all over and around the bar area. I don’t mind kids at all but there were way to many around the pool bar. 

Beach area is great, water and sand were amazing. The waiters/waitresses on the beach were all awesome also. 

The rooms were ok, nothing great or anything to really complain about them. I did feel like the AC worked less and less or got a little warmer as the week progressed. 

If it weren’t for the service I wouldn’t have given the resort three stars. We will always remember the Paradisus from getting engaged there. But we will be staying at another resort next time in Cancun.

reviews.author: Denise_Rocha
reviews.title: Maravilhoso!!!
reviews.text: Sem palavras... o hotel é simplesmente divino!!! Os funcionários são atenciosos, simpáticos ao extremo, educados!!! Tive um pequeno problema ao chegar mas que foi resolvido com tamanha delicadeza e atenção pelo atendente que acabei até esquecendo! Os restaurantes são bons, mas achei pouca variedade...  Gostei mais do café da manhã! Os drinks são ótimos! O visual do hotel... sem maturidade para comentar!!! Recomendo ficar de frente para o mar!!!

reviews.author: Kikays
reviews.title: Really a Paradise!
reviews.text: We had a great time staying for one week.The staff are all friendly and accommodating from the Bell Boy,Front Desk Francisco,Concierge Pablo and Rodrigo,our Housekeeper,our favorite staff in Enzo namely Mar,Gabriella and Martin.The food and drinks are awesome.They have a variety of food to choose from everyday.Special mention also to Carlos our favorite staff bringing our food esp at night time.The hotel is very nice and well kept.Really a paradise.Would love to come back again.

reviews.author: hrafique77
reviews.title: Overall good experience
reviews.text: Overall trip was good. Lobby/floors really warm no AC. Checking in they gave us a room that already had someone in there. Had to go back to checkin desk and wait another 35 mins. Next day the keys to our room stopped working. Trying calling from "floor telephone" didn't work. Nonetheless they gave us a complimentary champagne bottle. Thank you for that. But I'd prefer a relaxing checkin experience after a long flight

reviews.author: alejandra mutio
reviews.title: Pésimo hotel, pésimo servicio.
reviews.text:
Check in duro 1 hr. No tenían mi reservacion lista, no servían sus terminales, nadie se dirigia a mi para explicarme el por qué de la tardanza. Una hr parada esperando a que me dieran mi habitación. 

Reserve en el restaurante de especialidades mexicano y sólo había cupo para las 11 pm, soy vegana y me sirvieron una lasagna de verduras en un restaurante mexicano. La mesera gritaba y aplaudía diciendo "ya nos vamos"... Como si tuviera prisa de que nos pararamos de la mesa por el horario. Me hace pensar que la lasagna y la Falta de creatividad del chef Fuera proque tambien tenía prisa de irse.

En el área de la alberca no usan sustituto de azúcar. Así que la Ndsdf me dijo rotjndamente: no hay, si quiere puede ir al restaurante a pedir su limonada con estevia.

En el coffee Shop le pedí al encargado que me Diera el nespresso más ligero y me dice: se lo voy a hacer pero sino le gusta no me pida otro.

El aire acondicionado lo servía y tardaron 40 minutos en llegar a la habitación.

Al final de mi estancia di toda esta información a concierge y la respuesta principal fue: a la próxima reserve en servicio real ahí no hay quejas.

Pésimo servicio, pésimo seguimiento.

reviews.author: Jesse V
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: By far one of the nicest resorts I’ve stayed at. Beach is beautiful, pool is massive, rooms are great, extremely clean, and the staff is next level friendly. Francisco, Eduardo, and Luis are incredible bar staff - friendly, fun, make you feel like friends. 10/10 would recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: Araceli
reviews.title: Vacaciones con amigos!!!
reviews.text:
Excelente vacación, con excelentes amigos @ Paradisus Cancun!!! Los que hicieron nuestra vacación extra especial:
Jairo - Reservaciones
Enso - Alberto, Amayrani y Eliseo, el mejor servicio al cliente, super amables, anticipando lo que necesitábamos y siempre sonriendo.
Asunsion y Gabriela - super trabajadoras, recomendando los mejores bebidas para la playa y para mantenernos a tono :)
El excelente equipo de Actividades: Alan, Rodrigo y Julio!!! Las clases de spinning y boot camp, el paseo en kayaks y el volleyball de la playa, otro nivel, gracias!!!
Penelope - Excelente servicio en el Grill
Y “last but not least” Naomi, Senney y GIOVANI del Lobby Bar, lo mejor de la noche!!! Giovani el “mejor” mixiologo de Cancun!!!!
GRACIAS a todos por hacernos sentir super ESPECIALES!!!! Nos vemos en el 2020!!!!

reviews.author: Daniel Hernández
reviews.title: Excelente atención
reviews.text: Fuimos un grupos de 11. Excelente atención por parte del personal desde principio a fin, siempre muy atentos y preocupados de que todos pasemos una estadía de calidad. Alimentos y bebidas de alto nivel. Instalaciones muy buenas condiciones, se nota que hay una preocupación por el buen mantenimiento del hotel. Si o si volveremos!

reviews.author: inmacg
reviews.title: Omitieron informacion sobre locales
reviews.text: Mis amigas y yo fuimos hoy martes a pasar el dia al club de playa cocos beach club en paradisus y llamamos para pedir info de vistos para locales y los I got Aton que 2500 pesos por Bali esa para 6 personas y entra hasta cierra cantidad de consumo de bebidas y comida pero estando allá para hacer el feta presumir para llegar el consumo de lo que nos cobraban para aprovechar solo éramos 3 adultos y una ninla de menos de 2 años estando allá mi amiga que había pedido info por corro le informaron que salía entre semana de lunes a jueves 500 por persona y niños menores de 5 años cero costo .. indignadas por no haber wifi informadas le comentamos nuestro enfado al camarero el cual nos atendió muy bien pero también fue la persona que los atendió la Llamada para la información de costos le dijimos la información recibida por correo y nos dijo que lo preguntaría y pues finalmente nos dijo que se quedaría así  como tenías de consumo quecasi llegaba a los 2 mil .. pero los hubiera gustado tener la otra opción pues pedíamos consumo solo para llegar a la cantidad .. u el menú todo era mucho totopos y jitomate y cebolla y poca comida..

reviews.author: Nikki
reviews.title: Beautiful resort! Ask for Alan!
reviews.text: My friends and I had a great time at this beautiful resort. We participated in many of the activities held on and off the resort. Alan, one of the workers, made sure we had a wonderful time and always went out of his way to include us in the activities. Because of him we all had a great time. I would definitely stay at Paradisus again.

reviews.author: Dorothy Nicklis
reviews.title: Dorothy Nicklis
reviews.text:
Great service by our Butler Rhode.
All of the employees were very pleasant and helpful. Food was very good and rooms were well kept. Managers were always concerned about our happiness on a daily basis. It was my first time there but I would go back again.

reviews.author: Silvia
reviews.title: Viaje de amigas
reviews.text:
Viaje soñado!! El lugar es increíble!! 
La atención es buenísima, ya en sea en restaurantes como en todo el hotel!!
Destacacamos en entretenimientos a Alan que tiene toda la onda y le da el toque de diversión al resort!! 👏👏👏👏 
Gracias Alan por hacer que la pasemos genial!!🤗

reviews.author: Fabiana
reviews.title: Viaje de chicas!!
reviews.text:
La pasamos súper!!! 🌴☀️💦🌙⭐️El lugar es soñado!!!! 😍!!!
La atención en los restaurantes excelente, la comida con una muy linda  presentación , muy buena calidad y sabor!!!! 😋!! 
Queremos destacar la atención en el Market grill de Penelope!!!! 👏👏 siempre con una sonrisa y predispuesta!!! 
En el restaurante Mole , disfrutamos y aprendimos  secretos de la comida mexicana Gracias a Víctor Salaya !!! 
Y suprema atención en el sector Royal Service, agradecemos a TODO el personal que nos hicieron sentir como “dos  Reinas”!!! ☺️

reviews.author: 449ashac
reviews.title: Girls Trip
reviews.text:
On arrival the hotel is stunning and luxurious from the drive up the entrance and walking into the hotel. The staff are happy and helpful. They handed beautiful smelling towels that’s very refreshing after a long flight.

On checking in there was an issue, we was given the wrong rooms. The check in staff did apologise and sent a bottle of Prosecco up to apologise. We was moved to the correct rooms 2 days later. 

The food isn’t great considering it’s 5*. I was expecting better. My group and I got food poisoning from 2 of the restaurants (Mole and Mix grill).

There could be more sun loungers with umbrellas as it’s too hot and dangerous to be laying directly in the sun all day. Skin cancer is real people! They have booths that are in the shade however you can’t sit on these for more that 2 mins without staff saying it’s $70 for these. Which is very cheeky as they all in the shade giving most people not much choice but to either burn or pay extra. 

You also have to pay $35 just to use the spa facilities considering it’s all inclusive I think this is also cheeky. Access to use the facilities should be free. 

However all being said I had a lovely stay! The staff couldn’t be more helpful and cheerful. The hotel is clean, room was always cleaned well. Thanks

reviews.author: JeanDenis1985
reviews.title: tres bien vue le prix
reviews.text: nous étions un groupe de 12, tout le monde semblait etre ravi, les chambres sont magnifique et propre. le services est impeccable partout. le seul hic c'est que en septembre s'est la saison morte donc il y a des resto en réno(fermé): vento, naos. le palapa est pour le service royale. la nourriture est tres bonne mais moins de choix vue la periode de l année. les piscine sont bien mais sans plus. la plage est merveilleuse. rempli de palapa. Nous avons eté chanceux on a seulement payé 1075$. normalement il coute 1600 et plus. j'aurai jamais payé ce prix pour cette hotel. mais je le recommande a bon prix. tres bonne hotel

reviews.author: off2thekeys
reviews.title: Not anywhere close to perfection
reviews.text:
Walking in was very lovely with a smell and vibe of a spa inclusive of cold fragrant towels to wash your face upon arrival. We were taken to the check in the area until that our room would not be ready until three. They went over the policies of the resort and then you meet with a resort planner to tell you about the restaurants and such. It was at this time that we found out that three of the restaurants were closed.  They asked if we were celebrating anything so we share we were celebrating my birthday which is this month. 

We went to the taco/quesadilla place for lunch only to find out that if you’re vegetarian your only choice is cheese. They only offer pork, chicken or beef. The beans are not vegetarians he cannot have that.

We looked on the site before coming here and there is zero mention of any renovations or construction. But I’ll put arrival we found out that three of the restaurants we could’ve used are closed for renovations. When we spoke with Margarita she told us that it was on the website which we went back on the website to confirm that it actually was not listed as having any construction she was quite defensive with us and kept telling us that it was posted on the website but in fact it is not. 

When we finally got to our room the door was broken into the balcony so hot air it was flowing in as well as water. We tried to have air-conditioning compensate her but it was impossible. We call downstairs six different times asking to be changed to a different room. Keep in mind we were told a check and that they were only at 40% occupancy so we know that there are other rooms available. They sent to people from housekeeping and one person for me except they never shared with us what was happening. Finally during the six calls we spoke to said she would get somebody to move us in 45 minutes. At that hour we called and they were told that they were on our way it was another 15 minutes before anyone showed up. Unfortunately couldn’t do much on the resort because we needed to wait to get to our room and get everything settled.

The new room was bright and well appointed with perfect air-conditioning. There is a small step to get into the bathroom   This is a major fall risk and horrible trip hazard. 

But we had wasted three hours of her first day which was not appropriate. When we went to talk to Margarita about it, she made it as if she did it a favor to ask by changing our room. We explained that we paid for with air-conditioning and so really just change our room was not doing us a favor. It started to get a little heated which was also inappropriate.

She asked what we could do for us and we asked if we could have dinner in the upscale restaurant and we were told that it was not for us only for private guests. We tried to explain that we we’re not asking for a discount in the room; she didn’t even offer an upgrade or a free massage or a free cabana on the beach or anything just to make the reservations for dinner that night in a restaurant that was included. She offered an upgrade towards the end but at that point we had already moved and did not want to do it again.

We went to the sushi restaurant which was not good and then went to moly the specialty Mexican restaurant. I’m sure if you eat some of the items there it would be great but if you’re a vegetarian it’s very limited. Also on the vegetarian menu is grilled grasshoppers. And my book that is not going to work. We ended up going to the buffet which was lackluster.

The next morning we got up had breakfast in the downstairs restaurant which was buffet style but good. Of note the omelette has a large selection but be careful to ask for a little cheese otherwise you will have an enormous amount. If you like that then you’re in the right spot. There was no cocktails offered at breakfast which was strange being in an all-inclusive resort.

We came out to the pool looking for a towel service as we had that cards to get towels but could not find where to get them. Once we finally figure that out we asked where there was a bar. There is no bar open before 11 AM. You have to go to the buffet and ask for a drink there. I guess this is one of the ways that they save money by not having to serve alcohol. I’m not saying you need to drink your entire day away but on vacation having a bloody Mary, Mamosa or margarita in the morning would be nice. But that is not available here.

We were approached by someone in for a massage telling us that it’s normally $140 for a 50 minute massage but today only you could get it for $90. Since there were three of us we asked to get it for 80 each. She came back inside now. Again not trying to be cheap about it but if you’re telling me you only have 40% occupancy and that you have tons of openings then work with us or say hey for the $90 we can throw in an extra five or 10 minutes but they do nothing of that here.   We have been to Moon Palace, Nizuk, dreams and they are significantly better with food, service and beauty. 

We were told Market Grill was open for breakfast it is not. It is open for lunch.  

Manuel has been the best service person here. Very attentive and friendly. 

There is a gelato place but it closes before 1000pm. Really??

Overall if you were looking for a budget friendly, clean hotel this is it. If you’ve been anywhere else that is truly five start this will not meet your standards. I would give it a two star.

reviews.author: Cathy D
reviews.title: Embarrassing encounter at pool
reviews.text: We were so impressed by the Melia Paradisus Cancun resort that on our first day  we decided to sit through the sales presentation about their rewards program, and were even seriously considering purchasing the package for both of our families. We were having this discussion by the pool under an umbrella, when an hour and a half later, another guest and her family came “back” to these chairs and hovered over us for over 30 minutes, causing a scene and even speaking to the waitstaff and pool staff about us. (We had done nothing; it was embarrassing.) When we spoke to pool management all they said is they accommodated the other family so we should be okay now. While I can appreciate this, nothing was done to help us. It certainly left an impression... accommodate the load screaming lady by giving her an upgrade or cabana... tell the innocent guests they are “ok” now. That said, we have found a super sweet pool server in Asunción.

reviews.author: Ryan W
reviews.title: Best trip with my friends hands down
reviews.text:
Hotel is amazing, food is great and staff are so welcoming. I love the pool parties and unlimited drinks!

Water aerobics with Alen, Julio, and Rodrigo are the best!! He keeps the party alive and going at all times of the day!

reviews.author: AdriCantuaria
reviews.title: De paradisus NADA!
reviews.text: Pésimo el trato que recibimos en el check in, hasta nos quisieron volver a cobrar por las habitaciones ! Nadie nos explico NADA! Si es tu primera vez en un all inclusive como saber que tenes que reservar para los restaurantes ? Más de 3 restaurantes cerrados por refacción, cierren de a uno! Para el desayuno teníamos que esperar más de 25 minutos en fila por una mesa! Uno de lo huéspedes terminó con picaduras de chinche !!!!!!! Una vergüenza ! Fue un viaje que tanto esperamos y la experiencia fue lamentable !

reviews.author: Cynthia
reviews.title: Increíble
reviews.text:
La atención que recibimos mi mejor amiga y yo por parte de todo el personal del Hotel, fue muy especial, increíble y única!

Quisiera además mencionar de forma especial a nuestros garzones: Victor, Moisés, Julio, Oscar, Orlando, Luis, César y Valeria, también a nuestra camarera Maricela y de forma muy especial a nuestro mayordomo Djordje Topalovic, quien con sus bellos detalles, profesionalismo y constantes atenciones, nos hizo sentir muy especiales, excediendo todas nuestras espectativas, muchas gracias Djordje!!!!

reviews.author: rene
reviews.title: LA CALIDAD Y LA ATENCION CADA VEZ ES PEOR!!! AUN EN ""ROYAL SERVICE""
reviews.text:
Me dirijo al Sr. Chrystian Rodríguez o a quien este a cargo del PARADISUS  CANCÚN.  Soy cliente frecuente de los PARADISUS Playa del Carmen y de PARADISUS Cancún desde el año 2013 y cada año de manera consecutiva voy con la familia o con amigos.  Y en esta ocasión tanto la calidad de los alimentos y la atención del personal fue pesima!!! El servicio en general no fue a lo que nos tienen acostumbrados y más en el Segmento o el Nivel ""ROYAL SERVICE"" En esta ocasión de plano nos DECEPCIONARON!!!  Y repito a pesar que estuvimos hospedados 8 días 7 noches en "ROYAL SERVICE" que se supone que es el nivel o segmento más alto en calidad y atención, y para nada fue lo que esperábamos comparado con otros años....... Al Grado de buscar otras opciónes para nuestras futuras vacaciones como los Hoteles: HARD ROCK CANCÚN, SECRETS THE VINE CANCÚN, LE BLANC,  LIVE AQUA. ETC ETC.
Algo no están haciendo bien y sus clientes lo están notando esa no solo es nuestra percepción si no también de otros huéspedes con los cuales estuvimos platicando y opinaban igual.

reviews.author: Annette Sofia E
reviews.title: Best experience ever
reviews.text: The hotel is so beautiful I had such an amazing time but I need to mention the service of several people... Antonio, and Timoteo at Toji bar! Tee did the cigar bar, guacamole bar, and margarita bar: it was a cultural experience and I had such a great time thank goodness for these free experiences that we get to enjoy! Special shout out to Alan in activities we’ve met him several times and he’s awesome and great with details he makes us have a great time and keeps our spirits up!!! Love this hotel!!

reviews.author: katherinel0427
reviews.title: Awesome Trip
reviews.text: Cancun I figured totally wasn't our vibe but Paradius was a blast. They accomdadated our friends greatly. It works really well for large groups. I really appreciated some of the spontaneous stuff that just occurs through out the resort. There was a random silent disco that was a good time. Three hotel workers (Alan, Julio, Rodrigo) came and played volleyball with us multiple times. They were such a solid addition to our trip. It was a great surprise. We also loved our waitress down on the beach, Irena.

reviews.author: emkelly7
reviews.title: Great hotel!
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful and the pool area is great. Had a great time at water aerobics with Alan!! He has a great energy and is very friendly. Ibana was good and the buffet had a wide variety of options. Would recommend for an all inclusive.

reviews.author: Rima
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: It’s my last day of a one-week stay at the Paradisus Cancun and my experience has been great. Great service, location, pool, And beach. Food is good. Hotel is very nice. Awesome pool area, service is very good. Asuncion’s service at the pool area has been impeccable - she always checked up on us, brought us drinks often, and paid close attention to detail. The days when she wasn’t here, the service was not the same. Special shoutout to Alan at the pool, who was very friendly and kept us up to date on all the activities happening around.

reviews.author: Thatsme12312
reviews.title: Paradisus cancun
reviews.text: spent couple of days at the paradisus cancun. Best hotel on the strip very big hotel and a very long beach! The food is not the greatest. Lunch menu is very limited (hot dogs held in the sun for hours and thick hamburgers) the coffee shop is only open for a very short period ( its not long enough). Mole restaurant is terrible. The two excellent restaurants palapa and market grill. Special shout out to alan the entertainment

reviews.author: Mia
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text:
This hotel has been an amazing experience - pool is fantastic, good music, lovely drinks.
The entertainers were so good - we did some Zumba, danced and had good snacks by the poolside. The staff was very helpful - especially Rodrigo, Alan and Ricardo Torres.

reviews.author: Pia D
reviews.title: Excellent Hotel
reviews.text: Our experience here was 5 star. It was amazing food, amazing hotel and excellent service and entertainment. the shows have been really good, zumba and BBQ and dancing. We especially loved the warmth the staff had to offer. Rodrigo and Alan really helped us throughout our week.

reviews.author: Letthys
reviews.title: ALL INCLUSIVE - MAIS OU MENOS
reviews.text:
Estive durante 10 dias nesse hotel, nos 6 primeiros dias estava em um grupo de 450 pessoas, devido à lotação recebemos um up-grade, nesse quarto estava divino, porém resolvi ficar mais 5 dias, então começaram os problemas, o quarto reservado pela tarifa escolhida, era velho, haviam baratas ao final do dia, o frigobar não gelava, reclamei e fizeram a troca, porém a porta não fechava, no segundo dia como não havia melhora, fui até a recepção para falar com o gerente, que prontamente nos forneceu um novo quarto, faltando 3 dias para o término da minha estadia, iniciaram uma reforma no em um dos restaurantes, então a qualidade caiu bastante, tudo foi alterado e arranjado de lugar, a qualidade das refeições caíram bastante, se me perguntarem se eu voltaria, fico na dúvida, pois após a saída do grupo não sei bem o que aconteceu!
Voltaria pela manhã qualidade do atendimento dos funcionários que o tempo inteiro, estão sorrindo e desejando bom dia, e com certeza escolheria a tarifa que inclui o reserve que fica na torre 5!

reviews.author: ladys712
reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: This hotel was absolutely amazing! I was so worried as I reading some of the reviews within the past few weeks were very skeptical. Upon my arrival, I booked with Otium Shuttle from the airport to the hotel (Otium is part of Paradisus). I was so worried because they base your pick up time from the time you land and although I landed on time. It took me over 2 hours to get through customs. Horrible. Once I got through, I met the Otium worker and he was absolutely amazing! He saw that I arrived earlier and knew I was in a 2 hour line at customs and gave me an upgraded private shuttle straight to the hotel free of charge! Without the upgrade, I would’ve had to wait for others and make multiple stops to other hotels. Once I arrived I was greeted by the door man, he took me inside and held my bags for me while I checked in. The front desk was amazing! So nice and friendly! Now, to remind everyone the inside hotel area does not have AC. This is where people might feel the discomfort as I did at some point while eating at the buffet inside, it can be a little uncomfortable. But my room was very nice! Updated, AC was great! Balcony to a gorgeous view of the water! Cleaning lady came every day. We had fresh towels every single day. Overall I was very happy and would definitely come again!! :)

reviews.author: Krisbreezy09
reviews.title: Love this resort! Royal Service is the way to go!
reviews.text:
We traveled with friends & family and opted for the Royal Service and all I can say is that we were catered to NON-STOP! We were so impressed with the service... the hotel is beautiful, fresh flowers EVERYWHERE so it smells amazing. Plenty of restaurants and Bars to choose from...
My son and I took a fishing excursion and he caught a huge Anahi- the captain filleted in-board and we took it back to the hotel where the chef at La Palapa made fish tacos for our group. Beautifully presented and so delicious! Plus, my son got thanked profusely for catching dinner! Great trip, awesome memories!

reviews.author: Alyson F
reviews.title: Great stay at the Paradisus!
reviews.text:
The paradisus saved my vacation!!

This vacation started out poorly- was booked at a nearby hotel and it just wasn’t up to my expectations :(

I stayed at the paradisus a little over a year ago and just knew I had to get back there! I went online, booked a room and the rest of my week was heavenly in the royal service area! Because I checked out if the original hotel at 8 am,  I arrived at the paradisus super early and the amazing royal svc staff accommodated us- they let us check in, have access to our room and our vacation finally began! Our awesome butler, Rode, did a great job of making sure we had all of the things we needed (Bali beds, restaurant reservations, spa day and excursions)! I can not recommend this hotel enough. The staff takes such great care of the clients and really cares that you enjoy your time in paradise! 
I will definitely be back!! 🏝🏖☀️

reviews.author: NIQQIB
reviews.title: Paridisus - The best resort experience EVER!!!
reviews.text: Where do I start! I was on a trip with a group from July 10 - 16th. We checked in a day early and stayed a day later.  The event was actually July 11-15th.  When we checked into our new room on the Royal side we were met  and escorted  by our butler Rossana.  She was awesome and we have missed her since we left and would request her when we return next year!  The spa staff and service was amazing and so relaxing! Fernanda checked me and was so pleasant! Diane gave me the tour and was so informative on how I can relax and enjoy the spa before ad after my treatment. Liliana was my therapist and she was AMAZING.  The last day I was at the resort i was able to squeeze in the spa and was greeted by Diana again.  It was great to see a familiar face. The overall staff of the Paridisus was amazing overall.  One staff member dropped everything he was doing to make sure I found m way to my location!  Fernanda was amazing as our Buter and she was INSTRUMENTAL in my roommate and I having a great time. There was nothing we wanted for during our trip! I really hope she is availalbe next year.  If you can do the Royal Service and can get Fernando, you won't be disappointed!  The food and the restaurants where very good!

reviews.author: Lauren
reviews.title: Paradisus Girls Trip
reviews.text:
I highly recommend Paradisus Cancún Resort to families, friends, couples, etc. I never once felt unsafe, the facilities are beautiful, the staff is phenomenal and not once did I see an employee just standing around. The food was excellent and the drinks were generous! Whenever we needed water to the room they were there within 15 minutes to drop it off. Our bartender Randy at ibana was FANTASTIC! My friend and I had drinks with him every evening before dinner, he was very attentive, always brought us water bottles, great conversation, and kept the drinks coming. Huge shout out to my boy Randy, thank you for taking such great care of us every night! 
I would definitely return to this resort again! It never felt too crowded at the pools until our very last day as a conference had just arrived. 
A few tips, bring several singles and fives for tips, the employees definitely deserve to be tipped for their services. The convenient store only offers pesos or card, but you can charge things to the room as well. Get outside early in the morning to reserve chairs/umbrellas. The resort could use several more umbrellas by the pool. 
Overall, great experience at Paradisus Cancún and a very affordable trip!

reviews.author: lynnsmith241
reviews.title: Best service ever
reviews.text: I had the best time at this resort thanks to the wonderful staff. I especially enjoyed breakfast at the Market Grill. I wa treated like royalty thanks to Pascual,Tomas and Armando. If you are looking for good service look no further. You guys are awesome.

reviews.author: Brittany N
reviews.title: Awesome Girls Trip
reviews.text: We just got back from an awesome girls trip at the Paradisus!  Myself and two friends had a wonderful (but too quick) stay at Paradisus.  We left our own children at home so we opted for Royal Service!  So worth the extra money!  The service is amazing and we enjoyed the quieter, less busy pool and beach area!  We had stayed at Paradisus in June of 2018 so when we started planning another trip to Cancun, we knew we wanted to stay here again. Truly what makes this place so awesome is the staff!  In both of my trips, I have encountered some of the kindest people you’ll ever meet!  It’s why we loved our stay so much the first time, that we had to rebook here the second time!  This year we had the pleasure of having Leyner as our butler, and he was amazing from the moment we arrived!
