Immediately got us to lunch and booked Bali beds for our stay while we were waiting on our room. He checked in on us regularly and handled anything we need so quickly!  He also had such a wonderful personality and was beyond kind!  We hope to have him as our butler when we return!  The staff at the Royal Service pool and beach area, and La Palapa were AMAZING as well!  Valeria, Eddie, Cesar, Moises, Orlando, Oscar, & Victor were all wonderful!  They remembered us, what we drank, and always greeted us with a smile!  We enjoyed all our dinners, but tacos and tequila at Blue Agave was our favorite!  We liked the more laid back atmosphere there, and our waiter Donovan was great!  I have stayed at other all inclusives in Cancun, because I love the beach and atmosphere of Cancun, but as I stated, I chose to come back to this one because of its awesome people!  You will not be disappointed in your stay here! If you’re like our group, you’ll be sad to leave, but looking forward to your next trip back!

reviews.author: JS474
reviews.title: Excellent service, best overall Al-inclusive, Adult only, Butler service
reviews.text:
The service at this hotel in Mexico was outstanding. We stayed in the adult only all inclusive with butler service which I highly recommend. Individuals who really showed excellent professionalism and service were Supervisor Daniel, Ramone, Moeses, Ceasar, Eddie, Julio as well as Rosanna our personal butler, Lilianna who gave me two massages at the SPA and Christian at Bona. These folks are excellent at service, hard working and extremely nice people. They literally made our trip. 
The hotel had very good food at various restaurants for an all inclusive. I have stayed in many hotels that were all inclusive in Mexico and throughout the Caribbean and this is by far the best overall. The rooms were clean and anything we asked for we received. I would and have recommended this hotel to friends.
It is NOT a golf resort, that was the only negative I have to say about it. As golfers (not for this trip) we laughed at what they called a course. If you want a golf resort this is not it! However I rank it as one of the nicest places I have stayed in the US and Mexico.

reviews.author: Nikolas C
reviews.title: retornar
reviews.text:
gostamos muito do royal service, mas as comidas noturnas sao muito ruins , fomos 2 dias comer fora do hotel 
gostaria  muito que voces melhorassem as comidas dos restaurantes a noite , a qualidade nao e boa

reviews.author: Shavonie B
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: I had a great time at this resort. All the staff members were very kind and helpful. They showed my family and friends a great time. Naos Restaurant was great my favorites Ignacio Vazquez Dania Cristian, Ignacio helped me with my Spanish, Hablo Espanol. Ignacio is a great person and has great customer service.

reviews.author: Dee
reviews.title: Nothing but Amazing
reviews.text: I recommend this hotel to anyone. I went here recently on a 4 day all inclusive vacation with a big travel group. The hotel was big, beautiful, and the staff kept it very well cleaned and maintained. My room was located on the adult side, the Royalty Suite. The atmosphere and environment on this side was set up with the Zen, peace, and tranquility philosophy. All the workers had on Chinese or Buddha robes. They had koi fish and ponds everywhere. They had sand with peace, Zen, and Chinese symbols drawn into them with incense lit and spread around. It was very relaxing. We had our butler, whose name is Norma. She was a gift from heaven. She took our numbers and kept us updated with things going on or happening, pick up of our luggage, reservations for activities, spa treatments, to see if we needed our clothes ironed and more. She also had champagne and chocolate cover strawberries sent to our room and spread roses on the bed. Outside the Royalty side has its own private pool, cabanas, and restaurant and the food was amazing! You won’t be disappointed. We surely were not. I can see myself returning.

reviews.author: Flyer44634778617
reviews.title: Would never stay there again
reviews.text: Main building is extremely loud, you can’t sleep if any events or music is playing. My entire group got sick from eating at Vento - we were all super sick the rest of the week. Food was just okay. Not enough chairs at the pool. No food served at the pool. Would not recommend this resort.

reviews.author: karlacalbear
reviews.title: A Heavenly Week in Cancun
reviews.text:
My friends and I spent 8 days and 7 nights at Paradisus Cancun in late June 2019. This was my 4th summer trip in 5 years. I am Club Melia member so my group stays in Pyramid 1 and then we upgrade to Royal Service to use the adults only pool, eat at La Palapa and use the hydrotherapy pool in the spa (can use daily- wonderful experience.)

The staff at Paradisus is why we keep coming back even though we can go to many other Melia resorts. 

Betsy at Club Melia registration was super helpful all week as well as was our concierge Lilian. Lilian made all our dinner reservations for places that require and signed us up for a Sushi making class. No reservations needed now for Bana and Enzo. 

Daniel is the captain of the team at the Royal Service pool and beach. He is always so welcoming and asks how he can make our experience better.  Degner and Aaron helped us with our cabana each day. The servers are hardworking and friendly: Moises, Victor, Cesar, Valeria, Rueben, Josue, Julio, Ramon and the very enthusiastic Orlando. The bartenders like Erik and others make tasty drinks and we brought our own insulated Reduce tumblers to keep our drinks cooler longer. La Palapa menu choices for breakfast and lunch are all wonderfully prepared. Make sure you ask for their habenero salsa. We all had a side of French toast daily, so yummy!

Paradisus and Cancun have made lots of eco-friendly changes in the last year and staff was happy to make our drinks in our tumblers. 

The WiFi has been upgraded since last year. We could update our Kindles easily even at the pool, stream Netflix in the evenings and browse online. 

The evening entertainment varies and draws lots of spectators. Rock bands, circus, dancers, little craft vendors, etc. 

We would love to see more music at the Royal Service pool with themes like 80’s, 90’s, Mariachi, etc on some days. Maybe not every day. 

There are lots of activities that Rodrigo and Adriana plan: fitness classes in the spa, daily aqua aerobics and cooking classes. Just make a reservation for the cooking & tequila tasting classes. We enjoyed our sushi making class. 

If you are looking to just relax (swim, eat, drink and sleep) then this is an ideal place. We don’t leave the resort. Years ago we did all the sightseeing and adventure trips. Now we just enjoy pure relaxation at the Paradisus.

reviews.author: Brandon
reviews.title: An incredible resort
reviews.text: Just spent several days at this wonderful resort and loved every second of it. We did the Royal Service because our friends said we had to experience it. It was worth every penny especially due to our wonderful friend Rodé that works there. He took care of us our entire trip to where all we had to do was relax and enjoy the beauty Paradisus has to offer.

reviews.author: Julia B
reviews.title: DAVID JULIO AND RODRIGO
reviews.text: JULIO & RODRIGO ARE THE BESTTTT!!!!!!!!!!!! Sooo much fun to hangout with and they have the best activities. The restaurants are good. The drinks are good. And the hotel is absolutely amazing. ALSO DAVID WAS THE BEST WAITER EVER EVER EVER.

reviews.author: DaniDB8
reviews.title: Royal service 100% worth it!
reviews.text:
Great hotel for a short and long stay. The Royal Service upgrade is amazing, better rooms, better facilities, exclusive restaurant, access to the spa... make sure you get a balinise bed.

What surprised me the most is the food! Great quality and flavor which you normally don’t expect at an all inclusive. In the Enzo restaurant make sure to buy the korean bbq specialty, it is just out of this world, very smokey flavors.

La palapa restaurant is great for lunch but it is only available for Royal Service, I ate there during my whole stay.

The only reason im giving four stars is because the service depends on your tips... if you give a tip at the beggining to the pool waiters, the bars, the nightclub bars then great service, if not they won’t pay much attention to you.

So a few bucks here and there for tips won’t hurt.

reviews.author: EVELYN R
reviews.title: Fun in Cancun
reviews.text: This is the only resort I will stay at in Cancun, Rode our butler is always so accommodating be sure to ask for him!!! Beautiful resort with great views and wonderful food. This is a nice spot for couples and for family vacations.

reviews.author: alicefeitor
reviews.title: Hotel com estrutura espetacular
reviews.text: Local muito agradável e relaxante co erto de verde, e sons de água, piscinas limpas e vom temperatura agradável, quartos sempre limpos e organizados. Os restaurantes são sensacionais.o atendimento deixou a desejar em alguns poucos momentos.

reviews.author: R.Craft
reviews.title: The best vacation ever
reviews.text:
My friend and I stayed at Paradisus Cancun June 1 - June 8,  2019.  The service we received from the following people all week long made our vacation absolutely one of the best.  These people went over and beyond to do anything they could for us.  Please acknowledge them and their work ethics on our behalf.  This is the second time we have stayed at this resort and because of these people we will return.

First of all our butler,  Rosanna.

Then the kind and friendly people at Lapalapa:  Josue, Valeria, Moises,  Florencio, Oscar, Daniel, Victor, Eddie, Ramon, Orlando, Javier, Cesar, and Julio.

And also, Yamil at Enso.

Thanks to everyone for making our vacation the greatest.

reviews.author: Sightseer32929156662
reviews.title: Food and service was very poor
reviews.text: If you enjoy good food and great service, then book another resort. Towards the end of our trip, our air conditioning stopped working and I requested for maintenance, but they never came. They also charge a $5 room service fee, even if you purchase the all-inclusive package. The food had no flavor and they have very limited choices. The only friendly and attentive staff we met was Martin who worked at the Market Grill. Everyone else was rude and acted like they didn't want to help you.

reviews.author: Sightsee27395129073
reviews.title: One of the best experiences EVER!
reviews.text: Paradisus is a must go to resort. They treat you like royalty from the time you're there to the time you leave. Everyone is so nice an friendly and the view is beautiful. When you first walk into the resort it's just such a lovely view. The only complaint I have is the fact that I had to leave. I will definitely comeback to paradisus i loved it.

reviews.author: Voyager59913539418
reviews.title: Precioso Lugar
reviews.text:
Servicio y locaciones excelentes, Debo reconocer al chico del Pool-bar Alan muy buena actitud y atención . Todo en General excelente calidad , limpieza , atención . 100% Recomendable ya sea
En familia o amigos

reviews.author: Natalia27
reviews.title: Stay ANYWHERE but here!
reviews.text:
I have stayed at several different hotels in Cancun but this was by far the worst experience I have ever had. The food was barely edible and the service was very poor. The first day we got there we ate at the poolside snack bar which serves hot dogs, hamburgers, nachos, and pizza. All were very bland, chips were very stale, and my nachos had strands of hair in it. For dinner we went to the street taco restaurant (Blue Agave). Tacos were not good at all with several chunks of fat still on them. We asked for sour cream and the waiter brought us a plate of warm milk. We left there and decided to go to the the buffet since we were still very hungry. Everything looked like it had been sitting out for a very long time and multiple items looked like they were the leftovers from the lunch buffet. We left there (still hungry) and ordered room service (pizza, spaghetti, and fries). All very bland, tasted old, and the spaghetti was basically noodles with barely any meat sauce on top. 

The next day we learned from one of the pool entertainers that since there was an upcoming election in Cancun they would not be able to serve any alcohol in the bars for the next 2 days. They would only be able to serve at the restaurants while you were eating. That was the deal breaker for me, especially since the food was not edible I needed to at least enjoy the alcohol I had paid for in my all inclusive package. I went to the lobby and asked to speak to the manager and out came Margarita, the WORST person anyone could have hired to work in management. She did not care about the situation at all, did not care that her guests were unhappy. She pretty much laughed in my face and made me cry. I travel ALOT and have never been treated this way at any resort I have stayed at. The second our conversation was done I went up to my room and booked a new resort for the last 2 nights of my trip and got the heck out of that hotel as fast as I possibly could. 
I would like to add that while checking out I heard the family next to me speaking to management very loudly and they looked visibly upset as well (I wish I could understand what they were saying, but they were not speaking English). I have a feeling this kind of thing happens often and I am not shocked at all.

reviews.author: Fernanda Queiroz
reviews.title: Recreação
reviews.text:
Angel, Adriana e Saul responsáveis pela recreação estão de parabéns pela atenção e simpatia com os hóspedes.
A alimentação precisava ser um pouco mais light.
O serviço de quarto foi excelente e o check in muito rápido e eficiente.
Yerre sempre eficiente nas reservas perto da piscina.
Estão de parabéns

reviews.author: Meng Hsuan L
reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text:
First time i checked in, I spend 30 min to wait in the line, a lot of people keep cutting into the line and the staff don't care, after I reach the front desk, they said the room is not ready, it's fine I get it, so we hand out around the hotel, after, they told me I have to wait in the line again, so it took me almost 1 hr to check in to get the room key.
need to pay for a lot of things even I am all inclusive
outlet on the wall won't work
bad smell in the bathroom
poor light
So hard to log in to the wifi

reviews.author: Meg
reviews.title: Stay here if you don’t plan on not eating the whole time.
reviews.text:
The good reviews left for this resort absolutely baffle me. The initial experience when checking in and getting the room were positive. The room is clean the beds were as expected, building 5 where the lobby is and most restaurants is beautiful. The pool is ok. The service isn’t the best by any means, many times they made me feel like I was inconveniencing them with my presence. The food... was not good. At all. Barely edible. I’m being 100% serious, I am not picky by any means I cannot tell you the last time I dined somewhere and didn’t enjoy the food. But here I was completely at a loss for words I just wanted to look around at people and see their expressions and wondered if they felt the same as me because I couldn’t believe how disgusting it was. On the second day me and my friends were approached by someone from the entertainment staff (if you can even call them that) with warning that they would stop serving alcohol at the pool and bars at midnight for 2 days. My understanding from management was that it was for a local election that was taking place and they could only serve alcohol at some of the restaurants and the bars would be closed. I was completely outraged, I only drink on vacation, I paid for an all inclusive vacation and that’s not what I was getting. And the cherry on top was the way we were treated by the guest services manager with the name that is the same as a drink. She was so awful to us that my friend started crying.

We weren’t expecting a whole lot. We understand it’s a law it’s out of your hands (but really why would a local election affect tourist areas???) but a bit of courtesy, kindness and RESPECT was all we wanted. And at this resort it was too hard for them to give that. Maybe if you paid more for the royal service you would get treated better having the pink bracelet. After being treated like garbage me and my girls went back to the room and booked a different resort for the remainder of our vacation. We couldn’t stay there any longer. Yes, we paid more just to get the hell out. Thats how the manager made us feel. And guess what? The resort we stayed at reminded me what it’s supposed to feel like! Being treated like literal family! When you get in the pool at an all inclusive resort you feel like you are in paradise, which is not the case for Paradisus. I will never stay at another Melia hotel again and will do everything in my power to make sure no one I know stays at this resort.

reviews.author: jasonf21083
reviews.title: Watch paying for upgrades
reviews.text: While the staff was fantastic, the resort is nice, but we had paid for the royal concierge service as an add-on. They made me pay for the full stay of upgrades, but they did not have a room available on that side of the resort. We was also not given the proper cards to access that portion of the hotel, nor did we have ANY of the features included with the royal service. They next day we were given access AFTER we had to check out of the room we was in by noon and into the next room at 3pm. I went at 9am they told me they had the room available, but it still needed cleaned and we would then get access to the room, was told it "would be no later than noon, sorry for the inconvenience." When we checked at noon they still had nothing available. Basically we was left "homeless" for the hours while we waited. (Not nearly as bad as it felt at the time). But I am still waiting on the refund of the one nights worth of upgrade. Was told "we'll take care of you next time" which is very unacceptable. If this is not resolved, there will not be a next time with any Melia properties.

reviews.author: walter s
reviews.title: Hotel hermoso
reviews.text: Mi estadía en el hotel ( por cuarta vez) fue muy buena. Lo único malo fue que al hacer el check in, me pidieron que presente la tarjeta de crédito con la cual realice el pago, con lo cual les explique que esa tarjeta me la habían robado, y al decirles eso, me tuvieron que cobrar de nuevo y luego hacerme la devolución a la tarjeta de la cual había hecho el pago. Con lo cual me complico mucho ya que en el medio, me cerraba la tarjeta y no entraba en el mismo resumen tanto el consumo nuevo como la devolución.

reviews.author: Discover41095646547
reviews.title: Royal Service Absolutely Worth It
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time staying with the Royal Service experience at Paradisus. Our concierge, Hector, was incredibly attentive and was available via text the entire day. There is essentially anything at your fingertips the entire time you are there. Very handy for making reservations and setting activities like golf up. Pro-tip, you'll probably be the only one on the par 3 course, so just rent one set of clubs ($25) and share. Also, bring your own balls, they are 3 for $12 for range balls. Essentially everything else we did at the hotel was free, including use of the sauna and steam room at the spa. The food was pretty good, and the drinks were great, with a nice selection of alcohols if you asked for them. They were included in Royal Service, with other things like cabana rentals.

reviews.author: Jose Gomez
reviews.title: Horrible food and no Entertainment!
reviews.text:
For a 5 star hotel the buffet food was horrible and the restaurant food was moderate. If you wanted good food you had to leave the hotel.

There's no Entertainment past 10pm in this hotel, which for a 5 star hotel is very bad and yet again i had to leave the hotel to for entertainment. You might say is ok but at Majestic Hotels they had live shows until 12am.

My major problem with Paradisus was the sales pitch to be a Member of Melia club, it being and absolute waste of money. Please id you go to this hotel DO NOT GET THE MELIA CLUBS IS A SCAM AND YOU WILL LOSE A LOT OF MONEY.

NOW FOR THE GOOD PART, the beach was beautiful and the pool was awesome. Lots of booze for you to drink on and the staff nationals are amazing people.

reviews.author: Road24671596682
reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text: I visit Cancun at least twice a year, and I read the reviews and try to apply them to me. This hotel is not worth but 1 star. Hotel rooms need updating, such as lighting flickering the whole time, TV picture not clear on all channels, bathroom fixture and shower were falling apart, bathtub was literally sinking in the middle and Wifi was very very bad and connectivity was horrible on ALL DEVICES, had to log in every 2-3 min. NEVER AGAIN

reviews.author: PaulAK2011
reviews.title: Great Hotel, great staff & great location
reviews.text: My Europe friend & I wanted to return to Cancun to celebrate our 1st meeting in Cancun 7 years ago & chose the Paradisus.  It has been wonderful.  The resort is the cleanest, best kept I have experienced.  The entire staff have been extremely friendly & helpful.  The location is directly across Kukulcán Blvd from the Aqua water sports center, thus a 4 to 5 minute walk for any of the many water sports activities.   Also the bus service is excellent, about every 2 minutes anywhere into Cancun for Walmart, Costco etc. or the malls along Kukulcán Blvd and only 12 pesos . The restaurant choices are very good.  The towering interior with its amazing hanging green vines is stunning and very peaceful and soothing. There was a quality variety of good entertainment all week .   I highly recommend the a Paradisus !!

reviews.author: LalaAtl
reviews.title: BUGS & Basic Service
reviews.text:
Upon check in, expect to wait in a long line.  They do provide many people to greet you and offer drinks during this time though.  Arriving at our room, we saw bugs in the bathroom and asked the bellman to take care of them, hoping it would be an isolated incident.  Upon returning to our room that evening, roaches greeted us on our dresser and we had enough.  Not wanting to room with roaches, we called down to request a new room and proceed to repack all of our luggage.  What a huge surprise when "guest services" Paulina came to our room and demanded we show her the dead bug or a photo of the live bug!!  Because they ran behind the dresser when we entered, we could not find them and did not look, we were ready to get out of there.  After over an hour of them debating on how to handle this, finally we were offered a new room.  It was very frustrating to have gone through all this at 11pm after a long day of travel and just wanting to go to bed.  

We did encounter some great customer service throughout our stay from certain staff.  The "Guests Service" staff was the least helpful and least friendly of them all, ironically.  The servers on the beach are EXTREMELY attentive and never let your drink run dry.  The servers at most restaurants treated us well and were very friendly.

The food was nothing to brag about in our opinion.  The cantonese restaurant Enso was our favourite and the taco restaurant Blue Agave was awful.  How hard is it to make decent tacos!?

Housekeeping did not leave washcloths and when we called to request some they never brought us any so we were forced to attempt to wash the sand off our bodies with no washcloths which was super annoying.

The ocean view from the balcony was amazing and very private.  The room stayed nice and cool, but it was basically the ONLY place in the entire hotel with air conditioning!  It was cooler out on the beach than in the hotel the entire time!

The pool was nice and very big.  The beach was nice and mostly quiet, but the water was full of seaweed and you could´t swim without getting tangled up in it.  Not many people in the water, presumably because of this.

Regarding our SECOND room, I liked the shower, the hairdryer, and the beds were comfortable.  Only 1 channel on the TV was in English.  The first room they put us in was pretty bad and had old furniture, only one power outlet, and BUGS of course. The light switches in both rooms were confusing.  They are everywhere, most of them don´t do anything, and each switch is not even near what it controls.  They are not logical at all and need to be labeled.

My very expensive sunglasses disappeared on our last day and we only made 3 stops in the hotel.  We checked with the workers at all 3 places we had been and no one admitted to seeing them.  Not sure if it was housekeeping or someone else but they are gone, not returned to lost and found and SOMEONE has them.  I am very upset about this.

Basically, we enjoyed a decent stay here, but had some less than stellar experiences with BUGS and the customer service.  It was not worth a return visit in our opinion.

reviews.author: Discover546391
reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: This is our second time staying in Melia Resort and I would definitely stay there again. I highly recomend getting the Melia app to schedule dinner reservations etc. so convinient. We were a group of 10 and we asked to have rooms close by if possible, the staff was very accomodating. We were all a few doors from each other. Loved it. We rented a caba on the beach one of the days and it was the funnest day with great service. Can't wait for my next vacation.

reviews.author: Nathalia1405
reviews.title: Bom Resort
reviews.text:
Estivemos hospedados em 2 casais no Paradisus por 8 dias.
É um bom hotel, com ótima estrutura, mas tivemos os seguintes pontos:

1) Eles utilizam a pisicina principal para execução de eventos privados, do qual os hóspedes não podem participar.
Quando tem esses eventões, eles retiram todas as cadeiras de sol da piscina e não tem lugar para os hóspedes ficarem. A única opção é o aluguel de bangalôs por uma taxa absurda em dólares.
Todas as cadeiras eles colocam em uma piscina menor e montam um gazebo para disponibilizar as bebidas (as bebidas ficam quentes e no sol).
Em 7 dias de hospedagem, ocorreram 2 eventos particulares. Deixando os hóspedes com a restrição das cadeiras. Devido ao evento privado, eles também fecham um restaurante de frutos do mar Enso, não permitindo acesso para jantar.

2) O guarda-sol não pode ser aberto na piscina, eles pedem pra você fechar independente do sol que estiver. Alegam que devido ao vento, eles podem voar e machucar alguém. Nos dão a opção de assinar um termo de responsabilidade caso isso aconteça.
No caso, eles deveriam ter outra alternativa e não deixar os hóspedes no sol ou transferindo a responsabilidade em caso de acidente. Outra opção sugerida: aluguel dos bangalôs.

3) Restaurante Market Grill: eles dizem que é um restaurante de churrasco Brasileiro e Argentino.
Isso é uma vergonha para nós Brasileiros, carne seca e sem sal.
Eles fazem uma salmora de água e sal para colocar na carne. Horrível.
Um Resort deste porte precisa oferecer um churrasco descente. 

4) Os restaurantes fecham as 10 pm, após este horário não temos mais onde comer.
Se você chegar da balada com fome, tem a opção de pedir comida no quarto por uma taxa de 5 dólares.

5) O mar na região é muito bravo, não tem codições de ficar no mar. (Isso não é culpa do hotel, mas estou registrando essa informação para que as pessoas saibam que a única opção se torna a piscina).

6) Comunicação com os hóspedes: temos acesso a aplicativo Melia, e mesmo assim o hotel não nos avisa que a piscina estará sem cadeiras ou que o restaurante estará fechado por conta de um evento privado. Sendo assim, não ficamos sabendo e se soubéssemos poderíamos  programar um passeio para a data.

reviews.author: Storyteller640568
reviews.title: A Must Stay
reviews.text: Everything was great on our stay. The staff were friendly and hospitable. The rooms and food were great. I would definitely return to this hotel . The views and the indoor gardens were a sight to look at.

reviews.author: Denissecolon1219
reviews.title: My first vacation
reviews.text: This was the first trip I ever experienced and my experience at this hotel was amazing the staff would never let me go without and I was always full from the food that they offered.. the staff and the Excursion or worse every dollar and I would definitely go back

reviews.author: seeker54
reviews.title: excellent stay
reviews.text:
The hotel it’s so beautiful!!! And so comfortable ! You don’t need to go out to the city to find anything else you have everything at the hotel !!
The BEACH IS REALLY PRETTY ! You have one of the best catering and a great  array of liquors !!! 
The Bali beds include within the price CHAMPAIGN Of a very good label Plus  LOBSTER CEVICHE AND SHRIMP PLATTER!!! 

The swimming pools are so big and nice !!! You may choose to eat from snacks to  a Gourmet meal

What I like most are the kindness of every person that works at the hotel !!! Really kind helpful and cheerful and the HOTEL AREA nearby very good shopping centers 

The boutiques within the premises are really good and you may find all kind of gifts , accesories, Mexican artists jewelry , beach clothing, ATM , SPA 

Love to go back !!! With my family

reviews.author: bryney
reviews.title: Beautiful resort!
reviews.text:
My friend and I were very impressed by the cleanliness and friendliness of staff. Pool was pristine. Food was pretty good. Morning buffet was ok. There was many serving trays of food that were empty and not refilled very promptly. Overall it was good. The Fuego restaurant was excellent. Service and the filet were exceptional. There was burning insence by the elevators that choked you with smoke  fumes. 
The only thing I wished wouldn’t have happened was the Club Meliá (time share) pressure to join. They are very friendly but it becomes overwhelming with cost and multiple resort options. Way too much information that was a painful 90 min experience. Carolina was very intimidating and she kept throwing out financial numbers. What we got for that was a nice Bali bed on the beach with a lobster appetizer, champagne and live music. So I call it even.

reviews.author: Happiness65700092938
reviews.title: Paradisus review
reviews.text: Being all inclusive was a great experience. However, we needed alcohol bottles in the room too. I was there for my birthday, and I made a special request at reception for a bottle, they said that could make it happen, but it never did.

reviews.author: Shannon
reviews.title: Nice property
reviews.text: I was unimpressed with the food and the cleanliness of this resort. Great location... drinks were ok and the service was decent however I doubt I would stay here again. The food was subpar and seemed to be the same thing over and over everyday as there wasn’t much variety on the menu at the buffet and other restaurants on the property.

reviews.author: Juanita A
reviews.title: Excelente lugar
reviews.text: Un lugar delicioso. Variedad de restaurantes y atención muy especial. Lo mejor de el Royal Service fue el mayordomo (Djordge) un chico de Serbia con una actitud de servicio increíble que nos hizo sentir como en casa

reviews.author: Haircut
reviews.title: Can't Wait to Go Back
reviews.text:
Had a wonderful time here.  Here are the Cons and Pros:
Note: I want to point out cons first as their pros will cover all of the negatives.
Cons:
- Do not book their lowest rate rooms.  They are dated, far from everything and kinda sad because the atmosphere were so quiet.  Try to ask for an upgrade and/or pay for the ungraded ocean view room that is newly renovated.  It makes the whole experience 100% better.  We did not like the basic room so we upgraded to an ocean view room in Building 3 where it is the most convenience location to restaurants, pools and beaches.  The view from the room was also spectacular.  It was also great to get coffee in the morning as the coffee stand is just on the ground floor in Building 3.
- The swimming pool was too deep.  I am not a good swimmer but at least I was not afraid to be in deep water.  Verses people who do not know how to swim and / or not taller than 5.5 ft, they will have huge difficulties enjoying the pool as they are 5.9 to 6 ft deep.  The kids’ pool is 1.5 meters deep but I don’t think adults would want to stay there for relaxing times.  Also, because of their deep pools, they do not do poolside party / bubble pool party like other resorts do which was something I miss.  Of course, they did not have Aqua-aerobics too because not many people can stand in the water and breathe.
- Very little choices of foods at the Buffet.  It is probably the smallest buffet I have encountered from All-Inclusive resorts.  Maybe they prefer guests to eat at their a-la-carte restaurants.
- Lack of chairs at the Pool.  If you don’t get up early in the morning to get your chair, it is likely that you won’t be getting any in the afternoon.  All “good chairs” with shade are taken by 7:30 am.  Other chairs could be available before noon.  At least this is how it was while I was there for a week.
- No entertainment manager / team.  I didn’t see activities personnel persuading people to join activities.  Maybe it was too hot while we were there.  My boyfriend did not get a chance to play beach volleyball the whole time as the court was always empty.
- The stage for their shows are too small and too far.  It is usually at the poolside outside the Grill restaurant.  Performers are really far away from their audience.
Pros:
- Friendly and absolutely amazing service from every staff at the Hotel.  To name a few, they are Mario, the manager of Naos; Jennifer and Mariza, hostesses from Naos, Pablo, Mesero Andres, Christian Rivero, Edwin Peree from Bana, the two Angel(s) from all those activities... I am sorry but I cannot remember all the names.  In general, these people have made our trip memorable.  You are assets to Paradisus.  Thank you All.
- Delicious foods from all restaurants.  Other than the lack of choices at the Buffet, all other restaurants have high standards dishes.  I love Fuego the most.  It was better than lots of dining experiences I had with Mexico All-inclusive.  Impressive overall.
- Spectacular views from Oceanview rooms.  Highly recommended.
- Gym and Exercise Classes were great.  I enjoyed the spinning class and their strong air-conditioning gym.  I forgot the name of the handsome instructor (pls see picture attached) but he always try his utmost to make sure guests are exercising well.  
- Nice and clean grounds / Beautiful Hotel - during the week we were there, I always see staffs cleaning / wiping every where in the hotel.  Spotless clean on most places.
Conclusion: Despite a few cons from the above, I will definitely recommend anyone to go to this hotel for a great time.  Please keep up the good work.

reviews.author: HARDESH S
reviews.title: Excellent beautiful holiday
reviews.text: We arrived on 24th April evening and leaving cancun to London today on 1 may the 1735 pm flight to London.  Everything was good but I would love to point out my thanks to the lost important people in the hotel that actually made my holiday special . All their efforts and services was the reason why I have the smile on my face . Thanks to coco beach bar Jaime, Juan , Manuel , David and especially the pool lounge ELLIOT . He is the best love them and love cancun

reviews.author: Jacqueline
reviews.title: Girls vacation
reviews.text: My sister in law and I spent 12 glorious, relaxing days at the Paradisus.  We upgraded to Royal Service, which I strongly recommend.  Our butler Norma was fantastic!  She made us reservations at the restaurants, booked our bali beds around the pool, ensured we had our favourite beverages in our mini fridge.  She was fantastic!  Eddie our server for our first day around the pool was incredible.  We did not want for anything!  Sadly Eddie wasn't there everyday, the other servers were alright, but Eddie had set the bar very high!  We were on the Adult only side, which was quiet and calm.  You didn't have to worry about rushing down to get a lounge chair, as there were always enough.  The pool at most had 8 or 9 people in it.  When you wanted to be in more of a festive mood, you went to the other side and  socialized with the rest of the hotel.  We did find that the food was never really hot in the restaurants (except for La Palapa, which is the only restaurant on the Adult side and is only open for breakfast and lunch).  Everything came out room temperature.  All that being said, we loved our time at the Paradisus.  We loved Norma and Eddie and look forward to returning!

reviews.author: Lee
reviews.title: Simply Amazing
reviews.text:
I fell in love with this place on day 1 and it was everything I could have wanted. First off, I have to give a shout out to majority of the staff that works at this resort! These people make this place THAT much better and excellent.  Especially Roberto, Josue, Pascal, and many more went over and beyond. They were so attentive, friendly, charming, and helpful with any and everything. Then of course our Butler Norma was sent from above. My group of friends wanted for nothing because of her, and her taking care of all of our needs. She was awesome! 

This place is HUGE, you could get lost. I had 2 rooms right next to each other and they were spacious, nicely decorated with an impressive layout. Especially the bathroom, beautiful shower and tub. I can’t get over how comfortable the bed was. Huge balcony, I mean I really can’t say enough good things about this place. You just have to experience it. There’s a lot to do on this resort, but in just 3 days we couldn’t do it all but did enough. The food was pretty good, and the drinks were great not watered down at all (Huge plus.)Tip these hard working people if you can, it seriously goes a long way. Kind of hard not to lol. I can’t wait to come back here. Royal service is certainly worth the extra money. I highly recommend this place. There’s something for all ages. You feel so comfortable, highly respected, and at home being here. My group of 4 had nothing but positive things to say about this place. I had such an amazing time and experience here.

reviews.author: flr1987
reviews.title: Holiday with friends
reviews.text:
We did travel from London with 5 friends to Cancun for the final part of our trip to Latin America. 
Very happy with service, food selection & quality and cleanliness of the rooms and shared hotel facilities. We all got upgraded, rooms were close to each other as requested (although we booked via different channels).
One of the better all include resorts in Cancun

reviews.author: Megan S
reviews.title: Where you wanna be! ;)
reviews.text:
I came to Paradisus for my second time 4 years later and it again did not disappoint! The resort is very clean, smells like a spa/incense everywhere. The views of the bright blue ocean are breath taking. It’s so big with so many places to eat, that 5 days was not enough to try it all! We enjoyed the food and drinks everywhere we went. 

It was an even variety of families, friends and college/spring breakers while there. It never felt too crowded even though the beach chairs on the beach do fill up quick but are easily to snag if people don’t leave personal belongings with their towels that that try claiming seats with while going MIA for hours. We enjoyed Jaime & Karina Coco beach bar which is right off the pool and above the beach near Market restaurant. They were very social and friendly which made that bar our go to spot every night. Thanks for being great and memorable bar tenders! :) I hope you remember Megan, Kaitlyn & Scarlette!

We did the Zapote Cenote excursion (signed up through the hotel) and we had so much fun! You get to zip line and swim in 3 different cenotes in the Mayan jungle. I’d recommend to anyone who enjoys nature/scenic tours. The water and caves are stunning! Our tour guide Cesar, the photographers, bus driver, and restaurant hosts were all great! 

I can’t wait to come back again and show more friends and family this beautiful resort.

reviews.author: Passport26485481318
reviews.title: Not what I anticipated
reviews.text: I thought I purchased a trip with a great room but it ended up being old outdated and just the worst. I was absolutely upset the entire time. Even worst, I found my luggage being carried into someone else's room.

reviews.author: Wanderer37549381338
reviews.title: Experiencia unica
reviews.text: Fue una experiencia inolvidabke, desde que entras al hotel se nota el excelente servicio que brindan, personal altamente capacitados y amables, la persona que nos hizo el check Martita fue excelente, desde hay me enamoré del hotel..

reviews.author: Julia
reviews.title: Nice hotel, friendly staff, great food. Rooms could do with an update.
reviews.text:
The hotel is huge, but nicely build. The lobby is truly beautiful. 
Our room was alright. It includes everything you need and is certainly clean, but everything is rather old and the bathroom could really use an update. However it had a big balcony with a great view. Also if the room is located in the central pyramid, its quite noisy (restaurants and bars are located there). 

The staff is generally very friendly and helpful and they tend to speak excellent English. Only very few exceptions. 

The food was amazing. Due to the large number of restaurants you have a great variety which is all included in you all in package. It is also great for food allergies, since everything is clearly marked, all the staff is able to assist and they have a large e.g. glutenfree menu. 

Beach and pool are right outside and are kept very clean. Also good service w.r.t. drinks is provided. Animation availabe but easy to ignore if you dont want or need it. Evening shows are provided by external professionals and are usually of high quality.

Overall, a very pleasant and relaxing stay.

reviews.author: si2
reviews.title: Luxurious and great service
reviews.text: We had high hopes for our stay at the Paradisus and weren’t disappointed.  The accommodation bedrooms/bathroom were fantastic with a superb shower/wet room, the hotel is absolutely spectacular with its high pyramid structures with incredible service levels throughoutl from the most warm and friendly people.  We were staying in their Royal Class section as we wanted a bit more peace and quiet - it included butler service and we were all delighted with Alex for making our stay so easy and pleasant (making restaurant bookings, arranging Bali beds for us round the pool, and generally very helpful and friendly throughout our stay). There are several restaurants at the hotel a lot of the food may be unfamiliar to British visitors so important to explore the different ones - the Ensos Thai, Blue Algarve for tortillas and Fuegos were my favourite, and also a lot of choice if you like fish. The beach is beautiful white sand, and the sea at the end of March was warm, perfectly sandy and very clean. It was a little bit rough at times so the waves could bump you about a bit so we tended to go for short sharp dips! The pool area was very nice but important to get a Bali bed if you’re in Royal Class otherwise there isn’t a lot of shade. It’s a fairly quiet hotel at night - there’s a nightclub on site and a very nice little beach bar that stays open till midnight otherwise everything pretty much closes down late night . There’s a surprisingly good casino 15 minute walk at the grand oasis hotel next door but one for late night action!

reviews.author: artmarcelino
reviews.title: Not a five star experience
reviews.text: I stayed at the Paradisus Cancun from March 18 to 25. It was a buddies golf trip & were assigned Rooms 3618 & 3620. Unfortunately the bad experiences trump the good in this case. It started off bad as check in took almost an hour, they truly need to revisit a more efficient way of checking guests in. When a bus full of people come to the resort to start their vacation the last thing they want to do is wait almost an hour to get their rooms. Waiting that long is a new experience for me as I have never had that in any all inclusive (AI) resort I've ever been to. Just unacceptable. But I have other firsts to share with the Tripadvisor community. They ran out of towels daily at the beach & pool area. That's daily folks. I'm not making that up. Towels, at a resort, on the beach. I'm trying to figure out how that occurs? Good luck if you're lucky enough to score a beach lounge chair before 10 am. As a matter of fact, early in my stay I observed a rather irate guest ask for management to do something about the shortage of beach chairs & was dully ignored. Ridiculous. NEVER have I been on the beach at an AI & not had beach chairs accessible to everyone. The food was average at best. In fact 3 of the 4 of us got some bug which I can't truly attribute to the food at the resort but I was sick on Wednesday (Day 3) & Friday (Day 5). So I can only deduce it might have came from the food. The best meal I had was on our last day the Sunday where we tried the Japanese restaurant in the main atrium. It was delicious, flavourful & fresh. I'm sorry to not have ate there more during the stay but sushi in the Caribbean is hit or miss sometimes & being sick two days I had to be careful. But I'm truly shocked some members gave this place five stars which I believe should be reserved for exceptional resorts with extraordinary customer service. Take for example their Nespresso stand which opens at 8:00 am to 10:00 am in the morning & 3:00 pm to 5:00 pm in the afternoon. My buddy was 2nd in line in a 2 person lineup at 5:01 pm & the barista shut him down citing they were closed. That is not going out of their way for guests to provide truly great customer service. Like the extra 4 minutes he would have taken to make my friend's cappuccino would have impacted his workday so negatively? We also experienced this puzzling practice of not getting enough water from the beverage replenishment staff. My friends would leave notes on the counter above the fridge requesting, no begging for more bottled water & usually what they would call "stocking" your fridge was three mini water bottles. Finally we had to practically confront a beverage cart attendant & give him 10 US dollars/room & we were able to get all the large bottles we wanted for the week. Just so frustrating why they would hoard their bottled water like that. Just unexplainable. But it wasn't all negative as the rooms were quite clean & the beds were comfortable & most of the staff were very engaging & friendly. The resort sits on a pristine stretch of beach & the main atrium is beautiful. I would call the Paradisus all style & no substance. I believe all of my reviews have been an honest assessment of my experiences & unfortunately because of all the issues I've experienced during this stay sadly, I can not recommend this property.

reviews.author: Navigate40221045210
reviews.title: Been better in the past
reviews.text: 4th year here. There has been some obvious cost cutting to maid service, Mini bar service, and guacamole which was disappointing as the first three years were amazing...now just average. Have to really think long and hard as to if we’ll go back again next year.

reviews.author: Jessica W
reviews.title: Amazing experience with the Royal service,
reviews.text: Amazing experience specially with the Royal service, The food is amazing, the pool and private beach are clean and quiet, our Butler was very helpful, arrange  all the plan and give us good advice for tours, very satisfy, we will definitely come back.

reviews.author: Agsss7
reviews.title: Wonderful experience
reviews.text: One of the best hotels I have ever stayed in. Super tasty food (large variety of restaurants), good service and nice staff. The beach is amazing and it is not far from the airport - perfect for a weekend getaway.

reviews.author: Amarjeet M
reviews.title: They Say Great employees and Staff Can hide your all deficiencies .
reviews.text: Great staff ,hard workers But management thumbsdown Small reception desk could not hold even office supply.Basement Ground floor rooms Noisy Couldn't sleep kept getting noise from adjoining restaurant

reviews.author: Lucy Moreno
reviews.title: My butler rode
reviews.text: From the moment that we stepped onto the property grounds we were treated with the best service. We had the royal service and it was definitely worth it. Part of royal service means that you get a personal butler and our butler was, Rode, and he was amazing! I celebrated my birthday while I was here and he went above and beyond to make it amazing! He blew up balloons, decorated my room, had a cake, and even a bottle of wine waiting for me. He checked in with us everyday and made sure that we had everything that we needed. He was super attentive and made us feel at home and safe. Rode, thank you so much for making this the best birthday and trip! I hope that we will get to have you again when we come back. I highly recommend this place and Rode! Thank you, thank you!

reviews.author: Breannagilbert
reviews.title: My butler rode
reviews.text: Rode has made our trip the most memorable time! He was very attentive, energetic and exceeded all expectations! We’ve been treated like royalty from beginning to end! I can’t wait to come back and visit, I will be requesting my very favorite, Rode!

reviews.author: Yamila P
reviews.title: Amigas en SPring
reviews.text: Increíble hotel y servicio, tiene una vista asombrosa al mar y muy buena la animación y los shows que se organizan en la noche y por la tarde, Angel, julio y Rodrigo de la animación nos han tratado siempre de 10! Lo mejor fueron las clases de zumba y el bar del red launge también siempre muy buena onda! Ojalá nos podamos encontrar de nuevo es un destino hermoso. Saludos desde Argentina 💕

reviews.author: Luciana D
reviews.title: Experiencia en Paradisus
reviews.text: Gran estadía en el hotel. Más que recomendado! Buena atención al público, el personal a muy amable y cuidan mucho a sus huéspedes! Con respecto a la comida, mucha variedad y de gran calidad. Gracias a el equipo de entretenimiento del hotel que lograron una divertida estadía! Sobre todo a Rodrigo!

reviews.author: alejandro M
reviews.title: Excelente opcion para vacacionar en familoa
reviews.text: Hemos viajado con un grupo de amigos , en total 9, y nos hemos divertido mucho, la antencion de todo el personal excelente. la variedad de restorantes y el edificio en excelentes condiciones, muy recomendable.

reviews.author: Juanpy
reviews.title: Falta de sillas y sombrillas. Es insuficiente. Hotel grande y pocas sillas. Son 5 bloques y la playa es limitada.
reviews.text: Me parece que debido a las pocas sillas de playa podrían limitar a 3 horas de uso por cada pax. Así entre todos podemos usar. Otra cosa es que deberían emitir facturas legales ya que pagamos impuestos y No lo hacen. Podrían decir que son evasores de impuestos el son casi 20% de impuestos en México. Los tragos podrían ser más dulces y con un poco más de alcohol.

reviews.author: czmarchy
reviews.title: Birthday Bash
reviews.text: I came back from a fantastic birthday trip to Paradisus Cancun, I went with a group of friends and we stayed in Royal Service. Every one was great-Hector, Melina, Moises, Cesar, Valeria, Oscar-just to name a few. It is a low key luxury experience in paradise. Love the Bali beds, the Cadillac margaritas, the nightly entertainment and the décor of the hotel. We all agreed that we need a yearly trip to Paradisus!

reviews.author: Meilyn Boutet
reviews.title: Spring Break at Paradisus
reviews.text: I attended with my friends for our spring break. As soon as we entered the hotel we felt welcomed. The staff was amazing and super friendly. The food was pretty good, better than I was expecting. I would 100% recommend the hotel to a friend.

reviews.author: Aaron Tagala
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun 2019
reviews.text: Amazing staff and awesome views! Be friends with Julio, Sergio, Ruben, Argenis, Perla, Angel, Jaime, and Rodrigo and they will make sure you have an awesome time! The sushi in the main lobby restaurant is great and the tacos at Blue Agave are delicioso!

reviews.author: annie0liver
reviews.title: MAS TEQUILA!!!!
reviews.text:
That was the best trip ever! I stayed there for my spring break trip and all of the employees went above and beyond.

Shoutout to the activities team for making this trip soooo much fun! (julio, rodrigo, y angel hasta leugo y muchas gracias!!! -Annie) I learned how to make ceviche and sushi, and i went wine tasting (lol) on the resort. I also went kayaking on the bay right off the resort. The pool party was a ton of fun and the silent disco was definitely a sight to see. Bored was not even an option during this trip because of all of the activities. 

The food was good, i definitely recommend ordering all of the appetizers because they never disappointed. The buffet (Naos) offered so many different foods, also shoutout to my waiter Martin for really making me and all of my friends feel so welcomed and special.

The service throughout the pool and the beach was awesome. All of the waiters made sure to ask us if we needed anything every time they passed us. Shoutout to Victor (the victor that works right next to the pool bar i believe his last name is rodriguez because sorry if i'm wrong!)

Speaking of the pool bar, shoutout to the bartenders Ruben, Sergio, and Perla for taking care of our demanding asses. All of the drinks were so yummy, they were always ready to hear what kind of shot was going to be ordered next. Sometimes we wold just turn around and see a line of shots waiting for us because they knew we were going to ask for more. 

Don't worry, if you like to workout the gym had at least 15 different machines, 4 or 5 treadmills, 4 ellipticals, and several other cardio machines. There was a good variety of free weights, a smith machine, and a set of cables. 

The room, the resort, the views were all spectacular. Honestly, cannot thank the staff enough for how hard working and caring they are. I would 100% go back to this resort without a doubt and will always recommend it.

reviews.author: Chase T
reviews.title: Service Beyond Measure!
reviews.text: Guillermo and Christian at Fuego are a duo to remember. Their attentiveness and service was above and beyond. So much so that we went to Fuego three times during our stay at Paradisus. We will certainly be back to the resort just to see them! Additionally, the man who showed us our room, Alex (or Antonio?) saw that we were not happy with the room and without being asked he called the front desk and got us a better room with a great view! It is this kind of attention to guests needs that is rare in today's world. Can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: Natalia
reviews.title: La mejor semana
reviews.text:
Soy Natalia de Argentina, pasé una excelente semana con mi prima. Impecable todo. El hotel, la comida, la playa, súper recomendable. Siempre me trataron muy bien. Soy celíaca y siempre fueron muy cuidadosos con la comida y me dieron varias opciones para elegir. Gracias a los mozos Christian y Andrés del desayuno por la amabilidad y el buen trato, gracias al chef por siempre cocinarme waffles a la mañana y gracias Christian del restaurante “Fuego” por recibirnos siempre muy bien, muy buenas personas. 
La fiesta que más me gustó fue la “fiesta silenciosa”.
Saludos!

reviews.author: Shannon C
reviews.title: Spring Break!
reviews.text: We had an amazing experience here! Rodrigo, Julio, and Angel kept us busy with fun activities while Sergio, Perla, Ruben, Michael, and Victor Rodriquez gave us drinks! We were always welcomed at meals with Martin as our waiter and couldn't have had a better spring break!

reviews.author: Anncole
reviews.title: Amazing week!
reviews.text: I was here for my spring break and it was amazing! All of the workers are so nice and attentive and go out of their way to make sure you’re having a good time. Julio and Rodrigo were especially friendly and so cool—try to find them for fun activities and a good time. If you go to the buffet, find Martin—he is so sweet will make sure you’re taken care of. Overall, I had an amazing time, and I felt like the workers really made the trip special.

reviews.author: Stacie N
reviews.title: Very nice, would come back.
reviews.text: Only  setback was the delay getting registered at the front desk.  However, Roberto saved us and gave us a beautiful ocean view room.  Everything else was excellent, service, attitude, coco beach pricey but well worth it.  The seafood platter and champagne was awesome.  Fuego was delicious but make a reservation.  Loved it.

reviews.author: Al W
reviews.title: Nice Resort
reviews.text:
Had a nice room in the main building along with our friends which was convenient as most restaurants are located there and central to the beach and beach bar. 
The beach itself is wide and sandy and we had no problem getting chairs. The ocean had large powerful waves which necessitated “red “ flags during our stay and I think this is an ongoing situation there. So due to the wave action on the sand when walking on the beach most times you are walking at at an angle as opposed to a flat surface. The beach staff came by on a regular basis to see if we required anything. 
Meals we ok but nothing special. There is one restaurant that serves Tacos as their specialty but they were not particularly good. 
Small issue with housekeeping as getting hand towels and facecloths was hit and miss but room was always nicely cleaned. 
Entire staff very friendly and offered a Tequila or a Bloody Ceasar  to start your day. Nice touch.

reviews.author: Sarah L
reviews.title: You would love it
reviews.text:
Very good customer services. We were arrived at midnight and they had only one room left. We booked just the lagoon room, and it was a Lagos room as well but somehow I just found out the size of the room was a one bedroom! It is huge room. Huge washroom with a living+dining area then our bedroom, plus a outdoor massage bathtub!
We did not get charged for the extra due to they only have the room for us! 
And we had a room service for our dinner which we had no dinner on the flight. 
The days in cancun was awesome with sunshine only weather!
The regular hours for the front desk line up was awful! I hope they can have more then 5 ppl working at the time.
The only time drive me crazy was check out time. Feels like it takes me forever!
Food:
Many restaurants can choose and they’re all different styles!
I love the buffet at main building. Can get the food right away. And the Japanese restaurant was awesome. I also tried the special dinner at the poolside dinner! It was an Italian dinner. With the show after dinner. Missed the fireworks due to we had a trip the other day.
Swimming pool was really fun and really big. Pool bar and water yoga. It’s cool!
The chair are free to get. The customer service was really good! The towel area ran out the towels so I just asked someone and they just went to grab one for me. Really enjoyed my first trip in my dream place. 
I see some other bad reviews for the days I was stayed, I need to say, it was a full resort for my whole stays until I left.
They already tried their best for everything I believed! 
They also have kids indoor play area.
Thank you all

reviews.author: Hectordavidreynoso
reviews.title: Mi Hotel en Cancún
reviews.text:
Se observan las cinco pirámides del hotel desde el avión.
Arquitectura espectacular, por más que tenga 30 años, conserva sus rasgos imponentes, las habitaciones, pirámide central, piscinas y restoranes, de lo mejor. El personal, altamente entrenado y calificado.

reviews.author: ppd
reviews.title: My favorite resort
reviews.text: Paradisus is a beautiful resort inside and out.  Great food and accommodations, as a vacation club owner our 2 bedroom suite was beautiful.  All staff went out if their way to meet every request.  Take advantage of bali beds

reviews.author: Happiness61312345974
reviews.title: Great butler experience
reviews.text: Rodolfo knocked it out of the park. Very professional and a pleasure to have on our side. He was right on top of everything we asked for, no matter what time of the day!!!  From fish food to a bottle of wine, he did it all. I can’t express how much we appreciated him as a person and also as a butler!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Conrado M
reviews.title: Excelente servicio
reviews.text: Desde la llegada al lobby del hotel te hacen sentir especial, lugar comida y bebidas son excelentes, el personal muy amable, la atención que te dan es de primera y las habitaciones muy limpias, con jacuzzi en la terraza.

reviews.author: Rockgirlca1
reviews.title: How do you run out of towels at a beach resort ?
reviews.text:
Gorgeous day in Cancun we have sun however been  waiting for over 1 hour ... it’s pretty bad when you come to a beach and they cannot accommodate their guests with the basics ie beach towels ! 

BRING YOUR OWN TOWEL (BYOT)

reviews.author: BabeRog
reviews.title: Mega resort, mega perks
reviews.text:
Yes I paid for the Royal Service and my experience may be slanted.  However this resort offered something for every type of traveler.  

Facilities beautiful and very clean.  I can even go as far to say, scenic indoor spaces.  Many entertainment options, classes - ceviche cooking class, tequila lessons, wine tasting - yoga, water aerobics, pool side bands, lounge acts (excellent) and night club.  So much to entertain!

Food was wonderful.  Tapas, Peruian, Brazilian, Mexican with high end twist, and everyday Mexican ( have to say that was the worst service restaurant with its no reservation policy) and buffet.  There was another internationally acclaimed restaurant that had a lofty price tag which I didn't visit.  If you felt really lazy you could order food at your personal palapa.  I had tuna skewers!  Delicious!  Room service available also.

Beach:  probably due to season and high winds, but ocean almost unusable.  I did walk it daily but waves very rough and current strong.  Chairs and shade plentiful.

Now for my personal experience with the Royal Service.  Alex was my butler.  He did absolutely everything for me.  He was friendly and efficient.  I would just text him and it was done.  I have traveled to Mexico many times and have always gone to scuba clubs or adult only.  The option here to have an adult only space was a good choice.  Alex made experienced, knowledgable recommendations when I asked about particular activities in and outside the resort.  Great experience.

reviews.author: PJKIENTZ
reviews.title: Awesome staff
reviews.text:
I can’t say enough about the staff who are so willing to take care of you!

A big thanx to David our waiter on the beach, the best service we could have along with taking the time to entertain us!

To “Nacho” at the Market Grill, great service  and making our time at meals fun!

I really do not have one bad thing to say about the hotel and staff, would definitely return!

reviews.author: roxyzym
reviews.title: Impressive!
reviews.text: It is impressive design wise and a lot of effort is put in details. There is entertainment on almost constantly - on Saturday it even changed every hour or so, first there were singers, then drummers, then chill DJ music and so on! There is a lot of choice food wise, if you can't find anything in a buffet there are several other restaurants that are included in all inclusive deal. Beach is great, the bar in the pool also but my favourite was the service - staff are constantly walking around asking if you'd like another drink while you are sunbathing and relaxing. Honestly everything was just fantastic :)

reviews.author: Lee J
reviews.title: Above Average Resort
reviews.text: Great staff and service. Melia hotels are run as a business so efficiency geared towards profits is apparent. Particularly in the dining venues. Food comes from a common kitchen for most restaurants. Restaurants are closed based on occupancy so availability takes some planning. Reservations are hard to get at times.

reviews.author: Isidoros K
reviews.title: Could be better
reviews.text:
cleaning should be checked in buffet area, glasses , spoons tables etc.
Shops are very expensive
Shows should be more interactive
Rooms should be more equipped 
Very friendly staff at check in and checkout
Gardens very beautiful 
Beach amazing

reviews.author: Josephyeremian
reviews.title: The Hotel, the service and Management are all Excellent I give more than 6 stars.
reviews.text:
The moment we arrived to the last minute we were treated royally. 
Everything was excellent, especially under the directive of Mr. Michel Albahari, he must have trained his people excellent. Looked after all the details to keep customers very happy. The hotel is excellent, we will come again and again and bring Friends with us.

reviews.author: Sightseer06965494877
reviews.title: Paradisus Birthday Party
reviews.text: We went to the Paradisus for a friend's 40th birthday and had an amazing time. The resort and beautiful and extremely clean, and the service was great. The staff is extremely attentive and very friendly.

reviews.author: Norman G
reviews.title: Girls trip
reviews.text: Nice resort and great activities and beautiful beach. However we struggled with the food choices. Little weird on some stuff. Loved the breakfast but struggled at buffet and other restaurants for lunch and dinner for quality food.

reviews.author: Taylor M
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: The trip was amazing we only had one problem and that was a lady who worked at the buffet but other then that everything was amazing and so so so beautiful I plan on coming back but with my son and mom

reviews.author: Flyer34458034733
reviews.title: Perfect in every way!
reviews.text: From the property, to the rooms, to the service to the food/beverage.  We were 100% happy with every part of our trip.  We will definitely be back!  The staff is entertaining as much as they are helpful and quick to help with whatever you need.  Thanks for a great experience!

reviews.author: Heidi S
reviews.title: Absolutely Amazing!
reviews.text:
Looks like my pictures came out sideways so I'm sorry for that. 

A friend of mine found a package deal and had plans to stay here one weekend in October. I checked my schedule, was off from work and bought my package that same day. I'm usually always working for all holidays so I don't celebrate them and sometimes I don't even remember it's a holiday. So we booked to be there 4 days, Halloween included but I was unaware that their Day of the Dead celebration was the same day.

Let me start with the pros:
I found the hotel to be so beautiful!
We arrived early morning and check-in isn't till 3 but the staff is amazing and EVERYONE goes above and beyond to help you out. Well, they let you do the check-in process but you don't get your room till later.
While you're checking in someone is passing by offering alcoholic beverages.
As soon as you check-in you have full access to the facilities. 
They have a spacious luggage area where you can leave your bags and you're provided with a ticket to claim later so you don't need to be going all around the hotel with your bags. 
They tell us at the front desk that we've juat missed breakfast but we can pass by the center of the hotel and see if there's anything left.
Here we met Andres "Andy". He sees us walking around and asks if we wanted to eat. It's very clear that almost everything has already been taken away so we ask what he has left. He tells us there's some fruits, yogurts, cereals and bread but we can order whatever we want and he'll have it made nice and warm for us. Whaaat?! Hell yeah!! We ordered 2 omelettes and mimosas. All the tables were cleared so Andy brings out our silverware and in no time our delicious omelettes are out. 
Breakfasts are amazing! Andy is the absolute best server I've ever had in my life so if you see him grab him but you better treat him right.  
Everything was included but we still made sure to bring a lot of cash for tips and even though the service is amazing when you tip they make you feel like royalty!
The pool we used was very clean and I love the pool bar.
The bar is fully stocked! And they actually have good liquor included which is not always seen at these all inclusives. Not everything is shown so if there's something you want but don't see ask, they might have it stored. 
The service at the pool is great. At the bar the bartender is making rounds nonstop so you're never waiting too long for a drink and if you're outside of the pool there's people going making rounds delivering drinks as well. The times I was drinking I never had an empty cup before the next had been delivered. They remembered what I was drinking and if they saw I was low they'd get me a drink before I even asked!
When you get you're room you call and they deliver your luggage to you so you don't even have to get it and bring it up. I'm telling you you will feel like royalty here.
The room was nice and had a great view to the pools and the ocean. The bathroom was amazing!
You get complete room service to tour room and you can call and ask for anything at all and they'll bring it. We only used it once I think cause we were rarely ever in the room.
Every day they restock your fridge with alcohol which of course is included.
I fell in love with the Day of the Dead decorations! I hate being repetitive and saying amazing a couple dozen times but it's just what suits them lol. They go all out with these decorations! These altars are beautiful, everything is fresh, it is the real deal and everything is done to perfection. They make skull designs out of different colored beans!!!
I loved the movie Coco and they had a very long and enjoyable performance on it. It was like a little Coco play but instead of rust seeing actors everyone was in full costumes head to toe. The kids loved it but most of us there were adults. And of course while you're watching they're bringing drinks around.
I love that we didn't have to make reservations for dinner because I am totally unpredictable on vacation. I might make a reservation by 9 but be starving by 7. Or make a reservation for 7 but still be partying and not want to eat just yet. 
I love sushi so I didn't really give other restaurants a chance and I only had sushi for dinner the whole time I was there.
Andy worked every day we were there in the mornings and early afternoons so we always made sure he was our server but even the ones we got at night were great too. Andy introduced us to his friend Pascual when my friend and I made some friends and expanded our breakfast group so they both served us and everything was always perfect, quick and delicious.
I was hungover one morning and Andy recommended and quickly brought me some hangover concoction they drink over there. Don't remember what it was but I loved it and it helped.
There's a small bar by the pools that plays all kinds of music at night and is a great place to have a few drinks and chat with friends before bed. I'm not a clubber so I  didn't even go in once and can't tell you anything about them. 
My friend and I drank the water they would bring us in cups and we never got sick which was a big concern for us in Mexico.

Now let me go over the cons which before I go into are so minimal to me and outweighed by the pros that I've already booked my next stay for May.
Lunch time we were always in the pool area so we would go to the buffet or a small hut by the pool with hot dogs, hamburgers and pizza. Lunch for us and anyone we spoke to was horrible. I'm sure the restaurants are great but who wants to get out of the pool, change into dry clothes, go eat and then change back into bathing suits to go back to the pool? We didn't want to cut our pool time short so we always stayed there for lunch and met many others that did the same and felt the same about the buffet and the hotdog/hamburger hut. I tried absolutely everything at the buffet multiple days and could not eat anything other than cheese. The food was either so salty it was inedible or just plain bad. Everything we tried tasted bad. We ate hotdogs and pizza every day for lunch because it was much better than the buffet but even that wasn't too good.
The hotel is pretty big and maybe it was cause we were drinking all day but it took us forever to learn how to get to our room! Lol it was a bit of a maze for us and we got lost the first 2 days all day. But again, most likely caused by our drinking and not the hotel.
I'm severely allergic to dust mites and my allergies were out of control in the room, especially in bed so I'd wake up completely congested. But my friend was fine so it's most likely just cause my nose is too sensitive.
Only other thing that was a con for us and is not a big deal at all is that everything but the clubs close relatively early. We were more bar people and like to lounge and relax so we were disappointed when the only options we had after dinner was to go clubbing. 

I think that's it! I think I've covered everything. Like I said, pros definitely outweigh the cons. Eat pizza or hotdogs for lunch or get your butts out of the pool and get dressed for lunch amd you'll be fine.

I've already sent a few friends there in the 3 months since I came back and like I said I'll be back there in May with my best friend for her birthday. I hope I'm able to make it back for The Day of the Dead im October as well because it was one of the best experiences I've ever had in my life. 

I love this hotel,  I love these people! Go and have a great time!

reviews.author: Paula C
reviews.title: Gorgeous views but the food was never hot
reviews.text:
Beautiful grounds and views.  The beach is gorgeous and I've never seen such clear beautiful water.  There is an open-air dining room for breakfast, lunch and dinner.  I thought the staff was always helpful and considerate. Overall, I really enjoyed the quiet and relaxing atmosphere. Grounds get an A

Hotel check-in was slow.  We checked in before 3 and had to go back at 3 to get our keys.  Our junior suite with an ocean view was roomy enough, but the sliding glass door leaked during very heavy rain - housekeeping had to put towels down on the floor. There was a ceiling light that wouldn't work and they couldn't fix it so maintenance put a lamp on the table.  The room and bathroom were very clean and my bed was very comfortable. The bathroom does not have an exhaust fan. There is no additional way to lock the door from the inside - none of those swing arms that prevent the door from being pushed open. Check-in and Room get a C (that lack of security took it down from a B

The food wasn't bad but it was not hot. There are multiple restaurants but theyr'e more like dining rooms than restaurants - you can take your buffet lunch from Naos and sit in Naos or Market Grill or Fuego or one of the others. You need dinner reservations at Fuego, which is a la carte for dinner; Vento, a tapas restaurant; Market Grill which is Argentinian / Brazilian Steakhouse where meat is carved onto your plate but you get your own sides.  There's a sushi restaurant but it wasn't always open. Any hot dish I took from the buffet was never more than warm-ish. My favorite place to eat was Market Grill because it's open air and even in the rainy weather it was a delightful place to sit and relax.  Warning, though. The wood tables need to be scrubbed, sanded and refinished.  They always felt sticky; I had to open my napkin and spread it out like a large placemat. The wait staff was all very nice but also very obvious about looking for tips -  Food gets a C

What? No bingo! No! There weren't a lot of activities to do - unless they were all at the family pool.  I didn't mind that too much - I was more interested in just relaxing and decompressing after a stressful year.  Each evening there was a show at the Avenue Bar but it seemed to be about 30 or 45 minutes and it was family friendly.  Activities get a C

It's not a dump but it's not spectacular (in my opinion). Overall, I'd give the resort a C+ (2 1/2 stars).

Hey TripAdvisor - you need to add 1/2 stars (circles?) to your rating system.

reviews.author: Chelsea G
reviews.title: The best vacations
reviews.text: Saul and Julio best activity directors. Inviting and make you feel right at home. If you have any questions about Cancun they have they answers! If you are at Paradisus, make sure to look for them ans then write a review on trip advisor!

reviews.author: Morgan G
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun Resort
reviews.text: Stayed at the Paradisus this January. Was very impressed. Hotel was very accomadating service waa good. Buffet was ok, wide variety of food at buffet. I highly recommend making a reservation at the resturants for dinner. Vento was great, Fuego was amazing and The Market Grill was fantastic. I am Gluten free, I did not call ahead to discuss options, but they had plenty of food options and if I couldn’t find something the waiters took care of me. The weather was beutiful, even when it was a little cloudy. The beach was well kept and the views were beautiful. They offered beach volleyball and soccer. Saul the hotel entertainer was very helpful with suggestions of things to do at the hotel. Everynight they had a show at 8:30pm and they were all amazing was never disappointed. Would return and would recommend to friends.

reviews.author: Megan R
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun Resort
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Resort in Cancun was amazing! The room accommodations were very nice and clean. The food was delicious (especially the ice cream!). And the shows were very entertaining! Would definitely go again and recommend to a friend!
Saul Zarate is the best entertainer

reviews.author: Alicia C
reviews.title: TOTAL DISAPPOINTMENT
reviews.text:
I don’t even know where to start with this review, I usually do not write many reviews but I will this time because I don’t want customers to be fooled and be sold something that’s not worth what they are paying for. 

For starters this is supposed to be a five stars hotel, apart from the waiters good customer service I don’t know where else this fits in the category. 

Starting with the check in, the receptionist named Yuli was the slowest receptionist I have ever encountered! It took about an hour to get us checked in, and at the time of our check in (3pm) 3 of our 4 rooms were not ready. We also had to come back to get our keys and where inside the room by 4pm. 

When I booked this hotel it caught my attention because of the “many different restaurants this hotel has” but don’t be fooled, we were not able to eat in any of these restaurants because they were always “full.” We even tried booking two nights in advance and still had no luck. Some of their restaurants were closed, and I saw that their restaurants do not hold the capacity for the amount of guests they have in this hotel. We had to eat at the buffet Naos every night and the food wasn’t even good, not many varieties either. I would give it 2/5. 

Unlucky for us the weekend I spent here rained everyday none stop, on the last day my room and my friends room were flooded due to the rain, I called reception and they told me I wasn’t the only one, that every other room in the side of the hotel we were in were having the same problem, but if they know this why don’t they fix this?
