Also a lot of the common areas had water on the floor and water dripping from their roofs. The rooms are old and not very clean. They charge you $5 if you want room service and alcohol bottles are not included in your room. 

The receptionists were not very helpful at all. For any inconvenience I had to call a couple times before they helped me do anything. 

Overall for the price of this hotel I do not recommend this hotel. DONT BE FOOLED!!! I have been to other resorts in Cancun and this is such a disappointment.

reviews.author: ginamkk
reviews.title: Royal Service at Paradisus
reviews.text:
We recently stayed at Paradisus Royal Service Ocean View. The resort was absolutely stunning! Our view was gorgeous and our room was immaculate! We were celebrating my 30th birthday and when we arrived we checked in at a private Royal Service area with complimentary champagne. We were escorted straight to our room and it was decorated with balloons, streamers and a bottle of champagne and chocolate covered strawberries! Such a thoughtful touch!

Alex was our butler and he was amazing! He took care of absolutely everything for us from dinner reservations to Bali Beds and checked in on us in person at least once a day. He was always there for us when we needed him and even took care of us on his day off. He even decorated my room with streamers, cake and champagne while we were out at dinner! Our trip wouldn’t have been the same without him! He made everything absolutely perfect! So so grateful that he was our butler. If you are visiting Paradisus requesting Alex is a must!!

When it comes to Royal Service, this is the pinnacle! We were waited on hand and foot our entire trip. From the moment we arrived, the service we received was impeccable. Every single person we encountered went out of their way to take the best care of us and made our experience indescribable. Everywhere we went, I was sang happy birthday to and it made my trip so special!

La Palapa restaurant at Royal Service was delicious! Fuego is also a must! These were our favorite restaurants.

Royal Service is definitely worth it!

We truly felt like Royalty this entire trip and we cannot wait to be back!! Thank you for the incredible and unforgettable experience!

reviews.author: Mandii09
reviews.title: A beautiful place for a getaway
reviews.text:
The first thing I noticed when arriving st Paradissus, was the amazing smell of essential oils and lush greenery, almost everywhere. The staff here were all very attentive and friendly, and the hotel itself was very well kept, including the washrooms on the beach. Despite the size of this resort, it didnt feel crowded.  The morning barista at the Nespresso bar, Orlando, was excellent - always smiling and great with the guests. 

✅ if you want a plated dinner, reservations can only be made 1-2 days in advance. All were good, but Mole was my favourite ( traditional Mexican). 

💡 those wonderful Bali Beds (palapas) are $100 per day if your not staying as a “royal service” guest. 

✅ The food at the resort is good, but I think taking a day to go off the resort and eat at one of the local places in hotel zone is definitely worth it! My favourite place was Taco y Tequilla at La Isla mall

💡 Taxi to the main shopping area ( near Plaza Fiesta) should be 160 pesos from Paradissus.  No meters - so always agree on the price before getting in the car. 

🇲🇽🇲🇽🇲🇽🇲🇽🇲🇽

reviews.author: Kellyqtz
reviews.title: Amazing staff
reviews.text: Went to Cancun for few days to relax and tan. The staff here are super friendly and helpful. Guadalupe and Alex make our check in and check out process super pleasant and also suggested us to upgrade to royal service (you will not regret upgrading). I would highly recommend this resort due to great staff and lots restaurants to choose from. Definitely will come back.

reviews.author: donahoe05
reviews.title: girls trip
reviews.text: th.e sfatt was great! the Service was great!I did not like the constant push for spa services everyday, the pool was nice and bars had everything you could want. The food was good, no complaints.the facility is so beautiful but lots of stairs, up and down, hard to find elevators at times, ok for us, but if you had difficulty with stairs would be frustrating.I would go back here, great for romantic get away, family and girls trip.

reviews.author: Kerri H
reviews.title: Girls birthday trip
reviews.text: Had a great time at this hotel. The entertainment staff was great. Two of the employees Julio and Rodrigo were the best. Always checking on us and making sure we were having fun. Also the bartender Manuel made us the best drinks. Had a fabulous time !

reviews.author: Kennybrooke
reviews.title: Birthday for Melissa
reviews.text: Paridisus Cancun is a beautiful resort!  The food is delicious and abundant!  The staff was all very courteous and helpful. Lucia, Julio,Rodrigo and Alan justvtp name a few! Can't wait to spend next January here again!!!

reviews.author: Stephani B
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation!
reviews.text: Loved the resort; however the staff truly made the difference in this amazing trip. The shows, food and accommodations were good, but again, the staff really made the difference. Rodrigo, Julio and Lucia made sure we had everything we needed at all time and went the extra mile every day to make sure we were having the time of our lives! I highly recommend this resort!!!!!!

reviews.author: Melissa R
reviews.title: Vacacion 2019
reviews.text: We had a great time thanks to Julio, Rodrigo and Lucia! They were so much fun and made Mezcal and wine lex so fun. They kept us on track as to where activities were and at what time. Manuel, Samuel and Alan were amazing bartenders

reviews.author: Tamara A
reviews.title: Fun trip
reviews.text: Everything was great.  So much fun.  New friends and awesome workers.  Bartender Alan from the red latern bar and Manuel at the blue aguava bar and Julio the fun got.  Had fun at mezcal tasting and casino night.

reviews.author: Guide519808
reviews.title: Girls birthday trip for melissa
reviews.text: Rodrigo, Immanuel,juilio,lucia and Alan made this trip wonderful!! Great hospitality. Made  us feel very welcomed. Wine and mezcal tasting was wonderful. Special shots were brought to us numerous times by juilio

reviews.author: 983valterc
reviews.title: É um paraiso
reviews.text: Hotel tem excelente atendimento e restaurantes exceto o market grill. Piscina e localizaçao ótimas, não atendem de maneira diferenciada em função de gorgetas (melia de punta cana só atendia bem quem dava gorgeta o tempo todo). O hotel tem aspectos mais para família do que curtição com amigos, mas foi otimo. Vale a pena ficar no the royal service principalmente por ter piscina climatizada.

reviews.author: Ktrd5
reviews.title: Amazing staff
reviews.text: We have been so thrilled with this trip! The staff has made it extra special! Marisa and Carlos our pool and room concierges (respectively) were so kind and helpful, Carlos at Ensō was the NICEST waiter, Karina, Timoteo, and Carrillo at Cocos bar were outstanding, Fransisco from the avenue bar is the sweetest! Seriously I cannot say enough how amazing they all have been! Absolutely made the trip for us.

reviews.author: monika_s_vancouver
reviews.title: Great hotel friendly staff
reviews.text:
Came to Cancun with a cpl friends for the weekend and decided to continue with the Melia chain hotel. We upgraded to Royal Service upon arrival and it was worth it. Beach cabanas and private beach and pool area was way quieter then the other side. 
 Guadalupe was great with our check in and was extremely accommodating! Oscar and Joel were the best by the pool they came over often to check up on us if we needed drinks or anything. Friendly staff all around, going to continue checking out more Melia hotels all around

reviews.author: riiiiichh
reviews.title: #WhereYouWantToBe RELAXED
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun consistently continues to provide the best service. Friends and myself go there every 6 months or so for a quick getaway from the NYC grind. Staff always delivering stellar service. Alejandro at the hotel entrance to safely handle our luggage. Andres serving us morning "Tequila" during breakfast at the Market Grille. Luis and Flor taking care of us poolside all day from the moment the bar opens, all the way to last call at the end of the day. They made sure that we never had to leave that lounger for anything. The new updated rooms give a bright "Miami-esque" vibe to the former look which was a delight. If you don't book Royal Service, upgrade to the Gold band if you can to get access to Royal Service amenities. Access to YHI Spa and La Palapa alone make it worth the $$ .

reviews.author: REBECCA C
reviews.title: Felicidades al equipo de animación y shows
reviews.text: Omg it was awesome and Saul and Julio was the best entertainer and took care of us all! We received an upgrade to royal service which was so appreciated. Thank you so much for all the accommodations! THANKS!!!!!!

reviews.author: 652PSM
reviews.title: Tres belle hôtel familiale et très tranquille
reviews.text: Nous avons séjourné 4 nuits, nous avons profité pleinement de l’hôtel.Le personnel était avenant et à notre disposition. Les restaurants sont excellents. Le room service laisse un peu à désirer tant sur la qualité que sur la présentation.Un grand merci à tout le staff et à la direction

reviews.author: lbabchuk
reviews.title: Paridisus Cancun
reviews.text: Very good service! There are very fun activities that the workers provide for you. Constant volleyball games, zumba, and excersizes that keep you moving and having a great time! The workers that helped out most and went above and beyond were Rodrigo, Lucia, Angel, Adriana, and Saul. The waitor that always tended to our needs even when we were needy was Darwin. He worked at the Brazilian restaraunt and the Asian restaraunt. Excellent time here!

reviews.author: Olga K
reviews.title: Great time!
reviews.text: Awesome service. Entertainers are great, we played volleyball/games every day and there were shows/activities by the pool. Rodrigo, Angel, Saul, and Lucia and Adriana were very nice and friendly! The waiters are so sweet, we loved Darwin! Hotel was clean and lots of variety for restaurants. Great stay, would come back.

reviews.author: Nadia K
reviews.title: Best entertainers!!
reviews.text: Today is my last day here! I’m so sad to leave!! Rodrigo, Angel, Lucia & Saul were so great at keeping us entertained!! I had such a great time by the pool and with beach volleyball!! They will be missed!!! Can’t wait to come back!!

reviews.author: Katie S
reviews.title: Amazing workout
reviews.text: Saul zarate  is the best workout instructor ever! Fun time. We did boot camp and 6 pack and they were both so fun, the gym was great and the shows were great too. Awesome food, great beach all around fun time.

reviews.author: Thirsc
reviews.title: Um bom hotel para férias
reviews.text:
Estive no hotel com amigos e tivemos uma agradável estadia. O Hotel é bem bonito e confortável, os quartos embora sejam mais antigos, oferecem uma ótima noite de sono com cama muito confortável, banheiro limpo. O sistema all inclusive é muito bom, os atendentes dos quiosques são muito simpáticos e prestam ótimos serviços, com bebidas de vários tipos. O ponto negativo é a demora no serviço na praia.

Uma dica é escolher os quartos com vista para o mar, a vista é fantástica.

reviews.author: Ailén M
reviews.title: Excelente hotel
reviews.text:
Estoy terminando mi estadía en el hotel, me parecieron muy buenas las instalaciones y la atención del personal, la comida, bebidas y espectáculos.
Nuestro vuelo sale de noche y nos permitieron permanecer en las instalaciones hasta el momento cercano a la partida de nuestro vuelo.

reviews.author: AliJohnson
reviews.title: Friendly Staff, Beautiful Facilities
reviews.text: The staff here are incredible, and so much fun too! Shout out to Francisco and Jayme for making our stay so much better with their amazing hospitality. The gym is beautiful, as well as the pool and beach area. The bedrooms are clean, and get cleaned everyday which was lovely. The food was also delicious, with our favourite being the top sirloin from Fuego. This resort is mostly oriented to families and couples, but there were also a good amount of young adults, which was fun!

reviews.author: Alba Rocio A
reviews.title: Hermoso hotel
reviews.text: La comida muy rica y mucha variedad de restaurantes, lo que más sobre sale es La amabilidad de los colaboradores pero en especial Rodrigo el coordinador de actividades e instructor del gym, muy buenas clases y cansada. Regresamos pronto

reviews.author: Leticia C
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Excelente entretenimiento ! El teacher Rodrigo del gimnasio es genial y Lucia también es un sol, sus clases son buenísimas y súper dinámicas. Les recomiendo que tomen las clases de entretenimiento con ellos !!!

reviews.author: Dreamer28540732920
reviews.title: Excellent spot in Cancun
reviews.text: Everyone was very friendly and the service was excellent. Also, I thought the food was pretty good for an all-inclusive type of resort. I hope to come back at some point in the future with my family!!

reviews.author: Shelby D
reviews.title: Fun trip minus the staff completely scamming us
reviews.text: Just traveled to Cancun for an earned work trip and stayed at Paradisus. Everything was really great up until checkout where the hotel made me and multiple people pay RIDICULOUS amounts for wine that we never purchased. The same situation happened to multiple people from my company and it is a disgrace. Paradisus is an all inclusive, obviously minus alcohol that is not included. At dinner the first night, we asked for house wine and the waiter kept only shoving the wine list in front of our faces and kept telling us it was included and paid for by our company and that all we needed to do was sign. We knew better but he kept insisting it was included. Little did we know we'd be paying $500 out of pocket for wine that was not even good nor included in the "all inclusive" deals. The women at checkout would do absolutely nothing about it. All the staff did was threaten to call the police and that we could not leave the hotel if the wine was not paid for. This was appalling and we were 100% taken advantage of. It was really unfortunate that our trip had to end on a bad note and I would not recommend anyone staying here because of their staff.

reviews.author: vanblack
reviews.title: Great quick vacation
reviews.text: Stayed for 4 days to celebrate a friends 30th but also had to take my 1 year old. We stayed family concierge to make it easier. The hotel is beautiful inside and all restaurants are located in the middle. The views of the ocean and pools are beautiful. We came during a strange cold front it was a high of low 70s wish the resort had heated pools. Also wish the kids pool was heated. Must get to Bana early to get a awesome table with a jungle feel. Mole was our favorite restaurant with excellent food and a mariachi band playing. Family concierge is a must with children. You get two very attentive butlers and access to them all day through an app. They also make your reservations and tell you all daily activity. Our only complaint about the room is not enough plugs for 3 ladies.

reviews.author: Stay557906
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: wonderful two week vacation!  best morning service at Naos by our waiter Atilano!  so pleasant and couldn’t do enough to make sure we had everything we needed!  Thanks Atilano.  Wonderful bartenders Oscar, Edgar and Alan also.  See you next year.

reviews.author: sckmama1952
reviews.title: Vacation in Cancun
reviews.text: I was at the Paradisus Resort  at the end of November 2018 on vacation with a college roommate.  The hotel deserves high marks for its beauty, inside and out, and of course its wonderful beach. The center of the main building of the hotel was like a beautiful garden.  The service was over the top friendly and courteous at all times.  Excursions were well organized.  The buffet dining room was well stocked for all meals - don’t get there late for breakfast though or the lines will be long and the food not necessarily replenished.  The Asian fusion restaurant on our first night was really nice with a friendly waiter, but another night not so great  - server was not into it and the food was served cooled  off like it had been sitting around.  The Brazilian restaurant was good - the meat servings were delicious and generous, but the salad, veggies, and dessert was served as a buffet - family style service would have been nicer.  The Japanese restaurant was my favorite!! Be sure to make reservations early for the restaurants that require them!  The service in the bar area was sporadic - sometimes great other times not so much.  Seating was a little weird there with some seating in beds - which were definitely awkward and uncomfortable- better to replace these with couches or some other more practical seating!  Also, there seemed to be no notices about daily activities such as shows so we never knew if something was going on.  And we missed fiesta night because we were out on an excursion but it sounded like it was fun.  On the whole, we had a wonderful time. If you want to get away to a quiet resort and really relax, this was a good choice!

reviews.author: ecordes
reviews.title: Nice trip
reviews.text:
Hotel and staff were friendly.  Housekeeping was okay as we had no washcloths or enough towels replenished daily. It was otherwise clean. 
Room was somewhat outdated but comfortable and a larger dresser would have been nice so we could put away clothes.  Storage was limited. 
Pool area was nice with shaded spots and beach was beautiful!

reviews.author: bhaurez
reviews.title: Bartenders
reviews.text: Alan and Edgar...best bartenders you have on the property! They took care of us and got to know us as well. We loved going to the little bar that they worked at..the Red Lantern bar is what we always called it. Great drinks, great workers, and 2 of the nicest people we met At the resort. Keep up the great work Alan and Edgar.

reviews.author: Janice S
reviews.title: Treated like a queen
reviews.text: The employees really know how to treat you and make you feel welcomed.  The food was fabulous.  The beach is absolutely amazing.  Enjoyed the shows and the Red lounge.  Recommend this resort highly.  Can’t wait to return.

reviews.author: Flamin
reviews.title: El mejor servicio
reviews.text:
La semana pasada estuvimos en el Hotel Paradisus en el Cocos Pool.
Nos atendieron Didy (Didier) y Rene. Ha sido de las mejores experiencias y atención que hemos tenido. 
Literal, lo que deseábamos Didy lo concedía! 
Si van, no dejen de preguntar por ellos! 
La champaña, fruta y langosta DELICIOSAS!!!

reviews.author: litlsheba
reviews.title: Mostly great, some confusion and difficulty.
reviews.text: Overall, great stay.  Buffet food was adequate.  Not good just adequate.  We tried not to eat at the buffet often.   We did find 3 days into our stay that there is a breakfast buffet as well by the pool at Enso and no one goes there so we did for the remainder of our stay.   Ask for Franco.  He was amazing.  The tapas restaurant and Market Grill were our favorites.  We also ran into not being able to dine at night without a reservation but not until 2 nights into our stay.  All of a sudden you have to have reservations for dinner.  I was pretty angry so went to the front desk.  Lazaro Asencio was manager on duty and he graciously offered to talk to the staff and also arranged for dinner reservations for the next 2 nights for us.  It was very much appreciated Lazaro!  Rooms without them need to be updated for USB ports and other than that our stay was fabulous. Pillows go mysteriously flat quickly... maybe new fluffier options?  Very helpful staff.  Especially wait staff.  Tip well, they deserve it!

reviews.author: CanadianSuzyQ
reviews.title: VERY DISAPPOINTING
reviews.text:
1)     This hotel has a "Club" (time share), and you are directed to them when you check in.  Too aggressive for my liking. 
2)      No one seemed to know what the entertainment was and where it was and even what time it started.  This is the first all inclusive hotel I have ever stayed at that didn't have nightly entertainment - at a set time and in a set place.
3)      Food was OK.  Staff was great.  
4)      Spa - massage was amazing but the experience before (1 hour before was boring and the water was cool to cold in the pool area and the shower
5)       One day they put up a blow up slide by the pool for the kids, but that was it.  No one doing water aerobics, playing volley ball or anything else to keep the guests entertained.

reviews.author: Trail60434407186
reviews.title: Iryna Sytnikova
reviews.text: Stayed at Royal Service Paradisus Cancun - Excellent. The Hotel is very clean, loved the garden area in the middle with food bar. There's a variety of restaurants/food - all inclusive. The only one not included - TEMPO, expensive, but definitely worth the experience! Our butler Maria (Russian lady) was amazing! She has provided excellent service, was very attentive and responded to all of our needs in a timely manner. She made our stay very comfortable!

reviews.author: Josh M
reviews.title: Amazing Experience
reviews.text: This is my first time to Punta Cana and will not be my last! Paradisus is an amazing hotel with amazing staff. In particular, my OSCAR POLANCO, FIUMER JAVIER, EDWARD CAMINERO, ANTHONY ASTACIO, DEYANIRA MOTA and YARITZA BURGOS!! THE BEST STAFF EVER!

reviews.author: vitorgambassi
reviews.title: Razoável
reviews.text: O hotel é bem imponente, pé direito enorme e decoração e estrutura que lembram cenotes. Tudo é bem cuidado e o quarto é amplo e sempre muito bem limpo. O hotel fica muito próximo à praia, assim como a piscina e alguns restaurantes, facilitando bem a vida de quem está lá para descansar. As bebidas são, quase todas, de primeira linha, muito boas e com drinques muito bem feitos. Porém, a comida é bem fraca. Em todos os restaurantes que comemos, sempre algo dava errado, seja a comida demorar demais para chegar, vir fria ou mesmo ruim (às vezes tudo acontecia junto). A comida foi o ponto fraco, muito fraco do hotel. Um dos restaurantes estava em reforma, então dividiram o café e o buffet por outros, bem mais fracos. No último dia, o restaurante abriu e notamos a diferença absurda que ele fez, pois era realmente muito melhor do que os outros. Uma sacanagem essa reforma no restaurante sem qualquer benefício ao cliente que ali ficou durante esse tempo. Não recomendo por causa disso. Tivemos também problemas com a agência de viagem que fica no hotel, OTIUM, não recomendamos e acabamos com um prejuízo de 60 dólares. O hotel deve verificar isso.

reviews.author: tammy v
reviews.title: Excellent every time!!!
reviews.text: I love Paradisus is my 3rd time staying there and will always come back everytime I’ll go to Cancun. Everyone is amazing from Nacho in breakfast, Asunción in the pool to every single person in the hotel.

reviews.author: Cristoteca02
reviews.title: Is avarage .. but is good
reviews.text: I like this hotel the is avarage .. the drink are good .. you need reservation for restaurant .. pool are .. royale service is good if you want to relax adult only .. they hotel is very clean .. it has a nice night club too!

reviews.author: amylynn1010
reviews.title: Good, not great
reviews.text:
The week did not start out well. At check in we were not told that two of the restaurants were closed for remodeling, including the main buffet. Also, we are used to getting a list of activities or at least an explanation of how to find the list, but that didn't happen.

My friend and I were denied for dinner our first night at two of the resort casual restaurants because we had halter top bathing suits on under our clothes. We were not wet at all but were still turned away. A manager finally let us in the substitute buffet.

The restaurants didnt have much variety. The breakfast buffets were pretty much the same. The Market Grill was good the first time, but the second time the beef was all very rare, the bacon on the bacon wrapped turkey was rubbery and the chicken wings weren't cooked.

Mole had fantastic sea bass. The tapas were hit and miss at Tempo. The shrimp with risotto was the best one. 

At all the restaurants if you have a large group I recommend family style. You get a good variety of everything on the menu.

It also seemed odd that there was a restaurant in the main courtyard instead of a bar or area to have shows. The shows were not always in the same place. Sometimes in the Avenue Bar and sometimes at the pool outside Market Grill.The two shows we did watch were fantastic- Michael Jackson and a traditional Mayan show.

There was also a weird vomit smell near one corner of pyramid 3 on every floor.

The convenient store had everything you needed reasonably priced. 

The safe only used the room key, no code. We didnt have anything stolen, but we thought it was weird.

Sofonio was an amazing server at the pool next to the adults only section.  Jamie at the pool bar was great too.  In general, the staff was nice.

We have stayed at multiple resorts in Cancun/Playa. The Royal in Playa is our favorite.

reviews.author: ElenaFdz
reviews.title: Hermosísimo hotel
reviews.text: El hotel está HERMOSO, me di el recorrido en cada uno de los edificios y está genial!!! La comida bien, promedio...pero la playa está HERMOSISISIMA, la disfrutamos muchísimo y una atención buenísima del personal..el único detalle que me pareció muy fuera de base es que la playa tuvieran zonas especiales en los camastros de acuerdo a tu brazalete...que mal gusto estaban los camastros igualitos y a un lado pegadas las dos zonas y no quien supiera de repente pues estábamos sentadas en los camastros y vienen a movernos que porque esa zona era especial..y nosotros...pues son exactamente iguales los camastros y a un lado y bueno la verdad sí fue molesto pues ni siquiera había algun letrero o algo..es más aún con eso que mal gusto. Ese fue el único detalle que me pareció de mal gusto pero realmente por lo demás fue muy buena nuestra estancia.

reviews.author: Ana Gláucia d
reviews.title: No paraíso
reviews.text:
Resort simplesmente maravilhoso, todos os serviços, funcionários, comida.
Desde o café da manhã até o jantes, todas as comidas são muito bem preparadas.
Serviço de quarto, piscina e praia são maravilhosos.
Saul zarate e julio vazquez muito atenciosos com nós hóspedes.
De modo geral, tudo perfeito 😍🏖️✈️

reviews.author: Maricela E
reviews.title: Great experience... a few glitches
reviews.text:
The hotel is beautiful and the staff is incredible! We had excellent service our entire stay. Staff is super professional, very helpful, and fun. The hotel is beautiful, the views are unbeatable, the food was great, the beach was a-ma-zing, the pools were refreshing, and the entertainment was wonderful.

The few glitches that we encountered were the following: we had teeny, tiny, little ants in our room, the power went out in our room once when I was using the blow dyer, the battery pack on our door feel out of its place twice and we have to call to get it fixed, a juice from the minibar in our room made me extremely ill on my trip back home due to a past due expiration date that I didnt notice before I drank it.

reviews.author: Joice G
reviews.title: Vacaciones fenomenales
reviews.text: El mejor hotel con los mejores bailarines de animación. (Saul Zarate, Julio y Rodrigo) 🖤 Las clases son muy divertidas, el show en la piscina es bastante bueno. Me gustó la comida, el helado, la gente, los funcionarios son muy muy gentiles. Volveré pronto.

reviews.author: jdccurtis
reviews.title: Beach paradise, almost perfect
reviews.text: Check in easy with a waiter bringing and cocktail, juice, soda that you could ask for.  The resort is clean with fresh flowers and beautiful decor anywhere you turn.  The views to the ocean look like a postcard and once your on the beach you will never want to leave. The sand is soft, and water is clear and blue.  Service on the beach for drinks was amazing as you never were without a drink of choice.  This was also more impressive as we were with a group of 12.  The rooms are clean and modern and fit the tropical island feel.  We had one major issue as our doors electronic key reader went dead.  We had to spend 2 hours waiting for the staff to figure out how to get us in our room. They eventually used a crow bar to get the door open so we could take showers. We continued to have issues with new door and keys and had to make 7+ trips to the front desk to get in our room.  We were not mad as we know things happen, but we were offered nothing for the inconvenience. We thought maybe they would throw in a bottle of wine not included in the all inclusive, but nothing was offered.   The other part of the trip that could have been a little better was the food was average for the most part.   Nothing really impressed any one of our 12 travelers.  It wasn’t that is wasn’t good, it just wasn’t great for how fancy everything was.  Overall I would go back as the positives far outweighed any negatives.

reviews.author: Ahna P
reviews.title: An amazing trip to Paradisus Cancun/Royal Service
reviews.text: We had a great time at Paradisus Cancun while staying in the Royal Service.  The ocean was beautiful, the food amazing and the service was like nothing else’s I’ve ever had before.  Victor and Caesar in the La Palapa and pool area took great care of us, along with the rest of the staff.  We cannot wait to return.

reviews.author: gidrah
reviews.title: Birthday vacation!
reviews.text: The hotel was beautiful, beach was clean, service was as expected, good. The staff very hard working and most are very accommodating, just had an issue with hostess at “mole”, was rude, which is not tipical. The regular rooms do need upgrading, expected better decor, but were clean. We upgraded to “royal service” for $200 each for five nights. Worth it, did not get a butler but got ocean view on second night of stay, The royal service area was beautiful and had nice snacks all day, wish they closed later(10;00 pm) This is second time visiting Cancun this year. Food at Mole was not good, Blue Agave ok, Sushi was ok, the tuna tartar was great! Next time will go to another hotel, just to try a different experience. Had a great time with my friends, long lasting memories!

reviews.author: Cindy M
reviews.title: First Time Definitely Won’t Be The Last!
reviews.text: Stayed at Paradisus November 3 through November 10th.  Royal Service is a must.  You could not ask for anything better.  Octavio I. royal service building 5, was the best coffee barista on the resort.  Always happy and smiling.  La Palapa for royal service has wonderful staff.  Victor, Daniel, Orlando, Jose are always there to get your drinks and food with a smile.  Really enjoyed the breakfast and lunch.  Naos buffet was okay - Antonio was a great waiter.  Market Grill was our favorite.  Martin knew our names when we would eat there.  Coco’s Beach Bar was the best place to get a drink- Salvadore and Karina make the best chocolate martinis.  We will definitely be back to this resort.  The grounds are beautiful and the staff is the best!  If you have a butler, Rosanna is the one to ask for!!!

reviews.author: Juliacarmo72
reviews.title: Esperávamos mais
reviews.text:
O Hotel apresenta ótima infraestrutura, porém perde na qualidade da comida e atendimento da maioria dos garçons. Comida repetitiva. Não funciona 24 horas all inclusive como prometido. É um lugar muito bonito, praia bonita mas perigosa. A recepção é educada e ágil. 
Não voltaria.

reviews.author: MaRyChRy
reviews.title: Tres beau, super service, réno buyantes
reviews.text: Superbe hôtel, bon emplacement, belle plage peu d'algue. Service A1. Seul hic: réno dans la chambre du dessus et à la terrasse extérieure du Resto buffet. Bel emplacement, super sécuritaire. Personnel efficace et à l'écoute de ses clients.

reviews.author: Fahad Q
reviews.title: Good stay!
reviews.text: great workers, not enough seafood, only some restaurants had it for dinner, don't worry about 'royal service', not worth it, the hotel review is skewed bcuz of royal service.  resort is stunning!  No point getting a room if it doesn't have an ocean view, ask for the updated rooms in the main building.

reviews.author: Viciousvixen1
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text:
Absolutely beautiful resort with all the amenities you could imagine. The food was great and the all-inclusive rules were very easy to follow and simple - nothing shady, no tricks or hidden fees or anything like that. Top shelf alcohol is included! Everything here is very clean and exceptionally well maintained. The hotel is right on the beach and they have multiple pools too. They even have complimentary coffee &/ or dessert carts. The pistachio muffin is incredible. 
The entire staff here (except one weird rude creepy employee at the pool) was incredibly nice. Please tip them well- because believe me, you have a lot more than they do. Raul the bellhop was sooo sweet and very helpful, and so was another guy who was among the front desk with the glasses (he was greeting the guests and stuff)... I forget his name but he was my favorite  :(
All in all, beautiful resort, would definitely go back!

reviews.author: Glowee
reviews.title: The Paradisus Cancun was just okay
reviews.text:
Went to Paradisus with my girlfriends for a long getaway weekend.  The food wasn't good, the best meal we received was when we rented the Bali bed for the day.  The drinks were good with top shelf alcohol.  The hotel itself is beautiful and for the most part clean.  Wish there were more activities during the day but the nightclub was definitely the place to be at night for drinking and dancing.  

We encounter some great staff at the hotel, Didie and Rene in the Bali bed area, Julio with entertainment, Atilano in Fuego, and Jorge in the Market Grill.  These staff members made our stay at the Paradisus unforgettable, if the food was good I would've given the hotel five starts.

reviews.author: Randy F
reviews.title: The Leazer Group
reviews.text: Our trip was an all expense paid business rewards trip through The Leazer Group. Food, accommodations, amenities, all interactions with staff and employees were excellent. We would certainly revisit Paridisus again.

reviews.author: Rania Zohny
reviews.title: Highlight of my trip
reviews.text: From nyc to Cancún—this is my second time staying here and I couldn’t seem to book elsewhere. I love my stay at Paradisus and look forward to more visits! The all inclusive options came is handy as my friends and I love food and exploring our options. From casual, to extravagant we had full range and control. The hotel smells and looks incredible and the staff is so kind and generous. They called us after we checked in just to let us know if we need any toileteries or forgot to pack anything they will be happy to provide it for us. They checked in on us often to make sure our mini fridge was full and satisfying. Piece of advice—be kind, generous and tip the staff. We didn’t need to spend much with everything being all inclusive, and the staff is beyond attentive to your needs—so be prepared to leave a generous tip that they deserve. The only thing I disliked was the beach grill food—by 1 pm they were out of most of the options and only had chicken burgers and fries or pizza which all of them were dissatisfying. Stick to all the other restaurants but the bar and grill one by the pool needs a major upgrade in food and quantity. Naos and Fuego have been my favorites. Naos NEVER disappoints and the food options are endless—all you can eat, self serve, and hibachi options and desserts are limitless. Fuego and Molé were also incredible for Dinner.

reviews.author: Pioneer65383269491
reviews.title: Great experience !
reviews.text: Staff very friendly . Accomadation very good .Hostess ,waiters, bar waiters , cook , room stewart , enteriners , managers , front desk all emoloyers are great . Unbelieveble exoerience . I recomend frim the hart . I will get back next year with entire family .

reviews.author: Rumrush
reviews.title: Upgrade to “Royal Services”
reviews.text:
Food: all restaurants were average. The best one (great food) was “Fuego” 

Rooms: definitely upgrade to “Royal services”, their rooms are renovated and their pool is for adults only and very nice. 

Beach: very nice, waiters attentive and friendly.

reviews.author: glenda soledad m
reviews.title: Descanso y diversión
reviews.text: Excelente atención, se agradece mucho él servicio excelente de todo el hotel, alimentos exquisito,instalaciones y playa hermosa, el chico saul zarate y Rodrigo  son muy buenos anfitriones , nos llevamos un excelente recuerdo de cera con nuestras manos

reviews.author: CaptDusty1
reviews.title: Great vacation with friends
reviews.text:
We visited the Paradisus with 3 other couple and had a fantastic time. My wife and I were the only couple that got a family concierge package. 
Our 2 butlers, Sandra and Gloria, did a remarkable job! They booked our dinners and activities not only for us, but for our whole group. They also left us gifts on our last night there. Thank you !
The food, drinks, pools and activities were awesome. We will be back!

reviews.author: Patricia G
reviews.title: ROYAL SERVICE!!!
reviews.text: After a week on Isla Mujeres (which was wonderful), we moved on to Cancun for 3 days and stayed at Paradisus. I cannot express the surprise of how beautiful the hotel was. The hanging plants around the pyramids, the flowers everywhere, the staff... everything was just lovely. We got the Royal Service and Arturo was our butler... he was great. Anything we needed - he was there. Super friendly and helpful guy. Im not sure how I will ever go back to regular hotels again after this one. The royal service also allowed us to use the spa services which was nice. Our room was a 2 bedroom and we thought our friend would have to use our bathroom.... luckily she had her own. Just another surprise from Paradisus. We will be back!!

reviews.author: Fara S
reviews.title: Man I wish I could give this resort a 5 star.
reviews.text: Hey everyone! I'm back with a detailed review of the Paradisus Cancun. First let me begin by saying how much fun I had during my 7 days! What a blast! I went parasailing, jet skiing, boat touring and Flo riding. Alright, the two cons about the hotel is the very long check in procedure. I can't tell you how long we had to wait on the line just to get checked into our room :-( I guess it's expected on a Tuesday/Wednesday. The second and major con were the two small roaches we found in our room during our stay. Oh my goodness I can't begin to tell you how I despise insects in my living quarters. Anyhow, after all the grimace and running back and forth we killed the insects. I can honestly say that this hotel would've definitely been a 5 star if it weren't for one of the two cons (the insects). Other than that the hotel is beautiful, the beach is beautiful, the pool is fun, the reception/conference center for weddings was beautiful! The food was simply ok nothing major and the entertainment was nice too. The rooms and restrooms were spacious, but the hallway leading to our room was a bit dim...I'm guessing it's because they wanted to keep the jungle theme going from the main lobby. One big piece of advice I would give to the wedding coordinators; if the ceremony has to be held indoors because of weather I would advise that the ceremony take place in the hallway outside the reception hall. I cannot begin to tell you how large, bright and beautiful that area was. The wedding that I attended was so dim because of the jungle themed lobby area. Not a good place for a ceremony. Overall, I had a blast, but the only thing that would have made this top notch is if I didn't have to play bug inspector. Oh and I almost forgot, outside my room were towels because the ceiling was leaking.Hotel is handicap accessible, smoking outdoors and is a family resort.  :-( That's all for now. Pictures to follow.

reviews.author: Rosana K
reviews.title: Exelente
reviews.text: Top a comida,entreterimento, o atendimento....Rodrigo o Saul e Julio sâo exelentes np atendimento!o hotel é maravilhoso! A equpipe infantil éde mais....Satahi. arantaza. Adriana, Dinorah y paola Halina Sarah Ivone sao maravilhosos, atenderam nos brasileiros mt bem.

reviews.author: lenayavkina
reviews.title: Animation team!
reviews.text: We stayed in Paradisus one week, it was one of the best hotels I have ever visited. Every department was very courteous to our needs. Amazing service from saul, rodrigo, julio! Thanks a lot! Great resort!

reviews.author: 218marksmith
reviews.title: Food awful no premium drinks
reviews.text:
Just back from a week here been was looking forward for a while to come here.
Hotel is beautiful room lovely see view recommended.
Staff fantastic they work hard, however this hotel is not worth the money for the food and drinks hardly any vegetarian food and they cook the meat same place as they cook vegetarian food as in omelettes and use the same tools etc all rice pasta and soup is cooked in chicken and beef stalk but staff will tell you it’s vegetarian because it has no meat nothing is clear here so it’s hard to know what your eating. Please educate your staff on vegetarian food and how to cook it and what is acceptable  for them to eat it’s really not that complicated.; 
We love Mexico and having been coming for years for the amazing standard of food and premium drinks you certainly won’t get it here.
if you manage to book a restaurant 3 days in advance and if they’re not closed the food wasn’t great either, buffet same food repeated constantly. 
Every hotel We’ve stayed in served us premium drinks as in grey goose 1800 tequila etc here it’s smirnoff and cheap tequila which considering the price we paid is totally unacceptable it’s been the most expensive so far.
We stayed in dreams royalton Rui to name a few the food standards and restaurants there are amazing and always premium drinks.
The drinks are also watered down massively as mentioned in previous reviews. 
I wished I had paid attention to the reviews about the food before booking but I really wanted to stay at this hotel. We feel so disappointed.
The coffee shop is open for about an hour a day as with the ice cream station so catch it when you can think they’ve closed them down because it’s not high season as with the restaurants.
The beach was beautiful weather amazing.
We love you Mexico and can’t wait to come back but wouldn’t come back here we could have saved thousands by booking a cheaper hotel on the hotel zone with the same standard of food and drink.

reviews.author: ofelia t
reviews.title: Mesero rene frente a la alberca paradisus cancun
reviews.text:
Fuimos amigs a festejar cumpleaños y rentamos uno de los camastros
Que tienen frente a la alberca y ahi un mesero excelente que se llama rene nos atendio de maravilla... quiero recomendarlo ampliamente y si van pregunten por el nos encanto sus atenciones

reviews.author: Atulupadhyay2015
reviews.title: Awesome is the word
reviews.text: amazing property, great hospitality loved the greenery, rainforest kind of greenery inside the hotel..view from balconies is absolutely stunning all restaurants serve fab food. we enkjoyed our stay thouroughly. English seems to be bit of problem with some staff..

reviews.author: Maria F
reviews.title: Excelente servicio
reviews.text:
El hotel está muy agradable. Las habitaciones muy comodas, bien equipadas y de muy buen tamaño. La comida está deliciosa y muy variada en los 9 restaurantes que tiene el hotel. Disfrutamos mucho nuestra estancia. Muy recomendable y sobre todo la atención del personal es excelente las 24 horas. 
Lázaro Asencio fue muy atento durante nuestra estancia sin duda me volvería a hospedar ahí.

reviews.author: AmandaSoot
reviews.title: Total service
reviews.text:
Lo mejor quedarme en Royal service.
Todas mis amigas y yo súper bien atendidas las 24hrs , hotel súper limpio, agradable , bien ubicado y súper bonito. 
Variedad de restaurantes, comida y bebidas de la mejor calidad !

reviews.author: aminovi
reviews.title: Muy buen hotel
reviews.text: Excelente la comida de todos los restaurantes del hotel. Muy buen servicio. Hermoso hotel. En royal service Mayordomo Rode Excelente, con predisposición y atencion permanente. Hermosa experiencia!! !!!

reviews.author: Erika B
reviews.title: Felicidades
reviews.text: Excelente servicio. Animadores muy buenos Saúl Zárate. Julio y Rodrigo.  Excelentes y muy animados muy divertidos. Recomiendo este lugar . Excelentes servicios. Instalaciones . Todo. Si vuelvo a Cancún sin duda seria en paradisus. Lo recomiendo para todos h volveré pronto

reviews.author: Carlos P
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Las instalaciones del hotel son excelentes, la comida es deliciosa, bonitas habitaciones, el trato de los empleados no podría ser mejor, en Paradisus Cancún sí que saben que es la atención al cliente.

reviews.author: Daniela R
reviews.title: Instalaciones y servicio excelente!
reviews.text: Excelente atención de Royal Service! El personal súper atento, en todo momento. Alex y Jesús de royal service súper servicio. Francisco Rocha, que se encuentra en el área de dirección, tuvo una atención inmejorable! Hicieron de nuestra estancia, unas vacaciones muy placenteras!

reviews.author: arkrok
reviews.title: Perfect for anybody
reviews.text: Excellent adults-only section called Royal Service. I would recommend (if everyone is over 18) staying here and going between the two areas. Nice pool, lounge area, and beach. The smell of the Royal Service building is absolutely wonderful. The staff is extremely friendly and helpful. The restaurants are also wonderful, especially Blue Agave and Fuego (definitely my favorites of the trip). Nighttime entertainment is good. Lots of pool space, good for families and kids if you stay in the main areas. All in all, would totally do it again and was a great value for the money.

reviews.author: Vauneeka L
reviews.title: Bachelorette weekend
reviews.text: Visited Paradisus cancun with a group of girlfriends for a Bachelorette weekend. We paid for the Royal Service. Totally worth it! The hotel was extremely accommodating and I definitely felt the experience was elevated compared to my previous all-inclusive vacations. Jesus was our groups butler! He was FANTASTIC! So patient, so sweet! He definitely takes the time to make a genuine connection with his guests. The reason for the 4 stars was because the food in the restaurants in my opinion wasn't the best! Shout out to Daniel and his team at La Palapa for taking great care of us everyday even when we were loud and obnoxious and needy! Lol! I'd return to Paradisus Cancun for the experience but not so much for the food.

reviews.author: Eunice L
reviews.title: Perfect weather
reviews.text: Royal service for 4 nights. food was great, service great. on our last day there we had the calmest sea and clearest blue sky. our butler Daniel was great too. he went out of his way to get drinks for us that the hotel did not have. loved la palapa. they have the best fried chicken wings! went to the buffet a few times, one day they had sushi. their desserts are to die for. loved Mexican Fiesta night. i forgot to make a reservation that night, luckily, fiesta night saved my butt.

reviews.author: sillygoose520
reviews.title: Great experience.
reviews.text: Great experience. The hotel is clean and the staff are generally helpful, however, there are too many pushy salesmen for tours and activities. Sometimes they can’t just leave you alone. Otherwise it was a pleasant visit, remember to book dinners early because the restaurants(except the buffet) are usually fully booked.

reviews.author: Extraordinary581618
reviews.title: Great Staff - Mediocre Resort
reviews.text: The staff are there to help and do a fantastic job.  They were absolutely wonderful.  The grounds are lovely, although there was a ton of seaweed that was not removed until about our 4th day there; perhaps there's a good reason for that, but it smells and does not make the beach very inviting.  The pools were not crowded at all when we were there the first week of September.  We found it odd that the largest pool (with the only swim-up bar) was so deep.  It's huge and yet the entire thing is about 5 feet deep with the only shallow area leading up to the bar.  It could be because we're mature travelers (late 50s/early 60s) that we didn't appreciate the odd lounges/bars which had beds and low seating in one and just an odd decor in the other.  Maybe it's more suitable for a younger crowd; just didn't appeal to us.  The food was just OK - wasn't really our cup of tea.  We prefer Italian, French, American and I didn't pay any attention to the evening restaurant options before I booked so that's my fault and not theirs.    The buffet had nice options and I would say it was better than many other all-inclusives we've been to.  We were thankful we had gotten the Royal Service because it was the only place we felt we could go and be comfortable visiting with friends at regular tables and chairs.  Every morning and evening they had a (slight) variety of food options if you preferred to eat there and not at the buffet or elsewhere.  They also had a nice open-air restaurant and a bar out by the pool/beach that was exclusively for Royal Service guests.  Coors light was the only option as far as American beers go and they were only available in the Royal Service area. The Mexican light beers were tasty so that was fine. They had nice top-shelf liquors in the Royal Service area as well.Our room was comfortable and we were able to keep it nice and cool with temps outside in the 80s.  The rest of the resort was HOT.  HOT as in sweat your butt off hot.  There were a couple of restaurants with A/C and that's it.  The common areas, shops, majority of restaurants - basically the entire resort was without air.  That would be fine if there were any sort of attempt to bring the nice breezes in off the gulf, but that's not the case.  It's almost like the design KEPT the cool breezes out by putting up doors and glass and walls, etc.  This is the primary reason we will not be back.  We don't like to eat and drink and socialize while sweating.

reviews.author: Rodrigo R
reviews.title: Gran Viaje
reviews.text: La experiencia que da este hotel es increible, los sevicios del paquete all inclousive es extraordinario, las bebidas son de un muy buena calidad, la comida es excelente y los cuartos y el room service es inimaginable, muy recomandable. Gran experiencia.

reviews.author: ameliadixon
reviews.title: Very good all inclusive
reviews.text: We came here on a whim, after the hotel we booked originally turned out not to be all-inclusive.  Luckily the Paradisus was able to accomodate us at the last minute!  The food at the restaurants was very good for an all-inclusive resort - better than some others I've experienced!  The beach is long and nice.  It was very seaweedy and high surf, but not unswimmable, and I think that's due to the time of year we went (Sept).  The pools are kept very clean, the service at the bars is good.  We were impressed with the entertainment staff.  Mariachi band at the Mole restaurant was a nice touch.  Mini fridge gets regularly stocked.  The gym is certainly adequate.  We never ran out of bottled water.  The beds were a little hard, but not awful.  For a "lagoon view" room it was still pretty on the balcony even though it was the cheapest one.  I'd absolutely recommend this place.

reviews.author: eferradah
reviews.title: Excelente Hotel
reviews.text: Uno de los mejores hoteles en los que he estado. Excelente atención, la comida y bebida de primer nivel, recomendable 100% la experiencia en Royal Service como servicio exclusivo para adultos. El hotel queda cerca además de shoppings y lugares turísticos de cancún, y resulta fácil movilizarse.

reviews.author: lmaristan1986
reviews.title: Lo tiene todo
reviews.text: Es imposible describir lo que es este hotel, la excelencia en absolutamente todo. Las instalaciones son impresionantes, el personal maravilloso, atento, amable y siempre pendiente de brindarte lo mejor. Te hacen sentir una reina!!! Gran variedad de opciones culinarias, no te da el tiempo para probar todo lo que hay! Las habitaciones son un sueño, la vista, todo el hotel es INCREÍBLE!!! Si quieren unos días de relax, comodidad, privacidad, y dejarse mimar... este es el lugar perfecto! Lo ame y seguramente los volveré a visitar!

reviews.author: vashko
reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text: Amazing resort , great food , friendly and very helpful staff, our Family concierge butlet SANDRA was very fun and there for us anytime we needed anything , lots of restaurants to choose from and activities to do , resort is very big and has a lot to offer, great shows every night and just a fun and classy place overall.

reviews.author: Tiffany Nicole
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: I absolutely loved this little piece of paradise! My birthday was nothing short of amazing! The food people and atmosphere added to the beauty of this resort. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a nice getaway!

reviews.author: Whitney H
reviews.title: Amazing Royal Service
reviews.text: Royal service was amazing and 100% worth the money. We enjoyed every minute. The room was nice, the private pool and restaurant were great, the spa was amazing, it was all wonderful. Really enjoyed the pineapple party as well!

reviews.author: It's Me
reviews.title: Wonderful! Always a favorite!
reviews.text: My best friend and I stayed with Paradisus Cancun back in May for my 30th birthday. From the moment we arrived the staff was nothing short of amazing. We arrived later in the evening, but were greeted with smiling faces. They already had us scheduled for different restaurants each night. All of which were superb. When we got to the room they had streamers, balloons, and a birthday cake with a candle. We stayed in the club tower and had Jorge as our "butler". He was absolutely fantastic. He checked in on us every morning to ensure that we were well taken care of. Also, the restaurant and pool service staff, they were always amazing. For my birthday I think I must have been sang to at least 4 times. The staff at the breakfast buffet always remembered us, and were excited to see us. There is nothing about this resort that I don't love. If you have the opportunity to stay here I highly recommend taking it.

reviews.author: Aixamar R
reviews.title: Awesome experience
reviews.text: Excellent environment, clean, fun, and very relaxing. Everything was excellent, specially HECTOR my butler. Food was amazing and the Rogal Service was over the top. Amazing Spa experience and very relaxing. I recommend this Hotel to EVERYBODY.

reviews.author: romuloschumann
reviews.title: Melhor Hotel
reviews.text: Qualidade de atendimento e instalações impressionante. Serviço impecável.Variedade de comidas e bebidas de altíssimo nível, totalmente inesperado frente ao valor cobrado pela diária.Realmente um dos melhores hotéis para se ficar em Cancún

reviews.author: Bery187
reviews.title: exelentes vacaciones
reviews.text:
Al momento de llegar nos atendieron excelente, mi familia se fue encantada del hotel, el restauran naos (buffet) es muy bueno aun que le falta un poco mas de variedad, pero la atención del mesero que le dicen Grillo fue la mejor, nos encanto el restauran japones uno de los mejores. 

hermosas instalaciones, spa de lujo, el puesto de helados y café fue lo mejor espero poder ir con mi familia próximamente

reviews.author: FarAway161679
reviews.title: Great time!
reviews.text: Had a wonderful stay here for 3 x nights. The food and drinks were at a very high standard. Special mention to Jaimie who helped us get tickets for coco bongo, andreas and Moises from the buffet and the wonderful Elliot at the pool. These staff really made our stay. Look forward to visiting Mexico again !

reviews.author: Trfigueredo
reviews.title: Entrada fatal
reviews.text: Espero que mejore la estancia porque hasta el momento califico como fatal mi entrada al hotel. Deficiencia de atención en cuanto a solucion de problemas. Llevo 2 hrs esperando para hacer check in. El cual no me dan soluciones adecuadas si no somos nosotros los que la damos. El Niño sin almorzar y aún estoy esperando. Horrible. Espero sinceramente que mejore. Muy mal para Melia. Tenía mejor criterios para ellos.

reviews.author: Cmarch310
reviews.title: DO NOT recommend for Club Melia Members
reviews.text:
I greatly enjoy the Melia hotel chain and have stayed at multiple Melia resorts (Paradisus Playa del Carmen, Paradisus Punta Cana, Melia Orlando, The Level at Melia Tropical, spent a day at Melia Cozumel) and in my opinion this hotel does not live up to the rest. This was my second stay at this hotel (last stay was in 2016) and I would say the service has declined over the years. I traveled with a Club Melia member and we were NEVER contacted by anyone on the Club Melia staff to see how our stay was going. We were a bit surprised by this as every other time (8+ times) we have stayed in a Melia resort the service is always the outstanding part– here the service is what was extremely lacking! Cancun is one of our top travel destinations but unfortunately I will return to this resort again. 
Some notes from our stay:
-	The hotel accommodations are good - hotel is extremely walkable, everything in a short distance. Nice large pool area, Jacuzzi on balcony is a great touch. 
-	One of the “rules” is to not reserve chairs by the pool, however, during busy season if you do not get your spot picked before 8am you will not have much luck finding a spot later in the day. 
-	The food is not bad for an all inclusive. We enjoyed the Grill, the Brazilian steakhouse style restaurant as well as Fusion for dinner. Blue Agave has great authentic tacos. Red lounge is a fun nighttime option after 10pm. 
-	We had a wheelchair accessible room and if you do not need it I would try to steer away from it. Limited counter space in the bathroom as well as a bit of an awkward room layout due to ramps. It is not a deal breaker by any means but if you can avoid it I would try to. 

All in all, the hotel is not bad. However, in comparison to the other Melia properties and service we have received in the past, it definitely falls short from the others. We will not return.

reviews.author: Rainbow S
reviews.title: Excellent Service in NAOS restaurant
reviews.text: Andres and Juan provided super great service at the NAOS restaurant.  The Concierge was also extremely helpful with booking a trip.   The nightly entertainment was varied and very good.  The inside entertainment was especially nice.

reviews.author: samquater
reviews.title: No lo que esperaba
reviews.text:
De todos los lugares de la riviera que visite fue el que menos me gustó, me pareció un poco desordenado y creo que deberían de mejorar la atención a los huéspedes ya que estuve en recepción varias ocasiones y no me volteaba a ver. 
Aunque es impresionante de cierta forma

reviews.author: Rachel I
reviews.title: Meh.
reviews.text:
Pros:  Rooms are nice.  Buffet and bar staff went above and beyond and were fabulous!

Cons: Both during check in, check out, and several times when we had questions, there were anywhere from 3-5 people standing around with iPads.  Not one of them was able to answer any of our questions or help out in any way.  

I joined the "Melia Club" and checked in online several days in advance.  When we arrived at the check-in, there was a special line for club members. We sat in that line for several moments until someone told us we had to go to the other line.  There were additional people who had joined the line since we were there that were now in front of us.  The wait to check in was over 25 minutes.  I booked the resort with  my husband's credit card, but he was not on the trip.  It is the same account, but they made us rebook with my card and then refund his.  Bringing the card used to book the room was NOT listed on my confirmation email.  The room we reserved "wasn't available" and we were told it's not something the resort even offers.  I don't know how that's possible when I clicked the button for a two bed, ocean view room.  We were given a King size.  The room was nice, but we looked at a wall.  When we went to discuss this the next day as we were paying an additional $30/night for an ocean view, we were told that "nowhere on the website does it guarantee you a view" and that you are "either on the lagoon side or the ocean side".  (This is incorrect; see my attached photos.)  We were then given a different room that faced the ocean but had a poor view due to shrubbery.  Neither room had a stocked fridge when we arrived, however, when we went to take our stuff from the first room (we stayed one night there), the fridge was then stocked.  Lastly, there was a big difference in the height of the bathroom floor vs. the rest of the room.  I stubbed my toe in the middle of the night, and anyone with poor vision may end up doing it multiple times!

Dining: The buffet is great- good choices and variety, and they move relatively quickly to get you seated for meals.  Staff here went above and beyond!

We were not told at check-in that reservations were required for dinner.  I have been to several other all-inclusive Cancun resorts, some of which require reservations and others do not.  I have been informed at check in IF I need reservations at every other resort I've stayed at.  We went to get sushi, not realizing we needed reservations.  We were told we could not be seated because we didn't have a reservation, but there were *at least* 15 open tables.  After we pointed that out, they told us we could be seated in 15 minutes.  

Pools: We took a tour with a staff member of the hotel for an event.  She took us to the "adults only" side and showed us what the facilities in that area looked like.  The next day, we walked through the glass stores stating only "Adults Only" and attempted to settle in lounge chairs only to be told we didn't have the right color bracelet and the "adults only" side was only for patrons in Pyramid 5.  This was not previously explained to us nor is it posted at the entrance.

Pools were overall beautiful and were clean.  Service at the "regular" pools was slow.  Our server was very friendly but obviously had a big area to cover as she only came by once in about 2 hours.

All in all, we were very disappointed in such a highly rated resort.  While there was nothing earth-shattering like food poisoning, there were SO many little things that were not indicative of such a "nice" resort.  We will not be returning.

Pics are of our original room, the view from the Asian restaurant, or food, the room we switched to with a supposed “view, the empty fridge, doorway height discrepancy

reviews.author: Stan S
reviews.title: Big Disappointment!
reviews.text: We started off waiting for an extended period of time after our check-in time because the room was not ready. When we finally arrived to the room some of the pillowcases and sheets were dirty and clearly have not been changed. We informed housekeeping on the floor had them change out the soiled linens. We had a mini fridge in the room. I opened it to get a bottle of water and it was warm. The fridge was plugged in, but not working. We called the front desk to notify and they said someone would be up in a few minutes. The maintenance man did not come until about 3 hours later. I called to make a reservation at a restaurant for the following day. Only one place had availability to make a reservation. When we arrived there the hostess could not find my name on the list. It took some convincing and we were finally seated. The whole hotel has NO air conditioning in the atrium or hallways. The restaurant was in the center of the hotel and everyone was hot and uncomfortable. We were literally sweating and did not even feel comfortable to eat. The next morning I was woken up to a sound of dripping water. I investigated the sound and found water to be dripping from the bathroom ceiling. I called the front desk. I was shocked that they sent someone up and they were unable to fix it and did not move our room. I asked the manager to please relocate us since the floor was very slippery and my girlfriend already fell. I feel this property has potential, but the management is terrible and leaves their customers unsatisfied. I cannot believe the property does not even have air conditioning in the common areas. I would  not return to this hotel again. Very disappointed. When we left we reported and even took pictures of our concerns, and not even an apology was received. As a corporate travel agent who has many clients travel to the area, I will not be recommending your property in the near future. I had hoped very much to have a pleasurable experience and was very let down.

reviews.author: T P
reviews.title: Outstanding staff, excellent hotel
reviews.text:
We are staying at the hotel right now. This is our fifth time with Paradisus. We stayed at Paradisus La Perla in the past. Paradisus Cancun offers outstanding service by very pleasant and helpful staff, beach front location and delicious food options for the foodie. We upgraded to Royal Service this time and it’s totally worth it.

Daniel, our butler, is exceptional! He arranged a surprise for our occasion and goes above and beyond. Melinda at Royal Service check-in is excellent. Jose at the Royal Pool Concierge is awesome. Daphne gave us a great overview of the property. The staff at the Royal Service restaurant, La Palapa, and bar are simply outstanding: Cezar, Oscar, Julio.

Our favorite restaurant is Vento which is tapas. I’d say almost all food at this hotel, including buffets, is great and, even though restaurants require reservations, they are accommodating.

The people who work at Paradisus are always helpful, work very hard and are pleasant to interact with, which sets this hotel above the rest. That’s why we keep coming back. Highly recommended.

GP

reviews.author: Amy  T
reviews.title: First trip to Cancun and loved it!
reviews.text: My first trip to Cancun from Los Angeles and traveled with a friend- everything was amazing, relaxing, and the best service! From beginning to end the service was 5 stars. We had a lagoon view room with a balcony which was great, the pool overlooking ocean is a perfect hang out spot, loved the Market Grill Brazilian steakhouse restaurant and the Tapas Restaurant as well. The pool grill by the pool was just okay as well as the Enso Asian cuisine. The resort itself is large and beautiful, people are hard working and smile all the time! Such polite workers here. The pictures of the resort beach are misleading- it’s pretty but not clear water, it’s full of seaweed which means no swimming here. It doesn’t matter though since the ocean is across the street and book excursions through Aqua World. Do the Jungle tour for a fun speed boat that takes you out to snorkel in clear water and we saw so many fish!!! We also took jet skis on the water which was so much fun and absolutely loved the the day trip to Isla Mujeres- we snorkeled in the ocean and loved the taco lunch on the island. We loved every part of the visit- thank you!!! Can’t wait to try the Paradisus coming to Costa Rica!

reviews.author: Lana
reviews.title: Самый лучший отдых
reviews.text: Самый лучший отель. Отзывчивый и вежливый персонал. Красивый и по настоящему райский отель. Еда и напитки вкусные. Первая линия океана. Анимация не дает народу скучать, все время новые программы. В номерах убирают  каждый день. Есть номера с видом на океан и с видом на лагуну. Рядом с отелем автобусная остановка, автобус довезет вас до центра и намного дешевле, чем такси. Если у вас все включено, то бар в номере пополняют бесплатно каждый день. Отель самый красивый и шикарный, все в отеле на 5.

reviews.author: Courtney S
reviews.title: Amazing experience!
reviews.text: The Royal Service experience exceed all of our expectations. Our butler, Leyner, went above and beyond in ensuring I had the best possible birthday trip! I would absolutely stay at the Royal Service portion of this property again!

reviews.author: Ligia B
reviews.title: Fun girls trip in Cancun
reviews.text: Traveled 5 days with friends. Had been to Paradisus in Riviera Maya and was hoping for same luxe experience. Was not the same and I would go back to Other one. The beach was nice but had seaweed in many areas. Was in Royal Service and private pool and restaurant were great. Butler was out for 2 days and hotel should have assigned new one but didn’t. Restaurants were better than most AI places but sushi one was meh, and better at other Paradisus in general. Very attentive staff. The Tempo restaurant (not included) was phenomenal and worth every penny! NYC high end restaurant worthy. Spa was ok-services great, facility and space is not grand and much better in other hotels.

reviews.author: Jami H
reviews.title: Beautiful vacation, everything as advertised!
reviews.text: The Paradisus was exactly as advertised, but pictures can't tell the story of how lovely, friendly, and attentive to our needs every staff person was! We enjoyed everything about the resort including the food. Be sure to make your dinner reservations early so that you can enjoy all the fabulous specialty restaurants. Rooms were very clean, spacious and luxurious. The buffet for breakfast and lunch offered so many different choices that everyone in our party could always find something yummy to eat. The pool was beautiful and the swim up bar is the place to be to meet new friends and enjoy interesting conversations! Ask for bartender Jamie at the swim up bar - he's the best and will take great care of you! Our daughter suffered a broken ankle on an off-site excursion and everyone at Paradisus was so nice and helpful, even sending out for crutches for her and pushing her around in a wheelchair. I can 100% highly recommend Paradisus. A great value for the money too.

reviews.author: Monica F
reviews.title: Relaxing with superb service!
reviews.text: I visited this resort with two other girlfriends and we had a blast!  We stated in the royal service and it was so worth the money.  We had the lobby that smelled of wonderful vanilla and drinks and snacks throughout the day.  Our room looked out over the ocean and was stocked with everything we needed.  Jeisel was our butler and he was AMAZING!  He made us reservations at the pool everyday and we cannot speak more highly of his service and friendliness.  The bali beds near the pool and facing the ocean are the BEST beds I have ever had at a resort and they made our entire day.  We also loved the spa and there sauna and outdoor spa area while waiting for our massage.  I would absolutely recommend visiting this resort and for the money it was worth every penny.  Jeisel really was the cherry on top of our visit.

reviews.author: tomfarmer31
reviews.title: Beach Service and Staff EXCELLENT!  Asuncion and Oscar Team were awesome!
reviews.text:
My wife and I, + another couple and their 4 teens.  All beach and ocean lovers.

We went to the beach every day we were there.  The service team of Asuncion and Oscar made each day so much easier and fun to enjoy!

As a former waiter in my college days, I am very picky about not enough or too much service...these two had it right!

They were always making sure we had whatever we needed, drinks and food!! bags of ice for an old knee..you name it!  But they could tell when to come by, and when we were content to lay in the sun etc.

They speak solid english, and were very helpful about the activities available, the hotel layout etc.  They also have great senses of humor.  

We actually recommend that you find their section on the beach.  (Near, but not too close, to the beach small sand volleyball court...BTW, great fun to watch the different families meeting and getting a game going...it was a VERY friendly place to vacation)
 
Food:  it seems you have to make reservations for every dinner restaurant...be sure to do that. Check with your concierge ahead of your trip if possible

reviews.author: SMDB15
reviews.title: Great time but always room for improvement.
reviews.text:
I booked based on rave reviews about the DR location. I booked a royal service junior suite. While the room was lovely, it was just a double room and by no means a sweet. When I asked I was informed that we had a "lower level" of junior suite. Every junior suite I have ever been in at least had a sofa, table, etc. That was my only disappointment with the room. That and that you can leave anything other than water out for more than 5 minutes or hundreds of ants will be all over it in a few minutes. Other than that, it was spacious, clean, very nice balcony, very nice view. Some amenities need to be updated if you want to call it royal service.

Food- specialty restaurants were good. The tapas and Brazilian restaurants are excellent, breakfast buffet excellent, the asian fusion restaurant is just ok. Blue agave was good but if you go too late, most of the basic things like salsa will not be available. Mexican restaurant with no unlimited supply of salsa was insane to me. Room service, worse thing I ever ate. Should not be called food. Stay away from the pizza, worse pizza I ever had, no effort put into it at all. Cheese not even melted. Also stay away from the chili dog. Spelled like Alpo. Hot dog not even cooked, grilled, or boiled. Taste straight out pack. 
Lapa Lapa, by the royal service pool had very good nachos and mini burgers. Drinks always good and service always good.
- Grounds, grounds beautiful. Pool area and cabanas are well maintained and beautiful. The beach minus the seaweed was beautiful. 

Butler and royal service- this service needs to be improved. There was no way to reach him unless you had whats app. He told me if I needed him to call but how can I call with no phone service. Not everyone has whats app and in order to set up whats app you need to be able to receive the initial autorization text. Cant do that if you dont have international cellular service. I was informed that at other paradisus resorts, royal guests are given cell phones. Perhaps this wouldnt be a bad idea for this place. Also, we only saw him if we needed something.Otherwise not attentive. Made no suggestions unless asked, etc. Nice but I dont think he did anything we wouldnt do ourselves.
I liked checking in seperately at the royal service building and that they had light snacks through out the day and eve. Just wish it was later.

I had a great time. No place, no matter how much you pay will be perfect and luckily the positives of this place outweighed the negatives.
Some suggestions 24 hour snacks and liquor access. Room service does not deliver drinks other than soda so it would be nice is there was a 24 hour self serve.

reviews.author: Phuong Jenna T
reviews.title: Only good for Adults only, not family
reviews.text: We went as a group of 8 families with kids and teens. For those with Family concierge the experience is slightly better, but for non-family concierge, it's not a great experience. The hotel did not have enough staffs and not enough restaurant tables so if you don't have Family concierge, be prepared to wake up at 7am on your vacation to call in the restaurants to reserve. Even with Family concierge, which our family had, it's not a guarantee to get in a restaurant, so mostly you are stuck with a buffet that does not have enough variety or quality even in comparison of the cheapest cruise ship. The hotel is beautiful, and when we drop off our kids and head to the Adults only area, it's wonderful. Staffs there are attentive and the food/beverages are better quality. The beach is not great for swimming, it's filled with seaweeds, and the pool on family side are so packed that if you want a chair, you need to wake up at 7am on vacation and bring some personal things to put on them to reserve. The staffs tried, but there isn't enough of them comparing to the amount of guests, think waiting 1 hour for a drink by the pool, even when you tip them generously they are so overwhelmed. Our room was nice, but one of the bathroom leaks, and the furniture is pretty outdated. We won't be going back since it's not a relaxing vacation as we expected, even with Family Concierge/Ocean View Suite package, it's just okay.

reviews.author: Jason L
reviews.title: I wouldnt come back
reviews.text: I was very fustrated with this trip and felt like i was scammed. I paid for royal service which includes bali beds and butler services. Even after gettinf my butler to book bali beds and restaurants 3 days ahead we still got denied. The bali bed day of we went to pool and we never got our bed. Restaurant day before we get a text from our butler saying reservations was denied but when i walk by restaurant at my supposed time the place had like 4 empty tables but wouldnt accept walk ins. Whats the point of going to an all inclusive when i am forced to eat buffet for breakfast lunch and dinner bc i cant get into any restaurants.

reviews.author: Ryan A
reviews.title: Royal service, cockroaches, great service, Butler.
reviews.text:
Cons: I stayed for 4 days and initially paid for the lagoon view but upgraded to ocean view when I got the hotel. Be aware if you get first floor ocean view. My room had cockroaches on half of the room and we weren't changed rooms for two of the 4 days. Apparently when a complaint goes in about cockroaches, a fumigation of the room is equal to a guy with a can of raid. They also failed to tell me about any of the Royal services for the two days, which included the fact that I had a Butler and free bottle of alcohol with my new room upgrade or any benefits besides the room view.

One more thing about the cockroaches. Once I found out I had a Butler I told him about my cockroaches and he fixed it immediately which makes me wonder what would've happened if I didn't have a Butler upgrade. Would they have just sent the guy with the raid can offer until I left? 

I probably would've left, but I know Mexico. Me leaving to another place means that the new hotel will know they have an advantage and get worse so I dealt with it.

Room service might as well just be frozen hot pockets and chimichangas. The food in room service was terrible but that's not a big deal to me. The restaurants more than make up for it.

Once you give them your money it's theirs. Even if you can't use half your room for 2 of 4 days because of cockroaches. Being denied a refund of $280 upgrade fee because I didn't get Royal services I thought was fair. They did not and refused my request for refund. 

Pros: minus the negatives, my ocean view was gorgeous. Fuego and mole were delicious restaurants. The yhi spa massage was the best massage I've ever had.  The staff is incredibly nice and seemed to always say hi even just in passing by which I like. My bed was awesome. 

The pool was great. The beach is great. Regardless of my cockroaches I loved the hotel. But I probably won't go back. The refund for cockroaches really bothered me.

reviews.author: KAZI
reviews.title: Average
