reviews.text: Nothing special about his hotel. Food is average, not anything that I miss. We were there for 3 nights, but if we were there longer, I could see that we would get sick of the food. Activities were average. Nothing about this hotel and experience stood out above average. Not that we had any bad experience here, but I’ve stayed at better all inclusive resorts that I would not return to this hotel. It was just two girls and we had a very relaxing trip. Bar/club they have were lame. They did leave us a bottle of tequila in our room on arrival, but also we have upgraded to adults only area of the hotel. I’m not sure if that was worth it.

reviews.author: R.Craft
reviews.title: The best resort in Cancun
reviews.text: This resort is a 5 star resort.  The hotel and the people are top notch.  I've been going to Cancun since 2000 and this is the only resort I will stay at from here on out.  Rosanna in the Royal Service section was our butler and we will be asking for her in the future.  All the staff members went beyond what was expected to make our stay perfect.

reviews.author: Jacqueline E
reviews.title: Cuidado com os pertences de valor!!!
reviews.text: O hotel é bom bem limpo e grande com opção de varios restaurantes com variedades de comida os drinks não gostei todos tem o mesmo gosto ruim, a cerveja sempre quente e não tem opção de porções na praia, os garçons q atende na praia só funciona se der “proprinas” como eles chamam a gorgeta para obter as porções na areia tem q pagar uma taxa a mais para o hotel, os bangalos na area da piscina e na praia tbm não está incluso no all incluse normal, só cadeira de praia e quiosque. MUITO CUIDADO COM OS PERTENCES PESSOAIS, um casal de amigo q foi com nós foram roubados em 200 dolar em espécies e outro casal que conhecemos tbm foi roubados em dinheiro e joias, não deixe nada a vista dos camareiros se puder nem deixe no cofre! Nenhum dos casos foi resolvido, infelizmente um ponto muito negativo para o hotel.

reviews.author: Israel L
reviews.title: Hotel resort con todo para no querer salir
reviews.text: Excelente hotel para familias sobre todo por lo espacioso que son las habitaciones y la variedad de comidas que se sirven, suficiente espacio en alberca, la atención de su personal es muy distintiva, es una excelente opción si buscas una playa bastante tranquila.

reviews.author: JoseLover
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text: If you enjoy partying then come here. Awesome nightlife. Luís and Victor are both great bartenders. Delvis and Raphiel are awesome dancers. The bars have great service and never left my cup empty. Great spot for family and your friends.

reviews.author: Wrldtrvlr
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: This hotel is about a 20 min ride from the airport and right across the street from aquaworld which offers great excursions. Bus stop for transportation to shopping is right in front of hotel as well. Great location. Middle of hotel is a beautiful atrium, but not air conditioned. Most restaurants were somewhat warm as well and fans were the only means of A/C. Staff was very friendly and tried to accommodate in every way. Hotel doesn’t pay attention to room requests. When making reservations, both parties requested double beds. Both parties received king beds. The people traveling with us had a horrible experience. Their shower backed up and flooded the bathroom floor, then the toilet backed up and flooded the floor. After several calls to the front desk, maintenance supposedly fixed the problem only to have it happen again the next day. This resulted in them having to move their things into our room to wait until after 4pm to get another room. Beautiful pool and beach area. There was a lot of renovations going on the hotel. Must say much needed! IMO... better options!

reviews.author: Quicka
reviews.title: Buen nivel
reviews.text:
La cadena Paradisus cuentan con hoteles a los que vas a la fija. Cómodas habitaciones, excelentes opciones de restaurantes, discoteca, piscina, spa, gym y bellas playas con todas sus comodidades y opciones para divertirse.
Como es un gran complejo tiene un sistema de carritos que te desplazan a todas los bloques áreas del hotel o bicicletas que puedes utilizar sin inconvenientes. 
Los planes son excelentes en cuanto a los beneficios que se reciben por todo incluido. 
El personal en general muy amable y siempre dispuesto a atender las solicitudes de los huéspedes. 
Habitaciones amplias, cómodas con todos los servicios (plancha, nevera, secador, cafetera, wifi)
Excelente opción en Punta Cana que encuentras de todo

reviews.author: Ian S
reviews.title: Girls weekend away
reviews.text: Although the weather was terrible the resort is so large and there is so much to do we did not feel trapped. The Royal service is worth every dollar. Food is fantastic. FIFA was on all the TVs and the bars were all set up to watch.

reviews.author: susanxxe
reviews.title: Great property! Royal Service not worth it if you get a bad butler.
reviews.text: I booked 2 rooms at the Paradisus Cancun with a few girlfriends to celebrate a birthday. The property was absolutely beautiful, the amenities were great, and the food at La Palapa kept us wanting more. The only issue is that we had a terrible butler. We paid extra for the Royal Service based on high recommendations from another friend. Unfortunately, the service was not as described, which really impacted our overall experience.

reviews.author: Jordan
reviews.title: Had a great time!
reviews.text: A friend and I went in spring and it was fantastic! The staff is very friendly and accommodating, the pools are relaxing, and the food was good - Fuego was our favorite and Christian was an excellent waiter (so good, we went back a second night)! Would travel here again for a nice beach getaway.

reviews.author: Crystal H
reviews.title: Vacation in Paradise Wonderful Staff and Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text:
Lets just say this is about my ninth time staying at Paradisus Cancun Royal Service. I love love love this resort. It is so relaxing excellent staff many restaurants  to choose from with many different options for food and dining.  Some top shelf alcohol at bars and restaurants although some brands you can only get on the Royal Service side. Rooms have recently been updated and are beautiful and very clean. When you arrive you will be assigned a Butler who will take care of you during your stay. We always request Rode. He is very friendly funny and great with his guests. He will take great care of you any issues you may have if any during your stay. Your butler will make your dinner reservations and anything else you may need.I do recommend you make your reservations in the beginning of your trip so you can eat at the restaurants you would like throughout your stay but it's not usually a problem getting in. All the butlers are great. We also know Galdino and Sergio they were also awsome during our stay this time and throughout the years taking care of anything we may need and very friendly. If there are any issues the manager of Royal Service Lacero ? spelling of name is great. He is always there with a smile saying good morning good afternoon etc. checking on how your stay is going throughout the week and wanting to help if any issues are going on. One of the best parts or royal service is it is adults only so 18 and older. We have our own pool with no kids which is a plus when on a relaxing vacation. There is the pool concierge staff that will help you Jose, Marco, Degner and Elizander. They are great very friendly interact well with the quests. If you need anything from suntan lotion to towels even cabanas they will be the ones you see. They even came around with fruit for quests while we were there. There is also a royal service restaurant  la palapa which is only for royal quests. The food is great. They serve breakfast and lunch with a great ocean view. Daniel is the manager of this restaurant. He is so friendly is always there to help his staff and get you anything you may need.  The waiters and waitresses will rotate from the restaurant to bringing you your food and drinks to the pool or cabana wherever you may be for the day. We love Valeria, Eddie and Moises. They as so friendly and great with there guests also as the other people are that work there but from going so many times you start to remember familiar faces. Edier that now works at Naos which is the buffet for breakfast and Francisco that works at the red lounge now also took very good care of us this stay. They both use to work on the Royal service side. We would go to find Edier for breakfast and Francisco when it was time to go out for the evening. It is so nice to go to a hotel to find the same friendly faces of everyone that i had mentioned above when you come to visit. I could go on and on. I just want to say this is a great resort and very friendly staff and managers. I almost forgot to give a great job to the manager at Fuego one of my favorite results Guiermo. He was great and i loved the way he interacted with his guests also. We will deff be back soon can't wait to see my friends/family i have made throughout all these years at the Paradisus Cancun Royal service.

Crystal H.

reviews.author: carolsvisuals
reviews.title: Excellent Experience
reviews.text:
Paradisus was AMAZING! Every staff made us feel at home and spoiled us with their kindness and attentiveness. They made us feel like royalty! Thank you for giving us such a great experience! 
Everything from the room to the restaurants and the service was all wonderful!

reviews.author: Laísa L
reviews.title: HOTEL INCRÍVEL!
reviews.text:
O hotel é maravilhoso! Tudo é perfeito, desde o check-in funcionários atenciosos e solícitos. No hotel cada ambiente tem um aroma diferente, um melhor que o outro. Quarto grande, espaçoso, bem confortável. 
Restaurantes com opções bem variadas e muito saborosas o que me surpreendeu já que se trata de um all inclusive, pena que não deu para conhecer todos.
Vale a pena pagar a tarifa de Royal Service ou family concierge para quem vai com crianças e ter um mimo a mais, inclui consumação de frigobar, serviço de quarto 24h, áreas exclusivas, serviço de mordomo e entre outras comodidades.
O hotel possui uma academia grande, com aparelhos novos e modernos, também tem um SPA e lojas a disposição.
No período que fui a praia na frente do hotel estava um pouco mais batida por conta de um mau tempo que teve, mas é maravilhosa, cor da água incrível e muito tranquilo.
Se voltar a Cancún com toda certeza voltaria a esse hotel.

reviews.author: Jonathan P
reviews.title: Really great trip
reviews.text: I really liked this resort. In 2016, I vacationed at the Paradisus Playa del Carmen location. Both resorts were wonderful. I liked this location a little more since it was closer to the airport and I thought the beach here was better. Aqua World was also right across the street so that was easy for any excursions. The staff at the resort and Aqua World were wonderful and courteous. I was very pleased with how nice everyone was. I've vacationed in Cancun before and would go back here again for sure. The other resorts around were not really great. We did the royal service at this resort which was worth every penny. The resort itself was beautiful. It's an older resort so if you look close, you'll see some wear and tear but that can be expected. It wasn't horrible and didn't effect our trip. You felt like you were in a different world inside the resort, in a good way. The meals were great for an all-inclusive. Some restaurants were better than others but I didn't eat one thing I didn't like. I'm surprised by some of the negative comments on here. I can't say enough good things about this place. I want to try the Punta Cana location next, looking at the summer 2019 but I might just come back here again.

reviews.author: Sandra L
reviews.title: Recomendable
reviews.text: Buena zona de playa con muchas olas y aunque siempre hay muchos huespedes el servicio es muy bueno.al tener muchas opciones de restaurantes siempre se encuentra lugar.la ubicacion es cerca de los lugares de salidas nocturnas

reviews.author: Rosalievb
reviews.title: Amazing Resort!
reviews.text: My girlfriend and I vacationed here for two weeks in May/18 and couldn't have chosen a better resort.  We stayed in the Royal Service area of the resort and we were truly treated like Princesses.  We experienced 1st class service by all of the staff, delicious meals fit for foodies and wonderful amenities like the poolside Bali Beds.  Our room was lovely and spacious as was the large balcony.  The restaurants were all amazing, particularly  "La Palapa" and "Vento".  As part of Royal Service we were given our own personal Butler,  "Galdino".  He was exceptionally attentive and accommodating during our stay.  A special Thank you to Galdino for his kind hospitality.   Also, Thank you to Gabriela, Luis, Salvador and Martin as well as the entire staff for all of your gracious help.   I would definitely return to the Paradisus.

reviews.author: Losfranksnyc
reviews.title: A week in Paradise!
reviews.text:
We just came back from one week in Paradisus Cancún! We brought a group of 65 people to celebrate our wedding in the hotel from all over the world! 

Everything was perfect ! We want to mention couple employees from the hotel that they were top- notch ! 
our wedding planner Marlene and Melina!
Our butler Eduardo in Royal Service ! 
Waitresses: Didier, Miguel, Jorge ! 
Bartenders; Alan and Perla !!!! 
All the staff in the hotel were very cordial ! 

The hotel was perfect ! All the employees are on point and they are very cordial , Congrats to the team of Food and beverage , Mr. Eduardo and Mr. hector! 

My only concern is the thirds party companies that work with the hotel when you do your wedding ! 

Novia mía Photography - bad . Too much money for the bad quality of Picts and videos. but at the end it’s the brand that matter bc the hotel told us to use this vendors! 

Js & audio visual- bad cero communication between the client and the company they want to do whatever they want and they don’t listen to the client! 

Alquimia florist - bad service they don’t know how to sell and they showed us pictures from another hotel since they work with Paradisus and are the prefer vendors from them ! 

Paradisus need to check out your third parties companies that work with the hotel! Because at final your name come first because you chose them to work with futures brides and grooms.

reviews.author: Melissa12340
reviews.title: Awful Service
reviews.text:
I came with 3 friends on a bachelorette stay at Paradisus. We were really excited to begin our adventure but at our check in the person at the front desk said that we needed to have the credit card which we had used (6 months ago) to pay our reservation with. Of course we didnt have this credit card since my friend’s fiance was the one who paid for her trip. 
The hotel said that it was hotel policy to show up with the exact credit card used 6 months ago and wouldnt let us do the check in even though it was paid for and we had other credit cards we could use for backup. 
In the end we had to give another credit card and the hotel charged the whole stay all over again! It is a really expensive hotel and they treat you like garbage; we asked them to show the terms and conditions where it stated that we had to give the exact credit card and they didnt have them. It was all a lie.
If a parent paid for their kids trip or you credit card was cancelled how can the hotel expect you to bring this exact credit card?

reviews.author: Pierre C
reviews.title: Buena ubicacion
reviews.text: Ubicado entre la Laguna y el mar, el hotel tiene vista a ambos lugares, habitaciones confortables, de los restaurantes que tiene excelentes y variados, la atención del personal excelente, el servicio de bar muy bueno, posiblemente el único problemas son pocos elevadores para la cantidad de habitaciones que tiene

reviews.author: sirlove11
reviews.title: What a trip, what I say?
reviews.text: From the moment we arrived the staff made sure our trip was memorable. We arrived super early ( 7:00 in the morning) they offered a room so we could rest until our suite was ready.  Our butler Rode made sure all our needs were met.  The restaurants were fabulous especially Tempo and the grill. Finally our pool concierge Elsander made sure we had a beach Bali beds everyday.  I could not ask for anything more.  I have traveled to some of the most beautiful beach locations in the world ( Turks and Cacios ,South of France, Canary Islands , Phuket Thailand) this trip was one of the best!! I am already set up our trip for next year.

reviews.author: Sara M
reviews.title: Vacaciones en el paraíso
reviews.text:
Nos alojamos una amiga y yo en el royal service, que es la zona mas vip del hotel, y se encuentra en la pirámide 5, importante todas las  torres se unen por la planta 2 o 3 ( en la pirámide 5) , antes casi de entrar al lobby ya sabían de nuestra llegada desde que nos bajamos del taxi, nos sentaron hasta que nos vinieron a buscar para llevarnos al lobby de royal service, en el lobby principal tienes la mayoría de los restaurantes, luego contare un poco de cada uno, y en el lobby de royal service tienes un pequeño buffet lleno de exquisiteces y suculentas tapas para tomar o bebidas donde tomar lo que quieras, nos registramos y el check in fue bastante rápido,Melina es una encanto nos hizo el check in y check out, preguntad por ella! mientras esperábamos a registrarnos nos trajeron dos margaritas deliciosos, y nos presentaron a nuestro mayordomo Alain, que nos guío a la habitación, una estupenda habitación con vistas al mar super amplia, un minibar con todo lo que quieras y nos pregunto por nuestras bebidas favoritas le dijimos que ya que estábamos en mexico pues el tequila es el que probaríamos y apareció con una botella de tequila de lo mejor para nosotras.
Las piscinas son una maravilla tienes muchos ambientes si vas en familia, con amigos o a relajarte. 
La piscina de royal service tienes incluidas las camas balinesas y 2 hamacas al lado para todo el día pero hay mas hamacas por el resto de la piscina. 
Si que estaria bien algún día que no pudimos reservar la cama balines hubiera mas hamacas tanto en la piscina como en la playa aunque nunca tuvimos problemas de encontrar.
En la piscina están pasando continuamente brochetas de frutas o cocteles si quieres probar, no obstante, hay un botón que tienes y vienen enseguida a ofrecerte tanto cosas de comida como de bebida. Hay un ambiente relajado, y hay esta uno de los mejores restaurantes LA PALAPA,  siempre desayunábamos allí y comíamos ya que estaba todo maravilloso, es un restaurante a la carta aunque si quieres algo que no este en la carta te lo traen inmediatamente. Recomiendo probar el arroz con camarones, muy muy rico, la gente que atiende allí una maravilla en los desayunos Julio se acordaba de que nos encantaba tomar el zumo de naranja y nada mas llegar ya lo pedia y casi antes de sentarnos ya lo teníamos en la mesa, siempre nos decía algo para empezar el dia con una sonrisa!! GRANDE JULIO!!! Mi amiga es alérgica al gluten y siempre tiene problemas para comer y deseo destacar a Daniel de la Palapa ya que todos los días estaba pendiente de las necesidades especiales que teníamos con la comida, es algo que en general me sorprendió porque me metí varias veces a buscar información sobre esto y no lo encontré por eso quiero destacar en TODOS los restaurantes que este tema les pongo un 10, era lo primero que preguntaban y estaban muy pendientes hasta en la creperia por la noche iban a comprar harina especial para ella.Moises un hombre alegre donde los haya en las comidas de la palapa muchas gracias por tu hospitalidad.
Para cenar hay restaurantes diferentes a la carta 
Blue agave no necesitas reserva : es un restaurante genial que tienes todo tipo de tacos y quesadillas para tomar si quieres algo mas informal, hubiéramos cenado allí todas las noches pero había que probar todo.
Mole: restaurante mexicano clásico, a parte de nachos, tacos y quesadillas demuestran que pueden hacer un cabrito delicioso, o otro plato fuera de lo que todo el mundo conoce de Mexico, nos encanto.
Vento: un restaurante de tapas maravilloso , tienes un sin fin de tapas para probar y degustar no podéis dejar de ir.
Fuego: Una mezcla de peruano o chileno , probamos el foia y muy rico también 
Bana: restaurante de sushi , tengo que indicar que no me gusta el sushi pero el de este restaurante el que es especialidades mexicanas me encanto, así que si yo alucine a la gente que le guste también.
Enso: no pudimos probarle ya que ese día hicimos excursión y llegamos bastante tarde.
Tengo que añadir que el día que hicimos la excursión nos levantamos muy pronto y pedimos desayuno a la habitación y fue una pasada todo lo que nos trajeron aunque fueran las 5 de la mñn y la puntualidad de ello, si os pasa como a nosotros recomiendo llamar la noche antes para tenerlo preparado a esa hora.
En la playa dispones de servicio que te atienden a nosotros todos los días nos atendía Victor nada mas sentarte te traen un cubo lleno de hielos y botellas de agua y luego nos traía todos los cocteles que pedíamos incluso cuando veía que se nos acababa ya nos traía otro, la playa maravillosa , divertida con olas pero un agua azul turquesa que las fotos no lo hacen justicia. Indicar que hay cremas y protectores solares que te regalan para que te protejas del sol.
En el bar de la piscina siempre hay el mejor ambiente para tomar unos shots , y no tardan nada en atender , no como en otros resorts que se lo toman con mucha calma, por supuesto no os podéis ir de este hotel sin hablar con Carlos el camarero de la piscina que hace los mejores margaritas de todo el hotel, os lo aseguro, de echo un dia estaba trabajando en el lobby del royal service y nos dio una clase de las proporciones para prepararlas, siempre todos los días íbamos a verles, no se que vamos a hacer sin Carlos hasta la próxima vez que vayamos!!! 
Como sugerencia seria que los espectáculos nocturnos empezaran mas tarde son a las 8:30 y si estas cenando nunca los puedes ver. También hay una mini discoteca que es muy divertida y siempre hacen fiestas especiales, temáticas ...
Añadir que las fotos del hotel no le hacen justicia! 
Como consejo os indico que os bajéis la app de melia y desde ahí podréis solicitar todo lo que necesites y os lo llevaran a la habitación. 
Recomiendo el hotel al 100% no solo por sus instalaciones que creo que son las mejores de Cancun si no por el servicio, la gente con la que tuvimos el gusto de tratar fue genial, volveremos mas de una vez así que espero volver a encontrarlos a todos para poder recordar unas vacaciones maravillosas!!!

reviews.author: Carol-Ann K
reviews.title: Butler Luis
reviews.text: We loved this place! It’s beautiful! Our butler Luis was amazing. I wish it was a longer stay, but the days we were there, he made every moment count! We went for our friends birthday. He planned a surprise for her with balloons, rose petals, champagne and cake! He exceeded all expectations! He’s professional, informative, friendly and a great personality over all. When going to this resort and getting a room with butler service, be sure to request Luis. You’ll be very pleased you did!

reviews.author: Claudia Z
reviews.title: Vacaciones soñadas
reviews.text: Me quede por 5 noches, la atención de primera categoría. Hotel familiar con comida excelente recomiendo comer en todos los restaurantes a la carta, son una exquisitez. Las habitaciones haces que recuperes todas tus energías y te llevan los tragos hasta la Playa. 100% recomendado.

reviews.author: HALLIEG3
reviews.title: Great Resort, Great Service Thanks to Asuncion
reviews.text:
My friends and I visited the Paradisus Cancun for 3 days/4 nights. We weren’t really sure what to expect, having never been to an all-inclusive, but by the end of the trip we had all agreed to come back. The view from our room was beautiful and the grounds were very well maintained. Blue Agave was our favorite lunch spot, and Naos and Mole were are favorite restaurants for dinner. The resort staff was friendly and always made sure we had what we needed. 

We spent most of our time enjoying the ocean from the palapas near Cocoas Bar (just be sure to get there early to be able to soak up some shade). While the view itself was great, the best part of camping out at this location was the outstanding service from Asuncion. She always made sure we had cold beer and water and made fantastic drink recommendations, encouraging us to venture out. Aside from going above and beyond with her service, we loved her outgoing, kind and funny personality. She made the whole resort experience even better, by making it feel more personalized. Paradisus is lucky to have her – one of the biggest reasons we would decide to go back to this resort is because of Asuncion.

reviews.author: Kristin P
reviews.title: Royal Service is definitely worth it
reviews.text: Great experience. All of the staff is very friendly and attentive. Our Royal Service butler, Louis, was super nice and took excellent care of us, especially with all of our restaurant reservations and getting us a bali bed next to the pool. Louis even got us a bottle of rum, a bottle of tequila, and a bottle of champagne for our room. He was excellent about providing reminders for us on reservations and our departure arrangements, which was a huge help. The gentleman who brought us drinks on the beach in the Royal Service section on Sunday, May 6th, was one of the hardest working men I've seen. He was the ONLY one servicing everyone in the Royal Service section on the beach and he had to go up and down stairs to get drinks/food/etc every single time. Probably has calves of iron. He was ALWAYS super cool to us, had a great personality, and he brought us more Miami Vices than we could count. The tables and chairs on the beach filled up FAST every day. Couldn't manage to get a spot on the front row even when we got up early one day for that purpose. The pool was immaculate and large enough to feel like you had your own space with other guests around. The beach was perfection. The water was perfect shades of turquoise and very clear. The sand was very soft with almost a playdough texture when damp. The beach was clean and quiet in the Royal Service area. All of the food we had was great, especially at Mole and La Palapa. The only negative moment was when a roach got into our room during the night one night. Seemed like a one-off type of issue, though. Our room was on the ground floor, so that probably had something to do with it. Everything was very clean, so I don't think it was an issue with the hotel. I would definitely stay here again. Did NOT want to come home.

reviews.author: kaleesmith86
reviews.title: THE BEST SERVICE EVER
reviews.text: 3 words.....Jesiel is AMAZING. first my best friend and i booked royal service for our 6 day get away. From the moment we were introduced to Jesiel, he tended to all of our needs,  exceeded our expectations and was always available to us, even on his off days.  He was polite, professional, punctual, attentive, comedic and also very personable and friendly.  I believe we enjoyed our time even more because we had the ability to be worry free. Jesiel booked our dinner reservations, cabanas, as well as went out of his way to bring us the menu from the restaurants because my friend only eats particular foods.  He was always happy to help.  He went above and beyond to make sure my travel arrangements back to the airport were also taken care of,  so there was no need for me to worry. He was exceptional and if and when I do decide to go back to cancun, I will make sure to request Jesiel and I know my trip will be smooth and worry free. Thank you Jesiel.

reviews.author: julie233512
reviews.title: Great resort, but most of our group got sick from one of the restaurants
reviews.text:
The resort was great and the beach was beautiful. The service was also great and everyone was friendly and helpful. 

However, 5 members of our group got sick after eating at one of the restaurants (Vento).

reviews.author: Fernanda893
reviews.title: Excelente atención !
reviews.text:
Hemos visitado el hotel la primer semana de Mayo y la experiencia ha sido muy buena . 
Queremos destacar la atención del personal en general y sobre todo de Luis , el encargado del espacio de café Nespreso que todas las tardes fue muy cordial , atento y de excelente trato . 
También fue un placer la atención del camarero Christian , del desayuno en el restaurante Vento, siempre muy amable y servicial .
El hotel en general esta en muy buen estado , la vegetación interna es maravillosa y el edificio se mantiene limpio.

El area de pileta espaciosa y con espacios mas ruidosos y otros mas tranquilos y el área de playa un lujo y con excelente atención del Sr Sofonia .

reviews.author: marianqdea
reviews.title: Me robaron plata de la caja fuerte
reviews.text:
Estoy en el hotel y el dia qhe llegue luego de instalarme y acomodar mis cosas me desapareció plata de la caja fuerte
Hice la denuncia correspondiente pero aun no me dieron ninguna solución, es para tener en cuenta y tomar cuidado con eso, me parece algo importante que el hotel resuelva!!!! Y que me devuelvan el dinero

reviews.author: jonathanfranca
reviews.title: Muito bom

reviews.author: Carlos S
reviews.title: El mejor hotel en el que he estado.
reviews.text:
Este hotel es fabuloso, primero la forma en la que te reciben, la atención en recepción es excelente, te dan una breve explicación del hotel y te dicen todo lo que puedes hacer dentro del mismo incluyendo el horario de los restaurantes, por que es todo incluido de verdad TODO incluido, desde lo que hay en el minibar de la habitación que te surten diario, también el servicio a la habitación no importa que sean las 4 de la mañana si pides algo del meno te lo llevan.
Las habitaciones son muy amplias, limpias y con una decoración agradable, ademas de un balcón increíble y la mejor vista al mar caribe.
Los alimentos están deliciosos y la variedad de opciones de comidas es muy muy amplia.

Las palabras no puede expresar lo grandiosa que fue mi experiencia en este lugar donde se encargaron que mi estancia fuera única e inolvidable.

reviews.author: Aneeta
reviews.title: Omar the Entertainment Lead
reviews.text: So the Paridisus has lots of activities throughout the day. Our first day there we ran into Omar who told us about a party that evening and welcomed us warmly when we attended. We asked him about other activities offered that weekend and he quickly became our go to person for all questions Cancun! He was so helpful, friendly and entertaining that every activity we partook in added to the fun and richness of our experience! He became the familiar face we associated with our stay at the Paridisus and while the property is nice and has lots to offer, the experience wouldn't have been what it was without Omar.

reviews.author: Pegah N
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun had an impressive service
reviews.text:
We were incredibly impressed with our stay at Paradisus Cancun this April. I am unaware of how good the normal service is for the all-inclusive, but we upgraded to the royal service for an extra charge which I highly recommend. 
If you are a couple/ family looking to relax at a classy and peaceful resort, Paradisus is the best option for you. However, if you are single and young, and looking to have fun and party, this resort may be a little boring because there barely was any party. 

Getting the royal service (after bargaining about the price) was worth it because we got our own butler who made reservations on behalf of us and took care of our needs, we got access to the adults pool and royal side of the beach, we got 4 free bottles of liquor, a beautiful lounge room with snacks, a renovated room, and some other great options.

Some things that I would want Paradisus to improve is the entertainment team and the night-life. There were some awesome performances such as the guy with the flying board in the pool, the dancers, or the Mexican party. However, some days there were no activities by the pool, and the nightly entertainments were not that good. I was expecting to have at least one foam party in the pool, or any sort of party in the resort. However, our only night-time party was at the red lounge which was only busy and fun for one night of our stay. Other than that, the resort became somewhat boring. Our butler was somewhat helpful, but we were expecting to get more help for reserving cabanas and becoming aware of what the nightly entertainments were. 

We were incredibly impressed with all the staff working at Paradisus. They were all kind and helpful and I will actually miss some of them a lot. They all worked so hard to provide a good time for the guests. 
Francesco working at the Red Lounge was one of the most amazing guys I have ever met. He was professional, sweet, and caring. We only went to the red lounge because of him because he provided an awesome service. Aaron at the Fuego restaurant was a professional server. He was very kind and made our trip even better with his warm conversations. He even taught us some Spanish. Elisandro who worked at the Royal pool towel service was also an amazing person. He was very helpful for providing us with chairs and Cabana reservations. We had an amazing time talking with him because he truly cared about the guests.

reviews.author: Wanderlust_Twin
reviews.title: Great hotel and amenities, wonderful service, good food, old property
reviews.text: Went to Cancun for a girls' trip and had a great time at Paradisus. Lots to do at resort: sushi and ceviche and mixology classes, salsa at the pool, lounge and club on property. Amazing gelato and Nespresso bars. Buffet had decent food and restaurants were good, best one was Fuego. Rooms are old and resort is showing signs of aging (cracks in floors, in bathtub, sinks drain slowly, etc). but staff was quick to address the issues and moved us to another tower. The staff was amazing! Especially Omar on the entertainment team. He made our stay memorable! You can tell he loves what he does and was funny and so so helpful. By the end of our stay, he had become our "go to person" even if it wasn't related to entertainment.  The nightly shows were entertaining and there was tons to do at the property. View to the beach from the property was breathtaking and there were plenty of beach chairs/umbrellas. Luis at the Nespresso bar and Eddie at the Market Grill were so so nice. Another shoutout to Omar, thanks so much for everything, Paradisus is lucky to have you!

reviews.author: Lcisco1
reviews.title: Girl birthday trip
reviews.text: We traveled to the Paradisus Cancun April 12th thru the 16. The hotel was was amazing, it is one of the older hotels but still very nice. When we arrived , we were taken to a private lounge where we waited for a few minutes until a nice young man came to take us to the royal concierge check in. The check in was private and really fast. We then met our butler Jesiel Bravo who took us to our room. When we went into our room it was very nice and clean. Jesiel explained everything to us regarding the royal service. We had a well stocked fridge with beer and assorted beverages. There were also snacks. We booked a lagoon side room, but when we went out on the balcony we had a beautiful view of both the ocean and lagoon side! We were very pleased! Every one at the hotel gave excellent service! Shout out to Asunción, wonderful waitress at the pool. Captain Guillermo, Chef Eleazar, Meseros Efrain, Cochinlta Pulbil all from the Mole restaurant who made us a wonderful surprise meal for our birthdays! They were great! Also Guillermo Fuego who also worked the pool. Can’t say enough about the staff in this Hotel! Food was great and our stay was relaxing. My best friend Rose and I will come back for another’s girls trip. My husband and I are thinking of coming back for Thanksgiving. Loved it!

reviews.author: Jillian T
reviews.title: 40th Bday Girls Trip
reviews.text: I cannot say enough how wonderful this hotel is!  We upgraded to the Royal Service and it was the best decision! We not only had a butler named Luis who was so sincere, sweet and incredible with detail!  He booked all of dinner reservations, helped when we couldn't find our sunglasses and picked out awesome ones for us, helped us plan our excursions, and made fantastic recommendations throughout the week!  At the pool, our waiter Orlando was also incredible!  He truly went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed and make it fun!  Our last nights dinner, our waiters brought us an extra special dessert since they knew it was our last night.  We also went to the nightclub where they had a silent dance party with headphones and two dj's battling. If they offer it, make sure to go!  The spa was incredible and visited several times to relax.  Overall, they truly made our 40th bday the most special and one we will never forget!

reviews.author: nicolifa
reviews.title: Definitely a top destination for a wedding with friends
reviews.text: You must dine at the Tempo restaurant, as one of the best dining experiences in the world.  The adults only side was fantastic lounging on the Bali beds next to the pool or by the palapas on the beach.  Great poolside and beachside service with drinks and food all day long.  We left with wonderful memories we won't forget.

reviews.author: Kristi R
reviews.title: Best Wedding Ever
reviews.text: I attended my friend's wedding at the Melia property in Cancun (along with 86 other guests!), and the service, location, treatment... all were exceptional. The bride and groom were especially cared for, and our trip was amazing!

reviews.author: Maysworld
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
My friends and I came to Cancum to celebrate my 40th. Please do not try to plan anything in advance because they do not respond to your emails in a timely matter and no one really comprehends the Englosh language to properly assist you. It was 15 of us who came to celebrate my 40th birthday. My assistant and I tried several times to contact them to set up a welcome dinner, breakfast brunch, cabanas, photographer and etc. Nonetheless, they kept giving us an email that did not work. I had to go on social media and ask for someone to respond to me and when they did nothing was ever confirmed or followed up on. The hotel is well kept and beautiful. The staff are very nice and pleasant. However, from the 15 of us 8 of us go sick and experience diarrhea after eating at the Sushi restaurant. Yeah we shouldve known better. At first we didnt figure anything of it until 2 of my friends flew back the next day and went to the Urgent care and was told they had a bacteria infection. They shared with the doctor that a few were still in Cancun and was experiencing the same symptoms. Doctor told us to only eat bread, banana and drink water.  We booked a tour to go to the ruins. 1 of my friends could not attend because she had diarrhea the entire time. I was experiencing discomfort in my stomach but still attended the ruins. We tried to explain to the gentlemen that she couldnt attend due to illmess. He going to tell us that we need a doctor note to get our money back... Expected us to pay $135 to see a doctor in their hotel to state she was sick for a refund. Wow! Once we figure something wasnt right because too many of us were sick. I spoke to someone at front desk and explained to them the situation. She stated that she will tell the general Manager Andrew and he will call me at 7am in the morning. She also kept saying they didnt have no other complaints and that they needed more complaints. I was like ma am it is 15 of us right here in the lobby sick as hell and your asking for what again? We are all present to file the complaint. That night of my bday we went to a resturant outside the hotel. We got to the resturant which was beautiful. We order drinks, appetizers and placed our entree. Guess what mone of us could eat. We spent over $760 and barely ate. Who didnt feel like they had to throw up, the others had to go to the bathroom. The waiter asked us why wasnt we eating and we explained the situation. He felt bad that we werent eating and left all the food behind. We explained it wasnt the service but we couldnt eat or take the food back with is because there were no microwaves in the rooms. The next morning no call from the general manager. I go back downstairs to ask for the general manager and they say he wont be in till 2pm. Im like excuse me I leave ay 1pm and you guys are not going to rreat this matter lightly. They kept giving me the run around until they got a lady who is a manager for the family center... eitherway she got me to go with her into another area so I can explain what occured. Then I had to write what happen, list the resturant and etc. She tried to say we went to the restaurant so we got sick from there. I said no we were sick from before and I filed the complaint before going to the restuarant. She said the general.manager Andrew or Andreas whatever his name would contact me. Yeah its been a week later and no contact or follow up. I came back home and went to urgent care and was also diagnosed with a bacterial infection. Dr stated that whatever we ate was contaminated by someone who prepared the food and because we ate sushi there was no serious cooking needed to kill off the germ or bacteria. Simple as someone using the bathroom and not washing their hands and prepared the food. We ate it and got sick and some experience diarrhea. I lost 4pds bc I wasnt able to ate and had diarrhea for 4 days straight. We also had issues with their transportation. We paid in full for round trip and their transportation agent told us we had to pay again. We kept going back and forth for an hr till they said it was corrected. We showed them the emails and they sent us confirmation. We go upstairs for them to call us and tell us that we will jave to pay 35 again for transportation. How? We again had to dispute this till they finally got it right. The photographer at the hotel is good. Tool great pics. I Selected my pics and paid for them. I spent over 375 for pics. For them to then tell me they will send them to me in an email. Hello! Come again. Why wasnt this told to me up front. The girl told me that they will print them out and to pick them up at 9am the next day. Guess what happen at 9am they werent printed. And the guys is going to apologize to me
 No sir it doesnt work like that I was told one thing and you guys are doing whatever. So I figure they are quick to get your money and whatever you get you get. The only place we didnt experince any issues were at the 2 cabans that I rented. I gave the girl the decorations and they were not put up in a timely matter. Although at 8am I went to her and she said no problem it will all be done. It sure was done after 11a... the final straw was this... my friends ordered room service for breakfast. 1 is allergic to shell fish. Why after eating her food she experience an allergic reaction. In which I called and ask for the female Manager and they transfer me to her and she came upstair and saw her face. She had a shock look and asked them what they order. All of this and NO ONE FROM PARADISUS BY MELIA jas contacted me. I left my number and email address... we gave them our business for 15 ppl and their was no follow up. You shouldnt waste your time or your money at this resort. These are serious matters that can lead up to legal actions...

reviews.author: sunnytan1215
reviews.title: Good resort, could use some improvements
reviews.text: Overall this is a very nice hotel, very clean and beautiful floral arrangements throughout.  Our room was in pyramid 1 which was a far walk each day to pyramid 3 where all the restaurants were located.  Check in was pretty quick, but our room wasn't going to be ready till 3pm.  We were given our bracelets( much nicer than the plastic ones at other all inclusives) and we headed to the beach.  Very nice beach except for the mounds of seaweed.  I'm not sure why it wasn't cleaned up daily.  It wasn't very nice to walk through it to get to the ocean.  Beach service was excellent.  At 3 pm we headed to the lobby to receive our room key, and there were very long lines.  There should be a designated area where guests who are already checked in could pick up theirs key.  Room was clean and the bed was very comfortable.  We had a studio room with a small refrigerator, cooktop, microwave, coffee maker and sink.  There was a hot tub on the balcony that we tried to use, but took forever to fill.  We gave up after 10 minutes.  The bathroom is very small, definitely needs some improvements.  The shower/tub is awkward to get in and out of.  The main pyramid is very dark at night, be careful walking through Bana.  The resort has the feeling of being in a shopping mall, definitely not the open air beach feel. It also has incense burning everywhere, if you are sensitive to strong  smells this is not the place for you.  If you are not at the beach or pool, you feel trapped inside, there is no air movement at all.  The breakfast buffet was excellent!  Egg station, smoothie station, make your own Bloody Mary or Momosa.  Lunch and dinner buffet were good also.  The specialty restaurants were a big let down.  Market Grill looked so promising, but a lot of the meats were flavor less. Bana as well was disappointing.  We tried Blue Agave and Vento too.  The drinks were very weak even after asking for a stronger pour.  Gelato was very good, and the snack bar by the pool was good too.  The Michael Jackson show was excellent! The performers did such a great job.  Every employee was so friendly and helpful, really great service! I would recommend this resort to families, but for me I would choose to stay at an adults only resort.  There were just too many crying babies everywhere.

reviews.author: Cupcakes75
reviews.title: Good Resort
reviews.text:
We were at this hotel for a friend's 40th birthday weekend.
Check in was okay, the staff at the front desk were friendly and helpful, we got a room on the 1st floor which we didnt like and it was changed to a room on the 6th floor which was okay but we only got a view of across the road.
The room it self was clean but the bathroom can do with some updating.
The food was average, a lot of options for breakfast  though. the staff i must say where very friendly and helpful, although we had an experience with 2 very rude staff at the Market Grill. 
It was an all inclusive package with included all drinks but i must say the alcoholic drinks where a bit watered down, you will have to ask for more alcohol in your cocktails.
The Japanese/Chinese restaurant was the least favorite and took the longest to get your meals and the meals where not that great either, and probably that was why it was also available when you want to book, unlike the others which were always fully booked, so booking the restaurants at least  48hours before is best. The icecream and coffee spots are really great and taste almost heavenly a great place to visit.
If you need to buy anything in the hotel shop, remember to change your money to Pesos as that is all they accept in the hotel shops.
Overall, its a good hotel but a bit expensive for what you get.

reviews.author: Trvlr4life25
reviews.title: Wonderful time.
reviews.text:
We went for a girls getaway.  ( keep in mind.. we did not upgrade to the royal) 
Upon arrival we were taken care of .  They took our luggage to hold until we were able to check in( we arrived early am). 
This resort absolutely gorgeous!  Extremely clean. 
Check in was smooth ( especially since there were 4 rooms in the reservations) 
I read several reviews where guests were constantly harassed by staff to upgrade or buy their club membership ...not only was I not harassed at all but I didn’t hear anyone bring harassed either.  There are tables where they promote their club but we just said no thank you and they were fine.  They were very respectful.  

The pools are beautiful.. clean.. pool bar — Awesome!  The bar tenders were so friendly and despite a few patrons who weren’t so nice— the bartenders kept a smile.  
Food at the pool was very good.. they have brick oven pizza, chicken sandwiches, wraps, nachos fries, 
We did go down to save lounge chairs.  In the am but that was more bc we had a bigger group.  
Beach is beautiful.. clean.  The lounge chairs we had no problem getting them.   There are beach venders but they were very nice.. they ask if you are interested if you say no thank you, they move on. 
Waves.. please be smart.  The lifeguards on the beach are very nice and will explain everything but short version.. if there are red flags.. follow their rules.  The waves/ riptides can change very quickly. I am a swimmer and they knocked me around. 
Gelato: A MUST!!!! Absolutely delicious!
Espresso:  same as Gelato. 
Staff:  absolutely wonderful.  They were all very willing to help you.  The waiter waitresses were also wonderful. 
Thank you Paradisus Cancún for making our getaway so wonderful.

reviews.author: Jennifer
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: We just returned from Paradisus and it was an amazing experience. We received royal service! The all inclusive option is the best choice. We had great food and drinks the entire time we were there. The people were friendly and the facilities were immaculate

reviews.author: Martin L
reviews.title: Vraiment 5 étoiles!!
reviews.text: Présentement sur place du 6 au 13 avril 2018, tout est parfait!! Le service est excellent!! Le chef Eduardo répond à tous nos besoins!! Souper hier au resto Fuego, reçu par Paola avec beaucoup de classe!! C’est décidément un site 5 étoiles!! Magnifique!!

reviews.author: celticech0
reviews.title: best vacation ever
reviews.text: fantastic all way round selection of restaurants, great service. Pool service was fantastic special thanks to Manuel! We were treated like queens. Enzo's was our favorite restaurant. Special thanks to Sonia who helped me when I fell and to Our breakfast crew Aleuandro, Andrew, Arturo & Armando, not forgetting Marta our concierge who helped repair my walker

reviews.author: Jessica H
reviews.title: Highly recommend Paradisus, great experience
reviews.text: My friends and family were so pleased with this exceptional resort! The activity directors-Marco, Daniel, Hector, and Omar were absolutely amazing! They were amazing dancers and always so positive and kind to anyone that did their activities. The Zumba,volleyball, and gym exercises were so much fun and always kept me busy. My family and I were also very happy with the food, it was always so fresh and available all day! They changed up many selections of food each day so it never got boring and even had themed food nights daily. One of the waiters that we made sure to have almost everyday was Martin Naos, he had such good customer service and made us enjoy every meal at the buffet! The shows were also amazing, and the red lounge for ages 18+ was always so much fun with great music every night! This resort is clean, has amazing food, great customer service everywhere you are, very safe(I ran outside everyday and felt comfortable), and well worth your money! If you are looking to stay anywhere in Cancún stay at Paradisus!

reviews.author: ADF-1988
reviews.title: An EXCELLENT All-inclusive choice!
reviews.text:
I have nothing but good things to say about Paradisus Cancún. My friends and I traveled there last week for a vacation to celebrate turning 30 this year, and we thought it sounded absolutely perfect, and from the photos, it was exactly what we wanted. 

It was absolutely the correct choice. The property is beautiful, perfectly perched on a choice stretch of pristine beach. The staff is among the most attentive of any resort I have ever stayed at, and the service and amenities were flawless. Blue Agave and Mole, in particular, were highlights of our culinary experience. The number of choices for dining make this a no-brainer for groups with diverse cuisine tastes. 

Our rooms were flawlessly clean, beds were comfortable, and the vista from our ocean-view room was breathtaking, as you can see below. 

Of all the superlative aspects I can come up with, though, the absolute highlight was our beach attendant, Asunción. I have never in my life been treated with such care, warmth, genuine positivity, and all-around hospitality than Asunción showed my friends and I. Not only was she attentive, but also incredibly caring and literally one of the sweetest, most genuine people I have ever met in my life. 

We became fast friends with Asunción, and I was very sad when our time together came to an end. I could go on and on and on about her incredible warmth and positive energy, but suffice it to say, we made a real friend in Asunción and she made our time at Paradisus Cancún not only perfect, but memorable, with her wit, charm, and the real pride she takes in making her guests comfortable. 

Asunción, you are Paradisus Cancún’s biggest asset and we thank you for a weekend we will never forget. 

If you’re thinking about an all-inclusive in Cancún, stop looking and just book Paradisus. Doesn’t get any better.

reviews.author: Anne S
reviews.title: Loved the resort and Asunción!
reviews.text:
I visited Paradisus Cancun with friends for 3 days/4 nights and had an absolutely wonderful time.  Our group was impressed with how smoothly run the resort was and the variety of restaurants, bars, and services available.  I appreciated the 24-hour gym access and took advantage of a great hydro-therapy/massage package at the spa (additional cost but great value – thanks Cynthia!). Other favorite spots included Market Grill and Mole for dinner, Naos and Blue Agave for lunch, and espressos from Nespresso bar.  We were impressed with the grand interior of the lobbies, the design of the rooms, and the beautiful beachfront and sprawling pools.  This was my first all-inclusive experience and I have never had such a relaxing vacation before.  I had high expectations for the trip and they were exceeded.

While the resort itself was remarkable, our experience was made most memorable by meeting Asunción.  Asunción works as a server for guests using the beach palapas near Coco’s Bar.   Asunción was extremely attentive to our needs.  Our ice bucket was always filled with beers and water.  Asunción was notable for her speedy service and fantastic drink recommendations (mango colado, banana monkey, mudslide, among others), but we quickly came to appreciate her playful, friendly personality.  Her English skills are excellent and she is very funny.  We looked forward to talking to her throughout the day and even took a picture with her before we left.  Of course we have fond memories of Cancun in general and our time at Paradisus specifically, but Asunción was the person who most directly contributed to our positive experience.  I can’t overstate her value to the resort or compliment her highly enough. 

Additionally, I highly recommend USA Transfers as a shuttle service to/from the airport.

reviews.author: Pat K
reviews.title: Just what the Doctor ordered!
reviews.text: Room was perfect and had all we needed for a great nights rest.All of the staff was nicer than the next. Restaurants were superb. Beach was great.Plenty of staff and towels for chairs and beach.Food and drinks near the pool also.

reviews.author: Jasmine S
reviews.title: Lovely hotel
reviews.text: Loved my stay here, stayed in royal service was great. The spa was amazing but make sure you book with Manuel, he can give you 20% for the spa which the butlers / spa reception can’t! You’ll be able to find him walking round the pool or beach. Great stay.

reviews.author: Gabriella (Gabb... Z
reviews.title: BEST TIME
reviews.text: Seriously Jesus, Didier, and Jaime made our whole trip! Rent a cabana and they will give you the best experience ever!! I will recommend this resort to anyone for the sole experience these guys give! Will come back for them. The hotel is awesome and everything service wise is A+ all around. From the outside bar bar to the inside bars everyone is so awesome. Front desk was amazing as well. Can’t say enough about the service.

reviews.author: lulabobula
reviews.title: Truly Paradise
reviews.text: I had an incredible stay at the Paradisus Cancun last week. I found myself constantly amazed with the level of entertainment, ambiance, and service. If you are staying here I highly recommend doing the activities. Omar is amazing and went above and beyond to show me a good time.

reviews.author: dethredge
reviews.title: Best Vacation Ever - Good Spring Break Destination on the Chiller Side
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun is the best Resort for the reasonable price. Everything was completely clean and any question or problems were handled immediately. As a college student on spring break this resort was nicer than other resorts in the area and had plenty of younger people although it was not as much of a party scene although red lounge is bumpin. The staff was the best, shutout to Francisco and Rigoberto.

reviews.author: animatga0
reviews.title: Excelente lugar, comida super regular
reviews.text:
Fui el fin de semana a pasar el día en el club de Playa coco's, la música super bien las cabanas en general esta muy a gusto, el inconveniente es la comida, esta horrible, super decepcionante, por que barato no es y tienen el nivel de comida a la par de lo que yo podría cocinar y puedo apostar que algunas cosas me quedarían mejor.

Por fa póngale atención por que si me gustaría regresar.

Destacado el servicio de Jaime el mesero que nos estuvo atendiendo, super simpático y amable.

reviews.author: barbarasprague
reviews.title: Great Trip
reviews.text: Great hotel and experience.  The place is made all  the better by friendly, accommodating and outgoing team  Everything was done with a smile.   Alejandro, Andres and Pascal had us looking forward to breakfast and lunch everyday!   The rooms and property are very good.

reviews.author: Bridget D
reviews.title: Did not meet our expectations
reviews.text:
The first thing you notice when you walk in is the overwhelming scent of incense being burnt. If you are sensitive to scent or migraines are triggered my scent do not stay here. In parts of the building (older buildings) you can actually smell the mold and mildew they are trying to cover up. 

Were were initially put in the wrong room but had to walk about 15 minutes to the furthest building and up 5 flights of stairs before we figured it out. The room was DISGUSTING. I feel like everyone rejects that room or they put the drunk 18/19 y/o college kids in it. The couch was stained and so worn out, the air was filled with bleach and the balcony was over the parking lot which had construction and we couldn’t hear a thing. The mirror also had a red burn stain all over it so you couldn’t even see in it. They had 1 tiny elevator for this building and it wasn’t working, so we hiked it up 5 flights of stairs before realizing they put us in the wrong type of room. 

We were relocated to building #3, night and day!! The room looked like the pictures online, it was clean, didn’t smell, balcony was larger, and the bathroom mirror was clear. The staff did not heckel us for this so I give them credit for that, BUT I give them 1 Star for putting me in a room like the first one to begin with after spending $360/night. 

Our shower was never cleaned during the 2 night/ 3 day stay. I set up the shower head, etc., to test it and it was never touched. Pretty gross. Waters in fridge were never refilled and safe only worked on room key. The room also didn’t have an extra latch lock, this made my friend and I a little uneasy. 

FOOD: we did room service, pool side service, buffet and the taco restaurant. I would give it all 2 stars, not good at all. But they are feeding the masses. 

POOL/BEACH: The pools are huge and they have a lot of cabanas to rent. The lounge chairs are first come first serve. I watched the pool servers give away people’s chairs (mine included) when they stepped away for less then 10 minutes and left personal belongings on them. So unless you’ve parked your behind on the chair, it’s not safe. Beach views and beach front is a major plus for this hotel. If you’re a beach goer, this is a prime spot. 

SPA- ALERT!! We had a spa employee offer a private 20 minute massage out of the spa and asked us to keep it a secret. He was so creepy and made my friend and I so uncomfortable we immediately ended the conversation and did not schedule any spa services. He begged us many times not to tell anyone at the hotel, which we didn’t but we are writing it on here. 

Paradisus is a very large resort but it’s old and not well maintained all around. If you are paying for Royal or family concierge they may focus on you otherwise I would spend the extra $$$ and stay at the Marriott next time.

reviews.author: girlfromSC
reviews.title: Absolute Heaven
reviews.text:
Stayed here as part of a girls’ 30-something spring break in Royal Service suites and it’s been the most amazing experience. 
The hotel is flawless from the moment of arrival. We were whisked away by a butler to our special checkin area where we were met by Melina. We were given an overview of the Royal Service and since we were early and our rooms weren’t ready, asked if we’d like to go to a restaurant or the pool. Our butler, Hector, arrived and we got introduced. We exchanged numbers so we could contact him via WhatsApp if we couldn’t find him. 
We decided to go to the pool, which Hector showed us to and introduced us to Jose, our pool concierge. Day after day Jose ensured we had sun beds we liked and setup our towels for us. We were then greeted by Valeria, our Royal Service pool waitress for the day. She made sure we didn’t go hungry or thirsty. 
While we lounged by the gorgeous pool, Hector made sure our rooms were prepared. Our rooms were immaculate and mine was decorated in honour of my birthday with balloons and streamers, with cake and champagne waiting. It really makes you feel special. 
Overall the rooms are spacious, cool and comfortable. The bathrooms are perfect with high quality toiletries (including conditioner!). 
The Royal Service pool is fantastic and try to reserve your Bali beds early. The service at the pool is incomparable. Valeria, Moises, and Octavio all took the greatest care of us. Also, wander over to the semi-secret pool near the wedding gazebo with sun loungers in the shallow water. If you have an inflatable, take it to the main pool to be blown up. 
We enjoyed the pool area so much we didn’t make it to all the restaurants. We had breakfast and lunch at La Palapa each day. I will always remember the great service we received from Joel de Jesus at La Palapa; he made each meal memorable. Tip: if you ask nicely, your pool waiter might bring you something from the main menu to your sun lounger. 
Of the other restaurants, Blue Agave was memorable for its laid back atmosphere and delicious tacos. Market Grill was a great Rodizio experience. Bana had inventive and delicious sushi. Mole was the only letdown as it was too dark and the menu seemed limited. 
Room service is included and they’ll also oblige to some off-menu requests. The Royal Service lounge is also very well equipped with soft drinks, premium spirits, wine, beer, teas, coffees, and canapés bordering on mini-meals. 
The overall Royal Service experience is second to none. You’re constantly made to feel special and cared for as a guest. Saying goodbye to Hector was a moment and I had to give him a big hug.

reviews.author: Conny2785
reviews.title: Fantastic holidays
reviews.text:
We spent 9 days at Paradisus Cancun in March 2018 and had a really great stay. We booked Royal Service and a Junior Suite with ocean view and it was definitely worth it. The view and the spacious room were amazing - the bathroom had a large rain shower and a bathtub. Our Butler Daniel was very attentive and took good care of all the restaurant bookings etc., thanks a lot to him. 
The hotel is very clean and in a good condition with many nice looking details, even though it is a bit old. The beach area and pools were great. 
Paradisus Cancun offers a lot of entertainment - sports, dancing, sushi workshop, shows (I recommend the artistic show - amazing) etc. Every evening a different person/group were singing at the Royal Service Lounge. 
The food was delicious, especially the grilled shrimps at La Palapa :-) We liked the a-la carte restaurants Bana and Fuego very much, only the ladies at the entrance of the restaurants could be a bit more friendly. We asked for a table without a prior reservation, while the entrance lady referred us to the telephone right beside her with the statement that reservations for the next day are only to be made by phone - which we perceived as bit insolent. All in all the staff, above all the La Palapa staff, was remarkably friendly and helpful - being always aware of personal needs, even if you jammed your finger a waiter brought you some ice right away (thanks a lot for that) or if you asked for churros in the afternoon although they serve it only in the morning - the staff made it all possible. Special thanks to Abraham Franco, as management team, for making our holiday that great :-). We will definitely come back.

reviews.author: Annie M
reviews.title: Amazing Time
reviews.text: We had a girls trip here, and splurged on the butler service. Totally worth it!!! If you can request a butler, request Alain!  He is the best!  So accommodating, attentive and overall awesome.  We wanted to take him home :) The resort was beautiful and had amazing food.  Service was on point!

reviews.author: Yü Y
reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: I went to Cancun with friends and we stayed at adult only area in Paradisus for 8 days. All I can say is that it is a great experience. I personally enjoyed the restaurant La Palapa very much. Not only has it the breathtaking views, but also it has tasty food. We are also lucky to have a dinner there once. Really great! Except that the personnel in the hotel is very kind and helpful. They also have some travel agencies in the hotel - either at the lobby or near the pool for water activities. It offers you many options. We also happened to get a personal touch with one of their members in the senior management team - Ebraham Franco. Very experienced management and always put their client first. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Curious677966
reviews.title: Muy bueno
reviews.text: Sigan asi tienen muy buena atencion, la gente muy gentil y cordial, sus alimentos riquisimos una felicitacion a sus chef's porque son muy buenos cocinero, felicidades tienen un excelente  hotel.. saludo

reviews.author: LittleButterfly1987
reviews.title: Perfect Vacations
reviews.text: I just came back from a visit to Cancun and stayed in Paradisus. The location of the property was the best. I stayed on an ocean front and my friends had a lagoon view. They have the authentic Mexican food onsite and even the buffet restaurant was great. My favorite was the Asian. Service was top notch and the staff always had a smile.

reviews.author: Pete L
reviews.title: Relaxing vacation
reviews.text: Upgraded room offered a great view of beautiful azure waters and sunrises.  Don't miss the Togi bar and the excellent and friendly service you get from Evaristo and Alan Tec. Itl;s right next to the Bana Restaurant which has a breathtaking tenor performance on Monday nights.  Don't miss it.  There's nightly enterainment near the pools with a lot of variety. The Enzo restaurant was the only one that was disappointing .. but that was just our take on it.

reviews.author: Brock T
reviews.title: Best Choice of Resorts
reviews.text:
After watching months of YouTube videos on the choices of resorts in Cancun, Mexico, we  chose Paradisus Cancun Resort! This place is absolutely perfect, clean, and elegant. We stayed five days in Royal Service, the staff are very friendly, attentive, and willing to do anything to make your vacation perfect. While waiting in a short line upon check in, we were greeted and served a cocktail. The rooms are very breathtaking, bright, modern, clean and omg the shower was AMAZING. The restaurants , pools,  bars, and grounds are FIVE STARS. I must say after driving along the strip of resorts, the Paradisus Cancun resort has the best curbside Appel.  I strongly recommend this resort. 

   Our first night at the resort we ate at Blue Agave, which was so yummy, and we also ate breakfast there a few times. Martin was our waiter every time, he was very attentive, friendly, funny, and welcoming. 

    Sandra was our butler, she was welcoming, accommodating, friendly, funny, and easy to communicate with. 

                  ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.author: 1LiviaC1
reviews.title: The staff is nothing short of incredible
reviews.text:
Where to start, the food was phenomenal! I'm surrounded by some of the best sushi places at home but I would say the sushi I ate at Paradisus was up there with the best sushi and sashimi I've ever eaten. The seafood and tacos were also awesome. The buffet was even pretty good in comparison to other all inclusives I have been to, plethara of options, clean and always stocked.

Above all else I CANNOT stress enough how sublime the staff was, specifically the staff at the pool bar. The majority of the hotel staff was much like other hotels, very helpful, and nice. However, both mine and the others I visited with, trips would not have been as amazing had we not been to the pool bar. Sounds cliche, I know, how could you not love the pool bar right? We had originally seen Randy at the avenue bar where he was equally as amazing, but the next day at the pool bar he remembered all of our names, the drinks we enjoyed and were able to offer suggestions based on the types of drinks we liked. Nestor, Juan and Andres were equally as amazing able to handle large groups of people, speak to everyone in both spanish and english. My friends and I like to have fun but we were looking to avoid the insane college spring break crowd, we were a little worried when an obnoxious group of 18-20 somethings but Randy was able to assess whether or not they could use another drink or if they needed a water. Shutting down any behaviors that were either not appropriate or impacting other guests. The pool bar staff gets a big 20 out of 10 from me and my friends!

reviews.author: Julie G
reviews.title: Fantastic week!
reviews.text: Just returned from a 1 week stay for a sisters’ getaway, we had an an amazing week! Starting at check in, which was fast and efficient, with the help of Marta (from guest services), who took the time to explain all the different services, the restaurants, how to go about making reservations (just pick up the phone, couldn’t be easier), and showing us the premises. We were treated warmly everywhere we went, and service was excellent. Special thanks to Miguel and Tania for their wonderful and friendly service at the beach, they always made sure our bucket of iced water was full, remembered our favorite drinks and kept them coming lol! You made our week all that more enjoyable :) Rooms were spacious and clean, and the grounds beautiful. Would definitely recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Kimberley Y
reviews.title: Wonderful all inclusive resort
reviews.text: It has been my great pleasure to stay at the Paradisus Cancun twice.  I found the service, accommodations, and facility to be exceptional. For this visit,  booked two ocean view , Royal Service Junior Suites, for myself and 4 friends.  I knew from my previous visit the suites were large enough to comfortably accommodate an extra bed for the 5th person.  However, upon our arrival we were graciously upgraded to the Presidential Suite.  The accommodations went for very wonderful to luxurious, every detail of our trip was orchestrated by our staff liaison, (butler) We found every staff member from housekeeping to waiters, pool people and poolside waiters and most of all our butler to be about the most hard working, efficient and gracious persons we had every dealt with in a resort setting. The food was very good and the drinks were very generously supplied.  I know that when I have the opportunity to return to Cancun , my stay will be a Paradisus Cancun

reviews.author: Liblou
reviews.title: Beach Cabana Rental @ Cocos!
reviews.text:
The hotel was lovely! Very lush and green inside! Staff was very attentive and willing to help. Our favorite part was the beach cabana rental at Cocos. Manuel was our server for two days and he was awesome. He kept the drinks coming, supplied us with ample amounts of water and ice all day! Alejandro was his backup and he was just as amazing. the beach cabana was an extra charge but that included champagne and a lovely lobster plate. Other food and drinks were included in the all inclusive part. 

Only downside was we ordered room service one night and it never showed up. and another night ordered extra pillows and they never showed up. Other than that, great experience!

reviews.author: KenMurphey
reviews.title: Beautiful Inside and Out
reviews.text: Love this place if you like Cancun and want to be south of the main Hotel district. You can catch a bus at the entrance for about $.50 or 8 pesos to go just about anywhere north and to Cancun proper. Very nice beach and staff and pool.

reviews.author: REGINAC
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text:
I had a great time at Paradisus. It is a big complex as most of the hotels in the area. As you are entitled an 'all-inclusive' service and you may feel like enjoy everything they have for you, there is not much you feel like doing outside the hotel, I guess.You can always go to town or a mall. For that, lots of buses are available to take you there for 1 dollar. 
The restaurants at the hotel are excellent. Most of them require reservation for dinner, but the one that is always available, Naos, is a great place for a meal.
The only thing I think it should be clearer from the start is what is really NOT included. For instance, we had to pay extra for some wine and beer and we just learned that after they were served and opened. 
We saw some people feeling embarassed when they wanted to use the beds around the pool or on the beach and did not know they were extra charged as well. 
The staff is always very ready to do the best they can to make your stay unforgettable.

reviews.author: magk341
reviews.title: Nice hotel and beach
reviews.text:
It is a nice hotel, a great beach and overall I was pleased.
The room and beach were great. The bathroom was a bit rundown...there were cracks in the sink and bathtub and although it was clean it was disappointing...especially that it was the most expensive beach package I purchased and I've been 3 times only in Cancun before, plus in other Caribbean resorts.
From the airport we're picked up and asked to seat 2 persons on the front seat near the driver. Clearly that was a generous 1 seat, but not for 2.  The people from the back seats did not try to accommodate one of us either. The positive part - it was like 20 min drive. Clearly I was unimpressed...
The check-in - not impressed either. The porter did not help with the luggage and actually indicated the wrong desk. Then there were some ladies that pointed to the right desk. The guy was trying to convince me to upgrade the room but was not concerned at all if we can eat anything at 4 pm. He pretty much told me that the restaurant was closed. Then finally he gave me a piece of paper with all the restaurants and I could figure out the grill on the beach was open until 5 pm, so we could eat something.
The travel agency representative next day was as helpless as the check-in guy, he was interested only if we want to buy trips and for the rest of questions regarding the hotel he told me he does not advertise for the hotel.... 
So, from this point of view this is the worst experience I had for check-in and travel agency representative in my 8 visits in the Caribbean resorts.
But I ignored all this and actually the food and beach were great.

One other note: reservations to the restaurants are done 1 day prior and you better do it at 7 am (by phone) else you don't find seats anymore. I went just to the Market Grill restaurant - it was great, the food was excellent.

As a final note - drink is "controlled", meaning the waiter serves you and it can take a while. At least 2 times when I ordered a glass of wine they brought after 20 min and by that time I was done with eating. And I actually don't drink wine if I don't eat in the same time, so...

The weather was beautiful (except 1 day). The entertainment - I don't care too much for it - it was crowded close to the swimming pool - they do not have actually a dedicated inside area for it. There was a music band one day on the beach that sang many classic rock songs. That was nice.

As I said I pretty much ignored the negatives and enjoyed the positives. Most of the waiters/servers were quite nice.

reviews.author: Lis V
reviews.title: The name suits them well! Paradise.
reviews.text: amazing hotel. beautiful lobby area! rooms were comfy and modern. Ignacio, Martin and Edwin at breakfast buffet restaurant went above and beyond to serve us and make us feel welcome!  Great location in reference to the nightlife outside of the resort. Amazing spot on the beach! great food.Overall, can't wait to return.

reviews.author: Dale M
reviews.title: Treated like honored guests!
reviews.text: We are Melia Club members in Dominican Republic and moved our time share over to Melia Cancun for a new experience. During our week's stay, we were gratified at the commodious ocean view room (wished we had a hot plate), extended pool, pristine beach, towel service, attitude of all staff members, and drink service everywhere. Even the evening entertainment was better than expected. The checking in and out could have been more efficient. We can't comment on the food/restaurants as we ate out instead of choosing the all-inclusive, but certainly would return in a heart beat. Very welcoming!

reviews.author: EZ_Pickins
reviews.title: Good Vacation Location
reviews.text:
Resort: Fifteen minutes from the airport. Check in was quick and efficient. We were then given a briefing about the hotel and how it works, where the restaurants are, how to make reservations for dinner and other amenities. We were given a booklet explaining the resort and the number of the person giving the briefing to call if anything is needed. The grounds are beautiful, and well maintained. The beach is beautiful with white sand and turquoise water. There was a show every evening at the central beach access. The Power Girls show was great. Especially the second half light show.

Accommodations: We had booked a Ocean View Junior Suite. Our room was in building one on the fourth floor. You could not ask for a better view. The room was a good size, clean and the bed was comfortable. The sofa appears to have been spilled on in the past but you could see that it had been cleaned (normal wear and tear). The bathroom was stocked with four face cloths when we arrived but were not replaced when used. Bath towels were replaced. Housekeeping stopped by the room in the evening and we would ask for more then.
