Food: We ate breakfast and lunch at the Naos buffet nearly every day. There was a lot to choose from beyond the standard buffet items. There is something for everyone. Other than Naos for dinner we ate at other ala carte restaurants to try different cuisines. The Market Grill (Brazillian Rodizio) was very good; Bana (Japanese fusion) was OK but only OK because it was new to us. Wait staff very good explaining the menu. Enso (Asian) was OK also, same reason as Bana. There was a problem with my wife’s meal that was promptly corrected.

Staff: The staff is exceptionally nice and helpful. You are greeted by every staff person you meet in the resort with a smile and a happy greeting The service was great at the restaurants and the pool. We need to mention Asuncion, the waitress at the pool. Get in her section and you will not want for anything.  A special thank you to Ignacio Vazqez at the Naos restaurant. We ate breakfast there and when we returned for lunch the first day he knew our names and provided us with excellent service each and every meal. Also, Richie Vasquez and Jorge Alberto at Naos restaurant.

reviews.author: nick_ng
reviews.title: a very popular place ...
reviews.text:
Stayed here last week for 6 nights and had a delightful experience. The staff are all friendly and helpful. Check-in was smooth and the front-desk staff were informative and efficient. F&B staff in the restaurants are engaging and always willing to serve. There are many restaurants to choose from. Since this is a popular hotel with many guests, it is a good idea to book in advance for dinner.

Getting to downtown Cancun is easy. The local public bus stops are directly in front of the hotel. The ride is a standard flat rate of 12 Mexican Dollars/Pesos or US$1 (you don't get change if you pay in USD) and it takes approximately 30 minutes. Costs the same to travel the opposite direction to the popular public beach at Playa Delfines.

The hotel's beach and swimming pools are great.

This is a great location for a vacation.

reviews.author: Kellyz0212
reviews.title: Decent size hotel at Cancun Hotel zone
reviews.text: Just came back from 4 days 3 nights vacation from Cancun, had previously been to cancun multiple times, this visit we decided to stay at Paradisus as we have heard so much great reviews about this hotel. It did not disappoint, the hotel ground is beautiful. Beach is beautiful, but I think given the season we were traveling, the waves were too strong for a swim, and the beach has a lot of seaweed. The rooms and décor in many places seem a bit dated, but overall the view is amazing. I also love the pool, and there's always beach chairs available for the time I stayed at the resort. One thing I do want to point out is that all the pools are deeper than the ones I am used to. As I do not know how to swim, but in the previously hotels in Cancun I've been to, the pool is usually around 4-5ft deep, but instead I think all the pool area except for the kids pool area is 5ft or deeper, making it difficult for me to even stand on my feet when I'm at the pool, I had to tippy toe because again I dono how to swim. The hotel provide many restaurant options, although I believe all inclusive is all inclusive, the food is never as good as fancy restaurants in the city, but given the number of options that are provided, I think it's definitely a plus, I also enjoy the breakfast buffet every morning- it has more than enough options. Rooms are decent size. Avoid staying around tower 3 (main tower where everything is) unless you plan to party and drink all night long and sleep after 11PM, we had to change our room from tower 3 to tower 4 as we were traveling with a baby, and it was impossible for the baby to fall asleep with the noise going on in the lobby. Overall I think it was great experience, its very family friendly. The kids zone and baby's zone was amazing, because of them, my friend was able to leave her baby there and we were able to enjoy spa for 2 hours. However, I do want to point out that I think the spa facility was disappointing and small, especially for the price we paid for (145 dollar for 50 min). all the workers in the hotel are super friendly and nice, always available to help! That's wat makes this an amazing experience.

reviews.author: Ralph S
reviews.title: Always good experience
reviews.text: Keep going back for great time in January.  Weather can be iffy but always have some nice days and the beach is so good. Pool bar waitresses ASCUNION and LAURA take such good care of your every need.  Market Grill waiters Rafael, Alberto and Maniel give service beyond expectation.  Food is so good at all restaurants and all staff is so helpful. Will be back in 2019

reviews.author: 69karlar
reviews.title: Best vacation ever!
reviews.text:
We went to the paradisus to celebrate my birthday with some of my closest friends and I have to say everyone in this hotel created the best vacation ever. From the moment we got to the hotel everyone was very professional you can see this people are there to help you with anything you need. Kudos to Moises, Ricardo in the restaurant palapa he was always so happy and very professional with all of us. Our butler Daniel was 
always there for everything we need. I want to say thank you to the Royal service in the hotel the upgrade to the presidential suit was amazing this was unexpected and unforgettable. My friends and I were looking to spend time together and with this upgrade you guys let it happen! Thank you for this amazing experience and we can’t wait to be back again to this dreaming place!

reviews.author: Leyanis A
reviews.title: Awesome Stay!! Great experience!!
reviews.text: My friend and I went to the hotel for the weekend. The property is beautiful, rooms are great, and very important they are clean and confortable. The hotel has many restaurants , but we went to Restaurant Naos in the first floor which is a buffet. It has many options and I surely recommend it. Awesome service and a big shout out to Cristian Lovera and Gaudencio!!! They are the best, they make the stay so much better and fun. They make sure you have a great stay. Keep up the awesome service! I would definitely recommend the hotel.

reviews.author: Elocin
reviews.title: Lovely hotel, a few major drawbacks...
reviews.text:
The hotel and grounds are beautiful, the staff is helpful, and the all-inclusive package is the way to go.  We enjoyed the drink selections and the staff frequently checked in at the beach and pool to take our orders.  The staff were very friendly and accomodating.

 I recommend staying in pyramid 2 if you can, it is the main building and much more vibrant than pyramid 1 where we stayed.    Avoid a first floor room as well- the patio is easily scaled and I'm not convinced that the door locks would prevent a theft.  Apparently we had a "lagoon view"  bur on the first flooe or view was only a parling lot.   Further, we had people from upper balconies throwing cigarettes off of theirs and they often ended up on ours.  

We had two junior suites and they were quite spacious and clean overall.

We ate at two restaurants, Fuego and The Market Grill.   We found the food to be just o.k.  The breakfast spread at the buffet was great, however, and was my favorite meal there- plenty of selection, mimosa and bloody Mary station, a wide variety of breads, omelet station, and much more.   The fruit was delicious.   

The gelato stand and the Nespresso stand on the main floor were great and we really enjoyed them.  

Where this hotel fell short is in lighting, humidity and, well, sewage treatment.    To be clear, we were there for a very short time (48 hours) so we didn't bother bringing it to the attention of the management.   We also didn't spend much time in our room since the weather was so beautiful so it didn't affect our overall trip very much.

The room size was great, but one of our two rooms had an old couch that was impossible to sit in because it had no support.   We came to find out it was because the mattress in this sofa bed was missing entirely.    Miraculously a new couch appeared on day two, but it was odd.   We also didn't have a coffee table in that room, whereas our second room next door was much better maintained. 

The lighting (in both rooms) was a problem.   After sundown it was nearly impossible to see clearly- there were approximately 11 light switches throughout the room and bathroom, each linked to a tiny recessed light.    Even with all switches in the "on" position the room and bathroom were dim.    There is no way to properly apply makeup after dark and you have to walk around switching off each light before getting to sleep.

The humidity in our rooms was odd considering that we were able to control our air conditioning.    However, each night we got into a damp bed.   This never went away and was pretty uncomfortable, (though the mattresses themselves were quite comfortable).  No setting on the A.C. unit successfully rid us of the humidity, and we tried repeatedly.    I suspect it may be an issue with the ground floor rooms.  

Possibly the most concerning was waking up one morning to the overpowering scent of sulfur and sewage.   There was no leak or sewer backup, but the smell was overwhelming.    It suggests some type of sewer issue but we never figured it out. We were checking out that same day and simply told 'thanks for letting us know'.
   
Overall, the hotel was lovely but our rooms left something to be desired.   For such a short stay it didn't matter much, but if I was planning to stay any longer i would certainly have requested to speak with the Management.  I might come back...  but would insist on a room on a higher floor.

reviews.author: VWCalgary
reviews.title: Nice Resort
reviews.text:
I was at the resort for 5 days for my Noevir (Japanese Skincare Company) 2018 Convention. It was a very beautiful resort. The entrance was grand, the inside was beautiful, everything layout perfectly. The outdoor areas was beautiful too, with a few swimming pools all setup with umbrellas, tables, chairs and cabanas. On the beach within the hotels, umbrellas and chairs are setup so we can enjoy our time in the beach.

The rooms were nice and clean, but some areas needed refinishing. I booked 2 days in a room with the lagoon view, which is a little cheaper and 3 nights with our Convention price to an ocean view room. The ocean view room has magnificent ocean view, I enjoyed watching the sun rises everyday.

The service was good at the restaurants, and we enjoyed the a Market Grill, Feugo and Bana the most.

The only disappointment was we did have some hiccups when checking in. The first 2 nights we booked through Booking.com, but somehow the hotel did not get our reservations (2 groups which were booked at the same time). We had to call Booking.com and it still took the resort on each occasion at least 4 hours to correct. Especially Kelvin, the resort reservation clerk, he wasn't very honest, he kept telling us different stories even though Booking.com had already fixed the problem, with him speaking Spanish to his colleagues, we knew he was lying. Finally we had to speak to the Manager.

reviews.author: Coleman P
reviews.title: AMAZING Resort!!!
reviews.text: I cannot say enough good things about this place! Definitely worth the upgrade to the Royal service. I just spent a week here with friends and this is for sure the best resort I have ever stayed at. The property was beautiful, the food was wonderful, and the staff was INCREDIBLE! Daniel was our butler and he was there to help with anything and everything. He booked us cabanas by the pool for every day and always made sure we were happy with everything. BIG shout out to Moses and Orlando at the pool! These guys were on top of things. They went out of their way to make sure we were happy and enjoying our time. All of the restaurants were great - I especially liked Blue Agave for their authentic tacos. The drinks were were wonderful as well! We go to Cancun every year, but this was our first time at Paradisus and we will definitely be returning. Thanks so much for all you guys do at this resort! It was an amazing vacation.

reviews.author: letsgonow123
reviews.title: 3rd time and here Still a 5 Star Review
reviews.text: This was my 3rd time at Paradisus Cancun and every time, it is perfect. The first time I was here was with my husband, second trip was for my wedding, with family and friends and this was a girlfriends trip over New Years. Whatever the kind of trip, it doesn't matter, the staff at this resort are amazing. Everyone works to make sure you have what you need. I have stayed at other resorts in Cancun and throughout the Caribbean and I would choose Paradisus over them all. I have always had a Royal Service room, but others I have stayed here with have had a regular room and they are just as nice. Royal Service is adults only, and adds in some additional services and the La Palapa restaurant. It also adds in the service of a Butler, and this time we had Rossana, who was so wonderful!!! <3 There are a few restaurants that you need to book reservations at. This time, we ate at Mole and our waiter, Christian, took very good care of us. The food and whole dining experience was amazing! Our days were spent relaxing in the sun at the Royal Service pool and Jose made sure we had what we needed from towels, our Bali bed and he checked in regularly. Joel was one of the waiters from La Palpa and also came by often, we never we lacking. The staff made sure that our days there were spent relaxing and enjoying the time we had wth each other, I really cannot say enough about them. We ate breakfast either at La Palapa or the main buffet. the Buffet has great choices and the quality of food is good for all meals. You cannot go wrong at this resort!

reviews.author: apaoiram
reviews.title: Como siempre excelente hotel
reviews.text:
Esta vez fuimos con amigos por mi cumpleaños y siempre la pasamos de lo mejor. El servicio es excelente, la comida ni se diga.

La playa es la parte que más me gusta de este hotel pues es grande y muy bonita.

Aunque es un hotel familiar la pasas muy a gusto si van solo adultos

Recomendable

reviews.author: carolinamZ9946LJ
reviews.title: Gran hotel, excelente para adultos
reviews.text:
Si vas en familia hay un área especial para ellos y los chicos se sienten a gusto. Pero si eres de los que no les agrada los niños como yo, el hotel ofrece una excelente opción rotal service que es para adultos, todo está rennovado, playa privada y mucho silencio es una maravilla.

Además está cerca de los restaurantes más nuevos vale la pena

reviews.author: Luciana G
reviews.title: Espetacular
reviews.text: Hospedamos no Paradisus no ano novo, utilizamos os serviços do Royal Service. Vale muito a pena pois tivemos restaurantes e piscina exclusivas e quarto diferenciado. O atendimento excelente, todos os funcionários muito amáveis. Gostaria de destacar o atendimento do Orlando, que nos atendeu na piscina e não deixava nos faltar nada. Quarto ótimo tbem.

reviews.author: 573kjones
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: Wonderful! Royal service was outstanding.   We just wished there was more of a social lobby bar area and more entrainment at night.  Our butler was galdino- he's simply the best.   He was always attentive and we enjoyed all the help he provided.

reviews.author: itsmelidee
reviews.title: AMAZING VACATION
reviews.text: I stayed at this hotel in November to celebrate my best friend's birthday. I was very impressed with the layout and design of the hotel. When we got there, we updated to the Royal Service which was a great decision. We were treated like royalty and everyone was very attentive. The restaurant La Palapa by the pool in the Royal service side is DELICIOUS. We had breakfast and lunch there every day. Very grateful for the way we were treated by Jorge and Julio in La Palapa. Also, Carlos the pool concierge was very helpful when ever we asked for something he even decorated our Cabana with balloons on my friend's birthday. I am also very grateful for the way that we were treated by our Butler Eduardo he would go above and beyond to help us with what we needed. Finally, a HUGE Thank you to pool server on the Royal Service side, Victor Cauich he is the best server there. He would literally run to get our orders a brought us so much food I thought I would explode. He honestly warmed my heart. I would definitely go back to the Paradisus Cancun. Thank you all for the wonderful experience.

reviews.author: 124tracia
reviews.title: Enjoyed this hotel
reviews.text: Had some really good servers. Fransico in the lounge at night took the time to learn our names. The two girls on the beach were also very good, would be nice to be able to use the Bali beds without paying for them. They sat empty all week. Very pretty lobby. Spa pools need work.

reviews.author: 657narinei
reviews.title: Horrible experience, it looks fancy yet its so cheap and low quality with an awful service
reviews.text: I wish i could mention what was satisfying about our stay! As every experience i had at your facility was nothing but a nightmare. I chose this hotel based on my past experience with Melia as i stayed at Me couple of years ago. We paid a lot to be simply eating frozen chicken wings and guacamole all day since those were the only edible things after a horrible experience at your restaurants, buffet and room service. The food only looks like a food no taste, no flavor and 0 quality. We stayed at Royal Paradisus yet not only the room was not royal nor was the service. Our butler Giraldo was incompetent and could not even reserve our pool side beds that we were promised we would get for 2 days. What was astonishing was the level of poor service and poor quality food at every single facility let alone the quality of your alcoholic beverages. What a waste of $$$! If you are reading this, i would like to escalate this issue to the management in the hopes that you would compensate me for such terrible experience!

reviews.author: Antonio Rodriguez
reviews.title: Un servicio de primera
reviews.text:
Con unos amigos nos hospedamos  en Paradisus por recomendación de unos conocidos. Quedamos encantados con el servicio, las amenidades, los alimentos y bebidas de muy buena calidad. El staff siempre muy amable y dispuestos a ayudar. el check-in fue tan rápido que ni lo sentimos. 
¡En definitiva lo recomiendo!

reviews.author: Kristen S
reviews.title: Sisters Trip
reviews.text: We had the most wonderful time at Paradisus.  We first arrived with expedited check in service and was served champaign while we checked in. We were immediately greeted by our butler, Hector, who showed us to our room and made sure we had reservations to the restaurants we wanted.  The whole hotel feels like a spa.   Every restaurant we had dinner at was delicious and the service was top notch. I highly recommend the Royal service. With that service, you have a butler, private pool, private area where they serve top shelf drinks and snacks all day. It is all kid free.   The servers at the Royal Pool went above and beyond to meet our expectations.  We were never had to wait for a drink or service.  Julio was especially amazing at the pool bar.  Our beer bucket was never empty.  The Spa had a water treatment that we had access to every day including the Gym.  On the last day, Hector (our butler) decorated our room for my sisters birthday.  He left a delicious cake and a bottle of Champaign.  Over all, our experience is one we will never forget.  Thank you!

reviews.author: 198peggyb
reviews.title: A Great Experience
reviews.text: We loved our stay at this hotel.  It was our first time at this property.  Occasionally we were not able to get a reservation at a restaurant that we wanted, but alternatives were available.  The pool side experience was the best as well as the spa and included "water therapy".  Everyone was very nice and attentive.  I was very glad we upgraded to the "adult" side since we did not have any kids with us.  This is a must if you are not traveling with children.  The variety of food in the buffet was excellent.  I love my coffee in the morning, and I would say the coffee was just ok.  But the Capaccino's were excellent.  They also did a great job mixing drinks with specific directions and choice of alcohol.  Poolside food on the adult side was excellent.  The ocean was rough in December and not very swimmable.  There was also no snorkeling off this property site.  But the comfort and beauty and ability to just relax was excellent.  Also, for excursions, the staff was very helpful in getting us into designated transport vans.  Lastly, I would say the biggest drawback at times was how muggy the common areas of the resort became during warm days.  I would definitely revisit this property again in the future.

reviews.author: Vacay_Lady_1
reviews.title: Trip of a life time
reviews.text:
I usually don’t write long detailed reviews, but this resort deserves it. I was blown away by the beauty and cleanliness of this resort. It smelled amazing, and felt like paradise. The employees were extremely courteous and friendly. We were greeted and directed to the check in counter and were even upgraded to a nicer room with an amazing ocean view. 
The food was great and they had a variety which is a must. The pools were clean and nicely maintained. There were plenty of workers asking them if we’d like drinks or food which was so convenient. 
The spa was one of my favorite part of the trip. My friends and I had an 80 min deep tissue massage with access to the steam room, sauna and private spa pool. Honestly it was the best massage I’ve ever had at any resort. So bravo to their well trained masseuses.
The beach was beautiful and clean, but a little dangerous. The waves were a little too much for me. 
Overall, I had an amazing time and would definitely plan another trip to this particular Melia. Thanks for making my experience extra special ❤️

reviews.author: Jess1308
reviews.title: Hotel super grande con mucho por ofrecer pero Antiguo!
reviews.text:
Tipico hotel de zona de playa en caribe, muchas áreas a disfrutar: Piscina inmensa, restaurantes, bares, discoteca, animación en playa y en piscina, personal super amigable (algo que sobresale en todo mexico). El spa, gimnasio, tiendas...Vives unas buenas vacaciones!!

A considerar:
Las habitaciones son pequeñas, con camas enmarcadas antiguas pequeñas. su terraza super simple (2sillas y ya) la puerta para abrirla necesita mantenimiento (super dura). El espejo del baño, no es para nada visible por la luna tan vieja que tiene. Los ascensores se nota estilo antiguo, alfombras viejas, un tanto sucio.

reviews.author: Morgan M
reviews.title: A Slice of Paradise
reviews.text:
I just got back from six days at Paradisus Cancun with my best friend and had the BEST time. We stayed in an ocean-view family concierge suite that included Royal Service.This resort is top-notch, the food was so gourmet and delicious and everywhere you went there was a full-service bar. Our favorite restaurant was Fuego and the Market Grill. The staff was so friendly and super accommodating, they also kept they resort clean at all times.

Our favorite part was the adults-only pool at Royal Service and (of course) the private beach for Royal Service members. We also enjoyed the lux activities of sushi making and mixology. The hotel also has a pretty cool nightlife with the club in the red lounge and the avenue bar.

I highly recommend staying here. Not only is there a lot to do, but the staff is friendly and the resort is top-notch.

reviews.author: Gregorio R
reviews.title: Hotel Antiguo
reviews.text:
En general bien, sin embargo el edificio, áreas comunes, habitaciones urgen sean remodeladas, parece como una maquina del tiempo gigante, para ser de una categoría 5 estrellas es necesario se cuiden esos detalles de estética, hay partes del hotel que han tenido remodelación sobre remodelación que hace se vea grotesco, la habitación es pequeña y mal iluminada.
La verdad esperaba mas del hotel.

reviews.author: John N
reviews.title: Great hotel, great location, great time
reviews.text: Hotel was beautiful, clean and the food was great. All employees were very helpful and pleasant. Appeared to be happy working there. Beach was great, pool and bar wonderful. Tequila bar and restaurant was a favorite.

reviews.author: cgray3day
reviews.title: Best Trip Ever
reviews.text: The staff are amazing. Food was delicious, service was always friendly. Renan at Blue Agave makes the best omelettes, Jose & Sonya make Bana a must stop restaurant. Carlos and Eduardo make Toji Bar the place to get an evening night cap, by far the best drinks on the resort!

reviews.author: Sarah D
reviews.title: Amazing vacation! :)
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Cancún at the end of November. Our stay was amazing!! Everything was perfect! We had our wedding here and brought 26 family members and friends along with us. This group included 4 children under the age of 3.
Our wedding was perfect. Mariana (our wedding planner) was definitely busy but everything we asked for was provided and the wedding went off without any incidents. I definitely recommend the Camilo Outdoors photography! These guys were very professional took amazing pictures and even stayed later to get a few last pictures in that we wanted :) 
The DJ was also easy to work with and did amazing at the reception! 

The resort was absolutely beautiful. All of our guests, some of whom travel yearly, agreed that this was the best resort they have stayed at yet!

The beach was beautiful, white, sandy and cleaned daily by the hard working employees on the resort. There was always lots of seating available and you were never without a drink in your hand. The service was wonderful :)

The pool is divided into two sections with a swim up bar and snack bar during the day. The snack bar was delicious we had lunch there nearly every day! Again service was amazing at the pool, employees always made sure you were looked after!

All food was delicious! We didn’t get to try all the restaurants but anything we did have was amazing! Well cooked  with tons of variety and again service at the restaurants: A+. They also have a coffee shop and gelato shop open daily which is a nice little extra :)

Bars were all amazing with great bartenders that always were happy to create any request you asked! 
Highly recommend coco beach as we sat out there many nights. The atmosphere is great and service was amazing! 

Our guests that had children were happy with the kids pools and little extras like the playground and inside play areas for the kids :)

As the wedding couple we were upgraded to royal service. Due to the fact that we had 26 guests with us we didn’t use to amenities as much as we could have but there’s a few things to make note.
Our butler Daniel was amazing! Anything we asked for he provided. Even things that I was sure he would think we were crazy for showed up at our door :) he always checked in with us several times a day and made sure we never went without. He was great :) Reserved us dinner and Bali beds on super short notice. Always pleasant to work with! 
Our room in pyramid 4 was beautiful with amazing views of the beach. The rooms were always clean with turn down service nightly. 

The hotel itself is very well looked after. Although it is quite large you never get that feeling when you are there. After getting our bearings the first day everything was centrally located and well kept. The lobby area is beautiful and everything is kept so clean! Bathrooms were always spotless inside the hotel. 

I really can’t say enough about this hotel! We had a perfect vacation and our only downfall was not booking for 2 weeks! We will definitely be back :)

reviews.author: welkeranie
reviews.title: solo  elogios
reviews.text: lo único q no mi gusto el DJ, q no lo hás pu esto  musicas brasileiras, um poco mal educado, no mi gusto muxo EN la disco del hotel,  creo que deverias majoras el DJ,  pero lo mas tudo bien, el barmen carlos e su amigo, muy bueno chico , mi lo has atendido en el bar mucho bien , mi gusto mucho. lo mas tudo otimo, mi quede encantado quiero volver otra vez.

reviews.author: Horea V
reviews.title: Spectacular
reviews.text: The architecture of the hotel is spectacular, with its five piramids. The main lobby looks like a jungle. Very friendly personal, very good and diverse restaurants, very clean rooms. The beach is lovely, with fine sand. There are many posibilities for interesting trps.

reviews.author: EkaterinaPanfilova
reviews.title: Great service!
reviews.text:
The quality of the service makes it a great experience! Not one employee of this hotel will pass by your without smiling! Restaurant service is great- Luis(Bana), Edier( Breakfast buffet), Ener outrageous!!! (Vento), pool service- Flor, Hugo, Luis all doing an amazing job! 
Hotel grounds are not so big but beautiful and clean.
Entertainment team is great, but a tip for hotel management- maybe there should be more of entertainment during the day. 
A tip for the travelers— TIPS ARE NOT INCLUDED IN YOUR ALL INCLUSIVE PACKAGE, would be nice leaving a few bucks after you are done asking to bring you this and that..it’s embarrassing to see North Americans not tipping at restaurants or !!!bars.

reviews.author: clarissaa1969
reviews.title: 2nd trip to Paradisus
reviews.text: This hotel/resort is amazing in every way. We will stay there each time we go. It’s clean,beautiful,amazing food and the service is 100%. Victor Hugo Arellano Yañez was one of our amazing servers. He took such great care of us. Very professional and personable. He made sure we had everything we needed. We will look for him each time we go back!!

reviews.author: dealgrabber
reviews.title: 5 stars except food quality, rooms
reviews.text: I gave 4 stars only because coudn't reserve any of those restaurants for dinner. One of the rooms that we got had a water leak from A/C vent. We didn't get offer to switch room until we asked for it on last day.

reviews.author: Rubemnsp
reviews.title: Incrível
reviews.text: Melhor destino de Cacun, atendimento excelente, conforto, me tornei sócio do Clube Meliá por tudo que esse Hotel tem a oferecer, uma atenção Especial ao Sr. Artur Piovesam fez toda a diferença na minha decisão pela sua cordialidade... Indico muito esse Hotel se você quiser conforto.

reviews.author: Lily O
reviews.title: Paradisus really lives up to its name
reviews.text: This hotel was, by far, the best!  Staff was extremely friendly and hospitable... shout out to Jose at the Bana restaurant and Jaime by the poolside.  Keep up the great work as you guys made my vacation a memorable one!  Think of Las Vegas but without the gambling---- endless entertainment (never a dull moment), delectable meals, etc., and the best part you get your monies worth!!! Truly enjoyed my birthday vacation!!!!

reviews.author: Ailton P
reviews.title: Maravilhoso
reviews.text: Meu nome é Ailton Pessoa  fiquei 5 dias no Paradísus  Cancún,fomos através do Grupo Hinode, foi tudo perfeito, comida excelente, café da manhã maravilhoso, bom atendimento de todos os funcionários que nos trataram muito bem. Em especial o Arthur Luiz Piovezam, do Club Melia, um excelente profissional que fez toda diferença em minha  estadia, parabéns ao Club Melia por ter um profissional tão capacitado e carismático, ficamos realmente encantados com o atendimento que recebemos e  com certeza pessoas como você, Arthur fazem nossos dias melhores. Obrigado! Em breve estaremos juntos novamente.

reviews.author: Jesus G
reviews.title: Buen servicio
reviews.text: Estadia por 5 dias en paradisos royal service. Atendido por Rossana muy buen servicio siempre atenta y brindando las alternativas de las comidas y los lugares que se podia visitar y sobre todo los servicios brindados por el hotel. Recomiendo a rossana como mayordomo ya que el servicio es mas que exelente.

reviews.author: David G
reviews.title: Nice Hotel with an Amazing beach
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at this property.

I honestly do not have much experience in all inclusive hotels, however I know of those properties that stand out in these services.

I have to admit that I liked the personalized attention they gave me prior to entering this Resort, the Reservations Staff was in a very cordial way accommodated to the requirements. . They gave me assistance in a very effective way with some CC changes due to an inconvenience during my trip, I have to highlight the incredible work of Elena Cruz in this department, she was extremely effective, professional and with a very good touch for the handling of information, very grateful for your good work.

The food was good, the services and the drinks in general were good.

In relation to the rooms I think that this property has been operating for several years which is remarkable due to its concept and decoration. so it's not your strong point on my opinion.

The beach area was my favorite, definitely you have a great beach. The pool area was pretty good, however they tend to take a bit longer to provide service. (being aware that there are usually many people)

In general it is a well maintained property, with a lot of enthusiastic staff in what they do every day and an incredible beach.

Thank you very much.

reviews.author: Jgfchef G
reviews.title: Increíble!!! Totalmente Renovada la piscina
reviews.text: Una vez más decidimos, Cancún. Por lo que debía de ser Paradisus!!! Una vez más nos enamoraron con todos los detalles, increíble el nuevo córner de helados y crepas, el suelo de la piscina muy mejorado.

reviews.author: tenzi123
reviews.title: Celebrating friend's 50th !
reviews.text: My friend and I went to Paradisus Cancun mid November for 5 days.   We had the best time ever!!!   We were greeted with warm smiles as soon as we arrived.  Check in was a breeze.   The restaurants where we needed to reserve were all amazing which is not always the case on a resort.  We went to Bana- thanks Luis for making our first meal there memorable. We also went to Market Grill- so delicious . A big shout out to Alberto and his team for   making us feel so welcome...these guys work so hard to feed us...I am eternally grateful!  Our waiter was also friendly at Vento..I'm so sorry I forgot his name but he was helping out Alberto at the Market grill one night.  Johnny at Fuego was so attentive and gracious and even made the time to celebrate and sing Happy Bday to my friend eventhough he was so busy.  Richer from Naos buffet was fantastic as well.  We had a great room with an ocean view and they made my friend's bday so special with the ballons and cake on arrival and champagne and chocolate covered strawberries! The beach had white sand and the water was a beautiful turquoise and we had a lovely waiter who served us tantalizing mamboleles!  The spa staff made us feel relaxed and at home....loved the jets and cascading falls!  A big shout out to my Argentinian hottie at the gym who gave me workout tips! A big thank you to Gloria and Maria who also were so helpful and attentive to our needs.  Overall we found the people so warm and they were happy to take a pause and chitchat with us.  They made us feel genuinely welcome.  We would go back in a new york minute!!  Thank you everyone at Paradisus for making this a vacation to remember!

reviews.author: Ferruccio TxS
reviews.title: Una settimana di puro relax
reviews.text:
Dopo playa del Carmen e il tour dello Yucatan una settimana a Cancun,in questo splendido resort
Coccolati H 24
Avevamo due persone a nostra disposizione x qualsiasi cosa taxi prenotazioni ristoranti  ecc ecc un saluto particolare a Fernanda
Buffet ottimo e abbondante 
Personale tanto è tutto cordiale
Qualità/prezzo x questa struttura invidiabile eccellente 
Buffet ottimo e abbondante
Belle camere vista super 
Spiaggia lunghissima X ottime passeggiate
Super in tutto consiglio a tutti

reviews.author: Ana Paula O
reviews.title: Drinks!
reviews.text:
Francisco and Nestor were amazing and made great drinks at Toji (the bar at Bana). I would greatly recommend coming to this bar if you are staying at Paradisus Cancun. 

The hotel overall had very welcoming service. Everyone that works here is friendly and ready to help. We absolutely loved our trip. The service was no doubt the best part!

reviews.author: Majid M
reviews.title: Another Paradisus experience
reviews.text:
I've been in Paradisus Punta cana and you can find my review over here and the Paradisus Cancun adds up the good experience that I had with this chain.Despite some bad impression when you get in Sunday afternoon the service was excellent.
There are top notch restaurants for different taste from Asian to Mexican which you can pick and enjoy.My favorite restaurant was VENTO which had great Tapas-es and nice desserts.Just be careful not to book restaurants via themselves which you would have problem with reservation later on.On the contrary of Paradisus Punta cana which is a big resort,Paradisus Cancun dosent have that land and space, therefore they built hotels and they used the height which you can see in the photos I post here.
One drawback is the night shows are at 8:30 pm which is early for some people. Because Cancun is party city and lots of  people (young) prefer to go out and use night clubs outside.It is better you go there and experience yourself and leave more information for you to catch.

reviews.author: David L
reviews.title: paradisus is a great experience
reviews.text:
The resort was very beautiful. The lobby and main entrance was amazing. The various restaurants were sprinkled throughout the main common area. There were some other restaurants in other areas. The best food was from Mole, Fuego and Market Grill. We also loved La Palapa. The Asian themed restaurants were not as good, some dishes were better than others. They also have a café and a gelato stand. The poolside food in Royal Service was very good! 

Our room was upgraded to family concierge which was bigger and more spacious but the décor was a little dated. It was clean and tidy but somewhat dated. There is a mini bar with drinks, and snacks.

Service was good. Everyone was kind, nice and tried to be helpful. The Service was not as good as it should be in that our servers kept forgetting dishes, entrees, sides, drinks, etc. It happened everywhere from the buffet, to La Palapa to the various restaurants.  Its an odd thing but if servers and management took their time to double check orders and what we are supposed to be given the service would be impeccable. They do very much try and are very kind. 

Our room was upgraded to family concierge but our bracelet/service level was upgraded to Royal Service. Because it was an upgrade we did not get a butler service. Royal service is very nice as you have your own pool, own restaurant area (La Palapa), use of the lounge with snacks and premium drinks and can use the spa facilities. I think it is about a 90 upgrade a night. Is it worth it? If you also pay for it, you get butler service with first priority to bali beds and restaurants. They also unpack and pack for you! We would definitely get that service if we were to come back.

reviews.author: ALEXBELINI
reviews.title: Estrutura e atendimento de primeira
reviews.text:
Hotel com atendimento especial, fiquei com acomodação e atendimento do sistema family concierge, o qual vale muito a pena.
Vamos por pontos.
* estrutura do hotel gigante e muito bem conservada e limpa.
* quartos otimos limpos banheiros limpos e vista sensacional
* restaurantes - O buffet que é o naos é onde serve todas as refeiçoes essa deixa um pouco a desejar. o café é muito bom, porem no jantar tente sempre reservar algum dos ala carte que por sinal são otimos, cada um com seu conceito e tipo de alimentação. tem para todos os gostos. Já o Naos no almoço tem comida bem diversificada alguns gostos diferentes do gosto brasileiro mas com tanta opção impossivel não achar algo do seu agrado!
* piscinas muito boas grandes um pouco fundas mas show.
* bar da piscina com bebidas de qualidade, as x demorava pela quantidade de pessoas mas nada que prejudicasse.
* MAIOR PROBLEMA - FALTA DE RECREAÇÃO ATIVIDADES NA PISCINA E FORA DELA E NEM UMA MUSICA DURANTE O DIA.

No mais tivemos otimos dias.
estavamos em 30 pessoas.

reviews.author: Simone Belini
reviews.title: Muito bom! Recomendo.
reviews.text: Estive no Resort por 6 noites e foi muito bom. Resort é muito lindo por dentro e por fora. Muitas opções de restaurantes não deu tempo de conhecer todos. Café da manhã muito farto e delicioso. Nossa cerimônia de casamento foi muito linda e emocionante. Nossa estadia foi maravilhosa. Vale muito a pena.

reviews.author: Michael G
reviews.title: Best workers! (Gerardo)
reviews.text: We stayed it paradises for a week and I️ was astonished by how nice and friendly the workers are. Mainly the activity workers. (Gerardo) and his crew where very fun to be with. The guys do a great job at entertaining people. 🔅🔅🔅🔅🔅

reviews.author: cjdrxjohnson
reviews.title: awesome resort- awesome staff!
reviews.text:
This was an awesome resort and worth every dollar- I wouldn't stay anywhere else in Cancun.  The restaurants are delicious - the staff is courteous- the rooms are clean the bars are fabulous and the bar tender at the Toji Bar Samuel and Edgar are the best EVER!!!!
Awesome Spa as well!

reviews.author: Kathleen N
reviews.title: Girls Getaway
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun for a weekend girl's getaway. We upgraded to the Royal Service building when we arrived at 10am, but did not receive our room until 6pm! (We were told when we checked in and paid the additional fee for the upgrade, our room would be available at 2pm.) The only thing that saved the day was the service we received from our Royal Service Pool Concierge, Jose. His professional attention and stellar service made our weekend the vacation we were looking forward to. We will definitely return to this property, our number one reason...the service from the Royal Service Pool Concierge, Jose and Carlos. Thank you for taking such great care of us. We miss you!

reviews.author: 674ayeshak
reviews.title: Superb!!!!
reviews.text: I️ have too many great things to say about my experience from the beginning to the end of my stay at Paradisus. Every staff encounter was more than professional to name a few: Autoro, the outside waiter at Naos restaurant; Alejandro H. the indoor waiter at Naos resturant; and Alejandro along with the other waiters at the poolside. There was many outstanding activities that the resort offers. I’ll definitely come back to this resort and highly recommend it to others!!!!!!

reviews.author: Olympia60
reviews.title: Wonderful time
reviews.text: From the minute we walked into the lobby of the Paradisus we were meet with a wonderful staff of people from the Concierge to check in. The lobby had beautiful flower arrangements that were changed every couple of days and the greenery that hung from each floor was well maintained, Our room was spacious and the mini bar was stocked with cold drinks, beer , water and snacks. The buffet food was delicious and never boring. We use the pool in front of the buffet restaurant and  were never without a cold beverage or any snack thanks to  our waiter Sergio Mescro who took well care of us. The entertainment was great but the  location where they performed could have been somewhere else  were we did not have to sit on the stairs going down to the beach which were hard and uncomfortable, the Michael Jackson impersonator group was fabulous. My friend and I went to the SPA which was a wonderful experience calm and soothing, we spent a couple of hours there and were never rushed to leave by the staff. We truly had a wonderful time recommend Paradisus to our friends family and 1 has already  booked it for December on our recommendation.

reviews.author: mflower275
reviews.title: Time Well Spent and Gone Too Fast!
reviews.text:
When we exited the bus, there were friendly faces awaiting us. We were offered a washcloth which had a lovely aroma. We were assisted with our luggage and upon entering the hotel, noticed how beautiful it was from the distance. 

What I loved:
-A quick and smooth check-in.
-The room was beautiful - picture perfect. 
-We had access to the snacks, soda, water in the refrigerator, 24-hour room service (for a $5 fee), unlimited food and drinks.
- Impeccable customer service.
- There was a number of restaurants on the grounds which served very tasty food.
- Housekeeping was amazing.
- Their efforts to assist us and accommodate such a large party was greatly appreciated.

What I would improve:
- There were limited channels on the TV in which most of them were in Spanish. There were only a few programs in English.
- I didn't enjoy the majority of their alcoholic beverages.

reviews.author: kimmiechr
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: Great hotel, good service and awesome food. I recommend it. Royal service was great best breakfast at La Palapa restaurant, the market place restaurant is a plus with their quality of meats and fresh. Daniel was very detailed oriented with us and gave us a great service.

reviews.author: Dimitar B
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text:
We arrived before they were expecting a hurricane to hit Cancún which never happened. Everything about our stay there was impeccable but above all I would like to recognize the very hardworking staff. Always kind and smiling. I’m impressed. Our server at night Mario did a great job. Excellent service. 
I would recommend booking the ocean view even though the lagoon view is nice too. We will be back. Thank you for the great vacation!

reviews.author: Matthew C
reviews.title: Fun memorable family getaway
reviews.text: All the best to say about the Paradisus: immaculate property, excellent service, so easy and relaxed. Just back from celebrating my mother’s 80th birthday. They accommodated our party of 12 with comfort and panache. Don’t miss Mole & Fuego restaurants...AND the swimup bar. My only criticism is the lack of AC in the common spaces.

reviews.author: Lauren L
reviews.title: Loved this hotel
reviews.text:
This hotel was excellent! We went for a wedding and were not sure what to expect and it was awesome. The location is perfect because it has a huge beach and it right on the bus route to town ($1 each way) if you wanted to leave the hotel. The food at Tempo was an extra charge but it was the best tasting menu we have ever tried. The margaritas at Blue Agave were really good and the food at Vento (tapas style) was yummy. We stayed in the Royal Service 1 bedroom ocean view suite and it was amazing. 2 balconies, 2 bathrooms, room to hang with friends and family and we really like the Royal Service bar at the bottom of the pyramid and the extra restaurant for breakfast and lunch. 

The Royal Service pool was nice and quiet and the service was excellent.  The hotel carries a nice selection of high end alcohol so you can easily find something you like. The one downside to the resort is how long it is. We had some elderly people traveling with us for the wedding and  it was hard for them to walk from one end to the other but most of the services and restaurants are right in the middle.

We will defiantly be returning to the hotel in the future!!

reviews.author: marilei2017
reviews.title: MARAVILHOSO
reviews.text: Hotel maravilhoso!!! Restaurantes ótimos... Equipe de recreação e atividades sempre muito animadas... em especial a professora de dança Andrea muito alegre, simpática.... Foi tudo perfeito!!! Recomendo...  Marilei

reviews.author: josejaimef1
reviews.title: muy buena
reviews.text: buena experiencia, el personal muy amable y atento el servicio de primera, siento que falta remodelacion en las habitaciones y el WI FI con mayor capacidad en la playa, fuera de esos dos detalles no le veo ningun problema

reviews.author: Hugo L
reviews.title: Excelente !
reviews.text:
Me hospedé anteriormente con mi familia y lo disfrute mucho, este marzo pasado volví a descansar con amigos y mi experiencia fue mucho mejor que la anterior, la comodidad de las habitaciones y el servicio dentro del hotel sobresaliente.
La bebida de primera calidad igual que la comida. Volveré !

reviews.author: Juan Camilo S
reviews.title: Muy lindas vacaciones
reviews.text:
Muy lindas vacaciones gracias a todos los meseros por sus atenciones y servicios .
Gracias a Daniel y Andrea por invitarnos siempre a realizar sus bacanas y cheveres actividades, la musica de dj. Ricardo que nos ambientaba con un excelente gusto musical.
Gracias al equipo de mantenimiento y ama de llaves por dejar nuestra habitación limpia todos los días 
Gracias por ser un equipo excelente!

reviews.author: Rac G
reviews.title: Vacaciones paradisus
reviews.text:
Un excelente hotel:
Fuimos mis amigos y yo de vacaciones y honestamente disfrutamos bastante, recomiendo el restaurante bana, market grill y blue agave, el servicio del personal es increíble, son muy amables y te intentan ayudar siempre.
El servicio de los meseros en el Pool es increíble, gracias a Faby y Alejandro por estar al pendiente de que no nos faltará nada.
La habitación muy bonita y con vista maravillosa.
Las actividades bastante entretenidas, quiero destacar el servicio y la actitud de Andrea quien fue nuestra instructora de actividades y nos dio toda la información sobre las actividades, siempre estuvo al pendiente de que se nos ofrecía y nos dio recomendaciones sobre los restaurantes bastante acertadas siempre con una sonrisa y una actitud bastante admirable!
Los shows son algo improvisados por el lugar pero son entretenidos, mis favoritos son circo y Michael Jackson.
La Pool party del sábado estuvo bastante amena gracias al DJ Ricardo por pasarnos la lista de las canciones.
En pocas palabras unas vacaciones inolvidables definitivamente vamos a volver

reviews.author: Isaac Bell
reviews.title: Excellent Stay
reviews.text: Despite a horrid rainstorm all but one day here, it was an excellent visit. The hotel ramped up the indoor entertainment and made it fun anyway. Andrea is an excellent entertainment coordinator!  In addition to taking a mixology course, they even did a very informative tequila tasting that was excellent and I don't even like tequila!

reviews.author: ritafN2849QI
reviews.title: Experiencia memorável
reviews.text: Excelente  experiência, atendimento nota mil, todos são extremamente cordiais e fazem o impulsivel para te agradar.Hotel maravilhoso, com shows incríveis, decorações belíssimas, refeições deliciosas. Muito bem frequentado, ambiente familiar e com atrações para todos os públicos.

reviews.author: R0silda
reviews.title: Tudo perfeito
reviews.text: viagem de férias com amigas, experiencia incrível. Hotel com uma mega estrutura, primeiríssima qualidade. Excelente localização, atendimento, limpeza, organização e muito conforto. Vários ambientes e muitas atividades para serem exploradas. Na parte noturna possuem festas no lounge, tudo maravilhoso!

reviews.author: Monipuviajera
reviews.title: Lo mejor: mi sesión de fotos con Outdoors Photo Family
reviews.text:
Disfruté mucho mi estadía en este hotel.  Aunque tiene muchos años, está muy bien mantenido, particularmente las zonas comunes.  La comida me gustó mucho; de los de buffet, estuve en Naos y Market Grill, ambos con buena variedad.  De los de platos a la carta estuve en Fuego y en Tempo.  En este último, corrí con la suerte de llegar un día en el que, junto con el menú de degustación regular, había degustación de champagnas.  Al final, tuvimos la oportunidad de saludar al chef quien, amablemente, salió a saludarnos.
La playa es espectacular y muy amplia, lo cual ofrece la posibilidad de tener zonas de actividades donde hay música y mucha gente, así como otras zonas más tranquilas para leer un libro o descansar.  El servicio de la piscina también es excelente pues siempre hay alguien atento a cualquier necesidad del huésped.  
Sólo mencionaría dos cosas: 1) estuve hospedada en la torre del Club Meliá en una habitación con jacuzzi en la terraza, la cual es muy amplia y clara pero creo que ya merece una remodelación (tanto la mueblería como el baño y el jacuzzi, así, como el aire acondicionado que era un poco ruidoso en la noche. 2) fui al spa por un pedicure que me pareció extremadamente costoso por lo que obtuve.  Sin embargo, estas dos cosas no opacan para nada la excelente experiencia.
Pero lo mejor de todo fue mi sesión de fotos.  El hotel cuenta con una oficina de la empresa Outdoors Photo Family.  Acordé con Gloria, la broker que me ofreció el servicio, una sesión de 15 minutos a las 5pm para tomarme un par de fotos en la playa.  Pablo, el maravilloso fotógrafo que tuve la suerte de que me asignaran, llegó súper puntual y lo que era una sesión de 15 minutos se convirtió en hora y media de diversión liderada por el profeisonalismo y la buena vibra de Pablo.  Al otro día, Dani, el encargado de ventas, tuvo toda la paciencia para esperar a que yo seleccionara las fotos para mi álbum (que evidentemente fueron mucho más que dos).  La calidad del trabajo y los tiempos de entrega, estuvieron por encima de cualquier expectativa.  El resultado fueron probablemente las mejores fotos de mi vida y el mejor recuerdo de un lindo día. 
Si tengo la oportunidad, volveré a Paradisus Cancún.

reviews.author: UARK
reviews.title: Totally Enjoyable Stay
reviews.text: The Royal Service option is the way to go.  Our personal concierge Hector was fantastic.  He anticipated your needs and followed up to make sure you are satisfied.  He really went above and beyond with our entire group.  One couple in our group had a different concierge but once Hector found out that he was MIA, Hector just folded them under his wing and took care of them also.  The food is very good and each restaurant makes dining an "experience".  Overall, a great experience and one I will remember.

reviews.author: Silvia Regina d
reviews.title: Uma semana perfeita!
reviews.text: O resort tem uma excelente estrutura. Destaque para a decoração, o jardim verde na parte interna é de encher os olhos! O hotel possui 5 pirâmides, ficamos hospedados na pirâmide 3, que é a central, onde fica a maioria dos restaurantes. Conheci os apartamentos da pirâmide 1, mas os mesmos tem na antessala uma mini cozinha, com mobiliário antigo, e totalmente desnecessária na hospedagem all inclusive. Achei os apartamentos da pirâmide 3 mais aconchegantes. A maioria dos restaurantes necessitam de reserva para o jantar, recomendo experimentar o restaurante Vento, especializado em cozinha mediterrânea, simplesmente maravilhoso! Tivemos uma semana de muito conforto e descanso no hotel! Super recomendo.

reviews.author: Kellien G
reviews.title: Great Resort Vacation
reviews.text: My best friend and I decided to spend a feq days in Cancun and we are so happy we chose Paradisus Cancun Royal Service. The hotel itself is clean, smells wonderful all the time. I think they have some essential oils in the air system. The Royal Service side is quiet and very zen. The staff is very polite and helpful. Most of them speak english so its never a problem. Royal service comes with butler services,  our butler was helpful but wouldnt say proactive in trying to assist us. We asked tbat he book our dinner reservation for the duration of our trip and asked for restaurants with seafood choices as I dont eat meat and the first two nights the reserved restaurants offered either no seafood and the other a very limited selection. That was the only thing i could say was negative. On the otber hand we spent most of our time at rhe pool/beach and the staff there is hands down the beat service we've experienced in any resort. I have to point out a few in particular that went above and beyond to make our stay special...Victor, Edier, Ricardo, Omar, Valeria and Hector. They knew what we wanted even before we did!! They offer such great swrvice and they did it with such a happy and kind demeanor, it just made our stay that much more special. Thank you!

reviews.author: DoctorFlo
reviews.title: AMAZING... ROYAL SERVICE - Where you NEED to be!!!!
reviews.text: I rarely write reviews, but while at the resort, I said I HAVE to write something. This experience was beyond!! I have traveled all over the world, and this was the BEST service I ever received. The grounds are extremely clean, and very well kept - I did notice that some of the furniture looked a little dated, but that was the minority... But more importantly, if you book here, you HAVE to book ROYAL SERVICE. I cant stress that enough. And its not even that much more... I dont have the time or patience to write down all Royal Service has to offer (it really is that much), but I will say this: We left with 6 FULL bottles of absolut vodka, rum, and tequila. These were just gifts left in our room. The premium bar was so good that, we didnt even need to open our bottles, so we took them home. Probably would have taken more if our check in bag had the space. The butler service is amazing. They book everything for you. They get your clothes ironed everyday. Personalize your pillow with whatever scent you want. Make your dinner reservations (which I hear is really hard on the regular side). The private pool area and balibeds... and my favorite - snacks and drinks delivered directly to you on your bed or WHILE IN THE POOL - just amazing. I must admit some bartenders are better than others. They have good products but you may have to direct them a little.... Anyway, the most relaxing, enjoyable time. OH, and I love to party, so I got the best of both worlds. The relaxation during the day, and turn up at night. The Red lounge was packed with people every night, and they actually played good music. The kind I listen to like Hip Hip & R&B.

reviews.author: lboogie4evr
reviews.title: Had a great time overall..
reviews.text: I can only speak from the Butler/Royal service, since that's where me and my girls stayed.  The wing of the hotel was lovely and being away from all the kids during our vacay was appreciated.  The property itself was pretty big, we often had to ask for directions to different restaurants. The pool was mostly empty and the restaurant solely for Royal Service customers was where we ate the most (La Palapa). The butler herself was seldom around and helped us maybe twice during our entire trip.  She tried to redeem herself towards the end of the trip, which was nice but we mostly had to fend for ourselves or see someone at front desk when we had requests. She was very nice though.  The lobby area in the Royal service wing was always stocked with bottled water and fresh fruit and cheese and pastries.  It was also air conditioned unlike the lobby of the main lobby, which was extremely hot and muggy at all times.  Our rooms were lovely, some had better views than others.  Ours was of a garden and had a few plants on the balcony which were long dried and dead.  The beds were comfy and the bathroom was modern.  In the morning we thought the power had gone out after we had a hard time putting the lights on only to discover that there's a switch to turn all the electricity on in the room. I felt like someone should've mentioned that at check in, that it would happen daily. We tried many of the restaurants but not all.  The buffet, Naos, was mediocre. Enso had a nice ambiance, but the only food we liked were the spring rolls.  Everything else was mediocre at best. The Brazilian restaurant Market Grille, was great, the food was flavorful and they kept it coming.  It had some beautiful outdoor seating, that was nice when the heat was bearable. Blue Agave was a small Mexican restaurant that I liked a lot. La Palapa had an amazing view of the ocean, and had a little of everything on their menu and a bar adjacent to the pool, which made it a favorite of mine.  Mole' was a fancy Latin restaurant where the food was pretty decent, depending on what you got.  The vibe was awesome in this place, they had a live mariachi band playing at times, and even took requests. We had a problem with the maitre'd at Vento, though, because he couldn't find our reservation, even though we made them all a day in advance (which I highly recommend for dinner) and they were very rude about it.  After all the fuss, I disliked the food so much, I wish I hadn't gone in the first place. There was an outdoor BBQ that looked really nice, but we were unaware of it. I would try and make a reservation for that next time, not sure of the name, but it was right outside of Market Grill.  The nightlife was almost non-existent at this resort after dinner everything was pretty quiet, even the pool on the Royal service wing closed early,  there was maybe one 'show' a night, but they were all in the lobby area that was too hot to bear, even at night. We visited the Red Lounge the first night, very small and hot also. The DJ was surprisingly good and since we didn't have plans that night we just accepted the fact that it would be a sweat box and enjoyed the music. Bottom line, I had a good time, and would prob return but would def return to Royal service.  Also, if you walk the beach, all the other hotels are lined up, which I liked. Different vendors and water sports to choose from and shop for the best price.

reviews.author: sfppn5
reviews.title: Best place to go
reviews.text:
We went to Cancun with friends and family it was a great time I can't explain how great the staff was especially the staff in the restaurant.  Alberto,Vincent and Orlando were the best they went out of there way to  make sure we had everything we needed and if they didn't have it they made sure to try and get it and go out of there way for us this really makes a difference when you have great service like this we looked forward to seeing them ever morning and after noon for breakfast and lunch.  Food was amazing I would defiantly recommend this place to anyone and look out for these guys they will make your stay feel like your important  VIP 😀guest trust me 

Sincerely
A yearly traveler

reviews.author: Fabiola8587
reviews.title: Reencuentro con mi maestra de Primaria
reviews.text:
Fui a visitar a mi querida Maestra que se hospedo ahi y lo que mas me encanta es su atrio me encanta. 
El servicio  desde la entrada es muy bueno, aunque no consumi nada lme gusto mucho ir alla.
Pude percatarme de las habitaciones son pequeñas, no muy confortables pero  me gustaron.

reviews.author: 721akina
reviews.title: AK
reviews.text:
Fantastic and memorable. The rooms, pool area, access to beach, food, drink and attentive nature of staff were of the highest standard. Wanted to stay for the whole summer.
The staff make you feel welcome and looked after the whole time. Once they have an idea what you like they tailor the service to your needs very effectively

reviews.author: endlessbeachdays
reviews.title: Amazing resort. Outstanding service!
reviews.text: Had an absolutely amazing stay at the Paradisus.It was a girl friends trip. We stayed in Royal Service. It had been 25 years since I was in Cancun, alot of changes since then!  What really made this hotel stand out was the outstanding service. Hector our butler was very attentive, checking on us regularly to be sure our stay was going well and promptly took care of any of our requests. Joel and Valerie, our servers at La Papala provided excellent service and friendly conversation with lunch each day. Moise the bartender in Royal Service would have our drinks ready as soon as he saw us and have them refilled before we were ever empty. Carlos the pool went concierge went  above and beyond to make sure we were well taken care. He truly made our stay amazing and can't thank him enough for all he did. We enjoyed the entire staff, everyone was friendly and thoughtful. The resort is beautiful, the food is very good and the beach is stunning. You will not be disappointed staying here!

reviews.author: Stacey N
reviews.title: Girls trip
reviews.text: We had an amazing time! The service was great! Anything you need and want the staff will try and help you. Rosanna was our butler and was fantastic! The pool decking in the royal service area was being upgraded so it caused some disruption but other than that the resort was really nice! My food was great to. Definitely would return.

reviews.author: Pam A
reviews.title: Paradisus se defiende teniendo el mejor servicio
reviews.text: Paradisus es un hotel viejo y poco a poco lo van reparando y remodelándolo pero siendo en si tan grande es obviamente muy difícil. Lo que lo hace resaltar es el servicio que le ofrecen a sus clientes. Esta fue mi segunda vez en este hotel. La vez pasada tuve una mal experiencia llegando al hotel porque el check-in tardó horas! Esta vez todo fue súper rápido y eficaz. El check-out también fue rapidísimo que ni tuve que ir a recepcion! Todos los empleados hicieron hasta lo imposible por hacer nuestra estancia cómoda. Mi esposo llego enfermo y nuestra valet genuinamente se preocupó y nos dijo donde estaba el médico y la farmacia. La comida también estuvo excelente en todos los restaurantes. El que más me gustó fue mole. Nuestro mesero fue Cristian. Bueno, creo que a todo quien lea este review les tengo que recomendar que vayan a conocer a Cristian. Es una gran persona que hace con orgullo su trabajo y se nota. Su sabiduría de las clases de mezcal y tequila nos dejó impresionados. Su amabilidad y paciencia no tienen comparación. Todo mundo se porto súper bien con nosotros pero Cristian, mis respetos.

reviews.author: Nate L
reviews.title: Solid Choice
reviews.text:
Spent 4  nights with friends. Food was pretty good. Good location on the beach. We paid for Royal Service but didn't see all that much difference (quiet tower, quiet pool, small bar in our own tower, the RS snack buffet was meh). So if you want those things, pay for it. Other pool was more active. We wouldn't have
 minded hanging out in either pool. 

Rooms were pretty nice. I was pleasantly surprised. 

Heard some complaints about check-in taking a lot of time. Was pretty quick for us but we checked in at around 4pm. So don't expect to be able to check-in at any of the Cancun resorts early. They are all pretty well booked in the Summer. 

All in all, we were all very happy with the stay. We felt like we got what we paid for.

reviews.author: Wgwhitley
reviews.title: What a great time we had!!!
reviews.text:
This was my first trip to Cancun, Mexico and what a wonderful experience it was.  My daughter took me on this trip as a Mother's Day gift.  It was four ladies in our group.  We were there 6-10 Jul 2017. We were in Rooms 5118 and 5121. 
The rooms were very comfortable and beautiful.  I must say from the very start it was awesome.  Starting with the Concierge person name Roberto, who made us feel so welcome and he was extremely patience with us and all our questions.  The Royal Service Lounge employee named Orlando was accommodating to our needs, making sure our food and drinks were to our taste.  
He always serviced us with a great smile and excellent service.  In addition, I would like to mention two other employees named Joel and Eddie from the La Palapa Restaurants. The service we got from Joel was excellent. I wish I could bottle Joel's and Eddie's hard work and enthusiasm in a bottle and take it back to the United States with me.  They made sure our every needs were met, while we were at the Beach Bali Beds and at La Palapa Restaurants and the Royal Service Lounge.  The last person I must mention is Mars.  Her English was exceptional and she made us feel very comfortable using our broken Spanish.  She was very informative and helpful to us with any situation that we needed help in.  I will absolutely recommend this hotel to all of my friends. We will definitely be back in 2018. Your employees are some of the best we've seen.  Although this was my first visit  it was my daughter's fourth time in Cancun and even she agreed with me that the Paradisus is among the very best.

Thank you, 

Wanda Whitley - Room 5118

reviews.author: diegocD8109YT
reviews.title: Es un hotel más familiar y de parejas, es mas tranquilo
reviews.text: Es un hotel muy bonito, grande, tiene varios restaurantes, variedad de comidas, bebidas, todos son muy amables y atentos. Es un hotel más que todo para familias y parejas, para pasarlo muy tranquilo y relajado, con mucha paz y alegría.

reviews.author: Peter Mark K
reviews.title: Fantastic Hotel
reviews.text:
This hotel blew me away upon arrival , it's very impressive on the outside and inside things just get better .
Admit we stayed in newly refurbished rooms , the beds were just amazing , staff are a credit to the hotel .
In all it was a privilege to stay here .
Can't say more than that .

reviews.author: teeny2012
reviews.title: Great hotel stay
reviews.text: The Paradisus Cancun is beautiful. My room was a little outdated but it was clean. The hotel itself was immaculate. The staff were very friendly and accommodating. The food was good at the buffet and the presentation was nice. It was actually better at the buffet then some of the restaurants . The beach and pool areas were well-kept and beautiful. I would definitely stay here again or recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Benita C
reviews.title: Girls week
reviews.text:
We enjoyed this resort!  Lots to do in Cancun and we did a couple of excursions but at the middle of the week, I just wanted to stay on the beach.  Pools were nice too.  Service was mostly good.  Had to get a little aggressive at the pool side cafe. They didn't make eye contact but were friendly once I caught their attention.  The restaurants were each great in a different way and the service was exceptional.  They often brought out items just to try.  The buffet was also good. 

I could do without the incense at night.  Ugh.  Other than that it was a very relaxing week!

reviews.author: Wayne E
reviews.title: Milestone birthdays in Cancun
reviews.text:
I went with 5 girlfriends celebrating 50 and 60 year birthdays. We had 3 rooms and the hotel was able to get us altogether. We had a lagoon view on the third floor where we enjoyed amazing views of the sunset each night. 
  Check in and out were a little slow but they give you a cold beer while you wait! 
The food did not give anybody stomach problems. Our favorites were Mole and Fuego. 
Breakfast buffet at the Market Grill each morning where we were treated like princesses by Martin and Fernando. Beach side our waiter Sofiano was great, bringing numerous Mojitos and buckets of ice cold bottled water. I enjoyed an amazing massage in the spa with Justina and a water aerobics class led by "Magic Mike". We also saw the Michael Jackson show, very entertaining with Cirque de soleii quality dancers. 
 The resort is dated but it is also charming, kind of like going to Mexico in college!
 ( in the 80's!) Our room was comfortable, the lobby and open areas are not air conditioned but most of the time you could find a refreshing breeze.  
We went on a snorkle and Isla Contoy excursion. Great! Jauquin at the concierge desk was very helpful in setting this up. It was a nice break to do something different and see more of the area. Next time I want to do the underground cave trip.  
Our four night trip was under $1,000.00 including airfare from Houston. I think we definitely got our moneys worth!!

reviews.author: Liana N
reviews.title: 5 restaurantes para experimentar
reviews.text:
O Paradisus é um resort familiar mas excelente para viagens com amigos ou românticas. Eu fui com uma amiga e aproveitamos 100% do hotel. 
O café-da-manhã é excepcional e cada noite jantávamos em um restaurante diferente. 3 restaurantes dos 5 já estão inclusos no sistema do resort. O restaurante com comidas mexicanas fica aberto até tarde da noite, onde passávamos para beliscar após curtirmos a noite na cidade.
Os apartamentos com varanda são um must para ficar relaxando no fim do dia e à noite. 
A piscina fica cheia durante o dia, porém é possível nadar também à noite.

reviews.author: Miranda S
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, great food, dated air conditioning
reviews.text:
Paradisus is an absolutely stunning resort with amazing a la carte restaurants with delicious food. The resort is mainly for couples and a few families. It is beautiful, romantic and not too crowded. The staff are wonderful and make your stay definitely worth your while

Pros
- great restaurants, lots of variety and yummy food
- beautiful hotel (definitely one of the better resorts)
- great value for money
- romantic!
- amazing staff, very friendly and helpful (besides front desk) 
- well kept beach
- fun bar staff that can make you lots of fun cocktails if you ask!
- great fitness classes! Our fave was Coach Martin, he's a great trainer and super enthusiastic. Makes getting up every morning at 9 am on your holiday worth it!
- Yhi spa, fantastic massages and beautiful serene setting. You definitely get spoilt here! 
- all inclusive includes mini bar access and room service, which was fantastic service! 

Cons
- Air conditioning is dated in the rooms, very noisy and gushes out a loud stream of air. We had a lagoon room facing the sun in the afternoon, and it was boiling hot. The coolest the room could cool down to was 27 degrees C, with the AC on high the whole day. We changed rooms to a different side of the hotel and the coolest the room could get down to was 25 degrees C. 
Most of the restaurants and bars are also not air conditioned, and so can be quite hot and sticky. Granted we went to Cancun during a very hot time, but there wasnt enough ventilation or fans to make up for the heat, even at night!
- not a great party life if that is what you're after. The resort is very couples oriented. A few families around, but great for couples! There is no night time activity/ parties after 9:30 pm. 
- Front desk seems a bit stressed and uninterested to help

Overall: beautiful resort, would highly recommend if air conditioning is not a big issue for you! Great food and staff overall

reviews.author: Olga M
reviews.title: It could have been excellent if air condition the  in room would have been fixed and
reviews.text: If there would have been a/c in the DISCO. In all areas ac should improve and thereshould be some shows with a mexican flavor. We asked for a king bed and it was not available. The ENZO REST is not good at all.

reviews.author: 254Ronald254
reviews.title: Lindo Hotel
reviews.text: Un bello hotel , excepto por la comida que no fué de mi agrado.Las instalaciones muy completas y en realidad se pasa bién no entiendo el fallo con la comida.Queda en una zona céntrica desde donde uno se desplaza en taxi adonde quiera que además son muy baratos .

reviews.author: michaelgP2554FY
reviews.title: Great Hotel & Service
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus as a group of friends. The service was great, Eduardo, our butler was exceptional and really took care of us. The facilities were great, genuine alcohol brands are served, the food quality varies from average to good depending on the restaurants. The pool cabanas were great to relax, and the waiting staff there are great and looked after us very well. Overall, a great hotel, with good value for money.

reviews.author: wanttobetheir
reviews.title: another great time
reviews.text: We stayed at another resort for awhile then came to my friends time share both great. But this resort a small step above. From the service, food, and room were great. The swimup bar, and service on beach awesome. Gym keep us from gaining to much weight thank you. Fun resort lots to do 4th time and won't be the last. Thanks  Doug  (UT)

reviews.author: Estefnaz
reviews.title: Hermoso Hotel Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
Esta fue la segunda vez que tengo la oportunidad de visitar este hotel, en lo personal a mi me encanta esa sensación  de estar al aire libre y eso de las cortinas de plantas, el restaurante entre arboles,fuentes,iluminación de día y de noche me parece muy muy bonito, de igual manera los sillones en varios puntos te hacen sentir que estas en la sala de tu casa, en lo personal a mi me gusta.
Las dos veces que fui las habitaciones estaban impecables. El servicio en general por parte de los colaboradores es muy bueno sin embargo me gustaría recalcar el trato que recibimos por parte de ANDRES en el área de CAFÉS Y DONAS, las dos veces que he ido nos ha dado un servicio de lo mas cordial,amable, cálido, siempre sonriendo y dándonos una afectuosa bienvenida, interactuando con la gente y dándonos información de otras áreas, como horarios etc. en fin , se ve que le gusta su trabajo. El room service esta muy bien.
Que bueno que agregaron el servicio de crepas y helados!
Como algunas sugerencias yo diría colocar mas botes de basura, quise tirar una servilleta y no encontré bote hasta que fui al baño. Que por cierto que bueno que usan papel de buena calidad,tanto de manos como higiénico, menos desperdicio.
La piscina principal es grande y larga, creo que seria buena idea poner una red de volleyball acuático, no se por que no usan micrófono para anunciar los happenings que hay durante el día, solo empiezan. creo que se le podría sacar mas provecho a esa área para que sea mas entretenida, sin embargo esto no es una queja solo es un comentario de una persona joven. La primera vez que fui visite el kids club y es bonito  se ve que tienen varias actividades solo que los curiosos no somos realmente bienvenidos supongo que es por la misma seguridad de los niños, tiene sentido.
EL hotel me encanta si tengo la oportunidad lo visitaría otra vez, lo recomiendo para la gente que busca relajarse.

reviews.author: akj0902
reviews.title: Great stay at the Paradisus Royal Service
reviews.text:
My friends and I visited Cancun last month for four days for our best friend's hen/bachelorette. We initially booked to stay at the ME, but was relocated last minute to Paradisus because the renovations at ME had not completed in time. We were very unhappy initially to be moved to Paradisus as it is known to be a 'family hotel', which is not really the atmosphere we wanted for a bachelorette. 

With the hope of having a more 'adult friendly' experience we booked the Royal Service , which was the adults only section. I would highly recommend this to anyone travelling without a family. The service is amazing and it really made a huge difference to our trip. I don't think we would have had as much fun without it.

The hotel itself was lovely, with beautiful rainforest type décor inside. The staff were very friendly and helpful, and even upgraded one of our rooms for free so that our two rooms could be near each other. 

The location of the hotel was good. Without traffic it would have taken about 10minutes to get to the main strip, but we weren't forewarned about the crazy traffic, and on one night it took us 1 hour + to do that distance! There was a taxi rank outside the hotel but unfortunately we couldn't book the taxis in advance and had to queue, so often there was a 10-15minute wait for a taxi.

Royal Service

When we arrived at the hotel we were introduced to our butler, Erik. Right from the start he was friendly and helpful and was willing to go above and beyond to make our stay as comfortable as possible. He stocked our rooms with our preferred alcohol (tequila, vodka and champagne), made dinner reservations at our preferred restaurants for our whole stay, booked us bali beds in the Royal Service pool area for 2 days, and checked us in for our return flights.
