He even went to the shop and bought my friend some nail polish remover! We were able to contact him on Whatsapp for anything we needed and he would reply almost instantly. Erik made our trip so easy and enjoyable and would recommend asking for him directly. 

The best part of Royal Service was the privacy. We had our own adults only pool and beach area, along with a lovely beach club restaurant which served amazing food and drink. All the waiters were so helpful and friendly. There was a separate check in for the Royal Service, although when we arrived and left the main check in area was empty, so that didn't save us much time. 

The pool area with bali beds was gorgeous and it was almost empty every day which was quite nice for quiet relaxation. Being on a bachelorette it was also great to be able to swim/lounge/drink without children screaming and jumping in the pool! Whilst there was a DJ for a couple of hours on our final day, there wasn't any music at the pool otherwise, which would have been a nice addition. The general pool area was beautiful and much bigger, but we didn't end up spending any time there. 

The beach was one of the most beautiful beaches I have been to in my life- and literally a 10 second walk from the pool. There were also always sun loungers available.

Food

Room service 

The first meal we had was from 24 hour room service, as we arrived very late on a Thursday. The food from room service was the worst food I have ever eaten. I cannot explain how disappointed we were, and were desperately praying that it wasn't an indication of the food in the restaurants. The tortilla chips were stale, the chips/French fries were cold and dry (as if they had been cooked days ago and then microwaved), the chicken was dry, the pizza base was raw with sloppy toppings and the nachos cheese was bright orange- like you get in the cinema. We couldn't even eat it. Out of sheer desperation on another night we ordered again after returning from a club- and despite asking them to make sure they gave us 'fresh' food, it was the same. We presume this is because they want to encourage people to eat in the restaurants!! Would recommend staying away from room service if you can.

La Palapa

This is the beach club restaurant exclusive to Royal Service. It was a pleasant surprise, especially after our room service nightmare the night before. Best guacamole and (non-stale) tortilla chips I've ever had. Also loved the seafood pasta. Nice light food and good service.

Bana

This was the pan-asian/sushi restaurant. Absolutely loved this place, delicious food and the setting and decor was gorgeous. Would recommend this for sure.

Mole

Traditional Mexican food- not what we expected but we loved it. Delicious flavours and great service. 

Blue Agave

This was a Mexican restaurant where we ate Tacos (very different to the tacos we have previously eaten) and quesadillas. We weren't thrilled by this restaurant which was disappointing as this was our leaving meal.

Breakfast buffet

There was a separate Royal Service breakfast buffet, but the choice wasn't huge. However we visited the general Buffet one morning, and although limited, the food in the Royal Service buffet was definitely better. We didn't really enjoy the general buffet and the food didn't taste very fresh.

Rooms

The rooms were slightly disappointing as they were not very 'luxurious' and could do with some modernisation. 

Beds were very comfy and the hotel provided slippers and robes which were nice. There was also a safe in the room. One thing that was slightly frustrating is that the hairdryer provided was very old and basic- we didn't bring our own as we presumed the 5* hotel would provide a decent hairdryer. So girls, bring your own!

In terms of the location of our room (5th floor lagoon view), it quite far from the exit, so we spent around 10 minutes getting from our room to the taxi stand which we thought was quite long. 

Spa

We visited the spa on our final day, and it was lovely. There was a decent sized hydrotherapy pool which was very relaxing. The décor and ambience was also lovely.

We each had a 50 minute massage by the pool, and although pricey (we spent £80 per massage which included a $50 discount), it was one of the best massages I have ever had (and I have had many!). Would 100% recommend Lola- she works magic!

All in all, we had a great trip. Loved the hotel but I think that was mainly due to the Royal Service and Erik. Being all inclusive was nice too as didn't have to worry about carrying money around- although the waiters did expect tips so we did have to take some with us. Not sure if I would come back to the hotel if not staying in Royal Service, so would recommend those travelling as a couple/without children to consider upgrading- it is worth it.

reviews.author: Cidacarvalho10
reviews.title: Hotel espetacular
reviews.text: Hotel com excelente localização e acesso fácil aos principais pontos turísticos da cidade. A decoração dos ambientes do hotel é maravilhosa. Quarto grande e arejado com camas muito confortáveis. A vista da varanda do quarto é inesquecível. O atendimento é impecável por parte de todos os empregados do hotel. Destaco o excelente atendimento do garçom Alberto no restaurante Naos. A comida é outro ponto muito forte do hotel, variada, farta  e deliciosa. A piscina é maravilhosa com água de temperatura extremamente agradável. A praia é simplesmente inesquecível. O atendimento dos garçons na piscina e na praia é excelente. Super recomendo e já estou com muita vontade de voltar.

reviews.author: paulina761
reviews.title: Amazing Cancun Experience with Paradisus
reviews.text: This was my first all-inclusive experience and I have no complaints. The staff, food, service and hospitably were amazing and went beyond expectations. Daniel, Jorge, Denger, Omar and all staff were super polite, accommodating and made our stay memorable.

reviews.author: Paige M
reviews.title: Perfect vacation
reviews.text:
Everything about this resort was wonderful ! Went for 4 days and wish we went for longer. 

The hotel is just stunning ! They take amazing care of the property, workers are always cleaning the grounds and service was very fast. 

We had a lagoon view and it was so beautiful, our room was always clean and always stocked. Beds were comfortable. Our room seemed slightly warm and a/c wouldn't go down past 65. 

The beach was very clean, life guards are always out watching. It wasn't too busy so we always had a spot to sit under an umbrella, but people do go early and reserve spots. 

Food was amazing ! We ate at 2 a la cartes: Bana (which should be #1 on everyones list of to do's) and wow this place was delicious !!! And Vento which we weren't the biggest fans of only because we didn't realize the style of meals were to get multiple small orders and share the portions. Buffet was so great ! In our group there were 2 vegans and a vegetarian and we were all very well fed, options for everyone ! 

Short ride to airport as well, around 15-20 minutes. 

Highly recommend and will be returning in the future !

reviews.author: danielly963
reviews.title: Muito bom
reviews.text: o Hotel é lindo, piscina muito boa , porem tem q acordar cedo p pegar cadeira perto da piscina,  o hotel é all inclusive mas tem umas diferenças para quem tem o clube de associados deles, algumas bebidas  mais caras nao estao disponiveis para todos, falta cardapio de Drink nos bares, nenhum tem ,  pra quem nao conhece muitos drinks é ruim.caipirinha deles é bem diferente da nossa, nao é boa. a boate deveria ter mais isolamento acustico pq as vezes voce acorda no meio da noite com barulho da boate. comida nao é muito voltada para brasileiros, apesar de ter um que serve rodizio de carne tipo churrasco a noite, o churrasco brasileiro da de 10 nele rs vai ser muito dificil voce achar um arroz com feijao, entao logo vc enjoa de comer hamburguer e bacon . vale a pena conhecer eu recomendaria 4 dias no maximo pq enjoa e o hotel é um pouco longe do centro onde tem os bares e baladas

reviews.author: Bessie M
reviews.title: If u want activities and variety of restratuants this is not the place.
reviews.text: Would not stay here again. Front desk staff not friendly. Did nothing to accommodate for room mix up. Maids never left enough wash clothes or towels. Not enough space for most guest to attend shows had to sit on steps outside.

reviews.author: roro2102
reviews.title: Please do not stay anywhere else... Paradisus is the best!
reviews.text:
One of the best resorts with amazing staff and brilliant food! I went there with 5 other friends and I can say it is one of the most amazing holiday I ever had. As a vegetarian i didn't struggle with the food, there were always so many options. Additionally, the dive centre inside and across the road makes this deal more sweet. We booked Junior Suite with the adults only section and it was really good.

I hope you go there lie by the pool whole day, enjoy their mango ice cream, have pina coladas, have dinner at one of the exclusive dinner places (they have some 7 or 9 I forgot places) and then go to the club xxx

I wish I was there

reviews.author: MarcGarciaHallam
reviews.title: Relaxing and pampered.
reviews.text: This is one of my favorite vacations and not just because it is the most recent. The food was good (some restaurants far better than others), the quality for what we paid was far more than I expected, the staff is trained impeccably and had knowledge of activities outside of the resort and the pool/beach areas were very well-managed with a relaxing atmosphere even when they were at their peak with foot traffic.

reviews.author: Vahiide
reviews.title: Best ever
reviews.text: That was one of my best holidays i had in Paradisus the resort is great the people there are great special thank to Brenda who made with us the salsa lesson and to antonio for the best icecoffee you people are great come to visit you again. The service and the foot is excellent and in one word everything is great❤️❤️

reviews.author: Jennifer C
reviews.title: Great Choice For Couples & Families!
reviews.text: My sister and I are both in our early 20's. we came to this resort during our spring break the first week of march, and we opted for the royal service upgrade. the resort itself is stunning and very well maintained, the rooms are spacious and beautiful, the beach is breathtaking and the service is impecable. however, this resort caters mainly to couples and families. i wouldn't recommend this resort to young, single people because you'll get really bored. the red lounge which is their only nightclub was pretty much dead every night so if you wanna have a fun night out you have to go out of the resort to the main strip which is not too far and it's super fun.  we visited most of the restaurants which were all pretty good, we also loved the 24hr room service. we absolutely loved the VIP treatment that comes with royal service, the exclusive royal service pool and the Bali beds. our butler Eric was amazing and tried to help us with everything we needed. overall this resort is beautiful and i'd highly recommend it to couples and families who are looking to relax, we feel like it wasn't the right choice for us and wish there was more entertainment and fun.

reviews.author: Vika P
reviews.title: Good old - fashioned hotel
reviews.text: Have spend 7 days in that lovey hotel!Yes exactly -  hotel is really lovely,nice design with jungles inside of piramide,but it has really old managment!Food isnt good,from all la carte restaurants - brazilian was good!Others was awful!Beach is pretty good but sea is very wavy!Entertaiment is poor.Very talanted people but cant show their own ability but make american clone!Was sad....

reviews.author: Boris T
reviews.title: отдыхайте друзья отдыхайте
reviews.text: выбирал долго но попал в цель.отдыхали с друзьями с начала мая неделю.прекрасный отель начиная от места расположения середина косы.интерьер превосходный все сделано с большим вкусом.работа персонала четка и не навязчива но без нариканий.номера брали простые но они большие комфортабельные.уборка во время т.е. во время нашего отсутствия.еда-основной ресторан  места всегда есть свободные .еда на все на все вкусы от мексиканской до европейской.выбор впечатляет.много фруктов соков.есть альтернативные без доп оплаты.были в гриль и в европейской кухне-вкусно при этом наливают то что просишь.ассортимент выгодно отличается от турции.вина виски вкл бурбоны ханнеси и т.д. любые коктейли.три бассейна один из них в вип зоне при них бары.но места надо занимать от 7 утра взяв полотенца накануне.полотенца выдают свободно и сколько хочешь.море отлично но были сильные волны сбивало с ног и большей части висел красный флаг.но в бассейне вода без хлорки и тепленькая.вечером есть шоу работают бары в самом отели.много молодежи.вообще контингент молодой.по моему все описал оценка 5 5 5 5  5

reviews.author: clarag951
reviews.title: Best Birthday Ever
reviews.text: This resort was by far more than I could ask for. The service was excellent, the food, the atmosphere. Strongly recommend the ocean view. For a relaxing time go to Yhi spa. The only down fall there's not much of a night life.

reviews.author: Rachel M
reviews.title: It's not great and it's not terrible.
reviews.text: I don't have anything bad to say about the Paradisus. The staff was always wonderful, especially Jesus at the pool bar. But I have stayed at several resorts in the Cancun area (Rui Peninsula, Now, Secrets) and all are relatively close in price range and all are better in quality. The beach is gorgeous at this resort, but the beach is gorgeous everywhere in Cancun. I never had outstanding food but I never had bad food, it was always just ok. The mixed drinks were very weak but the bartenders were very happy to provide alcohol when asked. It appears to be an older resort that some of the newer places are just passing up in respect to modernness. For the price it's nice for a few days.

reviews.author: ashley d
reviews.title: Love
reviews.text:
Loved everything about this place 
Everybody was nice very helpful and over all very welcoming will definitely be going back to this place it was worth every penny. I'm in my 20's and went with friends

reviews.author: Darine N
reviews.title: My Cancun first experience
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my stay at Paradisus...Very well located, luxurious hotel and many amenities.Too bad our stay was too short in Cancun that we couldnt take the opportunity to try the spa and the many restaurants in the resort.

reviews.author: S.Cristina
reviews.title: EXCELENTE!!
reviews.text:
Estivemos no Paradisus  Cancun  no começo de maio, fomos em um grupo de 7 casais, adoramos!!
Muitas opções de restaurantes (gastronomia farta), bebidas variadas e a vontade, serviço de praia ótimo! Funcionários excelentes, muito bem treinados, todos dispostos a ajudar e muito simpáticos. Faço aqui um elogio particular ao rapaz que fica no   Conner Coffee (Não me lembro o nome dele), que simpatia, sempre de bom humor, servindo e interagindo com todos. 
Limpeza nota 10! Cama muito boa e roupa de cama de excelente qualidade! Procurem ficar nos blocos próximos  da recepção, pois o hotel é muito grande e terá que andar muito sempre que for para os restaurantes e praia! 
Com certeza voltaria!!

reviews.author: Meg K
reviews.title: Fun with friends!
reviews.text: So relaxing and easy. We had a stress free wonderful vacation. Very much enjoyed the Royal Service! So nice to have the adults only section which had direct access to the beach, a nice pool, delicious food and soaking tubs, too.

reviews.author: Elizabeth D
reviews.title: Super voyage
reviews.text: Cet hôtel est au top un service excellent et très courtois et très propre et on a spécialement beaucoup apprécié le service très professionnel et très gentil de Alan qui était à l'arrière du bar du restaurant de sushi il fait de super bon drink et  de très bonne compagnie !!! Et pour les restaurants on a beaucoup apprécié le resto Enso et avec le très bon service de Alberto et de carlo ...cette hôtel c'est dur que j'y retourne il mérite un 5 étoile! Merci pour les belles vacances

reviews.author: Julie N
reviews.title: great value all-inclusive!
reviews.text:
We had an oceanfront room with a gorgeous view! The staff was amazing, especially Martin Andrade, the fitness instructor (thank you for all the tough classes so I did not gain weight on this vacation!) and Veronica in the Yhi spa (fantastic massage.)
The food was good, the wine OK, I heard the tequila was great! We enjoyed the entertainment and the activities under the stars. Wish we could have stayed longer than 5 nights!

reviews.author: Carol W
reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: We stayed here after the Mei wasn't complete.  What a treat!  The rooms and bathrooms were very nice in the royal service area.  The staff was wonderful, very nice and accommodating.  We typically stay at Sandals properties so I do have to say I prefer not having to tote around money for tips.  That being said my recommendation to anyone staying at this property is to make sure you take plenty of small bills with you.  It is very difficult to get change for tips.   Overall the resort and beach were wonderful!!  The street tacos at the Blue Agave for lunch are a MUST have so don't miss them!  We will definitely come back here at some point.

reviews.author: OneLoveFitGirl
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, fantastic (royal) service!
reviews.text:
Decided on a quick 3 night adults only get away with only a month and half to plan it. Started research and was worried we were going to have to switch to playa or not adults only...fortunately I ran across this place and they were having a sale. We did Royal service with a group of 8. If you read my reviews you will see most of our travels are in Jamaica so my only complaint is that Cancun water is just too rough to enjoy and relax in. But I knew that going in so can't really complain. The hotel was fantastic. Incredible service, food, drinks, butlers (Daniel was awesome), Bali bed service (Moses was great as were the others). Really can't think of anything to complain about. Even with a group of 8 we were able to get weekend reservations. First Thai/Asian place, then market grill, then tapas. Every place served us family style so we could all share and not choose one entree. Loved that!! I will say they definitely want you to drink tequila/shots lol. 
We walked by the entertainment one night and weren't impressed but the red lounge was jamming and we entertained ourselves. 
Our room faced the lagoon because ocean side was sold out. Still an excellent room. Our friends ocean front suite was incredible with 2 different verandahs and a sitting room and 2 bathrooms! 
No regrets about choosing this hotel at all. I never had a chance to ask about purchasing the oils they diffuse throughout the resort, but this place smells INCREDIBLE!

reviews.author: Iluvacas
reviews.title: Bana with vero
reviews.text: Bana is amazing mUst get the Yalu son with shrimp. Veronica is the best waitress ever!!! Everything was delicious and on time. The most beautiful restaurant. Flowers and leaves from ceiling to floor! Take your pictures at night when everything lights up

reviews.author: simonekris10
reviews.title: Hotel Perfumado!!!
reviews.text: Adorei o hotel. Começando pelo lobby, todo perfumado, não dá vontade de sair de lá! Tudo impecavelmente limpo, lindo, luxuoso. As piscinas são muito boas, em frente ao mar. Fiz apenas um passeio, porque o hotel é tão completo que preferi ficar e aproveitar ao máximo. Os restaurantes são ótimos. Pretendo voltar com certeza.

reviews.author: Hzorzi
reviews.title: Procure outras opções de hotel em Cancun!!
reviews.text: Foi o pior hotel all inclusive que já estive hospedado em Cancun. Infraestrutura antiga, funcionários mal educados - inclusive no Royal Service que era para ser o serviço mais exclusivo. Não recomendo!

reviews.author: Kalinda W
reviews.title: AMAZING!!!!!
reviews.text:
[This review is long overdue- I visited in January 2016. I published this as an article on my LinkedIn account, however, it sat in my drafts and it never actually made it to TripAdvisor] 

On a trip to Cancun, Mexico early this year, I had the privilege of enjoying all-inclusive accommodations at the beautiful Paradisus Cancun Resorts. In addition to providing a well-deserving 5-star review on TripAdvisor, I am compelled to share my experience on LinkedIn as it attests to what I deem to be exemplary customer service and hospitality. I understand what it takes to provide exemplary hospitality, so I truly appreciate when I witness service excellence. 

From the time my plane landed at Cancun International Airport, to the day of my departure...I felt like a VIP! The shuttle driver entertained us with jokes and singing, and even shared cost-saving tips for getting around the town. Thankfully, my travel companion spoke fluent Spanish which helped in situations where the English language was not as common. We were greeted at Paradisus with smiles and bottled water. Most of the staff knew our names (AMAZING- given that this resort could have its own zipcode). Paradisus maintained a continuity of service that left me feeling like the entire town of Cancun knew that I had arrived. Yes! I was repeatedly blown away. 

One might say "Well, isn't that their job...they are supposed to be amazing in Cancun!" Well, don't we all get paid to be amazing?! It seemed as if each team member absolutely loved their job. It is not a job if you love what you do though, right? Their smiles, laughter, camaraderie with guests, and sense of ownership was commendable. 

One afternoon while being serviced at our cabana, our waiter (who I adopted as family) asked if our room were okay [Pause. He was a waiter; not in charge of housekeeping or front desk duties]. Without much thought, I mentioned that our A/C was leaking water on the floor. The floor in our suite was marble, so it could potentially end badly on a night that includes margaritas and/or Coronas. Since we ARE in Mexico and condensation is most likely a common problem, I would have been completely fine with a few extra towels for the puddle. To my surprise, we returned to our suite that evening with a note that the repair had been made. Wow!

The experience above was just one of several instances where "AMAZING" happened. While venturing downtown Cancun into the vibrant nightlife, a street promoter pulled a calculator from his back pocket to give me a crash course in converting US dollars to Pesos. (FYI: 450 pesos is nothing to get excited about, its only 30 USD haha) At Senor Frogs, the bouncer offered me his jacket because I dressed for 85 degree weather and caught a chill when the 70 degree night air brushed my skin. Across the street at Carlos N' Charlies, the waiters sang and glided their way to each table, provided an AMAZING presentation of mixed drinks (that many bartenders would have simply garnished with "pretty"), and led me on the dance floor to a session of salsa, laughter and applause! Then there was the lady at Ferragamo who let me try on several pairs of shoes (priced well over my budget), and took snapshots of me modeling on my imaginary runway.

Back at Paradisus, there was the Sales professional who showed us a presidential suite for a potential future trip. She seemed to have a genuine concern for who we were and if we were enjoying our stay. We had an in-depth conversation over lunch about family values, how much she loved working at Paradisus, and her climb to her current position. Even when you know a person wants a sale, doesn't it make you feel better when you feel like they want the relationship as much as the sale? We declined booking at this time, but I tell you what- when we do book, we will contact her for the sale. It was an intimately AMAZING conversation.

I could go on and on about all the "AMAZING" that took place in Cancun. I challenge you to Be AMAZING! Whether you are in Hospitality, Sales, Design, Education, Law, or any industry where there are clients and customers who depend on your service- Be AMAZING! I strongly believe that service and/or experience can make or break a product.

Sell the experience! Paradisus is a company that inspires and empowers their people to do their very best work! They put every ounce of energy into the experiences they provide. I've learned that in business, you earn money by creating value. People trade you money for the value you create. I am no expert, however, I have worked at great companies and have been mentored by great leaders. The pattern I have noticed is that they are committed to greatness! 

While dining inside Paradisus at the Marketplace Grille which overlooked the beautiful Caribbean Sea, my travel companion and I silently watched as the workers engaged with one another and other guests. We began discussing the possible anecdote that attributes to the success of the resort: multiple departmental huddles, touch points with guests, training and professional development, recruitment, amongst many other elements. Ultimately, I would not be surprised if Be AMAZING was posted in every back service area, office and was spoken in passing along with a high five and a smile.

reviews.author: steph-gia88
reviews.title: Amazing week in Cancun
reviews.text:
Spent Easter week at the Paradisus with my husband, sister and friend.  The hotel was stunning and unlike many of the reviews check-in was flawless.  We were escorted to the check-in desk and then to the concierge who gave us all the information regarding the hotel.  We did not do Royal Service and had the junior suite, lagoon view.  This was my first time in Cancun (been to Mayan twice).  The beach was gorgeous however, the currents were quite strong.  This was okay with me since I am a strong swimmer and I love the exercise so I never felt unsafe.  I did see one couple being pulled out by the waves and they were not in shape so the guy started to panic when he was struggling to swim back.  The lifeguards did a good job at making sure people stayed safe, even if I was annoyed since I am a strong swimmer and wanted more freedom to swim.
All the restaurants were great but the desserts, WOW.  The rice pudding at Enso, the Mexican 3 milk cake at Mole and the Tiramisu at Vento were spectacular. Take the server's advice on your orders they will not disappoint. 
The staff at this resort are amazing - everyone was super friendly and it seemed like they actually loved their job and for this, we tipped generously. Francisco who works at Mole/Blue Agave was super sweet he remembered all of our names and brought us special shots.  
We went out to Mandala and got the VIP package which was amazing - we had the most attentive care and the party was great.  
We also rented the Bali bed twice at the beach which came to 125 USD per day but was totally worth every penny.  You get special service, there is a DJ spinning beats,  food brought to your bed and a bottle of fabulous Moet. It was extremely relaxing.
The only negatives I have are that they shouldn't allow people to leave their towels on the beach chairs and or should increase the amount of chairs available. People were so rude and would leave their towels there from 6 am and NEVER show up.  We ended up just moving people's towels because it was ridiculous and unfair. The second complaint I have is with my Nexus rep. Alexis - this has nothing to do with the Paradisus but I was extremely annoyed he did not help us at all and was rude.

I would like to also call out the front desk staff who helped my friend get her phone back (at 4am) after dropping it in a cab after our night at Mandala.  They called the driver over and over until he returned with her phone.  I think Mexico always gets an overly bad reputation and there are a large number of great and honest people who get lumped this bucket.  If she had dropped her phone in a cab in Canada she would have never gotten it back. 

We will surely be returning!!

reviews.author: macloqr
reviews.title: Buen descanso
reviews.text: Es un buen hotel.  Mucho mas moderno del de Playa del Carmen.  Los empleados excepcionalmente amables.  Buena atención.  buena Comida.  Amplios en los tragos.  Minibar surtido.  Excelente wifi. Servicio de alquiler de coches bueno.

reviews.author: Brittany M
reviews.title: Most relaxing vacation in a LONG time!
reviews.text: I don't have a single negative thing to say about this place! It was perfect from start to finish! Great service, strong drinks, clean, beautiful beach... the list goes on and on! My best friend and I took an all inclusive trip to this resort in April 2017. The staff was very nice and professional, and made sure we were taken care of the entire trip. All of the food options were delicious, including the room service! This was my third all inclusive trip, but my first time in Cancun. My other two trips were about an hour south in Riviera Maya, but this one BLEW them out of the water in every aspect! I would absolutely recommend this resort to anyone.

reviews.author: Laura C
reviews.title: Amazing beach , close to airport
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancún has a great location close by to the airport. The property is on an amazing stretch of beach and there is a great pool by the beach as well. Food, drinks and service were solid and the staff did go above and beyond. I will say that at night the resort is very very low key. This is a great spot for couples or families but I don't feel like it would be a good fit for groups of friends who are looking for entertainment. Great spot though!

reviews.author: Manda_pandaboo
reviews.title: EXCELLENT!!!
reviews.text: This was my first trip to Cancun and I loved staying at this hotel. It's worth paying a little more for the ocean view. We did not upgrade to the personal butler service, and I'm glad that we didn't because it wasn't necessary - I think if you have kids, or absolutely don't want to move at all, it would be worthwhile, but my friend and I didn't miss it. Overall most of the food was great. Recommend that you book the restaurants as far in advance as possible because they fill up. We ended up eating at the buffets mostly but I was satisfied with that. The lobby is the most beautiful that I have ever seen at any hotel. We arrived around noon, check in time isn't until 3pm, but they gave us wristbands and told us we were free to eat/drink/swim while we waited for our room. Highly recommend this place. It's a bit far from the crazy downtown area of Cancun, which is fine unless that's what you are looking for.

reviews.author: Stacey J
reviews.title: Satisfied but may not go back to this specific location
reviews.text: The hotel is dated but the staff was extremely accommodating. I wish there were more activities during the day and the shows that were listed on the entertainment board were consistently wrong. Also the pool was too deep, I couldn't stand without being on my tippee toes (I'm 5'1")

reviews.author: 67CindyF
reviews.title: Royal Service upgrade! YES!
reviews.text: Fav restaurant was ENSO.... Carlos Svaste was our amazingly wonderful server.  We were there celebrating my 50th, &he surprised me with a birthday cake!  The Royal Service is really worth the money especially because your butler gets ALL your dinner reservations for you.  (We stayed the first four nights on the non-Royal side, & couldn't get any decent dining times/reservations.)   We loved the Bali Beds by the Royal pool that faced the ocean.  La Palapa was our fav spot for an outdoor meal (breakfast&lunch) with both an ocean & pool view.  Blue Agave has great Ritas.  Be sure to bring plenty of $1 & $5 for tips.... especially for the pool & beach cocktail servers.   The more you tip, the better your service.

reviews.author: Cathy C
reviews.title: Amazing resort and location!
reviews.text:
Everything about this resort was 5 star.   The rooms were clean and spacious.  If you don't want to hear live music in the evenings, I would not recommend staying in the main building.  The restaurants were all excellent and the food was top notch.  There were so many choices at the buffet and the a la carte restaurants were all excellent.  The Brazilian bbq was by far the most memorable, especially if you are a meat lover. There was plenty of fresh meat, vegetables and fruit.  The guacamole was to die for.
The pool and beach were fantastic and there were always spots to sit on the beach on the sand.  The staff were very professional and polite.  The service at this resort was exceptional.

reviews.author: Jesus U
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: The upgrade Royal Service was the right thing, all the amenities and the service of the people that work there, you feel like in family, it was excellent, you have to go there, it's worth every penny I pay.

reviews.author: Louane
reviews.title: L'hôtel Paradisus Cancun est paradisiaque !!!!
reviews.text: La plus belle hôtel que j'ai vue. Le site est grandiose et magnifique. J'ai choisi le Service Royal avec vue sur mer. Nous avions un restaurant près de la mer. La nourriture est excellente. La margarita est excellente. Le restaurant Naos, buffet, on a le choix de manger en dedans et dehors. Le restaurant Market Grill est excellent, c'est comme le Milsa au Québec. Les sushis sont d'une grande fraîcheur. Tous les restaurant à la carte sont excellents. C'est extrêmement propre. Le Spa est magnifique. La mer sublime. Les Bali bed est un must. Ça sent très bon partout. Excellent service de tous les employés(ées). Un gros merci à notre majordome Hector. Jorge et Eddir au restaurant Palapa merci.

reviews.author: Karine1322
reviews.title: Très bien !
reviews.text:
Nous y sommes allés du 18 au 24 mars 2017 avec un autre couple d'amis.

Le site est beau et propre, le personnel est gentil.

Le restaurant Bana est tout simplement INCROYABLE... Il faut y aller et y retourner. Les autres restaurants à la carte sont corrects mais sans plus. Le buffet est diversifié et la nourriture est bonne. Le vin maison est tout à fait acceptable pour un 4*1/2.

Les chambres sont ordinaires et pas super bien insonorisées mais propre. La femme de ménage passe 2x/jour.

Les piscines sont propres mais j'ai trouvé qu'elles étaient trop profondes. Je mesure 5"5 et je devais constamment être sur le bout des orteils pour ne pas avoir de l'eau par dessus la tête. Très peu d'animation durant la journée, manque de musique et d'ambiance. Il faut se lever très tôt pour avoir une chaise près d'une piscine et le personnel enlève les serviettes lorsque la chaise est trop longtemps inoccupée . Le service d'alcool au chaise est bon.

La plage est belle, il y a de la musique mais rien d'agressant. Beaucoup de vendeurs de souvenirs etc. 

Nous avons passé une belle semaine et nous pourrions y retourner dans l'avenir.

reviews.author: hyeyeonl335
reviews.title: My Spring break experience at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: I really loved to stay at Paradisus Cancun. It is located in safe area and has long beach walk. Also, the service was very friendly and helpful. The food at Asian restaurant needs to be changed because it is bit salty and not that flavooury. However, I loved food at Fuego and Mole! They cleaned our rooms regularly and neatly. It was such a good experience. I would definitely recommend Paradisus Cancun to my friends and family.

reviews.author: carolnyc2003
reviews.title: Singles vacation
reviews.text:
I was at this property last week for five days.  The rooms were quite dated but clean. We had a room overlooking the lagoon which is basically the parking lot so beware.

We upgraded our service which was worth it, especially for the "all" adult pool.  To the families looking to book here, there is a family/kid pool so not sure why you all insist on staying at the main pool (sans bar).  This in itself was worth the additional $80 p/day. 

Restaurants- It was difficult to get reservations but the older crowd seemed more concerned with this issue. Mole got the best reviews and it was just average in our taste. There were men singing and playing instruments throughout the meal and it was 
really annoying. I understand they want to give you the whole dining experience but 
dinner doesn't need to be almost two hours with loud entertainment. 

The buffet for breakfast was great and by far our favorite meal of the day. We didn't notice the activities board until three days in when we walked by the party pool. We wanted to take yoga but didn't get a daily pamphlet or notification when classes would be. I would say it would be helpful to slip under people's doors like most resorts do. 

Beach/Pool ~ Difficult to find chairs. I get that everyone wants a seat so they leave their towels while they eat or dos whatever, but if a waiter notices unoccupied chairs for hours they should give the chairs to someone else.

Staff- Very friendly and tips go a long way, especially at the beach/pool.

I was in Cancun this past November and it's by far worth it to pay more money for a nicer property, like Secrets the Vine.

reviews.author: Kaiden1215
reviews.title: Relaxing Vacation in Paradise
reviews.text: Paradisus was the ultimate relaxing vacation! Every year our group of friends take a vacation together to reconnect and just have a good time without the kids. We chose Paradisus because it was an adult only resort. We were very pleased and happy with the entire resort. The variety of food was descent and the pools/beach was perfect. It was never crowed and the people were truly friendly. We had an ocean view room which was large and clean! We couldn't have asked for better and will definitely return.

reviews.author: sharimar5
reviews.title: I LOVE IT!
reviews.text: Ame este hotel! Si duda es el mejor hotel en el que he estado. Los cuartos son super grandes y cómodos. Los empleados son super respetuosos y amigables. Hay buffet gratis todos los días. Es un lugar perfecto para unas vacaciones familiares, luna de miel o para ir con amistades.

reviews.author: kdandino
reviews.title: Best friend girls getaway!
reviews.text: Cindy and Laura by the pool were exceptional!!!! Treated us like royalty! I miss them already! Gabriel at the lounge bar was great as well! We never wanted to leave! Our room was a perfect ocean view and the food was great!

reviews.author: Edna C
reviews.title: Overall this hotel is excellent.
reviews.text:
Room was spacious  with very private balcony. Out of 7 resaurants we  tried 6 and all were  top quality with staff who REALLY wanted to please.  They were knowledgeable  about the different menus and always  always asked if we had  allergies . 
The pools were always sparkly clean with pool boys working none stop vacuuming and  testing the pool.  The grounds were spotless  and the gardens full ,green and lush. Our beds were rather hard and we had to ask for  foamies which were happily given. My favourite  waitress at the pool  was Asuncion who helped me with my chair every day as I was unable to lie on the sun bed. She was attentive and fast and always had a smile.  Although I didn't travel with children I was told by those that did that an excellent kids programme was in place every day.   
.

reviews.author: Alvin B
reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text:
This place is literally Paradise! One of the most beautiful resorts I have ever stayed at! My friends and I came here for spring break and we had an incredible time. The lobby is magnificent and as soon as you walk in, the fragrance the resort uses is amazing. I recommend purchasing the all-inclusive package it is definitely worth every penny or pesos! The place is designed to be relaxing and has a very Spa-like feel with koi fish and ponds and hanging gardens everywhere. All of the restaurants in the Resort were of 5 star quality along with great live music. Red Lounge and Avenue Bar were a great place to wind down with music and shows. The beach was breath taking and the pool was also amazing. One of the best perks is the great buffet style food and being able to sit by the pool or beach and even the cool swim up bar. 
      But what I want to commend this place for was the HIGH QUALITY LEVEL OF SERVICE!!! All of the employees there were so above and beyond than any other resort or hotel could offer. Every employee says Hi to you and always makes sure to ask if you need anything. They even respond with "it's my pleasure or it was my pleasure to help!" I have never heard of any other service at a hotel use those words. To hear that come from their staff, no words can describe it. From the waiters to room service or front desk, everybody was willing to help with a smile. There was a great sense of genuine humanity, care and dignity from all of the staff there. I am from NY, and out of all the places I have visited/stayed at through out USA there is nothing that even comes close to what I experienced here. 
     I want to give a great shout out to Parvi and Ame of the Outdoor Photography group for their extraordinary service and helpfulness. Parvi is a great photographer and did an amazing job taking my photos. I have never seen such great skills and it was worth every cent for such great quality photos. Ame was genuinely super helpful in helping me select the pictures and putting together the right package. I wish I could remember the names of every person who helped me and deserved a shoutout but then I would have to list every single staff at the resort. 
     Overall beautiful place, great food, excellent service and no doubt the best resort to stay at when thinking about vacationing in Cancun! I will definitely be coming back here for sure!!

reviews.author: spoiled2014
reviews.title: My favorite Hotel
reviews.text:
Though a bit "pricey" this hotel is my favorite place to travel too. We have been here four times over the years.
Beautiful suites, a huge pool, several top rated restaurants to choose from, and exceptional service all around, combine to make this Heaven on Earth for vacations.

reviews.author: Adrien T
reviews.title: Paradisus Hotel Cancun
reviews.text: I had a fabulous trip to Paradisus Hotel in Cancun.   The food, the location, the room, the staff I give 10 out of 10.   My friend that I travel with is waiting for a knee replacement so we spent a great deal of time by the pool.   Asuncion was a primary waiter.   Asuncion couldn't do enough to make my friend comfortable due to limited mobility.    She brought ice for the knee and made sure we always had water or frothy libations at hand.   Laying in the sun is hard work.

reviews.author: Ed2travel666
reviews.title: Coc!o Bar makes me loco
reviews.text: Quality and service for great PRICE! Grab a chair by the pool early let them do the rest. Please stop by the Coco Bar and see Christian and Katrina for a good time and  tell him Ed and Joni said Hello.

reviews.author: Lesly H
reviews.title: Great Group Vacation!
reviews.text: We stayed here with a large group of friends and family (all adults). After a slow check-in, we had no complaints. Food, drinks, pool and beach were all amazing! The beach area is very close and made it easy to go back and forth to find friends. Everything was well maintained and clean and the service was excellent! The main pool with swim up bar is a little deep (I'm 5'5" and was on tip toe) but not a major issue. Our flights were canceled going home and the hotel worked with us to allow us to add an extra day with no notice. We would definitely go back!

reviews.author: Alberto G
reviews.title: Charge for extra service, as Royal service, and deliver worst service than a motel
reviews.text:
As soon as you get there they push to sell this special program, that basically does not add any benefit.

What you end up getting is rudeness from the staff, specially manager and people from the help desk staff.

When you ask for something there is no one able to help and redirect to somewhere else.

Once we called the help desk over the phone to check something and they end up transferring  over 5 times until they hangout.

Basically it is the worst service I have ever stayed, mostly for being and all inclusive. 
It advertised it has multiple restaurants. But there is no way to eat in them, they ask for reservation and when you call they tell you they are full, however they are empty.

In the end, we tried to speak with the general manager, who is always busy or does not care.

It was without a doubt the worst experience in Cancun.

In the pro side the installation are good, but not word a dime for the terrible service you received.

reviews.author: H8447DLjulies
reviews.title: Spring Break with a Large Group
reviews.text: I was part of a Spring Break group of 14 moms & their daughters plus extra friends who were Seniors in high school. The Paradisus was what we expected for the price and location of an all-inclusive hotel in Cancun. The hotel was clean, the rooms spacious with nice views, and the property was nicely maintained. However, the food was just mediocre, especially the buffet breakfast and lunch grill. There's little kid-friendly food besides bread or rolls, and no cheddar cheese anywhere so "nachos" were a plate of thick tortilla chips with a scoop of pico de gallo and guacamole on top. It was difficult finding a single chair or group of chairs after 8:00am at the pool or beach....unless you upgrade to the Royal Service Side. We were never able to secure large group dinner reservations before 8:30pm at any of the restaurants, despite calling each day at 7:00am as recommended by the hotel. The beach was picturesque, but service was slow and there were people peddling their wares all day long. The chairs at both the pool and beach were extremely uncomfortable, and there weren't enough chairs (although there was enough space) for peak times when the hotel was at capacity. The drinks were very good - and Christian was an outstanding waiter for our group of moms who would stay by the pool while the girls spent the day on the beach. I personally would choose a more upscale, non-all inclusive hotel if I travel to Cancun in the future.

reviews.author: marcb1034
reviews.title: Perfecto
reviews.text: Instalaciones impecables, de lujo, las albercas están climatizadas y muy limpias, la playa es parte de delfines por lo que es espectacular y la vista desde las habitaciones también; no recomendado para ir con niños porque tienen mucho oleaje. Las habitaciones perfectas, con jacuzzi, bien equipadas; ideal para descansar.

reviews.author: Eduardo Flores
reviews.title: Excelente experiencia!!!
reviews.text:
Todos los servicios son 10 puntos, desde la amabilidad de sus trabajadores hasta la comodidad de sus instalaciones.
La comida y la bebida de primera!!!
El cuarto súper cómodo y el servicio a la habitación fue muy rápido!!

reviews.author: Gisela H
reviews.title: Hermoso hotel all inclusive
reviews.text:
Excelente hotel, muy bien ubicado. Las instalaciones son hermosas, con un hall lleno de vegetación. 
Todas las instalaciones y servicios del hotel son de muy buena calidad, la atención es rápida y cordial. Además la calidad de las comidas, tragos y bebidas es excelente.
Lo único que puedo aconsejar es que no es un hotel ideal para ir con niños, ya que la playa en ese sector tiene bastante oleaje.

reviews.author: hugo_lippa
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Cumple todas las expectativas en respecto a precio calidad. El servicio y la atencion ideales. La comida y las bebidas de primera. El BarMan Evaristo de la barra central un buen empleado, nos hizo sentir muy comodo.

reviews.author: Dogbluehorse
reviews.title: Go Rodrigo!
reviews.text: My five friends and I had an absolutely wonderful time here- the food was pretty good and the beachfront was lovely. Our favorite part, though, was the activities manager Rodrigo. He was the highlight of every day and always made the poolside that much more fun. Always remembered who we were and stopped to say hello and invite us to the next activity- really made a difference. Only thing I'd caution is the Bana sushi place as we found the fish wasn't too fresh.

reviews.author: Bob I
reviews.title: Pretty awesome hotel!
reviews.text:
Check in was easy, and then they offered us our first drink - it was awesome!

The hotel has 5 towers with tower 3 being the tall one in the center and tower 5 is the northern most tower which is the "Royal Service" area.  It appears that Royal Service also includes:
- their own pool by tower 5
- their own palapas on the beach
- their own restaurant
Fear not peons!  The rest of the hotel is pretty awesome!
There is a HUGE pool with a swim-up bar that goes from tower 3 to tower 1.  And another pool you can enjoy as well (that is wonderfully warm too!)
I didn't find an outdoor hot tub although there are parts of the big pool that have bubbles.  I'm sure the spa had a hot tub, but we didn't partake.

Speaking of the towers, tower 1 is closest to Fiesta Americana which at the time (mid-Feb) was having MAJOR work done on their northern most building (next to tower 1).  Hopefully that'll be done soon since the workforce was very large and busy.

This hotel will WOW you at how beautiful the public spaces are, especially in tower 3!  LOTS of restaurant choices and making reservations was much easier than other hotels -- just pick up the phone, and ask for your reservation. 
My personal ratings for the reservation restaurants:
Mole - wonderful
Fuego - wonderful
Market Grill - the Brazilian style eatery at night was delicious!  Be VERY hungry the food doesn't stop!
Bana - was "meh"
La Palapa - was "meh"
Vento - I'll be nice and just say, I didn't care for it.

The buffet is Nao and its strengths are the foods prepared in front of you like omelets, grilled fish, etc.  Like any buffet, some food is hit or miss depending on how long it's been sitting there.
Without question though, the pastry chef is absolutely AMAZING!  Zillions of beautifully prepared tastes of a great variety of desserts!  Major applause to the pastry team!
Also, the ice cream here is TO DIE FOR!  Always had 2 servings each day!  Yummm!

The drinks are great!  Not just the availability of top shelf liquor but also their drink mixers are great quality too!  

The staff is extremely well trained and so polite and courteous.  Please tip them!

The only negatives I have are:
1. Our ocean view room needed a "refresh".  The bed closer to the window had a big sag in it, the love seat had a stain in the fabric, etc.
2. The 8:30 entertainment needs to have better lighting and more seating.

Overall, I'd definitely stay there again!

reviews.author: Nick B
reviews.title: Amazing Place
reviews.text:
My friends and I stayed at Paradisus for 5 nights and it was our first time in Cancun and Mexico and we loved this hotel. The service was beyond amazing and as soon as we entered the hotel we felt at home. We stayed in the Royal Service side which was incredible. Our butler Erik was the best from the start. Erik no matter where at the hotel we were always found us and made sure we had everything we needed. He brought us to dinner and made sure our nights were filled with activities and things to do. He went above and beyond to make sure our trip was amazing.

The La Palapa restaurant was our go to. From the view of the beach to the amazing service by the staff we ate here almost everyday and would go back for sure. The staff, Jorge, Cesar, Josue and Alejandro were the best and always knew what we wanted before we even did.

We will definitely be going back to Paradisus next year.

reviews.author: Cherie D
reviews.title: New widow
reviews.text:
I was widowed after booking this trip with friends and my husband and the place was not very compassionate about the circumstances, didn't even address my questions about any sort of refund and sending a death certificate unlike the airline which quickly refunded the whole cost and sent a letter expressing their sympathy. After making phone calls was told the refund for an all inclusive with one person not going was 50.00 dollars a day, I personally don't think that that is fair  and it was difficult to even get them to do that. Pretty sad, what is there biggest concern? Money?
And there check-in and check-out service was horrible. They really need to re-evaluate how they do it.

reviews.author: Alys B
reviews.title: Couldn't have asked for more
reviews.text:
We spent four nights at the Paradisus Cancun for my bachelorette party- Feb 8-12. It was a great trip and the experience at the hotel was superb. It was very clean, modern, and absolutely beautiful. The staff was all very friendly and accommodating. From check in to check out I have no complaints. We spent a lot of time at the pool as opposed to the beach because the water was rough, but we never had an issue getting lounge chairs by the pool for our group of five. The weekend was more crowded than the weekdays, but still was not an issue. The food was the best I have had at an all inclusive resort. Even the buffet was a step up from other places I have stayed in Mexico and other countries. The food and service at the restaurants was outstanding. Be sure to check out the Market Grill for dinner - Brazilian steakhouse rodizio style. Every night we ended at the Red Lounge where Alejandro always made sure we has a drink our hands. His service along with friendly personality ensured every night was a ton of fun. I am missing the amazing iced coffees from the coffee stand. I can't remember the name of the guy working there but he was such a sweetheart. He knew my order after day 1 and provided excellent service. All of the guys at Avenue bar provided great service, especially Samuel. We also loved the team leading zumba and water aerobics by the pool. We did not see much of the evening entertainment because we usually chose late dinner times, but they seemed to be a lot of fun. The entertainment by the pool on the weekend was excellent. Very original. I would definitely visit here again. It was a great trip with friends, but would also be fun with family and kids. 

I would recommend bringing small bills to tip the staff. All inclusive does not include tips which is how anyone working at a resort makes a living. If someone provides you great service be sure to slip them a couple dollars! =)

reviews.author: mandywlai109
reviews.title: Just ok
reviews.text: We just return from Cancun. We stayed 4 nights here and it was just ok. I've been to Cancun 4 times, and this hotel is just average. The service at the restaurants were average. The service at the front desk was below average, they are usually very eager to help but I didn't feel that way. We booked two rooms, we expected both rooms to be at least on the same floor. needless to say, we did not get what we wanted. I had to take a handicap room just to be on the same building as our friends. The problem with the handicap room is every time you shower, the water spilled over to the hallway. The food sucks except fuego. The beach is very nice though, but will not return again.

reviews.author: cottager
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun is paradise!
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun is one of the best resorts I've ever been to. We upgraded to the Royal service, thanks to Rosy at check in and were very happy we did. The service was second to none they could not do enough for you. The variety of food was really good. Royal Service has its own breakfast and lunch restaurant right on the beach, its own butler which made all your dinner reservations, stock your bar in your room, and pretty much did any request within reason. Royal service also provided our own restaurant/bar within Pyramid 5, appetizers in the afternoon, music in the evening. You could go to Pyramind 3 for nightly entertainment but it was Loud and not my cuppa tea. 
 I could go on and on but you must go and experience it for yourself, I would go back in a heartbeat.

reviews.author: Angela D
reviews.title: Who could ask for anything more???
reviews.text:
We loved this resort for its beauty and wonderful food, top shelf liquor and friendly staff.  We would like to say a special thankyou to the following:  Andres from Noas and Market grill, Pablo (we loved seeing you for breakfast every morning) Alberto at Enso, Keyla and Alex (who discussed the timeshare and respected our wishes), Leonardo at Mole, Norma who booked our snorkeling trip, Talina from housekeeping (you were so sweet and helpful).  
I was there with my husband and another couple and we all agreed that we would stay here again. We had a great time.

reviews.author: Darin B
reviews.title: Paradisus wins me over again!
reviews.text: I've been to Dominican Republic Paradisus Palma Real a few times and loved it so I decided to give Cancun Paradisus a shot as well and loved it almost as much. Cancun's Paradisus is much more compact in geography, meaning you don't need golf carts or trains to get around the resort. The food is probably a little better in the Dominican, but overall I was very pleased with my Cancun stay. I was there two weeks and had beautiful weather the entire time!  Coco Bongo was a great time too.

reviews.author: LondonM23
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text:
Overall an amazing trip, but hopefully the below are useful to both travellers and the hotel.

Good points:
- The spectacular location and view
- Wonderful resort with lots of entertainment (it’s the little things that count)
- ALL staff were amazing, a credit to the resort, much thanks to the lovely waiter Jamie
- Room was great, no complaints
- Very impressed with the buffet
- No delays with check-in or check-out

Bad points:
- I was trying to email the hotel prior to the holiday but I struggled to get a response and when I did it was a week later which is a real shame as I have always had good contact with a hotel previously on email
- Although there were signs that say not to, people still reserve sunbeds! I suppose this is a common theme with all hotels but it is so annoying
- We were on the top floor of pyramid three and when we wanted to come back to our room for a snooze before dinner we couldn’t as the noise from the entertainment on the ground floor was so loud. It is essentially open plan and outside your room door, so I guess this is down to the design of the building
- The individual restaurants we found a bit strange. Although the food and service was lovely, it was as if the menus were trying a little too hard to be fancy and the atmosphere was a little odd (exception to the market grill where the atmosphere was great!)

reviews.author: SocorroCP
reviews.title: Maravilloso
reviews.text: Desde la llegada fuimos atendidas muy solícitamente las instalaciones son hermosas los restaurantes ofrecen una amplia variedad de alimentos además de la excelente calidad de los mismos,mi preferido el Enso deliciosa comida asiática

reviews.author: X7786ENmichaele
reviews.title: beach getaway
reviews.text: great place to relax with great beach at very reasonable price. beach terrific and very close to hotel. dining options were very good and food great. staff was very friendly and did anything they could to enhance our stay.

reviews.author: bregabe
reviews.title: Perfect in every way!
reviews.text: We have a timeshare with RCI and visited two Paradisus resorts this year.  Cancun is our favorite.  The rooms are not as nice as the Playa resort, but it is so much nicer in every other way.   For starters, the all inclusive fees are half at this resort. We are still trying to figure out why Playa is so much higher.  The beach at Cancun is much better. The resort at Playa del Carmen is much closer to the water adventure parks, so that was convenient.  The Playa del Carmen resort does not have a dance club and the Cancun one does.  The Cancun resort is MUCH more tropical in decor.  The buffet and restaurants are AMAZING!  You are spoiled silly at both resorts. I wish I could just move in permanently!

reviews.author: firegloglassart
reviews.title: Fabulous vacation destination!
reviews.text: Had a great time. Beautiful beach, pool, restaurants were great, live performances and shows were very good. Would highly recommend Paradisus!  Very elegant. Good variety of restaurants. Room was spacious and comfortable.

reviews.author: Fabiola C
reviews.title: Amazing and relaxing 2nd honeymoon
reviews.text:
My husband and I had the most amazing time in Cancun, not only was the weather excellent and the property but most importantly the hard working people that works there making you feel like VIP everyday. it wasn't our first time at this property and that's why we went back because every time we get excellent service. I want to Thank the following people they made our stay very special.
Faby from front desk at club Melia, Alan our bartender at the pool, Hector & Asuncion our cabana servers, Faby & Roberto our beach cabana servers, Sergio & Francisco from Blue Agave restaurant. Overall I want to THANK all Paradisus staff for their great service, we will definitely be returning next year.

reviews.author: Dolores W
reviews.title: Great service and amenities
reviews.text:
Room great nice ocean view. Food great especially Fuego and seafood night at NAOS buffet. Great Brazilian steakhouse with unlimited meats.  Water a bit rough this week for swimming in ocean. Pool water a bit chilly except for Royal service adults only pool which was warm. Desserts great. Try the coconut ice cream and apple ice cream served in an apple. Amazing!,,!
Butler Jorge great and most of the staff. All friendly and accommodating would go back

reviews.author: lilyh672017
reviews.title: exelente¡¡¡
reviews.text: muy bueno¡¡¡ hacia rato no viajaba a cancun...muy bueno¡¡¡ el hotel genial un cinco estrellas de verdad....las habitaciones sumamente reconfortables, la atencion de todos, personal del resto, bar,pileta,atencion de mucamas.....mmuuuuyyyy bueno...

reviews.author: Jgfchef G
reviews.title: Increíble atolladero creada por la noche en el atrio central
reviews.text:
Fuimos atendidos de lujo, gran comida servicio y actuaciones nocturnas. Gran mejora en el hotel, se nota que lo están cuidando y mejorándolo. 

Por suerte pudimos obtener una oferta para disfrutar una categoría más, suerte que fue una de las nuevas habitaciones totalmente renovadas.

reviews.author: Julie K
reviews.title: Beautiful week!
reviews.text:
This is the best vacation ever!  The quality of service there is more than amazing.  Nothing bad to say about this hotel everything is excellent from the check-in to the room service, the waiters at the buffet and what to say more about the service at beach.  WOW!  Is all I have to say!  

I would go back in a heartbeat and I usually don't visit the same hotel twice.  This is how wonderful my stay was.  Thank you Paradisius Cancun!

reviews.author: Christine G
reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text: La semaine au paradisus cancun resteras dans ma memoire longtemps ! La plage ..l hotel...les restaurants ... le service ...l acceuil.. la proprete meritent un 5 etoiles et plus ! Une  mention speciale pour nos 3 serveurs de la semaine ...Christian et Atilano du resto naos et Laura du service sur la plage ! Avec votre service et acceuil et vos beaux sourires la semaine a été superbe !! Merci encore :)

reviews.author: Melissa D
reviews.title: Amazing trip!
reviews.text: An amazing resort with friendly staff, beautiful property, delicious food and gorgeous rooms! Can't wait to visit again. We were here with a large group and the staff made our stay as comfortable as possible and always with a smile.

reviews.author: swright_utd
reviews.title: More like 3.5 star.....
reviews.text: The Paradisus is a beautiful hotel inside and out and is positioned on an amazing beach. That is where the positives end.  Long check in and out process.  Tons of beach beds left empty ( literally like 90%open) because they charge $120usd while there are no open beach chairs because everyone takes them by 9am.  There is no nightlife.  The food is not on par with other resorts.  We were here during the Super Bowl and they charged $90 per person to get to watch the game. At an all inclusive. Rediculous. I just booked another Mexico trip for May to the Hyatt.

reviews.author: Claudia Diaz
reviews.title: Las fotos son !DE LUJO¡
reviews.text:
me encantaron las fotos pero por falta de dinero no me pude llevar todas sin embargo me habria encantado llevarme todas. Nuestra fotografa Parvi fue muy simpatica con nosotros y muy buena, extremadamente buena sacando fotos.

Fue una muy hermosa experiencia :)

reviews.author: Alexandra K
reviews.title: AMAZING!
reviews.text: Nothing short of amazing. Food was great, beach and pools were amazing! You can eat off the floor the hotel was so clean. The rooms were huge and very clean every day. There was plenty room for storage and to completely un pack and get settled. There were armoatherapy diffusers throughout the hotel therefore it smelt incredible. The staff was as friendly as friendly could be. They were taking our drink orders before we even checked in. A few tips: make dinner reservations in advance, the pool on the left hand side when you walk out is heated, the one with the swim up bar is not. Iwould definitely return again  and I would reccomend anyone to stay here.

reviews.author: Brooke H
reviews.title: Amazing!!!!
reviews.text: I had the most wonderful time at paradisus resort. I'm already planning my next trip and it has only been 7 months since I have been home. Cancun is my happy place. Thanks to paradisus....I had the most unforgettable experience. Food was good... drinks were great and the ocean view room was to die for. U must see for yourself.

reviews.author: Alison H
reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text:
The service was wonderful here, just steps to the beach and excellent table service on the beach! Our favorite waiter in the huge buffet was Pascual, he was so friendly and remembered everything that we liked!! The bartenders in the Toji bar were wonderful also, we made a point to go there every night just because of them. All in all we felt very pampered.
The only things that would stop me from returning was the amount of small children at the resort. Although they were cute, there were a lot of unhappy kids and that made it uncomfortable. The music on the beach was redundant and booming all day, that got to us after a while also.

reviews.author: deandgeorge
reviews.title: quick cancun escape
reviews.text: just returned January 2017 from this hotel. the reception staff was awesome and check in and check out was wonderful. fast and easy.... our room was on the sixth floor with a beach view......very clean and and beautiful........the hotel was filled with green plants and flowers......it is very clean and the staff always greets the guests.......the down side to this place is the fact that is is a join in club and they try very hard to sell you.....i had no idea it was a do you wanna buy in hotel........also i want to let everyone know that the smell of the spray and incense they burn is so overwhelming it almost chokes you....i have allergies and it really irritated them......the beach is nice and the staff works hard to make your time a pleasant one....if you can tolerate smells and dont mind being bugged to buy in it is well worth the all inclusive price. manuel at the bana bar was out of this world.....

reviews.author: jf19572017
reviews.title: Great vacation with excellent staff!
reviews.text: The property has everything you need for a great holiday. Staff are amazing! We enjoyed Zumba by the pool with Hugo and Suzanna, workouts in the gym with Freddy and drinks by the pool with Veronica. Best gym we have seen at a resort - cardio, weights and a spin room as well. The evening shows were great and again staff were there to assist. Thanks for everything.

reviews.author: Wanda K
reviews.title: The worst EVER
reviews.text: Really, its the worst hotel I've ever been. The immediate response for all the employees was "NO" . It was really annoying. We ask for jam and they tell us its only for breakfast. We asked for a table for 6 and they told us NO . They had the worst attitude . It is really the worst experience ever . The employees have no training . They want to charge extra for everything and it's all inclusive !! Please , take my advice and go to Secreta The Vine or Hard Rock . Depending on your type of trip . It's a bit expensive but trust me , it's worthwhile.

reviews.author: JFO84
reviews.title: Decepción
reviews.text:
El hotel es renovado y está bonito pero
El servicio en todos lados menos el
Pool bar es deficiente . Urge trabajar en la
Actitud de servicio del personal . No es lo que esperaba . Los centros de consumo son mejorables . Habitaciones confortables

reviews.author: Mariana P
reviews.title: Buen lugarcito
reviews.text:
Le falta es mejorar el sazón de La Cocina pero la verdad buen servicio buen hotel. 

Para convenciones y eventos grandes es muy buen hotel y el servicio es de calidad. 

Ampliamente recomendado tanto de viaje familiar, con amigos o laboral. 

Además tiene ambiente propicio para niños y es algo que otros hoteles ya no tienen.

reviews.author: Marcia Vitória C
reviews.title: Sensacional
reviews.text: Ficamos quatro dias hospedados no Resort e fomos muito bem atendidos. Ótimas instalações. Não fui em todos os restaurantes disponíveis, porém no principal e grill foram excelentes. Bebida maravilhosa e o atendimento no bar então... nem se fala. Maravilhosa hospedagem.

reviews.author: David G
reviews.title: Bebidas y comida de calidad. Playa regular. Servicio a mejorar.
reviews.text:
Es un buen hotel en cuanto a comodidad y calidad de la infraestructura y alimentación. Realmente me sorprendió que tengan bebidas de calidad, lo cual suele ser una pobreza de los 'todo incluido'. Pero aquí es un gran acierto. 

El servicio tuvo algunas deficiencias, por ejemplo: al asear la habitación nos dejaron sólo con una toalla, y sin shampoo y jabón. 

Los camastros no son suficientes para la cantidad de huéspedes en el hotel. No me imagino esta situación en temporada alta. El segundo día no encontramos un camastro disponible.

Recomiendo ampliamente evitar las horas de check-in y check-out alrededor de mediodía, pues las filas son interminables. Después de nuestros 45 min. haciendo fila para el check-in decidimos hacer temprano el check-out el día de salida, y permanecer allí para desayunar con tranquilidad.

reviews.author: Lyne V
reviews.title: Ho My god Wow!
reviews.text: Tout était parfait... bémol, notre vue qui donnait sur le stationnement... à part ca, j'ai adoré mon séjour, le personnel est très dévoué à donner un service impeccable...petit merci spécial à Ernesto et Hugo au gym et Zumba à la piscine, hawsome guys! Merci à Victor et Didier pour leurs services sur le bord de la piscine. La nourriture est très variée et fraîche ... Resto de sushi est excellent et market grill. Très belle plage... tout est très propre sur le resort même les toilettes de la plage. Chambre très confortable, fait 2 fois par jour. Service aux chambres très rapide. J'y retournerais n'importe quand.

reviews.author: preethi j
reviews.title: love this hotel!
reviews.text:
I booked a stay at this hotel after staying at the Paradisus Punta so I knew a little what to expect.  I loved this hotel.  It is beautiful and the rooms are nice. Everyone who works here is so nice and accommodating.   Check in was  a breeze- however it was not busy when we arrived.  Compared to the paradisus in Punta Cana, while this hotel is large it is not spread out and it is easy to get around.  The food for the most part was good.  Market grill and Blue agave were excellent.  The breakfast buffet has everything you could ever want. The Sushi at Bana was ok.  Ive had better- ive had worse. The buffet seemed to be good if you got there right when they opened.  IF you got there later, the food didn’t seem fresh.  Also a lot of the time the food would not be hot on the buffets- but if you eat at the other restaurants this is avoidable.   We had no problems making restaurant reservations.  We went to a guest relations counter and she made them for us on the spot (a big contrast from Paradisus punta cana where you are given the run around for days).  We checked out right at check out time and only had to wait about 5 minutes. 

We were here MLK weekend and never had any problems getting chairs at the beach.  The beach is clean and beautiful.  The water is rough.   Not a lot of people swimming but I don’t like a boring calm beach so these conditions were perfect for me. 

My main criticism is they are always trying to sell something.  Which is fine but sometimes we were being lied to.  I asked the water sports desk where I could get boogie boards.  I believe it is an aquaworld desk but I am not 100% sure.  Aquaworld is across the street from the hotel.  He told me he didn’t have them and tried to sell me other excursions. When I told him that I wanted to buy a boogie board he told me that I would have to ride the bus half an hour away to get one.  Not only does the hotel gift shop sell them- aquaworld across the street sells them.  You can get them at any pharmacy within minutes of the hotel.   So in order to sell me something I didn’t want, he just lied.   When we asked guest relations for something, they tried to set us up for a timeshare type presentation.  Every time I went to get a towel at the pool they tried to sell me an excursion.  I get that they are doing their job but at a certain point it gets old, and the water sports desk blatantly lying to me put me off. 

All in all, I would return. This is a really nice place to stay for the value.

reviews.author: Carlin H
reviews.title: Lovely experience
reviews.text: This was my first time doing an all-inclusive resort vacation and it was a great first experience. My biggest takeaway is how great the all-around staff was. They always had a smile on their face and treated us with the warm hearted hellos. The activity coordinators and staff members were great and made for a great experience. Ernesto, Antonio, and Hugo were great at interacting with the guests and making any activity of the day fun and memorable. I would go back to this hotel just for the staff! Awesome people.

reviews.author: Adelina P
reviews.title: MAGNÍFICO!
reviews.text:
Um dos melhores hotéis em que já fiquei hospedada. Qualidade no atendimento desde o momento do check in até o momento do check out.
Ficamos na prâmide 05 e foi excelente! Funcionários com excelente atendimento! Com certeza voltarei e indicarei para todas as pessoas.

reviews.author: Saliceto
reviews.title: Casi para un excelente
reviews.text: El hotel, sus instalaciones y la atención del personal es excelente. En todo momento nos atendieron con una sonrisa y muy bien dispuestos, excepto el encargado en el restaurante Enzo que resultó algo antipático la noche que fuimos. Como elementos negativos menciono: la playa con muchas olas (bandera roja los 7 días), pocos baños cercanos a los restaurantes, no hay bares para tomar copas con vista al mar (excepto Coco, que no está incluido en la promoción all inclusive) y el sauna seco nunca sube de 70 grados (a pesar de que lo pedí). El resto excelente

reviews.author: ariel9892
reviews.title: フロントスタッフの対応はメキシコレベル
reviews.text:
全体的に良いホテルですが、事前にwebチェックインしたにも関わらず希望の部屋はすでに満室でした。
ツインルームをリクエストしてましたがダブルルームでした。
日本みたいな親切な対応は期待してませんが、それなりの値段するのでもう少し対応してくれたら気分よく過ごせたとおもいます。リクエストがある場合は、しつこいくらい連絡した方がよさそうです。
スパはとても良かったのでオススメです。

reviews.author: ToniCB
reviews.title: Fin de Año 2016
reviews.text:
Hotel más que recomendable. Servicio excelente. Atención inmejorable. Comida exquisita y entorno paradisíaco.
Sin duda, una elección segura si se quiere disfrutar del Caribe ya sea en familia o con amigos.

reviews.author: Karen C
reviews.title: Pésimo servicio
reviews.text: Se tienen que buscar a los meseros para que te atiendan, hay un trato sumamente diferente con personas extranjeras cuando el costo por la habitación es exactamente el mismo y no encuentro razón alguna para el trato

reviews.author: hanee e
reviews.title: The hotel is old and staff are the worst
reviews.text: I have visited 3 other hotel in cancun and I never had any problem with hotel and the staff. But this hotel is old and dirty and lack of service. The staff is the worst part. I will never in my life will return to this hotel. Check in took me an hour to check-in.

reviews.author: eprivat
reviews.title: Muy buen hotel pero...
reviews.text:
Llegue a Cancun buscando un poco de diversión y playa. Me voy a enfocar solo en hotel y es que es sin duda uno de los mejores "todo incluido" que he visitado en el caribe. 

La atención es en generalde primera aunque te ofrecen el Royal Service como un adicional y la verdad más allá de algunas preferencias no brinda mucho. Solo lo recomendaría si va uno con pareja 

En cuanto a la comida todo bien, los tragos muy buenos en suma es un buen hotel. Lo malo que siempre hay es el extremo mercantilismo pero creo que es normal en Cancun

reviews.author: Alla B
reviews.title: Когда попадаешь в рай!
reviews.text:
Пожалуй это самый лучший отель в котором я была. Вообще сеть Paradisus by Melia смело можно считать достойным конкурентом таких сетей как Ritz Carlton. Я ни к чему не смогла придраться. Территория отеля большая, ухоженная и зеленистая. Снаружи отель выглядит в виде пирамиды Кукулькана, а внутри в виде Сенота - безумно красиво. По вечерам по всему отелю зажигались огромные свечи и очень приятные ванильные аромапалочки. Этот отель подходит для пар которые хотят убежать от реальности и наслаждаться друг другом в раю.
У нас был all inclusive,ежедневное посещение любого ресторана отеля по предварительной записи и room service 24/7 (room service проверяли в 3 часа ночи))
У нас был номер с видом на лагуну и мы по началу расстроились так как хотели на море, но потом обнаружили что солнце встает со стороны моря ( и многие из-за этого просыпались в 6 утра) , а заходило солнце с нашей стороны и мы каждый вечер лежали на своей террасе и провожали восхитительные закаты.
По ресторанам, очень понравился Мексиканский ресторан, обязательно заказывайте дегустацию разного вида текилы, но сразу просите правильно расставлять стопки по градусам,либо не выйдете а выползите с ресторана)))). Отличный японский и мясной ресторан. Вообще на удивление в Мексике бесподобно готовят мясо, хотя я считала что их фишкой должна была быть рыба)))
Персонал очень добрый и приветливый, могут посоветовать много интересных мест для посещения в Канкуне.
По экскурсиям посоветую Дельфинарий в открытом море, оно того стоит)))была еще в бане у шамана,довольно весело и необычно, но своих 130$ не стоит).
И напоследок...о море)карибское море  - божественное, не спокойное конечно, но манящее.

reviews.author: Melanie K
reviews.title: Royal Service is a must, food sub-par
reviews.text: We stayed in a royal service room, and I highly recommend it! The general buffet was usually not the best of food quality, so it was awesome to have the La Palapa restaurant on the royal service side only for breakfast. It also helped immensely that our butler, Antonio, could make dinner reservations for us every night. Side note, nacho cheese was really weird. I suggest asking for the empanadas when you can!

reviews.author: mabdancinlikedavid
reviews.title: The staff was so helpful & welcoming!
reviews.text: Overall the hotel was a great place to stay & good value for the money.  The staff was excellent throughout the hotel; very helpful & friendly!  Special mention to Mole Restaurant; the food was delectable!  The servers & manager made me feel like a VIP!
