I want to commend Leo, Mirian, Irvin, & Dany for giving my friend & I an unforgettable dining experience.  TEN thumbs up! (We ate there a few times, the food & the service was so good.)

reviews.author: Pier7911
reviews.title: Great resort with great staff
reviews.text: Spent the week with friends and enjoyed everything about the resort.  All staff were friendly.   Sergio and Ascinion were wonderful servers and made our stay special.  I will definitely go back again with more friends.

reviews.author: karenanders0n49
reviews.title: Great place to vacation.
reviews.text: This is my second time to Paradisus Cancun this year. The value is great. I tracked the discounted rate and got a great deal, which included all food and alcohol. We worked out every day with Freddie, who ran the gym at Paradisus. Freddie is super nice and give a great workout.

reviews.author: Janice P
reviews.title: Birthday Celebration
reviews.text:
We visited the Paradisus November 11th-15th to celebrate my 52nd birthday. I must say it was a GREAT stay! The property, the food, entertainment, the staff-especially Jordie at the Market Grill is phenomenal! Make sure to ask for him, he'll make you feel like family! He was such a delight, made my birthday a very memorable one! Our room had a beautiful view of the ocean and pool, it was very clean and located in building #3 (#3524) which is where all of restaurants and entertainment is located. The hotel is located within walking distance to many things, but most importantly it's a very short walk to the bus line which takes you into downtown Cancun for $1 USD.

Can't wait to return!
Janice from Texas

reviews.author: nora a
reviews.title: Vacaciones increibles!
reviews.text: Fuimos con una pareja de amigos y la verdad la pasamos increible, el hotel es hermooso, empezando por el lobby lleno de plantas que cuelgan, los restaurantes, habitaciones y areas comunes super bien cuidadas, la comida muy rica!! lo unico malo es que me parecio que no hay muy buen servicio al cliente, los meseros en general me parece que tenian cara de pereza y cuando llame por telefono a hacer la reserva del restaurante para la noche no me atendieron muy bien, me prohibieron reservar dos restaurantes en la misma noche!! de ahi toodo bien

reviews.author: Allison J
reviews.title: Amazing Vacation
reviews.text: Ernesto, Josue and Gloria all made sure we had an amazing time. Food was excellent and the service is second to none. Drinks were refilled before they ever ever got empty and restaurant service was quality. We felt like Queens all week! Try the sushi bar and also the flank steak at Market Grill. You will not be disappointed. The ceviche was a other favorite. .  We will be back!!

reviews.author: FPatriota
reviews.title: Agradável, satisfatório e confortavel
reviews.text: Hotel com boa área de piscina e praia, alimentação bem diversificada e atendimento de primeira qualidade. Bonito por dentro e por fora,  além de confortável e agradavel. Comemos bem nos diversos restaurantes além de petiscos e bebidas na piscina.  Ótimo para descansar!

reviews.author: melissa d
reviews.title: GREAT PLACE!!
reviews.text: Staff everywhere very friendly and accommodating, no matter time of day or night! Bartenders, Randy, and server, Eduardo, at the walk up pool bar by building 3 (not the COCO POOL) were awesome! Knew our names, our drinks and just friendly & great service every day! All servers in restaurants were GREAT! Very hard workers! i definitely left a tip for each server because it was well earned! The greenhouse effect within the hotel is BEAUTIFUL...plants, greenery, flowers everywhere!

reviews.author: ticker777
reviews.title: We love the Paradisus
reviews.text: Service is excellent and non stop. Rooms are spotless, with a great view front or back. Real comfortable bed. The food is the best in Cancun. My wife and I go back every year. It's paradise only four hours away.

reviews.author: Deborah B
reviews.title: My Favorite Place.  Cancun is NOT just for Spring Break.
reviews.text: Stayed here two years ago and have been wanting to return.  This property is situated on the most beautiful beach I have seen---to include Hawaii.  The staff is amazingly attentive and as happy as a ray of sunshine.  We were originally booked for Family Concierge as I got a great deal on CheapCaribbean but they upgraded us to Royal Service.  Royal service is great due to the private pool with bali beds and its own bar and grill.  Don't bother with Royal Service if you are into a loud party pool...that's safely at the far end of the property.The concierge service seems redundant as many of the staff are more than willing to help with anything you might need.  The food is outstanding and even more so when you consider that this is an all inclusive.  Top shelf alcohol is the norm.  Thank you to Valeria at Royal Service and Raymundo the mixologist at Toni.   Gracias!

reviews.author: Mary H
reviews.title: Restaurant
reviews.text: We was enjoying food on site Paradisus Hotel very much especially the Bana restaurant , We stayed there 5 nights 6 days, when we bought a package that included air fare plus room with inclusive, we did not know the price we paid for is 1 floor room, when we were there that time no vacant room for upgrade as we want ( the room at higher floor ) but we are okay with the room ( big and balcony ) We will come back

reviews.author: Islandgirl517
reviews.title: Amazing Cancun Vacation
reviews.text:
Thank you Paradisus Cancun for an amazing first trip to Cancun, Mexico! 

If you are looking for a well maintained, friendly staffed, attentive resort to stay at in Cancun then Paradisus should be your choice! 

I was here with three of my girl friends for a girls trip and we had an amazing time! We weren't sure at first if it was going to be the right place for us as it seemed like a very family oriented resort and not much for drinking, but we soon discovered that was not the case. There was the perfect balance of families areas and adult areas. 

A huge GRACIAS to the following staff that made my stay at Paradisus absolutely amazing:

Coco's Beach Bar - Alan, Katarina and Jason

Royal Service Beach - Edwardo (Eddie) and Moises

Entertainment/Activities - Rodrigo 

You are all incredible at your job! Thanks for making our stay an amazing experience and making us all feel so taken care of. 

I will be back again for sure and will recommend this place to anyone looking for a well balanced resort with relaxing and partying. 

Thanks again!

reviews.author: AventuraBird
reviews.title: Unforgettable wekend!!! Extremely recommended!
reviews.text: We went to that wonderful hotel for a friend´s wedding and we had the time of our lives! The service was excellent, you can feel the kindness and good vibe from all the employees. My husband left his iPad pen on the room, we called from Miami to let them know that. The housekeeper already reported it and one of our friends brought the pen back home. The room, the bed, and the bathroom were always clean and comfortable. The room´s view: breathtaking! The weather was so good! The best liquors in all bars. The food: Oh my God!!!!!!! You don´t have to go out to eat like a king. We loved all the restaurants, but "Blue Agave" and "Mole" are top of the line!!! We will come back soon.

reviews.author: amoureuse1976
reviews.title: Excellent choice, service is great
reviews.text: Stayed there this past week 11/15-19/2016.  This is my fourth time in Mexico and this hotel surpassed the expectation. Check in was a breeze. The staff is attentive from the moment you are on the premises.  This is an all inclusive hotel - the food is great. The premises are clean. The staff is nice, never a complaint in Mexico for me. The room was nice and clean. The beach is clean. The ocean was 'rough" but beautiful - if you are a strong swimmer than you should not have a problem.  They do not say no. They make sure your stay is enjoyable. Definitely recommend and would go back. No complaints.  Restaurants on the hotel grounds were all fantastic from Enso where Benito and Ernesto were great to David and Jaime at the Grill.  Go and enjoy!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: camillajacques
reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: I came back 2 days ago..114 of us in a group stayed at Paradisus. .the staff were amazing. ..food was excellent. .hotel fantastic.. .we enjoyed emensley. .I would definitely recommend. .and would go back to same hotel

reviews.author: BethMorrison6
reviews.title: You should stay here!
reviews.text: Everything so well coordinated.  Oscar will have a cocktail ready at check in and the front desk is super helpful.  Thanks Bennui!  The rooms are clean and comfy.  The common areas are stunning! Many onsite restaurants make this a good option however they are only open at night.  Daytime dining is limited to Mexican food or buffets.  That's the only thing that needs improvement.

reviews.author: Larry L
reviews.title: Cumpliendo un sueño
reviews.text: La atención personalizada, la amabilidad y disponibilidad del personal es de admirar. desde el Check in hasta el Check Out Con Isela fue una experiencia super agradable. recomendado el Paradisus y nos vemos en mi próxima visita

reviews.author: l0littah
reviews.title: EXCELLENT
reviews.text: The resort is amazing and the staff excellent! I would definitely stay there again. Hector along with other servers on the beach were efficient, friendly and made our beach days very comfortable. The ambiance is beyond beautiful. The nightly shows were great and very entertaining. Also, the restaurants and quality/taste of food is superb.

reviews.author: Joy N
reviews.title: Beautiful Vacation
reviews.text:
My best friend and I spent 5 days here at the end of October to celebrate her 40th birthday. The resort is absolutely beautiful. Our room was great. Very clean. The balcony facing the lagoon gave us a great view. The beds were very comfortable, mini bar always stocked. Because we were celebrating a big birthday, we had a fun photo shoot planned. The hotel staff went above and beyond to help us with some things we needed, like ordering a cake and filling balloons with helium.
The pool and beach were beautiful. There is always someone close by ready to take your drink order. 
The food was great! Market Grill was our favorite restaurant - we ate there twice! One night we booked at a restaurant (Vento) and when we sat down we realized there was very little on the menu that we liked. The server was extremely accommodating and had the chef make us the best steak I've ever had. The buffet had a large variety of food available all day and night. We are very picky eaters but there was always something for us. 
There are shows every night that were entertaining.

There were a few cons but nothing that would stop me from returning:

1. Stairs!!! The hotel has stairs EVERYWHERE! There are elevators to get from floor to floor but there are many many stairs throughout. To go from the pool to the beach and back there are many stairs. For someone that has trouble getting around, this could be troublesome. 
Aquaworld is conveniently located right across the street and there are many activities/excursions there. The 60 steps down from the hotel aren't so bad, but walking back up - that was tough!! I would recommend the hotel offer a golf cart or something to help guests go back and forth. 

2. U.S. Dollars. The hotel does not have US dollars available. We had larger bills and forgot to bring ones for tipping. The concierge or anyone else there was unable to provide change. 

3. Daytime activities - we felt they were lacking in daytime activities. We realized on our last day that there are activities, they just aren't advertised very well. If you are interested is doing something other than lounging by the pool/beach, just ask the concierge what is going on while you are there. 

4. There is a great little coffee bar big it doesn't open til 10am. Just found that odd. 

Overall I highly recommend Paradisus.

reviews.author: Diego N
reviews.title: Excelente servicio, siempre están a disposición de los huéspedes.
reviews.text:
Si bien no es de los hoteles mas nuevos de la zona, la verdad es que esta muy bien mantenido, y con un excelente servicio, en todo momento preocupados por hacer agradable la estadía, desde los botones que te reciben en la puerta en adelante todos se preocupan para que uno pase una estadía agradable.
Es muy bueno el servicio de cuartos, con room service las 24 hs. Las opciones de los restaurantes temáticos son muy interesantes, si bien no tienen nada extravagante, en general el nivel de la comida en cada uno de estos es muy bueno.

reviews.author: Martha S
reviews.title: Hotel espectacular
reviews.text: Fue una estadia maravillosa, realmente la pasamos muy bien, les agradezco la atencion , la comida de los restaurantes riquisima y variada y la atencion del personal de primera , realmente vale la pena conocer este lugar, altamente recomendable.

reviews.author: Monique B
reviews.title: This place is literally...PARADISE
reviews.text: This resort sits at a very good location and its HUGE! I went with a friend and she made reservations for the Royal Service side of the hotel - very mature, romantic, and no kids. I thought this was excellent that it was split that way. We had access to some great amenities and restaurants and we were just a few steps away from the beat. Rooms were clean and well attended to. The restaurants offered a variety of foods for different tastes but much of it was not seasoned or it was not served hot. We ordered room service several times and although they said 40 minutes it came a little faster than that. The food was okay the first couple of nights but the last night everything tasted OLD. Everything was cold and was NOT good at all.

reviews.author: SilverTalk
reviews.title: Sunny Beach
reviews.text: We loved the beach and the massage and the Mayan pedicure as I refer to it. The water was such a beautiful blue color and the sand so white. Beach side service made for a restful afternoon. Umbrella and lounge furniture available to rent. Free parking if furniture is rented.

reviews.author: Wade D
reviews.title: Service Excellence/ Nice Hotel
reviews.text:
We just returned from staying 14 amazing days at the Paradisus. October 22 to November 5th. 

I planned a surprise 2nd 29th birthday for my wife with 10 other friends and family. 

The majority of our group stayed in the Royal Service section and for those that did not they regretted it :( ! The only way to stay is with the Royal Service option in my opinion. 

The staff was Amazing!!! 

Suzanna our butler was a true professional and a pleasure to deal with from making sure we had all requests, reservations, comforts, and even some extra surprises through out our stay taken care of and always with a smile. She also helped me coordinate a private birthday dinner that turned out amazing and the food was spectacular! So much so the wife had to have the soup again! If you can request her to be your butler you will not be disappointed! 

Victor, Cesar, and Valeria, at the Royal Service Restaurant " The Palapa" where fantastic and always made a point of making sure we were fed or had a drink in our hands and that all our needs were taken care of with the most positive and pleasant of demeanors! 

These are just a few of the amazing people that made our stay amazing, every staff member is there to make sure you experience nothing less than pure comfort during your stay, need something? ask, it will not be long before your request is met! The staff truly made the Trip for us and our group! The only staff that put us off was the photography group, it was fine to be asked if we wanted pictures but it got annoying when it would happen 2 to 3 times a day even after making an appointment and being asked time and time again by the same staff members not being able to remember or keep track of who's they already asked or booked. It just brought to the surface it was purely a money grab and not about the experience. 

The food overall is great, The Palapa was our favorite place for breakfast and lunch as it is menu based with higher end dishes daily but each restaurant has some truly tasty dishes. One opportunity for us on our visit was the lack of chicken options in all the restaurants except Blue Agave and Enso.

The Hotel itself is going through renovations in the true Royal Service pyramid (5) and sometimes the noice did make its way to the pool but nothing that I would say took away from the ability to relax and enjoy the day. The Royal Service Bali beds and the beach are amazing at the resort, many days enjoyed in theses locations on the trip! The rooms are nice and the cleaning staff does a good job, for us this could have been nicer and cleaner on a day to day basis but overall acceptable. 

The Royal Service Bar is a nice touch for premium drinks and snacks and a great place to chill if you get an ugly weather day and yet again the service is amazing there as well! 

We would easily stay here again but there is always room for improvement as such the last opportunities we noted versus other resorts we have enjoyed that I would leave as a comment to the hotel and future travelers 1- No lobby bar 2- no stage for shows (shows take place mainly in a bar that really only allows small amount of people to watch in comfort or with proper visibility ) 3- the golf course and how it's is run needs updating and attention. Rental clubs are way out dated and overpriced for what is available. More guest would use the course if better priced and attention was focused on getting guest involved which would in turn add to the overall experience of staying at this resort. 

Great stay, Amazing people, Very good food, and overall an awesome resort!

reviews.author: Catalina P
reviews.title: Excelente atención y servicio !
reviews.text: El hotel tiene excelentes instalaciones y el servicio de los meseros fue impecable siempre procuran hacerte sentir muy bien, en especial los siguientes meseros hicieron de mi instancia algo especial: Rafael, carlos  y Yhoni Gonzales.

reviews.author: patiguti70
reviews.title: Bella vacanza
reviews.text:
Sono stato  qui ,bellissimo  resort  ...buona cucina, si mangia  benissimo! !!,i ristoranti  molto  eleganti  e variati. 
L'unico che  non mi  è  piaciuto  sono i bagni  che per  un ristorante  di lusso  non sono a la altezza.
Lo unico que no me ha gustado  de Este hotel  lindisimo  y Mu elegante  son Los baños  que no esta a la altura del Hotel  el inodoro  viejo  y las duchas  viejas, deben  renovar.

reviews.author: Sandersonbree
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful and with plenty do and eat. My best friend and I went there for her 50th bday and she couldn't stop smiling. The staff are wonderful and very accommodating. Now since more of our friends seen our pictures now they want to go with us to the Paradsius in Punta Cana.  Best Resort in Cancun great for girls trip, family and couples. Love, love it and the rooms are big, clean and fabulous!!

reviews.author: apaoiram
reviews.title: Excelente hotel
reviews.text: Me hospedé una semana en este hotel con amigos, el trato en general de todo el staff es excelente, te reciben con una sonrisa en el main desk, la habitación que nos tocó era enorme igualmente el balcón. Muy grato encontrar una botella de vino blanco espumoso de cortesía. Los restaurantes de muy buena calidad, buffet variado y vinos y licores igual variados. Recomendado.

reviews.author: Maricarahy
reviews.title: Resort TOP!!!
reviews.text: Fomos muito bem recebidos no resort. O quarto bastante amplo, tinha ofurô na varanda. A comida do resort era uma delicia. Vários restaurantes, incluindo na piscina, tínhamos alimentação por 24h. O resort possui a opção de all inclusive ou não. Além disso, a localização é perfeita, perto das principais atrações, como o coco bongo, e shopping.

reviews.author: emglegaspi
reviews.title: EXCELENTE SERVICIO E INSTALACIONES
reviews.text:
excelente hotel , instalaciones de primera y el servicio del personal cálido , amable y los restaurantes buenìsimos  ,habitaciones amplias y cómodas , la playa muy limpia , desde que registras el check in al check out la calidad del servicio del personal excelente , super recomendable
la atención que recibimos del restaurante ENSO genial,amable,aménos fuimos atendidos por Edwin y Natanael

reviews.author: Kmed14
reviews.title: Amazing place !!
reviews.text:
Wow, this hotel did not disappoint ! We had a room over looking the lagoon, it was lovely & cleaned daily! The views when you walked out to the pool were just amazing. The bar in the middle of the hotel does the most amazing cocktails, you can literally ask for anything and they will make it for you ( all the drinks were international brands too ) we ate at the buffet for breakfast which gave us plenty of choice. Our favourite evening meal was enso ( big thanks to Nathanael & Jose for making us feel so special every time we went, the desert was out of this world ) ! The pool & beach were lovely, waiter service at both. 
A bit of feedback that could be used to improve was the fact the restaurants were advertised as open from a certain time but they didn't open until late! Mainly the Mexican restaurant, it said 12 but didn't open until 4. The pool food got a bit repetitive every day ( burgers, chips, chicken etc ) I think this may have been because the hotel was quiet, so perhaps it wasn't worth opening. But we paid for a week all inclusive, so it would have been great to get what was advertised. 
Also the other problem we had was trying to get a towel in the afternoon, it's next to impossible ! I sat for 40 minutes waiting and the member of staff dealing with it was quite rude, it's a shame as he was the only one who was out of everyone in the hotel! They need a better policy in place, someone next to us had 4 towels for 2 adults, no wonder they ran out. Think going forward it would be helpful to keep track of who's had them from the room number. 

Even with them little points I would definitely go back & recommend this hotel to anyone. The staff really couldn't do enough for you. Only 5/10 mins in a bus away from shops & nightlife !

reviews.author: feleciag338
reviews.title: OMG
reviews.text: First time in Mexico! Special thanks to Joshua the bartender, and waiter who was very attentive at all times! I recommend he become a butler. Everyone is very welcoming, the food at the buffet NAOS was always great. The resort is beautiful inside and out! I definitely recommend going here because everyone is very friendly and will direct you during your stay.

reviews.author: Andréia Bueno
reviews.title: Férias incríveis
reviews.text:
Hotel excelente! 
Fiquei hospedada no Resort do dia 13 de outubro a 20 de outubro de 2016 junto com uma amiga, simplesmente adoramos tudo no Resort... A estrutura é maravilhosa, paisagens incríveis comida e empregados maravilhosos. 
O Wi-Fi é excelente pega até na praia... 
A praia em frente ao Resort é linda mar azul e água transparente. 
Cancun é uma cidade maravilhosa a noite é perfeita. 
Indico irem ao Coco Bongo e ao the City são baladas incríveis.. 
Utilizem o transporte público é barato confiável e funciona 24 horas. 
Indicamos o restaurante Naos a comida é maravilhosa e o atendimento também em especial agradeço ao atendimento excelente do funcionário Orlando Bello super cordial e atencioso. 
O restaurante Markent Grill serve carnes maravilhosas vale a pena efetuar a reserva. 
Quanto aos passeios aconselho  efetuarem por conta própria tivemos um "assalto"  quanto ao valor pela compra que efetuei através da agência credenciada da Cvc. 
Vimos que a compra no estabelecimento é mais barato. 
Exemplo pela agência o coco Bongo custou 85 dólares direto no coco Bongo o ingresso custa  60 dólares. 
Cancun tornou minhas férias inesquecíveis pretendo voltar.

reviews.author: landonterry
reviews.title: The Perfect Resort
reviews.text: I stayed here for 4 days and had a fantastic time. The room was decorated well and had a spectacular view. The food was great and the service was always top notch. I would like to especially thank our waitress Asuncion for making our time on the beach absolutely perfect. We called her Susie because we couldn't pronounce her name. Asuncion was very personable and brought us anything we needed. She has been working at the resort for 24 years! I will most certainly be back and would recommend Paradisus as well as Cancun Mexico for an ultimate vacation.

reviews.author: armandos421
reviews.title: Muy bueno
reviews.text:
La variedad de la comida deja que desear, hay bastante cantidad pero no varia dia  a dia..Faltan actividades nocturnas mas impactantes
NO tiene actividades acuaticas,
Se debe mejorar los Snacks, siempre la misma comida y deben haber mas atencion a la piscina y playa

reviews.author: LKG
reviews.title: Enjoy it, we did
reviews.text:
Just returned from our 7 night stay at Paradisus, and it was a darn good time.  

The service was great everywhere we went within the resort, without exception.

The room was cleaned and re-stocked daily, stayed nice and cool, the lagoon view we opted for was beautiful, and the location was perfect for reaching the main areas of the resort (building 3, the main building).  

Food was good.  Buffet had a lot to offer all of the healthy and not-so-healthy palates of our decent-sized group.  Reservations at the restaurants were pretty easy and plentiful, IF you got to making them by noon (mole, bana, market girll, fuego were all good; vento, meh).  

My partner-in-crime for the week and I hit the gym a few times.  The earlier, the more crowded, naturally, but never so much that what we needed/wanted wasn't available to us.  One of the nicer gyms I've seen in an all-inclusive setting.  The adjacent spa was decent, as were its ammenities, although we're a bit spoiled coming from Vegas.  

Heavy pours on some good liquors in the bars.  The "nightclub" left something to be desired, and we did hit it almost nightly for lack of anything else to do, but we were able to enjoy dancing with ourselves to mash-ups of Phil Collins and Bruno Mars.

May or may not matter, but there weren't a whole lot of children around, or that we saw at least, so no issues with that.  And no one seemed to have any trouble with relationships of any combination.

reviews.author: Pippi C
reviews.title: Eccellenza Messicana
reviews.text: Bellissima struttura elegante e di classe, generalmente si pensa al Messico come un paese fatto solo di posadas e grandi resort pieni di folla ma questo hotel è sopra ogni aspettativa, eccellente cibo locale servito con allegria e raffinatezza , ottimi i drink serviti al bar ed in piscina. Per un relax prima del tour dello Yucatan per noi è stato un incanto. Que viva Mexico !

reviews.author: 547jennifer
reviews.title: A Wonderful Vacation at Paradisus!
reviews.text:
I have been in hospitality/event management in Boston for 20 years.  I CAN NOT express how amazing the staff is here.  TOP NOTCH.   The resort is not perfect... there are pockets where things can be improved.. but this amazing team of hospitality professionals makes any and all issues melt away.  I have never had better service.

My friend and I stayed (2 years in a row) in the Royal Service which I would highly recommend.  Last year, we were upgraded to an ocean view.  It was so nice to wake up and feel the energy of the ocean and to see the blue waters. This year, the Ocean View upgrade was not available, but they did upgrade us to a lagoon view suite.  Having our own bathrooms was a nice luxury just the same.  Both were valuable in their own way. 

We had Galdino as our butler.  Galdino was extremely professional and truly did everything in his power to make our stay enjoyable.  He graciously made reservations, answered all of our questions, and made recommendations as needed.  This year we opted for the "butler cell phone" which I would recommend. I am not sure how, but he always answered the phone on the first ring.  Even when I mistakenly called on his day off.  (Sorry Galdino!) 

It's easy to make new "friends' with the staff here. You will look forward to seeing the people from day to day because they truly make you feel like they care and want for you to have the best trip possible. 
Daniel, who I believe is the Cabana area manager, recognized me from last year.  The cabana for me is my #1 priority on a relaxing vacation and Daniel did his best to secure me a wonderful cabana every day.  (both years!)   Daniel is THE BEST.  Truly!  Ricardo was our fav server @ the cabanas. They all are excellent and work very hard.  Please tip the staff because it is well deserved! 

For the most part the restaurants are good.  There are hits and misses in this department.  
The breakfast/lunch buffet is very good. Tons to choose from.  Great omelets! 
Bana serves Sushi which is good. I am in the "business" and a bit of a foodie.  I will say the food at the other restaurants is fine..  but you do get to order lots, try fun things, and get dressed up for a night out.  They do their best and for all inclusive I think it is good. 

Tempo on the other hand.. WOW.  What an amazing experience.  If you are a foodie 100% you need to have the tasting menu w/wine pairings.  World Class.  Rudy our server and Carlos made sure all was perfect. 

I will be back ASAP! Thank you!

reviews.author: Cesar Benavente Leigh
reviews.title: Una estadía poco agradable
reviews.text:
Desde que llegamos tuvimos problemas, la atención del personal deja mucho que desear, el EL CAPITAN DEL BUFFET (alto, blanco, cabello ralo, ojos claros) muy, muy malcriado . 
El último día nos impidieron ingresar a almorzar, a pesar de tener el VB de recepción, lástima de un hotel que dicen ser de 5*. 
El concepto del hotel de poca iluminación es totamnete perjudicial ya que dos de nuestras amigas se cayeron al ir al Restaurante Enso, puesto que hay gradas y todo oscuro.
No tienen un teatro adecuado para los espectáculos, generando incomodidad a los huéspedes, al hacerlo en un lugar improvisado y son poco los afortunados que pueden ver (pesimo concepto).
Nos cambiaron las cenas reservadas sin avisar previamente, generando malestar y tener que ir al Bufet nuevamente.
La buena estadía la hicieron mis amigos, pero no recomiendo este hotel, otros se quejaron del olor a humedad de sus habitaciones y la poca disposición de los mosos, malcriados.

reviews.author: Oscar i
reviews.title: Un muy buen lugar para vacacionar
reviews.text: Estupenda playa, lugar muy bonito y bien decorado. En general, muy agradable. Lo mejor es la amabilidad y eficiencia del personal. Como sugerencia, mejoraría el autoservicio, en cuanto a reposición de alimentos y orden. Me imagino como será en temporada alta.

reviews.author: Fabiana M
reviews.title: Fantástico
reviews.text: Amei cada detalhe do hotel. Todos muito atenciosos e dispostos a ajudar. Fique hospedada na pirâmide 1, no Club Meliã. O quarto é ótimo, bem limpo, cama king, sacada para o mar, jacuzi e banheira no banheiro. Os restaurantes servem muito bem e tem para todos os gostos.

reviews.author: 120stalin
reviews.title: the best
reviews.text: excellent on every aspect. rooms were clean, people were great. and please tip the people the deserved, i will go back with no problem, i like the experience i would recommend all my friends. we had a great time.

reviews.author: Phillucoe
reviews.title: Best trip!
reviews.text: We had an amazing stay at the Paradisus Hotel! The hotel, food, service and atmosphere was outstanding. Everything was always very clean, the employees are all very helpful and friendly. Ernesto is the bomb! We had an amazing time hanging out with him. We cannot wait to plan our return trip!

reviews.author: yguzman2016
reviews.title: BEST HOTEL EVER!!
reviews.text: Sep 2016 best hotel I have ever been to. travel a lot but this was the best. hotel is gorgeous, clean and the staff is amazing, specially staff in all the restaurants. will be back next year! no need to stay at another hotel. four days was not enough days to visit all the restaurants in this hotel. pool and beach are a dream. no need to leave the hotel for any reason

reviews.author: Tania S
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.text:
This resort exceeds expectations. I traveled with three  girlfriends to celebrate my 40th Birthday. We were looking to just RELAX, as we are all moms just needing a little break.  It might not be as new or as large as some other  local ones, but the staff and cleanliness are impressive.  We had the Adult Royal Service.  Our butler, Antonio, was so nice and VERY good. (I have stayed at Paradisus Punta Cana and our butler there was terrible.)  I would suggest asking for him, you won't be disappointed!  Our experience at the Royal Service adult pool was so relaxing and fun.  Moises is just the BEST server and was so friendly and funny.  He is by far, the most attentive and catering person I have ever encountered at ANY resort.  He anticipated every need and I would return just to see him again.
The spa was wonderful and it was amazing that the steam room and pool were complimentary.  We all got massages and they were very good as well.   The food was just perfect from the buffet to all the restaurants .  If you are truly looking to disconnect from reality for a few days- This resort will NOT disappoint!

reviews.author: Cass30tr
reviews.title: 1 week all inclusive
reviews.text:
Had a great time at this resort. Bar service was good. Not over crowded. Restaurants were very accommodating for the large group of 10 I had went with. 

All staff was wonderful! Very polite and friendly. Special thanks to Ernesto who  took care of us while there! 

I would recommend this resort and will likely return!

reviews.author: Brad M
reviews.title: An amazing trip made exceptional
reviews.text:
I just got back from a week spend at this amazing place. The variety of food, always helpful staff, cold drinks and spotlessly clean common areas as well as rooms made this location one of the best I've had the opportunity to visit.

From check-in to check-out, there wasn't a single reason to complain!

What made this trip truly exceptional was one of the activity directors Ernesto.  His happy and helpful attitude brought tons of smiles and laughter to the experience.

I'd highly recommend staying at this resort to anyone looking for somewhere warm, clean and friendly!

reviews.author: alexgalivan
reviews.title: AMAZING!!!!
reviews.text:
We just returned from a group getaway trip to Paradisus to celebrate my 30th birthday. The hotel is beautiful, the food is amazing, the service is unbeatable.
On the entertainment team, Ernesto made our stay so enjoyable with his lively personality. He always kept us engaged in water aerobics, Zumba ,beach volleyball and all of the other entertaining events and shows happening throughout the day.
He was so personable, always remembered all of our names! We had an amazing time hanging out with him!
All of the service staff members are so friendly especially Andres at the Espresso hut. I always enjoyed getting my coffee and talking with him throughout the day!

I had an amazing holiday and I truly cannot wait to back !

reviews.author: dennyq920
reviews.title: Amazing geat away
reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay and will return. The Blue Agave , Fuego and pool side in Royal service has the best food. The staff is very helpful, kind and attentive. The pool on Royal service side and beach were very clean.

reviews.author: rene
reviews.title: Mejoraron su nivel en alimentos y bebidas
reviews.text: La primera ocacion q fui fue hace 2 años para ser exacto en semana santa,  y acabo de estar hace pocos y la verdad mejoraron la calidad de los alimentos y bebidas. Sin embargo la atención al huésped no es tan buena como en Paradisus de playa del carmen la Perla o la Esmeralda. Pero es cuestión de tiempo y de capacitación a su personal para q esto cambié.  Los felicito por mejorar!!! Es muy obvio y el cambio se nota al instante que los alimentos son mucho mejor q hace 2 años.

reviews.author: xeimex
reviews.title: Know before you go..
reviews.text:
We booked Paradusis for a luxury getaway before travelling through Mexico on a much tighter budget. As a pair of girls we wanted a safe and luxurious all inclusive option where we didn't have to think about anything. We booked an all inclusive stay for 4 nights in a twin room. 

We checked in late at night with no hassle. The concierge told us we were in Pyramid 1, and that we could have a Lagoon Room with twin beds or be upgraded to an ocean view room and share a king bed. We went for the upgrade. 

Rooms were nice, aircon worked but was extremely loud. We later realised this was probably a good thing because the noise from the clubs and beach was so loud in the beach view rooms in Pyramid 1 and the doors were definitely not soundproof. 

Bathrooms are a little run down, but clean and stocked with essentials. Bed was comfy and the turn down service at night was a nice touch. 

The beachfront is beautiful, if you manage to get a good day bed, you're set. But be aware that the nicer beach beds are reserved for members or you have to pay extra to use them. 

There are a few different restaurants in the resort, all average unfortunately. If you're after western style food and buffets, you will like it. If you want some gourmet.. forget it. Or, pay extra to eat at the expensive option. 
We had a manicure in the spa while we were there, prices were extremely expensive. I wouldn't pay these prices at home, but we were on vacay. Had the manicure in a kids room because apparently there was something wrong with the usual room. Sitting in a kids chair for over an hour hunching over a small table for an average manicure was not ideal. 

Otherwise the pools and service was great. Good wifi. Tacky entertainment, but lots of people love that sort of thing. Minibar and water in room was only restocked once, had to keep asking for water to use. Beachfront was definitely the best part of the hotel. 

If your not a club member, or paying extra to use the beach club, make sure your room isn't internal to Pyramid 1 so you can get some sleep.

reviews.author: jes_sl555
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text: Es una pena que en la tabaquería del Hotel no hayan pasado en su terminal mis 2 tarjetas al pagar y no acepten dólares, sólo moneda mexicana, y que al sugerirle al dependiente que tal vez su terminal estaba fallando, él afirmara categóricamente que el problema no era de su terminal sino de mis tarjetas. Además no le pudo vender agua para beber a un huésped Argentino, por no aceptar dólares, y yo le pagué 71 pesos por su agua para beber.

reviews.author: Paisaman312
reviews.title: 6 couples trip
reviews.text: All inclusive is the way to go. Statehouse wasn't that great. I called in advance to have good mariachis and they cancelled my surprise at the last minute saying no mariachis were allowed in the property unless is something like a wedding.

reviews.author: cesars873
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: Great hotel to vacation in and enjoy some relaxation.  The food is excellent  as is the rest of the services.  The staff are very polite and welcoming.  This hotel is perfectly located in front of the beach giving great panoramic view

reviews.author: Amcwilcoxstl
reviews.title: Truly Paradise!
reviews.text:
Service is the first word that comes to mind to describe our stay at Paradisus!  This resort is lovely.  

The atrium plants are fabulous, although in mid-day it is quite warm in the main areas of the buildings because of the glass atrium roofs.

reviews.author: A_Southernbelle
reviews.title: Great place!
reviews.text: Great resort! Royal service is the way to go, the butler service is amazing with this option. The food is average but you have plenty of options so you won't be disappointed. The Bali beds are great, very comfortable. We will be back!!

reviews.author: nma0911
reviews.title: Girls trip to Cancun!!!
reviews.text: We had an amazing girls trip to Cancun for Labor Day weekend. The Paradisus hotel is beautiful. We booked the adults only suite with Royal Service and were not disappointed. Our butler Rode made sure that we had everything we needed. The view was absolutely beautiful, and surprisingly for an all inclusive hotel, the food was great. The beach was clean, the pool was clean, the staff was friendly.. I have nothing bad to say about this resort. I will definitely return!!!

reviews.author: pabloarmandos
reviews.title: Normal
reviews.text: No siento que valga por lo que pagas, te venden un concepto y resulta ser todo bastante peor de lo que parece. Las instalaciones son viejisisisimas y con poco esfuerzo de renovación al menos a mi punto de vista. La comida tampoco fue del todo una experiencia tan grata. En fin tal vez solo fue mi experiencia pero así me fue,

reviews.author: Jon S
reviews.title: Another Home Run by Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: This was our 5th trip to Paradisus Cancun and once again they exceeded our expectations. The service staff was top notch and we again found the property, restaurants and amenities to be be more memorable and improved from our previous visits-all of which were very favorable. We would recommend Bana, Mole and their new offering, Enzo as must visit restaurants as each one was a hit with us and our friends. The service staff in Royal Service defines attentive and helpful-in particular,  Lazaro, Susanna and Sergio demonstrated the kind of service that other staffs should strive to attain. Lastly, we would note the exceptional efforts of Melina and Esther in the Romance Department. In sum, we have visited this property a number of times, will return soon and would recommend it HIGHLY to our friends and family.

reviews.author: Diane H
reviews.title: Girl's Trip
reviews.text:
I just left Paradisus Cancun and it was a great experience. Last year I stayed at Paradisus La Perla in Playa del Carmen and had a great experience. So we did not hesitate when our agent recommended the Cancun resort. 

Both trips we had the Royal Service. The Royal side of the resort was gorgeous and quiet. Truly gave you the feeling of being away and relaxed. Rode was our Butler this past weekend and he provided great Customer Service. He made dinner reservations for us so that we didn't have to worry about figuring that out. He decorated our rooms for our birthdays (3 of us have Sept birthdays) which was special for 2 of the ladies who had never been to an all inclusive. Even if you don't feel you need a Butler  (we barely utilized all that he could do) I do recommend Royal Service as it is worth it. Even our Butler Armando from La Perla was amazing last year. It just gives you a true feel for great customer service. 

The food was amazing! We ate at Enso, Market Grill and Fuego. We also ate at La Palapas for breakfast every morning. For an all inclusive feeding masses of people,  they did not slack in this area. The food was tasty and fulfilling. We were all truly impressed. The only downside is that some nights we wanted wine with dinner but that was an extra cost. But the cocktails weren't, so it wasn't a big foul! The hostesses and wait staff were also very polite, accommodating and always had a smile on their face.

The beach, the beach, the beach! Wonderfully kept, gorgeous water and wonderful wait staff. Moises kept us laughing and you can truly tell that he loves his job. Now the pool! We mainly used the main pool instead of the Royal side pool. Only because it was more of a couples feel on the Royal side. For 4 young professionals we wanted to be around more people. We met singles, couples,  families, wedding guests, a group for guys there for a Bachelor party. It was a great place for everyone and the pool was our social circle. Hands down, it was our favorite part of the trip. Only downside,  the water is almost 6 ft deep, and for a person that is 5'3" my legs got a workout bouncing around on my tippy toes! At the beach and at the pool they are able to provide great bar snacks - my favorite was the guacamole.

Overall, the resort was gorgeous. Very clean. Well manicured. Very nice rooms and bathrooms. Wonderful scent. Beautiful decor. Great entertainment in the evenings. Multiple options for food and even top shelf drinks. We did not have one major problems to speak of, if anything happened it was quickly taken care of. I won't say it was all perfect but to comment on the small things would be petty. 

If you are considering a trip to Cancun, whether as a single group of people or as a couple(s), I highly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Mauricio
reviews.title: Excelente atendimento de todos funcionários
reviews.text: Lugar ideal para estar com os amigos e família. Funcionários extremamente atenciosos e sempre prontos para te ajudar. Com as opções de lazer que existem dentro do hotel, não precisamos nos preocupar em buscar opções fora. Isso nos proporcionou ainda tranquilidade para aproveitar nossas férias.

reviews.author: Pazy A
reviews.title: Excelente!.. pero no es como para un viaje de despedida de soltera!
reviews.text: Fuimos por una despedida de soltera, habiamos hecho reserva en otro hotel y como estaba en remodelacion, la agencia nos mando a este otro, en la parte de Royal Service. Desde que llegas la atencion es DE LUJO! Las instalaciones son muy bonitas y esta area de Royal Service tambien es muy buena, tienes un mini buffet con comida, bebidas calientes y bebidas alcoholicas disponible todo el dia (cerca a las habitaciones) y te dan un mayordomo exclusivo para ti (con telefono incluido) para que te atienda de 3 a 11 pm. El desayuno en Lapalapa excelente! El restaurante de comida tailandesa tambien muy bueno y el de comida internacional normal... El buffet estuvo normal tambien (pero nada como el Lapalapa, que es exclusivo para Royal Service). La discoteca y el bar dentro del hotel me parecio un poco aburrido, pero ahi fue error nuestro, porque este hotel NO es para un viaje de despedida de soltera ya que el ambiente era bastante relax, inclusive en la piscina (que btw por el clima estaba siempre caliente), la musica era chill.. La atencion de todos, tanto en la playa como en el htel era sobresaliente. Las habitaciones tambien estuvieron buenas, solo tuvimos problemas porque nos dieron una habitacion con una cama matrimonial cuando habiamos pedido una habitacion de dos camas. El hotel queda tambien frente a una de las paradas del bus asi que para salir de noche, esta comoda la regresada tambien. El wifi del hotel me parecio excelente, tenias acceso sin problema en todas partes del hotel, hasta en la playa (solo en la playa se iba por momentos muy cortos dependiendo donde estabas, que es totalmente comprensible).. En terminos generales, el hotel estuvo muy bueno!

reviews.author: cgarner1225
reviews.title: PERFECT
reviews.text:
Had it not been for the check in, I would have rated this a perfect 5.  This was our annual mother-daughter/girlfriends outing and we could not have selected a better vacation spot.  We stayed on the Royal Service side, which is the adult only section.  There is NO ONE there that does not want you to relax and have a great time.  Our first night we had dinner at La Palapa, clearly the best restaurant on site!  Service, service, service.  From towels, cabanas, and drinks someone was anticipating your every want and need.  Jose, Cauich, Valeria, and Jorge do there job and do it well.
If you get the chance, go!  You will experience the best vacation ever!

reviews.author: Frankie
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, Good Food, Great Service
reviews.text:
Once you get past the slightly awkward check-in process, you're good to go. We were 2 hours early, they gave us bracelets to get some food and drinks, we side-stepped the lady selling the time shares - she introduces herself as an entertainment director of some sort and tries to get you to go to the spa with a discount if you view a property - time share pitch.

Our opinion of the food:
Food is good, not the best we've had at a resort but good for the money.  Honestly we liked the Market Grill the best - pool side burgers, dogs, wings, fries, etc.  We killed two plates of wings, they were so good.  We tried the Japanese place which was decent - it's the place in the middle of the resort with the canopy bar. Sushi was fresh but they give you 4 bites, so don't be shy about ordering a few extra rolls. Tapas place was good as well - very small portions so order more than you think you need.  We loved the Blue Agave place - their quesadillas were amazing (poblano and cheese) and they have a good pozole as well.  They serve chips/guac/salsa when you sit down - they also have a breakfast buffet if you want to skip the busy main buffet.

Rooms
Spacious and clean. Nice marble floors granite bathroom - and they have a bidet.  Private balcony is always nice.  Everyone keeps saying you have to have the royal service - we didn't get this ($120 extra per day) and we didn't miss it at all.  We can make our own reservations, and top shelf liquor is nice but not necessary when we drink beer primarily :) I was worried we would be treated differently if we didn't upgrade, but that wasn't the case, everything was amazing.  Mini bar did not have liquor, just beer and sodas and a few snacks - royal service might be different though.

Pool
Huge pool, swim up bar, food, servers, towels, etc.  No hot tub though, that was a bit disappointing

Beach
Get there early, the free chairs/huts fill up quick.  Seaweed was a slight problem but not a deal breaker.

Overall this was a nice little trip to Mexico - this was our 4th resort we've stayed at in Cancun and I would rank it #2.

reviews.author: Alexander R
reviews.title: Paradisus Vacation
reviews.text:
We had stayed in here in August for 6 nights. Over the trip was absolutely amazing. The food, drinks, the treatment you recieved from the staff. When entering they took the bags for you and brought them to your room while checking in. After check out a "concierge" takes you and talks to you about setting up an appointment, you realize it is for a time share through Club Melia. After a long day of travel this is the last thing you want to do.
 We had a ocean view room which was amazing! The room was everything we needed it be. Daily housekeeping, Minibar stocked daily, and turn down service which we only used 2 times. They did a good job keep the room clean. We had have 2 issues with the room. After we ordered room service, we forgot to immediatley put the dishes out the door, and a we came to a table full of ants. Then the 2nd issue was the we lost power b/c apparantly the hair dryer my friend brought was too high voltage. 
The resort credits are not what they are thought to be. It is a coupon book for 20 dollars off a Bali bed at the pool or beach, coupons for 10 dollars off 100 dollar purchase at the gift shop, and a small discount at the spa.
We loved all the bars, Salvador at the swim up bar was amazing, we had a good time with  him. After dinner we would go to Coco Beach bar , Avenue, or Red Lounge. They all were our good time, and most the bartenders would remember our drinks. Does that mean we drank too much? hahaha. The food was very good too. The steak at Fuego was amazing.

reviews.author: 967lidiag
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: I have booked my vacation during 4 years in a row in the Royal Service . I have been very pleased  with the service I had received in all areas. Everyone has made me feel especial. I would like to take the opportunity of thanking the employees who have contributed to make my vacation  happier and unforgettable. Juan ( butler), Roxana (butler) Javier (butler), Valeria, Gustavo, Jose, Eddier, Moises, Pablo, Daniel  and many more. In general all employees at Royal Service deliver an excellent service. and .. our especial thanks to Royal Service manager , el Senor Lazaro.

reviews.author: mauriciovism
reviews.title: Excelente atención
reviews.text: Nosotros nos hospedamos en royal service, tengo que felicitar a susana que fue nuestra concierge excelente atención. En la recepcion de royal service Nichte nos recibio excelente, ella se preocupo por ofrecernos un servicio impecable. En el restaurante market grill hay que felicitar a Melvin que fue nuestro mesero en la 2da cena, ya que fue una atención muy agradable y amena estando al pendiente en todo momento de nosotros como huéspedes y por último en el restaurante enso hay que felicitar a Carlos y Andrés que nos ofrecieron un servicio de lujo y aclararon todas nuestras dudas e hicieron recomendaciones en base a nuestros gustos.

reviews.author: Carlos M
reviews.title: SERVICIO ROYAL SERVICE...LO MEJOR
reviews.text:
Cuando uno esta mas de 1 semana en el lugar empieza a conocer y ver mas detalles, siempre con mi señora viajamos con otra pareja de amigos y les cuento mi experiencia

1.- El servicio del Royal Service con mayordomo Excelente el nuestro se llama RODE e hizo nuestra estadía  muy placentera, siempre dispuesto a escuchar y arreglar algunos problemillas, atento a las reservas y otros detalles, le deseo que tenga una muy buena vida se lo merece.

2.- Servicio de Playa y restaurant del Royal, a no ser por dos personas a las cuales no voy a nombrar ya que actuaron de una manera discriminatoria realmente el servico es excelente...con EDI, ALEJANDRO, RAFAEL y    , a la cabeza de los mejores mozos agradeciendo su simpatía y dedicación.

3.- Buffet, no cubrió mis expectativas, no se si es un problema de lugar, infraestructura o xq lo diseñaron asi, la cuestión es que en ningún hotel las mesas están al lado de donde se sirve la comida, y en algunos casos lo dulce esta al lado de lo salado a mi parecer no es correcto.

4.- Restaurant VENTO, lo mejor no se lo pierdan

5.- Restaurant de fusión, muy rica variedad 

6.- Restaurant Bana comida japonesa Excelente pero aca hago otro comentario, esta a paso de toda la gente me toco una mesa en la cual había dos sillones atras con gente acostada...-10

7.- Shows, la calidad de la gente que hacia los espectaculos es muy buena y da ganas de mirar y escuchar pero el lugar donde lo hacen realmente merecen una disculpa como artistas, solo la gente que esta adelante de todo los puede ver, gente parada en los camastros y no como debería ser sentados y saboreando algo rico...no tiene escenario, una cosa de locos...esto es lo primero que deberían modificar

Pero bueno en resumen, este hotel esta en el puesto 21 y con modificaciones podría estar entre los 10 primeros, a ponerse las pilas que les tengo fe.

reviews.author: marcpenny
reviews.title: Perfect for a relaxing vacation!!!
reviews.text:
Ill get straight to the point: My wife and I loved Paradisus Cancun Resort and will be returning for future vacations! 

This was our first visit to Cancun, so to say we were nervous was an understatement. Upon arriving at the airport we were greeted by representatives for our travel company "vacation express/nexus". They promptly brought my wife and I a van and whisked us away to our destination (Our friends at Vacation Express and Nexus made an excellent first impression for our first trip into Mexico) 

Upon arriving at Paradisus the front lobby staff gave us a very warm and welcome greeting. Our room wasn't ready yet so they stored our luggage for us, got us checked in, and gave us our "all inclusive" wrist bands. This allowed us to go get some lunch and relax at the bar for an hour before we went up to the room. 
Nayeli at the Concierge desk was instrumental in ensuring that we had everything we needed to make our stay perfect.

There were eight of us total in our group so we rotated paying for a beach side Cabana for the week. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS! If you are beach bums like us then you just want to stay on the beach all day drinking pina coladas and rum drinks lol. The cabanas allow you to do just that! We had plenty of shade throughout the day so if we got a little to hot or to burnt we just sat in the shade and took a nap. So this next statement is very important: If you get a cabana you MUST request these three amazing gentlemen to be your servers. Here comes a name drop: Sofonia, Manuel, and David! These guys are AWESOME! We lacked for nothing while we relaxed in the cabana. And when we would visit the pool for an hour or so they looked after our stuff so we didn't have to worry about it. They kept our drinks full and our made sure we had everything we needed for total relaxation. If I had to name one thing that we enjoyed the most then this was it; Our beachside cabana! 

Just to touch on food really quick. It was good (not great)! Make your reservation EARLY! We had a large group so it wasn't always easy getting the place we wanted if I was a bit behind making the reservation. 

Overall we had a wonderful time and will be returning for our next Cancun adventure! I don't have anything negative to say, because not a bit of our experience was bad. The resort staff made every effort to make our stay as wonderful as they could, and in that they succeeded! THANK YOU PARADISUS! FOR EVERYTHING! Especially our new friends Nayeli, Sofonia, Manuel, and David!

reviews.author: Alfredo P
reviews.title: Simplemente lo mejor
reviews.text: El hotel lo tiene todo, comida, atención, servicio, cordialidad, lo recomiendo si quieren gozar de unas vacaciones de primera. La gente que trabaja en el hotel te hace sentir como en casa. Están muy atentos con el servicio al cliente, la gran variedad de comida en los restaurantes no te haran salir de ahí, la zona de alberca y mar muy limpios, de lo mejor que he conocido. Tal vez la única observación es la zona de bar, un poco con la preferencia al extranjero. Pero ha seguir gozando... aún me quedan un par de días. Vengan a conocerlo....

reviews.author: halk
reviews.title: Paradeusus cancun
reviews.text: We are members of Malia and as always another great resort . The personal are wounderfull and always want to help you. The food is by far the best , and the beach is really the best. Melia can't be beat.

reviews.author: tring2016
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Had a great time.  Butler Rosanna was superb.  Very attentive.  Went the extra mile everyday.  Enso restaurant was the best.  They were actually closed when we arrived and they still managed to give us friendly quality service.   Food is soooo good!!!

reviews.author: Lin Rebecca
reviews.title: 有點金玉其外的飯店
reviews.text:
我們入住的是面對加勒比海的雙人房，房間內的設施和風景都沒話說；餐廳的選擇也很多：包含自助餐，日式，墨西哥式，地中海式及巴西式料理，還有一家需自費的米其林主廚監製餐廳，價錢也算合理。
糟糕的是當晚上下起暴風雨時，房間竟然開始漏水，而且是很多間房都漏水，實在有點難以接受。

reviews.author: carlosandrad
reviews.title: Beatuful Hotel!
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel, very well located & great service! Room service was very good, The food, the service, the room and hotel cleanliness were all amazing, amenities were great, and the staff was very friendly

reviews.author: Nick L
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort & Great Staff
reviews.text:
Well first i will have to say a friend and I had the Royal Service package. For us when we booked it was slightly more but definitely worth the price difference. 

Thanks to our butler Rode, (highly recommended to request him) we were upgraded from a lagoon view to a beach view at no extra cost. They provided us with early check in at about 1 pm. We did email them 1 week prior to confirm as well as a request a room on a high floor, and we were accommodated. They also provided a cell phone to contact our butler and he always answered.

Most of our stay was in the royal service section (we have access to the whole resort) which is a seperate building that is still connected to the rest of the resort. It consists of a 2 private pools and  a restaurant / bar with a beach view. The service was impeccable. poolside drink service was easy to get. The pools were clean and they provided towels, sunscreen etc. They even had beach drink service. 

The buffet is one of the best I've seen they can accommodate almost any diet I would say . They even had gluten free bread. Seafood galore, Vegetables, Salads, Deserts, meats breads fresh juices all cooked to perfection. 

I'd definitely stay there again

reviews.author: T Corey
reviews.title: Ah Summer 16 Ah Summer 16
reviews.text:
Overall the resort is great. The lobby areas are like you are outside with the heat. Not extremely the most comfortable. The rooms are nice although we did have a few tiny bugs crawling around tables. No big deal after all, we are in Cancun. The staff are great including but, not limited to Yhoni Gonzalez-Torres, who welcomed us with a friendly smile and of course a shot of tequila. He made us laugh and shared some local visits we should check out. He was great and remembered us every time he saw us near the main lobby. 

Also, Jesus at the middle bar (next to Bana sushi spot) was fantastic. Him and his coworker were on top of everything. Made his "special" drink which was delicious. 

Overall, we had a great time! Thank you guys!

reviews.author: Frank F
reviews.title: What a place
reviews.text: I just finished my stay at royal service and I have nothing to complain about the staff was amazing especially our Butler rode he was amazing he got us a better room made sure we had everything he made our stay 1000 time better if u go here I would opt for the royal service and ask for rode as your Butler he will make your stay so amazing he treat with such a warm heart and he treat like family more then guest so many food choice pool is amazing

reviews.author: KatieWilks19
reviews.title: We will definitely be going back!
reviews.text: My boyfriend, our two best friends, and I came here in May right after graduation. We are 21 and 22 and we weren't looking for a crazy party resort. We wanted something very nice, relaxing, but fun for all of us to spend time together. Paradisus exceeded our expectations by far. The entire resort was immaculate, the staff was unbelievably courteous and helpful the entire week and the resort and the beach were just beautiful. The food was amazing and there were so many options. It was extremely easy to go from our cabana bed by the pool to take a dip or sit by the ocean which was only a short walk away. There was always someone helping us and checking up on us wherever we were. Needless to say we didn't want to leave. We purchased the royal service package which was well worth it. Juan helped us all week and he was amazing, so a special thank you to him. I would recommend this resort and the Royal service package to anyone and we are already planning on coming back!

reviews.author: Meli M
reviews.title: Muy bueno pero pudo estar mejor
reviews.text: Dentro de todo bien, pero pudo ser mejor para un hotel de 5 estrellas. Lo bueno, es que nos dieron una habitación frente al mar y se veia el sunset, lindo! Lo malo es que el aire acondicionado de la habitación se filtraba la humedad y el olor de la habitación era malo. Lamentablemente no nos pudieron cambiar de habitación pero si nos compensaron con entrada a Royal Service que estuvo bueno.

reviews.author: Mary
reviews.title: Amazing & beyond our expectations!
reviews.text:
Been wanting to experience an all-inclusive for the first time, and Paradisus Cancun happened to be our chosen resort. NO REGRETS. Went here on July 11-15, and unfwe wished we could have stayed longer! 

The staff at the resort are EXTREMELY welcoming and accommodating. No matter what corner you turn, there will always be someone there to assist you. Super friendly and helped in any way they could. 

The rooms were super spacious! My best friend and I shared a Junior suite lagoon view. And although we did not have ocean view, the room itself was amazing! We had a living room space with couches and a mini fridge that was constantly being refilled. Two washrooms with a shower in each, two balconies, a closet full of essentials and of course, our beds (in a separate room) that were super comfy, and always made done by the amazing staff- Thank you!! We also had AC that was either monitored from the living room or our bedroom. Wifi was also great in the rooms, not so much in the lobby though.

The beach is clean and well maintained. The only down part was that we went on a week where the waves were horrible, however that is aside from Paradisus' fault. There are many beach chairs and huts to lay under. There are always always always staff on the beach giving refreshments. The pools were great as well! However we wished that the pool bar was kept for adults only. We felt uncomfortable drinking in front of young children. 

As for food, they did not disappoint! We attempted to try all the restaurants, but our days fell short so we only had the chance to try out a few - Bana,  La Palapa, Blue Agave, Naos, Market Grill. They were all so amazing and the variety they served was outstanding! As for the drinks, they served a great selection! Don Julio definitely was our drink during our stay. They also made amazing cocktails and made great recommendations when it came to drinks. 

Special mentions to Jose and Jorge from La Palapa who made our dinner extra special. They not only ensured a well delivered meal, but they also entertained us well making our dinner extra special. Their hospitality, kindness and charisma is greatly appreciated! 

Overall, this resort was amazing! I had very little expectations as it was our first all-inclusive. However this resort definitely gave us high standards and we will 100% be coming back. Pictures really don't do this resort justice! Must see this resort in person!! 

Thank you very much to the staff of Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: Stephane G
reviews.title: No AC on July lobby.. it so hot..
reviews.text: I stay with some friends over 3 nights. Place is amazing when you arrive you don't notes there is not AC inside just on in close areas like the main waiting check in, and then some restaurants not all have Ac running so if you are the persons that needs AC all times don't Stay here they have fans stands around for air flow on the sushi restaurant is amazing because the plants hanging in the middle.. Ac on rooms can't be ajust is set. Also we have a problem with a guy that works there, he ask me what room I was staying the First night we arrive and he have other rooms numbers  on a notebook he asked what we like and what we didn't, I just wake up in the middle of the night and saw him standing there.. I wake up the next morning and check the door the door wasn't locked we forgot to looked, I asked my friends is they saw someone here last night, next night we make sure was lock, when I leave i make sure they knew about it at the front desk... so lock you door also if you stay here.. specially if you come with  young kids. I won't stay here again. Sorry.. also they have a bar where you have to buy a shisha or buy a bottle to sit there.. so we were thinking we can enjoy the place we already paid all inclusive. :(. Good things beds are very clean and comfortable, sushi resturant with reservation excellent food and service and music at night. That's what most enjoyable thing about the place. The pool is ok but not the best. The beach is clean but you can sit outside with out paying.. so ...

reviews.author: murphguard
reviews.title: Nice all inclusive
reviews.text:
Went on a boys trip with my cousin to Cancun.
The resort was beautiful and clean. The beach was larger than the properties near Paradisus. The sand was clean, white and powdery.
There were multiple pools that were kept clean.
This resort is great for families and couples. This was boys trip and there were not that many single young women at the resort. However, the nightlife strip was a bus ride away which made up for the lack of single people. 

The entertainment at the pool was slow for three days and then picked up the last days of our trip. We spent most of our time at the main pool bar (Rodger was a great bartender). Our favorite poolside waitress was Asuncion, she was fantastic.

After a checking inn incident we were upgraded to a ocean front view room. I will never book a room without ocean view again. The view was breathtaking. The room was not very cool and the ac seemed to have mildew around the edge- but it was no big deal since we only slept in the room. The room had a mini fridge with beer, water, soda, juices and three snacks. 

Blue Agave was our favorite spot to eat, Carlos was our favorite waiter here. The food all around the resort was average nothing special. 

We made friends and hung out with them at the pool bar and Coco's beach bar the whole trip. The entertainment in the Red Lounge and at the Main Pool can be improved by being more modern and lively. 

Overall, this is a beautiful and large resort. We would definitely come back.

reviews.author: Annie E
reviews.title: Amazing vacation
reviews.text:
This was a spectacular stay. The resort is pristine- so clean. The staff was wonderful, everyone was so kind. Very safe environment. Family resort- not many crazy, partiers even during spring break. Room service was quick and on top of things. The room was clean, always, and very spacious. you get a BANG for your buck.

The beach was huge and clean. not noisy. fresh towels and bar service provided. I relaxed there every day. crystal clear blue water; no seaweed

The food was generally good. The Asian cuisine restaurant in the center of the resort is great. the buffet is great. The Brazilian/Argentinian steak how was great. "Mole" was great. 
However, Vento was not impressive, actually the food was pretty bad :/ Additionally, their beach side bar food was not great. But that's the only negative thing I can say about my whole stay.

reviews.author: Camilla C
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text:
Lugar maravilho, várias opções de café da manhã, almoço e janta. 
Ficamos em um quarto de frente ao mar, não tenho nem o que dizer né ?! 
Funcionários sempre muito bem educados e dispostos a ajudar.
A única coisa que tenho a reclamar, mas que não seja relevante para muitas pessoas, é a iluminação dos quartos. 
A iluminação a noite é amarelada e de baixa intensidade no que atrapalha um pouco para se arrumar a noite, como fazer maquiagem. Muitas pessoas não se importam com isso, mas acho que muitas mulheres sentem falta de uma boa iluminação :) 
No mais, foi tudo perfeito

reviews.author: John T
reviews.title: Great Week
reviews.text: This was a week to spend with friends and rest. Both of these were done a ton and the week was GREAT. Can't wait to go back  The value for this hotel is great. The only down was the A/C in common areas is not very good. Service was fabulous and the staff was always ready to meet your every need. I would suggest the Royal Service for the adult,quiet, kid free get-away.

reviews.author: BlissfulinVestal
reviews.title: Great for the price. We'd go back.
reviews.text:
Everything was great. We stayed in the adults only area, and the food at La Palapa (for adults only section) was great. The other restaurants were all very similar - did not have AC, same core meals presented with different names. The staff was very good about keeping families from the other side with kids off the beach and around the adults only pool. Suggestions: 1) adults only pool needs freshening up with paint, etc., although they keep it very clean. 2) They need to wash the coverings on the pillows and mattress of the bali beds more often. We covered with towels - which were in ample supply. 3) Disallow personal blue-tooth speakers. People set up on the beach or by the pool and blast their music over speakers. 4) Designate a smoking area.
We want to recognize the servers who really care about their job: Around the pool was Alejandro. I don't remember his last name but he wears braces. The best. At La Palapa, the best server is Edier Cab. He was funny, nice, attentive - just great overall.

reviews.author: Chimelle
reviews.title: Best vacation ever!
reviews.text:
My bestie vacation buddy and I embarked on our 4th trip together this past May.  On the recommendation of our travel agent, we booked The Royal Service at Paradisus Cancun.  It truly was the best vacation either of us have ever been on.  My only regret is that it's taken me so long to write this review as we promised Fernando, our butler that we would get on it immediately.  Sorry Fernando :(

The moment we arrived we were escorted to a private lounge to wait for someone to bring us to our preferred check in.  At check in we were asked for a drink order while we get settled in.  Initially we were told we had one king bed which was not ideal for two girlfriends traveling together, but that got quickly rectified and then we were introduced to Fernando.  He brought us to our room, went over every detail of the resort, the restaurants, etc with us and then proceeded to make our dinner reservations for the week. (Which we altered daily)  He also booked our spa treatments which was included in our package.   Last, but not least, Fernando gave us a cell phone with his number programmed.  Call him and he's at our service!  We tested this theory by leaving sunglasses in the room that we didn't realize until we were toes in the sand.  Think Fernando will bring the glasses?  He sure did, with a big smile!  (See picture)   Everything about this hotel was magnificent.  Our balcony overlooking the beautiful Caribbean, the restaurants were each better than the last, the pina coladas with Fleur de Cana floaters that were delivered all day to our Bali bed or lounge chair without even ordering.  The staff got to know us and what we liked and had food made for us that wasn't even on the menu!  

We utilized the fitness center nearly everyday and were thrilled to find not just a room with machines, but another with pilate balls and mats that allowed us to do our circuit training.  The locker room/shower was clean and always stocked with water and towels. 

The only complaint we had was about the spa manager.  She was very rude.  Our package included spa treatments, which at first they tried to deny us, but finally agreed to provide.  The included treatment was a Swedish Massage.  We both preferred Deep Tissue and asked if we could upgrade, at our cost of course.  The difference in price on the spa menu was $20, however she tried to charge us $44 each for the upgrade.  When we explained the simple math equation she treated us like she was doing us a favor allowing the upgrade at all.  We walked out.  However, our spa story doesn't end there, because Awesome Fernando worked with his manager and the spa managers superior to get us our massages as deep tissue with not upgrade charge due to how poorly we were treated.  YAY Fernando, we love you!!!!!!

Overall, the resort, the staff, the food, the everything was perfect.  Just skip the spa.

reviews.author: denisesylvia32
reviews.title: 40th Birthday with friends
reviews.text: Loved this resort. It was very relaxing. We did the royal service and our butler Geraldo was great! He was very kind and went the extra mile decorating our room for our birthday's. Javier at the pool was great as well when it came to accommodating us with the Bali beds. Ceasar was our server at the beach, he checked on our needs frequently. We didn't have to look for him at all. This is a great resort.. I loved having access to the entire resort.

reviews.author: Fernando J J
reviews.title: Un verdadero Paraíso del Caribe Mexicano
reviews.text:
Es un Hotel Maravilloso y enorme. Muy bien situado. Con albercas y playas espectaculares.Es all inclusive. Toda la atención es muy esmerada del personal.
Volvería siempre y es altamente recomendable. Es muy moderno y elegante.

reviews.author: aprilreina
reviews.title: Girls 40th Birthday Trip
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus from 7/19-7/23 we chose Royal  service our butler was Geraldo. He was the absolute best, very kind and considerate responsive and always with a smile. Great personality!! He made all our reservations and he surprised us with flowers on our beds and wine one night, and balloons and confetti another night! Sweet surprises that made the trip memorable. Javier by the pool was great! He did everything he could to accommodate us and our request. Cesar by the beach service was the best! He made sure we received everything we needed!!!! The resort looked exactly like pictures but better, was very clean and everyone who worked there responded to every thing we said!!!

Tips: sunset grill has burgers, fries, chicken wings chicken sandwiches and hotdogs you can take with you.

Market Grill was delicious as well as Mole (all 3 of our favs) 

Royal service has Bali beds they're about 5 that are beach side so request that from your butler so he knows you want a beach one

Red lounge has great music and the show in avenue was worth watching

There's music and activities in the middle pool of your in Royal service your almost secluded but have the ability to go everywhere so if your with our kids I recommend it!!

Enjoy the Paradisus comes highly recommended.

reviews.author: juliaps1
reviews.title: Ubicación excelente
reviews.text: El hotel es cómodo buenos restaurantes personal atento lindas piscinas nohay niños que perturben a los q quieren descansar del bullicio. Pero hay q tener cuidado con el personal q atiende en el chekin porque luego te sacan mas cuentas q las que inicialmente tomaste y por todo te sacan mas dinero.

reviews.author: indhira5
reviews.title: Happy Medium!
reviews.text: Beautiful resort! Very luxurious. The good: the food was delicious, the employees were great very accommodating and always going above and beyond. Love the fact they have a section where no kids are allowed "royal service". My husband and I have no kids so we like going to all adults resorts. Very impressed since we were skeptical about going to a family resort.This was the exception because we were attending a wedding. The could be better. The buffet for breakfast, they had great variety but if you wanted eggs you needed to be willing to wait 10-15 minutes! There has to be a better way. What I didn't like; the pools depth. Not much to cater to us shorties. I believe 5'7 was the most shallow. Not the most comfortable thing for someone with a drink on hand that's 5'1.... The beach was beautiful but very rough. The waves were pretty violent. Beach service was great we can order food/drinks and always had someone coming around asking if everything was ok. In addition, didn't like that their AC in the red lounge was not optimal. They also don't have AC in the hallways. Let me highlight this place is huge!!! You will be walking for a while before you reach your destination. I think it took me half of my vacation to figure out where my room was lol. I personally didn't like that you have to make reservations for all restaurants for dinner. ( they are very flexible with switching times and adding people). Checkout was horrendous, we had an early flight so I went to check out at 6am. It took the person almost over 15 minutes to checkout the person in front of us....The night time shows were nice. The daytime entertainment could be better. Good luck if you need to dial 0. Operator is not always responsive. This resort is about 15 minutes in bus to the nightlife. Overall it was a great vacation!

reviews.author: Sonny D
reviews.title: Don't stay here
reviews.text: Pool staff were awesome, most staff work really hard. Some (very few) are lazy. Painting during stay. Very pushy timeshare. Reservation screw ups, lack of towels. No communication about activities. Hot hot hot, some restaurants not so good. Mole and Market Grill were awesome. Poor quality of breakfast.
