Two of us were sick after we got home from travelers diarrhea...

reviews.author: Jillian S
reviews.title: A dime a dozen
reviews.text: This hotel is a dime a dozen and doesn't really stand out compared to any other Mexican or Caribbean resort.  First, they were always short on towels.  In order to get a towel, you needed to go to the towel stand very early in the morning.  There were also not enough lounge chairs.  You need to get up early, get a towel and leave it on a lounge chair to guarantee yourself a towel and a chair.  The food was just ok, nothing special.  The rooms were very nice and very clean.  I will say that the ocean was beautiful.  We stayed at the ocean most of time since the pool was too hot.  We did do a zip lining tour with Selvatica and that was awesome.  I highly recommend that.  When returning to Cancun, I will more than likely explore other hotel options

reviews.author: Alexa J
reviews.title: Waiter: Guadencio
reviews.text: Every morning my friends and I would eat at the breakfast buffet and Guadencio was our server. What a wonderful, hard worker and someone who could always give us a good laugh in the morning. I would highly recommend his service to anyone, as he brightened my stay at the Paradisus, which is a perfect vacation destination!

reviews.author: Shamonique
reviews.title: The Best Vacation Ever
reviews.text: My stay at the Paradisus was memorable. The workers worked hard, extremely friendly, & always had a smile on their faces. Juan, our butler, was beyond fantastic. I would recommend this hotel. Love it!

reviews.author: tumwater12
reviews.title: Beautiful place
reviews.text: Great place! It's huge! We loved the pool. The staff was great. They treat you like a king down at the pool. The food was good too. My only complaint was the long driveway. Long walk to catch the bus, lol. Our friends had been many times and knew their way around like the locals. We definitely will be going back!

reviews.author: David V
reviews.title: Great Vacation for family or friends!
reviews.text: Went on a guys trip to do some fishing and relaxing! Hotel was clean, food was good and service was good! The Royal Service is worth it for the upgrade! The hotel had plenty of activities for children if you have kids and Isla Mujeras was great!

reviews.author: Joyc28
reviews.title: Celebrating 30
reviews.text: The room was amazing! Everyone was so friendly and helpful! I stayed for 5 days and 4 nights. Everynight and day was great! All of the restaurants were great! The only night we had that was a little weird was our last night. We didn't get our turn down service in the evening.  Other than that this one the resort in Cancun! Yhoni is the best ever! I would definitely stay there again and again!

reviews.author: Patricia R
reviews.title: Super Duper Great Staff
reviews.text: 2nd time at this resort. Do not expect for the rooms at the adults only Royal Service side to be any nicer.Tacos at Blue Agave amazing/authentic. Picana/ steak at La Palapa, WOW! I Special thanks to person in charge of cleaning my sons room. 3118 between Jun. 29 - Jul. 6. Everyone was great. Super special thanks to Armando, Alejandro, Victor (pool Bar) Andrea (always smiling was everywhere) Rode(our concierge ) Everyone at the Palapa (Too many names and last but not least . Our waiter and sometimes bartender at the Royal Service area Victor Manuel Cavich. Always had a smile.Will always remember his special attention in making me his awesome Pitalla ( dragon fruit) drink. We have stayed at  11 resorts in Cancun. At this one twice. 6 years ago and now . So I know for a fact that the quality of service has improved by 110 % Extremely hard working people. The ungrateful guest they have to put up with sometimes and yet they always keep a smile. My admiration to them all. .

reviews.author: tanjapayton
reviews.title: Amazing experience at the Paradisus La Perla.
reviews.text: This was my first time at Paradisus La Perla and it was amazing.  I went there as part of a Fitness Vacation Exchange program where I taught Zumba for the week.  The food was exquisite and some of the best meals I have ate.  Our room was wonderful and the view overlooking the pool was awesome.  The staff at the resort were  super friendly and the entertainment staff which I dealt with because of teaching Zumba were always willing to help out and provide me whatever I needed.  The entertainment provided in the evening was great.  I will definitely be referring this resort to others to stay when they visit Cancun.

reviews.author: marianazuzunaga
reviews.title: Summer vacation
reviews.text: The hotel was great, the staff was very nice, not as much activities for kids as we expected but overall was good. The food was good but the was at Bana Restaurant we made reservations there more because the restaurants was very nice than for the food, was a Japanese Fusion but the food was very good, the service was excellent and our Server Yair Perez was the best he was very patient with our crazy crew!!!!

reviews.author: Gerardo Glez Girón
reviews.title: Nada ha cambiado
reviews.text: He venido a este hotel en varias ocaciones desde hace 10 años y todo sigue igual , misma decoración, mismos restaurantes a excepción que el front desk cambió a una área cerrada y cómoda , el servicio continúa siendo bueno , la calidad de la alimentación regular a excepción del restaurante Tempo que es excelente , sus albercas y áreas libreas amplias y limpias así como las habitaciones , precio calidad asegurado con una estancia confortable

reviews.author: SharyZ
reviews.title: Wonderful property!
reviews.text: We stayed at the hotel in June and it was amazing.  The only complaint we had was the food was so so at the restaurants.  The buffet was as expected for a buffet and was good.  For our dinners, however, none of the places we ate at really blew us away.  We just thought they were ok.  I have had better at other all inclusive's.  But this hotel made up for that in every other area.  Very clean, beautiful property.  Close to town.  The staff was by far the best out of any of the places we've been to in Cancun.  We felt totally pampered.  Exactly what we needed.  We would go back!

reviews.author: Michele000
reviews.title: Ehhh, expected more!
reviews.text: Didn't feel pampered. Didn't like how I had to ask for things that I was supposed to just get. Service wasn't above and beyond. Drinks were good, appetizers were good at restaurant near pool. Room service was good, also.

reviews.author: KARIS S
reviews.title: Beautiful but not worth it!!!
reviews.text: I had the opportunity to stay at another Melia resort in D.R. in the VIP section ( The Level), and unfortunately was very disappointed in the Royal Service at Paridisus Cancun. We did not receive any extra royal treatment besides the self service bar and La Palapa restaurant. The staff was unfriendly and unable to answer simple questions. The hotel and beach itself were absolutely beautiful. I think that this was a more family oriented low key resort. I would not recommend this resort to a younger crowd.

reviews.author: Shelley O
reviews.title: Paradises round 2...Excellent resort with amazing restaurants
reviews.text: I stayed at this hotel for my 40th birthday with friends and we had a blast. This is the second Paradiso's hotel I have stayed at and loved every Minute. The service was excellent from the time we walked in the door of the time we left. This is the second hotel in this chain that I have stayed with and enjoyed the beautiful modern for the decor and amazing atrium plants and similar restaurants. Make sure you make your reservation early to secure time and restaurant choice. The buffet area for breakfast or dinner was very nice with the option of outdoor seating looking out towards the ocean.

reviews.author: Kelsey J
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: My fiancé and I attended a friend's wedding at paradisus cancun and had a blast. We stayed in Royal Service and if you are interested in an adults only feel, I highly recommend. Our butler Sergio was amazing. The wedding was beautiful. The royal service pool / breakfast / lunch / pool snacks were delicious. I wish they would have played some kind of music at the pool. I also wish they would have had a swim up bar on the royal service side. Highly recommend hotel for anyone looking for a relaxing trip!

reviews.author: Helena Pereira P
reviews.title: Férias excelentes
reviews.text: Estivemos em Cancun em março de 2016, do Paradisus Royal Service. Foi uma experiência impar! Atendimento de primeira, e comida excelente. Tinhamos sempre reservado um restaurante do hotel para jantar. Não deixem de ir no Restaurante Tempo, esse é pago, mas vale muito a pena! O SPA também é incrível, você sai renovada!! Todos passavam informações para ajudar no que precisávamos. Simplesmente incrível! Os quartos são amplos e limpos de acordo com sua necessidade, isto é, você pode pedir que limpem em determindado horário que não atrapalhe seu itinerário. Recomendo a todos que precisam de relax sem preocupações.

reviews.author: Ashley B
reviews.title: Cancun 2016
reviews.text: In June 2016, I went to my cousins Bachelorette party in Cancun, Mexico and stayed at Paradisus Resort. The service and our stay there was amazing!! Every employee went out of their way to accommodate us and make us feel like royalty. Upon arrival, I got a Welcome to Mexico tequila shot from Ignacio Vazquez from Naos Restaurant and he was very welcoming and kind. He made our stay that much special and took care of us every time we ate there. A big thank you to the entire staff, we highly recommend anyone going to stay there and we will definitely be back!!

reviews.author: Guayabi
reviews.title: Problema habitación
reviews.text: Lamentablemente un dia al ingresar  a nuestra habitación la encontramos inundada, todo el sector de acceso principal, sector de closets,  producto de no tener mantenimiento aire acondicionado que genero problemas con nuestro equipaje.

reviews.author: karlacalbear
reviews.title: A Great Week at Cancun Paradisus
reviews.text: This was our 2nd trip to Cancun Paradisus. Our first trip was in 2014. Their main pool is huge and great for an early morning exercise swim or later lounging around and chatting with other guests. Ingrid Cordova, our main poolside server for the week was awesome! We enjoyed the morning buffet, poolside lunches at Sunset Grill, and all the restaurants that we tried. Our favorites were Fuego (Amazing Flank Steak, nice servers Gameliel & Angel) and Market Grill (great service by Efrain & Manuel & Melvin). We are part of Club Melia Vacation Plan and have lots of space in our studios. We truly enjoyed our week relaxing by and in the pool or on the beach with our kindles and drinks. USA Transfers is the best way to shuttle from airport or take for an excursion. We took them to Xcaret for 5 hours. So much better than the large tour busses. Beautiful place for getaway beach vacation.

reviews.author: RobertoyVilma
reviews.title: ultima visita a cancun
reviews.text:
Hola estuve hospedado en la habitación 3626 la semana pasada del 12-16 y esta fue mi segunda visita a México, primero estuve hospedado en el Royalton cancun y ahora en este esperando haberme equivocado del primero, pero para sorpresa mia, fue la misma decepción.
del hotel les diré que tiene buena instalaciones y me parece bien distribuido aunque si muy caluroso en la parte central donde deberian de poner algún aire condicionado ya que es un área cerrada sin ventilación, problema que se resuelve sin contratiempos.
lo que me resulta no agradable es la atención del personal en mucho del los casos para no generalizar no tienen la carisma necesaria para atender a un cliente, ni la gentileza de al menos atender a uno correctamente, en nuestro caso (y digo nuestro porque viajamos un grupo de 10 personas) si no les dábamos propina no nos atendían y se demoraban bastante , no quiero pensar en discriminación por ser latino igual que ellos, pero mejor atendían a un extranjero de habla inglesa que a un extranjero de habla hispana, (los invito a que viajen a punta cana para que aprendan como se atiende a un cliente), conmigo viajaron dos duenos de compania que yo los invite a conocer cancun y se llevaron la misma opinión ademas mi hija como duena de agencia de viaje esta al tanto de todos mis viajes y mis opiniones para sus clientes se siente decepcionada porque sus cliente en la mayoría son latinos. espero que mejoren la atención o simplemente contraten personal de rep dominicana para que vean la diferencia

reviews.author: Leandro C
reviews.title: FÉRIAS PERFEITAS
reviews.text: adorei. resort maravilhoso. tratamento dos funcionários excepcional, super atenciosos, comida variada e uma delícia, café da manhã perfeiro, todo complexo lindo e impecável em todos os detalhes, quarto sempre arrumado, limpo e cheiroso

reviews.author: Snipe J
reviews.title: Got a Bang for my Buck!
reviews.text:
The hotel is nice, but a bit too dark. The service was excellent!!! We were treated like Royalty!
We had the Royal Service and the woman Rosanna who took care of us was one of the best I have ever had in all my traveling, she left no stone unturned! I am returning in July and she will be requested.

reviews.author: madisonpeyton
reviews.title: Best Trip Yet.
reviews.text: My husband and I went to Cancun in October but wanted to try a different resort this time. We chose this resort due to the great reviews and variety of restaurants/bars. What a wonderful choice that we made. From the minute we arrived until we left, everything was amazing. Pictures do not do this resort justice when it comes to the beauty. The staff went above and beyond to make us feel so special. We were considering doing the royal service, but decided not to as we wanted to put extra money towards excursions. Without the Royal service, we still received the best service possible! The Market Grill was our favorite restaurant on the resort! The bartender, Louis, helped us have the best time by serving us amazing drinks and making special drinks for each of us. With six in our party, we all had the best time and highly would recommend this resort to anyone. My husband and I rented a Bali bed for the day, the price was $100 but due to it being 1:00 already I talked the staff member into letting us have for $80. As many of these beds by the pool and beach were empty, a possible lowering of the price would be more beneficial for both the resort and those who are staying there. Service at Bali bed all day was impeccable.  We were so afraid that rainy forecast would ruin our trip, but due to the great staff and amenities we received, it was the best trip. The only complaint that we had is due to it raining throughout majority of our trip, there were some leaks throughout the resort. With that, towels were placed on the floors. Other than that, no other complaints whatsoever. When returning to Cancun, this will be the resort that we chose yet again!

reviews.author: McDonaldma
reviews.title: Nice Resort
reviews.text: Would recommend this resort.  Just always felt we were missing something.  The property is beautiful.  The ocean was too rough to swim in the ocean.  The pool was extensive and perfect.  The food was very good at the buffet.  We did not really like the restaurant menus.

reviews.author: Travelqueen324
reviews.title: Awesome resort - Royal Service was great!
reviews.text: We recently went on a girls trip Paradisus Cancun and we stayed at the Royal Service and had an awesome time.  The staff were all very nice and the hotel was extremely clean.The  Royal Service section of the resort is very peaceful and serene.  We met our butler(ess)  Rosanna who was AMAZING, she was super thoughtful and sweet.  I can not wait to go back with my husband.

reviews.author: Janet67Ottawa
reviews.title: Royal Service
reviews.text: My friend and I upgraded to the Royal Service, thank goodness we did!  The Royal Service area was quiet, and peaceful, one day, Saturday, was not.  The pool area is for Royal Service guests only, it tends to an upscale clientele, so on Saturday, to our surprise, they had a very loud DJ playing rock, and two "dancers" for 4 hours with no escape. The dancer looked like she was missing her pole,  I feel they should of had a different type of music, and no tacky dancers.  Other than that, the Royal Service was very nice, our butler was fantastic, he made all our reservations and booked our beds down by the pool.   The staff was outstanding.  The food was good, not exceptional.  The  rooms will be getting a much needed upgrade by February.

reviews.author: TH C
reviews.title: So. Much. Fun
reviews.text:
Just came back from an 8-day stay at Paradisus. Did not meet one staff who was incompetent or unfriendly. Was pleasantly greeted every corner and had a wonderful stay. Rooms are clean and spacious, the cleaning staff are very consistent and attentive. 

The front desk staff are not as friendly as the service staff - they don`t budge on the upgrades or special requests unless there`s something really wrong with your experience. (one of our rooms had AC problems and they didn't switch our rooms until the fifth time we called). They`d rather make you pay. They also take photocopies of your passports upon checking-in (reasonable) and don`t give it back to you when you check out (unreasonable). Make sure you insist on getting your copy back because the front desk lady said they're not really sure what they do with them after we check out. 

Although this resort is very much family friendly - i came here for my girlfriend's bachelorette party and had a blast. 

Each server paid close attention to our requests. Please don`t forget to tip the staff! We tipped $2-3 every time someone attended to us in gratitude to their great service!!

The food at each restaurant was great - i`d recommend each one of them except Enso. Room service was great, took about 20-40 mins to come but didn`t disappoint each time. 

Now on to my favorite staff:

1. Andres at Nespresso bar brightened up our days. He recommended great drinks and never stopped smiling even when the line got very busy. He remembers each customer and always attempts to put a smile on your face. He went the extra mile and taught us girls some spanish sayings that we will never forget. He even composed a song for us at some point of our trip.

2. Miguel at Naos - he works the dinner shift and always offered us tequila even when we declined. He gave us the `mexican trio`shot one night and that was an experience i`ll ever forget. He always waved to us through the window even if we were walking by.

3. The beach server ladies in front of Club Coco - i didn`t get their names but i`m so thankful to have met them. They probably have the toughest jobs out there in the hot sun and walking in the sand all day. Each time they walked by they asked if we were okay, brought water and refilled our ice even when we didn`t ask for it. I`m sad we didn`t get to say bye before we left.

4. The mimosa guys working in the Vento section during breakfast: Jorge - they always set up champagne and orange juice at our table while we were getting our food and would make the mimosas infront of us each morning. Had a great time! thank you!

Overall great experience. 

Tip: if you take the bus, don`t pay $1 USD like they tell you to - pay in PESOS which is equivalent to 50 CENTS one way.

reviews.author: VignaEve
reviews.title: Hotel Perfecto
reviews.text: Visite mucho hoteles de México ( Iberostar, Palace, Sandos ) , pero este es el hotel perfecto, estuve la el Royal Elite, su servicio y atención es excelente. Al Igual que la comida de todos los bares y restaurants del hotel.

reviews.author: Michael S
reviews.title: The Ultimate in an afordable All-Inclusive Resort
reviews.text: I have stayed in many all-inclusives over the years in many different areas.  I must say that Paradisus far exceeds ALL of the others.  We took the "Royal" upgrade for around $250 pp extra and well worth it!.  From our check in through our check out, we were pampered by staff who really enjoy the interaction with their guests.  Royal service has it's own building with private bar and snacks like caviar, cheeses, seared tuna, etc.  Also included is a private adults only pool, beach, open air restaurant (open from breakfast through lunch) with servers bringing you food and drinks, to the pool or beach when ever you like.  The restaurants are great and never overcrowded with guests.  One of our group requested a name brand white whine during dinner.  Our server checked with all of the restaurants in the resort, located the wine and had it delivered to our table, all within fifteen minutes.  The buffet was exciting and flavorful, from their inventive soups to their awesome desert selections.  And yes, your server will be happy to bring you your favorite Mango Margarita.  Oh yes.  I forgot to mention that with the Royal service you get a personal butler.  Yup!  When he escorted us to our room, he pointed out the minibar, which is included and is restocked every day.  We were asked what we like to drink...the next thing we know, he has a bottle of vodka and tequila for our personal use.  During the week he handled our restaurant reservations, minibar items ( he kept me overstocked with M&M's and Mango Fruit Juice).  The day before we left, he contacted me and requested our airline conformation number.  Later that night, he found us at an outside bar, told me that he had confirmed our return flight and gave us our boarding passes.  I have never been this satisfied with the service before!  From the time you arrive and are escorted into your Royal private lounge, where you are offered a drink and realize that the air is full of eucalyptus and you notice the sound of beautiful relaxation music, until the time that you are called to let you know that your airport transportation  has arrived, you will experience the ultimate all-inclusive experience.

reviews.author: Ozmusic
reviews.title: The staff are amazing
reviews.text:
I had the pleasure to stay at this amazing resort for a conference. The pictures speak for themselves re the facilities and decor. But it was some of the staff who really made this place special. The two guys who ran the aNespresso coffee shop were delightful and a pleasure to visit each day. Anores and Yhoni were their names and they really made my day. If I wanted to open a coffee shop in Cancun I would ask you guys to run it.
And the food at the restaurant Mole was outstanding. Really innovative and delicious. 
This is an exceptional resort which goes way beyond the 5 star standard for beauty and attention to detail. I hope to return again soon.

reviews.author: LivMarie4
reviews.title: Amazing! HIGHLY Recommend
reviews.text: This is the place to be when your in Cancun. The staff honestly makes the experience so much better. Everyone was so nice and friendly, literally every last person went above and beyond. They let us check in early and check out later on our last day due to flight arrangements. The food was delicious and Available 24/7. By the end of my trip I felt a bond with the staff that took such good care of us. The inside looks like a jungle and really brings the culture to life. Live entertainment by the pool and in the evenings. My friends and I had the pleasure of working out with Fernando! He was so funny and full of life. Overall I would definitely recommend this resort!

reviews.author: Phil M
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Hotel Paradisus Cancun on Boulevard Kukulcan Km 16.5. 
This all inclusive resort is very nice! We purchased the Royal Service package which is the adult only part of the resort with its own pool and includes butler service. Our butler Rode provided excellent service! He made our dinner reservation, reserved our beds by the pool and just simply made sure that we had everything we needed to relax and enjoy our stay.  I highly recommend requesting him if you plan on staying here. 
The hotel grounds in general are maintained beautifully and are always immaculate.  
Our room was beautiful and also very clean and included all the modern necessities such as cable tv, phone, WIFI. WIFI is available all over the resort property as well!
The waiters and waitresses at every restaurant and at the Royal Service pool were extraordinarily friendly and provided the best service I have ever experienced. Eddie, Octavio, and Javier at the Royal Service pool made sure that we always had cold water, margaritas, and snacks and they checked on us regularly. They and Rode made this one of our best vacations yet. 
The only reason I didn't give a 5 out of 5 rating is because the check-in process was slow and over whelming. It took almost an hour for the woman to check us in to the resort and to explain the Royal Service package. It was too much info at one time especially after having traveled 5 hours on a plane!  
But overall I highly recommend this resort!

reviews.author: 80danam
reviews.title: GREAT TIME, GREAT PEOPLE
reviews.text: I went with my daughter,her two friends and my girlfriend who is also one of the girl's moms.  We had a blast.  The weather was great, the rooms were plenty big and the people who work the resort area as friendly as can be.  Marco in The Market Grill, Luiz at the beach, Raul at the front entrance were especially friendly.  I love Cancun.

reviews.author: alicemaycrowley
reviews.title: Loved it definitely going to return..
reviews.text: It was our first time at this hotel and it was amazing, such a beautiful hotel inside and out and fantastic views of the beach and the ocean. The pool bar staff - Gerardo, Andres, Emmanuel, Carlos, Manuel and all the others not mentioned were absolutely brilliant, thank you to all of them for making us the best drinks and making a great atmosphere & making it fun, they are all very hard working. There is nothing bad about this hotel and we can't wait to return! recommend Avenue bar in the evening for entertainment followed by Coco's bar and then Red Lounge AND don't forget to ask for a rainbow shot ;)

reviews.author: B02908
reviews.title: beautiful resort!
reviews.text: went here with my best friend for a trip during MDW. we had the royal service package which was definitely worth it. We stayed in a more private building with a more quiet pool. The only complaint about the Royal service is the "butler" aspect, he didn't really do much he only booked our dinners we rarely saw him and he really didn't seem to care to go out of his way to offer us anything. The entire vibe of the hotel is amazing! the atmosphere is very calming yet chic at the same time. The greenery inside the building was gorgeous. The breakfast buffet was great just wasn't a fan of the eggs they used at the omelette station they didn't taste right. But all of the restaurants were amazing at the resort and even called up room service a few times for drunk munchies which was great lol.  we love the pool staff they are very attentive, Daniel was the best at attending to us at our Bali beds he is such a sweet heart we also loved Jeison at the pool bar in the public pool he was so much fun more so than the other bartenders. We wish there were more fun activities to do at night on the resort the entertainment was kind of lame it was definitely geared towards an older crowd (we are 24). The cleaning staff was amazing, I did lock my suitcase after reading precious reviwes but I'm happy to say I left with everything I came with! we had aromatherapy on our pillows and rose petals everywhere it was so pretty!! overall great stay and I will definitely be back next year

reviews.author: joharra_ceniza
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun review
reviews.text: I had an amazing stay at this hotel.  The customer service was perfect for instance, the server at the NAOS buffet remembered us after Day 1 and directed the waitress to seat us in his area.  The staff is friendly and professional. The complaints I had were the wifi was good inside the hotel and in my room but didn't reach the pool area as good.  Also, the AC in the rooms were not as cool as I hoped only because it's extremely hot and humid outside during the day.  Lastly, the ATM was not working during my last 2 days stay there so make sure you bring enough cash.  They accept dollar, even at the market place down the street.

reviews.author: Cashstro215
reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text:
Ive been to mexico twice now once to cabo san lucas and this time to cancun. I was searching around for all inclusive resorts and came across paradisus. I read the reviews and talked to my agent who also recommended this resort. 
I was not let down at all, when you first get there it can be a little overwhelming because the resort is so big. The moment you walk through the doors you are greeted with hospitality and a cold drink. I opted to do the "my time" package with the private check in so everything was quick and i was off to my room. 
I had a direct ocean view on the 5th floor, everything was included meals drinks room service etc. They have a very large pool with a swim up bar that can get very crowded quickly so i would advise you to get out there early if you plan on relaxing by the pool.

There are plenty restaurants but you will have to make reservations for them 24hrs prior and thats still not guaranteed. I tried to 
make reservations snd everything was booked pretty much everynight so i had to do the buffet a few nights. The buffet isn't bad at all, a lot of variety and flavors.
My only question is since this is mexico why cant i get a corona anywhere on the resort? Someone please explain this to me, this is my second time in mexcio staying on a resort that didnt offer corona's. Thats like me going to dunkin donuts and them saying they dont have any donuts.

reviews.author: GoPlaces647835
reviews.title: Viagem com amigos
reviews.text: Os Resorts Paradisus são excelentes, tanto o das Pirâmides na Blvd quanto o de Playa Del Carmen ! Os serviços prestados são ótimos, bares e restaurantes excelentes, danceteria ótima, os funcionários são atenciosos e todo o resort e sua decoração é de primeira e bem cuidado !!! Logo voltarei, não deixem de visitar o CocoBongo 🎉😁

reviews.author: DestWedThompson
reviews.title: Grateful Destination Wedding Guests
reviews.text:
This place exceeded our expectations beyond anything we imagined. It was our first experience with a butler, Fernando, and he was absolutely wonderful.  We LOVED his sweet surprises throughout our stay. 

All the staff genuinely seemed happy to please.   We came for a friends' destination wedding and long awaited vacation, and we will be back. We may even send our folks.

reviews.author: Sandra0775
reviews.title: Muito Bom,  mas não Exelente !!
reviews.text:
O resort é fantástico, ficou a faltar musica e algum ambiente na piscina, e não me refiro a festas loucas do spring break apenas a musica caribenha que tanto nos atrai nestes sítios, o restaurante junto a praia estava encerrado temporáriamente durante o dia, é pena seria mais uma opcão para os almoços, e a grande desilusão foi de que o que se têm que pagar a parte ou faz parte do serviço royal, como o champanhe Moet, a lagosta, e outras mordomias no passado e falo do Paradisus Punta Cana, eram um serviço normal desta cadeia e era isso que estava a espera deixando-me um pouco desapontada.
Tudo o resto foi 5 *****.

reviews.author: Jetsetter4TX
reviews.title: A fabulous vacation destination spot
reviews.text:
I come to Cancun often and stay at various resorts. Paradisus never disappoints, especially the royal service side. It is right on the beach and also has a private pool on royal side - which is adult only. The restaurants, the service, and food are superb. In fact, I usually don't leave the resort when I come here. However, the part that keeps me coming back is the Royal Service side and the team that keeps this running. The team really goes above and beyond. My butler during my visits it Antonio at Royal Service,  he is the most accommodating, always smiling, and makes sure I am taken care of during my stay - from checkin to checkout, including dinner reservations and any special requests. 

Again, the team at this property are so polite it's almost jarring. Everyone from the housekeepers to the waiters to the concierge could not have been nicer or more eager to please. It made for a great experience.

reviews.author: missehuang
reviews.title: Destination Wedding
reviews.text: I just returned from my destination wedding at Paradisus Cancun and I am SO happy that my husband and I chose to have it there! The majority of our guests stayed in Royal Service and we were all super impressed with the cleanliness, service, and comfort. Gerardo was my "butler" and he was amazing. He checked in with us every morning to see what we needed for the day, and even took it upon himself to make dinner reservations for me and my family on the last night of our stay at a restaurant we haven't tried yet. Thank you again! Leticia at the front desk concierge of Royal Service was also a pleasure to work with! She helped all my guests check in/out with no problems and helped us with reservations/bookings throughout the week. Melina, our Romance Coordinator, was amazing!! Upon arrival, she set up a meeting with us immediately to discuss wedding details. All we had to do was give her everything we needed displayed/handed out at the wedding and work with her to finalize our itinerary. After that, I just watched as everything was taken care of for us from decor, music, bridal party organization etc. The entire wait staff/servers/bartenders and housekeeping were all so friendly, it was so fun chatting with them! Everyone made me and our 45 guests incredibly comfortable, constantly bringing us drinks and making sure we were having a good time. The food, as usual, was great! My favorite restaurant has to be Vento! We all had such a fabulous time at the resort, I personally cannot wait to go back. Thank you again to all the staff here for making our wedding day something truly special and memorable :)

reviews.author: Jetsetter283
reviews.title: Truly Paradise
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel. very clean, lovely food 24/7. staff very polite and helpful, especially liked Andreas in coffee corner, fab personality, should be upgraded to reception.!! location very central on main bus route, just at front of hotel. Beach amazing and good size pools. please watch out sunbeds are dangerous they fold easily. saw three people hurt themselves including myself! shared room with two other adults, daughter and friend. lagoon view room definately not big enough for us, two beds divan size and a fold up bed added. insisted on only catering for two people with robes slippers pillows etc. asked for whole week for duvet and quilt for extra bed, it never arrived.  was special occasion so was a bit of a negative that we were so confined when we were in room. virgin rep Elouise did her best to sort things out. very nice person. restaurants very good especially enjoyed tapas. would still recommend this lovely hotel, but two people per room in lagoon view junior suite only.!!

reviews.author: rojil18
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Hotel and staff were amazing. Very attentive great service. Would recommend. Food was delicious and the drinks too. Definitely going back with more friends and family members. Can't wait to go back. Thanks.

reviews.author: Alton Custus
reviews.title: Paradisus Review
reviews.text: By far the best trip I've ever been on! Everyone at the hotel is very nice and friendly. Yhonl and Edge are two people at the hotel that made our stay even more special, they were the best! We'll definitely be back & we hope to see them two again! Also booking with our travel agent we had the opportunity to get the $1,000 hotel credit and was able to upgrade our room for the last night with royal service! I've already recommended Paradisus to many of my friends that are planning on going to Cancún!

reviews.author: jdk h
reviews.title: birthday getaway
reviews.text: love this resort I had been to paradisus in punta cana and loved it so when I went to cancun I knew I had to stay here all the melia chain resorts are great! great staff, great food, drinks, clean rooms, best location, best beacher...excellent overall!

reviews.author: juliebean512
reviews.title: Our second trip
reviews.text:
We enjoyed our trip in 2015 so much that we came back in 2016.  It was even more amazing this time.  When I checked in, they didn't say, "Welcome Back".  They said, "Welcome Home", and honestly - that's how it felt.  Like home, but much much more relaxing.  We stayed at the Royal Service.  The rest of the hotel is very nice, but if you can afford it and you don't have kids, I would recommend the Royal Service very highly.

When we came to the hotel, we were greeted by a hostess of sorts, who had us sit in a room - and then we were escorted to check in at the Royal Service desk.  Juan Carlos helped us check in and introduced us to our butler, Rode.  Rode was wonderful - he helped with restaurant reservations - and he decorated my room three times since it was my birthday.

One of the reasons to stay at the Royal Service is access to La Palapa restaurant.  It is only for the Royal Service guests.  I ate breakfast there every morning.  The waitstaff are so friendly and remember you and take such good care of you.  Eddie and Valeria were there most every morning.  They seem so warm and genuine. 

Since this time it was not part of an Award trip, we had a lot more time to ourselves.  There are many people who might consider what we did to be a waste of time - but the majority of our trip was spent in one of the Bali Beds pictured.  We were near the ocean, but in the shade, with unlimited refreshments and time to read.  It was fantastic.  Omar and Daniel were the gentlemen who helped us make reservations for the Bali Beds, and they are amazing.  They remembered my name and how many towels I liked and walked us to the bed so that we could get everything set up "just so" every morning.  They even changed the rotation of the cushions so that we could face the ocean, rather than the pool.

The wait staff at the Royal Service pool/Bali Beds are exceptional.  Cesar, Alejandro and Jesue were the ones we saw most often.  They walked so quickly between the beds, but I never felt like they rushed through our time together.  They made suggestions and remembered our drinks.  They brought buckets full of ice and bottled water, and changed the ice through the day so our water stayed cold.  

Once again, we didn't take part in many of the nightlife options.  Truthfully, it didn't seem like a "party" hotel.  There were families at one end - adults only on the other, and a mix in between.  

We were in a slightly smaller room than the year before, but that was not a drawback for us.  For one thing, we didn't spend much time in the room - and the balcony was the same size - so plenty big with a gorgeous view of the ocean.  And for another reason, it felt like the AC was able to keep the room much cooler than the year before.  

The hotel itself had some improvements since the year before, and it seemed as though they were still making some while we were there.  It's definitely not a new resort, but it has great "bones" and the service is just unparalleled. I truly do miss all of the staff there and wish I could turn around and go back immediately.  It won't be my last trip there.

reviews.author: Roweena D
reviews.title: Abraham Hicks Land Cruise
reviews.text: The Paradisus was fabulous our waiters at Naos restaurant Marco & David were the best, the food was amazing and the interior, grounds and location were all stunning. The food was also fabulous and was everywhere. We made lots of great friends and had heaps of fun would definitely stay there again. The spa was a bit pricey but worth the visit💞

reviews.author: Dayle D
reviews.title: April Trip to Paradisus, Water, Food and Fun
reviews.text:
Stayed for 10 days in April in an ocean-view room (no hot tub on the balcony or jetted tub in the bathroom).  The room was a very nice size with a comfy bed and very nice view.  The bathroom was good size and the towels were soft and large.  There is a slight step up to get to both the bathroom and the balcony, SO WATCH YOUR STEP.  (When checking in, you can ask what is available for a possibly better view or whatever you like.)  The service and staff for the most part was excellent, helpful and friendly.  We went to all the restaurants.  Some are better than others, but they all have different types of food, so I will not give any of them bad reviews.  The sushi place even made me rolls that had cooked meat and talked me into a grilled tuna they made special for me–it was great!  Fuentes, get the blackened salmon.  Also, the buffet had sea food on Wednesday night. Great selection of sea food, and they even cook it for you or you can pick one already done.  Market Grill was fun too.  Nothing is open 24 hours, but there is always room service.

     The pool and pool bar was wonderful.  Drinks were plentiful, and they have agua aerobics, zumba, music, belly dancing, and other fun stuff going on throughout the day.  RENT A CABANA AND ORDER A LOBSTER LUNCH ONE DAY.  It was about $70 and worth every penny.  

     The ocean is beautiful but always rough.  The floors are marble throughout the premises, beautiful to look at but really slippery when wet.  The lobby is also really nice.  We stayed in the infamous third tower.  Yes, you will hear music at night in your room.  Turn on your air conditioner or open up your door to hear the ocean, it’s just that simple.  For me, I loved the third tower as all the restaurants and action was going on there.  Also, check out the shows at the night club.  Wednesday was Michael Jackson and Thursday was dancers and music from Queen.  Lots of energy and the best shows all week.  We were there with two other couples and would definitely go back.  

     GET UP EARLY AND GET THOSE SUN RISE PICTURES.  Beautiful beach, beautiful view, and sometimes bands playing on the beach at the neighboring resorts – perfect.  If you have children, bring life vests AND blow up floatees. Check the web for the best prices.  Bring your camera, electrical strip, TWO SUNSCREENS, and at least two bathing suits and cover-ups.

reviews.author: Ronald. B
reviews.title: Return trip was as good as the first time!
reviews.text:
We arrived mid-April 2016 at the airport and we were welcomed by our rep, OLYMPUS Tours who provided the airport transfers, well scheduled clean vans with wi-fi. 
The Melia PARADISUS hotel (several pyramid shaped buildings) was gorgeous and clean. Our plan was "all inclusive" but tipping is very welcomed and appreciated (don't forget the daily maids). I met many wonderful guests at the pool and bar. The young attendants at the pool and restaurants are absolutely delightful.  They are compassionate, polite, more than caring and helpful. Most memorable was the extenuated family pool and beach attendant named Armando. Young, always smiling, always attentive and available to us (party of 8).  He kept us fed and watered and helped us obtain a beach cabana and "late" restaurant reservations (a must). The ocean tides were rough.  All pool waiters were wonderful.  The pool side entertainment was fun.  One activity was the "wax hand" by ART WAX (free).   Other free pool activities were the wonderful pool bar, salsa and belly dance lessons, and festive pool games and music.
We frequented the BANA and NAOS buffet restaurants and were never disappointed with the many many diverse food stations including almost anything you would desire. Lovely waiters there were Fernando, Arturo, Chacho, Rodrigo, Freddy, Alexia and Jessy. Very attentive and helpful. Every restaurant (with or without reservations) was just wonderful and tasty.
In the main AVENUE BAR we were welcomed and attended by Gerard who kept us well watered and amused. His smile was heartfelt. Evening hotel entertainment was interesting.
When you take the short bus ride to "downtown" you can find up-scale designer shops and a large clean mall.  If you have extra dinner money don't miss LORENZILLO's fish restaurant (bit pricey) including it's lake side alligator who eats your left overs off the patio.
We took the ferry ride over to THE ILSAND OF WOMEN and toured the island on golf carts for and hour or so (separate costs). LOTS and lots of souvenir shops!!
We went on vacation to relax despite all the available tours and we were were never disappointed. We have returned and will again.

reviews.author: popejoy59
reviews.title: great service
reviews.text: Asuncion the waitress at the beach at the Paradisus Cancun was one of the best.  She provided excellent service and very professional and hard working.  One of the few female wait staff members in the hotel.

reviews.author: Nicole O
reviews.title: Paradisus MX
reviews.text: I came to Paradisus for my 30th birthday and it was exceptional! From the surprise cake and balloons in my room to the service! Kauil from Naos was 100% dedicated to providing me with anything I needed. As soon as he saw me he had a table waiting for me. I actually cried when I had to leave him at the end of my stay. Thank you to him, for everything.

reviews.author: Y6708IObrendas
reviews.title: April 23-30 2016
reviews.text:
This was a beautiful resort, although it was too hot for my liking in most areas, at times it felt like the only air conditioned place was my room.  

We had too many maintenance issues during our week stay.  The safe box door had to be replaced because the lock didn't work.  Our key cards needed to be inserted several times before the door would open, and we had to go to the front desk to exchange keys that eventually didn't work at all multiple times.  We were told it was due to being near cell phones, but even after making sure the key card was not near a cell phone the issues persisted.  We also saw people from a room a few doors down sitting in the hallway one day because they couldn't get into their room because their key cards were not working and they were waiting for maintenance, which makes me think it was not a isolated incident.  They had to come more than once to fix a ceiling air conditioner that was dripping large amounts of water onto the floor.  Our alarm clock never worked after trying to plug it into many different outlets, I asked to exchange it but that never happened so we asked for wake up calls.  Maintenance staff were kind, timely and they did fix every issue except the alarm clock.

The evening  shows were at The Red Lounge which was an extremely small venue for the amount of guests staying at the resort.  After standing out in the hallway trying to see the shows because there was not enough seating,  I gave up trying to go at all.  The show dancers I did see were great, they deserve a more appropriate venue location.

There was a Nexpresso coffee shop but it was never open in the morning when most people would want a coffee specialty drink.  The drinks were good and the staff there were extremely friendly.
The food was good at the resort, I seemed to really like all the different chicken dishes, which sounds odd, but it made me think that I need to learn more ways to cook chicken at home.  The drinks were good, they used good quality alcohol.

The beach was beautiful, but the main beach area directly out of the central building only had cabana beds and not chairs.  There was a DJ booth playing music, but if you sat on the beach chairs to the side you could not hear the music, so it seemed like the music was catering to a small area that could not accommodate very many people.  Both beach & pool areas did not have enough spaces with shade or umbrellas.  

5 star staff, extremely and genuinely friendly.

reviews.author: Jeri Z
reviews.title: The happiest place in Cancun!!!!
reviews.text: This resort was absolutely beautiful, but it paled in comparison to the service!!! Everyone of the staff, and I am not embellishing, was totally focused on us, the customer...Every bartender, wait staff, room service, every customer service person, in whatever capacity, was exceptional. If someone even had a raised eyebrow, the wait staff was on it, asking that person if there was anyway they could help them...My friend broke her leg while staying here, and the staff was absolutely accommodating, compassionate and attentive to her every need....I felt like the staff loved their jobs, and it showed. , Concierge Abraham Aletandes, waiter, Nurbi and so many others that I did not get their names...there was one female waitress at the pool in the afternoon that was phenomenal!!! But all the wait staff was phenomenal!! Thank all of you for making my Paradisus Cancun vacation the best time I have ever had in my life!!!

reviews.author: amesbuddy
reviews.title: hello
reviews.text: It was a fantastic experience ... so much fun and the staff was beyond great especially Fernando our butler!  He was super and belongs being in the manager level! My friend and I will be coming back because we had so much fun.

reviews.author: picklesforsnookie
reviews.title: Quick get away to paradise
reviews.text: Everything about this resort was amazing!! Staff, beach, service, room, food-all fantastic. Would go back and couldn't have been happier with my stay!! Very good mix of other travelers. Never felt over crowded. With three pools and several lounge chairs on the beach there was always a spot to relax. Staff was attentive and entertaining.

reviews.author: Npassanita
reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: This place was great. We stayed there May 1,2016 to May 7,2016. This would be our 3rd time traveling to Mexico and our experience this time was so good all because of the Paradisus! The food had so much flavor (at the restraunts and the buffet) the beach was great, and the service was excellent in the rooms, pool, and bars. The pool was right next to the beach so we had the best of both worlds as well! My husband did use the golf course one time and he was not too impressed just because it was so short. Another thing is if you have a hard time walking, request a room in tower 3 because the resort is so large. We stayed in tower 1 and everytime we wanted to go to eat or go to the bar or spa, it seemed like the walk took forever and sometimes it was confusing to get from place to place. Other than that, we would give this place a 9/10...absolutely beautiful vacation!

reviews.author: LA_Success
reviews.title: Paradise Lost
reviews.text: Beautiful grounds - beautiful views, nice staff, very nice outdoor entertainment options - Late night food at late night food station on final night (thank goodness!) was the only food option available and boy oh boy -  did not sit well for both me and my friend the next day.. Sorry to say - the whole week was OK so did not expect to be hit. Food must have been on heat lamps too long?

reviews.author: ElleAhr
reviews.title: Royal Service earns its name
reviews.text: Excellent service from the Royal Service butler and the staff that supported him. Great selection of restaurants, all with superior food selections though our favorite was Mole. House wine was satisfactory and other liquors were premium as promised. A major benefit of Royal Service is more calm and quiet plus we got reservations at every restaurant we requested while others tried all week to get into some of the more popular venues.  The main pool has constant loud music from which we could distance ourselves somewhat at the Royal Service pool.  We heard from others staying in pyramid 3 that the nightclub music went on until 4AM; there was blissful quiet in Pyramid 5 (Royal Service)

reviews.author: emmaj182
reviews.title: Awesomeness at its very best!
reviews.text: The staff were amazing so friendly, kind, helpful, happy & joyful they go the extra mile always. Big shout out and big HUGS especially to all the pool bar staff, Market grill staff, and Bana staff. My favorite restaurant was by far Bana and also the NAOS Buffett always pleased. Fuego also delicious go with a group so you can try everything. I will be back again what an awesomely special place :) THANKYOU!

reviews.author: 1234jmj
reviews.title: Best Vacation so far!
reviews.text: Had the most amazing stay with our group!  Very accommodating staff and very attentive . I never waited for a beverage or food! The rooms were lovely.  There was a great kids area . The beach is beautiful !

reviews.author: Terry V
reviews.title: Group Adventure
reviews.text: I'd never go to an all inclusive resort of this type on my own, but we had a huge conference there and our group took over the whole place and it was amazing!  Amazing!  Amazing! Food was good, the setting was breathtaking, the beach large and clean, the pool refreshing and large.  Loved every minute there.

reviews.author: Charles J
reviews.title: Not likely to return
reviews.text: The air conditioning was set at 65 the whole week and could not cool the room on 6th floor. The Building 1 only had a single stairwell and the only elevator in building 1 was broke for the first 30 hours we were there. Not good for six floor building.

reviews.author: dmahaffey
reviews.title: Paradisus Paradise
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time! So much to do and see and great people to be with. I would return to this hotel again in a heartbeat. Looking forward to the next Landcruise with the Abraham-Hicks family. It's so damn easy to have an amazing life!

reviews.author: Charles M
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Very nice hotel with very friendly staff. Well located for various activities. The rooms are nice sized, and the restaurants offer decent, but not great, food. Beautiful hotel on the inside and the outside. I would not hesitate to stay again.

reviews.author: DayTrip370762
reviews.title: Beautiful place!
reviews.text: What a beautiful resort!  Excellent food.  Very friendly service, they bend over backwards to keep you happy.  Beautiful beach with soft white sand with beautiful blue water.  Nice swimming pools & plenty of chairs for everyone.  Will diffently go back.

reviews.author: travelingfriendReno
reviews.title: Beautiful resort.  NIce accommodations
reviews.text:
Strange layout. Took a week to mostly be able to find my way around. Had to climb stairs  and then then descend stairs to get to the other side of the same floor.  I was on the zero floor.
Beautiful interior.  Some maintenance needed on bathroom fixtures. Too dark. Smelled like sewer gas in the bathroom.

reviews.author: 1anncat7
reviews.title: We had an amzing time.  The resort was top quality and the service was amazing!
reviews.text:
I was amazed at how great the service was.  They worked so hard to make sure our trip was special and always had a smile on their faces.
The rooms were beautiful and very comfortable.  And the food was great.  Most of all I was amazed at the service.
Our waiter Ignacio Vazquez was so helpful and pleasant.  He did a great job taking care of us.
The concierge Abraham was also very helpful.

reviews.author: Pipo R
reviews.title: IMPECABLE
reviews.text: Gran hotel, el personal siempre dispuesto a colaborar en todos los aspectos (desde vida nocturna a excursiones de dia). Las habitaciones siempre excelentes y limpias. El all-inclusive también se destaca por ma calidad de la comida y sobretodo de la barra. Volvería sin duda alguna

reviews.author: E802OOsallyb
reviews.title: wonderful hotel
reviews.text:
My week at the Paradisus Cancun was amazing..  the people working there are so friendly and helpful. 
The whole hotel is kept spotlessly clean. There is a good variety of food . The sand and sea is stunning.

reviews.author: brigitte m
reviews.title: Beautiful setting. Spectacular beach.
reviews.text: I stayed at the Paradisus for a one week workshop, fun and sun. I had an amazing time. My room was beautiful and very clean. My Ocean view was a real ocean view! The resort is clean and beautiful. I have met wonderful guests and staff. Bana restaurant was my favorite by far. The food was delicious and Erik, our waiter, was amazing, professional and so thoughtful. The best coffee and friendlyess staff was at the Nespresso booth. Delicious and fun. My best morning service was with Gaudencio at Naos restaurant. So kind and so thoughtful...preempting my every needs. Thank you!!!

reviews.author: Martina H
reviews.title: Traumhafte Hotelanlage, wundervoller liebevoller Staff , azur- türkisblaues Meer direkt vor dem Hotel....!!!!
reviews.text: Das Hotel Paradisus in Cancun ist eine wundervolle (!) Anlage direkt am azur- türkisblauen karibischen Meer!!! Der Staff ist obermega freundlich, speziell George Clooney junior(Andrés) am Nespressostand in der Hotelinnenanlage, gestaltet als Dschungel mit balinesischen Hütten und Wasseranlagen!!! Absolut bezaubernd!!!!

reviews.author: Michelle J
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun Beautiful!
reviews.text:
I recently stayed with 1399 others at the Paradisus Cancun and the experience was delightful. 
Beautiful property, location was great, entertainment spectacular and many restaurants to choose from. It appears staffing for all inclusive is on a contractual basis meaning the staff are hired for lengths of time and then must be rehired. They were really great and respectful.

reviews.author: Pamela A
reviews.title: TRULY PARADISE
reviews.text: a week of rejuvenation felt like a month - so lovely indoors & outdoors.........surprised at the number of places to simply relax and take in the beauty of it all :-D  The staff is very friendly and efficient.  Always someone available to provide assistance.

reviews.author: Lisa M
reviews.title: The name says it all!
reviews.text: Loved every bit of my stay here!!! Friendly hard working staff alway attending my every need :). Soft sandy beach front property. Warm pool. Variety of food and alchol to choose from. And did I mention that I had a butler that would have a rose petal bubble bath waiting for me each evening!

reviews.author: singingwoman55
reviews.title: Even better than I expected.
reviews.text: Weather was good. The hotel has everything great food, great rooms, right on beach, comfort. It was better than expected. The service staff were the most committed that I have ever seen. This place has it all going on. I would love to come back.

reviews.author: TomStretches
reviews.title: Visually Intriguing Design, Beautiful Spaces, Great Service
reviews.text: I loved many aspects of this resort. The design of 5 pyramids is quite intriguing, allowing you to look down from above from any floor into a wide open space. And when you are below, you look up into this big open space with greenery hanging from all the floors above. The restaurants were varied and laid out in a fun way, but still near to each other to create a central entertainment area. All the finishings and decor was modern and colorful and beautiful. The food was excellent and so varied in the buffet, and then there were many specialty restaurants for more fun. The pool areas are great and go on forever, and the actual beach is very nice, with lots of beds and chairs, great live music or DJ, and amazing ocean. The staff is friendly and helpful, which is most important while on vacation.

reviews.author: Jerri A
reviews.title: Awesome Resort, Beautiful Beach, Exceptional Staff
reviews.text: We reserved rooms in Pyramid 5 which was the Royal Service area (adults only) with a private beach and private pool, fresh fruit, cheese, meats, and other snacks and drinks available all day.  La Palapa restaurant was a beautiful open air restaurant between the pool and the beach with great food and friendly waiters.  Our butler, Rosanna, was organized, efficient, and gracious.  She unpacked/packed my suitcases and ironed items that were wrinkled.  She also handled all dining reservations, etc.  The resort had over 10 restaurants with delicious food and charming, friendly wait staff.  All staff went the extra mile creating a memorable experience, from the lifeguard on the beach, to the store clerk that inflated our swim rings, to our waiter in Mole restaurant that not only expanded our knowledge by explaining the difference between a dozen varieties of tequila but also informed us about interesting facts (did you know that Cancun means "Serpents Nest"?)

reviews.author: carilynd
reviews.title: Excellent hotel.
reviews.text: Everything you could ask for in a hotel. The service was excellent.  The foliage was perfect.  The ponds were exceptional. The service was superb.  The food had variety and delicious taste.  Keep up the good work.

reviews.author: kpaide
reviews.title: Better than the Ritz Carleton
reviews.text: My sister and I were visiting as a part of a week-long group retreat and could not have been more pleased with the friendliness of staff, service in general, luxury of hotel, and food.  In fact, one evening we walked down the beach thinking we'd like to explore and have a drink at the Ritz Carleton.  We were shocked that a hotel with a reputation that precedes it, was far inferior to the Paradisus.  We immediately bolted and joyously returned to the Paradisus for dinner.  I still fantasize about the buffet!  Everywhere we turned, there was a staff member greeting us with a smile and asking if we needed anything.  Every detail was in place and cared for.   We would return without hesitation!

reviews.author: dianasN2340GF
reviews.title: No regrets, here!
reviews.text: Great location, with plenty of restaurant variety, big, beautiful interior open spaces with a great sense of privacy, and perfect outdoor pool areas and huge beach front access.  Definitely lives up to its motto:  "The place to just Be"

reviews.author: Elizabeth L
reviews.title: Attention to details!
reviews.text:
Beautiful surroundings. Friendly staff. Abundant variety - pools, beach, spa, restaurants.
Fabulous entertainment! The staff seemed very, very happy.
They accommodated our group of over 1,000 effortlessly...or so it seemed!

reviews.author: vince v
reviews.title: Great time!
reviews.text: All looked fabulous when we arrived and got better as we began to experience the full facility. Pool side and beach are we're excellent with lots of very comfortable seating and cabanas to enjoy the amazing weather. Very easy to have s great time but I would highly recommend you study the site map, it is large and easy to get turned around but lots of happy faces to help get you back on track

reviews.author: Pushkala
reviews.title: Top notch resort in Cancun!!
reviews.text: The entire resort is immaculate and absolutely stunning, the interior areas of the buildings are gorgeous, the water views are spectacular, the spa is lovely, there is a wonderful selection of restaurants, and the staff is incredibly friendly and willing to accommodate any request. Highly recommend the Royal Service building and a favorite food item was the shrimp and fish ceviche at Mole.

reviews.author: lovinglife_TO
reviews.title: Would be excellent but...
reviews.text: Loved the property and grounds. Staff are mostly wonderful. Food and drinks are great. Unfortunately my favourite skirt and top were picked up with towels on the bathroom floor by housekeeping and not recovered.

reviews.author: Playa_Ocotal_Jewel
reviews.title: Great week
reviews.text: My one week stay at the Paradisus was better than my expectations.  The staff was incredible.  They made us feel so welcome and were so attentive to anything we needed.  They were very friendly and helpful.  The food was never boring.  It was varied and plentiful.  Delicious.  The facilities are beautiful and the entertainment was very enjoyable.

reviews.author: Delina Y
reviews.title: It was over the top amazing
reviews.text:
Came for the Abraham Hicks worshop week which was perfect in more ways than one and the paradisus was spectacular.  
The staff were delightful and so attentive, I've never felt so pampered. 
Lovely hotel

reviews.author: Rosie T
reviews.title: Heaven on earth
reviews.text: What more needs to be said.  This place has it all.  Service, location, atmosphere, food, drinks.  Most comfortable hotel bed I have ever slept in. The entertainment is amazing. This place will not disappoint!

reviews.author: Lan S
reviews.title: 真棒！
reviews.text: 一个宽大的花园酒店，拥有漂亮的海滩。客房服务态度很好。餐厅的食物丰富多彩应有尽有！非常值得入住的酒店！去坎空一个不能错过的经历！

reviews.author: 710terriw
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun, Royal Service
reviews.text: This was an Abraham-Hicks Landcruise, so the entire hotel was booked to participants and their families. Everything was well orchestrated- accommodations, check-in/out, service, food, entertainment, tours... Just about everything wanted was housed on the premises. Ambience is unforgettable; attention to details excellent ; security not a problem; transportation accessible; well maintained and clean.

reviews.author: 965erinl
reviews.title: Paradisus was Paradise!
reviews.text: The staff was so gracious and friendly. Everything was completely taken care of for us! They had so many fun activities by the pool each day that kept us busy. The Masquerade ball was fabulous with some amazing acrobatic performers and jugglers.

reviews.author: Jennifer N
reviews.title: Truly Paradise
reviews.text: Wonderful resort with great service. It is like a massive greenhouse. I spent a lot of time at Coco's bar on the beach. Karina Reyes and Randy Argenis were great servers! Flor De La Cruz was a great server on the beach too. They had a Nespresso bar also where too lovely gentleman worked, Andres and Jhony. The shower is really nice, great food and options and pool and the beach is the best one I've been to. Overall I really felt I was in Paradise. I hope to return next year.

reviews.author: helenaF8896JT
reviews.title: It is a ok hotel
reviews.text: The hotel, pool, beach, good, rooms was nice. And the sevice was ok, but the 5 stars service was not there. The smal things like listen to the costumers order insted of going twise, smiles, eye contact. The Staf feelt so stressad out. Running around and not paying attention. They also keept saying that please go to tripadvisor and rekommendera this and that and menition my name, or else i can be fired. I think that is strange.

reviews.author: Missy M
reviews.title: Breathtaking
reviews.text: Beautiful greenhouse is what we were staying in! Greenery everywhere, gorgeous white sands, turquoise water. Need to take care regrading strong rip tides. Lifeguards needed to be much more vigilant as were a few close calls

reviews.author: sharoncpope
reviews.title: Great beach property
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful.  There are 2 splurges that are worth the extra money: the daybed on the beach with champagne and dinner at Tempo......both were highlights of our trip. The rooms are great and the resort is clean. The swim up bar is very cool. The wine they served was actually pretty good ....food was ok at the buffet, but there are other restaurants that are quite good.

reviews.author: pattyjean19
reviews.title: Incredible place, fantastic service!
reviews.text: I can't say enough about the place and the people. Exceeded my expectations. It was gorgeous, food was delicious, and the staff were helpful and friendly. Zumba by the pool with Fernando was a blast! Will be back!

reviews.author: pamsS6548GZ
reviews.title: Stay here when you go to Cancun!
reviews.text: Wonderful resort! Everyone friendly! Rooms clean . Staff helpful. Spa experience fabulous! Room layout kind of confusing, but you figure it out. Food was wonderful, and all the restaurants have great wait staff, generous portions.

reviews.author: B.A.W C
reviews.title: Just beautiful!
reviews.text:
Traveling with a group of 8 can be trying. But here it was not. We just returned from a wonderful 9 day trip. Just as great as previous trip 4 Years ago. Service was awesome! Armando at the pool bar was awesome! How does he move that fast! Alberto at breakfast always had our table ready and was so welcoming each morning with Mimosas! The evening buffet fish station was incredible.  Rarely does one find someone to cook fresh tuna perfectly! Rosa at concierge hooked us up with a van for transportation to shopping and dinner at Lorenzellos.  This restraunt a must for awesome seafood. Oldest bar in Cancun but not just a bar now. Original beams hand carved fish. Stunning!
On the downside..I could not get a washcloth to save my soul!! Everyone else was very happy with their maid service but me. I stopped tipping on day4. Minimal amenities in bathrm daily. Had to ask for extra shampoo and lotion. I'm sure was an isolated incident but annoying when on vacation. Eventually became comical.  
Overall...I would go back tomrow!

reviews.author: Kristen P
reviews.title: Luxurious Resort, Great Staff and Entertainment
reviews.text: Absolutely stunning hotel! Both the tropical forest-like interior and exterior with a great view of ocean were breathtaking. All of the restaurants, minus the one main buffet, was excellent. They restaurants represented quite a few different cultures as well as traditional Mexican cuisine so there was something for everyone. The service was great all around - especially Erick from Bana who created a custom meal for us. We did have two instances though where we tipped waiters in advance at the pool or at the indoor bar and never saw them again after that. All around, incredible experience.

reviews.author: PamKammer
reviews.title: Poolside DJ with Zoomba, Dance Classes & Poolercize
reviews.text: The Paradisus Cancun's pool-side DJ service with Hugo, Chacho, Fernando. Freddy & Ridrigo was so incredibly fun. Dancing and exercise classes every day. Great music for poolside while enjoying a swim or a drink. This place so tel dancing and exercise classes every day. Great music for poolside well enjoying a swim or a drink. This resort is wonderful. This group of guys run in the daily show at the pool made it a lot more fun.  They also were the DJs for the wonderful closing party for our event. Can't wait to come back!

reviews.author: millicentbrant
reviews.title: Enso Restaurant
reviews.text: We recently celebrated our 36th anniversary at this restaurant with friends, and the staff and the food were 5 stars.  It was the most memorable meal we have ever had.  The staff really made the difference, taking away our menus and serving us a special chefs menu for the evening.  I know we will never forget it.

reviews.author: Sarah K
reviews.title: Amazing!!
reviews.text: This was my 3rd time to Cancun and my first time at the Paridisus. Hands down the best resort thus far. The service was outstanding. The food options emmence and delicious. The entertainment at night left a little to be desired. It ended early but the resort has a 21+ club in the resort if you choose not to retire early or visit the strip. I will definitely be visiting again in the future!

reviews.author: glennd738
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, friendly staff, clean beautiful resort. Food portions at Vento's and Blueagave restaurant very tiny, they should be embarrassed to serve it. Sewage smell outside room when on the terrace facing the lagoon. Air conditioning not working properly, safe did not work, these problems were fixed.

reviews.author: kac9178
reviews.title: Wonderful Hotel Outstanding Service
reviews.text:
Just returned from 9 days at this hotel. Wonderful Resort.....Service is Awesome! We have traveled yearly as a group of 8 and have been to this hotel 3 times. We return for the Beach and Service! BIG SHOUT OUT to Gerardo Avila and Juan Diaz in the Avenue Bar...They are the BEST!! They made our night each and every night 
Alberto at NAOS took care of us daily and his service , kindness and smiles went a long way each day . And Thanks to Yhoni in the Welcome Lounge for all his service and assistance. Great Job Guys,,,,We will be back

reviews.author: Caroline B
reviews.title: Awesome resort - Royal Service is worth it!
reviews.text:
Stayed 1 week in Royal Service Lagoon View room.

Pros:
- onsite restaurant options
- ease of making reservations
- customer service
- Royal Service perks - private lobby, private check-in/check-out, private pool, butler
- towels available without sign-out or limit
- ambiance/decor
- cleanliness
- staff responsiveness
- variety of free live entertainment

Cons:
- no drink menu at bars
- limited poolside food options
- need more posted maps in all pyramids (not just main pyramid)
- need to explain butler availability/hours
- pool needs to be skimmed more often, sometimes debris/trash in pool
- sometimes slow food/drink service at pool

reviews.author: Y4357BIalbertog
reviews.title: Increible
reviews.text: El hotel es un 10 en todo, desde el momento en el que entras por la puerta. Por variedad de restaurantes y bares, de piscinas. La amabilidad del personal un 10, estancia única. Sin duda la mejor elección para Cancun y alrededores. Estuve el año pasado y no he dejado de recomendarlo, y este año he vuelto.

reviews.author: AMBERHM13
reviews.title: Royal Service is worth every penny! Every DARN PENNY! :) :)
reviews.text:
Everything exceeded my expectations. This place is fantastic and beautiful. Royal Service is worth the extra money. The staff is so attentive and full of personality. Our butler Juan is one in a million, always smiling and helpful making all our dinner reservations, making sure we had everything we wanted in our room, and making sure we were comfortable in the pool and beach areas. 
The staff by the pool and the beach is by far the BEST! Special recognition to Edair (EDDIE), Moises (Moses), Daniel, Gustavo, and Javier! Anything you need, they are more than willing to help. Eddie and Moses are especially great at delivering Mango Margaritas and chips and guacamole! Be sure to have the chips and guacamole, you will not be sorry. We ate lunch by the pool or on the beach pretty much every day. I mean, who wants to leave the beach to eat?
The Royal Service private areas are beautiful and perfect, I hated to leave our special Pyramid and head to the common area for dinner because it was full of people and kids. It was so quiet in our area, I forgot there was families in the rest of the resort.
The restaurant food was so-so. I found at least a coupe things at each one that I really enjoyed. Fuego being the best.
Went to the Spa for a treatment and all the ladies are great! It is worth spending an afternoon there and using all the amenities it has to offer. Special thanks to Lillyanna, she is very friendly and professional!
My only complaint is the pool, it gets too warm by the afternoon, and isn't very refreshing. I am not sure how that can be helped... More margaritas perhaps? 
The rooms were perfect, we were on the very bottom floor with easy access to the pool and beach. The Bali Beds are perfect for an afternoon nap!
Be careful on the marble floors, if they get wet  AT ALL they are VERY slippery. I fell once and slipped another time. I think the wetness is from people walking around from the pool with wet sandals. It was a concern.
I had a perfect week, so perfect because I never left the resort, crashed 2 weddings, witnessed a couple proposals, drank my weight in top shelf drinks, and laughed with the staff every day! I can NOT wait to go back.

reviews.author: Jacquelyn
reviews.title: Like living in Paradise
reviews.text:
The cabanas and pool side/beach side service was absolutely amazing. Everyone was so friendly and helpful.
Best beaches I've ever seen. I definitely want to go back. Royal service is the way to go! Very clean and beautiful decor/atmosphere.

reviews.author: marcelosO7942HR
reviews.title: Muy caro
reviews.text: No muy buenos los restaurantes mejorar el all inclusive, pocas reposeras en la playa y poca comida en las playas,falta comida italiana, buffet de pizzas, muy amable todo el personal, lo mas rescatable el personal

reviews.author: bunting_jl
reviews.title: Loved it here!
reviews.text: The weather was great, the hotel was awesome, and the service was excellent!! Would recommend this place to anyone and definitely go for the butler service.  Our butler Galdino was fantastic and made our vacation even better.

reviews.author: Luis D
reviews.title: Muy bien
reviews.text: me parecio buena la estancia del lugar, estoy muy contento con la experiecía que tuve del lugar, me sorprendio la amabilidad de las personas que estan al servicio del hotel y que en realidad la mayoria son mexicanos, los amo a todos y pase un excelente inicio de año en ese lugar la verdad es que lo disfrute mucho.

reviews.author: Kalli M
reviews.title: Will come back here!!!!
reviews.text:
First I have to say how amazing the property is here. Just beautiful. You must go Royal Service it's the BEST....definitely worth the extra money. Secondly the staff here is #1.Juan was our butler and he's the BEST. What a personality and will do anything to make you happy. He surprised us with a bubble bath with rose petals when we returned from the pool. He's definitely one of a kind. Lilyanna in the spa was one of the best I've ever encountered in a spa. Her hands are magical and personality to match. Daniel, Edair (Eddie) Moises (moses to us) are among the best. Any resort should be honored to have these people working for them. They work so hard yet always have a smile and will do anything to make you happy.

Now the down side, the pool on the Royal Service side shouldn't be as heated as it is.It's not refreshing at all. Relaxing yes, but not so good in the warm sun. 

With a property of this size you would think they would have a bigger entertainment place, but it's so small with little seating that I couldn't stand to watch any shows, but heard they were very good.

Food not so good...I'm a picky eater and the only dinner I liked was at Fuego...definitely a must try. Other friend didn't care for her dinner though, but I was happy mine was finally good. Try the crab soup and chicken entree!!!

Other than these little things that I can overlook....WE ARE RETURNING HERE. This place is amazingly beautiful and the staff is #1.

reviews.author: Larae S
reviews.title: The Best Tips on a Great Vacation
reviews.text: One of the BEST butlers at Paradisus Cancun names Fernando, he's very helpful with the best places to see in Mexico and the best deals on any entertainment you might be looking for!...If you stay at Paradisus Cancun request Fernando as your Butler he will take Great car of you!

reviews.author: Raquel P
reviews.title: Estancia en el Paraiso
reviews.text:
Despues de haber disfrutado varios dias en la opcion de Day Pass el Paradius Cancun puedo decir que es con diferencia el mejor hotel de todos los que me he alojado desde hace muchisimo tiempo.
Gracias a todo el equipo de Paradisus por hacerme sentir especial, por su impecable servicio y profesionalidad, pero en especial me gustaria mencionar a las personas que han marcado la diferencia: Tabata del Coco Bar, chef Santos de Tacos, chef Mauricio Soja y por ultimo al Chef Ejecutivo Juan por su excelente labor. Sin duda recpmendare el hotel y nos volveremos a ver muy pronto.

reviews.author: Eli
reviews.title: One word: Paradise...
reviews.text:
The first time I've done an all inclusive resort, but it won't be my last. What an amazing experience it was! Everything is grand! It has everything you need. The rooms were huge, had the best air con I've ever experienced and great facilities.
