It is a bit of a maze so getting around - especially at night - could result in getting lost; but there's staff everywhere to help. 

It wasn't too far from the clubs/strip either - a cheap cab ride away. But the resort has its own bars and clubs, and a few outdoor/beach events too. It was all quite surreal and romantic. It reminds you exactly what holidays are for, to relax, and boy was it relaxing! I'm going back there for my anniversary haha (yet to find love)

reviews.author: adrian
reviews.title: Buen sitio
reviews.text: La comida esta bastante buena en general, salvo en el restaurante de los tacos que no nos gustó especialmente. Buen servicio, buenas habitaciones y un ambiente muy familiar. La playa muy cuidada y todo el hotel estaba muy limpio. Nuestra estancia fue unicamente de dos dias pero fueron muy agradables.

reviews.author: Nicola F
reviews.title: Top ma più fare meglio...
reviews.text: Bellissima struttura, ottimo tutto, piante che da un che di jungla all'interno, bellissime le stanze, resort sempre pulito e curato, bella la spa e la palestra, unica pecca del mio soggiorno sono i ristoranti......cucina tipicamente internazionale, può andare bene per il resto delle persone ma non di sicuro non al meglio per noi italiani abituati come siamo a mangiare bene. Voto sufficiente però di sicuro da rivedere se vuole puntare a fare di più

reviews.author: Eugenio J
reviews.title: increible
reviews.text:
El mejor hotel al que haya ido, tengo que volver. me ospede con el servicio de Royal service.
el unico inconveneinte era que no habia lugar en la playa privada porque los lugares estaban ocupados por personas que no eran el royal service, pero inmediatamente me atendieron.

reviews.author: anthonyjohnt2016
reviews.title: Wonderful trip
reviews.text: The hotel was WONDERFUL! The service was exceptional. Everyone who works at the Paradisus seems like they love their jobs. They all were smiling and extremely friendly. The service in the Royal service area was excellent. We are already planning a trip back! I would recommend this resort to anyone. We were looking for a week to unplug and relax, we found exactly what I was looking for.

reviews.author: Dketterhagen
reviews.title: Naos restaurant
reviews.text: Ignacio Vazquez was amazing every day during breakfast.  He greeted our group every morning when we went to Naos for breakfast.  He was always smiling and a fantastic server.  We went to this restaurant every morning not only for the great food but for the amazing service.  We all loved this place.

reviews.author: Pablo C
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: De lo mejor en hotelería que hay en Cancún fue sin duda una gran experiencia y disfrutamos mucho nuestra estancia en un verdadero hotel con todas las comodidades inmejorable servicio y atención a los huéspedes

reviews.author: Trail624639
reviews.title: March holiday
reviews.text: Really enjoyed our stay here in Paradisus. The staff were so helpful and friendly. The service we received was of an extremely high standard and all staff went to great lengths to ensure we had everything we needed. The hotel room was extremely clean and serviced to a high standard every day!! Choice of restaurants was great and we loved all the many dining experiences. All the staff at la palapa and the Royal service were extremely helpful and friendly. Jorge in la palapa provided us with unbelievable service every day and really added to the fantastic time we had there.

reviews.author: Corrie B
reviews.title: Not such a great property for Time Share owners.....
reviews.text: Time share owners are put in their own "tower" of the building.  We were moved more than 3 times because of severe flooding in our room from rain.  Had a difficult time securing reservations in the nicer restaurants.  No dance club.  Other than salad bar (which was very large) very few healthy options available on resort.  Not impressed.....

reviews.author: 328carlyd
reviews.title: Spring Break 2016
reviews.text: Awesome experience! Beautiful! Good food & drinks. The service was great. Calm hotel, not a lot of noise. Fun atmosphere. The night shows in the lobby area were great! I recommend going and staying at this hotel!

reviews.author: mariajosea934
reviews.title: Imperdible
reviews.text:
Las instalaciones y la atención fueron excelentes. El hotel ofrece varias opciones gastronómicas, si debería recomendar alguna seria el Restaurante Enso dirigido por Mauricio. 
Desde el check in hasta el check out todos los colaboradores del hotel estuvieron atentos a nuestras necesidades. El hotel tiene orientación familiar, a pesar de ello la vida nocturna es buena. Y esta a 10 minutos del centro. 
Todos fueron muy cordiales.  Nuestra experiencia fue muy buena.

reviews.author: Donald C
reviews.title: so worth the trip.
reviews.text: We loved our stay. We had the royal service and I highly recommend it. The staff was very friendly and helpful. They made our stay so relaxing and enjoyable as we never had to worry about a thing. We could just enjoy the stay. The food and drinks were excellent everywhere we went in the resort. We will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Rakesh Natverla... P
reviews.title: Very good experiende
reviews.text: Totally would love to come back. 5 star ratings. We made a trip with family and friends and totally would recommend to anyone. Overall experice with service and. Food was the best.  We had fun at the beach, kids enjoyed the pool a lot

reviews.author: cjryan37
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun - extraordinary service!
reviews.text: Recent visit to the Royal Service at Paradisus Cancun for 4 night stay.  A foursome of girlfriends - we enjoyed the excellent butler service of Galdino, pool wait-service by Victor, Alberto and Daniel.  We loved the Bali beds for rest, relaxation and cocktails in between the pool and surf water play!  Andrea was so hospitable and welcoming, excellent leader of quality and hospitality - she even had Simon make us some special flowery "Simon says - Love Apples drink".  Cindy Valeria Josue also was our go-to gal at the breakfast bar - absolutely lovely.  Great staff!

reviews.author: Ankur S
reviews.title: Spring break
reviews.text:
What a place to be for your vacation. If not the best resort in cancun , definitely amongst the best . Top notch service - whether it's house keeping ,  concierge , restaurants , or room service . So many restaurants each offering different types of food , servers on their toes to feed you. 

Overall , a great resort.  Must visit .

Critic : all the private agents selling packages for tours to visit around cancun are overpriced. They all are cheating visitors by charging outrageous prices .. Shop around . Buy packages from down town , negotiate.

reviews.author: amrodri2
reviews.title: Eduardo from the swim up bar made our experience the best!!!
reviews.text:
The overall ambiance of the hotel is beautiful!!!! My best friend and I made a Spring break trip out to the Paradisus and upon arriving they upgraded us into Royal Service. We mainly took advantage of the restaurant La Palapa which had absolutely delicious food and the most beautiful view of the ocean. Jorge here treated us very nicely and made sure we had everything we needed at all times. 
The first day we arrived we got a lot of cloudiness and wind so we were pretty bummed, but we spent the whole day at the swim up bar where Eduardo immediately gave us the best experience. He was extremely helpful in giving us a local's insight on where to tour, etc and made us feel super welcome. He was by far our favorite person of the trip and favorite bartender!! His partner Alipio was also great. Overall, all the staff we came across treated us top notch and we made friends with everyone we came across.
It was slightly difficult to get a reservation in at the restaurants we wanted the night before so I recommend booking that at least 2 nights in advance. The hotel vibe was very family oriented so we didn't get the exact "spring break" trip we had imagined, but we had an amazing time regardless. There is a "club" inside the hotel open until 2am I believe but it seemed to have more older couples than young singles. Would go back!!

reviews.author: laurarob2016
reviews.title: Absolutely Amazing
reviews.text: We just returned home from our third vacation to the Paradisus Cancun.  We love this hotel, the location, the pools and beach, and more than anything, the staff cannot be beat!  We rented a cabana out by the pool every day that we were there and had the pleasure of having Sofonia and Jesus serving us our food and drinks the entire time we were there.  We travel quite a bit, and by far these two provided the best service of any place we have been.  It is always hard to leave when are vacation comes to an end, and we can only hope when we go back again, Sofonia and Jesus will still be there, as they made this year's trip The Best!

reviews.author: sglong5
reviews.title: Spring Break - Wonderful Vacation!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus during Spring Break and had a wonderful vacation!  We were greeted promptly when we arrived and had no difficulties securing our room overlooking the ocean.  Our room was centrally located and it was easy for us to get to the restaurants, pools, and beach.  We were at the pool the next morning by 8 a.m.  Our concierge, Alexander, was already at the pool area and helped us pick a spot and gave us all the tips for securing a spot at the pool.  Alexander was always extremely polite and accommodating.  We had a spa reservation one morning and Alexander watched our stuff at the pool area while we were at the spa.  Our waiters Sofo and Jesus were very polite and routinely checked in with us to see if we needed any beverages.  They had our routine down!  It was sad to say goodbye to Alexander, Sofo, and Jesus.  The restaurants were great!  I would definitely encourage people to make reservations early to get into the restaurants.  The buffet area is great though if you are unable to get into one of the restaurants that require reservations.  Our view overlooking the water was awesome!  Our room was always cleaned well.  There were a couple of times that we needed more towels and the hospitality staff delivered them promptly.  If there were any concerns on our part they were rectified immediately by staff.  Everywhere you turned there were staff members and they were all extremely polite.  We loved chatting we our Nespresso guy too.  We went to the show at Avenue Bar each night and were even lucky enough to when a spa visit the next morning.  One of the best massages I've ever had!!!  On our last day, we were not leaving for the airport till 4 p.m.  We checked out by noon and the concierge stored our bags.  We reserved a hospitality room and were able to clean up before our departure--this was such a nice amenity.  I can't say enough wonderful things about the Paradisus and the staff.  If I would have to give one criticism, I would say that the wifi was very weak, but it was free.  I love to research for good deals when traveling.  When I return to Cancun I will stay at the Paradisus again.  No need to look elsewhere.

reviews.author: Paige H
reviews.title: Great property. Ask for Sergio Mesero or Asunción for your poolside/cabana/beach server!!!
reviews.text:
Sergio was our poolside and beach server for a few of the days we were there.  During his days off, Asunción was our server. She has been on the property for over 20 years and it's obvious why.  She specializes in Tequila tastings and is very friendly. The rest of the staff was also fantastic but Sergio and Asunción were AWESOME!   Our drinks were never empty and our group is a bunch of trained professionals when it comes to downing poolside cocktails.  We were paying for the all-inclusive thing so all we did is throw tips his way.  Our drinks were never empty and we typically have holes in the bottom of our glasses for some reason :-)
Bit of advice:  Bring LOTS of 1$ bills or LOTS of Pesos in small denominations.  ATMs spit out large bills and getting smaller bills was a slight pain.  Property was beautiful but massive.  Later in the evening only a couple bars in the middle of the property are serving.  Our rooms were in the end pyramids requiring a 10 min walk just to get a drink back to your room.  Room-service wine & hard liquor are not part of the deal so plan ahead.  They will stock your fridge with beer if you ask the service staff.  Awesome dining options (especially the Brazilian steak house) with a very helpful and friendly staff.  
I recommend using the hotel to airport transfer service (about $35 each way for up to 8 people) instead of a local cab for obvious security concerns.  The driver was waiting outside customs with my name on a sign and picked us up in a nice new clean black SUV.  I would definitely go back.

reviews.author: Camila B
reviews.title: Show!
reviews.text: Cancún é simplesmente maravilhoso ainda mais quando você fica hospedado em um dos melhores resort "Paradisus" tudo muito limpo, atendimento maravilhoso, varias opções de comida, restaurantes temáticos para um belo jantar! O lugar é de extremo bom gosto e ambiente é contagiante!

reviews.author: douglas l
reviews.title: Black Cloud Over 50th Birthday Vacation
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun Resort for 6 nights.  Upon arrival at 9pm, the desk said our travel arrangements setup online with BookIt.com had not yet paid for our rooms. they explained that "this is common and to give us your credit card so they could have reassurance that they will get paid" and "check with us in the morning and Bookit should have paid for it by then".  It was late so I agreed.  I checked back the next morning and still no payment, they told me to call Bookit and maybe they will expedite the payment which I did that afternoon.  Bookit claimed they paid for the room, again the hotel said they had not.  This went on my entire stay with a lot of time on phone calls and at the desk until finally the night before my checkout, the hotel said that Bookit paid for the rooms at 330pm of that day.  Basically, the entire trip I had the sinking feeling that I might have to pay for the room twice!.  My issue with Paradisus is they knew and have been having problems with Bookit.com for sometime. They continued to tell me that "I'm not the only one" and "this has been happening with Bookit a lot".  My response was "why are you allowing Bookit to book your hotel if you know this has been a problem".  It's a shame that they would allow this company to put their guests through this.  I'm extremely disappointed in how they handled our situation and hope this sheds light on others so they do not get "trapped" in this scenario.

reviews.author: Sofia P
reviews.title: The best beach club ever!!!
reviews.text:
Tabata and her staff make us feel just great, not the fist time i visit this place and everytime is just epic!!! Great food, great music, the best staff giving you the best service!! what else are you seeking for this holydays?!  safe, fun, availability, great food and amazing beach area just is coco's beach club, the place to be!!  
Big big thanks to tabata!!! Thanks to make our day, one of the best by been the best with us!!!

reviews.author: LePort963
reviews.title: Wonderful Staff, Great Hotel!!
reviews.text:
Just got back from Cancun and had a wonderful time, mostly because of the staff! These people work so hard to keep you happy and it wouldn't be fair to only mention a few people (but I will) because everyone from start to finish was great! Best way to describe this place is like a fun, beautiful cruise ship. No need to leave property!!
 
PROS:
Check In was easy, friendly staff
If you book your trip through the hotel website they will arrange your ground transportation.
Hotel room was very nice, we upgraded to ocean front which was a good choice.
Pools are clean, but cold. 
Pool service was AMAZING. Our waiter Jorge was the best, every morning he greeted us and was very attentive to our needs, our group drank a lot, but always smiling and friendly. Also every morning Alexander greeted us too checked restaurant reservations for us and he even helped me with transportation off property. I can't say enough about these two gentlemen!
The beach is clean and safe. The lifeguard was on point watching guests in ocean, he (Johnny) even saved a girl when she couldn't get back to shore because of under tow.
The food was all good but had a hard time getting reservations. Tried all week to get into Market Grill and Fuego but no luck. Ate at buffet most of trip.
Entertainment was awesome too. By the large end of pool there is plenty of entertainment from Zumba, water aerobics, games, dancing, performers and music all day or you can choose to sit by the quiet pools instead if you like it peaceful. The guys that are in charge are fantastic (can't remember their names) they kept everyone involved and are very good at their jobs!
Evening entertainment was nice too. Every night in the hotel there was a dance/singing show that was really good. 
Golfing is right out the front door, they guys in our group golfed 1-2 times a day.

CONS:
If I could ask for one thing it would have been a more comfortable bed. Bed was too hard.

OTHER COMMENTS:
Although there is ramps for wheel chairs this resort has a lot of steps, inside and out. If you're handicapped you may want to stay somewhere else, we saw a few wheel chair bound people and it looked like a real hassle to accommodate them. The resort is designed to look like the Mayan Ruins so there are a lot of levels & steps.

Our previous trip we stayed at the Marriott Casa Magna (next door) and we really liked that place but there is nothing going on in evening, but that place would be more accessible than Paradisis.

reviews.author: Eloelson  C
reviews.title: Hotel Cancun
reviews.text: Maravilhosa estrutura, restaurante ótimo, atendimento tbm, localizado em frente uma praia maravilhosa e perto de um shopping, o quarto tem wife, TV, frigo bar e cofre. O acesso as pontos pricipais é super fácil, da pra ir a pé.

reviews.author: B_C_C_2390
reviews.title: Great all inclusive
reviews.text:
Great location. When I looked at the pictures, I thought the plants inside the building looked cheesy, but the pictures don't do it justice - it is very pretty. The beach is beautiful. They do not have enough seating outside, but that is probably because they don't have a whole lot of beach space since it is smack dab in the middle of the hotel zone. We've stayed at the Paradisus Punta Cana before, and I can truly say that the service is consistently great. The employees are so accommodating and want to please you. We got a shuttle from the airport through Best Day, which cost us $18/pp. Check in is a little lengthy because they try to get you to look at a timeshare, which can eat up a lot of your time. The gym is well equipped. The pool is great. They use the alcohol in their drinks. 

We tried 4 of the restaurants. Our first night we dined at Vento. The food was ok at best. Not really our thing. Most of the entrees were sea food, and  we don't like sea food. Ruben was our waiter and he was absolutely fantastic. We also dined at Fuego. The service was very slow, but I think there was only one waiter working the whole restaurant, which is ridiculous. We spent over 2 hours there for dinner. The food was fantastic. We also dined at Market Grill for dinner, which is a Brazilian churrasceria style restaurant. It seems like they only circle around once with each meat and side, so you have to ask the waiter if you want seconds. The food was good. Our waiters Efrain and Alan were really cool. The last restaurant we tried is Blue Agave. They have tacos and quesadillas. It was really good, and they open up at like 3am for the people getting back from partying.The buffets were also good. Breakfast was better than lunch in my opinion. 

My only complaint was the beds. We had a room with the double beds, which are full sized doubles not queen sized doubles like some hotels. The beds were not comfortable, and you should bring your own pillow. That's my only complaint. Overall, it was a great hotel to stay in.

reviews.author: Marcroeger1
reviews.title: Decent hotel
reviews.text:
It is a good and large property, the food offered is really good so you should always be able to get something you like

Due to the hotels size it can be difficult to get a spot on the beach unless you're willin to get up around seven 

It's definitely a good hotel, but there are better ones in Cancun

reviews.author: 4max44
reviews.title: Cancun 2016
reviews.text: In spite of its age the Paradisus in Cancun is in great shape. The staff is very friendly and accommodating to guests. The beach layout with palapas and Bali beds is comfortable. The pools are beautiful.

reviews.author: ANNIE E
reviews.title: Annie's Mexico Getaway 2016
reviews.text: Upon arrival we were absolutely amazed - the reality was even better than the photographs we had seen.  The resort is absolutely beautiful and situated steps away from the beautiful white sand and blue blue carribbean waters..Most impressive was the interaction with staff - from housekeeping to wait staff, bartenders, concierge...especially Etter in the dining room. To a person, each and every employee we interacted with were all so welcoming and really willing to go out of their way to ensure our trip was completely to our satisfaction.we indulged in a day at the spa and it is among the most indulgent and beautiful spa experiences I have ever had - LuLu, my masseuse was incredibly polite, respectful and masterfully competent. I would recommend Paradisus to anyone looking for a great Cancun experience.

reviews.author: frankigos2HOLLYWOOD
reviews.title: Spring break 2016
reviews.text: Great sand and ocean, enjoyed the sand and ocean, and the sand and ocean was very good, we really enjoyed the sand and ocean, you will be really impressed with the sand and ocean,  and the sand and ocean are really nice.

reviews.author: brianlU3384VJ
reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.text: I have been to a bunch of similar resorts.  This one has been the best.  Rooms were good.  Food was good.  Sushi was similar to what we get back home.  Beach service (the biggest one for me) was on point.  Service was always top notch.  We did the Royal upgrade but just dont love to be pampered but the rooms and royal area are VERY quiet so it might be worth it on that level alone.  Bottom line well worth the $$$ and I will return.

reviews.author: Stephen Lee B
reviews.title: Great Time with the Royal Service!
reviews.text: We really enjoyed the Royal Service! Never stayed as a regular guest, so really have no way to compare. With Royal Service you could get a beach or poolside cabana for 2 days per room. It was a great experience!

reviews.author: DaveSC_7
reviews.title: Cancun vacation
reviews.text:
We stayed at paradises Royal service, comparing it with the paradises ponta Cana and Costa Rica was a little bit disappointing.
we arrived at 8.30 at night they checked us in without giving us a tour of the hotel and what we could expect from the Royal service also offered us water in champagne glass instead of a refreshing cocktail (seriously).
Our Butler didn't do much at all accept making restaurant reservation which we could have done it through the Royal service personnel ourselves, he did not offer us any suggestion as far as hotel amenities concern, for example we didn't know on Wednesday there was a sea food buffet or there is facility cross the street from the hotel that we could use for water sport activity and so on, he was a nice guy but obviously he wasn't trained that well.we still tipped him$100 for each couple because we know that without the tips they can't make a living with $5 a day. Royal service itself and all the staff from house keeping to the server and the cooks were fantastic and absolutely first-class worker.
our favorite was Alexandra he was at the Royal service bar at night and server at Royal service restaurant by the pool,also Valeria was amazing lady who served us lunch  every day at the Royal service restaurant.
The only restaurant for Royal service was opened for breakfast and lunch only and is located by the pool area, without a question that was the best eating place in  the entire resort, we tried all the restaurant for dinner, Brazilian restaurant was a joke all the meat was tuff, Thai restaurant was beautiful but food and service was awful, Mexican restaurant was better than the others with very limited menu and no traditional Mexican food, i must say I have been in restaurant business for 30 years and I know about food and service , in general they can improve  their restaurants and foods, I can't believe you couldn't find a fish taco or plenty of fish dishes in any of their restaurants.
Spa facility was great Angel at the reception was very helpful , Ana was my message therapist she was great and my wife had Lulu for therapist and she loved it. We also played golf 3 times and it was nicely maintained
Royal service beach is great but the ocean is always Rugh and it's not a snorkeling beach .

This is my suggestion for the management.

1- when your Royal service guest arriving treat them like royalty and have knowledgeable staff to greet them and show them around .
2-Royal service concierge should be smiling , happy and helpfull.
3-you should have one restaurant for Royal service guest for dinner time.
4- improve the quality of the food on all restaurants and have more seafood in all menus.
5-give more Training to Royal  service butler so they can service the  guests better.

reviews.author: sjp6790
reviews.title: Beautiful place - subpar service
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful, walking in is like walking into a tropical rainforest. The decor and layout are amazing in the lobby and all of the restuarants. Of the restaurants we visited the best was Ibana, which is located right in the center of the hotel. The restaurant we liked least was Enso, the place is located outside and has a lot of potential, but the food was just ehh and the decor/general feeling was just blah. The buffets for breakfast/lunch were nothing special, your standard all inclusive menus, but the service was just... off. No one working there seemed happy to be there and were not helpful. When we checked in they talked us into upgrading to an ocean view for an extra cost (highly reccomend, the view is worth it). They promised our room would be ready well before 3pm. It of course wasn't and they promised they had given us a $50USD credit to our room (get it in writing because later we found out it had not been added!!). Our new room was located on the third floor of pyramid 3 (the main pyramid). DO NOT STAY PYRAMID 3. Our room was located directly above the resorts 'night club' and all night and into the early morning it felt like we were in a sub-woofer, our complaints were only met with apologies and they said they couldnt move us without giving us a lagoon view room (obviously didnt say they would give us our money back for upgrading). Every morning we woke up to dishing clinking and plates dropping as they prepared for the breakfast buffet. Stay in a different pyramid. The beach and pool are beautiful, the service in those parts depends if you're lucky or not because some people were great and other people were horrible (no in between). Our last day we splurged and wanted to get one of the Bali Beds on the beach. The beds are like a cabana and include a lobster lunch and bottle of champagne or other type of alcohol you choose. This is where we were going to use our $50 room credit. The Bali Bed manager spoke only a little english and after waiting 30 minutes outside in limbo they brought out a manager from the front desk that told us we can have the second tier bed (there are three tier depending on the location closest to the water) for free but no lobster lunch or bottle. We countered that we were willing to pay for the first tier bed ($163USD) just with our $50 credit that was promised to us- argued that for awhile back and forth and finally they gave in. It's a nice place, but vacation shouldn't be so much stress.

reviews.author: chicagocj
reviews.title: excellent poolbar staff
reviews.text:
The best bartenders reymundo,eduardo,erick,cristian friendly and fast service everyday id join them for cold drinks at the poolbar around 2pm suns perfect about that time. Cj gracies amigos salud.
I also recommend royal service while staying at the paradisus. Ive been to cancun 9 times and by far was one of best resorts all inclusive ive stay at. Food was great and the room service was just as good, fit for a king and will return.

reviews.author: 732lloydm
reviews.title: Very good staff
reviews.text: Staff very friendly and polite they work very hard to keep you happy!  Good job! We had to be switched to a different room upon arrival as the room we were assigned was right above a restuarant air conditioner and was very loud and hard on the ears. Also I feel the pools should be heated 2 or3 months of the year as even the kids didn't want to go into them! We were at the resort for 10 days.

reviews.author: Eva Sanchez
reviews.title: FIN DE SEMANA INOLVIDABLE
reviews.text:
Estuvimos un grupo de amigas y lo pasamos super bien! El Hotel es muy bonito, limpio y todo el personal es encantador, nos trataron fenomenal desde la Recepción, los Restaurantes y desde el personal en Playa. Tienen unas camas en playa que fueron un lujo.. nos dieron por un precio increible además de la cama, una comida que incluia, excepcional: Langosta, Ceviche, Guacamole, pulpo y todo lo que quisiera de  bebida. Los desayunos super completos, las comidas mucha variedad, solo que hay que ser rapido a reservar porque se llenan rápido, pero el buffet esta bien. La Gerencia tambien nos resolvio un pequeño detalle que tuvimos con personal de uno de los Restaurantes y se volcaron a solucionarlo de inmediato.  Tienen zona de Pub y Discoteca, por lo que no es necesario ni salir del Hotel e incluso a las 8:00 espectaculo. MUY DIVERTIDO. MUY RECOMENDABLE.  
TIP: Dale una pequeña propina al personal, se lo merecen
.

reviews.author: Theresa S
reviews.title: Everything you'd want
reviews.text: 3 girlfriends and I did a 5 night trip here. My first time at an all-inclusive. Enjoyed it very much. The hotel and rooms are clean and nicely decorated. The grounds, including all the plants hanging in the interior, are well cared for. There is a buffet serving all meals. Might be closed for an hour between meals, but not sure. It was always open when we went looking for food. There are another 6 or so specialty restaurants. Make your reservations early if you want to eat there...like a day or two ahead so you get a better seating time. We ate at 3 different ones and really enjoyed all the meals. The servers were extremely friendly and always ready to get you something else. We had some fun bartenders, Emilio and Balan, at the Bana Bar, who made a couple of our evenings very enjoyable. The entertainment staff does various things throughout the day. Zumba in the morning was a good break from all the food and drink. They also put on a nightly show with singing and dancing that lasts about an hour. Talented people!

reviews.author: JuanC0218
reviews.title: MUY BUENA EXPERIENCIA
reviews.text:
Una muy buena experiencia manquen tuvimos en el hotel. Aunque se ve que es una construcción que tiene sus años, sigue siendo muy bonita y acogedora. El looby es hermoso. La atención es excelente. La comida es muy buena. 
Tiene gran variedad de restaurantes y de piscinas. 
La atención en la playa es muy buena.

reviews.author: Darlene B
reviews.title: A step away from heaven
reviews.text: The best girls trip I could've ask for!!!!! My and my 3 closest girlfriends went for a weekend here in november and ABSOLUTELY fell In love with this resort. Right when you enter the hotel you feel so accommodated and welcome during check-in. Since we stayed in the concierge level, we had a special check- in and we're offered the best service. It was soo quick and easy and we were given a butler to call if we wanted to make reservations or reserve seats by the pool. The food was beyond amazing at every restaurant including the buffet that I would never stop eating!!!! I sware I gained at least 5 pounds. The nightly entertainment was amazing and the lounges and nightclubs were amazing. We were also always served top shelf alcohol even at the pool. I will make sure to book my next family trip here at PARADISE CANCUN!!!

reviews.author: rissysmith
reviews.title: Coco Beach DJ
reviews.text: Best Sunday day party ever at Coco Beach!! DJ Artel Govea Tabata Ortiz was absolutely incredible for anyone looking to enjoy the most fun dance party at the most gorgeous resort. He plays tech house, perfect for a beach party groove. We were there for our friends' wedding & had such a perfect day with our closest friends.

reviews.author: Maria M
reviews.title: Excelente estancia
reviews.text: Quiero agradecer en especial al mesero Cristian (creo que del restaurante Naos), originario de Agua Dulce, Veracruz; la atención del chico es excelente. En cuanto a las instalaciones tengo que decir que es un hotel bastante amplio, pero si se ve un poco antiguo, la habitación es grande, el baño espacioso y la bañera bastante bien, solo debo decir que había un poquito de polvo en las gavetas, o probablemente era la pelusa del material con el que limpian la habitación. La comida del restaurante mediterráneo, no fue de mi agrado, pero lo demás todo excelente. El buffet súper variado siempre.

reviews.author: NeverSpartak
reviews.title: один русский)
reviews.text: Был в конце октября в основном находился в отеле, так как начался шторм. Отель огромный номера также большие с ванной и душевой кабиной. В Отеле в основном американцы и жители Южноамериканских стран, так-что общение много и разного, все как и наши любят выпить))) На территории Бары и ночной клуб. У отеля несколько корпусов в зависимости от категории, выдают браслеты разных цветов. Цвет браслета позволяет обедать и ужинать в определенном ресторане, если у вас золотой, то есть можно везде))) Несколько бассейнов, в некоторых есть бар)) Пляж у Отеля огромный, белый песок.

reviews.author: Alex M
reviews.title: Cristian Lovera, mesero del Restaurante Naos
reviews.text:
Fue una experiencia muy grata, el hotel excelente en servicio e infraestructura. Áreas publicas muy limpias con olor muy agradable a incienso, personal muy amable y servicial. La habitación muy limpia, con todo lo que necesitas a tu alcance.

El Mesero del Restaurante Naos, Cristian. Excelente servicio por su parte, muy atento, muy amable, sabe hacer muy bien su trabajo. El joven del café Nespresso, igual excelente servicio, muy amable y atento, los jovenes del poolbar muy amistosos y agradable rato en el poolbar.

La comida muy deliciosa, a excepción de algunos alimentos, pero en general muy rica comida, con mucha variedad. Restaurante  Naos y Market recomendado para Desayuno y Cena.
Deberían mejorar el uniforme del personal del bares, no es muy adecuado los colores y las prendas. La mayoría del personal portaba uniformes muy bonitos.

reviews.author: beatrizc396
reviews.title: Excellent Stay at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus January 25 through the 30.  We had a fabulous experience. We stayed in the Royal Service, which I highly recommend.  Our Butler Galdino, went out of his way to make sure my birthday was very special.  He was also so helpful in scheduling dinners and taking care of any needs we wanted.  In my opinion, one of the best restaurants on the property is the Palapa, which is only for Royal Service guests.  The bali beds by the pool and the beach are exquisite. The service is impeccable.  We experienced excellent service all throughout the hotel, with a smile.  The spa was incredible.  I had a facial and a message.  Both were excellent and so relaxing.  The water spa is so special and relaxing.  I've never seen anything like it.  The gym is state of the art and I especially loved the yoga.  Again, with the royal service, yoga is outside Monday, Wednesday and Fridays and it's only for the Royal Service guests.  The Royal Service Lounge, had really nice breakfasts, with fresh fruits, green juice, that was so yummy and just about anything you could want for breakfast in a beautiful setting.  We also enjoyed the dalily shows by the pool, at The Avenue each night and music in the Royal Service lounge.  Wonderful and relaxing stay.  They do a great job of making you feel Zen but if you want the party, it's there too!  Highly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: stacyt128
reviews.title: Bachelorette Party Fun
reviews.text: There were 18 of us and we LOVED staying at Paradisus. I didn't want anything wild for the trip, just good girl time on the beach! Dinner at Enzo or the Market Grill was our favorite and the beach club cabanas were perfect. We booked a private boat and went downtown one night. Other than that, we stayed at the hotel and had such a good time under the sun.

reviews.author: cortnol
reviews.title: My Wedding Weekend (Party of 33)- wedding went great- hotel disappointed on so many fronts
reviews.text:
This is perhaps the hardest review for me to write. There were few things this hotel does right. 
- The food is good, restaurant service is great
- The facilities are beautiful

For me, choosing a wedding venue was hard. I visited Paradisus a year ago and was not expecting to have the mistakes, errors, services, etc as I had in hosting my wedding day at this hotel. Some of these things are unforgivable in my opinion, thus, I am not recommending for folks to stay at this resort

- I reserved a VIP Suite and was told I could get an upgrade, which did not happen as part of my wedding package. This was to come with a Butler, we only saw our Butler once and the VIP services were minimal, definitely not worth the extra $$, rooms were not much better
- our room was practically never cleaned. My sand ceremony bottles were broken and sand got on the floor- the floors were never cleaned. We never tipped our maids for this reason. 
- The Hotel was turning off 1/2 of their electricity at times, and the night of my wedding, I had no AC and no outlet use for a hair dryer so I could not wash my hair the night before my wedding day.
- Red Lounge has hours listed to be open until 2am- the only night club. They were closing all together and did not even have it open the FRI/SAT of my wedding. They provided NO alcohol to my wedding guests after 10pm- at an all inclusive, this is unacceptable.
- I asked as it is included in my wedding package to have my Wedding Dress pressed, and it was provided to me with an Iron Stain on the front- they scrubbed it and got it off, but ruined the silk. Upon checkout, the tried to charge me for this which was horrible! It was to be free and included anyway
- 2 guests rooms had no hot water
- When a guests was missing because he fell asleep in the hotel and could not be found at 5am, the manager on duty was not helpful at all, nor was any of the security staff to help find him. Then he told us it was 'impossible for anyone to drown' when I asked if he had security cameras, they do not.
- The same night manager came down to the beach after my wedding and blamed me, the bride for taking 10 beers from the bar... one of my guests stole the ten beers, I did not and did not know it had happened. Instead of yelling at the bride, you should have asked her if she needed a case of beer! This was supposed to be an all inclusive resort.
- Because the red lounge was closed, I had to pay $2,000 more for my wedding reception to be extended from 10pm to midnight. I had to pay at an all inclusive to keep a bar open. Ridiculous and HORRIBLE!
- Planning the wedding remote was not easy either as I had to work with several people over and over and would have preferred to just work directly with all the vendors myself. I asked repeatedly for a new remote wedding planner as I did not like mine and they refused.  She told me NO for everything I asked for as  a bride. Instead of telling me no, offer me something else or offer for me to pay. It was horrible.
- Upon arrival, I was happy to see the person I met a year ago when I planned my wedding, but unfortunately, she herself was very disorganized as well as the remote planner. They never told me I would have to change the location of the reception until the day I arrived, and I was planning the wedding for a year. 
- When I stayed a year ago, I did a make up trial in the spa- and it was horrible, so I do not recommend anyone to pay for this service either. I did my own make up and eye lashes.
- When I asked for chips and guacamole for my guests at 11pm at my reception, we were told yes... but at 11:30 when I asked if we could get it again, we were refused.
- VIP concierge could not help my husband and I get a car.

I have never been told no so many times in my life. We left this resort and went to the AM Resorts line, Zoetry resort. The Zoetry was an amazing 5 days and they never told me no, even when my husband had the wrong attire, they gave us everything we could have dreamed of. It made Paradisus seem rude and not worth the money. My wedding venue looked beautiful and I ended up enjoying my wedding day with my guests and great service staff. That said, the management of this hotel needs to get their act together! Especially for a large 30+ party like I had provided to you.  I gave you well over $50K of services and expected more. I recommend folks to stay at a Dreams/Secrets resort going forward and not a Paradisus. The Gazebo here is beautiful, as are the grounds, the food is good and some of the wait staff, but it stops there. Cleanliness, Concierge, etc are horrible. Michael Jackson show is the best and only show I liked too.

reviews.author: nic0lej100
reviews.title: I will definitely be back!!  Amazing resort and exceptional service!
reviews.text:
Pros:  Everything!  The resort is beautiful and very clean. The lobby and main tower is gorgeous with the flowered vines hanging down, and the smell of the flowers was incredible! The staff was very friendly, helpful, and made us feel like royalty. Alexander and Rodrigo took excellent care of us by the pool. They made sure we had a full drink all the time, and they also brought us food whenever we were hungry. The guacamole was delicious! Maybe the best I have ever had. All the bartenders at the swim up bar were great! Christian was especially wonderful!  They had a great sense of humor, made us creative drinks and shots, and made sure everyone had a good time! The food in the buffet was very good for every meal, and again, the service was spot on. We asked specifically for our waiter, Pueblo, after the first morning because he was so friendly and took great care of us. We only made it to the Market Grill one night, but the food was amazing!! The beach was beautiful and was kept very clean and well maintained; they had servers on the beach, as well, and they did a great job! The Activity Staff were friendly, fun, and tried to get people involved as often as possible (and many times were successful!). We did not have any complaints or bad service our entire stay!  
Cons: If I had to give 1 con, it would only be that there wasn't a hot tub, and the pool water was a little chilly...however, when the weather is sunny, warm, and gorgeous, does the water temperature really matter all that much? Nope.

reviews.author: alexmurillo
reviews.title: Excelente Opcion de hotel en Cancun
reviews.text:
Excelente ubicacion pero el servicio de todo el personal fue excelente.  La comida muy buena...  
Fuimos un grupo de amigos y todos quedamos impresionados con el servicio del hotel y la comida.  
Los felicito

reviews.author: Ki L
reviews.title: excellent services
reviews.text:
excellent services,good foods
these are the names of the peoples did an excellent jobs 
1 - wilbert at naos 
2 - hector at the club melia beach side 1/24-31 2016
3 - daniel at fugeo

this resorts should not allow peoples wearing flip flop at the night time to any restaurants,
in paradisus punta cana they dont allow guys wear short at the dinner and no flip flop
peoples should dress nice and not too casual at the night time

reviews.author: Shawn H
reviews.title: Amazing Resort
reviews.text: Beautiful Resort, Amazing Pools with the White sandy beach right there.  But it's the service that makes this resort Extraordinary!  The service was amazing.  The staff is super friendly and definitely want you to enjoy your vacation and experience at Paradisus.

reviews.author: Loreto M
reviews.title: Felicitaciones
reviews.text:
Muy buena experiencia en el hotel: posee calidad en las instalaciones, limpieza y preocupación por la comodidad del huésped. 
Especial agradecimiento a los mozos Moisés y Jordhi del Restaurante Naos por su trato cordial, respeto y excelente atención.

reviews.author: Marvin E
reviews.title: Overall great experience. Not too crazy, but still very fun and relaxiing
reviews.text:
I had gone early Jan. 2016. The hotel is beautiful inside and it is fairly easy to navigate and walk around. It's big, but not too large where you feel like you will get lost. All the restaurants, bathrooms, and our rooms were extremely clean and tidy.

Service here is excellent. Servers truly want to make sure you have a great time during your stay. At the breakfast buffet, our servers Pascual and Jaime were great! They were excited to see us every morning and they made sure all of our needs were met. It helped with making our overall experience very comfortable.

Wifi sucks in the rooms. It's in the main parts of the building.

Access to the beach is easy and fun. Food overall was generally good.It wasn't the best. The food is very rich and so you will feel very heavy and tired. I recommend the Brazillian steakhouse and Fuego for dinner. the taco restaurant for late night snacks.

Make sure to check out the nightly show. Go there early to get good seats!

reviews.author: Christine S
reviews.title: Too Beautiful for words
reviews.text: The room overlooking the golf course and lagoon was incredible to wake up to each morning.  The beds were so comfortable and the room was spotless.  All of the hotel staff were friendly, helpful and fun.  Pablo greeted us each day for breakfast with superb service.  Oscar (bar manager), your staff are top notch, especially Erich, Christian, Alexander and Rodrigo.  Thank you so much for a wonderful time.  We will be back again.

reviews.author: aam154
reviews.title: Great Beach Average Food
reviews.text:
The beach was amazing and the facilities were great. Everything you could possibly need for our stay was provided. 

The service was also excellent. The only problem I found was that the food wasn't worth the price paid. If you like to travel to eat then this probably isn't the right place.

reviews.author: treslechee_
reviews.title: Restaurant Bana/Rodizio
reviews.text:
Bana: 

One of the Best parts of my trip. 
The vibe and ambiance of the restaurant was spectacular. 
Darwin was our waiter and he was phenomenal. He suggested the best dishes to taste. He had such a great personality and had us feeling like queens. I'm not a big fan of sushi but let me tell you after tasting the dishes suggested I wanted MORE. They sang happy birthday and made it super special. Thank you Darwin for making our experience one to remember. 

Rodizio Restaurant: 

One word AMAZING from the deliciously grilled meats to the side dishes all the way to the chimi sauce. Truly amazing! I would choose them over and over again!

reviews.author: Patty I
reviews.title: Girls week!
reviews.text:
We spent an all inclusive week here. There are 4 buildings in this resort. It is a large resort with beautiful beaches and large pools! You can view the ocean from one side of hotel and lagoon from other side.. Beautiful! Sunrise viewed on ocean side/sunset on lagoon side! The beaches have fine sand and big waves for body surfing! Lots of lounges to lay on ( beach & pool side). The staff is very friendly- can not do enough for you to make your stay wonderful! 
All restaurants (except one) housed inside building 3. The meals were exceptional - representing different ethnic foods ( Persian, Chinese/Japanese, Asian, Mexican, asian Fusion - 7) then an American Buffet too! 
They had a 1/2 hour show each evening that was good but had no special stage so they were performed in a bar/lounge (not a lot of room or seats).
The building at night was dark inside and outside. Needed to use flashlight on my phone to see menus ... And where we were walking... Romantic low lights and incents lit in evening...
Activities scheduled around one area of pool and on the beach were engaging and fun! There is a swim up bar too! 
The main building (#3) was a very busy building. Our room was on third floor - the air conditioning buffered the sounds from the activities going on in building...
The Spa was hard to find - over priced, small but excellent facials and massages experienced!

reviews.author: Margarita Z
reviews.title: Best Vacation Ever!  Wish we could stay longer!
reviews.text:
I seriously would not be able to find one wrong thing about this resort, even if I tried.  And I am very picky.. This was by far the best all inclusive stay!  Beautiful hotel, which always smells great, and always clean.  Beach is so clean and water is just beautiful.  The food is amazing.  I read a review below, complaining there is no Mexican food.  Not true, they have an amazing authentic Mexican restaurant that was super delicious. We made reservations to a different restaurant every night, and didn't even get through them all.  All of them were great!  The food is delicious, fresh and beautifully made!  Entertainment was awesome: special thanks to Fernando, "Chacho" and Freddy, who work so hard to keep guests entertained, and they do it so well!  The shows were awesome as well.
Special thanks to our favorite barista, (beating myself up for not remembering his name now) for always welcoming up with warmest greetings and making us laugh.
Our favorite waiter at the buffet, Orlando, always made us feel so welcomed. Sergio and George, the waiters at the beach - cannot say enough good things about these guys.  They work all day long to bring drinks/etc, and they always do it so quickly and with a smile on their face. Maria - the beautiful little lady who cleaned our room, I just wanted to take her home with me, the sweetest lady ever!  I wish I could mention everyone's name in this review, but I will just say, GO HERE!  Everyday these folks will make you feel like royalty.  Definitely coming back to this resort!

reviews.author: Houssam G
reviews.title: Very good service (waiters Alberto and Orlando )
reviews.text: I would like to thank the establishment for all my days in there , specially Alberto and Orlando (the waiters market grill)they are really kind and nice (best waiters ever ) I left the royal service only to be served by them ,in overall the hotel is really good offers plenty of services (spa beauty diving jet ski ....) I highly recommend this hotel

reviews.author: Dario M
reviews.title: Imponente-realmente all inclusive con todas las letras
reviews.text:
La verdad excelente hotel. Llegamos con un calor terrible y te reciben con sus tipicas toallas mojadas y algo para refrescarte.
La atencion es de 10, sin reproches y fuimos en temporada alta, en Agosto del 2013.
Nada que ver con otros all inclusive en los que siempre faltaba algo, o que pareciera que te tratan de ofrecer menos cosas.
El frigobar te lo cargan cada vez que lo solicitadas, el servicio de room service muy bueno, inclusive en horarios complicados, no te escatiman nada.
El desayuno, los almuerzos y cenas de 10...variados restaurants para ir al que quieran, vestidos como en casa, salvo en algunos donde la vestimenta formal se debe respetar.
La comida abundante, en el almuerzo esta la opcion de comer algo en la pileta dado que se ubican alli con una especie de parrilla y cosas para todos los gustos.
El bar que hay en medio de la pileta con personas que atienden muy bien y hacen cuantas veces pidas un trago.
Los servicios extras de 10, si no quieren ir al mar el cual esta a metros de la puerta trasera del hotel, se puede ir enfrente donde esta laguna y disfrutar de algunas de las actividades incluidas, botes, motos acuaticas, etc.
Con un bus en minutos estas en el centro, muy seguro todo como para ir por la noche a Cocobongo, hiper recomendable.
Lo mejor es que dentro del hotel te venden los servicios, alli pueden comprar entradas para lo que deseen, y no lo cobran mas caro sino como cualquier otra agencia.
Cuando tuvimos problemas en el wifi lo resolvieron agregando routers en los pisos mas altos.
Es decir, una maravilla , si buscan eso, desconectarse, comer mas de la cuenta, ser bien atentidos como huespedes, se los recomiendo.
Quizas me falten cosas por describir pero bue demasiado bueno nuestra estancia alli.

reviews.author: Francisco C
reviews.title: Regular
reviews.text: Las instalaciones son muy buenas, tiene una excelente playa muy bella, un amanecer Bellisimo, las albercas se están en buenas condiciones. La comida es mala. La atención es pésima, son muy estrictos con el acomodo se mesas pero no dan opciones a grupos grandes. Pasamos 1 hora esperando bebidas. Los meseros que nos tocaron eran groseros.

reviews.author: Camtender
reviews.title: Foruth Time of Staying Here, Love More Each Time
reviews.text: I always find the Paradisus Hotel to be one of the best hotels, if not the best, we ever stayed in. Staff is awesome friendly and they always goes the extra mile to make your stay as pleasant as possible. My first pick every time to Cancun.

reviews.author: kr2016788
reviews.title: Jan 2016
reviews.text: I traveled with friends from my medical school. We had an amazing time. I wish I had stayed longer. The facilities were very clean and the staff was very friendly. I stayed on the Royal side and I am glad that I did (it was quiet). The food was actually very good for an all inclusive (and I have stayed at a few). . .in fact the best I have seen (and we were a group of 12). We plan on making this a yearly trip at this point to the same hotel. We did not leave the hotel at all and pretty much ate, drank, relaxed. My only issue (which was individual) was my butler. . . he was nice, but I didn't see him much. My friends had a little more contact with their butler. I was traveling alone, so I was pretty low maintenance, but would have preferred to at least see him once or twice (or have a note from him reminding me he existed). I still loved my stay. I consider myself kind of a hotel snob and only like staying in nice rooms, but my overall trip was amazing from start to finish. Other names I remember as being super were Leticia (she checked me in), Sergio (one of my friend's butlers). Great stay, amazing location, and fabulous hotel. Get the Royal!

reviews.author: lori_holthaus
reviews.title: Panoramic Sensations
reviews.text: This was our first trip to Cancun and it was the most amazing experience. We were treated to only the best they had to offer; from check in to check out.  The resort faculties are beautiful from street to sand. The sounds, aroma and attention to detail were exquisite!  Can't wait to return.

reviews.author: 123Beenthere
reviews.title: Great property, great service, so-so food
reviews.text: We loved the resort and the pool area.  Didn't go in the ocean because it was rough but you can expect that in January.  Royal Service gave an adult only experience without children which we appreciated.  The dinners in the hotel restaurants were very average.  One of us has trouble walking and this is not a handicap friendly facility.  Requires lots of walking, poor signage and few elevators.  Do not come here if you can't handle lots of steps.

reviews.author: Arony_Machado
reviews.title: Excelente hotel
reviews.text:
O Paradisus oferece todo o conforto e qualidade de serviços da rede Meliá. São ótimas opções de restaurantes, que precisam de reservas com o concierge. Meu restaurante preferido foi o Bana, de cozinha asiática.
A estrutura do hotel é ótima, tanto para famílias quanto para adultos sozinhos.
O quarto muito confortável e tinha uma bela vista da praia.
O sistema All Inclusive é bom, com bebidas e refeições de qualidade.

reviews.author: Elena F
reviews.title: AWESOME RESORT
reviews.text: I've been to Cancun twice and didn't think I would go again but had to go again for the third time to attend a friend's wedding.  After staying at this top notch al inclusive resort, I would go again and choose to stay here again.  The service was over the top.  Everyone was no nice and friendly.  They go out of their way to serve you and the food was very good!

reviews.author: Vinícius A
reviews.title: Recomendação
reviews.text: Hotel excelente, com profissionais muito educados e atenciosos, opções de lazer e comida para todos os gostos de forma inclusa ou opcionais, ótima comodidade e conforto. Pretendo voltar ou conhecer outros hotéis da rede Paradisus e desfrutar mais uma vez de férias muito agradáveis

reviews.author: DavidB39653
reviews.title: Great Thanksgiving Vacation
reviews.text: Booked the Paradisus through Bookit.com for our first 10 day Thanksgiving vacation. Stayed on the adult side (Royal Service) with with my sister in law and her husband and friends from Arizona. Everything from start to finish was great. Our Butler Galdino was fabulous. He was there for our every beckon call. Have been at other resorts with Butler service but none as good as the Paradisus. Love the fact that they offer a free cell phone to you so you can call your own Butler for anything you need. Read the reviews before our trip that the Royal service was not worth the money but I strongly disagree. Worth every penny. The private pool and beach were awesome and Daniel who runs the cabanas pool side and on the beach was great. Some of the best people there were the wait staff both pool side and beach side. A big shout out to Jorge, Moses and Eddie for all the fabulous service. Never once had to wait for a cold drink or even lunch that they would gladly run and get for you.. Even better they would split their time inside at the adult bar and buffet in the Royal service lobby and outside at the pool and beach. I think the only drawback was that the swim up bar was not at the adult pool but on the family side of the resort. But the great staff made up for it. Samantha and all the other staff in the Royal service lobby were also there for all our needs and I didn't want to forget them. The room was beautiful with a gorgeous view of the beach and a huge balcony. Always cold drinks and liquor in the room.The free wi-fi in the room also would work at the beach and all through out the resort. Couldn't have been happier with the resort and all the staff. Would definitely go back and would recommend this resort to everyone.

reviews.author: N3417BUcarolineb
reviews.title: Outstanding Experience
reviews.text: The Royal Service was exemplary.  The Bali beds were amazing and the service there couldn't have been better.  The Royal Service lounge was lovely, as well.  The servers must get top notch training as our needs were met even before we knew what we wanted ourselves.  I strongly recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Megan H
reviews.title: Great staff, poorly managed
reviews.text:
I have mixed feelings about my time here. To start, the check in process was long and difficult. They did not have a room available that met our reservation so we were put in a room with one bed and an "ocean view" the view was a sliver of the ocean and the top of one of the nearby buildings. No apologies were made and no offers for an upgrade due to the lack of rooms. The next day we returned to the office to check on available rooms with double beds. Only after we asked how they would make it right by us did they offer any upgrade. This included giving us gold wristbands that gave us access to royal service areas. The staff was unapologetic that we had spent nearly half of our first day of vacation standing in line trying to fix their mistake. 

The food here was amazing. The daily buffet has great options, the food is kept fresh throughout the day. In the buffet there were several meals where we had no service, which meant we could not order drinks or water. This seemed due to poor staffing levels as I watched one waiter and one busser care for large sections of the seating. We ate at Bento and Fuego for dinners.  Bento was outstanding, even for those that do not enjoy sushi. The bartenders and wait staff were all excellent, friendly and made for a great dining experience. I want to especially mention Martin Sanchez in Naos restaurant, he was an amazing waiter who made our last meal at the resort a special experience. The Bellman Raul was also phenomenal in the service he gave. 

In our final room the view was perfect, everything you want on a vacation by the ocean. The minibar was disappointing. Two beers, several sodas and a bag of chips. No water was provided until we called room service. Housekeeping skipped our room the first day due to the do not disturb sign falling to the ground when we left the room. That was understandable, but not ideal. The next day we went on an excursion (Loma Bonita- very fun day). After leaving the room at 7:30am and returning at 2:30pm housekeeping still had not been to the room. We left the room again and returned at 4pm, the room had been cleaned and towels replaced but the shampoos had not been replenished. 

Each night we stopped by avenue bar to watch the show. Each night was unique, the dancers and singers were very talented and we had a great time. It is worth fitting them into your night. 

Overall, if your main priority is great food this property is a good option. The service staff in all areas are outstanding, they are just clearly mismanaged. The priority of this property does not seem to be in creating a seamless vacation experience for customers. I felt like a customer not a guest. If you are looking for an all inclusive service with an emphasis on hospitality I would suggest looking elsewhere.

reviews.author: katiesim99
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
I can't honestly say we would come back. I read many reviews on trip advisor before selecting our hotel accommodations. With rave reviews from friends about the food and service coupled with the positive words of trip advisor recommendations we booked at the Paradisus Cancun. 

Things happen that are beyond the control of the person behind the desk giving you the news. But how they handle it is important. To start things off we waited in a long and slow checkout line. Unlike other resorts no drink is offered upon arrival. We had requested two doubles beds and were given a king. Our "ocean" view was a small sliver of the ocean and the roof top of some facilities. The next day we were told to let them know before 11am if we wanted to switch rooms. We did. They said come back in one hour. We returned, waited in the Long check out line again and were told in another 30 minutes our room would be ready. Watching the clock tick on our sunny day as we sat in the hotel lobby we finally were given our room. We questioned what they were doing to make amends of the situation and they upgraded us to royal service. This meant we could enjoy some of the bars and dinners exclusive to Royal service. The view in our new room is gorgeous. 

Then we went to our first breakfast. Everyone had raved about the staff. We didn't have a single server address our table. (Which means you can't request bottle water). 

Off to enjoy the day. Lasted that night we went to make reservations for dinner and were put on hold for ten minutes. The only way to make reservations is over the phone. One nice thing is you can only book dinners two days in advance. This prevents people there for a week from filling all the spots. 

Lastly, I went to grab my glasses from the room and they wouldn't work. We went down to the lobby and explained it's a battery issue in the door and could someone call maintenance, the concierge said the only person who could do that was the main check in desk. Really? You mean to tell me I need to wait in the line where the average check in takes 15 minutes all to ask you to call maintenance because nobody else can.  I'm not faulting them for the door not working---but how you handle the issue is important. They sent a service person and 30 minutes later they arrived. I just wanted to meet my friends for breakfast....not wait for service. 

All in all, the service staff tends to be good. Bartenders try to take care of you. Although, the bars all close staggered from 10-12 until all that's left is the club. If drinking past 12 and not being in the club is what you are looking for your options are limited. Dinners are good and food is tasty. Even the Mexican that does not require a reservation was excellent. 

I can't recommend this hotel. Not because there were issues (that's life and travel) but because of how they didn't handle the issues. Of the three other hotels I've stayed at in Mexico, and one other in Cancun. I'd go back to the Iberostar in a heart beat. I actually looked at canceling day two and leaving. To spend all this time and money and feel like you can't get your issues resolved. I'd give up the good food for being able to enjoy my vacation from somewhere other than the hotel lobby standing in line.

reviews.author: HunnyBunny2014
reviews.title: Not what I expected
reviews.text:
Will go back to Cancun but will stay elsewhere.
Hotel dated, needs maintenance. Had a really really crap check-in experience which is too long to write about, Virgin refunded me 10% to apologize.
Staff ok in general. Most came across rude and obviously wanting tips!
I take my hat off to Samuel on the beach, he was friendly and assertive.
We opted for the extra cost of the beds on the beach everyday which we were made aware that it was rare for people to do. We went all inclusive but still spent a lot on extras and would expect to be treated nicely (not special treatment)
We didn't like any of the restaurants there - wasn't anything like I was expecting. So we went out and ate elsewhere most nights which was extra cost - not really what you expect for an all inclusive holiday.
Also the GM had friends staying so all the staff had to rally around them and make sure they were fed, watered, got their favourite bed first etc etc VERY POOR
Also lots of group large bookings which were disruptive. Wi-fi is not good.
Room was ok - my friend paid extra for a junior suite - and there was NO difference between my standard room and hers! housekeeping didn't top up fridge or cleaning products daily. One day my friend didn't even have towels!
Will be returning to Cancun but staying elsewhere.
I'm not a moaner, we did not let this ruin our holiday, still had a great time.

reviews.author: peterbV3322HZ
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: Everything was incredible. From the beautiful of the beach to the wonderful architecture of the hotel. I truly had a marvelous time. The staff did exceptionally well to attend to my every need and the food was quite exquisite. I will absolutely recommend this to all my friends and family for a future vacation spot.

reviews.author: Conrado R
reviews.title: Servicio
reviews.text: Necesita mantenimiento de pintura y tener show, el espectáculo del 31 de diciembre pésima la música y la acústica, necesitan tener un grupo de animación más versátil y colocar baños más cerca a la alberca

reviews.author: jem799
reviews.title: First impressions are key
reviews.text: Extremely clean and beautiful establishment.  Would highly recommend this resort to friends and family. Staff was very kind and knowledgable. Food and bar was phenomenal. I Look forward to a future visit!

reviews.author: Vijit W
reviews.title: Huge Place
reviews.text:
Huge resort. Nicely kept. Beach wasn't that good. Lots of sea weed and the water goes deep within a few feet from the beach. Pools were good. There were guests bringing food into the pool and some were eating it standing in the water and washing off the grease on their fingers in the water. There were security people around but they either did not care or was scared to point that out. 
It looked like the management was a bit confused sometimes. There are two pools and all of a sudden, they would close off one pool to the regular guests so that their exclusive club members could use it. There were only two couples in that section the whole day and lot of kids and parents were very disappointed as the other pool was deep and kids could not use it.
Good entertainment in the evenings but after 9.00 pm, the place is dead. There is a disco place which is a joke. Some guests go out to the night clubs etc in the City but there is nothing for people who want to remain in the hotel. Shopping is close. You can take the public transport. 
Most of the staff were friendly. Food was good and a lot of variety. Did not like the Japanese restaurant much.

reviews.author: Michele V
reviews.title: Maravilhoso!
reviews.text: O Resort Paradisus é maravilhoso! Os quartos são ótimos, amplos, limpos e confortáveis. As piscinas, os restaurantes, os funcionários, a decoração, achei tudo fantástico! A localização também é boa, com certeza eu voltaria a me hospedar neste hotel!

reviews.author: bcabezas
reviews.title: Royal Service, lo mejor!!!!!
reviews.text:
Buenísimo, excelente atención!!! Las habitaciones cómodas. Las instalaciones de Royal Service Solo Adultos cómodas, todo muy limpio, mucha preocupación.
La piscina y la playa excelentes y la atención en ambos lugares, impecable. Música en vivo relajante que hacen que uno quiera quedarse todo el dia descansando.

reviews.author: chrisgL5750BE
reviews.title: Fantastic Experience
reviews.text: I would recommend Paradisus to anyone! It was a great experience. From the staff, to the location and all of it's amazing adventures. The power boating, jet skiing, and the food is always met with the greatest service.

reviews.author: Jennifer W
reviews.title: This place is absolutely breathtaking
reviews.text:
Since the moment I entered the hotel it's just amazing! The rooms are large and very clean as well as the staff is attentive to your requests. You may get lost if you've had a few to drink but it's great. The pools are amazing and the bartenders near the pool area are just so much fun they made my birthday so much better.  
I have nothing bad to say about this hotel absolutely nothing!

reviews.author: donmS863MN
reviews.title: Amazing place
reviews.text: Went for a end of the year company party and it as great. My company has done this trip every December for the past 3 years and I'm sure it will continue. Staff is great and there to help with everything. Real fun bars and restaurants throughout the resort and the swim up pool bar is great!

reviews.author: kellenmccaughey
reviews.title: enjoyed everything
reviews.text: Room was clean service was great... whenever i needed something the staff was there.... also the everyone greeted us with a smile.   I wish the food was a little more diverse and the restaurants were easier to try.

reviews.author: hishram
reviews.title: Best vacation ever!
reviews.text: Resort was impeccable, service was on point. I really have no complaints and I thank paradisus resort for making possible what was probably the most epic vacation I have ever taken! The only thing that could have been better was the food, but who goes to Mexico to eat anyway!!

reviews.author: Diego T
reviews.title: Excelente opcion para relajarse junto a la playa
reviews.text: Fue mi primera experiencia en un All Inclusive de 5 estrellas, y fue muy buena, el servicio del hotel es excelente, incluye todas las comidas tanto en buffet internacional a casi cualquier horario del dia, barra libre junto a la piscina y playa y si los prefieren podes reservar en cualquiera de los otros 6 o 7 restaurantes del complejo y cenar a la carta también todo incluido. Excelente ubicación, a 20 min del aeropuerto, a 20 min de la zona de las discotecas y a 30 min de la ciudad de cancun. Tiene wifi gratis en todo el complejo incluso en la playa. El único aspecto negativo que encontré fue que para hacer uso de cualquier instalación del spa había que abonar el dia o un paquete de días (los servicios básicos del SPA deberían están incluidos en la tarifa, al menos las piletas, hidromasajes y baños saunas y demás baños humedos), en mi caso no afectaría al momento de calificar ya que no suelo utilizar estos servicios.

reviews.author: Leave88
reviews.title: Excelentes hoteleria
reviews.text: Este hotel es uno de los mejores de la zona, con excelente gastronomía, cocteleria y atención del personal. Ideal para visitarlo en pareja, con una increíble vista al mar tanto en sus habitaciones como en parte de las barras y restaurantes. En el mes de marzo festejan spring brake, por lo que todo cancun se ve copado por jóvenes estadounidenses que viven de fiesta, recomiendo ir en otra fecha.

reviews.author: rborislow
reviews.title: Don't go anywhere else in Cancun except here.
reviews.text: This resort is incredible.  The employees are incredibly friendly and understand their job is to help you have a great vacation.  The Royal Service section of the resort is the place to stay if it fits in your budget.  Don't go anywhere else.

reviews.author: jlieberman
reviews.title: Power home remodeling happy customer
reviews.text: Was on a company trip with power home remodeling. Was again the best experience of my life. The hotel staff goes above and beyond and do a phenomenal job. I would say the service is as good as the ritz carton.

reviews.author: Karen K
reviews.title: Had the vacation of my life
reviews.text:
The service was top notch.  Food was very good, pool bar was fun and resort was very clean.  Want to come back here again.  Very relaxing, view was awesome.
Plan on going with family and good friends, Resort has something for everyone.

reviews.author: Elena N
reviews.title: Amazing Holiday Trip hard to leave!
reviews.text: Was lucky enough to tag along on my boyfriends work holiday trip and it was nothing short of amazing! Would love to go back, amazingly beautiful place inside and out, very friendly and helpful staff from the front desk to the cleaning staff, great food, drinks, and amenities

reviews.author: JTB61
reviews.title: When Can We Go Back?!
reviews.text: Trip was unbelievable. Hotel is super clean, good smelling, easy to get around. Staff caters to your every desire and is beyond friendly. This is my 3rd year and it keeps getting better if that is possible. The food is to die. Our room exceeded our expectations. We just love everything about it.

reviews.author: kelly938
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.text: A place you won't forget. Great to spend with friends or that significant other. The facility was amazing. Good gym. Well kept. Rooms are big and make you feel like you're getting more than what you're paying for. Close drive to downtown cancun. This was my 4th time back.

reviews.author: scarpenter949
reviews.title: Great Customer service
reviews.text: Great customer service, I should know I work at a resort and if I could send every employee here to be trained they would understand the high standard that this resort has. The Activities staff is awesome, they really enjoy what they do and want everyone to have a fun vacation experience.   Great restaurants great pool area(but spend the money and rent the Bali bed it is worth it.  Great bar service.  Can not say enough great things about this resort.  Management and staff thank you for a memorable vacation experience.  Hope to visit there again.  Thank you.

reviews.author: Gennady K
reviews.title: A for effort, F for execution
reviews.text:
This is a review of my stay at Paradisus Cancun from 12/16-12/20

The good:
-beautiful hotel inside
-two huge pools
-easy beach access
-friendly staff
- comfortable beds

the bad:
-uncomfortable pillows on the beds
-very slow service at times (balcony was missing lounge chairs, took 2 days of several calls to service desk to bring these up)

-pushy sales tactics (twice during our 5 day stay we were approached about attending an "information" session about the new Paradisus locations - the first push at attending this was right after we checked in!!! this would NOT make me want to come back to this hotel

- air conditioning system: i know, mexico can be humid. however, the filtering in the AC system, or the system itself, is in need of servicing. every room had a musty wet smell to it, emanating from the AC vent when it was turned on. the room smelled very unpleasant, like a cheap motel rather than a four diamond all inclusive.

the ugly:
-restaurants: this was a HUGE HUGE problem at this resort. the entire reservation system is terrible, especially at an all-inclusive!!! restaurants except the buffet require a 24hr reservation... 24 HOURS!. we found every single restaurant to be empty, or serving very few parties. for example, one night we had a reservation for 2 at 8, and 8 at 8:30 to Enzo Thai. when we tried to combine these, we were told they could only accommodate 10 people at 8. when we got there, there were maybe 6 other people eating at the restaurant, with space for about 200. we encountered this same issue at Vento, at Bana and at Fuego, where we would be told they could not accommodate, yet would remain empty.
none of the restaurants we managed to eat at actually let us order off the menu, rather telling us they will bring us "customer favorites", which I'm pretty sure were the lowest cost items on the menu.

also.... not all restaurants are open 7 days a week. when blue agave is open, bana may be closed, and vice versa. none of this is specified at time of check-in. this random closure, combined with the reservation system basically funnels everyone to the buffet with so-so food and low food costs for the hotel.

On 12/19, when the rain closed down the poolside grill, the hotel opened blue agave earlier in the day. they were clearly not prepared, with staffers from other jobs being forced to work as waiters - they had no idea what was on the menu, and were constantly bringing the wrong orders to everyone at our 8 person table.

this is a very poor policy adopted either by management, or by the hotel owner. requiring a draconian reservation system, in order to manage food and labor costs is blatant. this is an all-inclusive - your guests should be able to eat when they want, what they want.

-another issue at this hotel was booking. we were told that after 12/20 there weren't any rooms available - fine, its the holidays, and its busy. however what they failed to mention was that the hotel was fully booked because some power company bought out all the rooms for a corporate retreat - fine, they're entitled to do this. however, the main issue with this is that the company also paid to have its logos and banners plastered ALL OVER the property. i did not pay to have my senses attacked by booming music, and corporate colors that were everywhere - corporate pillows on all couches around the hotel, their banners on nearly every glass surface around, the constant construction sound on the beach of the huge party tent being but up. the hotel treated all other guests as second-class customers, catering to this one big corporate client.
