overall, this was a terrible stay, not worth my money. i could have easily taken my business elsewhere, however having stayed at another paradisus property in mexico, i chose this location. it is clear to me that the staff is friendly and tries very hard to be helpful, however the management needs to reassess its policies.

reviews.author: Stephanie L
reviews.title: Relaxing Getaway
reviews.text: My first time in Cancun......loved it! Beautiful hotel. Very clean, great service, very friendly staff. Our Lagoon view suite was large and comfortable. The food at Naos was amazing.  I've never seen a buffet as tidy, clean and appetizing as the one in this restaurant. You could not ask for more choices. Also enjoyed a wonderful dinner of sushi at Bana and a delicious lunch at Blue Agave.  Want to give a special thank you to Carlos Fararoni who kept our mini bar very well stocked and was very helpful with bus information.  I will definitely go back there if I have the opportunity and I highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Sue L
reviews.title: Annoyed.
reviews.text: In 2014, we had booked a room thru Orbitz, for a friend's destination wedding.  When we arrived, we were told that the hotel was overbooked and we would have be moved to another hotel.  We were upset, we wanted to stay at the Paradisus to be close to our friends and spend time with them.  Apparently, all the wedding guests who booked thru Orbitz, or other non-hotel websites were booted.  I sent a complaint to Orbitz, but no response with them.  However, the hotel was nice and gave us a compliment voucher for a return stay.  This year, 2015, we decided to take advantage of the free stay and booked a room.  I emailed the hotel several times before our arrival, and told them we do not want a repeat experience of being bumped from the hotel.  When we arrived, we were told that our room was not ready, which was not a problem, we decided go eat lunch and have drinks.  Few hours later, room was still not ready.  At this point, I was irritated.  We expressed our annoyance with the situation, and finally, they found us a room.  We were "upgraded" to the butler service section of the hotel.  We were very excited about this "butler" service, then we get to the room, and realized it's a regular room, and we were supposed to have a junior suite.  At this point, we were so done with the check in process and wanted to start enjoying our vacation.  We didn't complain any further.  Our butler was very pleasant and accommodating, however, we did not utilize his services much, and I don't know if it was necessary to have this service ever, there really was no additional benefit for simple, do-it-yourself travelers like us.  We also made the mistake of signing up for a sales pitch, which we were told would take about 2 hours or less, and it took an hour longer.  Overall, as much as I don't want to sound ungrateful for the free stay, but overall experience is not positive.  We really tried hard to love this place, as we were super bummed the first time because the resort was so lovely, and extremely thrilled anticipating the second trip, neither trips were what we expected.  We love Cancun, and we will be back, but not to Paradisus or any of their sister hotels.

reviews.author: AndreaMSeoane
reviews.title: Un hotel ideal para ir con familia
reviews.text: Este hotel es perfecto para ir con niños. La piscina es muy agradable y allí realizan actividades y concursos todas las mañanas. Además está justo pegado a la playa. Tiene varios restaurantes (el peruano el mejor) y la comida diaria del hotel es bastante completa. Las habitaciones son cómodas aunque sin ser muy lujosas. El trato de los trabajadores es muy correcto. Un hotel ideal para pasar mucho tiempo en él.

reviews.author: honestnreal
reviews.title: Royal Services excellent staff…
reviews.text:
Overall we love going back to this property. Management should certainly be proud of their very hard workers. During this past visit we briefly chatted with many clients who stated they have been returning for years. 
Unfortunately La Palapa restaurant was closed during our stay. The hotel's website obviously does not provide actual updates.
A new restaurant Enso (formerly La Perla) should be opening before the very high season. It will offer an array of Asian inspired dishes.

reviews.author: Marvin R
reviews.title: Great Service
reviews.text:
Our Beach server Victor was awesome.  Friendly and always willing to help and give advice on what to do. the hotel was nice and clean, and the Blue Agave restaurant has great food. The gym could use a couple more machines though.

Marvin

reviews.author: K4283HWnancyc
reviews.title: Girls Weekend
reviews.text:
The adults only resort is very large and right next door to the kid friendly resort.  The surrounding neighborhood is questionable.  We did not leave complex.  The food was good but not great.  The Bali beds were great because in rained while we were there.
We had a very large bug that flew into our room.  We called the front desk and asked for help, no one came.

reviews.author: Laura A
reviews.title: Nothing special; very average resort.
reviews.text:
We rate this hotel as very average, nothing spectacular stood out. We came here as part of a group and Cancun/this particular location was chosen by the people who coordinated the trip. 
We stayed in the Royal Services side and appreciate that with this option we did have a quiet pool area, a butler to help us with reservations/etc, and a private beach area. Our butler was Galdino and he was very nice and helped us with reservations. He also gave us great advice on navigating Market 28 in downtown Cancun. At the Royal Services pool/Bali bed we had Cesar as a waiter one day and he was great! We never had to wonder when he was going to come back by or get us what we wanted...as we did with some of the other waiters. The bathroom at the Royal Serviced pool did get dirty quickly and ran out of TP, soap, and towels often. The Bali bed reservations fill up FAST so if you want one book ASAP! There are plenty of towels always available at the pool area. 
The food at the resort was not great, except for Tempo (which costs extra, but was amazing! Our waiter was Samuel and he was fantastic!). The buffet is subpar at best and your only option for lunch is the buffet or the Royal Services restaurant (which is only open to RS guests). The restaurants were also just OK and left us desiring better. In fact, we left the resort to eat somewhere else after getting tired of the limited options. The RS area has a continental breakfast and snacks throughout the day which we found to be fine, but nothing special.
The rooms were clean and comfortable. They provide you with all bathroom amenities you may need (soap, shampoo, hairdryer, etc). The maid service came daily and also our fridge was restocked with water, etc. The resort overall was clean. 
We visited the gym a couple of times. Most of the equipment was not working...2/4 treadmills and 2/4 elliptical were out of order during our entire week long stay. They also offer a couple of stationary bikes and free weights. 
The spa was very nice and prices were on par with what I would expect at a resort. I had a facial and it was relaxing. The amenities at the spa were very nice. 
Nancy at Olympus tours was the best! She helped us get a transfer back to the airport and also booked a snorkeling trip for our group. Her suggestions were very honest and appreciated. She also gave good advice on navigating the city when we left the resort area. 
Overall, all staff was courteous...but a few (Galdino, Cesar, and Nancy) stood out. We tipped these individuals, but none of the others went out of their way to provide service that we deemed to be worthy of an extra tip. In our future trips to Mexico, We would not come back to Cancun...we've been to other parts of Mexico and found them to be more our style and a little nicer. We came to this particular place as part of a large group of friends/family and we, personally, would choose to go somewhere else rather than return to this resort. 
We did have a relaxing and enjoyable time with our friends/family while here.

reviews.author: peirick18
reviews.title: Great hotel nice beach great value
reviews.text: I've stayed here 3 times . Very pretty resort for the money . Large footprint , big rooms with great terrace. Food is incredible , service is great . Don't get a room above the dance club 3355-3356 gangham style till 230 am with no one in the club but music pounding into my room. Royal service is the way to go at this resort . I didn't do it this past time and I regret it. I waited30 minutes to check out to pay $2 for a phone call . Like it was 1985 or something . Ok enough complaining the staff was awesome , the food was incredible , there are a lot of inferior hotels you can pay a lot more for . I'd recommend any Paradisus this is my 8th different one . They are a good brand for sure

reviews.author: Eduardo P
reviews.title: Muy buen hotel
reviews.text: Muy buen hotel, si bien no esta cerca del centro tiene playas muy amplias, las habitaciones son amplias, estan haciendo arreglos ya que algunos balcones no estan bien, los resto son buenos salvo los de comida mexicana, la animacion es regular

reviews.author: dean418
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: The hotel was great. Very clean and well kept and friendly staff. Excellent service from Rode went above and beyond for anything you needed. Hotel was only a short bus ride from downtown. The bus cost $1. Great place to stay!

reviews.author: chiroagha
reviews.title: Friendly staff, great beach, sub-par food
reviews.text: Overall great experience, but some things need improvement. First off our wait staff during breakfast and lunch was great.  Victor, Orlando, and Pascual really went out of their way to help us enjoy our dining experience and make sure we have everything and anything we wanted or needed.  The air conditioning unit in the room was extremely loud, the food wasn't that great, but on the other hand it was extremely clean and family friendly.  Compared to the other places I have stayed in Cancun this was probably the the better.

reviews.author: Nora Lorena C
reviews.title: Un paraíso!!!!
reviews.text: El Hotel tiene un tamaño perfecto para que no te sientas apretado en ningún lugar, el mar bellísimo y la playa sensacional. Ni que decir del servicio, todos muy muy amables, con una sonrisa siempre en la cara y te dan todo su corazón trabajando.

reviews.author: Joanne D
reviews.title: Royal service treated like queens!
reviews.text:
We loved our stay in this resort! The staff was amazing : thank you to Gerardo, Cesar, Rodrigo, Javier, Alejandro, Valeria, Guillermo,Octavio and all the pool and restaurant staff. They made our stay unforgettable with their professionalism and kindness. The restaurants were really good 
The whole place is clean and inviting. 
We strongly recommend you stay here, you'll have the time of your life!
All in all, great place, great staff, amazing food and unforgettable vacation!
We would go back anytime! 
Jocy and Joanna

reviews.author: Jana D
reviews.title: I'll Be Back!
reviews.text:
Two friends and I visited Paradisus Cancun from November 19 to 23, 2015, for a 40th birthday getaway. I've stayed at two other all-inclusive resorts in the area (from Cancun to Riviera Maya), and Paradisus Cancun was by far the best. 

When you enter for check-in, you notice a wonderful scent in the air. It smells like a spa, or just fresh air, and it's lovely. I'm sensitive to strong scents and this was nothing close to offensive. From the moment we arrived until the moment we left, the service was top notch. My experience has been that the folks working these resorts have fantastic customer service skills and are very friendly, but somehow the service here was just a step above. 

Our favorite staff person was Asuncion, a waitress at the beach bar. She has worked there for 23 years and was so hard working and very, very sweet and kind. She brought buckets of cold water (refilling with ice as needed) throughout the day, and we could hardly finish one drink before she was offering us our next. We did tip her two days ($10-15 each day because she was so lovely). The last day was the birthday for my friend, and Asuncion brought her a cake. We asked her to widen our drink repertoire, she asked if we like sweet or sour, asked if we like vodka, and brought us delicious special drink after special drink. Then the shots started coming. The drinks are the strongest I've experienced at an all-inclusive resort. They were very good, and I got buzzed but never sick. We stayed on the beach each day, and at least during our stay, Asuncion worked the section of beach on the north end of the resort, down the stairs outside the circle shaped restaurant next to the beach grill, to the right of the beach volleyball ball net as you look toward the Gulf.

We loved the nachos and chicken wings at the beach side snack place. That salsa was the best I've ever tasted. All the food was top notch. Service was great. No complaints with the food. Making reservations was simple.  A number to call each morning to make reservations for the following day's dinner is provided at check-in. Our first day there, we made dinner reservations for that night and the next; one for 7:00 and one for 7:30. There was a mixup the second night. We arrived to dinner at 7:35 and were told our reservation had been for 7:00 and we missed that, but after a 20 minute wait at a bar around the corner, we were seated for dinner. There was a bit of a language barrier but our hostess under promised and over delivered regarding our wait time. All was well. I had the seared vegetable skewers at the Mexican restaurant, and they were amazing, and the rice served with them was the best white rice I've ever had. The breakfast buffet is the largest I've seen, and everything is delicious. We only ate the lunch buffet one day since we enjoyed the snacks at the grill by the pool for nachos, guacamole, hot dogs, burgers, wings, etc. each day after a filling breakfast.

Our room was clean. We did have to ask for additional washcloths each day. They seemed to run low on those. There weren't many visible outlets in the room, so two of us charged our phones at night in the bathroom. The balconies are of generous size. Ours overlooked the lagoon. Beachside would have been better but we had a budget and opted for lagoon. At least we had water to see. There was a highway in view before the lagoon started. Still, no complaints.

We used the Expedia travel agent to book parasailing. He was very friendly, kind, and accommodating. I'd book all excursions through him since he knows which are safest. We didn't get to parasail because we planned to do so on our last day, we'd heard from what ended up being an unreliable source that 3:00 was the best time to go, and by then there was a storm coming so they couldn't take us up. Getting a refund from the travel agent was simple. If you parasail, don't wait until late afternoon on your last day, just to be safe!

The beach is deep (from shore to concrete at the resort) and beautiful with soft white sand, big waves, and gorgeous aqua green water. There were plenty cabana beds and lounge chairs under palapas at the beach and the huge, lovely pool. The pool water temperature was perfect. Our first afternoon, a father and his adult daughter drifted a bit too far in the Gulf, and out of nowhere a lifeguard showed up at the shore line, keeping a close eye on the situation, whistling to let them know that they needed to move inland and they were in danger. Once the daughter signaled that they needed help, the lifeguard swam to them with a life preserver, and three more lifeguards appeared on wave runners, as well as one more on the shore. The father was safely and heroically rescued. It was a team effort and I was glad to know they had an eye on the situation. I didn't drift too far out after that. I just let the waves his me when it was about waist deep. They father and daughter were trying to get back to shore but just couldn't make any headway with the current and waves.

This resort was the least "open air" that I've stayed in Mexico, but it's my favorite. Inside, philodendron plants vine down from each floor creating a wall of green leaves. There are glass walls in the restaurants at the perimeter so you can be in air conditioning with breathtaking views. The center of the pyramid (the most inner part of the first floor) includes fountains, fish, wooden walkways, gorgeous restaurants, many seating areas, and green plants that reminded me of a scaled down Opryland Hotel. Gorgeous! 

We booked this vacation in late August and needed a resort near the airport to maximize our beach time, that wasn't couples only but also not geared heavily to kids. It may have been the time of year, but we lucked out. There were families and couples and kids, all whom were kept entertained, but it was quiet and no obnoxious loud music at the pool. There was music but it didn't overpower everything out of that vicinity. There were nightclubs in the resort that looked fun but we didn't check them out.

Once we settled on Paradisus Cancun for our destination accommodations, we booked airfare and resort via Travelocity. We then added the airport transfer. We used Super Shuttle and we're pleased. Note, however, that Paradisus is pronounced Para Dee Sis (not Para Die Sis), as our initial pronunciation caused much confusion with two transfer services.

We were asked at check-in if we wanted a room on a low floor or high. We chose high and were very pleased with the views a high room offered. Elevators were convenient and quick. There are eight floors of rooms, and we were on the 7th.

There are a lot of concrete stairs around the pool and beach so this may not be the best place for someone to visit if they have some trouble with stairs. They do have ramps but the stairs are more convenient.

I was shocked to learn that the resort is 25 years old, because it's been very well renovated and kept clean and beautiful. The price is right for a place so nice. I can't wait to return!

reviews.author: Walter F
reviews.title: Excelente escolha em Cancun
reviews.text:
Surpresa muito agradável em
Cancun, estrutura física muito boa, restaurantes excelentes e
Com variadas e boas opções... Quarto bem grande, confortável, silencioso, com varanda... Pontos negativos: quando chove entra água no quarto (3409) é apenas uma vez um senhor no café da manhã foi bastante ríspido é grosso, acredito que o
Funcionário estava em um dia ruim... Pq o ponto alto do hotel, é o treinamento que dão as funcionários, todos bastantes solícitos, cordiais, e sempre preocupado em ajudar... Estão de parabéns pelo treinamento de seus funcionários...  Outro ponto negativo é a falta de
Música na aérea da piscina durante boa parte do dia...

reviews.author: passion4travel4ever
reviews.title: Excellent Service and stay
reviews.text: My friend and I visited Cancun in the beginning of November. We stayed at Paradisus Cancun. The weather was great and there was almost no seaweed (that was my main concern). Customer service at this hotel was outstanding. We booked Royal Service and it does make you feel royal. We had a cell phone to call our butler for any need we had. You have a server on the beach so you do not have to do anything. I would like to say special thank you to our server Octavio. He was amazing. I did not like anything from the pool bar menu and he would go to the kitchen and ask them to prepare a dish I was in the mood for. Also I would like to say special thank you to the pool concierge Daniel. He went above and beyond for us (bali bed requests). Overall it was a very nice property, the lobby is very different from traditional hotels. In the evening they have live music and then shows after that. Lots of food choices. It is completely safe on the property. I spent the last day by myself and not once I felt unsafe. I would love to visit this resort again.

reviews.author: Neener415
reviews.title: Truly Paradise- Excellent in Every Way
reviews.text:
What can I say about this resort that would do it justice? My cousin and I just came back from a 5 night 6 day stay at the Paradisus Cancun and we couldn't be more pleased with the hotel, the staff, the food and thee overall experience. I have stayed at a number of all inclusive resorts in the past and consider myself to be very picky when it comes to service, cleanliness and food quality. This resort had it all and then some. I highly recommend booking the royal service as it does make a difference in your stay. There is complimentary access to the spa, an assigned butler, premium drinks in the royal only lounge, an exclusive adults only pool and many other added perks. 

I want to send a HUGE shout out and THANKS to Rosanna our butler (only female butler) who was the kindness, sweetest and most pleasant person I have come in contact with during my travels. She did everything to make sure our stay was comfortable and enjoyable. She really went above and beyond and deserves all the praise for her hard work. Ask for her if you decide to get the royal service! 

In terms of food, we mainly ate at the restaurants for dinner and they were all fantastic. Excellent service, great food quality, lots of choices for vegetarian dishes and an extremely accommodating staff. The buffet had a lot of options but mainly greasy oily buffet food which i am not really into so if that's your thing there are tons of options. 

From the check in process to the constant greetings of the staff, to the pool concierge, the waiters, the food quality and the room comfort. Everything was top notch! Throughout the trip we were treated and felt like royalty. 
Sandra at the royal concierge was extremely pleasant, helpful and attentive. Daniel our pool concierge checked in on us several times throughout the day to make sure we were enjoying our cabana time. He even came by with fruit kabobs popsicles AND brought back my cousin's missing hat from the lost and found. Special mention to the manager Daniel and our waiter Gamaliel at Fuego who were extremely customer service oriented and were very much about making sure our dining experience was top notch! 

Here are a few other bullet points to consider in case you go

1. the hotel is dimly lit with mood lighting in the evenings so do not be thrown off by that
2. the elevators need a bit of sprucing up but they are working on it
3. the Nespresso bar in thee main pyramid is an added bonus
4. the royal pool concierge has banana boat sun block and tanning lotions in case you forget yours
5. If you want something special for your room just ask. They will try to make it happen
6. Room service food was excellent but you have to wait at least 30- 45 min for it to arrive
7. Spa is small but the hydrotherapy was great to end the day with.

Feel free to hit me up if you have any further questions.

reviews.author: thuytt1
reviews.title: Our stay at Paradisus
reviews.text: We went with a group of 16.  Everyone enjoyed their time there.  We were not able to try all the restaurant but the ones we did try were excellent.  We did the Brazilian Steak house, the Sushi, and Frego.   My favorite was the Sushi, which I wasn't expecting it to be good.  The buffet was the only thing I didn't care for and the taco place was good.  Make it a point to make reservations for the restaurants, you won't regret it.  The staff was amazing.  Please bring singles and fives so you can tip.  You won't regret it.  Victor by the pool, Luis by the buffet, and Gerardo in Red Lounge gave us amazing services.  We stood in the third pyramid, on the fifth floor.  You were able to hear the music from downstairs but we didn't mind.  We were close to everything.   Great hotel and we would go back for sure.   We didn't do royal service but no regrets.

reviews.author: Anibal A
reviews.title: maravillosa atencion y vistas increibles
reviews.text: muy cerca de todo, la habitacion espectacular, la atencion igual, los restaurantes en particular vento muy agradecido por la atencion prestada, gerardo,juans, katia y jose excelentes anfitriones y la comida de lujo.

reviews.author: tgob
reviews.title: Girls weekend
reviews.text:
We visited Paradisus recently for a girls getaway. The resort was exceeded all of my expectations. The service was superb. Food was awesome.  Buffet  at Naos was awesome. The staff at Naos awesome and great energy. The bartenders at 2nd Avenue bar made great drinks. Gabriel the Waiter  at Fuego was awesome and made sure we had everything we needed. The lobby of the resort was breathtaking day and night also  romantic at night. 
The rooms was always clean so is property. Minor thing when room would get clean  towels removed were not replaced.  But an easy fix as the staff responded promptly. 
Had a such a pleasant  stay planning to return to next year.

reviews.author: diegofalciola
reviews.title: Excelentes mozos!!
reviews.text:
Un gran reconocimiento a Marcos y Kauil del restaurante NAOS, por su excelente atencion y predisposicion para atendernos com otambien para solucionarnos inconvenientes para ubicarnos a un grupo de 8 personas.

Estamos mas que satisfechos y agradecidos por el servicio

Firmado:

Santiago Angel Falciola
Olga Freijo
Antonio Castro
Maria Castro
Enrique Perez
Ruth Perez
Oscar Perez
Liliana Perez

reviews.author: Janet R
reviews.title: Great vacation!
reviews.text:
Many issues including:

...false advertising....the web site for Tempo (restaurant) says under the description that "Additional charges may apply". That is very misleading because you pay for what you consume. It is no included at all. It is very upscale and worth the money though.

...difficulty making reservations for dinner. The place was packed for a convention. All of the restaurants were booked. I called the day before we left and they would not let me make reservations ahead. We did not arrive late, but at 2pm. Assertiveness and persistence paid off and we ate at Vento which was wonderful and Mole which was also great.

...it took a day to get 3 rooms close enough together.

...there are no only two outlets in the room so bring an extension cord.

...the bathtub didn't drain. 

...the room leaked at the patio doors when it rained.

...there are not enough shady areas or chairs for the beach and pool.

...the roof leaks in a lot of areas during the rain and with the beautiful slick floors there is a risk of slipping.

Now the good stuff:

...even the lagoon facing rooms have a beautiful view.

...the rooms are well appointed and comfortable.

...the service is fantastic! 

...the hotel is beautiful.

...the food is delicious.

I would come back! 

p.s. bring a starbucks insulated cup with straw. They will fill them for you with your drink!

reviews.author: Lynda C
reviews.title: Oustanding
reviews.text: This resort was above and beyond all my expectations.  The room was perfect with an ideal balcony with a full ocean view.  The staff was exceptional from check in to check out and everything in between.  The food was very good. The entire experience was amazing.  The atmosphere and serenity throughout the resort was perfect.  Especially enjoyed the evening shows at the Avenue Lounge.  The bartenders, Christian, Maritn and Andrez were a cut above with friendly conversation and great for suggesting new, different, tropical cocktails.  Everyone at this resort could not have been more helpful, friendly and cordial.  Can't wait to plan my next trip.

reviews.author: Hannahb350
reviews.title: First Class
reviews.text: Beyond all expectations of the country and all-inclusive resort. The upgrade to the Royal Service was well worth the extra money and Hector our personal butler couldn't have done anymore to make our holiday more special

reviews.author: Ronald S
reviews.title: Great Stay Great Service
reviews.text:
Very tropical main atrium. If your looking for an environment for ROMANCE & RELAXATION this is definitely the place.Staff is very friendly and accommodating (if you are looking for "over the top" service that include hand shakes, name recognition, extra fast response times, then simply TIP your hard working bar tenders, hosts, beach servers and restaurant servers). The crew we run with appreciates the art "getting what you pay for". We tip generously and we end up with all the attention we need while others who don't, sit around waiting for average attention. 
Very simple advice folks!
KAUIL (Ka-Will) is the BEST SERVER in the buffet. Greets you every morning with a hand shake, smile and first name. At lunch time he will see you coming from across the pool and gesture with hand signals requesting how many will be coming so he can set up our tables accordingly.
SAMUEL in the beach beds area provides first class attention.
JESUS on the beach is very courteous, friendly and will also greet you on a first name basis as well as everyone in your group.

reviews.author: 646dustind
reviews.title: Poor service and overpriced.
reviews.text: Overbooked, problems with check-in, staff seemed indifferent to anyone who complained.  Service was great from a select few people and terrible from the rest, with the bar staff topping the list of ignoring people and moving slowly at all times.  Also, this is the only all-inclusive I've stayed at where it just seemed like they were trying to get me to always spend more money on either service, products, or the staff making me feel like I have to tip at all times with tip jars out.  I've had better stays at half the price in other resorts.

reviews.author: Debbie H
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Absolutely loved Paradisus Cancun!  Beautiful property and beautiful beach!  The staff was excellent and would like to recognize 2 of the best.  Laura and Leticia waiting on us on the beach and they were the best waitresses than any other trip that I have ever taken.   They were very attentive and always smiling!  Hope they are there again on a next trip because they went out of their way to wait on us timely.  If we were gone walking, our bucket would be filled with drinks and ice upon our return!!!

reviews.author: Hope D
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun...in one word...AWESOME!!
reviews.text: I'm reporting to you live, from a Royal Service poolside bali bed! Many thanks to Victor Perez, our magnificent pool server, who keeps our cold drinks flowing & literally goes out of his way to get you whatever you would like to eat & drink. Also, special thanks to our butler, Galdino, who made all our wishes come true.  We have 3 more days at this beautiful island paradise, then back to reality. It'll be so sad to leave.

reviews.author: LaurenAnne25
reviews.title: Pool Bar
reviews.text: I have been coming to the  Paradisus Cancun for 20 years.  I want to recommend one of the waitresses at the pool bar.  Her name is Asuncion.  She has waited on me during each of my trips.  She is so friendly and is an excellent waitress.  Please ask for her when you are here.

reviews.author: naya32
reviews.title: Paradisus is a gem!!!
reviews.text:
Great location & some of the friendliest people!!!!
I can't thank enough for the services & friendly interaction with Miguel at Naos, Erick Cruz at the pool bar, and those who filled in-room mini bar & maids who cleaned up the room at least a couple of times everyday.   Thanks again!!!

reviews.author: T603DDcheryls
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation in a beautiful Resort!
reviews.text: I just returned from a week long stay at Paradisus and enjoyed it so much I felt compelled to write my first review. Four friends (women) traveling together and it was very safe!  We arranged an all inclusive package through Funject vacations. The all inclusive is the way to go, there are many different restaurants to choose from - hint, you must have reservations for most of them. They will only let you book two days in advance - we decided which restaurants we wanted to eat at before we left and made sure we called when we got there. All of the food was delicious! The buffet changes themes every day so you aren't eating the same thing for lunch over and over. The service everywhere we went was excellent.  We enjoyed Vento restaurant, with Aurelio, Katia and Jose, and Mole was fabulous!  Everything was very clean, we constantly saw people mopping the floors or cleaning the glass. Be careful because there are stairs/steps all over the place, including one to get into the bathroom of your suite. The beaches are beautiful as is the pool area. Sergio Mesero did a fantastic job keeping our drinks flowing! Even in the rain he kept coming over to make sure we were ok under our cabana and make sure we had enough to drink.  One note about the pool - the depth is 5.1 feet almost everywhere, which makes it challenging for shorter people. My friend is 4'11, so we bought floaties in the gift shop (they will blow them up for you) to make things a bit easier for her.  We arranged an excursion to Chichen Itza, which I highly recommend. It's a long day on a tour bus, and we were a little concerned about the travel to and from, but they take your safety very seriously there. We never had any issues. My friend had her door open a crack while she was grabbing something from the room, and security knocked on her door to make sure she was ok. The only time we left the Resort was on the guided excursion. As someone mentioned, they do start the lobby background music early, but it never bothered us in our rooms. We were on the 4th floor ocean view junior suite. One thing to mention, the entertainment does go till at least 9pm and it's loud - you won't be able to sleep through it if you want to turn in early (unless noise doesn't bother you). From start to finish we received excellent service!  We did not upgrade to Royal Service and didn't feel it was necessary. We had tips included in our package, but we still brought $50 in ones (each person) and tipped our servers. They work hard and deserve it!  I have recommended this resort already to many of my friends, and I would definitely stay at the Paradisus Resort chain again!

reviews.author: Grace Gómez-Herrera
reviews.title: An unforgettable experience!!!!!
reviews.text:
A pleasant atmosphere of the entrance, comfortable rooms with breathtaking ocean.
The service and attention are personalized.
Here you find the ideal holiday break.
Romantic and elegant in all areas !

reviews.author: yarden p
reviews.title: We love it
reviews.text:
Beside it was raining all day long we really enjoyed the hotel! Everything was great! The food and especially the bana sushi restaurant!!
The room service was quick but not a lot of options!
We enjoy very much !!

reviews.author: Curtis D
reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed here while attending a friends wedding.  The hotel is absolutely beautiful and the staff is warm, friendly, and always there to help with anything you could need.  We wrapped up our stay with dinner at Bana, the Asian fusion restaurant in the heart of the main pyramid.  Luis, our waiter, took perfect care of us and made sure we knew which menu items were "must haves.". He was helpful friendly and provided for some very enjoyable conversation about the area and his background.  It really made the meal memorable.  I will come back here, no doubt.

reviews.author: Gloria T
reviews.title: Excelentes restaurantes
reviews.text:
El hotel esta muy bien ubicado, con excelente servicio de alimentación, la playa y la piscina espectacular.
No nos gusto que durante nuestro viaje se encontraban haciendo muchos trabajos de mantenimiento, la parte de entretenimiento puede mejorar mostrando la cultura mexicana y caribeña un poco mas!!

reviews.author: iceman276
reviews.title: Great Experience!
reviews.text: We definitely recommend the Royal Service Package. Fantastic Service! Great food with premium drink options. It was nice to get away from the loud area and go to the private pool on the royal service side. If you travel in a group of four you should share a cabana so you have one for four days due to only receiving two cabana days per room. Large layout. Great for a big group.

reviews.author: Rona K
reviews.title: FABULOUS
reviews.text: big shout out to staff Letecis,Guildo,Edier,orig Eddie,Valeria,Moises,Victor,Gustavo,Omar,Jojue,Cesar,Juan Carlos,Ricardo,Staff at Rest La Palapa,and Housekeepers! All food was amazing, very clean property, everyone was very friendly! Would highly recommend this resort and for adults only, the Royal Service is a must, only negative is the Market Grill is only outdoor dining and was too hot.

reviews.author: jkeish
reviews.title: Service unlike any other.
reviews.text: This property was the very nicest, cleanest and with the best customer service I have honestly ever experienced. First, our pool side Spanish lesson with Erick M. was fun and informative and I have taken Spanish before..that wasn't fun or informative. Then, our Royal service butler, Alma was not only perfect in every way but found out I had a birthday and provided balloons, cake and a bubbling jacuzzi as a surprise. She was amazing. Additionally, our front desk host, Angel in the Royal service area was more than helpful and patient as we checked in and out without a hitch.  I will definitely visit this property again and hope to work with these superior professionals.

reviews.author: MsLyn901
reviews.title: Lacking Attention to Detail
reviews.text:
Overall, the trip was great. The beach is beautiful, there were several great food options, the housekeeping staff did a great job, the Royal Service pool area is beautiful, and the Royal Service outdoor staff is extremely attentive. 

However, there were several issues that I didn't expect to have with Royal Service. I had to call to have the minibar restocked, as it had not been restocked for more than 2 days. The power went out several times - not sure if this is generally an issue in Cancun or just this hotel. Whenever the butler was not at work, the lady answering the request line would say she would call back but never called back. Thus, I ended up having to call multiple times to get simple things done, and some tasks, like reserving a Bali bed, were never done! 

I hate to complain about such little things, but these issues made the trip much less relaxing as I was counting on things to be done that were never done. Plus, I felt like I never received the amenities and extras that were promised to me upon checkin. I definitely question whether Royal Service was worth the extra cost.

reviews.author: Q S
reviews.title: Best for the Best
reviews.text: No other to place to stay. After 3 vacations to other resorts near by this is the only 4 star vacation. Totally go all inclusive. Just do not stay near the dolphins.  We had the sweetest  concierge lady.  She catered to us and she recommended we listened and had tons of fun. Even a great couples massage.

reviews.author: Lorenzo C
reviews.title: Worth the Travel
reviews.text: I usually don't take the time to rate hotels or resorts, however, I was not passing this one by.  Simply put; the service and amenities are top notch.  This is the cleanest hotel I've stayed at: there have been over 50 in my short life time.  Worth the money and time...will book again.

reviews.author: Ron G
reviews.title: Beautiful and great resort!
reviews.text: We booked a short 4 day vacations for 2 adults and our 3 year old son.The place is very clean and the service is amazing ,they make any other place look like a disaster if you compare.they help you with everything to make your stay smooth, fun and  amazing.the food is very good and  the variety of restaurants and type of food can please the most demanding taste.the pools are very clean and the service around them is good too.the ocean side is beautiful and  very well maintained.they have activities and areas for the little ones and they hotel is perfectly designed for people with limited mobility as well as kids with strollers ...have nothing to criticize about it. their constant fight to keep the place shiny as a jewel is amazing  ..always people painting ,cleaning and polishing glass walls.timeshare talk it's not a problem for me since I know how to get rid of them , anyways lovely people too and not aggressive in any sense

reviews.author: jeff c
reviews.title: Anniversary trip with family and friends
reviews.text: Had a nice vacation at the Paradises,there for an anniversary,food was ok,tried the butler service much better,couldn't get anyone to keep the room stocked properly,all in all the staff was friendly, hotel was clean,would go back again.

reviews.author: veronique b
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Un simple mot WOW le personnelle est vraiment la force de ce bel hôtel pendant nos deux semaines des gens formidables. Un merci spécial à Mario Ivan Sandra Osacar et Juan. Un gros gros merci spécial à Daniel et Jesus. Un full love a mes amigos Kauil ;) Darwin ;) Guillermo ;) Leticia xxx and more lové for Sofonia and Laura see you again Québec City xxxxxxx

reviews.author: Farfalla
reviews.title: Hotel para relajarse.Pero con bastantes detalles que mejorar
reviews.text:
Ambiente muy relajante. Bonito hotel y decoración.Atención amable,pero no de todos. Buffet Naos muy bueno,destacan los garzones Edgar y Miguel.
Las frutas para los batidos no estan refrigeradas provocando la llegada de mosquitos.
Spa excelente.
Show entretenido.
Barman de la piscina Salvatore muy amable y simpático.
Disco muy bonita,pero la misma música y en mismo orden todos los dias. Garzona muy amable.
Piscina pequeña;las regaderas o duchas de la playa SIN AGUA.Simplemente me respondieron que no funcionan.
Aseo de la Habitación hecho a medias. Recien despues de hacerlo presente en recepción   lo hicieron como corresponde.
Solicitamos termómetro y no tenían;menos tenian  un medico.
Estos son detalles muy importantes para un hotel 5 Estrellas.

reviews.author: Saazzzz
reviews.title: Loved, loved, loved!
reviews.text:
The Paradisus hotel is great! The service was excellent, the food was great, and the beach was pleasant and relaxing.

I cannot speak highly enough about the service at every restaurant, buffet, and around the hotel. Everyone was very attentive and kind. They have servers at the beach, who are around to provide you with drinks. They aim to please. 

My favorite restaurants were Mole and Fuego. I didn't have high expectation for the buffet, but even that was excellent. 

Overall my friends and I had a wonderful stay at Paradisus Cancun. I highly recommend it.

reviews.author: ENRIQUE C
reviews.title: VIAJE DE PLACER... ESTADIA DE LUJO
reviews.text:
Estuve 4 noches por un premio corporativo y si bien el clima no acompaño los primeros dias, disfrutamos de las instalaciones; desde los restaurantes hasta las piscinas.
Increible atención all inclusive

reviews.author: danielarX3505CG
reviews.title: buen servicio al cliente!!
reviews.text: el servicio del personal es muy bueno,  en la picina nos atendio Salvador, excelente su trato al cliente. el hotel es bonito, para mi gusto le falta iluminación en las noches, y mas opciones para la hora de la comida!!

reviews.author: Paola SG S
reviews.title: All Inclusive Gourmet
reviews.text:
Si estás pensando que por ser un all inclusive comerás hamburguesas, pastas y papas fritas todos los días estás pensando en el hotel equivocado. Paradisus Cancún ofrece una experiencia gourmet que deleita hasta los más exigentes paladares. Con 10 diferentes restaurantes, este resort all exclusive ofrece alimentos y bebidas con los más delicados y frescos ingredientes. Barras de ensaladas, carnes frías con los más selectos productos importados de Europa, así como los mejores productos nacionales. 
Además con sus diversas instalaciones Paradisus Cancún ofrece el mejor lugar para que en familia o en pareja te olvides de la estresante vida laboral y te despejes un rato al ritmo de las olas del mar.

reviews.author: mailalerces
reviews.title: EXCELENTE HOTEL PARA DISFRUTAR DEL CARIBE
reviews.text: Buenas instalaciones, con una atención esmerada y cordial. Las habitaciones muy amplias y con todas las comodidades para una estadia perfecta. El hotel es general amplísimo para disfrutar de todos los momentos. Lo malo, no adjudicable al hotel, la cantidad de algas en la playa

reviews.author: Jesenia Q
reviews.title: Third time and still the best!!
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus Cancun for the third time and we still loving this hotel, special shout out to all our bartenders, Rogelio, Francisco, Salvador, Ernesto and their capitain Oniver, gracias, the waiters Martin , Orlando (Naos buffet) no complains, service is outstanding, hotel overall is spotless clean, we loved Paradisus, can't wait to go back.

reviews.author: Koyarzabal
reviews.title: It was nice but I would consider another hotel next time
reviews.text:
Pros: Good location, nice hotel, good atmosphere & good food
Cons: Restaurant reservation open only until 4 pm. Pool bar closes at 6pm (early) When turning off lights at night, the switches to charge cell phones and cameras turns off too. Hotels does not offer shuttle service from/to hotel/airport. 

For tours: Do not book anything at the hotel as the price for tours doubles.

reviews.author: Quicka
reviews.title: Ideal para el plan que tengas!!!
reviews.text:
Excelente y bello hotel. Sus instalaciones son muy amplias, cómodas y diversas para lo que se desee hacer. Sitios de rumba, tiendas con precios aceptables, múltiples tipos de restaurante, shows, excelente zona de playa y dos piscinas.
Habitaciones amplias con buen mobiliario, aseadas y equipadas con todo. 
Les sugiero no tomar las habitaciones del nivel más bajo, pues se corre el riesgo de perder la vela vista, bien sea a la playa o a la laguna.

reviews.author: Sarah W
reviews.title: Beautiful in paradise
reviews.text: I was there at the end of August 2015, despite the weather it was more than I can ask for in vacation. Place was squeaky clean, staff was overly helpful, service was exceptional. Only tip that I have to recommend is to make your reservations to restaurant as soon as you get there, otherwise its a hassle to get in to the nicer restaurants. Even though the buffet was more than enough, I would have liked to try more restaurants. But that was my fault for not reserving as soon as possible. If you eat at NAOS restaurant/buffet please ask for Rafael Chi, he was unbelievable. Unlike the other waiters, he was accommodating beyond his title as a waiter and you knew he did it because he wanted to and not for the tip money like the other staff. So please ask for Rafael, you will be satisfied. I will most definitely revisit paradisus Cancun. The hotel is so beautiful, peaceful and zen. It was probably the most beautiful, best staff and most fun I've had on a vacation.

reviews.author: brooke b
reviews.title: I want to live there!
reviews.text: This was an excellent experience!  The staff was amazing!  Rodrigo, Emilio, Omar, Valeria, Lupita, Octavio and everyone else couldn't have been more awesome! I would recommend this to everyone!  The rooms were fantastic.  The energy at the resort was so positive and warm!

reviews.author: Dottie W
reviews.title: royal service paradisus cancun
reviews.text: i am a travel agent from nc and i just returned from paradisus cancun staying in royal service - this is a secret 5 star hotel  one of the best vacations i have ever taken everything was perfect rooms  staff ect--------- one of the concierge in particulate   Leticia Patlaw Rosas was so kind and hard working --- everything i asked for including one almost impossible dinner reservation was worked out for me by her --- her smiling face and her energy to make our stay perfect leaves a lasting  memory . i would recommend this hotel to any of my clients !!! Our favorite resistant was MOLE - we ate there two times the hardest working waiter ever was  Javier Salazar he went above and beyond our expectation best waiter in all of mexico i think !!!  the hostess Sandra and  captain Jesus  at MOLE also did many things xtra to enhance our experience even bring us the mariachi  band to serenade the 6 of us in the private dineing room !!!! Chef Irvin Huerta made the most Delicious Mexican dishes i have ever tasted -- i am a mexico specialist and have stayed at every Paradises mexico and Dominican republic this one Paradisus Cancun  was by far the best experience in Royal service  i have ever had !!!

reviews.author: Melissa M
reviews.title: Very Nice Resort
reviews.text:
Very clean and attentive to guest. Loved the pool area and the swim up bar. Lots of lounge chairs , but you must get up early to get one. The beach area is very nice and waiters are very attentive to you . I never went without a drink.
Lots of restaurants to choose from. Gym was very nice and offered classes which was nice. Rooms are comfortable. Only complaint is that there were no table and chairs on our balcony. I love to seat outside at night :((.And drink my coffee outside in morning. We took the bus to a few places which was easy and only cost a 1.00 . Much cheaper that a tax.

reviews.author: rene
reviews.title: Semana santa de lujo.
reviews.text: LO BUENO:  Lo mejor es la limpieza y la comida, el Lobby esta espectacular a pesar de q ya es un hotel con mas de 25 años de construido, la atención no es tan buena como en el PARADISUS PLAYA DEL CARMEN LA PERLA Y LA ESMERALDA. En estos hoteles en verdad la atención es Excelente!!!!

reviews.author: enaughton
reviews.title: Amazing, Beautiful, Carefree!
reviews.text:
I recently visited the Paradisus Cancun with 6 of my girlfriends and I can say we all had an amazing experience at Paradisus. From the moment I checked in, Ramon, our concierge, helped us check in, offered us beverages, made us smile, and was helpful from beginning to end. He was on top of every little detail we needed, from cabanas each day to restaurant reservations. He checked in on us frequently to make sure we were all well taken care of and happy! 

Everyone at Paradisus was so friendly, accommodating, and genuinely made me feel like they cared about each and every one of us. The food was great, pool was amazing, and the restaurants, So good! They knew I had a large party there for my bachelorette and would accommodate us to have a nice large table or even a private room. 

All of our rooms were clean, air conditioned and had a fully stocked bar. The pool was amazing as well as the service at the pool. 

Overall, this resort was amazing and especially thanks to Ramon, our concierge! He helped our trip go so smooth, without a care in the world! I can't wait to go back!!

reviews.author: Stay296837
reviews.title: TOP NOTCH!!!
reviews.text: This resort by far exceeded our expectations!!  The food was exceptional & the staff (especially Chris) was perfect!!  The restaurants & bars are a little warm, so dress comfortable. A word of advise...GET THE ROYAL SERVICE, it is VERY well worth the cost.  NO kids & you are literally treated like royalty!!

reviews.author: Raghda S
reviews.title: Wonderful Stay
reviews.text: I just got back from a 5-day stay at the Paradisus Cancun Resort and I already want to go back. We stayed at the Junior Lagoon View Suite. We had a pretty cool view of the ocean on the opposite side of the strip.The staff was super friendly, the food was wonderful, the room was pretty and clean, the pool and swim-up bar were great. The pool is so big that even with a lot of people there, it doesn't feel over crowded. This was my first all-inclusive trip and it was a great one! Thank you Paradisus :)

reviews.author: Dana E
reviews.title: Wonderful resort
reviews.text:
When we arrived at Paradisus we were quickly assisted, given wrist bands to start our vacation. Our first night we ended up at Coco's where Geraldo was our bartender. He entertained the whole bar which various speciality shots. 

The next day we went to the pool where I met the sports and activities team. Those guys are awesome! Pool side zumba, water aerobics and a fun game daily. Oozie, Freddie, Huge, and Mauricio are seriously awesome. 

Several nights we ended up at Coco's where Chris and Gerry were wonderful bartenders introducing us to new drinks and being very attentive. 

The resort really takes care of you for a week, its nice to not have any worries for a week and truly enjoy a vacation.

reviews.author: dmb207
reviews.title: Nice all inclusive in Cancun
reviews.text:
My room was great, they were kind enough to put us in the adults only section, which was very nice since I'm not much of a kid person myself. 

Hotel was nice, accommodating. 

Tons of food choices, very large resort with just about everything you would ever need at your fingertips. 

The biggest plus of our trip was our AMAZING butler Ramon, he truly went above and beyond to make the experience incredible.

reviews.author: Lania M
reviews.title: Perfeito
reviews.text: Passamos nossa lua de mel e não temos do que reclamar. Ótimo atendimento, ótima estrutura, quartos super limpos, restaurantes gostosos. ajudou nossa lua de mel a ficar ainda mais incrível. Super indico

reviews.author: Jozias7Kelvin7
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: Hotel maravilhoso!!Quartos sempre limpos e arrumados, piscina perfeita. A equipe sempre prestativa e educada..Diversas variedades no cardápio. Vista linda! Um spa q supera as expectativas! Uma ótima localização!!Vale a pena a estadia

reviews.author: Charlotte H
reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text: My friend and I went to Cancun as part of her trip to see me in the USA and absolutely loved this hotel. We were treated exceptionally and the food, drinks and service were all fabulous. Big shout out to Omar who was one of the loveliest and funniest members of staff who entertained and looked after us as at the Royal service pool. Also to Orlando who made our breakfasts brilliant. Would hundred percent go again.

reviews.author: Kdalfred
reviews.title: Great time at the Paradisus
reviews.text:
I just returned home from Cancun this week. I went in celebration of a friends 50th birthday and there were six of us ladies who stayed at this resort for 5 days.

I found the resort to be clean and orderly the restaurants to be plentiful and the service to be outstanding. My friends and I opted to upgrade to Royal service as we were not going to be doing many excursions.

Personally, I feel Royal Service is a must do if you are on an adults only trip. Having a private pool and private beach which were kid free was fantastic (no offense to those with kids).

Special thanks to our Butler Antonio for making our stay so memorable!! The service he provided was top notch!!

Would definitely stay again!!

reviews.author: Joshua H
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel - awful food.
reviews.text: I have stayed at Melia hotels for 12 years now. This was my only negative experience. The food at the hotel, specifically the La Perla restaurant, gave me food poisoning. The Melia chain of hotels has always had good food. For some reason, this hotel could not get it right. The only restaurants that were 'safe' to eat and not get sick were Bana and Blue Agave. .

reviews.author: Lilian T
reviews.title: Sensacional!!!
reviews.text: O hotel dispõe de tudo que você precisa para umas hospedagem perfeita e sem preocupações. Os restaurantes são deliciosos e com bastante variedade. A preocupação dos funcionários com seu bem estar é algo notável. Fiquei no Royal Service e tive até um mordomo a minha disposição. A área de lazer é excelente assim como o SPA. Super recomendo uma massagem relaxante, é um investimento prazeroso.

reviews.author: Xharigu
reviews.title: Aniversario
reviews.text:
A mi me encanto este hotel, por ello deseo regresar pero ahora con mi esposo y darle una linda sorpresa de aniversario, en el viaje anterior que realice fue todo pagado por la empresa, estuve revisando la pagina y necesito saber algo muy puntual el servicio de alimentación es todo incluido como las bebidas, con el precio que aparece, yo me estaría quedando por una semana.
Espero que me puedan ayudar con esta pregunta.
Gracias de antemano.

reviews.author: Kleber N
reviews.title: Hotel Perfeito
reviews.text:
Hotel perfeito! Serviço Royal Service
Exclusivo top! Comidas e todos os serviços perfeitos! Alta qualidade! Comprei pela Angelik Tour agência especializada! Diversos restaurantes dentro do hotel tais como mediterrânea, japonesa, boates! O spa é incrível!

reviews.author: javier h
reviews.title: la excelencia en el servicio y la calidad de la comida de Royal Service
reviews.text:
Una nota 10 para los restaurantes Palapa,El fuego y el de comida japonesa espectacular y especial sus servidores Lupita,Valeriadier,Rafael y Ricardo,siempre muy atentos y con una sonrisa.
Una nota 1 para las carnes Grill y Vento,en especial este ultimo,muy alejado de la comida española,en especial la tortilla y los calamamares fritos.
Por ultimo nuestro conserge Hervik un maestro del servicio,muy pero muy valioso.
Lo que mas me llamo la atención fue el saludo de todos Uds.Un paraíso,un sueño.

reviews.author: Candace M
reviews.title: BEST RESORT EVER
reviews.text: Best resort ever!! Trust me your not going wrong if you choose here... With family or with friends.. Make sur you try La Palapa... EDDIE is one of the best servers .. Very polite and aims to please.. LOVE LOVE LOVE! And also my butler Rode who pulled our vacation together to make it special

reviews.author: Young Mi C
reviews.title: 편안히 쉬고 왔어요
reviews.text: 룸도 업그레이드 해줘서 조용히 머물면서 쉬기 정말 좋은 곳 입니다 직원들도 친절하고 음식도 맛있습니다 카바나도 예약하면 하루종일 쓸 수 있고 프라이빗 비치도 길고 멋있습니다

reviews.author: 490sebastien
reviews.title: Restaurant bana
reviews.text: I just make a reservation at the restaurant Bana it was so good and the service by Yair perez so nice and all the time with the smile he is friendly and the food was so amazing. The ambiance with the person who sing just beside the waterfall it's just magic

reviews.author: Grethel S
reviews.title: Atencion categoria Diamante!!!
reviews.text: Excelente la atencion, desde que uno llega se siente mimado, todos son sumamente amables, la playa hermosa, la piscina muy amplia, los mozos pendientes todo el tiempo de que no nos falte nada. Me centrare en 2 sectores que me parecieron estupedos: 1. Kids Zone, 100 puntos para el personal con mucho cariño cuidaron a mis hijos de Nara y Kenzo todos los dias, el kids zone esta abierto de 9 am a 20:45, ellos diariamente le dan clases de cocina, manualidades, arte y los llevan a la piscina para juegos acuaticos, mis niños felices!!! Solo los veia para la hora de comer por que todo el dia querian estar en el kids zone, mi marido y yo luna de miel total. Y 2. El restaurant oriental Il Bana: Delicioso!!! Sin palabras para describir los sabores, nuestro mozo de nombre Eric nos hizo sentir como reyes, el nos trajo una degustacion de toda la carta, exquisito!!! Y su atencion fue una maravilla, definitivamente puedo decir que el hotel se merece mas que 5 estrellas, se merece cat. Diamante!

reviews.author: shinal_patel
reviews.title: Awesome experience!
reviews.text:
This was my first time in Cancun - I went for a bachelorette and it was well worth it. Everyone was extremely friendly and welcoming. Each person went above and beyond to make our experience one to remember. I would highly recommend this resort to anyone. Also, I would recommend getting Royal Service, it does cost a little extra, but it is worth the extra cost. The extra cost goes a long way and makes life a lot easier. Two of us did not originally get Royal Service, but the manager gave us a reasonable deal.
As for the staff, Daniel, Rode, and Victor were awesome and made the experience even better!  These three made sure all of the girls had what we needed.  We could not have asked for three better people to assist us while staying in Cancun/Paradisus. When we needed something they were right there ready to get us whatever we needed. They took care of all our needs from drinks to dinner reservations. Those three guys took great care of us and we could not ask for better hosts! 
 Honestly, I have no complaints from the stay at Paradisus.  We all felt extremely safe, which was big concern for all of us since we were all girls.

reviews.author: Tytti85
reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: This was my first time in all inclusive hotel. The hotel itself is beautiful and kept clean. Because the center of the main pyramid is very open it doesn't feel like normal hotel at all. Food in the restaurants was good and I'm sure everyone will find something suitable for their taste. Fridge in the room was filled everyday with drinking water and sodas etc, which was really nice (included in the hotel price). Best thing about this hotel is the amazingly beautiful beach! I saw the beach in different spots along the hotel zone, and it is not that pretty everywhere. I could have stayed forever in the beach looking at the beautiful ocean. When we wanted to go further from the hotel (but inside the hotel zone) we used the buses which are running very often and one bus stop is right in front of the hotel. It is very easy to use and really handy (one way costs 1USD). I have only two negative things to comment about this hotel: 1) we had a balcony facing the lagoon and it would have been nice to sit there, but we didn't have any chairs or sunbeds in the balcony, which was bit disappointing and 2) there are not enough sunbeds in the pool area or in the beach for all hotel guests, so you need to go really early (before 8am) to reserve a chair for you (I know, there are signs that it is not allowed to reserve any chairs and items will be removed from chairs if nobody shows up in 30 minutes, but after two days we also started to reserve the chairs since everyone else was doing it also and we never saw that anyone's items would have been removed). Otherwise the hotel was perfect for our vacation. And I still have to mention this once more: the beach in front of the hotel is just amazing!

reviews.author: Gerardo A
reviews.title: Summer vacation
reviews.text: Service was very good at the best time staff waiters everybody was generous made me feel want to go back and visit food was great quite a few restaurants to pick from and the resort the bars were located all in a good areas and they offer good packages to go see and do many activities would recommend to everybody

reviews.author: Sandra I
reviews.title: Muy mala experiencia
reviews.text: El hotel es viejo y ruinoso. La comida mediocre. La atención  es muy buena y servicial como toda la gente de la zona, excelente servicio. Lastima que las instalaciones  y la disponibilidad de áreas  de alberca con sombra sean pésimas.  Aunque te venden los espacios con sombra no tienen los suficientes para dar la disponibilidad. En estos tiempos con tanto cáncer de piel que te expongan a esta situación. No volvería a hospedarme.

reviews.author: SocorroCP
reviews.title: Comida muy buena
reviews.text:
Estuve en Paradisus en Junio de este año y resulto una estancia inolvidable. La habitación era perfecta y con buena vista. La atención a la llegada muy amable, a tiempo. El hotel es impresionante en general por su estructura, limpio, los aromas y con muchos detalles que hacen sentir en un ambiente especial. 
La comida fue algo que nos impresionó por el buen sabor y calidad de los alimentos. Mi cena en Vento fue una experiencia que no voy olvidar jamás. Regresaré pronto a probar Tempo.
Agradezco a todo el equipo de Paradisus por las buenas vacaciones que me dió. Vale la pena ir.

reviews.author: fizbet
reviews.title: Fantastic holiday
reviews.text: A beautiful but very large hotel directly on the beach. There was a mix up when we first got there but the staff was amazing Maury Sanchez, who sorted everything out and we was up graded to Royal Service.  Amazing adult pool, fantastic food with lots of restaurants to choose from.  The only down side was the sunbeds at the other pools.  If you want sunbeds with a parasol they are reserved with towels by 7.00am .  There is a sign by the pools saying if you haven't used the sunbeds within 30 minutes of putting your towels down they would be taken off.  This didn't happen.  All in all a fab holiday

reviews.author: CarlesWispa
reviews.title: Потрясающее место!
reviews.text: Потрясающий отель. Даже как-то пошло в данном случае описывать великолепные завтраки, красивый чистый пляж, комфортные номера... Слов нет, чтобы передать все впечатления. Отель высочайшего уровня. Хочется вернуться в это райское место ещё много раз.

reviews.author: Dolores V
reviews.title: Awesome place! !!
reviews.text:
Wow!!! Es el mejor hotel que he visitado, los restaurantes están muy bien atendidos, la comida deliciosa, el paisaje divino, la gente que trabaja ahi atiende a la gente muy bien. 
Lo recomiendo ampliamente,  es limpio, la gente muy amable y. Cálida

reviews.author: 2015kansas
reviews.title: Kansas Crew
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time! Sofonia Jesus was awesome! Look for him on the beach. Everyone was so friendly and accommodating. Lots to do, the Speed boat Jungle tour was very cool! We enjoyed the evening shows and all the dining options, our favorite was taco bar.

reviews.author: 715joeyp
reviews.title: awesome resort to enjoy as a couple or family
reviews.text: I booked the Paradisus because two of hotels that I am a member of were booked.  I am so glad I chose the Paradisus it was worth every dollar.  From check in to check out they made our stay a wonderful one.  The staff is awesome, friendly, courteous and make every effort to accommodate your requests.  Special thank you to: Cesar, Eddie and Lupita from the Pappas pool area and to our butler Ivan.  If I have the opportunity to return I would definitely consider this resort.

reviews.author: sermar99
reviews.title: Restaurante fuego...you have to go.  The service and the food are amazing
reviews.text: Fuego restaurante...you must go...service and food amazing.  Order the ceviches..the sea bass..you can try all the sea options....out of this world. We went twice in 6 days...alejandro is a very friendly manager

reviews.author: Rias10
reviews.title: Just a mediocre resort
reviews.text: Ok let's start with I travel a lot .. I have been staying at all inclusive resorts for the past tens years now. This was not my favorite. Where should we start I got here on July 19 and leave on the 24th . We upgraded to royal service to get better service better pool etc. the first day the pool was. Disgusting empty ketchup packets and sweet and low all throughout the pool. I never complain about anything but I complained to the towel guys and after a hour the pool guy came and cleaned it a little bit. Today was actually the first day since being here I would say the pool was actually clean. Ok let's move on to the buffet / dinner on the verge of horrible . The buffet breakfast lunch and dinner selection was probably the worse I have seen in ten plus years I have been traveling. Dinner restaurants just mediocre bans and agauva was very good. Just not the four star hotel I thought it was going to be. Definetly makes me think if I would ever go to paradisus again. This is not the first paradisus I have been to I went to la perla in riviera maya and Palma real in dr . This hotel should be a three star hotel.

reviews.author: Esther L
reviews.title: Lovely!
reviews.text:
This was an amazing resort! The staff is incredibly friendly and helpful, and the resort is very well kept. The food was also delicious, although the buffet restaurant is lackluster compared to the other places to dine. I really can't imagine staying any where else when I go back to Cancun. 

This is definitely more of a family friendly resort than a couples' getaway.

reviews.author: kimmy j
reviews.title: swanky
reviews.text: Seriously nice place! Had an ocean view, all inclusive, awesome beaches, well maintained,  comfy bed, nice pools and cabanas, nice spa, nice gym...you really can't go wrong with this place! Staff was friendly, the life guard who saved my life was awesome. Food was scrumptious. I wanna go back!!!!

reviews.author: Los Ramírez De Viaje
reviews.title: PARA DISFRUTAR DEL MAR
reviews.text:
La visita a este hotel fue muy esperada ya que en una ocasión anterior por temas de ocupación tuve que cambiar al hotel hermano ME.
Nos recibieron muy bien, se nota que el personal se acuerda de los huéspedes o al menos intenta hacerlo ya que algunas personas nos saludaron haciendo referencia a la ocasión anterior.

La habitación que nos dieron fue con vista al mar, dentro de la dimensión normal, 2 camas matrimoniales  (sólo viajaba con mi esposa, solicite Kgz, la televisión estaba programada en ingles y no me di cuenta hasta el día siguiente creyendo que no tenían subtitulos algunos canales, después de ajustar en configuración todo se arreglo. Pedí  checar mini bar por que las bebidas estaban tibias y mencionaron que se acababan de meter y esa era la razón, me dieron unas que ya estaban heladas y por el momento se resolvió todo.

El restaurante de buffet es muy bastó, con sabores normales, de lo que se debe resaltar es la variedad de pan, jugos y licuados preparados en el momento, fruta de suficiente variedad toronja, Kiwi, fresa, uva, durazno y por supuesto los clásicos. Estación de tacos, oriental, y diferentes estaciones complementarias muy buenas.

Para las cenas se debe de reservar algo muy malo para la categoría que desea consolidar esta marca, tuve que hacer llamadas, aparecer en el restaurante y pedir favores para recibir el servicio que muy amablemente me fue otorgado en 2 de las opciones; la primera noche fue en el latino y nos atendieron más que bien, no recuerdo exactamente el nombre de los meseros pero fueron muy buenos en su trabajo y nos hicieron algunas recomendaciones que no puedo dejar de mencionar como el platillo de atún y los postres de maracuya y el de dulce de leche que es una verdadero suspiro.

Hablando de la playa la opción de las camas puede resultar una opción agradable ya que adquieres otro servicio con más contenidos Cómo langosta, agua Chile y otros opciónes disponibles, recomiendo rentar por lo menos 1 día y la zona de 70 usd es la que recomendaría.

En bebidas superó mis expectativas ya que ofrece marcas superiores dentro de la barra incluida y las cervezas de lata y sobre todo las XX hacen el día.

En la habitación es donde creo tienen muchas áreas de oportunidad ya que en la categoría que compite este hotel en este tópico perdería, el baño no tiene extractor, el mini bar nunca enfrió adecuadamente, no me quejo del servicio y de limpieza fueron muy buenos. Bien por las pantallas, cortesía nocturna con chocolates muy buenos, la vista muy buena, fácil de llegar a todos lugares, es un hotel grande sin embargo tengo entendido que las zonas principales son las de huéspedes del todo incluido y lo alejado es del club vacacional.

Gracias por las atenciones.

reviews.author: Nataliya K
reviews.title: Great time!
reviews.text:
Great food, great service!
We stayed there 7 days-and what a bless we've had!  Of course the food was simply amazing-the buffet food was fresh and had all different types of food-seafood, fish, meat, veggies, fruits, cold cuts... There were also kids menu! The service was outstanding ! 
Every night there was a dance show-the dancers were very professional!!!
I was there with my friend and her daughter , who just loved the Kids Zone( you can live your kid there 9 am-9 pm) we just took her out there for lunch. The girls who work there are amazing and very good with the kids!
We also tried the Spa-the hydrotherapy and massage package was very relaxing!
I would highly recommend the resort !

reviews.author: Mary N
reviews.title: Paradise at the Paradisus
reviews.text: Wonderful vacation at an exquisite all inclusive resort. Wonderful restaurants and a buffet that was open almost 24 hours per day. The lobby was so green with goldfish ponds and flowing water. The pool was wonderful because it was so long you could swim lengths.

reviews.author: Tony P
reviews.title: mi sombrero rojo.
reviews.text:
We booked a 9 night stay through Virgin and we returned on 5 July. We travelled with our friends (another couple). 

We had paid for the virgin plus service which included reserved sun beds and on arrival this was not recognised by the Hotel. However after a brief chat with the Virgin rep, the customer relations manager Maury Sanchez  came to see us and very quickly and efficiently put everything right. She then made a point of making sure everything was good for us for the remainder of our stay, without being intrusive.  She was an absolute pleasure.

I would strongly recommend going for the Royal Service. The extra charge is worth it. All of the staff in the Royal service area were more than efficient and very friendly. We must give a special mention to the following staff. 
Omar, Ricardo, Octavio, Victor, Eddier, Eddie. Marco. Leo.
Estoy feliz porque encontré mi sombrero rojo. !!!! 

In the Royal service the pool is exclusively adults only, there are cabanas available with fresh towels and sun beds and there was a nice breakfast / lunch dining area. 

All of the food and the drinks throughout the restaurants in the hotel were fine. We did not have a bad meal. 

I would strongly recommend the trip to go snorkelling with the whale sharks. We had a great day and we arranged this through our Virgin rep.

All in all a good stay but would not have been so happy without the Royal Service. 

Thank you Maury.

reviews.author: BRB0036
reviews.title: Fun Friends Vacation!
reviews.text: We traveled with a large group (10 people total) and while we did have to wait a little longer to be seated at meals (as to be expected) we had EXCELLENT Service!!!  The wait staff, especially Soppa on the beach, were fabulous! The spa was relaxing and the entire resort felt cool and comfortable.  Would definitely recommend to others!

reviews.author: missvanny
reviews.title: Super Strand
reviews.text:
Waren mitte Juni bis mitte Juli des Jahres 2014 im Paradisus Cancun.
Strand war 1A! Super Wasser, super Sand!
Das Personal war sehr freundlich und zuvorkommend.
Unser Zimmer war geräumig und angenehm welches 2x am Tag aufgeräumt wurde!
Das Buffet war gut...hätte aber für ein 5* Hotel etwas vielfälltiger ausfallen können,dafür waren die spezialitäten Restaurants sehr gut! HIER ist es wichtig früh genug (2 Tage zuvor) ein Tisch zu reservieren. Sehr großer Außenpool und tolle Fitnessanlage!

reviews.author: Jackie M
reviews.title: Very beautiful, relaxing resort.
reviews.text: We had a group of 70 people go to this resort for a wedding in the end of June 2015.  This resort is beautiful.  Everyone who works here is very helpful, and we were in the "Royal Service" and it was amazing. Our butler Hervick was amazing.  If I needed anything he was available 24 hours a day by cell phone that he supplied.  I have never had service like that in my life.  It was amazing.  My next all  inclusive will be here again.  Service was just amazing and the pool and ocean are just beautiful.

reviews.author: Vivian C
reviews.title: Muito bom, mas poderia ser melhor
reviews.text:
Para valer a diferença entre hóspedes Royal Service e os meros mortais (tipo eu) algumas coisas não são servidas para os que não pagam aquele adicional. Por exemplo, não servem bebida em garrafa na praia, não servem canudos na praia, água de coco tem custo extra... e por ai vai. Achei o atendimento na praia muito fraco.
Mas a estrutura do hotel é ótima.

reviews.author: Gary B
reviews.title: Beautiful Property
reviews.text: We did an all inclusive with friends June 2015. A beautiful property and hotel. Staff was always friendly day and night. Good food, Good bars and nice atmosphere. Nice big beautiful pool, and the beach was nice except for all the mounds of seaweed. As far as the pool goes the only problem we had was that parents let their kids sit at the bar and at times we could not find a seat. The kids were diving off the stools in the pool bar. Even tho there are 2 good size kid pools, there were way too many little kids in the adult pool while parents were drinking at the bar. The mini bar was not stocked daily and had to call down to get water etc., and coffee was not restocked daily either, had to call down for that. No wash cloths were supplied, and no furniture on the balcony. But overall the property was beautiful and the staff was great. Nice atmosphere in hotel, music etc. Restaurants had a nice variety of foods and was good. Breakfast bufett was very good too, always fresh and refilled constantly. I would recommend this property and hope they work on the things i mentioned.

reviews.author: Shelby P
reviews.title: Best vacation! Thanks to rock star staff
reviews.text: Traveled with my family down to cancun for a week vacation. Unfortunately the first two days were a tropical depression. The staff really came together and delivered above and beyond service to ensure the guest comfort even in the horrible weather.  The entertainment Staff was very entertaining rain or shine!! Pool side salsa lessons, belly flops & outstanding evening shows! Jesus was amazing we made sure we were in his section every day. He sweet and catered to all of out needs. We never had to wait for anything! I can't wait to go back.

reviews.author: Carola V
reviews.title: ESTADIA INCRÍVEL
reviews.text: O Hotel em si é espetacular. Os quartos novos, amplos e muito limpos, os restaurantes para almoço e janta são muito bons (o melhor na minha opinião é o FUEGO), o café da manhã é bem variado, a praia é maravilhosa (só é necessário guardar lugar logo de manhã para conseguir pegar um "guarda-sol"), as piscinas são grandes e com vários bares. O hotel também tem um mini campo de golf. Os únicos pontos negativos são que o bar da praia não serve comida, e os doces do almoço deixam a desejar. Mas me hospedaria outra vez COM CERTEZA. Recomento MUITÍSSIMO!!!

reviews.author: Laila H
reviews.title: Wow - the best hotel I have ever stayed at
reviews.text:
This hotel is absolutely stunning. From the moment we arrived until we left we were treated like royalty.
The décor is stunning - modern with an Asian infusion and the setting (right on the beach) is divine.
It has the most delicious restaurants, we particularly enjoyed the Sushi restaurant - Easily the best Sushi I have ever eaten.
The pool was great - equipped with a swim up bar and daily aqua aerobics and a nachos poor bar - there is not much more you can ask for.
The service was amazing !
The only bad part about our holiday was having to leave :(

reviews.author: Richard B
reviews.title: Royal service not worth the extra dough
reviews.text: 7 of us in 3 rooms the 1st week of Dec. The hotel was ok but none of us thought it was worth the extra money for the royal service. Our butler was non-existant during our week stay. several calls never answered. There was 3 staying in our room but 1 bed with a pull out sofa bed. We booked 2 bed unit. Sofa bed was awful. Food, drinks , bar staff were all at a level you'd expect. I don't know if we'd stay there again. It would have to be a great deal and we'd probably stay in standard rooms.

reviews.author: kimmmmms610
reviews.title: SIMPLY AMAZING!!!
reviews.text:
Royal Service ALL the way! Came to Cancun to celebrate mine and my friend Kamilla's birthday with my boyfriend and other friend, Heidi. From the get go we were treated like royalty. Check in was a breeze and right when you walk in you are greeted with champagne. One out of the two rooms we booked were ready so we hung out there before heading to the pool.
