We were hungry and ordered room service right after our butler Ivan explained everything to us. The room was nice with a king bed and a view of the lagoon which was nice. Our butler Ivan was really nice and attentive when we needed him, but we didn't see him much. The staff in the Royal service building were THE nicest people I have ever met! Nothing we asked for was out of reach. My friend Heidi and I drank Hennessy & Remy Martin which they didn't have out for guest, but they brought out for us since we asked, we felt pretty damn special after finishing 3 bottles in a days span (DONT' judge us lol) ! The breakfast buffet they put out in the morning is pretty good and ready at 7AM which I loved because I tend to wake up really early while on vacation. They also have a self serve alcohol bar with great brands of liquor, if you don't see a particular bottle you like you can ask and they more than likely have it and will bring it out for you. We spent our entire day on Friday at the royal service pool and beach area. Chairs on the beach were always available. With royal service you get two guaranteed bali beds by the pool during your stay which are pretty big, lucky for us we booked separate rooms so we got four, but couldn't use two since it rained Saturday and Sunday while we were there =( We were able to get one on our last day which was nice since many weren't already reserved. Service at the pool was prompt and amazing! Daniel and Rogelio were awesome and made sure we were always taken care of, lets not be cheap people TIPPING your server should come naturally and it gets you the best service, believe me we didn't have to want for anything and they remember you and make sure you are always satisfied. No complaints when it comes to service. The only down fall to this beautiful and absolutely amazing hotel is their food. We went to Naos, Bana, Vento, Blue Agave and Market Grill, the only one that I actually liked was Market Grill for lunch where we had pasta, steak and chicken it was all seasoned and grilled soo well ! Other than that everything was pretty bland so I stuck to fruits and veggies and room service which is open 24/7. I also didn't like their whole reservation system, if you show up and want to eat at a restaurant they will flat out tell you no even if you see about ten tables open for seating.  We got lucky at Bana because my friend and I were very persistent and refused to leave until we got a table all for almost nothing because their sushi was just okay and tasted like the pre-made stuff at Giant, but their dumplings and chicken teriyaki roll were good. All in all this place was awesome and I am glad I researched all the resorts in the area before deciding on staying here and my friends were super happy and thankful about my choice, I highly recommend this resort and would not hesitate to stay here again! I actually want to stay at other Melia resorts after coming to this one. I WILL BE BACK, PARADISUS! Thank you for the amazing hospitality!

p.s. Don't listen to the reviews where they tell you RS is not needed, IT IS! Clearly, they haven't experienced the perks you receive with RS. You get extra perks that I know for a fact that regular guests do not receive. What's better than being treated like royalty and having everything you need and want in the building you are staying in? NOTHING!

reviews.author: darcirogers
reviews.title: Great staff! Great place!
reviews.text: Loved our stay at paradisus cancun! The pool bar staff was particularly fun and accommodating. Carlos, Julio, Martin, and Giovanni went out of their way to make our trip so enjoyable! Love them. We also loved Marco, our waiter at the market grill. Made you feel very welcome and went above and beyond to make us happy! Fabulous staff who made the stay fun!!! Highly recommend. Will definitely visit again.

reviews.author: Andrea F
reviews.title: Viaje de amigas
reviews.text:
Simplemente espectacular! El hotel es hermoso en su totalidad. Las habitaciones son muy cómodas y cuentan con servicio wifi gratuito.
   Tanto la comida como la atención de todo el personal es excelente.
   Hay distintos restaurantes para cenar en los q se debe hacer reserva previa en el mismo día por la mañana. O se puede optar por el buffet q también tiene muy buena variedad.
.... es realmente recomendable!!! Ojalá podamos volver pronto!!!

reviews.author: Karina B
reviews.title: Fabuloso!!
reviews.text:
Hotel maravilhoso!! Ótima recepção pela equipe do hotel.. Todos os detalhes lindos muito limpo muito decorado!! Somos sócios do club Melia e esse foi um dos melhores melias que já fomos!
Amei os amenties dos banheiros.. São do perfumista therry muller... Peguei todos que via na frente hauahau

reviews.author: Lexiem1
reviews.title: Very nice resort with some flaws!
reviews.text: i just got back from my 5 night stay at the Paradisus Hotel. I booked an junior suite ocean view room but upgraded to Royal Service once i arrived. If you do book this resort i feel that Royal Service is a must! Royal Service has its own tower and private restaurant,bar and pool that is separate from the other towers. If you are apart of Royal Service you get your own butler who will set up dinner reservations for you each night. Also, each day you will get your own cabana bed near the pool which is amazing! The thing i hated the most about this resort was the fact that you had to make reservations a night in advance for dinner. Ive been to plenty other resorts where reservations were not needed and i enjoyed that much better. If you were not able to get a reservation you had no choice but to eat at the buffet. Restaurants were strict about the reservations. Food and drinks were way better on the Royal Service side. Royal Service gets premium liquor as well which is a plus. Beach was beautiful. Overall all the restaurants had decent food. Service was not the best, staff seemed to take awhile at times. Hotel had pretty good wifi which was great. Rooms were beautiful and clean.They also have a family concierge side that has a separate section on the beach to stay with your kids. I would definitely recommend this resort!!

reviews.author: Nilla J
reviews.title: Amazing!!!!!
reviews.text: I am 20 years old, and it was me and my friend's first time in Mexico. I am soooo happy we choose this hotel. I have 0 complaints besides the wifi! It was so beautiful. It was such an amazing experience. The food was yummy!! and the staff was excellent. They work so hard to keep you satisfied. They were beyond kind to me and my friends during our stay. Very attentive! I want to compliment Giovani, the bartender, for making the best drinks! The boys at the Coco bar. Saul and Tabbs at the Coco bar also. The spa was so beautiful and clean! This hotel was worth every penny, I cannot wait to return. We were so upset that we had to leave.. Thank you Paradisus!!!

reviews.author: NatiKolanos
reviews.title: Espectacular!!!
reviews.text:
Todo excelente!!! Playa, pileta, restaurantes, buffet, habitacion... Y la atención también
Los mozos súper simpáticos y con muy buena onda... 
Muy linda decoración ... El restaurante Bana de sushi, es lo mas!!!
Gran disponibilidad de reposeras en playa y piletas.
Muy buenos tragos
Un poco lenta la limpieza de la habitación

reviews.author: TravellingAph
reviews.title: Fantastic, great service, beautiful luxury
reviews.text: My first time in such an incredible hotel! I was shocked at how beautiful it was, how amazing the food was- around 6 restaurants included in our all inclusive price gourmet style, delicious- even all you can eat SUSHI! Top quality food, beds were so comfortable and service was top class. Mango margaritas, piña coladas and mud slides- yes please! Perfect for our friends hen party (bachelorette) and even though the hotel was fully booked it didn't feel like that at all, very spacious and no waiting time for the buffet. The only down side was the balcony, no furniture or plants and the sea was quite rough but you don't want to spend much time in your room in such a stunning place and also the sea was fun to jump over the waves- I did feel like a queen staying in this place :-)

reviews.author: Marissa G
reviews.title: Fun, Clean and Friendly!
reviews.text: Spent 7 days here last week and i have ZERO complaints. The resort is perfectly maintained and all the employees are absolutely fantastic. The waitstaff at all the restraints, especially Ricardo at Blue agave, Miguel at Naos and Julio, Martin, and Edgar at the pool bar. The zumba was great too, with Angel, Berto and the other guy...(i forget his name). All in all, I would definitely recommend. The red lounge is a great place for night life not downtown, and during the day the beach is a great place to relax with servers walking around constantly bringing food and drink.

reviews.author: Elissabetta A
reviews.title: Not at other Paradisus standards
reviews.text:
Not at the same level of other Paradisus hotels, laike In Punta Cana or Riviera Maya.
Poor food quality...no entertainments at pool or at night, no music at pool bar...
need to bargain to get the right price for any kind of upgrades.

reviews.author: Jackie H
reviews.title: Great Family Hotel
reviews.text: I stayed here for a friend's wedding.  Hotel was clean, rooms were spacious, staff were friendly and eager to help.  I will definitely stay here again. Pools were very nice and clean, swim up bar was a plus!

reviews.author: Sofia P
reviews.title: Ideal para descansar, relajarse y disfrutar de la playa y el clima.
reviews.text: Es un hotel con muchas habitaciones  pero tiene instalaciones tan grandes que no se nota si hay mucha o poca gente. La comida es buena y bastante variada. Las piscinas grandes y lindas la temperatura del agua podría ser más fría....y la playa si bien tiene oleaje, este es suave y se puede disfrutar de un buen baño en el mar.....la ambientación es  de muy buen gusto mucha vegetación dentro del mismo hotel y pequeñas lagunas con peces...es un bonito lugar y muy cómodo.

reviews.author: Fran Z
reviews.title: 1st Cancun Vacation, All Inclusive for a wedding
reviews.text: Loved everything about the hotel, food, wait staff, housekeeping, and pool bar staff!!!  Beautiful area, wonderful weather, and our son and daughter-in-law's wedding renewal was beautiful. The hotel was clean and comfortable, staff was very accomodating, and the food and drinks were great!!!  If you eat at the buffet for breakfast or lunch, go see Marco or Juan, they are the best waiters we had, lots of fun and great food!!

reviews.author: walter s
reviews.title: EXCELENTE
reviews.text: Hotel excelente. Atención, habitaciones, shows todo de lujo.  Muy buena atención en el market grill que fui casi todas las noches. En especial de Karla , Malvin y en realidad todos los que nos atendieron en el market fueron excelentes. Me encanto Cancún y si vuelvo. No dudo en volver al paradisus. Lo único que puede que tengan que mejorar es los shows nocturnos. Solo el del circo me gustó.

reviews.author: emptar
reviews.title: una semana en Cancún
reviews.text:
B uena ubicacion, hoteleria, excelente comida
Muy buen servicio, variados  locales ,interesantes  restaurantes
Buena atención en sombrillas, bebidas a reposeras,  servicio de toallas,
agradables piscinas, spa,

reviews.author: Maria Luisa G
reviews.title: Recent vacation at Paradisus Cancun.
reviews.text: My husband and I recently spent 19 days at Paradisus Cancun, a resort we have been visiting since 1996.   As members of the Melia Club, we received an outstanding assistance by all staff members that made our visit to be unforgettable.  We are already looking forward to visiting Paradisus Cancun in the very near future.

reviews.author: gwenc375
reviews.title: A very nice resort
reviews.text:
The pros:
•	All inclusive – you don’t have to tote your wallet with you everywhere you go
•	The staff was super attentive
•	Clean, clean, clean – I think they came and changed our towels twice a day
•	Inside the pyramids there were many water features and plants, giving a very soothing rainforest feel
•	Huge pools and easy access to the beach
•	Multiple restaurants with different cuisine options
The cons:
•	Shopping and other restaurants were not within walking distance
•	There never seemed to be anyone working the Guest Service desks
•	Only 2 of the 7 restaurants didn’t require prior reservations. Reservations had to be made the day prior (they tell you that you can make reservations day of, but we found this to be untrue)
•	The food was good, but uniformly under salted, so it tended towards being bland
•	We paid for a lagoon facing room, but our view was of another building. Luckily we didn’t spend any time on the room’s balcony – mostly because there were no chairs.
 Overall, I would stay at this resort again.

reviews.author: VANDERLUCIO
reviews.title: Paraíso na terra!
reviews.text: Simplesmente o melhor hotel no qual me hospedei.  Todos os funcionários são amáveis. O quarto espetacular. Uma piscina que passa por quase todo o hotel em frente ao mar com um bar molhado é uma petisqueira. Você pode ficar ali por todo o dia que nada vai lhe faltar. O café da manhã é um espetáculo à parte. Comida variada com opções de quase todo o mundo. Tem pra todos os gostos.

reviews.author: Jonathan M
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Esta muy bueno supuer recomendable desde la entrada al hotel con su majestuoso lobby con aromaterapia y sus comidas muy deliciosas con gran variedad de sabores, la atención por parte de todos es muy agrable ya que si tienes algún problema lo resuelven a la brevedad

reviews.author: Tina10Travels
reviews.title: impresionante
reviews.text:
Very impressive atrium with all the vines.  The koi ponds were peaceful.  Outside the pools and beach was great and big enough to party or find a quite spot.  They do a good job of entertaining guest day and night.  
Food: desserts all yummy,  drinks perfect cuz they'll make whatever you want, the savory plates varied from good to oddly bad.  
Rooms are spacious as are the baths.  
The staff is kind.  Their English is good and they appeased my attempts at broken Spanish.
Location is good.  Easy walking to various activities.  Convenience store and pizza joint very close if you get those kind of cravings.  
The bus stop was really close also.  We never waited more than 10min for a bus.  The bus ride into town was short and easy.

reviews.author: Vivian_MIA
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel
reviews.text:
Pros: 

Beautiful location with turquoise waters

Top shelf liquors!!! I've been to several All Inclusive Resorts but this one takes the cake with the liquor selection...Patron, Don Julio, Johnny Walker, etc. for no extra charge

Amazing service at the pool bar by Carlos!

Overall, the staff was polite and helpful. Audberto, who we guess must be the food & beverage manager, was truly a life saver when he booked dinner reservations for us when we were on our way to dine out due to lack of reservations

Rooms are spacious with a great balcony (although balcony didn't have any furniture)

Fuego restaurant was by far the best food we had at the hotel

Cons:

Spotty Wi-Fi

They ran out of pool towels by 1PM on a Saturday!

Reservation are required for most of the restaurants and must be done at least 1 day in advance which can be a bummer. We try walking in but, even though you can clearly see empty tables they, won't seat you. We were turned down at the sushi restaurant due to lack of reservation and 15 minute later, and with the help of Audberto, we were seated! On that note, the sushi place: nothing to write home about

Food is ok, not bad not amazing...just ok

We had an incident at one of the stores that required the intervention of the hotel manager (Alberto) who did NOTHING to help at all, even when the store clerk was being disrespectful to us in front of him. This incident alone will make me seriously consider returning to this hotel in the future

In summary, this was my 3rd time in Cancun, but my 1st time in more than 10 years and I was a little disappointed with the customer service experience. My memories of Cancun were always those of amazing customer service and this time, and based on the service at this hotel, I would rate it a 3 out of 5, tops

reviews.author: juliebean512
reviews.title: Relaxed and pampered
reviews.text:
I should preface this by saying that my stay was part of a group sponsored by my company for their award winners.  So some of the standard experiences, such as transfers and check in/out, I can't comment on except to say that the lobby was never overfull and no one seemed anxious or upset as I came and left.  Also, I had never been to Cancun so I can not compare this hotel to other Cancun hotels, though I've traveled fairly extensively elsewhere.

We stayed in the Royal Service Pyramid 5 - and had a lovely room with a view of the ocean.  The entire room had marble floors, which felt nice and cool on the feet.  It was a spacious room with two double beds, a desk, a sitting area and a table.  The entire back wall was all window, including sliding glass doors to get to the very spacious balcony.  I spent a great deal of time on the balcony, reading and listening to the ocean.  The bathroom was a good size with a very deep tub and a rain and hand shower.  Due to the humidity and the sun coming through the glass, it was very difficult to get the room cool enough for my American preferences.  But I had adjusted by the second night.

The highlight of the trip for me was the Royal Service pool and the Bali Beds.  These were complimentary for Royal Service guests.  You had to reserve them in advance, but you could also go after 11AM and ask if any beds were unclaimed, and if so, then you had one for the rest of the day.  I spent 3 of the 5 days there in one of those beds.  Daniel, one of the staff that set up the beds and brought towels, was very attentive and remembered me after the first day.  Cesar and Luis were fantastic waiters - stopping often to bring beverages and food - tempting me with Bailey's ice cream and Gin and Tonic sorbets (I imagine this wouldn't be the easiest place for a recovering alcoholic - lots of drinks around).  I felt like royalty the way they took care of me, and especially in that bed.  

The food was plentiful.  In the Royal Service pyramid, even room service is included.  I did have room service twice, but it was a bit too "American" and wasn't very warm.  I was only able to try a couple of the "reservation" restaurants, Vento and Bana, but they were good. I ate at the Royal Service restaurant for breakfast (very good Eggs Benedict) and lunch (served to the bed - try the skirt steak or shrimp flatbread).  I ate at the Buffet, Naos, several times.  The buffet had a variety but nothing particularly outstanding.  However, the service was wonderful.  Pascual and Arturo remembered our drinks by the second day and encouraged us to try different things.  Overall, the food at this hotel is good and fresh but not someplace that a "foodie" would be drooling over.

I did not try the spa but others that traveled with me said it was fantastic. I didn't want to try the nightlife, but there were shows and bars to choose from that looked interesting.  It was nice that the options were there.

Overall, I would definitely recommend this hotel - and, in fact, I'm already looking at prices to return.  If what you're looking for is a relaxing stay, this would be the place.  It was gorgeous and quiet and just what I wanted.

reviews.author: kkalica
reviews.title: Hotel maravilhoso.
reviews.text: Amei este hotel. Fiquei hospedada em maio de 2014, na modalidade All Inclusive. A vista é maravilhosa! Um lado fica de frente para a praia e o outro de frente para a lagoa. O sol se põe lindamente na lagoa. O quarto em que ficamos hospedadas ficava de frente pra lagoa, no oitava andar. Nós tínhamos uma vista linda. O hotel oferece diversos restaurantes e apenas um deles não está incluso no pacote All Inclusive. O ambiente é todo limpo e arrumado. O atendimento é de primeira qualidade. Todos os atendentes são muito prestativos e solícitos. O ambiente do hotel possui um cheirinho adorável e marcante. Possui música ambiente sempre no fim da tarde/início da noite. E, à noite, conta com shows temáticos. Vale muito à pena.

reviews.author: nniicchhoollee
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, Great Service!
reviews.text:
I stayed here with a group of five friends from May 20th thru May 24th and had a great time!  The resort is breathtaking inside and out.

Can't say enough about how great the service is!  The front desk staff was able to secure my friends and I rooms near each other which was very helpful (the resort is huge).  The concierge was even able get in touch with my airline when my luggage was lost.  

We eat at Blue Agave, Vento, Fuego, and The Market Grill and all the food was amazing.  We especially enjoyed our dinner at Vento; Emmuael our waiter kept the drinks and shots coming.  Enrique the bartender also made us so unique shots and cocktails throughout our trip.  

The Red Lounge and hotel bar never seem to get too crowded or crazy at night (we're in our 20s and were looking to party at night).  Not really a huge issue because the major clubs and bars are about 15 minutes away by taxi/bus.  There are families here but you can still have a great time if you're young too.

reviews.author: Donna L
reviews.title: An anniversary, an engagement and a get away
reviews.text:
We arrived May 13th for a 10 day stay in tower 1.  We had friends join us for 5 days and a second group join us for 7 days. As club members we were able to book 3 rooms to accommodate the group. We all opted for the all inclusive.  
The hotel has a wide beach with plenty of umbrellas, chairs, and Bali beds.  If you're not a beach person the pool is quite large with plenty of areas to swim, sit, lounge, eat, drink, and relax.  There's a swim up bar with top shelf selections and wait staff covering every inch of the perimeter.  If you like frozen drinks the selection is good. The hotel prides itself on service and we had several who delivered.  Antonio greeted us each morning for breakfast with fresh coffee and juice.  The entire breakfast crew outside of market grill was terrific.  Sofonia and Luis spoiled us with buckets of ice cold water and drinks by the pool.  The guys working the sunset grill snack area were kind, courteous and kept the snack bar clean and stocked with fresh sandwiches, wings, fries and nachos.  The addition of ground beef and white Mexican cheese for the nachos would be a great improvement.  We enjoyed the food and mariachi band at Blue Agave.  We also liked Fuego and Market Grill.  The option to select a protein  tasting group versus slices from the skewer would reduce waste and improve the overall experience at the Market Grill.  The lamb & pineapple never made it to our table and the pork was dry.  I highly recommend the all inclusive option you won't be disappointed.  
My biggest disappointment was our vacation club concierge.   We made a great effort to contact the club in advance to let them know we had friends who were celebrating an anniversary.  We were also celebrating an engagement.  We wanted to have a bottle of champagne delivered to the room for our friends anniversary and thought we had it covered but it didn't come through.  :(  We also requested several reservations through our vacation concierge but they weren't well communicated or scheduled per our request.  I know reservations are just a request but a day later and 10 pm versus 8 pm without any notification isn't exactly a slight change.  I felt like our vacation concierge was strictly a sales representative with a concierge title.  I understand its just business but don't offer if you're not going to deliver.

reviews.author: Spencer F
reviews.title: Awesome Stay Overall
reviews.text:
We picked the resort because of the location (we hadn't visited Cancun yet), the room, the resorts amenities, and the restaurant options. Also we have stayed at a Paradisus resort before and were very impressed with the quality. 

Arrival and Check-In Process:

We booked the shuttle the hotel offers and it was great. Private ride over from the airport to an absolutely gorgeous driveway/unloading area in the Club Melia portion of the resort. The inside is gorgeous as well with hanging vines, ambient lighting, and vegetation. Unfortunately the Club Melia staff were un-friendly (borderline Rude) and didn't seem particularly happy to see us. In addition, I am accustomed to having a welcome cocktail and a warm reception but we did not receive that here. After a long checkin process we were taken to our room (Ocean view 1 bedroom Suite). Our luggage was brought up promptly and our minibar filled with a selection of beer (we got to pick out). 

The Room:

We were very pleased with our room - the layout, amenities, comfort, cleanliness, and view were all top notch. Beautiful large bathroom, comfortable King bed, living room, and a balcony with a beautiful ocean view, jacuzzi, and sitting area. Our room was cleaned well daily and our minibar stocked with the things we liked. Room service was great - had late night wings a couple of times and they were fresh, hot, and delivered quickly. 

The Resort Layout / facilities:

Beautiful resort - well groomed with beautiful pools. I can't speak to most of the resort as we upgraded to Royal Service and spent 98% of our time in that area. I would highly recommend the upgrade for those travelling without children. It's a modest extra charge which we felt was well worth it. Private adults-only pool and beach area, separate bar, and dedicated food/bar and pool staff. 

During the days we spent most of our time by the pool or ocean in private cabanas lapping up the sun (and many, many cold drinks). 

The Staff / Service:

Excellent (except for Club Melia unfortunately) 

We were treated like royalty in the royal service section. The staff got to know us after a couple of days and by day 2 afternoon they knew what we liked to drink (and how often). Our waiter was by every 15-20 minutes and was quick to take our orders and bring us our drinks. Food service was great too - fresh chips and guacamole, burgers, etc brought poolside for those days we didn't feel like getting up. 

Our sit-down lunches and dinners were no different - the staff treated us like royalty - friendly, professional, accommodating, and fun. 

I highly recommend you tip your pool waiters and your dinner/lunch servers - they do not expect it but they greatly appreciate it. 

Food:

Excellent overall with only a couple complaints. We ate at just about every restaurant and from breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks we were very happy with the quality, freshness, and quantity. Again, staff was extremely accommodating, professional, and friendly.

Complaint: when we arrived, no dinner reservations were required (no reservations at all). Midway through our week we arrived at Fuego for dinner to be told that they couldn't accomodate us because reservations were now required. They changed policy mid-week without notifying anyone. Not really sure why, but it all turned out okay. 

Buffet:

Ate here many days for breakfast and lunch. Breakfast included a great variety of fresh fruit, baked goods, eggs, meat, fish, and a smoothie bar. Lunch featured fruit, veggies, soups, and a great variety of meat and seafood. 

Blue Agave:

I was excited about eating here because they feature a huge selection of Tequila and being the only one in our group of 4 that drinks it I was ready to partake. Our waiter was great in recommending tequilas for me to try and kept my glass full. We shared soft tacos and quesadillas. I highly recommend both - fresh and delicious. 

Vento:

Best restaurant hands down. We ate here twice we enjoyed it so much. Excellent Tapas - great for sharing. We had duck, beef, chicken, pizza, and more. Beautiful setting too with great service. Only complaint is how hot it is in this area! Made it a bit uncomfortable. 

Bana:

We ordered a big selection of sushi to share. It was 3.8 out of 5 if I were to rate it. I've eaten plenty of sushi and this was certainly not the best, but it was good and fresh. 

Market Grill:

This is a Brazilian steakhouse so if you go, expect a fast paced meal. We enjoy Brazilian style and this was no exception. Great food and good variety. 

Mole: 

We enjoyed it but for the fact our food was not hot. Luke-warm at best. I had the Mole Chicken and my Fiancé had the Lamb. Excellent seasoning in both. The mariachi band was a lot of fun!

Fuego: 

Mixed experience. The other couple we were with loved it, I though it was just okay. My fiancé was very disappointed. Her food came out cold - very cold. 

La Perla:

Closed. Not happy about that part as we were very much looking forward to eating here.

Royal Service restaurant:

Great breakfast area outside. I had Eggs Benedict and it was 5/5. They do well at keeping the food hot considering they have to bring it outside. 

Liquor / Drinks:

Awesome. Each bar had different drinks and it the bartenders all had a few special recipes of their own. They were quick to recommend drinks for us. Several different varieties of each type of liquor and a few beer choices. Drink service was excellent and quick.

reviews.author: Jaas456
reviews.title: Excelente!!!
reviews.text: Hace unos dias visite este hermoso hotel. Hemos estado en varios hoteles de la riviera maya y este ah sido de mis favoritos. Desde nuestra llegada quede asombrada con el hermoso lobby...la decoracion impecable..los aromas que se perciben en el ambiente genial...al terminar el.check in un delicioso desayuno nos esperaba en el buffet..una vez mas el servicio por parte de los meseros...impecable...al pasar al area de piscinas conocimos a.nuestro mesero que se encargo siempre de mantenernos hidratados con las deliciosas bebidas que preparaban para nosotros...El hotel.siempre impecable...el.servicio de diez y nuestra estancia en general maravillosa. Definitivamente recomiendo este hermoso Hotel

reviews.author: KrissyShea
reviews.title: Great property but the food was OK
reviews.text: The Paradisus Cancun is a beautiful resort with an amazing ocean view. There is a lot of explore in and out and you can easily get lost but in the best way. The food however could have been better, breakfast felt limited. The pools were spacious, never felt crowded and the beach is right there. Every morning I posted a FB video from my room overlooking the ocean. Make sure you take advantage of the airport transfers, most are included in your package.

reviews.author: Oscar B
reviews.title: Excelente escape.
reviews.text:
Normalmente visito diferentes hoteles con mis amigos, recientemente fuimos a Paradisus y vaya que nos quedaron ganas de quedarnos más tiempo, el personal es excelente desde la recepción hasta el chico de las toallas, todos te atienden siempre con una sonrisa, la comida deliciosa, debo resaltar el excelente servicio de Inocente quien fue muy atento con nosotros durante el desayuno.
Mi lugar favorito definitivamente el bar de la piscina donde además de ofrecer muy buenos tragos, los bartenders te hacen pasar un rato muy divertido.
Muchas felicidades a todo el staff porque hacen que uno quiera regresar.

reviews.author: stanlina
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: This Place was just about perfect. We went for a Batchelor party in January. This was my first time in cancun and Paradisus did nit disappoint. From the moment we pulled up to the front of the hotel to the front desk staff to the food to the beach, you name it...just simply exceptional service. We will certainly be back next time.

reviews.author: Kelly M
reviews.title: Destination wedding
reviews.text: The hotel was very nice. The rooms were very clean.  There weren't any plants in the planters outside the room however.  There were a lot of food options for dinner along with the buffet. The beach was beautiful however they needed more cabanas on the shade as the sun can get very hot.

reviews.author: jlt528
reviews.title: Gorgeous resort!!!
reviews.text: We stayed here because our friends were getting married on the resort. It was a fantastic experience and we would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a relaxing and beautiful location. Our only issue was that we tried to book transportation through the onsite service, and we had some issues with them keeping up with our flight changes, even though we notified them several times. Otherwise it was a wonderful experience overall!

reviews.author: Pam L
reviews.title: Beautiful vacation club
reviews.text: 3rd year back for 2 weeks and it was fabulous as usual.  First class luxury hotel, great food and service, wonderful pool, Nicki was our outstanding concierge rep.  Our vacation club room is ocean side with 2 full baths, 1 bedroom, pull out sofa and we ordered a roll away bed, at no charge, for our guests.  Long wrap around balcony.  Very clean room, very clean hotel

reviews.author: LaDaVla
reviews.title: Рекомендую Royal service
reviews.text:
Все было великолепно - как в рекламном проспекте.
Учтивый, очень отзывчивый персонал, идеальная чистота и в холле и в номере. 
Завтрак, закуски днем и сладости вечером накрывали прямо в холле (Пирамида 5). Так что если не хочется суеты в общем ресторане - это отличная альтернатива.
Номер с видом на океан просторный. Балкон с двумя креслами и столиком - отлично подходит для вечернего коктейля.
В номере кофеварка - удобно, холодильник (мини-бар) пополняется ежедневно, но можно положить и свое, телевизор (не могу прокомментировать - мы не пользовались).
Около 9 вечера горничные проводят забавный ритуал - "приготовление номера ко сну" отгибают уголок одеяла, строят тапочки на коврике между кроватями, на подушку кладут конфетку - потешно.
Кровать удобная, широкая, довольно мягкая. Подушки на выбор. Постельное белье отличного качества.
Wi-Fi бесплатный, довольно шустрый.
В ванной полотенца всех размеров, халат тапочки. Косметика без изысков, но в достаточном количестве. Сантехника в превосходном состоянии.
Зона бассейна и пляжа Adults only - что немаловажно для комфортного и спокойного отдыха. Полотенца у бассейна и на пляже в любом количестве. Средства для загара на выбор разной степени защиты.
На пляже зонт над каждой парой лежаков. Расстояние между лежаками достаточное. Проблем с тенью и лежаками нет. Мусор на пляже видели только рано утром, когда ходили встречать рассвет - к 8 утра, когда первые гости тянутся на пляж все уже убрано.
Мажордом - это такой  специальный человек, который трогательно улыбается и заботливо интересуется как у Вас дела - очень забавно. Он помог нам забронировать рестораны, spa, поменять деньги.... в общем все то же можно было решить на ресепшн самостоятельно, но так конечно гораздо веселее))))
Ресторанов в отеле несколько, большинство работает по записи - каждый найдет для себя подходящий, мы попробовали все и пришли к выводу, что нам ближе всего легкие закуски в тихом холле нашей пирамиды.
Единственное разочарование это SPA. Честно говоря за такие деньги я ожидала чего-то большего. Честнее было бы назвать это место массажный кабинет, но тогда и прайс должен быть другой. Сами процедуры на 5+, но вот обстановка и атмосфера к SPA не имеет никакого отношения.
Еще раз обращаю внимание, что все вышесказанное относится только к номерам категории Royal service.

reviews.author: Tze-Kau
reviews.title: Nice Ocean Views
reviews.text:
Hotel rooms are little out dated but ok, very beautiful ocean view. Easy to jump on a city bus to downtown.
The buffet restaurant Naos is the best restaurant of the hotel, the servers are very nice and polite. Forget about the other specialty restaurants, their foods won't meet your expectations.

reviews.author: Guada L
reviews.title: Excelente hotel y su gente
reviews.text: El hotel es hermoso.....todos los servicios son excelentes están en cada uno de los detalles y te atienden como a un rey. ..en el desayunador todos los días nos recibio con una sonrisa Ismael gracias por la onda, en la puerta al hotel nos recibió Juan un amor muy atento. En la playa nos atendió Carlos,  gracais por la atención y las aguas frescas.  Y en el restaurante fuego nos atendió Alejandro excelente todas sus recomendaciones.  Muchas Grcais a todo el plantel por una excelente estadía! !!!!!

reviews.author: Dixie M
reviews.title: Wonderful get-a-way!
reviews.text: Had a great 4 day trip at the Paradisus Cancun! Went to celebrate a few girlfriend's 50th birthdays and had a wonderful time. We upgraded to Royal Service which was very worthwhile! Our butler, Hector, was great! He had balloons in our room for the birthdays when we arrived as well as a yummy chocolate dessert and fruit. He was great about making our dinner reservations and taking care of anything we needed. Loved the lobby area of the Royal Service area with the lovely breakfast and afternoon snack spread as well as a private bar. Pool and beach area were great too  and the service was amazing out there as well. Only small complaint was the view from our room. We were on a lower level on the lagoon side which gave us a view of the service entrance. Not great, but we didn't spend a lot of time sitting in the room! Our favorite meal was at the Asian restaurant. Delicious and fun atmosphere! All meals and service were good! Great get-a-way.

reviews.author: martinaU2155MY
reviews.title: Instalaciones y servicio de camareros
reviews.text: Edificio muy antiguo para mi gusto, tambien en el restaurante donde se sirve el buffet mobiliario muy antiguo. El servicio de camareros pésimo hacia nacionales en cambio hacia europeos y norteamericanos muy atentos.

reviews.author: scottrF294QS
reviews.title: 30th birthday celebration.
reviews.text:
Had a very nice time though we were somewhat disappointed with a few things. We had hoped there'd be more entertainment and excitement throughout the hotel, especially at the pools but it was still a very enjoyable stay. Our butler Rode was amazing as was Victor down at the Royal Service pool/restaurant. 

Overall we were happy with our stay but if you're looking for a party, you may want to look elsewhere. If you want a very nice hotel to relax, have some drinks and eat well, I would definitely recommend this place.

reviews.author: Karen O
reviews.title: The food and service need a Hugh improvement
reviews.text: The food was so disappointing and very little entertainment.  The butler service was poor and needed training. It's never proper to had someone ask for a tip. Tip are earned with service. The best meal we had was room service getting a salad and wings.

reviews.author: Russell R
reviews.title: Supreme Service and Hospitality
reviews.text: We just returned from a week of "all inclusive" service at the Paradisus Cancun International Hotel in Cancun, Mexico. We opted for the round trip transportation package offered by the Hotel and it made our airport experience go smoothly. Upon arrival at the hotel, we were greeted by courteous and attentive doormen, receptionists and our personal concierge, Kayla Madrid. Our week in "paradise" could not have been more fun. Every service you can imagine was available to us. Kayla set us up with golf and restaurant reservations. My wife and the wife our traveling campions enjoyed an afternoon at the hotel's fabulous spa while the "guys" enjoyed rounds of golf at local courses. The week sped by and it was time to pack up and head home before we knew it. We will always have positive and fond memories of our wonderful time at the Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: steve m
reviews.title: great
reviews.text:
Beautiful place, outstanding service, great area. Can't speak highly enough about the hard working, wonderful staff at the resturant. lots of kids running around where a litle anoying i can sugest an kids area , as many adults are going for a peace retreat, but overal great experience and restaurants where top noch
.

reviews.author: Selim B
reviews.title: The place you don't want to miss !
reviews.text: Fantastic experience at this hotel ! It's my 3rd time in Cancun, and this hotel is what attracts me to always come back here ! Fully recommended .. and staff will always be there to help you and make you feel like you've always belonged there.

reviews.author: Keri C
reviews.title: The most relaxing trip I have ever had
reviews.text:
I stayed at this resort from April 17-April 24 with 3 of my friends. This trip was by far the best trip I have ever had. I booked the trip about 2 months in advance on Expedia and at that time I decided to splurge and upgrade to royal service. If you want to relax and enjoy your trip this is the way to go. Coming from New york we needed to escape from the cold and what better way then to an all inclusive resort?

We arrived at the hotel around 11am and were immediately whisked away to a special royal service lounge. The first thing you noticed is the amazing ambiance of the hotel and the aromatherapy smell. Checking in was quick and painless, we all were greeted with a drink and friendly smiles. Since we arrived so early I was not expecting us to get a room until after 3pm, however we were able to get 1 room so we were able to change and start planning our day. We met our butler Sergio and were given a phone to call or text him with our needs. If you can request your butler I highly recommend him, he was AMAZING! We were also surprised the phone would last so long without ever being charged… but it worked! *Side note, the hotel has an expedia office onsite. You can go there to book your excursions and if you booked your trip through expedia they will be able to help you with your return transportation back to the airport.*

Since we stayed so long we were able to eat at every restaurant for dinner including Tempo. You will leave this resort gaining a few pounds, the food was great everywhere we went. We gave Sergio a list of the restaurants and what day we wanted to eat there on the second day so we never had a problem with having a reservation. 

We want to give thanks to everybody we encountered at this resort but most importantly the royal service pool concierge staff. We spent all of our time outside and Daniel and Cesar really went out of their way to make sure we had everything we needed and that we were happy. The Bali beds were amazing!!!!

Overall I would give this trip a 10 out of 10. The nightlife was a little sparse but we came to relax so this didn't bother us. I think if there is anything the hotel could improve on it would be more events at night outside. We can't wait to come back and we highly recommend this hotel to our friends and family. Thank you for the best week of my life.

reviews.author: J H
reviews.title: Beautiful resort but no night life
reviews.text: Extremely nice resort, clean rooms and beautiful facility but they have no evening activities after 9:30 other than the disco and a small band on two nights of the week. Only beach event-volleyball...

reviews.author: Dara S
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Great food and service, beautiful beaches.  The staff was always friendly and helpful. Grounds were well kept and clean. I have been to Mexico four times. I found the paradius to be one of the best hotels I have ever stayed in and will be returning again.

reviews.author: Miguel Angel R
reviews.title: Amigoa
reviews.text: Uno de los mejores viajes y el.mejor hotel recomendaria ir siempre cuando visiten cancun excelente ate cion habitaciones comfortables piscina restaurantes gym bares y discotecas la comida muy buena y los mejores tragos

reviews.author: Felipe P
reviews.title: Hotel muito bom
reviews.text:
O.hotel é excelente. As comidas são fantásticas, as bebidas agradam. Faltou ter a tradicional cerveja Corona, mas isso não afeta o serviço. 
Como algo.negativo tenho a relatar um furto que ocorreu em nosso quarto. Levaram o celular enquanto tínhamos ido ao coco bongo. O que mais me chateou foi o hotel iniciado uma investigação e ficou de concluir e nos informar por email. Já enviei dois emails questionando e eles simplesmente não respondem. Não dão a menor satisfação. Acho que essa atitude mostra que provavelmente identificaram alguma responsabilidade do hotel e preferiram se calar. Esse tipo de coisa pode acontecer em qualquer hotel, é o atendimento que o hotel te dá, as informações necessárias que fazem a diferença. E nesse aspecto, o Paradisus Cancun deixou muito a desejar.

reviews.author: Gina S
reviews.title: Loved Paradisus Cancun!!
reviews.text: Staff was fantastic!   The service was above and beyond!  I will definitely visit you again.  It was a much better experience than the other all-inclusives I have stayed at in the past (Riu).  Also, the food was awesome.

reviews.author: markcO7736QL
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus
reviews.text: Had an excellent stay at Paradisus Cancun in The Royal Service. Very clean and comfortable. The food and staff were excellent! A special thanks to Edie C, our server at The Royal Service lounge and beach.

reviews.author: Jeff N
reviews.title: Coco's Bar
reviews.text: The service, food, drinks, view and accommodations at Coco's are excellent. The level of service provided by Jonathan, Gregorio, Tabata, Saul and Savay was fantastic! We will return to Coco's again! Thank you

reviews.author: olgui c
reviews.title: Melia paradisus
reviews.text: La.mejor luna de miel - aniversario que he tenido.. que buen lugar que atencion ...que comida Mole.comida mexicana tradicional no la mexicoamericana. Y fuego impresioantes tapas que delicia. La vista es alucinante y la atencion muy buena.

reviews.author: Mike P
reviews.title: They think of everything so you dont have to
reviews.text: This is the first time i have experienced an "all inclusive" resort package.  I was pleasantly surprised by the attention to detail, and the friendly helpful staff.  You can tell that the staff really does enjoy their jobs because their responses are so genuine.  The room was large and well appointed, and the free wifi was fast and available most places.  We did notice a couple of dead spots when you cross between pyramids, and at the far reaches of the pool area.  This was very much like being on a cruise ship, there were 10 restaurants, and several bars.  If you grew tired of them you could always go next door on either side to another hotel and eat at their restaurants.  But there was enough of a selection that we were able to spend 7 days eating our way through onsite and didn't have to go elsewhere.  We went for the Royal service and that was well worth it.  The adult only pyramid was quiet, tranquil and well appointed.  Our butler Pedro was attentive without being intrusive.  He made our stay exemplary, and i dont think we could have asked for more.  So if you're looking to spend 7 days not thinking about anything but relaxation, go here.

reviews.author: JimBoston67
reviews.title: Royal Service at the Paradisus Hotel Is Outsanding--Ask For Pedro to be Your butler
reviews.text:
Just returned from my stay 4/11-18/2015.  Pedro was our butler.  We cannot say enough about his outstanding efforts in making our stay absolutely fabulous.   You will love the Royal Service package.  All your food and alcohol is included.   Your butler is there to schedule all you reservations, and the bally huts by the pool.  

Ask for Pedro you will not regret it.  He has attention to details and his calming personality only adds to the resort experience.

Happy From Boston!

--Jim H :)

reviews.author: Eliazar T
reviews.title: Great hotel on all levels
reviews.text: The hotel is the best I have ever been to. From the arrival until the time we left, I was very impressed. The location,the view, and the friendliness were some of the highlights that made this hotel better than any other I have been to. Especially the fantastic service! The staff always takes the time to stop and smile and acknowledge your presence, always willing to serve your needs and wants as well. And you know they are sincere because i made some great friends with the staff along the way. Ignacio and Jorge Mata  at the restaurant Naos provided great service all 4 days I was there for breakfast. The evening restaurants were great as well with fantastic food. Definitely have to return in the near future!

reviews.author: Jen R
reviews.title: Amazing, relaxing
reviews.text:
Just spent 4 days at Paradisus Cancun, and it was truly an amazing experience. Beautiful white sand beaches, and excellent customer service. My husband and I have never been to an all-inclusive resort, so we really weren't familiar with how everything worked but everyone who worked there was friendly and helpful to the best of their ability.

With several swimming pools as well as the beach, there is nearly always a way to get away from the crowds. 

Our trip was organized by the company I work for, and it was a company-wide vacation for employees and their significant others/spouses. Despite having such a large group of people arrive at the same time, the hotel was organized and accommodating in getting us all checked in and out. We also had a dinner on the beach and a daylong pool party, and each event was well staffed, and they saw to it that there was plenty of food and drink for all of us. Clearly, aside from top notch customer service for smaller parties, they are able to provide excellent event planning services as well. 

We did not really stray from the resort premises other than walks up and down the beach, so it was probably the most relaxing four days of my life. Would love to try one of the other Paradisus locations in the future!

reviews.author: Steph
reviews.title: Middle of the road
reviews.text: I had high expectations of this hotel having read the reviews but boy I was disappointed on arriving after a 10 hour flight I was given the room key to a room that was a building site. A hole in the wall with a bag of rubble next to it bed on an angle and lamp at bottom of bed.  Went back to reception I who were useless.  Surely if this room was not ready it should be flagged up. I was given another room for the night and told my room would be ready by 12 noon.  The following day I went to see the Virgin rep Ellie she was extremely helpful and came with me to sort the matter out.  Yet more chaos the people on reception went into meltdown and could not sort the matter out only to say maybe my room would be ready that day or tomorrow.  I was then so angry as I was on holiday with my sister for her 50th birthday.  Her room was fine and we wanted rooms together as we had booked.  To cut a long story short they eventually sorted my room out and all was good even though I had wasted a days hols.  Ellie the rep was great she gave me and my sister a free trip on the dolphin experience.. Thank you Ellie.  Also the rooms were not ready some days till afterb4pm and then they came to turn the beds down at 6.30pm your having a laugh  I am trying to get ready for my evening meal and you want to turn my bed down!  On my last day my sister and I were sunbathing only to be told to move because there was a pool party and it was private.  You do not tell people on the day of the event to move you put a notice up 24?hours before to let us know,  would i return to this hotel - no virgin have classed this is 5 stars - not a chance

reviews.author: travelguru19_80_13
reviews.title: Royal Service all the way... will go back...
reviews.text:
I had never really though of Cancun as a relaxing destination, until now.

My sister and  came here for a girls getaway and it was the perfect choice.   We were 

wanting somewhere that wouldn't be all couples, or all families, or all 18 year old partying spring breakers.  we did the royal service as was advised by a friend, for the included pool side cabana bed , adults only pool, and private bar service.

the hotel exceeded our expectations.  I loved the lush and tropical decor of the lobby and through out, and all of the restaurants were great.  I regret not doing the asian restaurant, the setting alone looked gorgeous .   I also enjoyed having an on property night club which was actually fun and busy...my bed is so much closer than having to taxi home!  my only negative feedback was that the swanky bedsf outside the club with throw pillows were often taken over by families who allowed their kids to sleep there while they socialized...it was full with families almost every night.  restricting it to adults only will help create a more club like upscale atmosphere they seem to be going for.  

as well, with the daybeds, there was some confusion.  we were told that they had to be reserved in advance but after 11am anyone could have the ones which weren't taken,.  this seemed to also depend who you were as some beds would sit empty all day and we would still be told sorry, no reservation no bed, while other days we were able to grab one right away ..I thought maybe this is relative to who had tipped well the day before (just a hunch)...

another tip for royal service:  don't book lagoon view rooms...its basically a view of the tennis court and highway.  we got a great deal so didnt mind too much, but I imagine being someone who may have paid full price, this would be disappointing...

anyways, overall, we had fun, relaxed and ate great food...
will definitely come back...

reviews.author: Priscilla E
reviews.title: Belleza Divina junto con el hermoso mar turquesa :)
reviews.text:
Creo que es un excelente hotel, porque su personal en verdad se esmera por ofrecer un EXCELENTE SERVICIO! Pero no falta el tipo de gente SIN EDUCACIÓN que cree que por tener dinero puede tratar a todos mal, y NO ES ASÍ!

No olviden que no porque ofrecen un servicio SON TUS SIRVIENTES!

El personal, EXCELENTE! a excepción de unos cuantos; la infraestructura, podría mejorar un poco por dentro ya que por fuera ya es impresionante, y definitivamente la ubicación no es la mejor pero, ¿que se puede hacer? :p

Disfruten sus vacaciones y POR FAVOR, no peleen por pequeñeces como la "vista al mar", un par de toallas, o una reservación que no pudiste obtener, VIVANLO! que el "Presente" es ESO MISMO... Un regalo que Dios no da cada día. :)

reviews.author: Camila A
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Resort perfeito! Quarto grande cama delicia! Pacote all inclusive perfeito consegui fazer as reservas, só o restaurante Brasileiro que não é muito brasileiro rsrs mas de resto tudo perfeito atendimento, limpeza serviço de quarto, tem WiFi e cofre incluso praia linda! Obs no Check in existem pessoas que explicam tudo que o hotel oferece e junto desta explicação tentam te enrolar com outras coisas! Eu comprei todos os passeios com a CVC e deu super certo. Outra coisa seria os bônus que o hotel concede que quase nunca da para utilizar.

reviews.author: Grossbow
reviews.title: Wonderful Trip
reviews.text: This was a wonderful trip.  My girlfriend and I got upgraded to the Royal Service.  I would do this again in a heartbeat.  Private butler, adult pool, restaurant overlooking the ocean for breakfast and lunch. Excellent food, service and entertainment.  Loved the pool bungalows, so relaxing.  Rode our butler was very nice and entertaining.  We really had a wonderful time.  This resort is for all ages, and a fantastic getaway.

reviews.author: Cindy A
reviews.title: Seasoned traveler
reviews.text: The rooms are very nice clean and wonderful balconies.  The maids service was so so. They never filled up our water or coffee or replace towels. We were constantly chancing someone down for these items.  They cleaned the room made beds but seemed to forget to restock items.  Balconies would of been great to sit on in morning enjoying coffe or breakfast but no furniture and was told they ran out lol. The food is average nothing to rave about but edible. You won't starve. We did like that the buffet was close to the pools and that there was picky food close to the pool.  Water in pools very deep unusual.   There was very little music or entertainment during the day by pool.  So bring your own speakers for music bc basically you may get an hour of music each day.  The liquor choices were very good as was the free wifi.  Even at night there was not a lot going on.  We spent quite a bit more for this resort than usual. So we were pretty disappointed.  Also. They have scented candles all over which are too strong need to tone that down just alittle.

reviews.author: Jessica A
reviews.title: Staff at cocos bar
reviews.text:
Enrique was amazing!!!!! Hands down best employee at the resort. 
             Antonio at swim up bar also very lovely! Food at tapas restaurant is hands down the best at the resort. Buffet could use better options but still nice

reviews.author: Yetzi
reviews.title: hotel super recomendable
reviews.text: Una muy buena atencion tanto en los restaurantes como en el bar me encanto la atencion brindada y el barman Erick me encanto el servicio que nos dio lo felicito y espero volver a visitar este hotel algun dia la verdad lo recomiendo ampliamente.

reviews.author: Edfforever1
reviews.title: A must see
reviews.text: This place is gorgeous! We went for spring break 2015. Our ocean front room was to die for. All the restaurants were amazing. We were treated pool side by Jesus. He was AMAMZING! It is one of the best places I have visited!

reviews.author: Kristine S
reviews.title: Beautiful and Relaxing but could use a few tweaks!
reviews.text: Our family joined two other families for a Spring break trip to our favorite beach!  We found The Paradisus to be a lovely large scale hotel.  My family opted for the lagoon side because although we LOVE the ocean and the view, we prefer to be out there ON the beach so that was not an issue.  We stayed in tower 3 (the main tower) on the third floor.  We had two "queen" beds which I imagine to be more of a full size bed.  It worked for us.  I found that the lack of chaise chairs on the balcony a little disappointing.  I'd like to sit outside with someone and relax to watch the sunset or read a book while our kids shower and dress.  There was only ONE chair and NO table. ;(  The hair dryer in our room was broken but with one phone call, they came to replace it quickly.  We found all of the restaurants to have good food and options for everyone...anyone.  If you  wanted something different, all you have to do is ask.  We found everyone working there to be most helpful.  We chose to find a spot on the beach under palapas everyday and were lucky enough to have Sofonia (Sofo) take good care of us.  We really appreciated his enthusiasm and speedy service.  He is an asset to the resort!  We found that everyone who works there, works hard to make your stay enjoyable.  Our families (10 of us) were able to dine together most of the time.  They were accommodating!  The reservation process is a little disappointing and confusing.  Several of the restaurants require reservations made in advance and sometimes it is difficult to plan that.  My family used USA Transfers this time and the two other times we traveled to Cancun and I highly recommend them.  We called the Paradisus prior to our visit to see if they really had a tennis court, as reported on the website because I never saw a picture on the site.  They said they did.  However, when we arrived last week, we were told they were going to be resurfacing/repainting.  We got one day of early morning tennis only.  If you like to play tennis, the courts have been repaired and repainted so ENJOY!  Overall, we had a great time and I would recommend this hotel for sure.  It is a larger hotel and we've stayed at a small, medium and large hotel in Cancun and for a large hotel, they make you feel quite welcome. The Wifi is horribly spotty.  Our room had excellent reception but many others did not.   And let's get to the highlight . . . The BEACH.  What an amazing beach.  Although it is a little more weedy than we prefer, it is still the most beautiful white, soft sand and crystal blue water to gaze at while you enjoy a delicious cocktail and relax in paradise.  We'd definitely return!

reviews.author: Arturo L
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Excelente servicio en todo desde habitaciones asta el más mínimo detallé todo estuvo de muy buena calidad y el servicio de lo mejor con gusto regresare sí dios me lo permite ..gracias y bendiciones ...

reviews.author: Melissa M
reviews.title: Great stay, got a little weird at the end
reviews.text:
My friend and I stayed at Paradisus Cancun for a week at the end of February. It was exactly what we were looking for- a relaxing, beautiful resort with an amazing beach. Had we been looking for a "spring break" type of experience, this would not have been the place to go. When we were there it was by no means a party hotel, and that was totally okay with us. The food was decent but not extraordinary. Definitely enjoyed margaritas and tacos at Blue Agave and breakfast outside at the buffet. Mole, the Mexican restaurant, was a major disappointment. Most of our days were spent on the beach under a palapa, drink in hand. Our beach experience was further enhanced by the ever-amazing Rodrigo, who went out of his way to take care of us. His enthusiasm and friendliness was absolutely a highlight of our stay. 
The biggest downside of the trip was that towards the end of our stay, two large groups arrived and the climate of the resort changed drastically. Other than that, we had an amazing time and a wonderfully relaxing vacation.

reviews.author: Joanne F
reviews.title: Truly relaxing
reviews.text: We've been going to the Paradisus for many years now.   We find it to be a great place to relax for a week, and the all inclusive option is the way to go.   We visited early in March this year (2015) and were a bit under-impressed by the staff and the quality of the food.   With one exception:  Sofonia, who took care of us when we were at the pool, was absolutely amazing.  He was friendly, attentive and actually anticipated our needs.  If it wasn't for him I would have given the resort a much lower this year.

reviews.author: Lisa T
reviews.title: Royal service
reviews.text: Second time to this resort. We upgraded to the Royal Service which was not worth $100 a night! Service around the pool area was extremely slow. Our butler made reservations for dinner and that he couldn't even do correctly! Do not upgrade the rooms and service are the same if not better!

reviews.author: Milan H
reviews.title: Best Spring Brake Of My Life!!!
reviews.text: Great Location!!! We went with bunch of friends for the spring brake and we had a blast!!! All inclusive was full of great food and drinks 24/7!!! Great beach and swimming pool!!! I hope to be back one day!!!

reviews.author: Crisboffmaciel
reviews.title: Recomendo!!
reviews.text: Resort muito bom, com uma estrutura fantastica, limpo, o quarto que ficamos era grande e tinha jaguzzi na varanda, realmente muito espaçoso. Tem varios tipos de restaurantes para agradar a todos os paladares. As piscinas sao boas e o tamanho é adequado. O serviço de garçom na beira mar é otimo, smepre tem alguem te oferecendo um drink para beber. Boa opcao para Cancun e a localizacao tambem é otima.

reviews.author: Ellen P
reviews.title: Paradisus realmente é um Paraíso
reviews.text: Atendimento maravilhoso no restaurante Naos, principalmente pelo garçom Eder! Estão de parabéns!!!! Voltaria mais mil vezes 👏👏👏👏 adorei as acomodações do quarto e banheiros. A área das piscinas também é incrível!!!!! O Restaurante Tempo também é maravilho.

reviews.author: Lisa S
reviews.title: First class from start to finish.....
reviews.text: Staying at the Paradisus is always a luxury for our family.  We have been coming here for almost 20 years and have NEVER had an issue.  The service, the staff, the restaurants are always top notch.  They have increased the number of palapas, now found on the beach and have added umbrellas around the pool area.  Every day they are doing something to upgrade and impress.  Now the outdoor grill should be open and we can't wait to experience this next year.  If you are looking for a great place to stay, with friendly service and great food, the Paradisus is the place to be in Cancun MX.

reviews.author: JulieteLaura
reviews.title: ESPETACULAR
reviews.text:
O resort, que está entre os melhores de Cancun, é verdadeiramente um paraíso! Não tive sequer um contratempo durante a minha estadia. Mesmo contando com arquitetura, decoração e localização privilegiadas, o destaque vai para o atendimento, que é realmente de primeira! Os quartos são amplos, arejados, possuem controle de temperatura, secador, tábua e ferro de passar, cofre, frigobar (consumo livre), TV, e, no meu caso, uma vista deslumbrante da praia. 
O sistema all-inclusive abrange os 8 restaurantes, a boate e o bar de praia. O restaurante mais famoso de Cancun (Restaurante Tempo) está localizado nesse resort, mas não está incluído no sistema all-inclusive. 
O resort possui também uma academia satisfatória, lojinhas e um SPA (não incluído no sistema all-inclusive), sem falar que o wi-fi realmente funciona. Vale muito a pena! Pretendo retornar!

reviews.author: Day_Bk
reviews.title: Excelente servicio e instalaciones, muy recomendable!!
reviews.text: Todos los servicios del hotel fueron excelentes, y las instalaciones se encuentran muy bien. El servicio de Family Concierge excelente, nuestro mayordomo siempre muy al pendiente y todos los empleados muy atentos y serviciales. Las amenidades de la habitación también muy bien siempre tuvimos todo al 100. Yo si regreso con mucho gusto a ese hotel.

reviews.author: PAdee
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text:
I can sum it all up by saying .....incredible.  The hotel is absolutely beautiul and I can't say enough about the staff .  It is amazing that they are so upbeat  and caring all day, everyday. I wish I had more names to mention but there are just to many.  The staff at Naos are AMAZING.  Special thanks to Martin,Darwin,Abraham, Jorge,Fidel, David.  At Vento, Jose, Karla ,Leobunde. I wish I had some names in housekeeping, also great!  Servers  on the beach check on you often, and always with a smile!
Nice beach, gorgeous ocean.

reviews.author: Gabriel V
reviews.title: Luxo & Conforto
reviews.text: O hotel é luxuoso e confortável, atendimento exemplar e localização excelente. Apesar do hotel disponibilizar boate e shows, a maioria dos hóspedes é formada por pessoas mais velhas. Não recomendado para quem procura agito e badalação.

reviews.author: Susan P
reviews.title: Execellent service! Beautiful resort!
reviews.text: Excellent service!  Asuncion, Enrique, Alejandro, Simon, Victor were ALL very attentive to our needs and service was outstanding!  We definitely will return!!  We love Simon and Tabitha and Asuncion!  They are definitely assets to your resort - very hard workers and very pleasant - always had a smile on their face and quickly served us with everything we ever asked for.  I felt like a celebrity!

reviews.author: Canadian0102
reviews.title: Dissatisfied
reviews.text: This resort was good until I was feeling sick and was unable to go down to get food. We ordered room service (tuna sandwich and burger) and it took 2 hours and multiple phone calls before the manager came up with our order, which ended up being wrong. Prior to the manager coming up, I called multiple times. Initially they tried to make it sound like it was our fault that we didn't get the food. The operator said that they had brought the food into our room but no one was there so they just left the food in the room. The whole time after I ordered room service, I was doubled over in bed in pain and there definitely was no food in the room or outside the door. I called back twice after that and she told me the food was on its way. 30 mins later, no food. I offered to repeat the order but the lady said she knew exactly what our order was. When the food finally came, they got the order wrong (probably because they made the food while they were lying about it being on it's way). My friend has an allergy to gluten and we specifically said no buns on the burger but of course they brought the burger with buns. They did not do anything to fix the situation. This is not appropriate for a 4.5 star hotel, especially since they kept lying and tried to blame their mistakes on us.

reviews.author: Tim M
reviews.title: Awesome Experience
reviews.text: Very friendly staff and the facilities were first class. We really enjoyed our visit to Cancun.  The pool and beach area were very nice and well maintained and the choice of restaurants was vast.  We plan to return in the future.

reviews.author: Wayne W
reviews.title: The best
reviews.text:
Excellent service everywhere. Guillermo @ NAOS (AM) along with the rest of crew (Carlos) did a great job !

Bloody Mary's & mimosa's were always ready

Beach staff were always ready with cold drinks and ice.

reviews.author: christyfletcher
reviews.title: Treated like royalty
reviews.text:
I recently got back from a vacation in Cancun (March 7-12). My friends and I stayed at Paradisus Cancun. For the most part, we loved the resort! What especially impressed us was how well we were treated by staff. They were in every area of the resort and were so quick to ask what we needed. (Our favorites were Karina and Samuel from Avenue Bar! So fun and so sweet!) I spilled red wine all over my friend's white dress, and their cleaners were able to get it completely out! The pool and beach area are absolutely gorgeous and kept very clean. It is really fun to get a cabana and spend the whole day going from reading in the cabana to taking dips in the pool (rent a cabana a day ahead of time). RELAXATION to the max! There were fun acts at Avenue Bar in the evenings. 

Something I would have enjoyed would have been some more activities in the evenings for guests to enjoy together, such as a show or a bonfire, or music on the beach! We got a little bored in the evenings. We wanted to be outside at night but there wasn't much to do, other than heading into the expensive bars in town.

The excursion we chose was one were you did 3 ziplines and then got to swim in caves. It was an incredible experience to swim in a cave next to stalactites! Once in a lifetime.

reviews.author: Jess B
reviews.title: Excellent Customer Service!!!
reviews.text: We absolutely loved our stay at the Paradisus.  The hotel staff was excellent….they really go out of their way to make sure you are taken care off.  Julian, Rafael, and Carlos, at the main pool bar are fabulous.  Great swim up bar…..excellent beach!  We considered doing the Royal Service but passed, and at no time did I feel like I missed out on anything.  Our Ocean view room was large with a great balcony (no furniture on the patio however).  We mainly stayed around the main pool/swim up bar during the day. We saw very few children in this area as there is a children's pool under the bridge and a bit of a swim away.  I would suggest someone in your party get up early and get some chairs as they are limited. Besides that just sit back and relax.  This place was great! You won't be disappointed.  Food was great too and don't miss the Michael Jackson show!

reviews.author: Shawn M
reviews.title: The Butler Did it...
reviews.text:
First, I would like to preface that I did not choose this hotel. It was chosen for us as we came for a destination wedding.

However, although more expensive than I originally would have liked to spend (there were no "vacation specials" or group discounts), I was surprised by the level of service we received.

This was my first experience with a butler. Essentially, he is your personal concierge and can book everything from dinners and cabanas to give you input to where to visit in town and arrange tours. Our butler was great; very personable, pleasant and helpful. However, if you have never had a butler before, ensure you ask him first what he can and cannot do or else you may miss some services that he could arrange on your behalf (I know other couples were disappointed with their butler).

The food at all the restaurants was amazing. My personal favorite was the Market Grill, however Tempo was a close second (Tempo is the Michelin Star restaurant). If you are a wine lover, the wine list at the resort is impressive, but you have to pay extra for anything above the house wine.

The gym is a good size and has a spin room and a yoga room in addition to the regular area, but it will be busy during peak periods. 

We used the Royal Service, which is adult only, has its own pool and serves all top shelf liquor. 

My only issue? Food and drinks are slow anywhere in the hotel. Room service can take over an hour.

reviews.author: HV
reviews.title: great hotel and the Toji Bar is FAMOUS !!
reviews.text:
tres bel hotel et la formule all inclusive est imperative !

le plus : Le toji Bar avec Ernesto et Eduardo qui sont excelents et vraiment tres sympas! nous avons passé de bonne soirées grace à eux ! a ne pas manquer quand vous allez dans cet hotel!

emplacement ideal et bus pour aller dans le centre devant l'hotel;
resto, plage .. tout y est top

To ernesto and Eduardo : thank for your kindness and for your cocktails ! they were excellent !!!
The french girls Honorine and Severine !

reviews.author: sam555
reviews.title: Clean, good service, nice beach
reviews.text: When we checked in it was quick and efficient. The hostess was helpful with the questions we had. I was travelling with a vegetarian and the food is limited as they cook alot of what would be veg in animal fat, however the hotel accomodated for us and ensured we had vegetarian dishes available in all of the restaurants as long as we informed them in the morning, and even when we didnt inform them, they went out of their way to ensure everyone had something to their liking. So basically, we never went hungry. The rooms were clean and large enough for 3 to share. The balcony was nice with sea views. The beach is good, if you go towards the right when you face the ocean, their are plenty of loungers available. Overall a good, pleasant stay.

reviews.author: Victor V
reviews.title: Felicitaciones....
reviews.text:
Junto a mi hermano y un amigo hemos venido esta primera semana de marzo. .. la pasamos realmente bien. Somos miembros del Club Melía. ... y debo decir q la atención excelente.  Mis felicitaciones especiales para Arturo, David,Darío, victor y Cesar del rest. Naos  que nos arendieron de maravilla al desayuno y almuerzo. También felicitaciones a Ingrid  Córdoba. .. del pool bar.... nos atendió en la playa excelente.... el aseo de cuarto muy bien hecho.... También a Claudia Arriola nuestra concierge. ... nos ayudó muchísimo. 

Gracias.... 

Victor, Daniel, Marcelo

reviews.author: Pierre V
reviews.title: Had a great time at this hotel
reviews.text: The service was friendly and accommodating.  The service by the pool was exceptional.  Enrique, Josque, Carlos and Rey all made sure everyone was enjoying their stay as much as possible.  I'd definitely stay here again just because the service was so great. Oh and the meal selections were great as well.

reviews.author: Johnjohn G
reviews.title: Best hotel in Cancun!
reviews.text: This page is hands down the best hotel I've ever been to in all of mexico not just Cancun, and I've been there a lot. Great staff, beautiful hotel, clean, great food. We opted for the ocean view room and it was a great choice. Huge balconies, and you can't beat the view! I would go back in a second.

reviews.author: Shawna M
reviews.title: Dirty Underwear!!!
reviews.text: Upon arrival our room was not ready and we paid for a king bed and they tried putting us in a double room. We waited for 2 hours for a room with a king bed and when we arrived in our room there was dirty underwear in the closet. Our room was right above the night club so it was loud until 2 AM. Not good.

reviews.author: CandiceWinnipeg
reviews.title: Pyramid 4 is the best choice!
reviews.text: We recommend pyramid #4 as the best choice for a beautiful view and more restful, quiet night. We enjoyed the "quiet" pool and had excellent service from Victor! He was an excellent poolside server and even taught us a few words in Spanish!

reviews.author: Lyne_et_Alain
reviews.title: Le meilleur de tous
reviews.text:
Cet hôtel est tout simplement parfait. Le personnel est très chaleureux et dévoué. Le manque de végétation à l'extérieur est plus que comblé à l'intérieur: vignes, palmiers, plantes vertes et fleurs partout! Le buffet est très varié et délicieux. Nous aurions pu y manger tous les jours sans problème. Les restaurants à la carte sont également excellent, en particulier le Market Grill où ils coupent la viande à votre table (boeuf, porc, agneau, saucisse, poulet et dinde) et servent les légumes à votre table aussi. Le restaurant Bana vaut également le détour. On y sert des sushi à volonté.
A la plage, nul besoin de se déplacer pour des boissons car des serveurs vous apportent ce dont vous voulez. Marie-Sol est la plus gentille et la plus dévouée. Vous pourrez même demander un seau rempli de glace et de vos boissons préférées qu'elle vous laissera sous le palapa.
A la réception, on nous a parlé en français. Au Market Grill aussi.
Nous sommes restés 10 jours et ça été très plaisant.

reviews.author: Jannis S
reviews.title: Better hotels in the area.
reviews.text: We have stayed at 5 hotels in the cancan hotel district over the past few years. I would rank this hotel 3rd. or maybe 4th. for overall experiences. While the people who work here are nice and pleasant there was never the sense that they were willing to go over the top to accommodate us. When we arrived are group was told we were being upgraded to Royal Service. There was nothing Royal about the area except that there were no kids in one pool. That pool did not have a swim up bar, so us and almost all of the other guest spent our pool time in the regular pool. The pool area is nice, but there are no shallow areas in the pool except for maybe a 1' space on the outer edge. If  the swim up bar area was crowded you have to tread water to stay in the bar area. The best restaurant to eat is the Market Grill. Don't bother making reservation for The Steak House. The steak house was only a Mexican buffet. ( we were told that after we were seated) Our room in the Royal tower was small, I mean really small compared to the other couples in our group. There were no house coats or slippers or washcloths in our room. Room service is slow. There is only one elevator in each tower that is shared by workers and guest, so it is very slow. There are STEPS! A lot of STEPS

reviews.author: Carol C
reviews.title: Wonderful waters! Excellent food and service!
reviews.text:
Visited Paradisus, 2/21-2/28. Great place for a group of friends to gather, and a wide range of excellent dining opportunities - after a long day of sun and fun on the beautiful beach.

Vento, Bana and Fuego were my favorite evening dining experiences. The service was amazing and the food memorable! The chefs are impressive! Waiters: Fabricio and Carlos made the meals delightful! The Naos buffet provided a consistently varied and appealing array of choices.

Room amenities were pleasant, but there was a distinctive lack of facecloths and bath mats, on multiple occasions. Nice to have a refreshing beverage available in the fridge, and room service provided prompt, enjoyable meals/snacks.

reviews.author: Kris W
reviews.title: Awesome!
reviews.text: We just came back from a long weekend (Thursday-Monday), the resort was great, the service was excellent and so was the food.
