Want to especially commend the bartenders at the bar Toji, Ernesto and Eduardo! They were so much fun and provided great service! The rooms and the resort were clean, which is a must. No complaints, one suggestion: maybe more games/activities during the day by the pool. Had an awesome time overall!

reviews.author: jbailey2014
reviews.title: Amazing Weekend!
reviews.text:
We just returned from a 3 night stay at Paradisus Cancun and had a wonderful time. I traveled with my best friend, but this resort would be great for a family vacation or for couples. The resort was clean, the waiters and workers were attentive and very friendly. We especially liked the Naos breakfast and lunch buffets - Fidel was the best! We stayed on the beach for the majority of our time - but you must get there early (before 9AM) to claim a spot under the umbrella. The drink waiters were so quick and extremely nice. 

We did not leave the resort for the extent of our trip - we literally had everything we needed within Paradisus Cancun. 

This resort is perfect for a quick get away and the service was absolutely amazing! Be sure to notify the hotel if you are coming for an occasion (e.g.: birthday or anniversary). We did not do the royal service, but everyone was more than accommodating with any request we had. 

We will most definitely be back for more!

Jennifer

reviews.author: abautz
reviews.title: Great Service!  Gracias Ramon!
reviews.text:
Just returned from a 4 day trip to the Paradisus Cancun with my 15 year old son.  We stayed in a Family Concierge Suite.  What a great room, but the best part was our Concierge Ramon.  Ramon was constantly checking to make sure we had everything we needed, brought bottled water to the room immediately, and even located me on the beach to confirm flight times and return transportation to the airport.  First class service and a big shout out to Ramon.  He also made dinner reservations and left confirmations in the room as well as daily notes and treats.  I do not know if all the family concierges are as good as Ramon, but if you go the family suite route, be sure to ask for Ramon!  Management should be proud to have an employee like Ramon who takes obvious pride in his work - well done Ramon.  The beds in the room were very nice and are among the softest that I have slept on in Mexico (typically very firm beds) and we slept very well.

As for the rest of the review - We had a great get away and really enjoyed our stay.  The beach is great (it is Cancun after all) and the service on the beach was wonderful as well.  We ate at Blue Agave, Vento, Market Grill (at night it is a Brazilian meat on a stick place) and the main buffet.  We enjoyed Market Grill and Vento very much.  Blue Agave was fine and the buffet was ok.  The actual layout and location of the food in the buffet didn't seem to make much sense for traffic flow etc, but was fine.  Waiters Carlos and Andres in the buffet were excellent!  We had a large group with us and everyone said the food was better than previous locations we have stayed in Cancun.  The buffet could be crowded, but we were also there on a holiday weekend with 97% occupancy of the hotel so that was a factor.  Even with the hotel full, you never felt like it was that crowded either in the hotel or on the beach.  The property is very very long so plenty of room to spread out on the beach.  Get to the beach by 8 or so to reserve your Palapa or they will be gone...  They do have covered day beds you can reserve for a fee if you are a late sleeper...

Another suggestion for management would be to tone down the pumped in "scent" into the main atrium area of Building 3.  At times it was really strong and overpowering.  About a 1/4 of what they pump in would be plenty.  

The property is well maintained and very clean.  We did not go into the main pool as it was very cold.  I understand that the adult pool may have been heated but we preferred to hang out at the beach and the ocean...  Again, service was outstanding at the beach and easy to get waters, beers etc.  I especially like that they bring canned beer to you instead of little cups of draft beer.  They also don't give you straws for your frozen drinks that always just end up littering the beach - Well Done Paradisus!!!  The beach area is kept very clean and there are places to recycle your water bottles, cans etc.

We have a group of 22 people on the trip and not one person had any major issues or problems.  It was a wonderful trip and Paradisus is certainly on our list to return to.

reviews.author: ptnp02
reviews.title: Excellent location
reviews.text:
Just home from a 6 night stay - pros:  location is great - the beach is beautiful - the public areas are very pretty and well kept - spa is beautiful and relaxing - wait staff was excellent, friendly, cleaning of rooms was great - even wait staff on the beach for drinks was awesome - our first time in cancun and we do not speak Spanish but had no problems at all 

pros:  we had a junior lagoon view in the main building, 3 - room had musty smell, especially the dresser - our room, 3620, faced into the atrium - this could be quite loud some nights as two of the main bars are right off the atrium - most nights didn't bother us, but we were awakend one night by the noise about 1230 or  1 am - rooms are nice with marble floors, but a little dated 

pools were huge and beautiful but COLD!!!! I would think with all that sunshine down there they could figure out a way to heat them with solar - we didn't use the pools nearly as much as we would have if they were even a little warmer

food in buffet was good for breakfast and lunch - yummy omelets, just about anything you could think of for breakfast was there, but if you didn't have a reservation for dinner you were out of luck - the dinner buffet had lots of choices but the food was COLD!!  I mean they put out a new pan of pasta I wanted and it was cold when they put it out and it was not supposed to be a cold dish - even in the restaurants with res sometimes the food was not warm, it was all good but not always good temp - can't say any of the restaurants were outstanding, but we only used the ones that were included in the package - Ventos, the tapas bar, was our favorite

we were there for a wedding and I must say they did an excellent job with it and with the reception and buffet for the wedding 

overall an excellent stay - we were there over valentines day weekend and they said they were at 100% capacity and I think they were just overwhelmed - there were a LOT of children there, so if you are looking totally for romance, may want to weigh your choices - also wifi very spotty

reviews.author: ThinkaRijkoff
reviews.title: Excelente!!
reviews.text:
Hotel com ótima estrutura,atendimento,hospitalidade nota 10!!
E um ótimo hotel para quem quiser aproveitar muito bem a sua passagem em Cancum..Possui vários restaurantes dentro,e muitas outras atrações que não deixam nada a desejar..atendimento na praia super eficiente tambem!!Super indico!!Amei a experiencia..

reviews.author: traveltheglobe2015
reviews.title: Excellent stay!
reviews.text:
Visited this resort during February 2015 and the stay and service was above and beyond any explanations.  There were many different choices for food which made the stay even better. We were travelling with a group of friends so we were doing quite a few nights out in downtown cancun along with a couple of tours around cancun (snorkelling, xplor, chichen itza).  The concierge and staff were very helpful in helping us make arrangements for getting there and etc.  The resort itself has a show every night at the avenue bar and then has the red lounge open at 10pm- 2am as a mini club within the resort.  During the day, the pool bar and beach are gorgeous and extremely relaxing.  The servers would walk around the beach while you got to relax.  The only con of this resort is that it is really big.  So if you want to stay central in the resort without having to do too much walking, I would stay in pyramids 2,3, & 4.  (3 is the noisiest though as it is the central location).

One more thing i forgot to mention, they let us check in at 7am instead of 3pm because our flight arrived early without any problems! It was extremely convenience as we were exhausted and even after we checked out at 12pm on the day we were leaving, they took our luggage and let us enjoy the remaining couple of hours we had on the resort.  They were very flexible.

The stay was fabulous and the staff service is amazing and the views were breath taking. I would most definitely make a trip back to this resort.  And there is 24/7 room service as well.

reviews.author: Jacinto Maia P
reviews.title: Avaliação do bar
reviews.text:
Muito bom o atendimento dos funcionários que trabalham lá. 
Especialmente o Christian e o Efrain. 
Especial também o serviço de quarto.
Bom atendimento também no restaurante Peruano. ..........................................
.......................................

reviews.author: Sharon B
reviews.title: Interesting stay
reviews.text:
So... I'm on my fourth day of my eight say vacation at this resort and there's some good and bad. 

Good : nice looking resort

Bad : extremely cold pools (nobody even uses them), some of the restaurants taste so bad it's better off skipping dinner than eating at them (especially, fuego), when we first arrived everyone was willing to help us make dinner reservations and extremely helpful but they'd always end the conversation with asking if we had attended the timeshare presentation. Whenever I would tell them I'm not interested they'd immediately change their attitude. I eventually ended up saying yes to get a discount on an excursion and to receive a free four night stay (prolly won't be easy to get this) after being promised it would take 90 minutes max. I spent three full hours refusing the timeshare to the sales Rep that couldn't take no for an answer. After the presentation, I asked the staff to help me make a dinner reservation and all I got was someone pointing at a phone telling me to do it myself. 

They basically make you feel like you are here on some sort of free vacation because I am supposed to buy a timeshare. I paid 4000$ for this vacation and I don't owe them anything but I guess the staff were trained otherwise. 

The resort is nice looking and clean but if I were you I'd avoid ANY melia properties. The timeshare presentation was stressful and wasted three hours of my day

reviews.author: M D
reviews.title: Great Holiday!
reviews.text: Just returned from holidays at the Paradisus Cancun Resort and can not say enough.  The food was great, rooms were clean and well maintained, pool very clean and the beach well kept.  The customer service from all of the staff was excellent, very friendly and with our Spanish being a little rusty the staff went out of their way to make sure we all understood each other.  We would like to send a big thank you to Erick Delacruz who was are bartender for most of the vacation, Eric went out of his way to make sure we were happy and well taken care of at the pool bar and did it all with a smile.

reviews.author: Michelle P
reviews.title: Fun in the sun
reviews.text: We stayed at paradisus for 5 nights. There were 3 of us and we requested 2 double beds, but I guess when you book the hotel states they will try to accommodate requests but nothing is guaranteed and we ended up with a king bed and rollaway bed for the first 3 nights. The first room we had was on an inside corner that didn't get much light or wifi. The room was kind of dank and nothing seemed to dry in it. We also had hot water problems. After 3 nights we moved next door to a room with two double beds (they are regular double beds not queen beds like you would get in the USA just fyi) this room was only next door but made a world of difference - much more sunlight, full wifi, things dried, no hot water problems. We were much happier in this room. The resort is beautiful and very modern. Gorgeous lobby, beautiful pools / beaches, excellent service, fun DJ at night. I was impressed with the food too - usually resort food is kinda blah but this food was actually good, especially the taqueria (blue agave was the restaurant name). We took a few of the gym classes which were fun and we were able to do outside on the beach. The day trip planner was extremely helpful and friendly in assisting us in booking day trips. The 3 things I felt this resort was lacking: an outdoor hottub for late in the afternoon when the sun goes down or if its a rainy / cold day out. Some type of towel rack or clothes line for the balcony to dry your wet clothes and also after around 3 pm the sun moves so it is on the lagoon side of the resort - so it would be nice to have an area to lay out on that side to catch a few afternoon rays. Overall we had a great time and were happy with our stay.

reviews.author: H68
reviews.title: Excelente Servicio
reviews.text: Excelente servicio nos alojamos en este hotel con Royal Service y fue extraordinaria la atención, el servicio proporcionado por todo el personal en general desde la llegada hasta la salida, en especial el trato de Francisco Terrazas que en todo momento fue muy atento a nuestros deseos. Habitaciones Royal Service, muy recomendables. Todos los restaurantes muy buenos y especialmente no os podeis perder la Experiencia del Restaurante Tempo de Martín Berasategui. Una estancia muy completo, placentera y regresaré.

reviews.author: Karin F
reviews.title: Rules!!!
reviews.text:
Spent a glorious 8 days here, weather was pretty good even with the wind! 
Checking in was quick and efficient, and our bags were delivered to our room very quickly. The room itself was pretty large and the bed was two doubles pushed together.  There was no clock on the nightstand, but we did find it at the end of our stay. It was underneath the bed, as the nightstand was moved to accommodate the two beds being shoved together.There was the standard mini fridge with beers, some pop, chips and some cookies. There was also the usual coffee maker with instant milk powder. However disappointing was the fact that these items were not replaced on a daily basis, we had to phone for them if we wanted them re-filled. It was also difficult to get water re-fills.
There are quite a few restaurants here, but getting a reservation was a bit challenging. It appears that you must make a reservation 24 hours in advance, and if you try to make one after 5:00, you are out of luck. Most of our meals were taken at Noas, which if a buffet style overlooking the pool area. We went to this place and wanted a table for six, and were told by the hostess that we would have to sit at two tables. The tables are not nailed to the floor, so this sort of left us with an unwelcome feeling. Our waiter came, and seeing our situation, promptly put two tables together. The serving staff, no matter where we went, was amazing, not only professional, but also entertaining. 
One evening at Coco's bar, we had a server that we called "Ricardo Montalban", as he had an uncanny resemblance to this actor from Fantasy Island (hope I didn't age myself), and he was excellent at his job, as well as having a great sense of humour! We had many laughs that night. Job well done!
The restrooms are a bit sparse and all the restaurants on the first floor, all share the two public restrooms. So, you had to hike to one of them or go to your room.
We did have a cockroach visit us, and believe that it came up through the drain, but, this being the tropics, is not unheard of. Just cover or close the floor drains. We ordered a bottle of wine through room service one night, had about half the bottle. We had left the remainder on the dresser. The following night, we went to finish it off only to discover that it was gone :(  
We did go to the ruins, very, very well done, our guide was very knowledgeable, and then to the water park to snorkel. It was a fun filled day, even though it rained pretty hard!!
There are lots of walks to go on, one being the high end mall with Gucci, Armani, etc. 
The beaches could be a little cleaner as there are lots of cigarette butts, straws etc littering the sand.
Overall, our stay was pleasant, just found the rules a little bit constraining

reviews.author: FernandoMeza
reviews.title: Que pasó con la atención?
reviews.text:
Llegamos a este hotel muy ilusionados luego de unas vacaciones por Estados Unidos, teníamos una semana de alojamiento en la Pirámide uno ya que pertenecemos al club Meliá. Si bien sabíamos que el hotel no era nuevo, siempre fue más importante para nosotros la experiencia total más que algún punto en general. Es aquí donde Paradisus Cancún falla: El hotel está muy bien cuidado para los casi 30 años que tiene, pero existen muchas zonas que tienen goteras, la cañeria de la habitación se nota que es muy antigua, las puertas no cierran bien, etc. Por otro lado, el servicio del hotel fue una de las cosas que más nos decepcionó, llevamos realizando este tipo de viajes hace muchos años (hoteles todo incluido) y la verdad es una lástima ver como cada año el servicio empeora, pareciera que las personas que trabajan en el hotel lo hacen a desgana, son serviciales si, pero de manera forzada, varias veces tuvimos problemas porque no nos tomaban el pedido de bebidas, o no nos ponían la loza para poder comer. Una vez llegamos con media hora de anticipación al cierre del buffet y ya estaban quitando la comida, nadie nos atendió y cuando solicitamos que alguien lo hiciera, lo hicieron de mala gana, señores Meliá, arreglen las condiciones laborales de sus empleados para que por lo menos tengan una sonrisa, o cámbienlos, pero la verdad es que este punto fue el más bajo para mi de toda la semana La animación/entretención no existe, menos mal fuimos un grupo de amigos que podíamos armar actividades entre nosotros, porque el animador brilló por su ausencia. La comida en general entre regular y buena, los restaurantes son variados y existen de todo tipo de calidad (el brasileño horrible, el asiático el mejor de ellos, el resto al medio). La playa normal era lo que esperábamos.
La verdad es que cuando uno invierte y viaja de vacaciones espera que se le trate bien y se intente cumplir con todas las necesidades que tiene, sobretodo cuando no es un hotel que sea barato, lamentablemente es algo que en este Meliá no pude ver.
Éramos 8 personas y todas quedaron de alguna manera decepcionadas, creo que volveremos al Paradisus Palma Real que por lo menos uno se siente bien atendido.
Una lástima.

reviews.author: Anna S
reviews.title: Perfeito!!!
reviews.text: Gostaria de deixar registrada minha grande satisfação durante a hospedagem neste hotel. A estrutura física é maravilhosa…muito verde, som de água corrente suave continuamente dentro do hotel, com uma essência suave..parece que vc está sempre em um ambiente de SPA. Oferecem um buffe muito diversificado, mantendo uma alta qualidade, o que é um desafio. Eles disponibilizam ainda 5 restaurantes de diferentes especialidades, todos de alto padrão. Somente uma observação… o restaurante japonês deixa um pouco a desejar, apesar de ter  uma estrutura física deslumbrante. Havia lido que em mtos hotéis somente são atenciosos mediante gorjeta. Isso não ocorreu neste hotel. Foram muito atenciosos. Recomendo ir no esquema all inclusive. Os lanches oferecidos na piscina são ótimos. Realmente se vc chegar muito tarde na praia só terá disponível os bangalôs que necessitam de aluguel. Mas como fui em baixa temporada, o que recomendo, não tivemos problema. Os drinks servidos tem pouco álcool. Se vc pedir, eles providenciam mais. Considerei uma estratégia para evitar inconvenientes no hotel. Os Djs que ficam na praia e piscina são excelentes..sabem fazer uma boa e apropriada seleção de músicas. O SPA é ótimo. As massagens não são baratas, mas valem a pena. Utilizei a academia todos os dias. Tem bons aparelhos e assistência. Permaneci 10 dias e já estou programando retorno com toda a família para usufruir de mais tempo. Parabéns!!!

reviews.author: TRieck
reviews.title: Great 50th B-day at the Paradisus!
reviews.text:
My husband and I and 3 other couples went to the Paradisus Cancun Dec 4th-8th 2014 to celebrate my 50th B-day. We had such an amazing time. 

This was my first time in Cancun as well as 2 of the other couples. We arrived in the afternoon at the resort and were immediately whisked away to the Royal Service area (Adults only section of the hotel). We were seated and served champagne...what a great start. They got us all checked in within about 30 minutes as we lounged. We were then introduced to our Butler Ivan. He was very friendly. He showed us to our rooms and explained the Royal Service and made sure we all felt very taken care of. We could order whatever liquor we wanted. We had rum sent to the room. I asked if could send a treat to all the rooms from me which he took care of. He sent chocolate covered strawberries with a note from me.  

We enjoyed almost all the restaurants but have the most fun in the Blue Agave Tequila Bar and Grill. The Brazilian restaurant was really good but too much food for one sitting so go hungry. Did the breakfast buffet and it was pretty good. I think our favorite breakfast was outside by the pool with a view of the ocean. Not many people out there in the morning. It is like a hidden secret. There is also the Hookah Bar that faces the ocean that never seemed to have too many people. The nightly entertainment was ok not spectacular but that wasn't high on our list. 

Our favorite was hanging out at the beach with food and drink service, we felt so pampered. Another day we reserved the Bali beds by the pool and again felt so pampered by the service. Ivan even found us and checked in to see if we needed anything. Both the beach area nad the pool area were adult only. This is part of the Royal Service.

Overall the whole experience was next to perfect. All of my friends (including my hubby and me) would return. They do have a family side that looks pretty nice as well but since we don't have small children we prefer to vacation at an all adult resort or one with an adult only section.

All the staff were super friendly and helped me a few times on how to get to one side of the building to the other. The resort is huge and can be a little confusing. By the time we were leaving I was finally getting it down!

The only thing I didn't really care for was how dark the hallway areas and center of the resort were. At night it was beautiful with all the lights but during the day it was a little dark but I didn't spend my days in the hallways so it didn't really matter that much. 

The overall feel of the Royal Service side is Zen...very Zen. 

Go you will have a great time!

reviews.author: Roz
reviews.title: Excelente servicio del personal del hotel
reviews.text: La gente del hotel se esmera en brindar buena atención a los huéspedes; todos son muy amables y siempre tienen una sonrisa. El hotel es bastante cómodo y tiene varias opciones de diversión para no salir de ahí. La comida no es la mejor pero también hay diversidad.

reviews.author: LaurenAnne25
reviews.title: This is Paradise!
reviews.text:
Breath-taking..... From the moment walking into the lobby, I knew I was in Paradise!!  Magnificent lobby with ivy cascading down from each floor.  "Luxurious-ness" from every angle, every view.  Junior suites are well appointed, furnished with the best of everything.  Views of ocean and sounds of the sea from morning to night.  Our suite had 2 balconies furnished with everything to make an evening of star gazing perfect.

Breakfast and evening buffets was a feast in itself with everything you can imagine.  I especially enjoyed the grilled veggies, fresh fruit, and for those who love sea food, this is the place for you.

We arrived on Super Bowl Sunday and enjoyed watching the game in their premier lounge on huge TV screens while enjoying their party appetizers.  (Didn't enjoy the last minutes of the game.)

I highly recommend this resort for you next trip.

reviews.author: Trotamundo2000
reviews.title: Melia Paradisus
reviews.text:
Excelente hotel. No se si se merece los premios a la excelencia que se adjudican. Los restaurantes si bien tienen buena comida son demasiado estructurados en cuanto al menu que ofrecen,  por lo que muchas veces terminas buscando algo en el bufet.
Los bares, en general estan muy bien surtidos aunque los bartenders en general no se esmeran mucho

reviews.author: CmdtStubbing
reviews.title: Bon hotel
reviews.text:
Séjour du 23/01 au 30/01. Très bon accueil, très bon service nous avons toujours été bien reçu lors de nos différentes demande. Nous avons même eu un problème sur une valise a l'aéroport mais nous nous en sommes aperçu a l'hotel. Le personnel de l'hotel a contacté l'aéroport pour savoir quelle démarche nous devions faire. La restauration n'est pas mauvaise mais sans réel gout, pour plaire a tout le monde dirons nous. Les différents restaurants a theme sont plutôt sympas meme si finalement pas très différents des repas servis aux buffets. Les vins par contre sont a proscrire!
La chambre était très agréable, clim un peu bruyante sans plus et salle de bain très bien et propre comme le reste.
Pour de bons cocktails demander Emilio et pour un service et des conseils irréprochables a la conciergerie demander Bruno.

reviews.author: ilitvino
reviews.title: Paradisus is always the best!
reviews.text: We just returned from this wonderful resort. Overall Cancun is too busy -- to many hotel on the beach, too many people, but if you are in Paradisus -- you don't feel that. There is always a beach chair available and the hotel is very spacious. They also clean algae on the beach in this hotel (not the case in nearby hotels). Inside the resort is very serene with ivy growing and lots of vegetation. Basically, while you are inside -- you feel like you are outside. You can hardly notice the concrete (unlike other hotels). This resort has lots of pools (we stayed in Royal Service section). All pools (at least in Royal Service section) are heated -- which is nice after the sunset. The drinks are good -- but Pina Colada is "from concentrate" -- so we ordered Mojito, mud slide, amoretto sour, etc. The complimentary wine selection is also very nice. Finally we were very pleased with the dining options. There were no lobsters -- but the sushi in the ala cart restaurant were delicious. We also LOVED everything in El Fuego restaurant. DOn't waste your time with La Perla restaurant -- it is a very simple buffet by the pool. There is lot's of nice choices in a la carte restaurants for people who like things tartar and medium rare (e.g. filet mignon). For those who like simple stuff there is also lots of bacon, burgers and fries :-)) But me and my wife don't eat that. We were too busy in the evenings with friends -- so we did not go to the shows (thus, I cannot judge). The rooms are luxurious as well (marble all around). The hotel service is very friendly and they really do try to satisfy even your most ridiculous request (5 star all around!) Overall, great hotel -- worth every dollar and every penny. I would go back again and recommend it to others.

reviews.author: Fernanda G
reviews.title: No lo recomiendo
reviews.text: Fui en enero 2 semanas para relajarme,ya habia ido al de playa del carmen que fue bello .Aca todo es pesimo,el servicio es de cuarta..los cuartos parecen de un hotel de 3 estrellas...el hotel es viejo, entran convencciones de todo tipo y no hay lugar para desayunar o almorzar. Lo unico que es lundo es la playa

reviews.author: Richard W
reviews.title: Nearly Perfect
reviews.text:
Great Hotel, Beautiful Beach, Great Service, Good Food! The only minus to the week's stay was the poor quality of the WIFI which kept dropping out. Particular thanks to Asuncion, Marisol, Luis, and Enrique at the Pool Bar for their incredible service.

Thank you,REW

reviews.author: Diana Fiorella M
reviews.title: Un hotel para relajarse!
reviews.text: Este hotel no es precisamente el que buscarías si quieres ir de fiesta pero si quieres relajarte e ir con familia, es totalmente recomendable. Todas sus instalaciones son grandes y lindas y el servicio muy bueno!

reviews.author: itrippin
reviews.title: Cancun year end trip.
reviews.text:
A few words about this resort. Rooms are not as nice as some of the other hotels we have stayed in in Cancun. The beds are very comfortable and the grounds are beautiful and well taken care of. 
The pools are clean and big. The main pool with the bar was a little cold but the other pools were heated, which was nice. Food was just ok, it was hard to get anything that was hot. You have to make reservations a day in advance for most.

We were in tower 3, which is where the lobby is, and it was a bit noisy at night. One big problem was i needed to get on the internet for just a few minutes each day and it was nearly impossible. Called the front desk but no help there either. Also got some weird virus on my MAC BOOK which i thought was hard to do. 

If you like golf don't play the par 3 in front of hotel, not worth it even if its free. We rented clubs to play but they didn't have golf balls, go figure. Luckily a friend traveling with us had 4.

I will say the staff at the hotel are great. Friendly and will help with anything.

Overall would probably not stay here on our next trip.

reviews.author: Amaia M
reviews.title: Amazonic Mayan Paradise!
reviews.text:
I was taken aback, like other guests, by the amazon-like jungle decor from the inside of this gigantic five-pyramid complex. I was there with my colleague celebrating the publication of my book, but also we were there to work --to write. Both of us had deadlines pending so we decided to go to Cancun and work there. I had never been to the Paradisus before, and honestly, it was a matter of chance that I selected this hotel. I wanted to stay in Playa del Carmen, which is in the Riviera Maya but we decided last-minute and I didn't have a long time to select the vacation package. I decided to do an all-inclusive because I have done it before in Cancun and it's very comfortable no to have to think about finances when you're there (other than tips which I always leave, especially for the women who work behind the scenes but I'll get to that...). When we arrived we were upgraded to Royal Service after I told the front desk attendant that we were there to celebrate my publication. Let me just say WOW! Royal Service is amazing. First of all there are no children allowed and, no offense to people who chose to reproduce, that was very welcoming to me. No screaming, no running, no weird stuff in the pool, etc. That in and of itself was paradise. I concur with one of the reviews that though they told us the place was full, I hardly ever saw people in the pool or at the beach. This is due to the fact that they have five pyramids that are humongous so people are totally spread. I know that in the general area it was difficult for people to get a nice cabana by the pool whereas at the Royal Service, Bernardo and Arturo? who kept our reservations and we got a great place by the pool. The food was fabulous though after six days it starts to get boring... I really enjoyed the variety of restaurants although we were unable to go to two of them since they were always full. 
I appreciated the service at this hotel and the professionalism that all workers at this place have. They always say hello and give you the Paradisus ‘hello’ which is taking their right hand and placing in in their hearts (weird but it brings pride to workers because instead of them being invisible, guests acknowledge their presence and I liked that). So let's talk about labor: this hotel needs to be more balanced in terms of gender equity and workloads. On the one hand the waiters were always running around in all of the restaurants and the women in the buffets as well. Whereas the 'butlers' or others like the cabana boys in the Royal Service who spent most of their time chatting with each other and making reservations. Don't get me wrong they do work but the workload is definitely not balanced at all. The men waiters, bell-boys, valets, etc. make all the tips because they're all in front face-to-face with patrons whereas the women are in the background making your rooms, cooking, doing dishes, etc. This means all the tips go to the men and I find that horrible! That's why I'm giving this hotel only 'average' because they need to take care of their female employees way better than what they are doing now. Anytime I needed change for a $20 for tips guess who always had ones for change? the bell boys. So please when you go to the Paradisus be conscious of the women behind the scenes and TIP THEM! yes let me reiterate that TIP THEM! more than the cabana boys who make reservations, more than the guy who carries a couple of bags for like ten seconds, and take care of the smoothie woman at the breakfast buffet, or the woman preparing your eggs, and most importantly tip the women who make your room everyday! They have different shifts, so leave a TIP by the bathroom sink so they know it's for them or leave a note or something... be appreciative of the people who are working long hours for not a lot of money so that you may enjoy this amazing paradise. 
Having said all that yes, I recommend this hotel but I strongly advise the owners to re-structure their personnel so that women may be better compensated. They should have a tip pool and at the end of the day divide it among all of the workers. Just a thought.

reviews.author: Lggarcia1
reviews.title: Bom hotel
reviews.text: O hotel, apesar de antigo é bastante conservado. A comida com certeza é o forte do hotel, em especial o restaurante mexicano que existe lá. O café da manhã também é bom. Fica perto dos shoppings. O serviço também é ótimo.

reviews.author: Metalmulisha88
reviews.title: Paradise and royalty in your hands
reviews.text: Let me tell you something,  I don't do reviews often or really like to. I can't begin to explain how amazing this place truly is. Obviously we got the royal service and glad and so happy we did. When they say the word royal they truly mean it. Everything including your own private tower, they set you up with a butler for the whole time you are there. They also give you a cellphone to call him whenever you need something.  Also, they give you they same guy the whole time. Everything including top shelf lounge is included,  24-7 room service included and mini bar that you can customize for free! Now for the restaurants, we tried Bana, market grill, vento, the buffet and blue agave. I was very happy with the food except for the buffet and blue agave, they were very bad. The food is not even mediocre, other than that Bana hands down the best sushi and fresh seafood. For the names of people who stood out from the rest! Héctor,  he was so attentive and always there for us. Fernando, Salvador , Carlos and Alberth. The worse part of this place is leaving it. Please tip well, a few dollars here and there take u far away!

reviews.author: TeddyRuxpinGR
reviews.title: Excellent relaxing vacation
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun from Jan. 10-17, 2015. What a great place! We had a wonderful time during our stay. Here is my review of the hotel:

Pros:
1. The facility itself. As soon as you walk into the resort to check in, you enter an enormous pyramid and it almost feels like you've entered a luxurious jungle. There is green vegetation everywhere and it smells amazing. The hotel isn't brand new but it's very well maintained. Our room was more than adequate and featured a great Jacuzzi on the balcony!
2. The food. I've been to a couple of other all-inclusive resorts and this one had the best food and the most options in terms of restaurants. I was impressed by the variety of food that they offer, from Brazilian style (truly a meat festival!!) to sushi, to Mexican. I enjoyed every meal I had all week.
3. The SERVICE! The resort was pretty full during the week that we were there and yet it rarely seemed crowded. It was simple to make reservations for the restaurants (call the day before) and the staff did an exceptional job all around. A few staff members were amazing, including Manuel at Bana (he is soo nice and even had small gifts for us on our second trip to Bana). Erick and Enrique were hilarious and did a great job keeping us "hydrated" at the pool bar. "chacarone!". Luis worked his butt off making sure we always had drinks while we sat in our lounge chairs around the pools.
4. The location. The Paradisus is located right in the heart of the hotel zone and this made it easy to get to from the airport. It was also extremely simple to take the bus which runs right in front of the hotel into town to begin our excursion to Isla Mujeres.

Cons:
Sales Presentation: When we arrived we were given all of the hotel information and then were offered a discount on excursions if we agreed to a 90-minute presentation the following day to become a member of the Melia Vacation Club. We agreed, and the presentation was moving right along until it came down to the "hard sell" portion. We had to become fairly insistent that we were not interested before they let us go. If I had to do it again, I'd skip the presentation and enjoy the 2 hours that I spent there. Overall this didn't really bother me as I knew what to expect, but it can be frustrating when you have already said that you aren't interested and they keep pushing. Like I said, not a big deal overall.

Pro Tip!! We had stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana before and chose to upgrade to Royal Service there. In Punta Cana, the Royal Service really seemed important in order to get the extra free restaurant options and access to the Royal Service pool. I asked how much it would be to upgrade to Royal Service this time and it would have been an extra $100 per night ($700 total). We decided not to do it and were never upset about this decision. There are plenty of restaurants to choose from and there was always open lounge chairs at the pool. In my opinion, the extra $700 for Royal Service would not have been worth it.

We had a fantastic vacation at the Paradisus and would highly recommend it to others. The staff works very hard to take care of you and the facility and beach are exceptional.

reviews.author: InfininitusEquitas
reviews.title: Great, not perfect.
reviews.text:
Overall Paradisus Cancun is a good spot to spend a vacation.  You won't regret going there.

I opted for the Royal Service upgrade, and that was definitely worth it.  You have access to a separate tower, separate pool area with plentiful cabanas, and a separate beach front restaurant.  Not to mention better liquor in the base of the tower anytime you want it.  I also had a bottle of vodka delivered to my room, and any drink arrived generally within 20 minutes or less.

My private concierge was completely useless - never really around, and gave bad advice regarding tours, but the staff member that were present were always helpful.

I do suggest bringing lots of singles to tip, you will get noticeably better service.

The room itself is pretty standard fare for a resort, clean, lots of marble, medium sized bathtub.

Another perk of the royal service is you get to use the spa areas as much as you want.  The facilities were nice, but showing their age.  That said, on a rainy day it helps to still be able to get into water and relax after a hard night of partying.

With one notable exception - the mexican restaurant - the other restaurants on premises were pretty good, although service was slow.  Food was not of the highest quality, but perfectly in line with medium price restaurants.

The breakfast/lunch buffet were nice, but didn't have a very wide variety.  They also seemed to constantly run out of the more popular specialty dishes.

The dinner buffet was also acceptable, but nothing to rave about.  With the exception of the new years dinner, I really was expecting more.  On the plus side they were open up to 2am, which is nice for when you want a post drinking snack, coming back from the clubs.

In terms of location, it will take you a good 10-15 minutes by bus or cab to reach the club strip, which is fine. The bus coming back can be an excruciatingly long ride though.

While they advertise having two clubs on premises, based on my new years experience there is really not much going on at the hotel itself at night.

Assuming you don't have bad luck with the weather, it's definitely a nice place to stay.

reviews.author: ihatejjredick
reviews.title: Good......depending what you're looking for
reviews.text:
My buddy and I are in our early 30's and were looking for a fun spot to visit for a quick four day vacation. We stayed at Paradisus 1/16-1/19.

Pros:
- plenty of food options (note: room service for food included with all-inclusive)
- friendly staff
- buffet is good and available for all three meals for a quick meal
- great beach and pool bar
- very affordable
- very clean rooms

Cons:
- Very dated look and feel (included a 90 minute lip syncing Michael Jackson musical routine)
- Tons of amenities but you must seek them out constantly
- zero nightlife
- food is hit or miss
- Only four beers in fridge per day and they will charge if you want more

Overall I liked Paradisus but I wouldn't stay there again. Not because it is a bad place but because I'd rather see a different Cancun resort and see if I like it more.

Paradisus appeared to be perfect for older couples and families. Anyone looking for a party atmosphere or an ideal honeymoon spot will be disappointed.

If you want a relaxing, affordable vacation spot in Cancun you can do alot worse than Paradisus.

reviews.author: Alexander S
reviews.title: Great Time On New Years
reviews.text:
I stayed here were there a couple of friends this past years. But the hotel six months in advance and get a great deal.

When I came in for check-in I was suggested to upgrade to Royal Service, a different part of the hotel with an all inclusive package for drinks and food.

I had a personal lounge with the personal butler and a personal Full bar. My weeklong stay was amazing, I had no worries I had time to relax from the world. Cancun was full of tourists I had a great time will come again.

reviews.author: David W
reviews.title: Amazing trip.
reviews.text: We have been coming here for about 4 years for a company trip with spouses.  Not a formal trip...just fun.  Everyone here is always very friendly and accommodating.  Endless activities for all ages.  Kids welcome.  Never a complaint.  Always feel safe and secure

reviews.author: murdog
reviews.title: Just ok
reviews.text:
My sister and I came here for 3 nights.  We have been to Cancun many times, and have stayed at a handful of different places.  The service was good, and the hotel staff was friendly.  When we entered the hotel, we were led to a check in room as we passed by a large desk that looked as if it should be the check in area.  After waiting for around 20 minutes we were finally helped.  We got all checked in and went up to the room.  It was small.  We looked through the refrige area, looking for drinks.  Everywhere else that we have stayed has had top shelf alcohol in the rooms.  The bell hop came up with our luggage and said there was no alcohol in the rooms and that we would have to go downstairs to the bar.  
The accommodations were just ok.  The room never really cooled off.  The majority of the hotel was always very humid.  
The food was good at all of the restaurants that we went to.
We mainly went to Cancun just to relax by the pool and beach.  I must say that our favorite person in the whole place was Laura at the poolside bar.  She was very friendly and always kept our drinks filled- if we wanted them.  
When we travel together, my sister and I like to talk to other people, and maybe hang out with new friends for the duration of a trip.  There was really no one here our age (40's), with similar interests. 
We didn't find a lot of night life either.
Another con of this hotel is that they don't take US Dollars.  I found that very strange, and annoying.  Everywhere we have stayed is happy to take US.  I needed something from the gift shop and came in from the pool, wanting to just charge it to my room.  They said that I didn't have a credit card on file.  I know I presented it to them at check in.   I had to go all the way up to the room to get my credit card.
The check out process seemed to be odd too.  My sister had an earlier flight than I, so she left before me.  She had to get a check out card so that she could leave the hotel, although I was checking out a few hours later.  
After I had checked out, I was talking to the cab driver.  He said that there are some hotels that are marketed to Mexico City and other areas around Mexico.  Being from the US, I had no idea about this.  We won't stay here again.  I will stick with the Palace Resorts!!

reviews.author: leINDIA
reviews.title: Best Hotel in Cancun
reviews.text: This hotel is the reason I keep coming back to Cancun. The staff, food, and ambiance is great. I recommend that couples upgrade to RED Level (make sure you do it once you get there and not beforehand). A great place to relax. The Red Level experience was great, you have your own private pool and bed berths by the beach. Definitely recommended.

reviews.author: Nicolas F
reviews.title: El mejor hotel de cancún
reviews.text: No tiene ni el mas minimo detalle para perfeccionar, muy buen servicio, habitaciones muy comodas, all inclusive de primer nivel, las barras en la pileta es algo que no se compara con nada,  es un hotel para hospedarse y no irse mas. Lo recomiendo 100%

reviews.author: Maisa P
reviews.title: Nunca vi melhor! ameeeeiii
reviews.text: Melhor hotel que já visitei em minha vida. Com vários tipos de restaurantes temáticos. Cada noite pode escolher um tema e saborear as delicias que o hotel tem a oferecer. Possui wifi em toda a área, inclusive na areia da praia consegue cobertura. Amei, maravilhoso. Voltaria sem duvidas

reviews.author: Atl-TravelJunkie
reviews.title: Amazing hotel with a few gotchas
reviews.text:
I stayed at the Paradisus Cancun twice in the past few months.  Both times we upgraded to get ocean view rooms (definitely worth the money).  My first visit was for a long weekend getaway in October.  The property is absolutely gorgeous with a great beach and beautiful pools.  The hotel lobby is also beautiful.  With the decor, the hotel has a bit of a spa-like feel.   I liked the hotel so much that I returned for a 4 day trip in mid December.

PROS:
- Excellent service - great staff
- Beautiful property
- Very good food in the specialty restaurants, the main buffet is good but not great
- Nice large balcony's (but they seem to only come with one chair)
- Comfortable rooms
- Beach chairs are well spaced out, not on top of each other as happens in some resorts

CONS:
- The "personal concierge" is just basically a glorified sales person.  They will help you book your sightseeing trips (which is fine) but they will also attempt to get you to go on a Melia Club timeshare presentation.  On my second trip - the concierge lied to me about this (more below).

- The resort also has a conference center - during our second trip there was a conference including 1700 realtors that completely changed the feel of the resort from a laid back tropical paradise to more of a "Tony Robbins meets an adult spring break" vibe. There was no indication when we made the reservation that there would such a large group at the hotel.

THE GOTCHA
The Club Melia "Get a Free Trip promotion" is a COMPLETE SCAM.  For the record, I never do time presentations, I haven't been to one in over 15 years.  On my first trip, even though my "concierge" was doing a relative hard sell, I turned it down.  On my second trip, the concierge pointed out that I was staying for 3 nights.  He stated that if I had done the presentation, I could have been using a free 3 night certificate and suggested I do the presentation so that I could try one of the other Paradisus resorts.  I still resisted stated that there is always a catch.  We went back and forth for a while where I asked several specific questions he assured my that there were no hidden fees (boldface lie) just a $50 registration fee.   Since I am a big fan of the two Melia hotels that i have visited, I broke my rules and agreed to go to the 90 minute presentation to get a free ($50) 3 night stay.  THE CATCH: after the presentation when they game me the certificate, they stated that the hotel room is free for three nights but you must pay an all inclusive fee each night (which turns out to be at least $160 night making the "free" trip cost over $500 not $50).  I pointed out to them that this was in direct conflict from what I was told by the concierge. To which they pointed out was written clearly in the fine print of the document (which I did not have access to until after I wasted 90 minutes in the presentation).  I pointed out that I had asked several direct questions about the fees before booking the presentation and after complaining to management they gave me a free massage if I would sign the acceptance of the travel certificate.  The moral of the story: DO NOT DO A MELIA CLUB PRESENTATION.  The "free" trip is not free and has a series of restrictions.  You can do better booking a trip with hotel and air combined on Orbitz or Expedia.  

The sleazy timeshare pushing is a real negative for what otherwise appears to be a high end luxury hotel.

IN SUMMARY:
My first trip to the Paradisus in October was amazing.  I travel frequently and rarely return to the same property, however this was so nice that I went back.

My second trip to the Paradisus in December was still nice, but somewhat disappointing.  Two days before the large group arrived they began building a huge stage in the middle of the beach and putting large signage all over the property.  When the realtors arrived they had an event that complete took over the pool area. The zen feel that I enjoyed so much the first time was completely lost.

If there is a way to check that there are no large groups at the same time as your trip I would highly recommend the property.

reviews.author: Cooki
reviews.title: Refuse to stay at any other Cancun resort!
reviews.text:
This resort is beautiful inside and out! The property is modern with a large section of beach. I have read most of the negative reviews on here, and while a few people may have run into some bad luck during their stay, others just seem to be extra picky and not understanding at all. I stayed at Paradisus three times in 2014 and am booked for another stay in March 2015. Like the title says, I won't even bother visiting Cancun if I can't get a room at Paradisus. 
    I chose the Royal Service option each time, and although you'll cough up extra dough for it, shouldn't your vacation be the best that it can be?? If you can afford it, I say splurge, it's worth it!
    I'm picky, not so much as to complain about a crooked outlet or curtains blocking too much sunlight in the rooms (I think that's their purpose) like I've read on here, but when it comes to the cleanliness of a hotel's common areas and it's rooms I definitely am since I worked as a hotel housekeeper in high school. So I know first hand how careless and lazy some hotel staff can be with their work. But the common areas at Paradisus are spectacular, there are staff constantly cleaning, and more importantly so are the rooms. I usually bring my own blanket when I travel and remove the one on the bed because I know for a fact most hotels don't wash the blankets and bedspreads between guests. But at Paradisus the comforter is tucked between two sheets that do get changed daily so I felt very comfortable using it. 
    I can't speak on the experience of other options, but Royal Service provides the ultimate convenience. Royal Service is for adults 18 and over only and the rooms are located in the fifth pyramid, so you are guaranteed not to hear little kids screaming through the halls or the music from the lounge and other activity associated with the other pyramids. I was told that Paradisus does not permit spring breakers to stay at the resort, which is a plus. I'm not sure how they regulate that, but it's an inviting concept. Royal Service guests have the pleasure of enjoying a pool, food and drink service and a section of beach all to themselves, again nobody under 18 permitted in those areas. A server will pass through the beach and pool areas every 10-15 minutes to take your food and drink orders and serve them to you while you soak up the sun. 
   Every item in the room's mini bar is included (no extra cost) and is replenished daily. If you prefer that your mini bar be stock with more of a certain item than others they will accommodate you. They even have a selection of alcohol that they will bring bottles of to your room if requested. The Royal Service atrium provides snacks, finger foods, and desserts during certain times of the day along with a help yourself bar of premium alcohol, all of which you can bring back to your room or enjoy right there. 
    At check in you are given a glass of sparkling wine and assigned a butler and a cell phone to contact him at any time. Request Sergio, he's the best! Any time I asked Sergio to bring something to my room he brought it in a timely manner or had someone else bring it. He never left us waiting unacceptable amounts of time. He's very nice and professional. He took care of all our reservation requests for restaurants and Bali beds, we never had any trouble. The Bali beds are no extra cost with Royal Service. And on our last full day Sergio arranged our airport transportation and printed out our boarding passes and brought them to us on the beach. 
    I'm a foodie at heart, I love to eat! The food at Paradisus is very good. As with any establishment not every item may be to your liking, but I had a hard time finding items I did not enjoy. The omelet station at the buffet and the Asian restaurant are my favs. I stayed at Grand Oasis my first two trips to Cancun, and trust me, the food at Paradisus would win awards compared to that "food". 
     Not everything went well during my stays, not to any fault of the staff, but our own. My friend was a bit hungover one morning and while at breakfast in the market grill buffet she passed out on her way to the restroom. It was unbelievable how many staff members came to her rescue. It was like they came out of nowhere even before she hit the ground! The medical staff took her blood pressure and were very caring. I had my own drunken moment at dinner. The wait staff noticed that I wasn't feeling well, I couldn't even sit up at the table, and they offered to bring me a wheel chair back to my room. And they even sent the food we already ordered to our room, which was unexpected. Well, we learned to control our drinking, but if you find yourself in a bind the staff and medical personnel are very attentive and compassionate. 
    Some people have complained about the "stink" in the lobby as being overwhelming. Well, I love the AROMA, I think it's lavender, and I can't wait to smell it again every time I leave. Most confusing are the complaints about the staff not being able to speak English. Well, you are in a Spanish speaking country, THEIR country. I say to those people , maybe you should learn Spanish. But anyway, the only staff I encountered who didn't speak English were some of the housekeepers and kitchen workers, I was still able to use my high school Spanish and get my point across. But all the staff whose purpose it is to assist and interact with guests speak English. Some people have griped that they arrived in the morning and had to wait hours for their room to be ready. Well, as with just about every hotel, check in time is at 3pm, it's stated on all booking websites. So unless you don't mind waiting for a ready room, I recommend you book your flight to arrive about noon if possible. By the time you collect your baggage, pass through customs, meet your transportation and travel to the resort it will be check in time or close to it. Others have complained that the common areas, especially the main lobby/atrium lacks AC leaving it hot and stuffy. You should understand that they may have the AC on, but with the main entrance doors, as well as the doors leading to the beach in the back constantly opening it makes sense that the AC wouldn't make much of a difference. But it would be understandable if they don't run the AC at all in those areas, it's just a waste. As long as the restaurants and my room is comfortable I'm happy! 
   The only complaint that I have is that the Wi-Fi signal in the rooms is very very weak. If I hang my phone on the room door's knob MAYBE  I can catch a signal, but usually I have to step into the hallway for a good signal. I would love to used my phone or tablet comfortably sitting in my room or even on the balcony. But throughout the common areas and even at the pool and beach area I received a signal. 
   I don't truly believe that tips are included in the package price, if they are, it's miniscule. If you receive great service as I always have during my stays please tip well, they deserve it.

reviews.author: DMF Rossi
reviews.title: New Year's week in Cancun
reviews.text: We went to Cancun, Mexico for New Years week! Paradisus is the place to stay! We got the Royal Service.. Well worth it! Juan our Butler was the best! The food and drinks never stopped! Food was delish! The beach there was awesome! I stayed at RIU Cancun 2 years ago, & the beach there is terrible! Love Paradisus! I'm going back!!

reviews.author: DovBaron
reviews.title: Royal Pool Service
reviews.text: Despite many disappointments with this property we have received some great pool service. Bernardo, (pool concierge) find this best spots and keeps everybody happy. Octavio, pool butler; outstanding prompt service, goes above & beyond

reviews.author: malanks
reviews.title: Beautiful beach + delicous food!
reviews.text:
My friends and i went in December for a quick relaxing all-inclusive post Christmas trip. The hotel is massive, but VERY CLEAN (we even got towels 2X a day in the room) and the beach is also SUPER clean. We tried a few restaurants (Argentinian steak place -market grill was delicous; sushi restaurant in the hotel lobby was also super fresh; el fuego was also very good for latin fusion). The least favorite was Mole -- the salads are weird and bland, the service was good, but the food in the buffett was better.

all the bartenders were super friendly. Oscar and Salvador at the Sushi bar made amazing cocktails!

Its definitely worth buying a bottle on the beach and getting a cabana. Its very reasonable for all the services you get. Luis, Chewy and Ricardo were very attentive and made the day really enjoyable.

Its also definitely worth getting an ocean front room, the hotel is on the strip and if you face the front...there isnt a view (at least its nothing compared to the one of the ocean).

There is an adults only section...but we didnt check it out (as it was an extra $95/night pp).

The main reason i didnt give this resport 5 stars is at the check in/check out there is room for improvement. Our room wasnt ready until after 4pm (check in is at 3pm), and when we got there, we had a "hostess" sit with us for alsmot 45 min trying to sell us on some promotion that if we sign up now, we can have 2 adults, 2 kids stay free (we were a group of 3 females in our late twenties....). And they omitted telling us about the schedule of events/where to find it. At check out, it was mass chaos....instead of having multiple lines for each clerk....people were using it was one line and saying "well i was here longer". They should really streamline that a little better.

reviews.author: Brooklynite_Abroad
reviews.title: Now a Paradisus, but the same old Gran Melia it always was
reviews.text:
The setting:  This is the former Gran Melia Cancun, recently rebranded as Paradisus Cancun.  If you have stayed at other Paradisus resorts, you will be quite disappointed.  I stay at this property every couple of years and there wasn’t a single discernable difference about this property from a few years ago to its current reincarnation as a Paradisus.  The lobby is spacious and impressive, although dated.  The rooms are standard issue.
The room:  We stayed at a Royal Service room, which appears as any other room at the hotel.  The only difference is that there won’t be any children staying in the Royal Service pyramid, which is the north most of the five pyramids in the hotel.  The only advantage to Royal Service is the adults only pool which is located where the Level beach was.  We stayed here at the end of September and the Royal Service beach was packed.  Finding a bali bed/palapa with a nice view of the beach was impossible.  The super discounted rates for Royal Service (@$200/night vs the usual @$1000/night at other true Paradisus resorts) meant that this property was packed even during the off peak season.  The butler service, which comes with Royal Service was subpar as well; ours fully forgot to reserve our bali beds.
The food:  The breakfast buffet is the sole decent offering at this property.  The Mexican restaurants are decent but definitely skip the Asian and continental options.  This is a shame as Cancun has great restaurants so the chefs do not have to approximate other cuisines, they can try quality Asian and continental food outside of the hotel and recreate the flavors.  The mandatory all inclusive at this rebranded Paradisus is a major negative, as I would have rather paid less for the room and enjoyed the dining options outside of the hotel.
All in all, I found this property to be a solid choice when it was a Gran Melia.  As a mandatory all inclusive Paradisus, it just doesn’t hit the product quality that I have experienced and have to expect from a Paradisus.  I hope the Melia chain truly upgrades this hotel.  My biggest gripe is the need to fight for a bali bed; that should never happen at a Paradisus, especially when there was never a lack of these at the Level, during Gran Melia times.

reviews.author: Ishaan12
reviews.title: Great resort for kids and adults.
reviews.text: We came with 3 famalies to the resort. Everybody was satisfied. The food was great and with the family concierge service food was inclucive. The pool was a great way to spend the day. There are cabanas to rent and a bar. The rooms were surprisingly big. We booked a standard room. Everything about the resort was great.

reviews.author: Robyn C
reviews.title: So Great I'm going back.
reviews.text:
I am super late but better late than never!! I traveled to Cancun, Mexico back in July of 2014 for my 30th birthday with one friend.  This was a ladies trip!! It was very last minute so we decided to stay at Paradisus because it was a great deal at the time and it had pretty decent reviews.  Once we arrived, we were upgraded to Royal Service, which is located in the 5th tower (pyramid) because they were booked solid. Beware, because they will attempt to sell you royal service and when you decline they have no other choice but to put you in the Royal Service tower because there are no other available rooms.  However, I would totally pay for Royal Service next time because there is no other way to stay at this resort unless it is a family vacation.  We were told we "were not" Royal Service because we did not pay the extra fee.  However, once in that tower (and you receive your all inclusive arm band) you are Royal Service.  

First, the pictures on the website and most of the traveler photos listed on this site do this resort absolutely no justice.  It is simply beautiful and breathtaking.  It always smells great and is very clean.  Some say the smell in the common areas is a bit overwhelming but I enjoyed the fresh scent everyday.  Royal Service is secluded from the other parts of the resort and has a private pool, private pool bar w/ great servers, private dining, and many other private amenities.  However, those are the ones we used the most.  

You have to be sure to build a relationship with one of the servers and tip well and you will be treated awesome.  However, we were treated awesome well before we ever tipped our server.  He is soooo awesome and I pray that he is still there when we return this year.  His name is Ephraim (I hope I spelled that right)  He is simply amazing!! He treated us well, he always made sure we had something to drink or eat, he was very attentive, he made great suggestions, and he always seemed happy to see us.  We layed out by the pool and beach at least once a day during our stay and he was working the entire time.  We loved him so much that we were a bit excessive in our tipping but he definitely deserved it.  He kept us very happy.  Although, I feel that the resort was awesome he made our experience much better.

We have traveled the carribean and stayed at many different all-inclusive resorts.  However, we had never stayed at a resort at the capacity of Paradisus.  We were excited to learn that 9 out of the 10 restaurants were included in the all inclusive amenities and there was always something going on to keep us entertained and our belly's full.  The restaurants were absolutely amazing but you must make a reservation in order to dine there.  We were able to enjoy 3 out of the 10.  I believe the only one that is not included in the all-inclusive amenities is Tempo, which looked absolutely amazing.  We were told it is not included and the executive chef is award-winning chef Martin Berasategui so it was well worth it.  While we were there the resort hosted a BBQ and the food was absolutely amazing.  If we wanted music and a party we could head over to one of the other pools and there was always a ton of people and a lot of action going on.  However, if we wanted some quiet we could make our way back to the Royal Service pool.  This is a kid-friendly resort.  However, you would never know because it is sooo large and there is a lot for kids to do.  

There was so much to do in the resort that we only left the resort twice to go downtown to enjoy the nightlife and jetskiing over at aquaworld.  There are 10 restaurants, a number of bars, and a swanky bar/lounge called the red lounge which stays open until 1am.  

We were satisfied and this was money well spent.  We will definitely be going back to Paradisus again this year with more people to join in on our experience.  And yes, we will be paying extra for the complete Royal Service experience.

reviews.author: Peter G
reviews.title: Amazing - First Class
reviews.text: Paradisus was amazing.  First the staff was tremendous.  They were all very friendly, helpful and smiled the entire time making sure if we needed anything they got it for us.  It was very clean both in the room and all the common areas of the resort.  They have several different restaurants that you can choose from and the food was excellent.   They have 3 pools.  One of them has a swim up bar.  Outside grounds are well maintained and clean.  The beach is beautiful and they have outside beds that can be used along with plenty of beach chairs.  Beach and water is beautiful.  I can't wait to go back!!!

reviews.author: weatherman2003
reviews.title: Wonderful and Relaxing
reviews.text:
Stayed here back in February 2014 and was very pleased with my choice.  The ride from the airport was not very long at all and the check-in process was very quick and painless.  We were off to our room and onto the beach within a 1/2 hour tops.  

The room was great and exactly what were were expecting.  If you can, upgrade to the ocean view rooms.  One of the most relaxing things I did every day was to wake up and watch the sun come up on our balcony overlooking the ocean with coffee.  Best way to start the day!  

The lobby is amazing and all of the pics you see with the plants, trees, vines, coy pond, etc don't do it justice!  It's beautiful and really makes this hotel great and unique.  We upgraded to the Royal Concierge service - HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!  This meant that we had a room in one of the towers on the side, away from the main tower which got more foot-traffic and was a bit noisier.  We were so happy we upgraded to the concierge service.  Our butler was amazing and gave us everything we needed.  Every morning we had a bed reserved in the private pool section (only guests with concierge service can stay there).  We had priority dinner reservations made everyday. 

We really enjoyed Bana Restaurant as we're seafood/sushi lovers.  But Mole was delicious as well.  The food here was really good, and the breakfast/lunch options at the buffet were perfect and always seemed fresh.  Lunch at the Market Grill was always pleasant and right on the water, couldn't ask for anything more on a beach vacation.  With the royal service we also had access to a private bar and snack area every day, anytime we wanted.  Aside from the top shelf liquors that we could poor ourselves, we could enjoy a variety of snacks (meats, cheeses, etc).  It was perfect for when you didn't want to load up on a full lunch after a few days of doing that.  

Would absolutely stay here again on another visit to Cancun.

reviews.author: CarlosLozano2013
reviews.title: Ha cambiado, pero sigue siendo muy bueno...
reviews.text:
Fue mi tercera vez en este hotel...Ha cambiado su estrategia a todo incluido y por eso obviamente cambian los estándares.
Si se compara con lo que era antes, hay pequeños detalles que lo hacían grande, como por ejemplo, el tradicional saludo con la mano al pecho que hacían los empleados...pequeñas cosas como esas hoy se añoran..
No obstante, la calidad de los servicios han tratado de conservarla. El spa es muy recomendable. Las habitaciones sin duda tienen muy buena vista, sin embargo, son muy superiores las que tienen vista a la playa.
Conserven los estándares que los hacen diferentes..

reviews.author: milosb587
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun - Great Experience!
reviews.text: The staff was incredible, rooms very clean. The service was amazing and the staff was always very friendly. We had an excellent time and we would recommend this hotel to both family and friends! Delicious food and drinks especially NAOS.

reviews.author: wanttobetheir
reviews.title: Great stay this time
reviews.text: I came back to try this resort again because I knew it could be better.  I was right. This time we paid for the allinclusive right up front. The experience was much better from the start. The service was awesome and the food great. We laid at the pool a lot, and also the beach the servers brought us the best drinks whenever they saw are glasses empty. I do have one complaint the people doing the music told us if we asked to have a song played we had to give them $20. This was bad I would have tipped them but that was overboard. The entertainment was very good but get there 1hr. early for a good seat. This hotel is very good and I will be back again. Make sure if u have a time share to pay the extra it is well worth it.  Thanks for making this stay very good.  Doug (Ut)

reviews.author: David C
reviews.title: Continuing to get better
reviews.text: I stayed in the Royal Service section for the 2nd straight year.  The service this year was even better than last year.  Our two butlers, Sergio and Erick, were great, and kept in constant communication with us in case we every needed something.  I ate at several of the restaurants and all of the food was terrific (especially Blue Agave).  I hope to enjoy many more trips at this beautiful resort.

reviews.author: Tim F
reviews.title: All to be desired!
reviews.text: I have been to this resort twice and I don't have a negative thing to say about it. I stayed in the Royal Service section both times. That section has butlers for each room, a separate eating section, and even a heated pool.

reviews.author: albyz1977
reviews.title: Top top
reviews.text:
Siamo stati nel periodo di Natale ottimo hotel...qualità del cibo ottima il servizio discreto .
Una nota negativa sul servizio alla spiaggia.....x il resto ottimo hotel con i figli. Ogni sera ci sono intrattenimenti nelle varie aree comuni. Grande scelta sulla ristorazione...

reviews.author: RJ N
reviews.title: Perfecto
reviews.text: Excelente estancia en este hotel. El servicio fue muy bueno. Las habitaciones están geniales. El hotel, en cuanto a decoración e infraestructuras, muy bien. Los restaurantes y buffet, también muy bien. Sin duda, merece la pena alojarse en este hotel durante su estancia en Cancun.

reviews.author: MLO
reviews.title: 2 week vacay
reviews.text:
This is an excellent choice for relaxing and pampering. The staff were wonderful, food was superb and very clean surroundings. The beachfront rooms are wonderful, relaxing and huge. 
The nightly shows and performances were very professional and tasteful. 

This is a big resort so there is plenty of walking to do, hopefully this is not a problem for  you. The most convenient area is closer to the pool on the beach.

reviews.author: Jair A
reviews.title: Avaliação de Hotel Paradisus Cancun  Resort e Garçons do TojiBar
reviews.text:
Instalações muito bonitas, bem organizado, com seu pessoal educado e atencioso.
Destaque especial para Christian e Efrain, garçons do Toji Bar no Paradisus Cancun Resort, dois rapazes muito agradáveis, gentis e inteligentes, que nos atenderam todas as noites, proporcionando-nos momentos agradáveis.

reviews.author: Christie B
reviews.title: Royal Service or don't bother!
reviews.text:
We just returned from our weeks stay on the Royal service side in a one bedroom suite as a couple plus one friend. This will be lengthy but honest as we travel to Cancun every year and usually stay at Riu resorts. I don't not recommend this hotel unless you are staying in Royal service or travelling as a family with small children.

Upon arrival our room was ready and it was almost what we expected. Two bathrooms, one king bed and one pull out, two balconies but no doors on the separate rooms like the photos show. The balconies are equip with one sun lounger each which we put together on the one balcony and enjoyed daily. We would order room service and lay out while waiting for it to arrive then heading down to the pool. The room was cleaned daily except for one day which I'm certain was the maids day off. We always had fresh towels and if we didn't they arrived within 5 minutes of calling, no different than any other hotel. The beds are comfortable but the pillows are small so you just have to call and order a few extra if needed. Our mini bar was stocked daily and we used several bottles of vodka in our room that was replenished daily by our butler.

The butler service was nice to have he made our reservations daily, made sure we had a bali bed reserved at the pool daily, replenished our vodka and cranberry in the room daily and retrieved ice for us. Our butler was Hector who was fabulous!!! We tipped him well on day one and day 7 because he earned it. He would catch us in the hall getting our own ice and demand we let him help and go get it. He found us at our bali bed every day to ensure we weren't in need of anything and to see if we wanted dinner reservations. He also confirmed transportation to the airport and bell boy service on our last day. He was awesome and a great help!!

The food...
As I said at the start I am used to Riu resorts. That means I'm used to huge buffets with giant fresh salad bars, endless fruits and countless choices of food from all sorts of countries. The buffet was small with minimal choices and not a lot of seating. We only ate there twice and we expected far better food according to previous reviews. I'm a huge buffet fan so this was rather disappointing. I stuck to the salad bar and the odd pasta dish. If you like seafood then this will be the right place for you. 

We ate at Blue Agave, Vento and Market Grill. Market Grill being our favourite and blue agave being our least favourite. Blue agave serves salty bland tacos with cheese on them and that's it. We added pico de gallo and gaucamole but it didn't help much. No flavour and overly salted but I found that was common in most areas...possibly because I don't use salt at home that often. The service was great though.

Vento is a tapas restaurant so you choose 6-10 different items and they come as very small portions. Most of it was average but the steak with truffled potatoes was delicious as was the onion soup. The service is very slow here so plan to spend some time waiting for food. It was average food overall. Out of 8 different selections I really enjoyed 2 and the drinks.

We ate at the Market Grill twice. The first night was ceasar salad, potatoes, vegetables and plenty of different steaks and other meats. This place is a meat lovers dream! They bring 6-8 different meats around hot off the grill and slice it at your table. You eat until your full and get seconds of everything you love. The steaks were great the first night but overcooked and some what dry the second night. The second night the sides weren't very good as they offered rice with beans, fried banana and some potato. We preferred the first nights choices and meats. Again, great service.

We ate breakfast via room service every day. Canadian Bacon is just sliced ham and the omelettes are delicious. We were happy to eat in our room every morning and the rest of the room service menu was great as well. We tried a bit of everything and the only disappointing order was the tuna sandwich as it was more like a tuna burger. The room service menu is great and they hardly every make a mistake. They forgot extra ketchup some mornings but were quick to fix it. The lady who takes the order over the phone is not very friendly and she sounds annoyed by every order. The food arrives within 30-45 minutes which I don't feel in unreasonable and it all arrives hot and with a smile. We always tipped a few dollars to whomever delivered it. 

La Palapas was delicious! This is a Royal service exclusive located by the pool and either delivered to your bali bed or you can sit at tables and watch the ocean. The guacamole and pico de gallo was my absolute favourite and the boys loved the burgers and flatbreads. I had them make the chicken wrap with guacamole and pico de gallo instead of beans and it was the most delicious creation ever. 

The royal service buffet/snack bar was lacking. The booze was great but they hardly ever had food out, usually just some lunch meat and a few buns. 

The service throughout the hotel was consistently great. All the employees say hello and ask you how your day is. The waiters are attentive at the pool and most brought more drinks without having to be asked. We always tipped a few dollars throughout the days as for quality of booze, top shelf is available when asked for. If you don't ask for it then you won't get it. I was annoyed by the avenue bar because I was told I have to pay $8usd for top shelf vodka....but every other bar it was included. Very annoying and the waitress there seemed annoyed by us asking.

The entertainment is done at the front of the avenue bar in the main building and there is little to no room. I don't even know why they bother. They constantly ask people go move out of the way so the performers can get by and then the onlookers can't see. They need to fix this.
