Even having it take place out by the pool or something would be better...anywhere with more room. We watched one show and that was it.

The royal service pool was warm and quiet, we loved it. There is a hot tub there but it is not hot...it's actually colder than the pool. I suggest making it an actual hot tub. There is also a small pool near the wedding gazebo with the beds built into it to lay out but it was also ice cold.

The main pool is crowded and cold, you can't sit comfortably at the swim up bar because the water is freezing and the sun doesn't get to the seats until late afternoon and it's very brief. The pool is also over run with small children screaming and splashing so you can't enjoy a drink without wanting to yell at a few disrespectful kids who have no regard for the people around them in the the pool. It's a large pool and the little ones don't need to hang out by the bar splashing everyone. I think all pools with swim up bars should be adult only as there is zero reason for kids to be jumping off the stools and playing around the bar. 

There was never any trouble getting chairs on the royal service side as out butler reserved us a bali bed every day and we would get 3 sun loungers with it. The regular pool you have to get up at 6am to get a chair by the pool and I'm so thankful we only had to deal with that one time. There are plenty of towels and the royal service side doesn't require towel cards so we got 6-8 towels a day for the bali bed, our sun loungers and to use after swimming. I don't know what it's like on the regular side.

The beach is huge. It's man made in cancun and I'm not sure if everyone knows that or not. So it does wash away eventually. Lots of sun loungers on the beach, just find some and pull them together. They have the umbrellas for use of drag them out near the water to be away from the crowd.

We were treated like royalty on the royal service side until our last full day when a huge group of "Power Home" employees arrived. There had to be hundreds of them and the whole hotel turned into one big advertisement for their company leaving us feeling very out of place. It was like the "regular" guests no longer mattered and we were only in the way. They reserved all the bali beds by the pool and didn't use a single one which was annoying to us who would've used one closer to the pool for the entire day. On the morning we were leaving they started blasting music at the pool via dj and 4 huge speakers at 8am waking us up well before we wanted to be and I'm sure we were not the only ones. I made a quick phone call to the royal service desk and it was quickly shut off but the damage was done and we were now wide awake. Very very annoying. We were then disturbed about 10-15 times by maids and other employees basically harassing us to leave the room well before check out time of noon so they could prepare our room for the power home people moving in that day. They had already plastered our door the day before with their tacky power home banners with the next guests names on them. It was extremely annoying to have to keep answering the door every 15 minutes as we tried to shower, pack and prepare to leave. The same maid entered our room without knocking at least 5 times. The maids also knock once and then open the door immediately without saying a word, they got a few glimpses of nudity as they invaded our privacy quite frequently that day. I found this extremely rude and uncomfortable. This happened a few other times on our trip, the employees need to knock once and wait more than 10 seconds before entering. As soon as noon hit we were bombarded with phone calls to leave the room while we waited for the bell boy to come get our luggage. The bell boy also stole $50 for one of our wallets in the time from taking the luggage from our room to the lobby. We were very turned off by how we were treated on the last two days because we weren't part of this huge power home group. I am SO glad we were leaving, after they arrived the service went completely down hill as soon as they did.

An important tip regarding the bali beds is that if you do not check in at the royal service pool by 11am then you lose your bali bed reservation and it's first come first served after that. If you don't like the bali bed assigned to you then you can switch to another come 11am, so don't sweat if you don't get a reservation as it's easy to get one come 11am. 

There is little to no nightlife at the hotel but we didn't mind as we wanted to go downtown anyway. The bars downtown are always fun but the men's washrooms are filled with drug dealers, just something to be aware of. The staff at all the nightclubs are helpful and ensure the tourists are safe. If you act stupid downtown then yes you will find trouble, just be respectful and don't get blackout drunk and you're fine. There is nothing like the nightlife of downtown cancun so no matter what hotel you stay at you have to experience it.

The location of this hotel is good, it's about 15 from the airport and 10 from the bars. $15usd cab ride to town.

The scents around the hotel are nice but some days they were really overpowering. You walk through doors sometimes and it's like a slap in the face, some days they were fine. The hotel is very clean and well maintained, it's up to date and there are always staff maintaining it. 

I wouldn't recommend this hotel on the regular side for anyone without small children. It's all young families with young kids. I would recommend the royal service side but expect to be treated like a basic peasant if they have a large group like this "power home" group show up as their money is obviously more important than the regular folk. We will continue to stay at the Riu resorts as the food and nightlife is far superior. We paid $1500 each including airfare for our trip to Paradisus but I wouldn't pay anymore for it just because of the lack of food options and the lack of activities and now they have left a bad taste in my mouth with the constant harassment on the last room to vacate the room...as well as the lack so respect for privacy some of the staff have.

We were also called each morning to come get our welcome package in the lobby which was also really annoying. I told them several times I wasn't booking excursions or buying jewelry and I had no interest in many thing else they wanted to sell me. Some days they called 3 times before 10am but I believe this was BD Travel not the hotel. But really really annoying. We never picked up the welcome package because we were so annoyed by being harassed to go get it.

Overall this hotel receives a 3.5/5 from me. I found the royal service to be great but our great impression was quickly ruined on the last two days due to being pushed aside and being treated like a nuisance once the large group of power home employees showed up. The food was average in most areas and lacking overall for options. The staff was great other than the disrespectful maid staff who disregard your privacy and just enter your room. I would suggest booking here for a large conference or the like but we will be going with Riu resorts for our future yearly vacations to Cancun.

reviews.author: Gilvander F
reviews.title: Avaliação de garçom Pool Bar
reviews.text:
Miguel Quiñones foi um garçom muito atencioso e nos serviu muito bem durante toda nossa estadia. 
Nos sentimos muito a vontade com ele.
Sentimos falta de um cardápio que nos orientasse qual o drink pedir. 
Muitos foram selecionados porque vimos com os outros tomando ou sugeridos pelo Miguel.

Obrigado Miguel! 
Gilvander Fontes Carvalho
Brasil

reviews.author: Florencia F
reviews.title: REEEEE LINDO
reviews.text: Es muy lindo hotel, el servicio es muy bueno, la gente muy amable. La comida es muy variada, hay para todos los gustos, sobre todo en lo que son los buffets. Hay shows a la noche. Es para volver y volver y volver......

reviews.author: Laynemaria
reviews.title: Adorei o hotel e todo o servico
reviews.text: Este é um daqueles hotéis em que  voce se sente como o centro das atençoes. A higiene, o conforto, a música ambiente, a qualidade da comida, a decoraçao, os detalhes na arrumaçao do quarto...tudo é excelente!  Mas um dos lugares preferidos por nos no hotel foi o TOJI BAR, nåo somente graças as muitas opçoes de deliciosas bebidas, mas pelo atendimentos de dois funcionarios: Christian e Efrain. Simplesmente fazem toda a diferença naquele bar. Såo ótimos no que fazem e nåo faltam sorrisos, gentilezas para com os clientes. Nota dez para eles!!!

reviews.author: 632tanjah
reviews.title: Awsome hotel!!
reviews.text: From a moment you check in until you check out staff at this property is just amazing. We have stayed at the Royal Service and love it. All attention, all amenities, room was just beautiful. Loved all the restaurants except Vento, food was not bad but it took to long for small portions to be served, after 1 1/2 at the restaurant and few bites I was still hungry :). Loved the Marketplace Grill and their buffet was just excelent. Overall will reccommend this hotel and will stay there again.

reviews.author: Reagan D
reviews.title: Amazing 1st time in Cancun!!
reviews.text:
My best friend and I stayed from 11/29/14-12/02/14 and we didn't want to return to the states. The facilities were awesome. We were impressed with the variety of aromatic smells we encountered walking throughout... very pleasant, almost therapeutic. 

We opted for royal service and it was the best decision ever! Hector, our butler, was very helpful and polite. The overall service surpassed our expectations. From the restaurants, cabanas, to the nightly entertainment,we enjoyed every bit of it!! 

Yhi spa steam room... very relaxing!! We decided to get a massage. If you can, treat yourself to one.

For breakfast, the first few days we grab a bite to eat in the Royal Service area, but on the last day, we decided to venture out, best decision ever. Naos is the place to go for breakfast and if you're looking for variety. Excellent food choices! 

I wish we had more time to go wind surfing, but kayaking in the afternoon was definitely a good experience.

We will definitely be back and we will bring a few friends along. Thanks Paradisus Cancun Staff!!

reviews.author: sns1
reviews.title: Nice, but not spectacular
reviews.text:
We were on a girls trip in early November...6 of us, and we did have a great time, the rooms were nice, the beach was beautiful, but there were some parts that just didn't measure up!
The food at the restaurants was mediocre, not fabulous, not terrible, but nothing to rave about...exept the nachos, guac and salsa at the mexican restaurant YUM!!.  The drinks were very strong and if thats what you are looking for you will not be dissappointed.  Bar staff were all very nice and efficient getting us drinks.  
The negatives...maybe it was the time of year, but they had no fitness classes...let me clarify they had classes on their schedule, but the first day when we went for yoga on the pool deck no one showed up to teach it.  Then went to zumba in the pool and it was literally 8 guys who claimed they wanted to be in the class... watching and commenting on the instructors body rather than allowing anyone to do the class and then the instructors cut the class after 10 minutes.  The spin cycle class no one showed up!  I know most people don't care when they are on vacation about exercise, but I do and was really excited about the opportunity to have some time to do classes...oh well.  Resort credit...what a waste, out of 6 girls not a single credit was used...they are truly a gimick and not of any value.  I have heard that at other resorts the credits are amazing.  Finally just an overall comment was that there was this sense of unhelpfullness at the resort, whether it was going to breakfast buffett and having to ask 3 times for coffee, or as we are usually use to having staff at the resorts already anticipate that we would like coffee in the morning it would be there waiting or at least have the staff ask when we sit down...we usually had to flag someone down and ask them.  Also little things, like never enough towels in the washroom, our room not being cleaned thoroghly, room service takes forever. 
Overall we had a great time, but were a little dissappointed with the food and service occassionally.  THe wifi is also horrendous. 
The Paridisus is pretty but doesn't live up to high end resort service.

reviews.author: RANJIT A
reviews.title: Like a Five Star hotel.
reviews.text: We were there for six night in all inclusive pckg. The place is so clean and beautiful and peaceful and garden type atmosphere. We were four couples in Jr Deluxe Ocean view suit. The room is spacious and clean. The best part of all was the people(employee) were very courteous and helpful. Another great part was  the food in all the restaurants and the buffet was excellent. We enjoy every thing. The restaurant did not required the reservation so just walk-in type. The weather was great everyday in low 80's except it rain one day which gave us to visit the town for shopping. All the waiter at the pool bar and around the pool were attentive all time. Couple of the night show was great but can be more variety shows. We will go back again.

reviews.author: Marysol L
reviews.title: AMAZING BIRTHDAY VACATION IN CANCUN (PARADISUS CANCUN ROYAL SERVICE)
reviews.text: I had an AMAZING visit to Cancun just last week (arrived on November 22nd).  I stayed in the Royal Service section of Paradisus Cancun and it was AMAZING and WELL WORTH the upgrade!!!  My suite was extremely spacious and view was captivating!!!  I want to thank my mayordomo (butler) Ivan for making my birthday vacation absolutely wonderful and memorable!!!  All of the hotel staff were exceptional; I wanted for nothing!!! There are a total of 9 restaurants to choose from and during my stay, reservations were not necessary (with the exception of Tempo (which is at an extra cost)).  Tempo was absolutely AMAZING - I had my birthday dinner there (opted for the 8-course wine pairing tasting dinner).  I also dined at Bana, Vento, Fuego, Palapa, Market Grill and Naos and the food at each place was delicious!  Drinks are premium and NOT watered down!  Live entertainment was FUN at Avenue Bar... There is a different show scheduled each night.  If you want an amazing getaway, book your stay at Paradisus Cancun today!!!!

reviews.author: Mesja
reviews.title: Perfect!
reviews.text:
I have worked here and I have stayed as a guest.  I love the place from top to toe.  There is this ham/gruyere/cream cheese pastry puff turn over in the Deli that you will love! 

This hotel used to be Melia Cancun and now is Paradisus, a different brand from the same chain.  I love it here, the pool area is so relaxing and the view is breathtaking.  The grounds are well groomed, the foyer is impeccable and everything is nice, clean and perfect.

I loved it here! :D

reviews.author: Jorge F
reviews.title: SUPER RECOMENDABLE
reviews.text: es un hotel que no le falta nada para pasarla bien, les recomiendo la torre principal en los pisos a partir del 6 , no se siente nada de bulla de noche. el servicio es de primera categoría. lo que le falta es un poco de shows, animaciones para ser completo

reviews.author: Jesika A
reviews.title: Paradisus is really PARADISE!
reviews.text: Such a beautiful hotel, from the moment you walk in you will be blown away! The decor is beautiful and the atmosphere is so relaxing! Food at the restaurants were very good and the beach is GORGEOUS! I would definitely recommend this hotel. You won't go wrong with this hotel! First time in Cancun and when I go back I wouldn't mind staying here!

reviews.author: Cinthia S
reviews.title: Perfección
reviews.text:
Hay muchas opciones para comer dentro del hotel y todo es delicioso. La pisicina exterior es climatizada una delicia nadar en ella!

La playa muy limpia y grande, incluso me encontré una pequeña tortuga. ¡Súper!

Las habitaciones espaciosas y con balcón. 

El servicio es muy bueno, Muy recomendado para viajar en familia o para descansar!!!

reviews.author: Iryna B
reviews.title: Excelente!!!
reviews.text:
Perfecto en todos los aspectos: comodidad, playa, habitaciones,  restaurantes, Royal Service con muchissimos detalles que te ayudan relajarse y despreocuparse.
Los empleados del resort muy atentos y amables. 
Fue una experiencia inolvidable.

reviews.author: Richard B
reviews.title: Fantastic service and very relaxing experience!
reviews.text: We had a group for a birthday and stayed in the Royal Service area of the hotel.  It was great.  The facility is very nice, we enjoyed being on the ground floor and found it very easy to get around.  The beach is beautiful and the thatch umbrellas provide great shade.  The waiter service extends to the beach as well.  The pool and bali beds were excellent particularly if you want to stay out of the sun some of the time.  You could stay on the bali bed all day and only get up to go to the bathroom!  They bring you drinks and food and you never go long without being asked if you need something.  Michael at the pool was the best waiter ever!  With the Royal Service you get a butler who is there to take care of whatever you can come up with!  Hervik was excellent and our group put him through the paces.  He was a perfect professional even when our group got crazy after some drinks.  This was a great relaxing vacation for us.  We stayed for a week and never left the resort!

reviews.author: JZ M
reviews.title: Looking forward to going back
reviews.text: We've been to Paradisus Cancun at least five times using a friend's timeshare and are already looking forward to going back next year.  The place is beautiful and has several pools, in addition to the wonderful beach.  However, it might not be a good option for anyone who has problems walking, because things are so spread out. All personnel are friendly and helpful.  Very comfortable bed. We've never opted for the-inclusive, but it seems that most guests do.  The breakfast buffet is amazing and, for the first time, we ordered room service for a late dinner.  Surprised that it was reasonably priced.  Buses run frequently, and it's an easy ride to nearby malls and the Negro market and a huge grocery store. Only two minor complaints:  the balcony lights go on and off automatically, so we were unable to turn them off; music too loud around the pool.

reviews.author: Klozer
reviews.title: Top Notch
reviews.text:
We really, really enjoyed our stay. It is costly, but very beautiful. Our room was amazing with views of the ocean. The food was good. The atmosphere was awesome. 
The service was not so good at the bar or in the restaurant. It was actually shocking how poor the service was, because of how nice the hotel is. It didn't seem to match. They servers moved at a snails pace.

reviews.author: jaredcharlesc
reviews.title: A great weekend trip
reviews.text: The staff was helpful and friendly, The entire resort was clean and well kept, Most of the food was very well made, however I did not care for the quality of the food at the sushi bar. Have a great time!

reviews.author: netoche
reviews.title: No me alcanzan las estrellas!!
reviews.text: Fué una experiencia maravillosa hospedarme en este hotel, desde el check in muy amable, atento y elegante, el royal service es incomparable, las instalaciones son preciosas, la comida en todos sus restaurantes deliciosisima, la playa y las albercas muy bonitas, las bebidas de primer nivel, volveré feliz a este hotel las veces que pueda!!!

reviews.author: Noori B
reviews.title: MONEY STOLEN FROM ROOM- USE SAFE!
reviews.text:
The hotel, view, and location are all gorgeous! So beautiful.
Unfortunately, money ($180.00) was stolen out of our room from a friends purse the FIRST day of our stay. Room service came in the evening ( around 730pm) and we suspect they were the culprits. No other days did room service come in the evening.
When we reported the incident to Security, 3 men searched our room for 3 hours and the head of security made up a bogus story saying our friend left the room door open and had to be escorted to the room in the middle of the night because she was so drunk( which was not the case AT ALL). It was convenient for him to tell us this story AFTER the money went missing. 
USE THE SAFE AT ALL TIMES! nothing valuable should be left out. 

The food available at the resort outside by the pool was okay- but the hamburgers gave me food poisoning. Be careful with eating the meat that has been sitting out in the sun and not cooked properly. 

The bartenders called us "Borrachitas"! No bueno.

reviews.author: shannon1278
reviews.title: Thanksgiving abroad
reviews.text: We all wanted a quick getaway from our hometown in Southern Florida and found ourselves at the Melia aka Paradisus.  We all opted for the "royal" treatment and SOOOOOO glad we did!!  Screaming children and babies in strollers are not considered a vacation in our eyes.  The royal "wing" of the complex leaves all that rifraf far behind!  Between the four of us we had 3 ocean balcony rooms and all were exceptionally nice.  We smoked a respectable Cuban cigar and enjoyed lovely sunsets all without the noise of college kids/teens/ and toddlers.  Just a great place!

reviews.author: ellen c
reviews.title: Hurricane Odile'd from CABO...
reviews.text:
AWESOME!!!!! The most relaxed vacation EVER!!!!! Food was AMAZING at every resturaunt!!!!!!
Service was beyond good!!!!!
We spend most of our time on the beach and our waiter, Miguel, took such good care of us, you'd've thought we were his only "clients'!
The rest of the week our beach waitress and new friend, LAURA, just added more sunshine to our day.  She was an absolute delight to see very day! Her smile and diligence, were out of this world!!!!!!!
Loved the nightly shows!!!
I am hoping to take my entire family to Paradisus Cancun!!!! It truly was paradise!!!!!

reviews.author: Danielle W
reviews.title: A friendcation that we will never forget!!!
reviews.text:
My friends and I (ages 29-31, men and women) booked a vacation for 8 of us.  We were at the Paradisus from Wednesday, November 5th to Tuesday, November 11th. We had a great time!  We stayed in the Royal Service pyrimid 5.  It is the only way to stay - the adult only aspect is great! The royal service is awesome -- We had 3 rooms - Lagoon views for all.  We didnt mind, since we were really in the rooms to sleep and shower.  The lower level floors have ALOT more space than the higher level floors.  2 of the rooms on the first floor had a whole extra sitting/living room area besides the bed area.   The 3rd room was on the 5th floor, and they had alot smaller space.  Since it is a pyramid, the higher rooms have less space, but a little better views. Overall it wasnt bad by any means though... the larger rooms we liked Since we were splitting rooms, we didnt feel "on-top" of each other.  We had a great time, but we did notice some pro's and cons.

Pro's:
1) The resort itself is amazing! beautiful - both pool, beach and inside areas.  The smell that many people mentioned as a negative comments below, was not an issue for any of us.  We loved it! 
2) Fransico Terrazas, our pool server for the week was AMAZING!!!!!!!!! He made the experience and unforgetable one.  He was so personal, happy and all around great guy!  Not sure what we would do without him.  He made this trip unforgetable! 
3) Mole Restaurant - Delicious!!!!!  One of the better meals we had here. 
4) Our check-in and check-out experience was great! very easy and they pamper you since you are in the royal service. 
5) The bar and food avalibility in the Royal Service
6) All the views inside the hotel and outside the hotel.  It was all awesome! 

Cons:
1) Becuase we were a group going to some of the dinners - they always wanted us to do the "group order". Which means the waiter chooses some of the things off the menu and brings it all out.  We didnt like this at all, b/c we didnt know what we were eating half the time.  For example: Blue Agave - the taco/mexican restaurant.  Since we didnt know any better the waiter brought out a bunch of different types, and since we didnt know what half of them were, we werent sure what we would like and didnt like.  We are the kind of group who likes certain things and not others - we would have prefered for each of us to order our own 3 items, rather than them choosing for us.  
2) You wait a LONG time in some of the restaurants for your food.  Market Street grill for lunch - is not worth the wait.  They do have good items, but our experience, the food took way to long. 

Food Wise:
The better restaurants:
-Mole, Vento and Fuego. These were delicous! 
-The omlettes at the buffet for breakfasts were awesome! Buffet overall was pretty good! 

Not so great restaurants:
-Blue Agave (lower end taco/quasidella/ etc).  Not great food, and for mexico, not great mexican food.
-Tempo (sushi/japaense in the middle of tower 3).  Great aumbiance - one of the prettier restaurants, but some of food was not good at all. 

Overall - we had a wonderful time, i wish we were back right now! 
thank you paradisus cancun for your hospitality - and showing us a great time in Cancun (which some of us had never been before!)

reviews.author: meyjo82
reviews.title: Dream Wedding and Vacation!
reviews.text:
Hello, Everyone! I just wanted to tell you about my experience at the Paradisus Cancun in beautiful Cancun, Mexico. My husband and I got married here, and I wanted to express my gratitude and amazement with the resort, the staff, and of course, the outstanding romance department at this hotel. If you're searching for potential resorts to hold your destination wedding, or just to have a special vacation, this is the place to do it! There's a reason why so many weddings are held here. These people know what they're doing! And they're so nice and professional about everything, too. I thought this review would be helpful for brides since I, myself, had also searched for reviews like the one I'm writing now! I'm going to organize this review into two parts--the wedding and the vacation. :)

1.) The Wedding:

This resort has a wedding planning department in the US that is based out of Miami, FL. Bianca was the planner who helped us with all the details before arrival at the resort. Response time was fast via email (usually one business day, and they are also easy to reach by phone), and she was incredibly helpful, polite, patient, and informative; we absolutely loved working with her. The same goes for Francis, the representative who helped us reserve the wedding block for our rooms. Laura, from Alquimia Events, helped us with our decor; she is amazing and will ensure that your wedding looks beautiful and just the way you'd like it. 
When we arrived at the resort, we met with Lorena, our on-site wedding coordinator. During our meeting, she answered all of our questions, went over all the details, times, decor, menus--basically, a run-down of all wedding details. She walked us over to the locations where our wedding and reception were to be held. She was lovely in every way and worked so hard to make everything easy for us. She was with us the entire time, was readily available, professional, made sure that everything and everyone was in the right place at the right time, and really took care of us while we were there. Esther, from the romance department, was super sweet and helpful as well. We loved working with all these wonderful people!

For music, we used companies that work with the resort. Our awesome DJ and MC, Carlos from JSAV, who provided the music for our cocktail hour and reception, as well as Pedro Sampler, who provided our instrumental music during the ceremony (the guests loved all the music throughout the event) played a big role in making our day very special! They fulfilled all of our requests and were so accommodating. 

I know that it can be a bit nerve-wracking to try to plan your dream wedding from afar, but you will definitely be in good hands at the Paradisus Cancun! Thank you, Paradisus, from the bottom of our hearts!!

2.) The Vacation

I LOVE Mexico. This was my fifth time in Mexico, third time in Cancun, and this resort is the best one I've been to. One of our guests who had been to other resorts like this one said the same thing. It's beautiful and gigantic! The service is excellent and is what sets this place apart from others! If questions or concerns do arise, they take care of them promptly and professionally. Wherever you go in the hotel, it smells like flowers (it may seem like an odd thing to mention, but this place smells awesome!!). And the beach...wow...the beach is pristine with soft, white sand (wish we were still there!). The food is good, and I have to say that I was pleasantly surprised! There are also several restaurants to choose from and so much variety (Japanese, Mediterranean, Mexican, Brazilian BBQ, a taco bar, etc).

There are two nightclubs inside the hotel, a blue and purple lounge area where they do shows on certain nights (the shows are actually entertaining!), and a red lounge where there is dancing. I've been to hotels in Mexico where there are nightclubs inside, but the music here is better, and the vibe is more fun! 

Also, this resort is kid-friendly. There is a kid's play area inside the hotel as well. 

We opted for the Royal Service, which costs more, but I'm glad that we did it. Our personal butler, Sergio, showed us to our room and made sure that all of our needs were met. He was also able to get a spare room for us to use on our wedding day! He checked on us regularly to make sure if there was anything else he could do to make us more comfortable. Again, great service!

If you go with Royal Service, be sure to read through the pamphlet they give you on everything that is offered with that service (there's quite a bit of fun extras that are included, and you don't want to accidentally miss out on anything, i.e., the two cabana bed reservations with your stay, scented pilllows from their pillow menu, access to the spa, a make-your-own cocktail station with premium liquor, etc). They'll go over all of that with you when they check you in, of course, but we were so excited about the wedding and the trip that I couldn't remember what they'd told us. :)

Regardless of what service you choose, though, you'll have a great stay here. All of our guests complimented this place over and over during our time here. We will be back for sure!! :)

reviews.author: tracydeneenh
reviews.title: Awesome experience
reviews.text: Waited on constantly. Food great. Best trip yet.room very nice and clean. Had an upgrade to ocean view which was awesome. Close to airport and downtown.  Pool and lounges great . Will definitely visit here again

reviews.author: djr007
reviews.title: Nice but Disappointed !
reviews.text: Hotel was beautiful.staff was great. Food quality and selection was probably the worst I have had on all my Mexican Trips. Buffet was sad. Main restaurants small portions. Quality average at best. Our last night stay we went without dinner because we choose to watch a show and when we arrived at the restaurant around 9:30 they would not seat us.that was very disappointing. Definatly  not the "Royal Service" treatment we paid extra for. Alcohol quality very good. Need a "main bar" to gather at with friends.  As big as the hotel is it lacks Bar space. If your a couple traveling alone it will work for you. Larger group, not so good.

reviews.author: Phil R
reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text:
My wife and I just returned from our one week stay.  The hotel and surroundings are beautiful.  The staff is also wonderful and accommodating.  We wanted to especially recognize Jesus, one of the waiters at the pool bar.  He catered to our every request and was an especially nice person.  I would definitely recommend this hotel!

Phil

reviews.author: Fauco
reviews.title: Segunda visita - Hotel esta melhor ainda
reviews.text: Visitei pela primeira vez em maio/14, e agora novamente em outubro/14. Esse hotel esta cada vez mais  surpreendente. O atendimento, a limpeza, o clima agradável e relaxante que o hotel oferece, os deliciosos restaurantes, o quarto confortável , a area de lazer incrivel e claro, a praia paradisiaca completa um bem estar incrivel. Recomendo a caisais, famillia e solteiros.

reviews.author: beerman
reviews.title: The golf course
reviews.text: This will be just a short review of the Par 3, 9 hole golf course located in the front of the Resort  which I am sure will be helpful to others. To begin with each hole is approximately 100 yards so the amount of clubs you need is minimal. I carried a pitching wedge a sand wedge and a putter. The course was in relatively good shape the greens were very true but could use a trim. There is no charge to play but I believe there is a charge to rent clubs, they give you a very large bag with a full set of irons....why??. there is no dress code, no club house , no score card and no reason to make a time, but they do have 3 sets of marker tees very close to each other. All in all we enjoyed ourselves . Each morning at 9 am we would play a round which would last about an hour or so then onward to the pool.

reviews.author: piedy2014
reviews.title: Increible hotel
reviews.text:
Todos los servicios del hotel están destinados al cliente, por y para su comfort. 
Gran variedad en las comidas, con productos de primera calidad.Las habitaciones espaciosas con terraza  privada y un baño bien distribuido
Fueron unos días de playa ...... Inolvidables.

reviews.author: Johnny H
reviews.title: My 50th Birthday Celebration
reviews.text: The hotel was so nice and lots of restaurants, the Private restaurant (Michelin star chef) was perfect for my Birthday party!  Our butler was amazing (request hime, Hervik) and our pool waiters Francisco MIcheal and Francisco Terrazas were never far away with non-stop attention everyday we were there (7 days).  The stay was so nice we are thinking about taking a quick weekend trip in the coming 6 months.

reviews.author: Clarice C
reviews.title: Perfeito !!!
reviews.text:
Hotel excelente em todos os aspectos. Comida muito boa, ótimos drinks, praia maravilhosa, tudo muito lindo. Atendimento dos funcionários é nota 10. 
Tem muitas atividades para fazer dentro do próprio hotel, recomendo e inclusive pretendo voltar um dia !!!

reviews.author: Shelly G
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: This trip with my girlfriends was absolutely fabulous. The staff was very accommodating, facilities very nice, food tasted great and had a wide variety, entertainment was wonderful. I couldn't have asked for a better place!

reviews.author: Gemma
reviews.title: Nice hotel...but our room flooded!!
reviews.text:
I visited the hotel with my boyfriend in October for 8 nights. First impressions...hotel looks impressive as driving up, nice lobby/check in area. Check in was very smooth and quick as we arrived at 11pm on the evening. Bell boy brought our luggage up swifty. The next morning we had card posted through the door, saying a lady called Rose had missed us on check in and she had a 'free gift' for us and that we were to go and see her. I think this was a timeshare ploy so we just ignored it.

Room: We opted for deluxe lagoon view. We were located in room 3625 - main building, 6th floor. Room was fine, nice comfy bed. We had to sleep with our air-con on every night to drown out the sound from Red Lounge blasting its music out until 2am. Maid visited daily to clean the room and also on an evening for turndown service. There was only 1 sun lounger on the balcony which was strange as it was a room for 2 people...it didnt matter to us as we didnt use the balcony during our stay. Bathroom was a good size, bath plug did not work - we had to stuff a flannel in the plug hole so we could have a soak. On our second to last day a huge storm hit, when we woke up the next morning the rooms floor was totally soaked everywhere, approx 0.5cm high. Our suitcases were soaking!! We caught the maid outside & she quickly cleaned the water up. We heard that it happened to alot of room around the resort. Surely if its a place prone to heavy rainfall they would have better seals on the balcony doors?!

Resturants: In my opinion, there was plenty of choice for everyones taste. Only place open for breakfast & lunch was Naos - an international buffet style resurant, lots of different food choices. Only complaint about this is sometimes dishes would be on the cold side. Our favourate resturant was Bana - a japanese sushi resturant. We ate here twice during our trip. Beautiful surroundings and great food!! On our 1st visit we found our waiter very obliging (think he was called Leo), he explained everything to us. On the second visit we had a different waiter and service was very sloppy, although he only had 3 tables to wait on!! We also ate at Feugo - a Peruvian themed resturant. Service and food were very good. Vento - a tapas resturant. Again, food and service was A+.   Blue Agave - a taco cantina. We chose to eat here before a night out downtown as we didnt want anything too heavy. Good food & service too. The worst resturant we visited was Market Grill. We got sat down and had counters placed on our table - one side green, the other red. We guessed it was similar to a resturant we know in the UK. No-one explained the concept to us. We had to ask one of the waiters for drinks after we had been sat 10mins without anyone noticing us. The waiters then came round with meats, salads, potatoes and veg (approx 5 mins apart for each other). The concept of the resturant is good but it just did not work when we visited. We constantly had an empty plate and was thinking of leaving and going to another resturant. We ate at Mole on our last night - Mexican resturant. Service was fantastic and food was really good too.

Bars: We used the pool bar during the day...Christian, Julian & Efrain were great fun and always ready to make up great tasting cocktails. We used Avenue Bar & Toji Bar on an evening...no complaints, bar staff very polite and accomadating. We didnt use Red Lounge during our stay - it was booming with loud music until 2am every night though.

Pool area: Good sized pool areas. Plenty of sun loungers - make sure youre down before 10ish if you want a lounger with a parasol. People tended to 'claim' sun loungers with their towels before heading for breakfast. Activities were a bit hit & miss. My boyfriend wanted to participate in beach soccer & volleyball...some days they would play as advertised, others they wouldnt play at all. On the 1st day we went to get a towel & the guy asked for towel cards...these were not given to us at check in. It wasnt a problem, he asked for our room number & gave us the towels. Upon return, he gave us 2 towel cards. 

Beach: Lovely beach, no problem getting a sun lounger with a parasol. Waiters on the beach very fast, always asking if you would like more drinks. 

Overall, Paradisus is a nice hotel. Many lovely staff whom are ready to help you. There was just a few issues which had let us down. Next time we return to Cancun i will be trying a different hotel.

reviews.author: robert m
reviews.title: Great hotel and staff
reviews.text:
We stayed here when the weather could have been better. We stayed with another family and had a great week. The tooms are modern and the ones facing the sea have great views. On an all inclusive stay you can use nearly all of the restaurants. Ibana a sushi restaurant and the Market Grill stand out. The hotel restaurant Naos has wn incredibly varied and high quality buffet. 

The evening entertainments were variable and were aimed more at a younger audience.

There are several pools all of which overlook the sea and the beach has space for football and volleyball. 

When it rains the windows facing the sea do leak as does the hotel which was clearly built for sunshine. 

We really enjoyed the very well equipped gym.

reviews.author: Greg S
reviews.title: First Class Place
reviews.text: This is a first class place from the great food,clean rooms, and awesome service. We played the par 3 golf course and was lot's of fun. Beaches clear water and clean sand. The pools are my favorite part to this place. We will be back.

reviews.author: 874Lisa
reviews.title: Just another resort
reviews.text:
PRO's:  Beautiful beach and good location.
CONS:  Didn't get the room we paid for, mini-bar was only stocked if we left a tip, food was fair at best, hotel smelled overly strong like perfume, TV sound didn't always work, alarm clock was wired into the wall, not plugged in, and went off during varies hours of the night.  Only one lounge chair on balcony that they said they would get us another but never did. Bali beds are a joke.  You have to PAY to use them and almost all of them were empty.  The 1500 resort credit is also a scam.  It is not like the Palace resort credit that you can actually use it for activities.  Would definately not recommend this resort except for the beautiful  beach.

reviews.author: Cecilia O
reviews.title: Excelente hotel!
reviews.text: Fuimos en grupo de 12 personas y el hotel estuvo excelente ... Nos dieron nuestras habitaciones antes del check in correspondiente y nos ofrecieron el servicio de Royal Service y fue de lo mejor ... La atención en la playa fue demasiado bueno, de lujo realmente!

reviews.author: Moira e
reviews.title: Fantastic Holiday
reviews.text: My partner and I returned last week from a 2 weeks stay along with 2 other couples. We cannot fault the hotel at all, the staff the food the service was all first class. We did not do Royal Service and we found the service to be excellent. The pool waiting staff were just fab.  We had no problems getting tables in the restaurants and we would defiantly recommend this hotel to others

reviews.author: Rafaela U
reviews.title: Literalmente o paraiso na terra
reviews.text: O hotel eh perfeito, a alimentacao incrivel tem muitas opções de gastronomias diferentes para todos os gostos, todos os funcionarios estao tentando antecipar  as suas necessidades para fazer com que a sua estada seja perfeita, e a minha foi.

reviews.author: Luz C
reviews.title: Gran decepción
reviews.text:
Es un fraude, pagamos por un cuarto para tres personas, y nos dan un cuarto con dos camas y un sofá cama súper incómodo.
La señal wifi pésima, la limpieza del cuarto muy tarde, la caja fuerte no funcionó nunca, las toallas insuficientes, un pomito de shampoo de 40cc para tres mujeres que van a la playa y a la piscina, el desagüe de la ducha roto, y finalmente el gerente de la noche se molesta porque reclamamos , vulnerando nuestros derechos, a pesar de que el pago ha sido por adelantado.
Es terrible, un robo, una estafa, hotel 5 estrellas, ¿por donde?
Estamos indignadas.

reviews.author: Michael R
reviews.title: Great stay at Paradisus
reviews.text: We were there Oct 3-8 and had such great service I felt I should write it up. Bartenders Raphael and Christian at the swim-up bar and at Coco's Bar on the beach were the best. They were happy to see us every time, very attentive to whatever we need, always remembered us and our drinks and seemed genuinely sad to see us go. The service at this resort is the best I've had and this was my 8th different all-inclusive. The resort is beautiful but it's the people that make it great. Additional kudos go out to all the staff at the Market Grill. I've never seem service so attentive as that. Thanks everyone for a great stay,

reviews.author: 345Dansa321
reviews.title: Really enjoyed it
reviews.text:
Just four nights but found the hotel a treat to be in. Food was good all-inclusive food, meaning not great, not bad. Found we preferred the buffet best as you had some control over what looks good.
Royal Service is a must, as is the adult only sections of the hotel

reviews.author: Sue630
reviews.title: Royal Service 9/27-10/8
reviews.text:
Royal Service Staff excellent
Butler Very Good
Ocean front suite outstanding
Adult beverage service outstanding
Royal room treats outstanding 
Royal small bites inside good
Royal pool service outstanding
Royal pool outstanding
Royal ocean front breakfast and dinner very good, always willing to please
Tempo tasting menu: service outstanding, food very good, pricey
Mole very good
Fuego very good
Buffet good
Paradisus location, excellent
Bus safe and timely
Shows at 8:30, superior
Weather 11.5 days of sun out of 12

reviews.author: Matthew P
reviews.title: Read many reviews before going, my synopsis
reviews.text:
I did a lot of research before going. We just got back from a 5 day trip and had a great time. I will highlight the areas that I was warned through reviews about.The resort is only 15 minutes from the airport, you are greated and your bags are taken away. Inside it is a massive pyramid with vines hanging from each level. There are Koy ponds and an Asian restaurant called Bana that has it's tables hidden throughout trees and walkways.The smell that everyone speaks of does hit you, but only when you come in from the outside. Around the grounds and in your room, you do not smell it. 

You are then ushered into a lounge where you check in and receive your braclet. They offer the royal treatment and explain about the restaurants. To our suprise, they changed the reservation system, not once did we have to make one. It might just be for off peak season, but it was nice not to have to get up early to make a reservation. There was also little or no pressure for time shares. You see the desks around the lobby, but they don't hound you. The elavators smelled really bad, so bad that we never used them.

The room was nice, nothing amazing. We were in tower 3 and did not hear much outside noise from the lobby at night. AC worked, safe worked, only 1 lounger on the balcony, but never used it.

The pool was great, not very packed, it is deep, 5 feet 9 inches. Never had trouble with chairs, off season helped with that. No much shade, we all got burned bad. Bartenders were great along with walk around servers. Towel system was easy, never had any issues.

The beach is amazing, the huts with lounge chairs are perfect for shade. There is a good amount of seaweed, but they come around and clean it up. The water is nice and blue, waves can be very strong. There are also rip currents that can be very dangerous, life guards were on top of it.

We tried 4 different restaurants not including the buffet. The buffet is amazing for breakfast and lunch. Everything was fresh and the varity was very good. The first night we went to Mole, service was great, food was bland. We sat in the wine room, the funny part is that there were only 2 types of wine. The second night we went to Fuego, the food was great, the service was awful. We arrived at 8:30, seated at 8:45, at 9 we had no menus or water, at 9:05 we poured our own water, at 9:30 we got our drinks and ordered, at 10 we got bread and our apatizers, at 10:45 we got dinner, at 11:15 we got desert and at 11:40 we were told the restraurant closed at 11 and were asked to leave. The third night we went to the market grill. We had already tried it for lunch one day for burgers. At night it is a Brazillian steak house. We had 10 people and from sitting down to walking out, it took 35 minutes. A huge change from the night before, it is a well oiled service machine. They come first with salads, and then potatos and corn. Next the meat comes: chicken, turkey wrapped in bacon, beef, lamb, and sausage. Everything was amazing. The last night, Blueagave was closed and the sushi place didn't apeal to a few of our friends so we went to Tempo? There are two that sound exactly alike, but this was the one by the buffet in tower 4 that you did not have to pay extra for. It is tapas style, with 3 small crustinis to start, then 4 entrees and then 4 deserts. This or Fuego was the best meal as far as taste.

Entertainment was good, we saw the Michael Jackson and the dance show. Both were really good. They also had casino night, which was cool for about 15 minutes. 

Overall, we would easily come back. Compared to other places we have stayed, this was easily the best. I feel off season helped with many of the prior reviewed complaints.

reviews.author: LisaJ002
reviews.title: Abs amazing
reviews.text:
I cannot say ANYTHING bad about this place.Says it in the name Paradise…..went on a girly holiday and paid for Royal Service,gees didn't we feel like Royalty,as soon as ,on arrival you get assigned your butler in the sumptuous surroundings, the smell as soon as you step in the hotel was amazing ,I even asked if I could buy it in an oil or burner!! Our butler was the best…Hector,he was always wanting to help us and gave us first class service ,it was sad to say bye to him and he even gave us a present!
We tried all the restaurants as Hector booked for us and were amazing ,the staff were always professional and helpful.Our fav was definitely Tempo ,which you have to pay a supplement as it is by a Michelin Chef,well it was worth every $,you MUST go ,sadly we went on our last night to make it special but was offered a different menu just for us if we wanted to go again but couldn't as we were leaving ,we are all in the industry and couldn't fault it ,it really was an experience!
I could go on and on about this Hotel,even the tours(booked in the office by reception Expedia,Teresa and Efren(think thats how its spelt)gave us amazing service and a fab deal on diving ,snorkelling and Coco Bongos trips ,so book all trips there and they will discount! Coco Bongos and Senior frogs was amazing night out to,like Vegas in Mexico!
Ok well I can't wait to return and I can't stop telling everyone about how amazing it was,lots of pictures ,couldn't take a bad picture,even my friends say how nice my pictures are!!! 
Miss the place already….they need to bottle that smell….oh go to the Spa (free in RService)sooo releasing if you need to be ANY more relaxed!!

reviews.author: 2102olga
reviews.title: Хороший отель
reviews.text: Отдыхали в сентябре 2014, в целом отель понравился, однако мелочи многочисленные несколько окрасили. Началось с того, что на момент заселения  заказанного  номера не оказалось в наличии, появился он только через неделю!, переселились в разгар отдыха. Нашего мажордома Эрика видели пару раз,  рестораны, лежаки приходилось  резервировать самим. Да, это все происходило в корпусе 5 (королевский сервис). В остальном все на твердею 4.

reviews.author: Yudy Andrea C
reviews.title: excelente
reviews.text: Muy buen servicio y recomendaría el hotel y el destino para descanso, plan para parejas, familiar, y de negocios. Estuve muy Bien atendida y sin duda volvería a visitar este hotel, el servicio es excelente y las instalaciones de lujo además de su ambiente

reviews.author: lhtdmuller
reviews.title: Lo que esperaba!
reviews.text: Me hospedé apenas la semana pasada y aunque el clima no fue bueno los primeros días, salió el sol y todo fue excelente. Es un hotel muy grande con muchas opciones de alimentos y bebidas, albercas y una playa hermosa. Olvidé el nombre de la señora que nos atendió en la playa pero fue excelente, una muy buena actitud y siempre sonriendo al traernos las bebidas. El ambiente en el bar de la alberca principal es muy grato y los cantineros son muy divertidos. Sin duda regresaría a Paradisus Cancún.

reviews.author: karol_guerra
reviews.title: Muito Bom!!!
reviews.text:
Estive em Julho neste hotel e foram dias maravilhosos. Muitas atrações e perfeito para família. Várias piscinas, restaurantes e praia exclusiva. 
Um café da manhã fantástico, o melhor omelete que já comi... 
Mas deixou a desejar apenas na reserva dos restaurantes. O tempo é muito curto e, normalmente, já estão tudo cheios. É muito difícil conseguir vaga. 
Em resumo, um ótimo lugar para descansar e também para badalar (pois tem uma balada lá dentro).

reviews.author: Dafne V
reviews.title: Un Paraiso
reviews.text:
Encantada con la amabilidad y disponibilidad de los colaboradores del hotel. Los restaurantes fueron excelentes, sobretodo Vento y la atención del mesero Victor! Cuánta dedicación para con los huéspedes.
La habitación muy cómoda, en general las instalaciones permitieron disfrutar al máximo de tan paradisíaco destino.
La tienda de souvenirs fue excelente, precios muuuy cómodos, totalmente recomendado, es mejor que comprar en las tiendas artesanales.

reviews.author: VIVIANE T
reviews.title: Viagem dos Sonhos!!
reviews.text:
Estive em Abril de 2014 neste hotel, foram dias inesquecíveis...Comida de ótima qualidade e variada, bebidas inclusas de boa qualidade, funcionários receptivos.O quarto tem uma vista maravilhosa, é amplo e confortável!
A área da piscina é muito boa, grande e os atendentes muito gentis, a praia é uma maravilha, enfim, dias pra relembrar ...Super indico este hotel!!

reviews.author: Barbara W
reviews.title: Experience Paradisus Cancun...
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel and property! The staff were more than helpful and professional. For the price, one can't find a more beautiful and inviting place to stay for rest, relaxation, and recharging. Exceptional value and wonderful experience!

reviews.author: dicto49
reviews.title: Fantastique!
reviews.text:
Voyage fait en janvier 2014, 4 adultes, 2 semaines. Nous avons fait environ une dizaine de tout-inclus depuis 8 ans, et c'est de loin le meilleur, particulièrement en ce qui concerne la nourriture. Bien sûr il faut y mettre le prix... 
Le service aussi est à souligner, personnel très attentionné. Un merci spécial à notre serveuse Libertad, à L'Avenue Bar, et à Jesus et Natanael au Market Grill, qui se sont vraiment démarqués par leur accueil et leur bonne humeur. 
Y retournerions-nous? Sans aucun doute, si le budget le permet...

reviews.author: Brandon W
reviews.title: First Class Service w/ Lifetime Memories!
reviews.text:
From the very first greeting to the very last goodbye, not a beat was missed during my recent stay at the Paradisus Cancun. A vacation trip for my friends birthday, we selected this hotel after a very lengthy search. They had a wonderful deal we just couldn't pass--including 30% off the total stay, the ability to partake in their Royal Service option and all inclusive. 

We were greeted by multiple staff at once, rushing to our sides to take our bags and place a drink in our hands. Shortly after three shots of top shelf tequila, we were whisked away to the Royal Service check in area which is where we met our butler for the stay, Leyner. Great, amazing and remarkable are all words which fall short of describing Leyner's service. He set up our resort restaurant bookings, bali bed bookings, overseen staff in the cleaning of our rooms and even spoiled us with numerous bottles of champagne and bottles of tequila as parting gifts. Need I say more? Leyner, you are the man!!!

Our visit was during the low season, so pretty quiet all around with very few kids. The weather forecast mentioned it would storm our entire stay, but we were greeted by rain for roughly 10-20 mins a couple of days--more sunshine than clouds, no complaints really. 

Pros: The Royal Service is a must! It's only a few more dollars more than the other resort options, which includes access to the Royal Service adult only area (bali beds, special poolside food menu, adult only beach area). The Royal Service flatbread pizza with shrimp?! Ahhhh-mazing. You also get a phone to keep in touch with your personal butler. If they're not available, you can dial any of the others to assist you. Mole restaurant is also a high to-do. They had an amazing lamb taco dish. Also, The Market Grill and their Brazilian style set up is just... superb! Aromatic pillows, Thierry Mugler toiletries.

Cons: Blue Agave and Fuego were the two restaurant options I would avoid. Blue Agave is a taco-based restaurant. The soup tasted like Dasani water and the taco's lacked any flavor or seasoning, bland overall. Fuego is their asian-inspired offering, which features rather outlandish entrees. Their creme brûlée was great though!

To Leyner, Eddie, Roger, Rogelio and any other staff we came across during our 6-day stay, thank you! You kept smiles on our faces, shared many laughs with us, made sure we were fat, full and happy, and really made my friends birthday special. I will DEFINITELY be returning to this resort and making it my only go-to when visiting Cancun.

reviews.author: Mauricio Jose A
reviews.title: Excellent Vacations!
reviews.text: I really enjoyed the stay at this hotel. I really have no complaints about this hotel. Staff was very friendly and efficient. The help was immediate whenever you needed something; room service was phenomenal. The only thing I really didn't like was food; kind of blend, but I tend to have a picky flavor though and I understand the fact that they need to make food attractive to the tourists who are not used to spicy food.  I got a massage at the YHI Spa; quiet pricy but very worth it; they treat you like a king. Hotel has a good location, right on the Hotel Zone, close to shopping malls and downtown; easy to take the bus. I would definitely be coming back to this  hotel.

reviews.author: Donald Hoskins
reviews.title: Cancun Paradise
reviews.text: Was treated like a King choosing Royal Service at the Paradisus.  Beautiful resort and large comfortable room with a large pristine beach. Many resturants and bars to choose from in the resort itself.  Our butler was there to help in any way Caesar did an excellent job however the entire staff were excellent. Did not go to the presentation with free gift knowing it was a time share like offer which wasn't intrested.  I'll return and definitely choose Royal Servive again !

reviews.author: Itsajyaknow
reviews.title: Lovely hotel
reviews.text: What a beautiful property!  We loved staying at the Paradisus!  The room was large and lovely, had a jacuzzi on the balcony,  service was great and the food overall was pretty good.  Staff was friendly and helpful.  Would definitely stay there again.

reviews.author: Diego Hurtado
reviews.title: Super
reviews.text:
Me gusto mucho el hotel, excelente atención.
Sin embargo, si no están interesados en pertenecer al club melia, no pierdan el tiempo recibiendo esa informacion pues dicen q solo son 90 min. Y teminan siendo 3-4 horas

reviews.author: Zee
reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text: My first time going which was actually in May of 2013 and I loved it. The beds were very comfortable and the food was pretty good. We had an all inclusive deal. Would I stay again..yes I would! I really enjoyed the balcony view, waking up hearing the water and going outside on the balcony.

reviews.author: AtxGal90
reviews.title: AMAZING!! Wont stay anywhere else from now on!!!
reviews.text: This place is absolutely amazing!!! Only complaint is make sure your not on floor zero.view was awful but we got moved the next day so everything was fine and please tone down the incense it is way too much and not a good smell while drinking. Food was absolutely outstanding!! You have to go to the market grill and taco tequilla bar those were major standouts. Staff is very friendly and drinks were not watered down. Cannot say enough how much my girlfriends and I enjoyed this resort. Rodrigo and the girl (forgot her name) from the entertainment team were outstanding and team players we even got him to do a belly flop! Angel from Mole and Rudy in reservations/guest services. I will only recommend this resort to everyone and I even work for a resort company here that has one in Cancun I didnt even stay at. Thanks so much for a last summer vacation Paradisus Ill be seeing you again!!!

reviews.author: 490sebastien
reviews.title: sebastien
reviews.text: J'ai aimé l'hôtel bon service belle plage excellent restautant à la carte. Je vousdirais d'essayé l'hôtel danbs les chambres ocean view mais pas royal service car les chambres sont veilles et vue lagune pas très intéressant.

reviews.author: J B
reviews.title: Visiten este hotel!
reviews.text:
Tuve el placer de hospedarme en este hotel y quede muy satisfecha. Personal atento, conexion rapida de internet y un detalle que es sumamente importante para mi, limpieza en los cuartos. 

Mi habitación tenia vista al mar el cual fue totalmente impresionante y si no es porque teniamos actividades planeadas con mis amigos, hubiera pasado mas tiempo en mi cuarto apreciando la vista.

Totalmente recomendado!

reviews.author: Sarai C
reviews.title: Bello resort ... excelente servicio y personal.
reviews.text: Fue una experiencia muy favorable, lo recomiendo a cualquiera que visite Cancun.  Desde la llegada al aeropuerto, el recivimiento en el resort, la amabilidad y servico del personal, hasta la limpieza de las areas publicas ... todo fue un encanto!!!!

reviews.author: Judy F
reviews.title: Do not fall for their trap on timeshares
reviews.text: Overall, the resort was amazing. The customer service was excellent. Orlando, yovanni, and Julio were amazing. They were very nice and welcoming at the bar at Bana and at the all you can eat buffet for breakfast. Thank you for a wonderful experience.

reviews.author: Sasha R
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text:
Lets just start by saying that everything about this hotel was exceptional. The location is beautiful, gorgeous white sandy beach.. pretty large beach front for the hotel. 2 pools which was also a plus. We didn't have the royal service and it was still a perfect trip.. the lagoon front suites are just as beautiful as the ocean fronts. 

The food was truly to die for from the general buffet Nao which served breakfast, lunch and dinner.. to Market grill which was another lunch and dinner option .. and the restaurants which only served dinner. Everything was cooked to perfection.. the pozole at blue agave was delicious.. 1st time trying sushi and Bana was definitely the way to go for that. 

The staff was extremely friendly.. Carlos and Erick at the swim up bar were phenomenal, our new best friends. Riccardo at Nao was our waiter most of our stay, so attentive from day 1.

All in all great trip.. will definitely be returning soon.

reviews.author: Kelekita
reviews.title: Faltan tumbonas de alberca y playa
reviews.text:
Fuimos en temporada baja.  No el hotel ni el Resort estaban llenos y nunca encuentras sillas con sombra en el área de alberca o playa, aún que te levantes a las 7 a.m.  Todas están separadas con algún sombrero, lentes, toallas, libro, etc.   Me toco ver a los meseros poniendo las cosas sobre los camastros a las 6 am!!! Todo para que les solicites un camastro y le des propina!!!  Mejor propina, mejor lugar.  No se vale. 
Por lo demás el hotel es bastante bueno,  pero el àrea para los " shows" es un chiste.  No tienen ni espacio ni escenario.  Todo se hace en un bar de interior, que no està preparado para eso.  Me toco estar en in espectáculo de malabares y equilibrio en el cual los únicos que ven son los que estàn enfrente, que no llegan a ser más 30 personas y algunas sentadas en el piso.  Desde cualquier otro punto simplemente no se ve nada

reviews.author: Mathew Z
reviews.title: It was a nice hotel but with some flaws
reviews.text: I stayed there during x-mas last year and i decided to finally write this review. Staff was friendly but my friends and I was harassed by locals at the beach trying to sell me cigars.  Food was ok but the location and beach was fantastic.  Entertainment was really good. The singers and dancers were gorgeous.  If wasn't in a loving relationship I would hit on every staff member there. but all seriousness. It's a good hotel but the cleaning lady didn't come to my room at some days which really upset me and my friends that we had to take it up to management.

reviews.author: Sam G
reviews.title: Excellent resort and service!
reviews.text:
This hotel is one of our favorite places to visit when we travel to Cancun.....its just a beautiful property!
I would recommend it to everyone I know who would be traveling to Cancun. Very well kept property!

reviews.author: Hawra A
reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.text: 3rd time visiting Cancun definitely loved the hotel, all inclusive was a great deal everyone found a restaurant they loved, in room dining lacks variety. Hotel gift shops / convince shop is waaaay overpriced. If you're there for the night life, I would suggest a hotel closer to the clubs, but overall would highly recommend this facility.

reviews.author: Mahino79
reviews.title: Increible las instalaciones, excelente servicio
reviews.text:
Hermoso hotel, imponente el lobby,  las plantas colgando dan una sensación de estar conviviendo con la naturaleza. El detalle de los brazaletes de coco excelente, no son incomodas como la mayoría de los hoteles
El restaurante japones delicioso.
Una excelente experiencia en todo sentido

reviews.author: tikiterre
reviews.title: Excelentes Vacaciones
reviews.text:
Acabamos de volver de nuestras Vacaciones en el Hotel Paradisus Cancún, hemos estado 8 dias, Al llegar y ver el hotel por fuera no dice nada pero nada mas entrar te invade ese rico olor a rosas que hay por toda la recepcion y con ese detalle sabes que estas en un gran hotel. Aunque hay pequeñas cosas que se pueden mejorar nuestra estancia fue excelente.
Nos alojaron en el Royal Service y todo estuvo Increíble.
La habitación fantastica con una vista al mar impresionante aunque por sacar una minima pega tengo que decir que el baño esta un poco viejo, las instalaciones muy bonitas, piscina muy grande, la playa estupenda y la atención inmejorable. 
Queremos agradecer a todo el personal del Royal Service que tan bien nos atendio pero muy en especial a Carlos Abiel, Michael Mayorga, Omar Hidalgo, David Cabrera y Alexander! Nos lo han hecho pasar muy bien y nos hemos divertido un monton!!!!!! 
El Buffet del Rest. Naos debe  mejorar, los desayunos fantasticos pero  las comidas y cenas deberian de tener mas variedad (demasiada comida asiatica)  y como hotel Español tener  mas comida Española. Nuevamente tenemos que agradecer  a Rafael Chetos y Edgar Gamboa por hacernos empezar cada mañana con una sonrisa.
El restaurante Fuego espectacular, nos encanto tanto el servicio como la comida, el restaurante Perla sin mas, el restaurante Brasileño esta muy bien,  pero el Restaurante Vento no esta a la altura del resto de los restaurantes ya que las tapas tienen mucho que mejorar.
El Spa esta muy bien, disfrutamos de un estupendo masaje,  eso si,  te lo cobran a precio de oro!!!!!!!
También mencionar que las 4 piramides restantes son estupendas, las instalaciones barbaras, las camas balinesas en la playa, las piscinas, el bar de la playita …
 Sin ninguna duda volveremos a este hotel!!!!!!

reviews.author: Daniela A
reviews.title: Muy grata experiencia
reviews.text: Desde la llegada a la recepción, el aroma con que eres recibido te envuelve en un estado de relajación que te hace sentir increible. La comida es deliciosa y las atenciones del personal son inmejorables

reviews.author: Kristina E
reviews.title: Best wedding ever! And vacation
reviews.text: I have been to this resort twice now. This time I had my wedding there. I had Lourdes as my romance coordinator. She did an awesome job! Everything was perfect and we had no problems at all on our wedding day. We even brought extra items like a cake topper and she took care of putting it on the cake for us. For being in Mexico, this resort actually has food that tastes good. I have been to Mexico to all inclusive resorts seven times now and I am always starving by the time we leave because the food is so much different than what I am used to. But at Paradisus I even enjoyed the food. I will be back for a third time for sure!

reviews.author: Aude146
reviews.title: Amazing experience!
reviews.text: I just came back from Paradisus Cancun and my trip was amazing. The restaurants were beyond what I expected. As for the service whether at the beach, pool, restaurant, buffet or Lobey, it was excellent. The food at the buffet was also excellent. I loved the balcony and the rooms. The person at the concierge counter was always helpful. The shows during the evening were great. I had a lot of fun and I recommend this to everyone. Thank you

reviews.author: Thomas K
reviews.title: Absolute Paradise
reviews.text: 7 of us went to Cancun to celebrate a birthday and a graduation, and had a great time.  We stayed in the Royal Service adults only section.  We were pampered by the hotel butlers and other staff for 5 days.  The food was very good, and the hotel was clean and well kept.  A special thanks to Sergio, Cesar, and Francisco for taking such good care of all of us.

reviews.author: Sandra D
reviews.title: Cancun Ag 2014
reviews.text: It was a really nice experience overall. I definitely would choose the same hotel.  It was clean, staff are very nice, beach is fabulous, it is close in urban bus to nightlife, and if you don't want to go out of the hotel, they have shows and very good ambience.

reviews.author: SunyEllie
reviews.title: Great Place to stay if traveling with a big group
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Adults Only section of the resort. 

This hotel has a great location, close to restaurants shoppes and nightlife.You can even take the bus for like a dollar right across the street from the resort. It's also right on the beach and the beach it's beautiful. White sand and bright blue water.
 
Pros.
The Adult only section was nice and quiet. The food was very good the butler brought anything we wanted to our room and made reservations at the restaurants so we had priority.
Breakfast was delicious and they offer a great variety of dishes and also fresh squeeze juice.
The night club or bar offer sensational entertainment . They had very well choreographed dancers and singers. People of all ages attend it and enjoy it.

Rooms were spacious and offer a balcony with launch chairs. They also had Nespresso machines
If you dint feel like going down to eat you could have your breakfast deliver to your room which I though it was a plus.
If we wanted to be on the other side of the resort were they played music etc, that was available as well so I felt that we had the best of both worlds.

Cons:
The place is a little old but very well kept.
Dinner portions were small.

Being in an all inclusive resort is a lot of fun specially if you are traveling with a group. No one has to worry about the bill and people are more relaxed.

reviews.author: GailYonkers
reviews.title: "No Complaints"
reviews.text: My most recent stay was this July 2014. I have stayed at the Paradisus Cancun 3 times prior and must say enjoyed each and every stay.  I am a member of the melia vacation club with my home club being the melia tropical. I have heard some people complain that vacation club members get first dibs on dinner reservations so I really have never had an issue, but like everyone else I too have to make my reservations the day before. I have stayed at many all inclusives and this resort has a nice variety of foods. For the most part the servers are very attentive, happy, and aim to please, and a few dollars goes a long way and they are so appreciative. The buffet is different everyday and the food always looks fresh. Many people don't know that where the indoor buffet is, when you sit outside you can actually order lunch from a menu which is nice. I have no complaints about any of the restaurants. Drinks here are also good, pretty much anything is included. At some resorts you have to pay extra for Jack Daniels, Stoly vodka but that shelf of liquor here is all inclusive. The pool and grounds are well maintained. The beach water is gorgeous but depending on the breeze sometimes can be a little rough. If you need anything services for your room as like a problem with the ac or tv they send someone in minutes. The wifi is good in the rooms and in most locations of the hotel with the exception of the pool area...that is hit or miss. You will have no regrets staying at the Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: Das889 S
reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: This vacation resort was average at best. It has a pretty face but is lacking underneath. The royal service is the only way to go. The food is not good. Make sure you sign up for restaurants when you arrive. The open house rest and bad. Also sign up for the Bali beds ASAP on arrival too or you will not get one. They are the cabanas around the pool.  The whole tropical tiki hut feel is awesome though.

reviews.author: Raben N
reviews.title: fantastic entertainment staff
reviews.text: such a great hotel! The entertainment staff were great and always making sure we were having a good time. Angel, Edwardo (Lolito), Rodrigo, Carla, and Stefani were fantastic! great food and beaches too!

reviews.author: icmir
reviews.title: Wonderful Carribean sea, interesting architecture of the hotel, staff needs more training
reviews.text:
We stayed in the resort 10 days together with 8 friends , so, the  reservations for "a la carte restaurants"  were difficult to get, even one day in advance . Anyway, exepting Tempo, which is very expensive, the rest of them are average;   NAOS international restaurant is ok, but in rush hours, the lack of organizing things is obvious. Food choice is good, however few of the members of the staff are almost rude.
Accomodation is fine; the music at poolbars is too loud on beach side rooms and lasts too many hours  a day. It seems like a  "teenagers "hotel. Cleaning of the rooms was superficial, under the beds there was a thick layer of dust. The technical team was efficient and they helped us almost every day with a problem: stuck doors, leaking pipes,  air conditioned, bad key cards. This hotel is older than you'd expect for its stars.
The beach is exceptional, however the beach boys  make a  business from "reserving" places at 6 AM, 4 hours  in advance  for some special guests; think they could use a better control from their superiors, it's only them that do not respect the" 30 minutes rule"

Beautiful tours: dolphins, sharks,aqua parks, good public transportation; very poor WiFi in the rooms

reviews.author: Olivia848
reviews.title: Great but a view minor things to complain about
reviews.text:
We were really happy and amazed by the set up of the hotel. There are lounge areas everywhere and the hotel is really nice and modern. The beach is beautiful and the room size and layout is nice as well.

What we didn't like: 
1.The lounge chairs at the pool and at the beach are ALL reserved after 7am in the morning. We didn't know if the problem was if there were not enough chairs or if people reserved at the pool and at the beach. The was a sign with rules, which explained that the towels would be taken away after 30 minutes not occupying the chairs but the personnel of the hotel actually didn't do anything about it

2. The food was average. I expected a little more and I think I am not very choosy.

3.Our room was right above the grill (pool without pool bar), which was used after 7pm and the smell in our room was absolutely terrible.

reviews.author: el_Grande_loco
reviews.title: Great time at Paradisius
reviews.text:
We stayed at the resort with one more family for 9 nights in mid-July. We’ve been to Mexico at least 6 times and this resort is one of the nicest we visited. 
The main pyramid design will amaze you every time you will walk through it. 

The beach is as nice as the white sand beaches in Punta Cana. It is long and packed with fine sand without any rocks or the reef. The sea weed is almost non present. It had some waves, which was great for New Jerseyites and the color of  water was just amazing. This was our first time on the lagoon and the beach is so much nicer than what you will see off the main land, further south.

As far as the food went, we were very pleased with their buffet. It was very good for all meals of the day. They didn’t go overboard with the variety and had just about everything you would fell like. At the breakfast ask your server for beacon and he will bring it to your table. I loved the calamari, mussels and scallops they made at the grill for dinner. They have plenty of different restaurants which we tried. Our favorite was The Market Grill. They actually had a real picanha and all other meats were tasty as well. 

We avoided main pool as there was the usual scene at the pool bar. There is nothing more repulsive to me than seeing young woman getting hammered and acting stupid. We stayed at the small pool right on the front of the Market Grill and we loved it. The server will bring you drinks faster than you can drink them up. Our favorite was Flor. She worked hard every day and took good care of all of us. Please be nice and tip.

For lunch we always went to the outside seating area of the buffet. You will be able to eat from the buffet and order from their lunch menu. I recommend flank steak and grouper from the menu. We had a blast with the servers there as we all speak Portuguese and some Spanish and we were able to mingle with them in their native tong. They provided the best service and kept us laughing hard every day. Kudos to: Oscar, Jaime, Darwin and Alejandro who are on the picture with me. Special mention to Jesus who  always made sure we were taken care of - even if we weren’t seating in his area.

I would like to thank Front Desk manager Alberto for accommodating our room needs. He was very patient and allowed us to find a perfect room for our long  stay.

The resort is great and we will come back. Remember to tip as it is all on us Americans. The bloody Europeans and South Americans don’t and it annoyed me a lot as they were the most demanding and sometimes unpleasant to the hard working people there. 

Note to management:
Your  night entertainment  was too early and you should do it in the convention area. Nobody went to it as it took place in the small space of your lobby bar.

reviews.author: Bonnie K
reviews.title: Best Vacation Yet!!
reviews.text:
Hands down, this was the best vacation I have ever been on and best resort that I have visited in Mexico. The staff is top notch. They are very welcoming, helpful, and always polite. The rooms are beautiful no matter what view you have. The beach is breath taking with plenty of beach chairs and pretty low traffic. We did get the Royal Service upgrade and I 100% recommend that service. They are very accommodating and make it worth every penny you spend. The food was excellent every meal we had. Did not have one complaint about food or drink choices. This was a very relaxing vacation and we can not wait to go back next year. You will not be disappointed if you book with Paradisus!

BIG thank you to Francisco, the beach waiter for Royal service! He was the absolute best waiter we had! He was always there when we needed him and was so nice. He gave the best service! He is another reason we WILL be coming back!!

reviews.author: DAC
reviews.title: Fall with no one caring....
reviews.text:
My stay was overall ok.  The food was good, the pool closed at 8pm and the pool bar closed at 6pm.  No drinks were served till 10am.  So between 10am and 6pm was the only time at the pool we were there.  8-10pm would have been better.

They had a high end party at the pool for some guests and moved the chairs out of the way.  After an excursion we came back at 4pm to find all the bars closed at the pool and the beach so I headed inside for our group and got some drinks.  When I got to everyone at the pool, I slipped in some crud that was under the chairs that was moved that was never cleaned and dropped six drinks in front of the pool bar that was serving the high end party.
