No one offered any help getting be back up right, asked if I was ok or even bothered to move.  When I asked for some help they told me I had to make a complaint at the front desk.  So I went as is to the front desk.  I made my complaint and went back down the the pool area.  Not very happy.  Eventually they sent out some people to clean up in front of the high end area and eventually where we were.  Goes so show that if you "Show the Money" you will be taken care of.  If you were the regulars you had to fend for your self.  The event manager came up like we had been drinking for hours at the pool to find we were very sober and not happy in the pool trying to still enjoy oursleves after a 96 degree day and riding on the bus to come back to this....  Not even I'm sorry....  Very poor and since it was near the end of our stay, I will remember the whole thing.  Set the tone.

Also if you go do not eat at El Fuego the steak house.  The worst ever.  Go to your local Mexican restaraunt and order Steak Bisteca for 10.99.  It will be better I promise you.

Regarding all the other places be ready when you order to make an order and then for the staff to bring table portions that if you don't ask will be enough for half of the number in your group.  We found if at the table you ordered enough of something from the table (6 orders of baked potatoes) you would get one one plate (3 potatoes cut in half).  If only one potatoe was ordered you would get one whole potatoe.  I think they were portioning.

I hope this helps you on your pick.  If you are looking for a quiet place you will find it with and overall mediocrity of service and experience.

reviews.author: Kim M
reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: Everything was wonderful, the staff was very attentive, the rooms were standard but the resort made up for it with the detail to service. I had the Royal Service and would recommend it to everyone who wants to relax with  adults only.

reviews.author: Daisy F
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: Will definitely stay here again. The food in the restaurants were beyond great! Staff is the best and the hotel is absolutely beautiful. Overall we had a wonderful time at Paradisus and will be returning no doubt.

reviews.author: chico a
reviews.title: wonderful experience
reviews.text: Hotel is beautiful, clean , has very friendly staff ! Enjoyed my four days there! Ckose to clubs , aqua world right across the street!! The service and food was for most part excellent! Rooms are big , clean n the ocean view rooms are amazing! Royal service is an excellent option if enjoy being fully pampered! Overall experience was good and recommend this hotel to anyone!

reviews.author: Stephanie B
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful and the staff is very friendly.  The hotel is on a gorgeous beach. No real complaints except the food could be a little better.  The Fuego Restaurant was terrible, so try to avoid this one.   The drinks were kind of weak. There isn't much night life at the resort.  There is one club called the Red Lounge, and this club is not very good. All in all though, I definitely would go back and stay at this resort, it is very nice.

reviews.author: 90Marilena2014
reviews.title: "Los mejores vacaciones"
reviews.text: We were three girls and we stayed at Paradisus Cancun for 4 nights. The hotel was great, more than expected. The staff was very friendly and the food was very good! The beach in front of the hotel was beautiful and clean. We really had the best vacation ever. The entertainers, Lalo, Arturo and Angeel, were really nice and they organized a lot of nice activities. Gracias chicos! La pasamos increíble! Hasta la vista! Besos de Chipre!!

reviews.author: Andres_Rueda22
reviews.title: El mejor todo incluido!
reviews.text: El hotel es muy grande pero está lleno de espacios encantadores. La atención sin duda alguna es excelente, desde que llegas al hotel hasta que te vas. Me quedé en una habitación con vista al mar y creo que es la mejor opción. La comida de la barra es de muy buena calidad y muy variada, adicional de los otros restaurantes que hay que son de comida muy buena. El que más me gusto fue Fuego. La playa es muy agradable pero el mar es muy peligroso, tengan cuidado. Los bartender son muy buenas personas y siempre están dispuestos a prepararte un muy buen cóctel. Muy recomendado definitivamente para ir en cualquier plan.

reviews.author: T B
reviews.title: All inclusive at its best!
reviews.text: My best friend and I stayed at this hotel for a girls trip! It was fantastic! We had the royal service and it was definitely worth the upgrade! Conseoelo took great care of us by the pool and so did Vinny! I definitely recommend this hotel to everyone. It's clean, the food is good, the service is over the top and everyone is super friendly and kind, unlike other resorts that I have stayed at.

reviews.author: Dagmar W
reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: My first vacation in 2 years and was very excited when we arrived. The hotel looked beautiful and has a perfect location. The beach was amazing. The upgrade to the royal service didn't give us anything special, our butler was never around. The only good part about it is that's adults only. I had 2 days out of my 5 because I got severe food poisoning and was sick and unable to get out of bed for the rest of my trip and 2 days after I got back home. We did not eat outside of the hotel.

reviews.author: Harriet B
reviews.title: Adventure in Paradise via Paradissus Cancun
reviews.text: I'll start with the pros, there are no cons,  from the time you arrive you smell the aromatherapy that is infused throughout the entire property, and in your room upon request,  A young lady is at the door to greet you with cool washcloths to cool you down and having royal services we were escorted to the Royal Service check in where you were greeted with champagne and introduced to your personal Butler.  No task was too large or too small, the mission of this place is to totally pamper you.  The rooms, restaurants and all facilities were exceptionally clean.  Although you have a wet bar in your room, your Butler brings whatever your favorite bottle to your room,  Food was excellent; at the buffet they have raw meat, steak, pork chops etc that is cooked upon request and a seperate fresh seafood section also cooked when requested.  Everyone there totally caters to you to ensure you have a wonderful time and we did

reviews.author: latreaceh
reviews.title: Spectacular Experience!
reviews.text:
My brother and I vacationed at the Paradisus Cancun Royal Service for 5 days, 4 nights at the end of April 2014.  This was my third experience with the Paradisus line (I'd also stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real and The Reserve at the Paradisus Palma Real in the DR), and I have nothing but positive things to say! 

When we arrived, the line for check in was extremely long, but we were greeted by our Royal Service butler and immediately taken to the private royal service check in area in Tower 5, which was great after a long flight!  If you're looking for a top notch vacation, the upgrade to Royal Service is well worth the expense.  The personalized service provided by the Royal Service Concierge was second to none. We informed them of our arrival several days prior, and they were able to not only provide us with a complimentary room upgrade (to a luxury suite ocean view), but also made bali bed reservations for us in advance.  Our butlers Gal and Hector were very attentive, making dinner reservations for us and accommodating any changes that we wanted to make. The Royal Service lounge area served a great light breakfast each morning, and featured a "serve yourself" full bar which was a nice touch!  We also ordered room service quite a bit, and it was surprisingly good! The Royal service pool area was great, with an excellent selection of food from LaPalapa (Royal Service only pool restaurant).  We were able to get a Bali bed for 4 of the 5 days of our stay, and Octavio, Francisco, Omar, and David made sure that we were well taken care of.   The royal service was a nice separation from the rowdier general pool, and were able to relax without interruption!   The restaurants were better than others that I've experienced at all-inclusive resorts, and I found the wait staff to be very friendly. I definitely recommend Market Grill, a Brazilian style steakhouse. If reservations are not available, I recommend Blu Agave for tacos and more casual food.   In addition, Marisol, who works at the concierge desk in tower 3, was so incredibly friendly and made us feel like old friends quickly.  Everyone at the resort went out of their way to make us feel appreciated.  Amazing trip and I'm going back in October!

Tips:

1) Tower 3 is definitely the noisiest and most lively tower. All of the restaurants and bars are located there. I would definitely recommend a room in tower 2 or 4 if you are bothered by noise and opt not to get royal service.
2) Royal Service is a MUST!!!! Definitely worth every penny we spent on it.
3) Make dinner reservations prior to arrival if possible
4)

reviews.author: summertraveler71
reviews.title: great resort
reviews.text:
I traveled with a large group of 16 the week of June 21. Everything about this resort is top notch. It's the nicest AI I've ever stayed at. The beach is spectacular, very wide and the water is clear and refreshing.....fun to play in the waves. Every part of the property, from the beach to the pool areas to the entire hotel is spotlessly clean.The food at the buffet Naos was very, very good with a wide variety of foods and different things offered every day. Definitely worth it to get an ocean view room, perfect views of the beach from the patio. The shows every night in the common area were very good, well worth attending.
The food in all the restaurants was good, but we liked Vento, the tapas restaurant, the best. Our server was Leobardo and the service was top notch, it was our favorite dining experience of the whole week we spent there.
I have traveled a lot and here are the only negatives:
1. The first room we were given the AC was not working and had to visit the front desk several times to finally get a room change. All the resort employees were very courteous, except for the front desk people. They acted like it was a favor to wait on us. We were put off several times, telling us to come back in an hour and the new room would be ready, then when we got there, they said no, come back in 45 minutes. We had to leave our vacation at the beach 4 times to inquire when our new AIR CONDITIONED room would be ready and then move all our stuff. I would have expected to receive some sort of compensation for our trouble of moving, but they said NO. 
2. The common areas and most of the restaurants are NOT air conditioned, so it is very hot and humid.
3. If you are with a large group it is hard to get reservations at the restaurants. You have to make your reservation the morning before. The lady at the reservations desk was not at all accomodating. I was with a large group of people (16) and found that when we split up for dinner and went in smaller groups, the service in the restaurants was much better.
Despite these few negatives, I would go back to the Paradisus Cancun in a heartbeat and I highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Littleton80127
reviews.title: They should change more than just the name
reviews.text:
This hotel was formerly the Gran Melia. They changed the name and put a new coat of paint on things but generally speaking, this hotel is a little dated. 

Check In
I walked in the hotel and noticed immediately a unique smell. It is a signature scent they are trying to achieve but it is strong and wasn't "fresh" persay, it was more like an orange ginger overkill. They indicated they would send my bag immediately to my room but after waiting for an hour I wanted to change and had to call and remind them that I hadn't received yet. 

Concierge
There was 1 person that performed the concierge function and I often stood in line for several minutes. Many people left because they waited so long and didnt want to wait anymore.  I asked for the concierge to check on something for me and I had to follow up multiple times since  there was no follow through. The last day I was there, Bruno was working the concierge desk (it was a woman all of the other times) and he actually was "fresh" and  pleasant and followed through. This is also where one books the dinner reservations. They probably fill the restaurants 50 percent. I am not sure if it is because of food cost and they would rather you eat at the buffet, but it was difficult to secure a reservation.  I asked one of the employees why the restaurants were so empty, and he said "So that we can provide great service". My recommendation here is simple- staff more and offer more availibility. 

Rooms and Overall Hotel Ambiance 
Rooms not impressive. There was an incident which I am not going to mention, lets just say the cleanliness of the room was in question and I asked to be relocated. They didnt seem eager to relocate me to make me feel more comfortable. They eventually did but did not follow up to see how things were and or apologize or anything. The bathtub in both rooms were just sorta old and icky so much so that it looked dirty. The maid service never left additional towels and I had to seek them out. The big thing was this resort inside is HOT. Usually you can go inside to get some relief but it was like a humid oven inside. Several individuals complained. Ironically the coolest place I found was where they take their club property tours. I knew I probably shouldnt have been in there but it was the only place I found relief. The air conditioners in the rooms say they are at 65 degrees (the lowest setting) but it feels more like 75 degrees. So not much relief there. I will say the decor inside of the hotel itself is really nice in the evenings with some of the lamps they have and the candles they light. 

Food and Drink 
I have had better but then again I never go to Mexico for the food.... The breakfast buffet is not as good as some I have experienced. My favorite dining options were La Perla (steakhouse) and outside during the day they had a brick oven where they made pizza - that was good. I could have had that each day if they were open.  I did get a little case of the stomach junk after eating at Mole, something I hadn't had in my last 4 trips to Cancun. (I come a lot) The bar outside (Cocos) was a neat little place to go and the best service on the property with Enrique & Samuel being both pleasant and attentive. They need more bartenders at the swim up bar. Service there was extremely slow. 

Outside Grounds and Activities
Volleyball was really fun here. The Activity team played and made it lighthearted yet competitive. They really have an amazing stretch of beach. The pool wasnt as refreshing as I had hoped cause it was so warm. What really was irritating is I could NEVER get a lounge chair to sit on. I literally sat on a barstool 3 of the 4 days I was there. The problem is they advocate for you to get these bali beds which are abundant but at an extra cost that takes up the real estate where they could place additional lounges for free. But honestly I couldnt manage to get one of those either (they were all booked up). Same thing going for the spots on the beach. There were none.  Finally on the last day before my workout (like 715 AM) I went out to put towels on some chairs. It was pretty amazing- I still almost didnt get one. 

Finally, dont make a decision based on the " cash back incentives" they give you. I didnt use one. An example: Spend $100 in the market store, get $10 back. Or get 30 off in the Spa (there isnt one treatment that is less than $150).  Also dont

reviews.author: Josie K
reviews.title: MY PERFECT VACATION
reviews.text: My Cancun vacation was absolutely perfect this year. I chose to stay at the Paradisus because I generally select a Melia Resort (same family).and wanted an upgrade this year. well I have no idea where to start. This resort is is the most fabulous of the resort I`ve had the pleasure of visiting. We had the Royal Service this year, which comes complete with a butler. Our butler was Juan and he always went beyond the call of duty. Always anticipated what we would need or like, and he made various suggestions that added to the overall vacation experience. I will definitely choose the Paradisus in the future, as well as recommend it to anyone that I can.

reviews.author: Anne T
reviews.title: Fantastic stay at the Paradisus Cancun!
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at the Paradisus Cancun from the time of arriving and being escorted to the Royal Service Lounge to the time we left.  The Royal Service area was beautiful, we had an oceanfront room, a butler who made our reservations at the different specialty restaurants, all the staff was great.  The pool area and beach were great.  The food in the restaurants was very good.  I would highly recommend this resort.  We were treated like royalty.

Anne T.

reviews.author: MyriamClk
reviews.title: loved it!
reviews.text:
paradisus is a great hotel: the lobby is amazingly beautiful, the staff is helpful, the food is eclectic and can please vegeterians, meat eaters, sushi lovers etc

the rooms are spacious and have beautiful views. I have been upgraded to the royal service which gives access to a private area where only royal guests have access... 

the package of all inclusive is highly recommended . what is shown on the pictures is exactly how the hotel look: it is so big and you can easily get lost but you always gonna have someone to help you. The decor is so peaceful and relaxing

I definitely recommend it!

reviews.author: Kelly B
reviews.title: Amazing resort!
reviews.text: I stayed here with a group of friends, and it was absolutely perfect. The resort is beautiful, and the food is AMAZING. There's something for everyone, especially at the buffet, and there are also a number of delicious restaurants. The staff was incredibly nice, and went above and beyond in order to make sure that we had everything we needed. Honestly, I can't think of anything one could want at this all-inclusive resort. The beach is absolutely gorgeous, there are many activities going on that you could choose to participate in, and the hotel is incredibly clean. The beds are really comfortable, the shower is great, and the slippers are a nice touch too!

reviews.author: andrew n
reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun resort was the most beautiful hotel. The service and the staff was amazing. All the staff was very nice and polite but I have to gave Sofonia most of the credit, he is the best.  The hotel was extremely clean. I just wish the pool is a little bit more kids friendly, if they have the pool  like the one at Paradisus Riviera Maya, this will one of the best hotel in Cancun.

reviews.author: Heather F
reviews.title: Best experience ever!
reviews.text:
Melissa in Royal Service was amazing! She made our stay outstanding. 
Gerardo at the pool service was also awesome!! 
We had such a great time!! We stayed in Royal Service and after being pampered the way we were, it will be hard to vacation anywhere else!

reviews.author: gmc0
reviews.title: Best resort in Cancun
reviews.text: from the minute I arrived I was pampered ate the most delicious food and drinks and the best service ever- room cleaned 2x a day-  loved it so much going back next year and the best part it  it was $2000 for 2 for 5 nights

reviews.author: Frank T
reviews.title: Excelente, el mejor de Cancún
reviews.text:
El viaje fue hace unos años atrás pero por lo que veo sigue todo igual de bien...este hotel es el mejor hotel de Cancún, All Inclusive de los que superan tus sueños.
Posee un gran servicio y muy buena atención,desde los empleados que se encargan de la animación los barMan hasta los gerentes de turno.
Si vas con amigos,es destacable el Spring Break, totalmente contrario claro a si vas en busca de tranquilidad y en pareja!

reviews.author: therealreview20
reviews.title: Family concierge staff is bad
reviews.text:
The family  concierge staff is incompetent. The butlers are good but the people who handle the requests are not customer service oriented. When i checked in i made reservations for a bali bed for 2 days and they messed that up when i go to my bed for the day i reserved the pool staff had no idea.  Iy was not the pool staffs fault but the family concierge staffs fault. When i twll the staff my issue she blamed it on me for not paying. I had my credit card swiped when i cked in and they had the amount authorized. The manager found out and told me they messed up and comped me but the point is the staff member tried to blame me.the butler arabica was real good. He knew how to calm a person down and he fixed the problem   i hope mgt realizes he is probably one of the best customer service oriented workers they have. 

Food is okay. Japanese place is best. Bartenders are great.

reviews.author: Donna C
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Absolutely great resort. The food was fantastic. The staff was incredible, especially Melissa, Francisco Terrazas, Edier at La Palapa, and Karina Reyes at the Avenue Bar.  I will certainly be a return customer. The sooner, the better.

reviews.author: Rhonda E
reviews.title: Relaxing
reviews.text: The oceanfront views were fabulous!  The scenery inside resort was also beautiful.  The only improvement needed is the food.  All employees were very pleasant and willing to assist in any way.  Would love to go back!

reviews.author: Gary S
reviews.title: Royal Service - Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: We recently returned from a small group trip in Cancun where we stayed the the Paradisus Cancun.  We chose the Royal Service, meaning the all adult side of the resort, for our trip.  Several items come to mind in regards to this resort that exhibits where the owners - Melia Resorts - have gotten it wrong in regards to Royal Services at the Paradisus Cancun.  Since the resort has a Family section with mulitudes of children, the Paradisus established the Swim Up Bar in the Family Section instead of the Royal All Adult Sertion of the resort.  This makes no sense since most Adults use the Swim Up Bar and not the children.  I am not against children on a family trip for vacation, just those that are unsupervised by their parents and hen we did make it into the swim up bar the parents of some of the babies present would place the infants/toddlers on the bar not wearing any form of diaper protection and some sitting on the bar bare bottomed.  This was very unsanitary and needs to be addressed by the Paradisus Management.  In the All Adult section, there were many times that there were not Pool Butlers or any of the Concierge personnel available to assist us.  Further, I cannot count the # of times we asked the children who had sneaked into the adult pool to leave.  Again, no security personnel to take care of this.  The breakfast food that was provided by the Adult section restaurant, La Palapa, in the mornings was brought out cold and not appetizing.  Again this needs to be addressed by the Paradisus management.  With all of this being said, there were some positve things that we exprerienced during our stay that I will share.  Gerardo and Salvadore in the Pool Bar made our experience more bearable and provided EXCELLANT service.  Melissa in the Royal Consierge Service center did all she could to assist our group and was very professional and pleasant.  I believe that the Melia Paradisus Cancun management should insist on turning this resort into an All Adult All Inclusive resort.  I feel more travelers would choose the Paradisus if it was not a primary family focused resort which just happens to have an All Adult side.  This maybe a 4 Star resort, but it has a LONG WAY TO GO before it could be ever considered a full 5 Star Resort.

reviews.author: Vicente d
reviews.title: Woooow!
reviews.text: This is the best vacation of our life! Our 3year anniversary! Thanks to Oscar Rios(from the mini bar) and Josefina Mejias(house keeping). I would never forget them! They made our nights feel like Home! Restoke our room daily, and really maked our vacation feel like we where in home. I gave them 100% in points. Good jobs guys!!

reviews.author: Mona E
reviews.title: Great experience ! !
reviews.text: just came back from our trip with a large group of friends and family . had a great experience at the hotel. super clean. great service, beautiful beach food quality was good . not a lot of night time activities ?! I've been to Cancun many times and this hotel was one of the bests :)

reviews.author: Michelle Kenyon
reviews.title: Unforgettable week!
reviews.text: I can't thank the Paradisus enough for the incredible week I had in Cancun! The hotel was beautiful with fabulous food and impeccable service. The staff at Paradisus Cancun was also extremely welcoming, accommodating and friendly! We didn't leave the resort because everything we could have wanted was there - activities, fun night life, great restaurants, beautiful pools and beaches, water fun and more! I love the extra touches Paradisus provides - something for everyone! There is even the cutest kids spa.This is the perfect resort to travel with friends or family!

reviews.author: VoodooKrewe
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
Our vacation group has chosen Cancun for 11 years. This was the fourth hotel we've stayed at. We selected the Royal Service. We stayed from June 9th-16th. The property itself sits on the main boulevard and on a beautiful section of the beach. It's large and spread out just a bit so we all got a heavy dose of walking, not really a big deal. We were greeted at the front lobby and were given a walking tour to our exclusive Royal Service section in Pyramid 5, where check-in was easy. We were introduced to our personnel butler, and that was one of the few times we saw him the entire trip. The rooms are average in size. No ceiling fans and they are definitely needed if nothing else but for circulation. The view was spectacular as usual, somewhat restricted due to the building design. Would have liked a liquor cabinet as we were use to one at other resorts. They room fridge was not stocked daily not sure why. Wi-Fi was spotting outside the main lobby. As far as the restaurants, the breakfast buffet was limited and basically the same everyday. Other properties changed their choices daily. On most days only one poor lady was cooking omelets by herself which led to a long line and wait. The other grill was not being use during the busiest times. We ate dinner at the Market Grill where we were treated to a delicious multi-course meal. Without a doubt this wait staff seemed to enjoy serving and did so with a smile and conversation. 
The set-up outside is confusing. The main pool is big and deep. Many people seemed to stay to the edge. The bar was typical in regards to size. Here again our wait staff was not at all friendly. I tried several times to engage in conversation and was brushed off. The drinks were good and tasty. The chicken wings in the pool area are maybe the best around. Did notice a baby in a swim diaper sitting on the bar. Not cool. Also another young child swimming without any trunks. The Royal pool was off to the side and it was secluded. Very nice landscaping. The Bali Huts are nice, but several times our reserved card was removed by someone. Plenty of beds and huts, no problems there.Service in this area was spotty, the usually wait times for service was in excess of 10-15 minutes, and it was not busy at all. The shows were a nice break. As others have posted the area is small and that means warm. The best spot is the Red Lounge. Lots of energy, good music and A/C. As far as the staff, overall they were nice and polite but that was it. The Market Store on the lower level only accepts pesos. You find that out during check out. For some this property will be just fine. Avoid the Royal Upgrade it was non-existent for us. Several in our group visited a previous property and were warmly greeted by staffers as soon as they entered. All said the Paradisus is a typical Cancun property. I did express my concerns to senior staff members who were concerned about our experience. For most this property will be just fine. Our group is/was use to a different resort experience. To wrap things up our entire plane was hand searched by US customs which lasted around 2 hours.

reviews.author: FedeNQN
reviews.title: Hermoso hotel
reviews.text: Estuve alojado 4 noches y el hotel me encanto, el club Meliá al que asistí no deja detalle sin cubrir. Piscinas enormes, restaurantes para todos los gustos, y un bufete muy completo aunque le faltan algunas variedades para ser ideal. El servicio all inclusive es muy bueno, ya que las 24 hs. Tenes algo abierto, y tiene una de las mejores playas de cancun. El spa es excelente y el Gym impecable. Lo único para remarcar con respecto a otros hoteles visitados es que los chicos de recreación no están a la altura. No hay música en la piscina principal( estos va en el gusto de cada uno por supuesto) y no son muy entusiastas a la hora del entretenimiento. Lo demás como mencione exquisito, excelente atención de su persona, market completo aunque algo caro, y habitaciones muy lindas. Conocí otros no tan grandes pero donde la pase más ameno, aunque no es una crítica ya que como dije los gustos son muy particulares. Hermosos hotel

reviews.author: Marykayfin
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Lots of choices for food.  Bar staff is very attentive on the beach and pool.  Search Miguel out at the bar or beach.  He will take care of your family all day. we were here with 8 people during a 5 day rain storm.  There are alot of leaks in the hotel but we were glad we were not in an outside sprwling out resort as we would have spent most of the week wet.  Food in restaraunts is very good.  Buffet was even amazing.  Make sure you get a room on ocean side.  Lagoon view is not good.  If you got the extra money and want a little extra attention and quite, take Royal Service!!!  Well worth the money.

reviews.author: Ale_Nogueira2014
reviews.title: Excelente opción en Cancún
reviews.text:
En todas sus prestaciones servicios es excelente. La ubicación en plena costa y con salida directa a la playa mas las piscinas, ofrecen variedad de opciones en el mismo hotel. El servicio a la habitación como el trato del personal y la coordinación con otros recursos turísticos son muy buenos.
Una buena opción tanto para viajes en pareja como familiares.
Muy recomendable!

reviews.author: Maja  A
reviews.title: Perfect wedding at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
We just returned from Paradisus Cancun resort couple days ago. We got married at the resort and celebrated the week with the rest of our wedding party- there was 26 of us in total. From the moment we stepped into the hotel we had amazing service with our own private check in, refreshing drinks and impeccable service from the staff. Our butler Hervik was exceptional. He was very caring and genuine. He left us a couple of notes through the week with little gift and refreshing aromas on our pillows after a long day in Chichen Itsa viewing the mayan pyramids. He also made reservations for us for the restaurants and checked in with us every once in a while to see if we needed anything. He left a great impression and made our experience at Paradisus Cancun that much more memorable and special. 
The wedding coordinator- Lulu was also fabulous. She listened to what we wanted and made it all happen. She was also very supportive and made me feel confident and relaxed throughout the entire process. I also have to mention Dani our photographer from Sweet Carribean Vacations- she was incredible and took great photos. 
The resort is very beautiful and clean. Our room was in the 3rd tower (main tower) on the first floor. This was a great location as it was close to everything. The food at the restaurants was amazing- we went to Vento, Mole and Fuego. It's important to make reservations in advance as they fill up fast. The food at the buffet was average. The only negative thing I will say is that the entire week was rainy and cloudy..so we didn't get much sun. 
In general we had a great time and would definitely return again to Paradisus Cancun resort.

reviews.author: Melissa A
reviews.title: The service is out of this world!!!!!!!!!!!
reviews.text: Just returned from a stay @ the Paradisus Cancun. Stayed in tower 5, Royal Service, Oceanview Jr Suite. The staff was beyond amazing!! i have never experienced service quite like this, it was indeed royal. Francisco Terrazas @ the Royal Service Pool bar was the most attentive, kind hearted, sweet person....always remembering our names, our favorite drinks, food... everyone there is one step ahead of you... and keep outdoing themselves. SIMPLY WONDERFUL!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Also, Royelio Romano @ Vento was very similar to Francisco, kind, helpful, and sweet. loved it. our Butler Sergio was amazing, and again, exceeded all of my expectations. i will go back ASAP. BOOK ROYAL SERVICE!!!!!

reviews.author: Odalys H
reviews.title: "Paradisus is Paradise"
reviews.text: This was our second year staying at the Royal Services at this resort! Royal Services is the way to go. The service is magnificent from the moment you step in this gorgeous Hotel you are treated with much respect and friendliness. They have many restaurant to choose from. One of our favorite was "Vento" the setting of this restaurant is very pretty and the Tapas are delicious. Another one of our favorite is "Mole", where the food is fresh and unique. The "Mariachi" gives this restaurant an authentic touch. A great addition this year in Royal Services was the option to enjoy breakfast by the pool at "La Palapa" and it's beautiful setting. All the staff from the hotel especially from Royal Services will do everything to make your stay one to remember. Royal Services by the pool make you feel very relax and Francisco service is on surpassed. This Resort is a very good value and highly recommend give it a try. PARADISUS WE'LL SEE YOU NEXT YEAR. The Huggins, Atlanta ,GA

reviews.author: Tanked21
reviews.title: Mojitos,piña coladas, and screwdrivers
reviews.text:
Planned a trip here for a party of 13 monkeys.. And there was always something different for the group to do. This all inclusive hotel was only 20 minutes from the airport and and a little less further from the party scene in Cancun. But the hotel was perfect, the staff was always friendly and helpful. They also have a swim up bar where you can spend the whole day just drinking all the well mixed up drinks you can..but if you rather you can do it at the beach too which is only 50 ft away from the pool. They have beach chairs tables and cabanas set up for you and the water was one of the best I've swam in. For activities they have a gym and other accommodations set up at their red lounge games and such for the kiddies and for the golfer, there's a 9 hole par 3 which was fun! I brought my own clubs so I'm not sure how much to rent maybe..
  The food at the resort was perfectly fine with me. It is all inclusive so for the options they have it was great. Spent most of the time eating at Naos? Which was the buffet and the taco joint across the way. For the "specialty" restaurants you just need to make reservations and the service at those places were just as good. 
 The only drawback to be honest was that the pool would close at 7pm. If they fixed that I woulda gave a 100%.. But nonetheless I would come back here.

reviews.author: Sylenyap
reviews.title: Very relaxing
reviews.text: I enjoyed my stay here at the paradisus. The room was clean and stocked with towels and water. The aroma was relaxing as soon as you walked in. The staff was very friendly just wish there was more activities at night. Will definitely go back.

reviews.author: Bel1992
reviews.title: Great Resort!
reviews.text:
We just returned from a trip to Paradisus Cancun. Our stay was from June 1-5, 2014.This resort was very clean, very friendly, and the beach was wonderfully close and one of the best I have experienced! They received an enormous amount of rain while we were there and they were out working everyday to keep things clean and tidy. I would especially like to give a special mention to Solfonio (or Sofonio) who served us drinks on the beach everyday.  He was so friendly and worked tirelessly, all the while keeping a great sense of humor! He needs a raise! If you go to the Market grill, ask for Giovanni! He is a wonderful waiter! He made our night so much fun! He also needs a raise! I mention these two specifically because they especially stood out, but the whole staff was friendly and helpful. 

If you have a gluten intolerance, then I highly recommend this resort! My husband has Celiac disease and could eat anywhere and they took good care of him.  He did not get sick once! For anyone that deals with Celiac, this is a huge blessing to find a place that is knowledgeable about this disease.

Our room was clean and comfortable and we had a wonderful view of the ocean.  Out of all the resorts we have stayed, this is my favorite.  I highly recommend the Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: denise g
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: This is by far the best resort I ever visited....the service is wonderful the environment is peaceful the food is great.....the employees are fun and respectful....I recommend this resort to everyone.....

reviews.author: Kim S
reviews.title: Had a blast for my 50th
reviews.text: The staff, the food, the facility are all superb! I would rate this a 4 Star facility w/excellent prices. Had a blast with all 6 of my girlfriends. Felt loved by Laura (poolside service)-I had tears in my eyes saying goodbye to her. Keith pool concierge-Roderick and Nestor on entertainment were fabulous. All the restaurants' were well staffed and delicious. Thank you!

reviews.author: Zachary L
reviews.title: Paradise at the Paradisus
reviews.text: I just got back from my 7 night, 6 day vacation and I was extremely impressed. The location of the Paradisus is a short cab ride about (10-18$) depends on where you want to go from the shopping center, or where the night life begins. Or 1$ for the bus that runs all day and all night. From the airport it's about 20 minutes. The property itself is beautiful. The room was decent and the bathroom was beautiful from the marble and granite countertops to the rainfall shower head. I would highly recommend the ocean view suite rather than the lagoon view. The food was okay, I've had better at the Iberostars but again this is a higher up resort catering to the higher cuisine. However, my favorite restaurant was bono (sushi), the buffets were pretty good too. The service was exceptional from start to finish, the workers are literally there day and night. The room service was good and prompt. The only thing I wish the restaurants had was more of a selection. Between the pool and beach all I can say is wow. Surprisingly you didn't have to get up at the crack of dawn to get a chair which was very nice. The pool bar is awesome and a lot of fun. I did notice however, all the workers seemed very appreciative of tips as if they don't get them a lot which I think is sad as they literally slave away to getting you what you want. (I don't know but I always tip even if it's a few dollars). The housekeeping was a little too prompt, they come in the morning, afternoon (to reload the fridge) and again at night for turn down service. They are making sure you always have fresh sheets and towels. I would come here again in a heart beat. Being only 21, I didn't really see a younger crowd, it was mostly family and older couples which wasn't anything to complain about, it was actually really relaxing. The workers were all very helpful and extremely friendly. I forget the bartenders name at the bar in the main diamond, I think it was Alex but he was awesome and made really good drinks (Thank You Alex). Overall if you are looking for a beautiful resort with a beautiful beach, and overall quite property for families then this is your place.

reviews.author: Dorris B
reviews.title: 4 stars
reviews.text: The hotel was beautiful but the only problem I had was the employees at towel service, the one gentlemen was very rude. One lady that help me through my stay was Melissa Worsley, she was outstanding and very understanding. But overall the service was good.

reviews.author: Jaime S
reviews.title: Great hotel!
reviews.text: Great food, beautiful hotel. Went with a couple girlfriends over Memorial Day weekend. Attentive beach staff. Try to get the upgrade to the Adults only/Royal Concierge. Be sure to book restaurant reservations and pool beds ASAP as they book up early!

reviews.author: Lacey
reviews.title: Horrible experience!  NEVER AGAIN!
reviews.text:
This was a 5-night girls trip.  (Just me and another girlfriend sharing a room)  When we checked in, Felipe said that upgrades were available.  He said he had a lagoon view suite available for $600 more or an ocean view suite for $750 more.  We opted for the ocean view.   As soon as we made that choice, he said "Well... I actually don't have an ocean view available until tomorrow.  You would have to switch rooms tomorrow.  They are the very same room except one faces the lagoon, the other faces the ocean."  So, being flexible, we decided to do the lagoon view for one night and would switch to the ocean view for the rest of the trip.  The next day, our butler Hector took us to the ocean view room.  It was a SMALLER room.  Even the bathroom was smaller.  We went from having 2 sinks to 1 sink.  We ended up refusing that room and just went back to the lagoon view.  I was angry.  And the solution to the problem?  They told us there was a couple checking in the next day into the ocean view room that was the same size as the one we had.  But instead, to make us happy, they were going to give the people just arriving the smaller ocean view room and give us their room since they would never know the difference.  Nice thing to say, right?!

After the room situation was resolved THREE DAYS into the trip, we tried to relax at the pool.  Getting a Bali bed was next to impossible.  The first day we tried to get one, we were told we would be put on a waiting list.  The second day (when we DID have a reservation) we were told the same thing again... WAITING LIST.  So... AGAIN... I got a manager involved (Melisa) and asked her why I was paying for an "upgrade" when the Bali beds weren't even available to us to be used.  She basically told me that the hotel was booked at maximum occupancy and there just weren't enough beds to accommodate everyone.  I said, "Okay... so you're telling me I'll be able to enjoy a Bali bed 2 out of the 5 days I'm here?  Why did I even pay for an upgrade when I can't even use what I paid for?!"  I suggested that my room rate be changed.  She ended up resolving the issue by offering me a Bali bed at Coco's (which they normally charge $100 extra for) or I could choose a Bali bed by the pool I originally wanted to lay by.  She also offered to give me the lagoon rate on our stay instead of the ocean view rate.  I thought that was fair considering all of the issues we had.  And the best part of all of this?  My name WAS on the Bali bed reservation list.  She said it was just written really small and it was somehow overlooked.  So basically it all could've been avoided.

Just when I thought the problems had ended, the filter in the pool stopped working.  There was all kinds of disgusting stuff floating on top of the water.  The filter had basically backwashed everything it had cleaned out.  It was so gross!  Tons of guests were complaining about it.   No one wanted to even get in the pool.

On our last day, our butler had scheduled a time for the bellman to come get our bags from our room.  The bellman never even showed up at the scheduled time... so we hauled all of our bags all the way through the hotel.  This was not at all shocking to me considering the string of other problems we had experienced.  Seemed like a typical way to end this nightmare trip.

As for food at this hotel... it was average at best.  The drinks were extremely inconsistent.  We would order Sex on the Beach when lounging at the pool and it would be made differently every single day.  Some bartenders wouldn't even put orange juice in it!

The doors on the rooms at this hotel slam very easily.  Walls are paper thin.  Noise was an issue.

This hotel also had issues with air circulation.  The AC in our room worked great.  But when walking throughout the hotel in common areas, it was SO STUFFY!  The air didn't move.  It was VERY HOT.  There was no point in even putting makeup on when it was just going to melt off of my face.

The best part of this hotel is the beautiful beach it's on.  That is the only one good thing I can say about it.  Unfortunately, it's going to take a lot more than just a beach to make me ever want to return.

I just felt like so much was promised with the upgrade and it was one big empty promise.  I couldn't relax on this trip because I was constantly fighting to get the things we paid for.

With that said, I will never be returning... not even if they paid me to.

reviews.author: Tracey G
reviews.title: Staff
reviews.text: I just got back from spending a week at the Paradisus resort in Cancun.   It is a beautiful resort but what made the stay a great experience was the staff.  The pool wait staff, particularly Laura and Juan Queno and Keith Lopez who all attended to our every need and were always friendly and helpful.    The activity staff Roderic Garciamoreno and Nester Fernandez were always friendly and accommodating and brought lots of fun energy to the pool area.   I would definitely revisit this resort due to the great staff they have there.

reviews.author: Rodrigo A S
reviews.title: CONCEPTO
reviews.text: excelente servicio. las instalaciones super, la atención fabulosa, la piscina de los delfines donde compartes y nadas con ellos bella experiencia, la piscina super, la barra libre super dotada de las bebidas que quieras. recoemdable

reviews.author: Genaro D
reviews.title: Wonderful Waters
reviews.text:
Went on a trip with my wife and friends in November and stayed at the Paradisus Cancun. Luckily I found a non all-inclusive option as I felt that was the best plan for my wife and I, and it was! The all-inclusive is a great option if you plan on not leaving the resort, but if you decide to go out and explore Cancun, it seems to be a bit of a waste of money and food. 

The resort was nice and the restaurants were great! The pricing was about the same as any other resort, no complaints here. They had specials on drinks at the beach, this was a pleasant surprise and made the beach experience even more enjoyable. The service was great and the staff was very friendly. I would visit again, if I have the option of hotel stay only.

reviews.author: Jennifer W
reviews.title: Amazing Views
reviews.text: Although when I got to the hotel they could have offered more than "One" free ride from the airport for more than one person staying at the hotel. At first complicated due to the fact that I had to go to a different part of the hotel since it was a part of a "club" . The hotel overall was beautiful and picturesque! The bar by the pool was the best. Of course "all you can drink" the staff by the bar was AMAZING! The gym was great as well and the staff was just excellent. I lost a personal item and by  the end of the night it was found and left on my bed! The experience was worth it. Although we didn't do any excursions but go out to clubs at night (once) we stayed in the hotel the entire time.

reviews.author: MFlorenciaR
reviews.title: SOBERBIO !!!
reviews.text:
Me alojé 4 noches, desde el 16 al 20 de Mayo 2014.
Excelente desde donde se lo mire... ubicación, infraestructura, playa, atención, comida, spa, etc. Desde el primer momento en que llegas notas cómo están en cada detalle, una calidez desde lo visual hasta el olor de cada ambiente.La calidad de la comida es increible!! Variedad de restaurantes, muy buen snack al lado de la pileta. La playa es súper extensa, lo cual te da la posibilidad de elegir estar tranquilo, o escuchar música de un dj en vivo en Coco Beach Club. 
Lo único que podría decir (como para decir algo "negativo") es el tamaño de la cama. Yo me alojé en una Jr Suite vista mar con una amiga. Teníamos una cama para cada una. Pero mis otras tres amigas se alojaron en otra Jr Suite vista mar, y no es una súper cama como para compartir. 
Espero volver pronto!!!

reviews.author: Kelsey S
reviews.title: Incredible vacation!
reviews.text:
My friend and I just got back from a 10 day stay here and absolutely loved everything about it! The resort itself is beautiful, the food is all really good and  you can't get better staff anywhere else, especially when it comes to those in charge of all the activities going on like, Nestor, Magnolia, Arturo, Angel, Eduardo, Freddie and Roderic. They were always around making sure everyone was having a good time, they were a lot of fun! Later on if you go to the Avenue Bar, make sure you get a chance to meet Enrique and Israel, they are the best bartenders you could ask for and Enrique can do some awesome bar tricks. Carlos was great too!
Will most definitely be returning to Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: adonkinv
reviews.title: Unforgettable vacation!
reviews.text: I visited this resort with a friend of mine, and we stayed for 10 days. In all honesty, it was the most remarkable and unforgettable vacation I have ever taken! The staff, especially those in charge of the activities (Nestor, Arturo, Magnolia, Angel, Eduardo, Freddie, Rodrigo, etc) were phenomenal! Very friendly and attentive, there was never a moment where we weren't having a blast! Also at the avenue bar, definitely visit Israel and Enrique! They proved to be the best bartenders I've encountered in years! Overall the food was excellent and the property is incredible! The staff are so welcoming and kind; I am definitely returning with my family later this year!

reviews.author: Fauco
reviews.title: Excelencia em tudo
reviews.text: Fiquei uma semana nesse hotel com grupo de clientes, foi um dos melhores hoteis que ja fiquei, a estrutura do hotel é muito confortavel e bonita.o quarto é bem confortavel e bem equipado, com frigobar, tv,, e um bom terraço. O banheiro é excelente. As piscinas sao grandes e tem um bar molhado. Estrutura de praia é boa, alem das cadeiras e quiosques, pode se locar os bangalos por 60 dolares por dia. Os restaurantess sao excelentes, recomendo conhecer todos. O hotel é bem limpo e arrumado e os funcionarios atendem prontamente, recomendo esse hotel.

reviews.author: Vinícius A
reviews.title: Mimado em Cancún
reviews.text: Excelente hospedagem. Tudo de primeira, desde os acabamentos do hotel e cardápio dos restaurantes, até o lanchinho de madruga ou o drink na praia. Os funcionários de esforçam para que não falte nada em sua viagem. Será destino de outras viagens com certeza.

reviews.author: Frederico M
reviews.title: Luxo e cordialidade
reviews.text:
Um hotel de luxo. Desde a recepção fomos muito bem acolhidos. Funcionários cordiais, sempre nos cumprimentam, se preocupam conosco. Todos se esforçam para nos entender no "portunhol" . Passamos 3 noites neste hotel e ficamos em outros também. Este se destacou pelo custo-benefício, ótimos restaurantes (em especial o Vento), área extensa de praia, com salva vidas disponível,  quartos amplos. 
Dica de quarto: vista para o mar com jacuzzi na parte externa.

reviews.author: João Reinaldo A
reviews.title: imperdivel
reviews.text:
da recepção até o check out tudo foi 100%.
o visual interno compete com o externo, impossível dizer qual o melhor, um mar com vários tons de azul ou um lobby finamente decorado com bom gosto e sofisticação.
Envolvido com tanto charme , conforto e bem estar acabei me filiando ao Clube Meliá e espero ter outros bons momentos em locais tão bom quanto o de Paradisus Cancun.
nota 10, boa viagem.
Reinaldo

reviews.author: Jocelyn M
reviews.title: Muy buen Hotel
reviews.text:
estuve hospedada 1 semana en este hotel, supe de el por que el año pasado me hospede en ME Cancún y son de la misma cadena, en mi opinión personal... EXCELENTE CADENA HOTELERA, en todos los sentidos, desde que entras al hotel el trato es increíble, este año nos toco suerte y nos regalaron habitación con vista al mar... no lo cambio por nada, todas las personas del hotel sin excepción son agradables te desean un buen día, están al pendiente, te ayudan con cualquier inconveniente, esta increible la atención del personal como en todo hay gente que destaca, y para mi le agradezco mucho a OSCAR, Bartender del bar en la alberca lo conocimos el primer dia y tuvimos suerte que estuvo toda la semana increíble, siempre al pendiente de nosotras y consintiendonos en todo lo posible, con el sus compañeros que lo apoyaban como Julio, hacen un excelente equipo. En el hotel hay un mini antro que realmente esta muy padre para pasar una buena noche, los bartenders Samuel y Juan son increibles, a pesar de que tienen mucho trabajo se dan el tiempo para darte una muy buena atención y sobre todo personalizada por ellos EXCELENTE, otros por mencionar Diego y Alberto del restaurant Banna, Juans de Vento y Luis de Market Grill. Y cabe mencionar que el servicio de mucamas esta increible, siempre puntuales y tenian el detalle de pasar por segunda vez en la noche para darte un servicio de cortesia que consistia en arreglarte la cama para dormir, y verificar que no te faltara nada... el mini bar EXCELENTE y el room services es lo mejor, es 24 horas y son muy puntuales, hay mismo me atendió MARISOL, que vale la pena felicitar por su actitud de servicio, y que siempre esta al pendiente de que el huésped tenga lo que necesita, me sucedio un incidente, que mi traje de baño estaba en la terraza donde lo deje secando y como hubo mucho aire en la noche, el traje de baño se perdio, al no saber con quien acudir, marque a room services y marisol me ayudo a buscarlo, antes del medio dia tenia el traje de baño conmigo, tienen la atención que despues de pedir servicio al cuarto, te marquen para saber si el pedido llego bien y completo, tal vez no son detalles muy importantes pero hacen la diferencia en tu viaje. 

Respecto al hotel, es grande mas las distancias no son tan largas, nosotras fuimos al todo incluido normal... que incluye... 7 restaurantes para cenar, 1 es el típico buffet de comida mediterránea, que aunque fuera buffet no repetían comidas, trataban siempre de que hubiera variedad, en la comida hay 3 restaurantes, uno de ellos es la perla esta afuera del hotel y es de mariscos DELICIOSO. 

El mini bar incluye cerveza, refrescos, jugos, galletas y papitas, 

LA CERVEZA ES TECATE, SOL Y XX ( como soy regia esta excelente  ) 

Hay servicio en la playa, y como en el ME hay camas que se rentan, pero hay suficientes camastros con sus respectivas palapas, nosotras siempre hibamos como a las 10:00am y nunca nos quedábamos sin lugar. El servicio en la playa es de lo mejor, nunca te falta nada. 

La playa en si es algo que no se controla pero es bueno mencionarlo, el aérea es muy buena, cuando hay buen clima las olas están tranquilas. 

En general me encanto la estadía, te hacen sentir muy bien y no tuve ningún problema, regresaría... claro que si, lo recomendaría?... POR SUPUESTO QUE SI ....

Muchas gracias Paradisus, fueron muy buenas vacaciones.

reviews.author: Amandadale S
reviews.title: Girls Trip
reviews.text: Had a great time here for a weekend girls trip. All staff was so friendly, hotel was beautiful & clean. Rooms were roomy. Food was so so. Some better than others, but overall not bad. Eric our butler & Omar & Francisco at the poolwere great!!! Eden & Juan @ the swim up bar were so fun & kept the shots coming! Ask for a donkey semen shot (I know it sounds gross, but trust me on this!)

reviews.author: Christiansavard
reviews.title: Tout Simplement Génial!!!
reviews.text:
Bonjour, je suis un agent de voyage qui j'ai séjourné avec une amie au Paradisus Cancun du 24 avril au 01 mai 2014 et je dois dire (pour en avoir vu quelques-uns dans ma vie) que cet hôtel, bien que un peu âgé, n'as rien a envier aux autres 5*. Tout d’abord, le site est grandiose pour un hôtel de Cancun et la végétation à l'intérieur de l’hôtel nous fait oublié que nous sommes entourés de béton. Le service était génial; je vous conseille de passer vos journée du coté du cocos bar (beach bar) et de jaser quelques minutes avec Jorge, un homme exceptionnel et de bon service. 

Plage: tous simplement parfaite, eau bleu et sable blanc; longue plage et beaucoup de palapas.

nourriture: buffet correct mais un peu redondant, par contre toujours de bon gout. Les restaurants à la carte sont tous bon à part le market grill, genre de churrasqueria où j'ai trouvé que la viande n'était pas assez cuite.

J'ai pu visité le coté family concierge et sans avoir des glissades a n'en plus finir, ils ont une belle piscine d'eau peu profonde avec beaucoup de chambres à air et de jeu d'enfants. Il y' a par contre une odeur constante d'encens dans l'hôtel et plus particulièrement dans le bloc famille.

pas beaucoup d'animation dans la piscine mais le soir un certain night life s'installe avec de beaux spectacle au Avenue Bar, genre de lounge tendance très très beau. Il y' a aussi une discothèque a même l'hôtel. 

Bref j'y retournerais n'importe quand

meri a toute l'équipe et plus particulièrement à Jorge.

reviews.author: etapngav
reviews.title: Cancun vacay
reviews.text: The Paradisus Hotel in Cancun is a beautiful resort.  We were a group of 6 travelers (3 rooms).  Our rooms were ready upon our arrival and were located next to one another.  We had a wonderful ocean view.  The pool and beach service was great.  Our only complaint (small) was that getting reservations for the restaurants was hard, if you call by 7:10 am, most reservations were already taken.  We were only able to get reservations on one night and were able to walk-in to one of the restaurants on another night. The "Red Lounge" played a great mix of songs and was a great place to hangout instead of the crowded (overcrowded) bars in town.  They had a beach night club on a Friday night that we really enjoyed.  "Dollar rent a car" kiosk at the hotel was great for the 2 days when we toured the area.  We drove to Tulum, Xcaret, and Playa del Carmen.

reviews.author: ArronizRJ7
reviews.title: Un excelente servicio real!
reviews.text: Nos hospedamos un fin de semana para festejar el cumpleaños de mi hermano el viernes 4 de abril. La recepción fue excelente!! en particular felicitamos la atención de Natalia en Royal Service! porque siempre mostro una actitud de servicio realmente profesional! .También agradecemos la atención de Octavio del restaurante la palapa, quien siempre estuvo pendiente de nosotros! y la FELICITACIÓN MAS GRANDE A JUAN nuestro mayordomo!!!! Sin lugar a dudas pregunten por él al Check In!!! Es extremadamente servicial y atento! Estuvo al pendiente de nosotros en todo momento y la disposición por asistirnos fue excepcional!!! "Juan gracias por todas las facilidades brindadas para el festejo, tienes la camiseta bien puesta!!" esta celebración es muy especial para nosotros y sin duda regresaremos!! los restaurantes bien ubicados y la arquitectura sensorial del hotel es increíble! Att. José Angel Arróniz hab 5701 y Alejandro Torres

reviews.author: Mary Ann G
reviews.title: Girls trip
reviews.text: Loved this resort. Have been to cancun many times, this was our first time at   Paradisus and will likely be back. The food was excellence. Service was great through out the resort. Has to be one of the cleanest hotels I ever stayed at.

reviews.author: AngelaH22
reviews.title: Good value and service
reviews.text:
My best friend and I stayed 5 nights in early May for our annual girls' trip.  We booked a royal service lagoon view room through Cheap Caribbean. We were happy with our room, and since we were in it so little I don't think an oceanfront upgrade would have been worth it.  We both agreed that the Royal service upgrade was a must. We enjoyed the adults only pool and beach areas.  The Bali beds by the pool were wonderful (especially in the rain), and we were able to get a Bali bed after lunch even on the days we didn't have one reserved. 

I found the food to be well above average, but the setting of all the restaurants in the main building wasn't my favorite.  Sushi at Bana was our favorite and we had great service from Mauricio.  

The butler service was underwhelming, and after a brief tour the first day we didn't see our butler again until the day before we left.  He did make some of our dinner reservations, but since he didn't provide a confirmation we had to check with the concierge. Mayte, at the royal concierge desk, also provided outstanding service whenever we had a question.

We spent most days by the pool or on the beach and never had trouble getting a Bali bed or umbrella, but we are early risers.  There was one "miscommunication" about our reserved Bali bed when they changed our reservation to accommodate a bigger group.  An honest explanation (the whiteout was clearly visible) would have been better than trying to convince us we remembered it wrong, but this really didn't impact our enjoyment.  

One person that deserves special recognition is Francisco who serves poolside.  He is a stand out, and really made our time there enjoyable.   

I've stayed twice at Live Aqua and loved it, but it have to say that Paradisus Royal Service is a serious contender especially given the significant price difference when we travelled.

reviews.author: SantaClaus60_12
reviews.title: Paradisus--Not Paradise--but close!!!
reviews.text: Five days for destination wedding--(people from all over the world--groom was Mexican) and we stayed in the upgraded Bldg 5 with butler service in Royal Service. Room is tired with really crappy showers and tubs--dirty windows, but otherwise large, clean and comfortable--super daytime and evening maid service, the butler works like a dog for you with respect to reservations for dining, but too typical for all inclusive with food that can be described as mediocre at best, regardless of where you were--noting that service at Royal service's exclusive poolside dining was just flat out slow--like molasses (you cant even tip your way to speed!!) and a limited menu once you've been there a few days..but no complaints..royal service is a good deal overall...The entire resort is well kept generally with beautiful atria that must be the hallmark...and the pools are quite good and the beach cannot be described--beyond beautiful with the only minus occasional rough surf...but one of the best beaches anywhere when calm. We loved the sushi restaurant, even though the size of its bar is stupidly small (who ever designed this part of the facility--on the ground floor of the main building, was an idiot), but service was quick and impeccable, and the Mexican theme restaurant (Mole)was nothing short of terrific...my wife and I were overwhelmed with the amazing service by our waiter Angel, who made sure all of our needs were met with a good assist from Sonia, the hostess. This is as good as it gets when in an all-inclusive. Don't overlook the Market Grill if you're a meat lover...also with a great staff. also, the sommelier is one of the best we've met in such a place. Now, a few negatives...some of the staff is often unengaged---going through motions with sometimes feigned attempts to be friendly--and tipping seems to pick it up, but almost to the point of expecting it or worrying you'll be ignored. I never have a solution nor seen a solution for this dynamic...so it just kind of comes with the territory--with my hope that the workers there are paid a fair wage. so, please, if you go, please leave $5 or so for the maid each day..it's the least you can do. We enjoyed our stay overall. One note of caution--we traveled to/from the airport with Olympus tours, who spent every waking moment harassing us to do a side trip. when we said no the first time, they kept calling our room, when we said no a second time, they became rude--even nasty--hanging up on us when we pleaded with them nicely to accept we weren't going--no way should these people be given a desk at the hotel. We said no when the first day at $78 all in then changed the next day to $15 for this and $3 for that and $5 for that per person as add ons. Be careful..this is how they trick you.

reviews.author: Licia Freeman
reviews.title: Wonderful Spring Break
reviews.text: We went to Paradisus in April for a High School Senior Spring Break trip.  We were 12 parents with 22 teenagers, and we all had a great time.  This is an all inclusive resort, and to my surprise the food was actually really good.  They have a buffet restaurant open for all meals, which was very good, and so were all the other specialty restaurants. Reservations were easy to make, staff was very polite and friendly, the place was always so clean, and it was a very positive experience. They had three different pools attending to different levels of activity, which pleased all tastes.  The beach and setting were gorgeous.  Would go back in a heat beat.

reviews.author: Gabriel S
reviews.title: El mejor todo incluído
reviews.text: La mayoría de los meseros son muy amables y siempre están pendientes de ofrecerte algo. El mar estuvo muy divertido y la vista de la playa es de las mejores que he visto pero es peligroso para niños pequeños. No se justifica pagar los 90 dolares por día de cama Bali. Es mejor sentarse en los kioskos o las sillas blancas frente al mar que son gratis y aunque no te llevan los tragos te puedes hacer amigo de un mesero y te atiende todo el día por una pequeña propina. En la noche te puedes sentar a conocer gente en el bar del centro del restaurante japones y el barman Simón fue el mejor de todo el hotel. Ojalá que te sirva unas cucarachas o un huracán y a él le puedes preguntar los mejores sitios para rumbear. El mejor restaurante del todo incluído es Fuego una mezcla de comida fusión peruana. El segundo mejor es el español con sus tapas. Si la elección es el Buffete el Naos está bien pero el mejor es el que se encuentra al costado de la piscina donde el Buffete es de comida de mar y encontraras los mejores ceviches y comida super saludable. Lo único malo es la discoteca del hotel pues el DJ pone mala música y no es buena onda. Pero puedes hacerte tu ambiente si llegas después de las 10PM con todas las personas que van a divertirse en su  despedidas de soltera o convenciones de negocios. Aún así a los animadores les falta generar más actividades para integrar a los grupos. En resumidas cuentas si vas con tu familia, con tus amigos, de negocios o con tu pareja el plan siempre va a ser espectacular, el hotel tiene muchas cosas para hacer y el trato es muy bueno para el precio. Te relajas y te olvidas que tienes que salir del hotel.

reviews.author: Amanda S
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Just returned from an out of this world experience at Paradisus Cancun. We upgraded to stay in Royal Service, which is worth the extra, just for the additional restaurants and upgraded experience alone. The staff were fantastic, nothing was too much trouble. The food is amazing all around the hotel and the pool/drinks service was brilliant. The whole experience was relaxing from start to finish

reviews.author: J T
reviews.title: Royal Service
reviews.text: Excellent stay.  The only downside was that we didnt really use our butler because he was off for a few days.  Drinks were top shelf and excellent.  Staff was very courteous.  Had a few bug issues due to the season but they were accomodating to killing them.  We booked pickup and drop off by grey line but they came to pick up two others out of our 6 passengers in our group and we waited for 45 minutes or more for the next van to pick us up.  although not related to the hotel, just be aware of this company in terms of punctuality.  Overall recommend this hotel to anyone with the royal service being a must.

reviews.author: DMILLRN
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun-Superb!!!
reviews.text: Can't give the resort enough praise! From easy check-in, room comfort, pool and beach service, attentive staff, and restaurants!!! (could not decide which one was better, as all were great). And I can't thank Susan@BerwickTravel.com enough. She made the vacation effortless.

reviews.author: Tatiana Roso
reviews.title: PERFECT!
reviews.text:
Simplesmente maravilhoso! 100% satisfeita. Quartos de frente para o mar são os The Best!!!!Nota 10 para o restaurante NOA. Serviço completo e funciounários muito prestativos. Tem o bar COCOS que fica localizado na praia. Este é sensacional. Seus funcionários são otimos. Rápidos e muito simpáticos. Nota 1000 para os barmans Luis, Antônio, Jorge e Jonathan. São fenomenais!!!!
Restaurante Bana, comida japonesa deixa a desejar. O gerente Mário é péssimo e seus funcionários também. Nota ZERO. Um show de horror!

reviews.author: Sally C
reviews.title: Girls Trip
reviews.text: Considering we weren't even supposed to stay at this hotel, I think we were blessed to have this as our second option.  The hotel is beautiful, the grounds are well kept, there is a different aroma in each building, the staff is friendly and courteous.  It definitely has a very Zen feeling throughout the property.  We upgraded to Royal Service as we all have kids and this is our "adult" getaway.  Francisco and Enrique were phenomenal by the pool, Hector in Fuego and Alejandro in Bana.  All superior exceptional staff.  Why 4 stars?  We were supposed to have our private butler who was going to make our stay memorable.  Many things contributed to our disappointment.  We asked for scented pillows every night and received them once.  Our friends asked for coathangers, never got them.  Our butler asked if he could bring wine to our room and we said yes.  We never got any.  We were never offered nor received a butler phone.  We were guaranteed Bali beds for 2 days of our 4 day stay.  They gave us Saturday and Sunday.  We left at 9:30 Sunday so we couldn't use it.  I had to work very hard with concierge to get it switched.  I thought the butler would take care of that, but he wasn't around.  Needless to say, our butler was non-existent.  He worked 7 am to 3 pm - so who would cover the other hours?  We had no idea.

reviews.author: KseniaK2511
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Отель неплохой, большие и удобные номера, но территории нет совсем, мало зелени. Персонал среднего уровня, не хватает внимательности к гостям и вежливости. Питание в главном ресторане на 4, качество еды хорошее, не слишком разнообразно. Остальные рестораны не понравились, не вкусно, кроме Mole. Пляж хороший, но не хватает грибков, нужно занимать в 7 утра. Развлечений в отеле почти нет, вечерняя программа не интересная.В прошлом году на Ривьере Майя понравилось намного больше, хотя отель был попроще.

reviews.author: Alexandra G
reviews.title: Amazing Amazing Amazing
reviews.text: If I Can Write A Book About The Paradisus I Would Be Writing Forever I Loved EVERYTHING About The Hotel and What It Offered I Actually Can't Wait To Go Back I Wouldn't Stay Anywhere Else... AMAZING!!'

reviews.author: Angioletta L
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text:
Amazing! I can't even come up with words to truly express how much I loved my vacation here. We were here during the second week of April with 28 other people for my wedding. We had an awesome time! It was honestly just a great experience. All the staff was so sweet, responsive and caring. Everyone goes out of their way for you! Pools are beautiful. They have a good DJ right by the pool and a swim up bar. Beach is beautiful!! Great for kids. They have a pool with kids activities all day and even have ceramic painting for the kids. Drinks are great and food is also good. There are a lot of restaurants to choose from & this is one of the few all inclusives that actually makes a good drink! 

Our wedding was amazing. The romance team we worked with at the hotel was so caring and attentive! Everything came out beautifully. All of our guests loved their stay and that made us very happy. 

I don't have one complaint. If you are thinking about doing a destination wedding this is the place to do it! We had an amazing time.

reviews.author: Beth A
reviews.title: Beth. Awesome!!!
reviews.text: Can't say enough about this hotel.  The food was first rate at the ones we chose.  Staff super, Simons drinks to die for(cocos bar) geraldo an Carlos at pool bar super people.  If u need something it's pretty much taken care of for u.  Cons:The burning of incense was a bit much.  The ave. bar needs more room to watch enertainment.  Go go go to this hotel if ya want a super time.

reviews.author: beachloverdeb13
reviews.title: Beautiful resort and the best service
reviews.text:
We were a group of 4 ladies having a girls trip.  We opted for the Royal Service and it was mostly worth it!  The seclusion of "our" area was great.  We were in pyramid 5 witch has an open center atrium type area with walkways, small ponds and fish.  In this area there is also a self serve bar and food area.  The area has breakfast in the mornings and snack type items the rest of the day on into the evening.  I believe this area is open until 11pm.  The Royal Service is supposed to include butler service, but our butler Juan, was unable to provide even the simplest of requests(a few more hangers for the closet).   Manuel was our server the first day at the La Palapa bar and grill and he was wonderful.  Almost all waiters, bar servers, concierge employees and house keepers were always smiling and saying hello.  Michael, one of the bar servers started out being attentive then his attentiveness slipped.  Enrique and Francisco(bar servers) were EXCELLENT.  All of our servers at the restaurants were attentive, even the buffet.  The buffet food was just that and nothing special.  Most other food we received was usually just barely warm.  Bana is sushi and pretty good.  Fuego was the best of the places we ate.  For some reason you must make reservations 24 hours in advance for the restaurants, which is fine.  But one all occasions when we dined, there were numerious tables available.  So I don't understand the big deal about reservations.  Felipe our porter was also great!  Also, the web site states transfers are included but they are NOT! 

With the Royal Service you get a private area of the pool with Bali beds that you also must reserve 24 hours in advance.  It is a great area with no kids and very friendly employees.  

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would stay there again if we are back in the area.

reviews.author: Brian S
reviews.title: VT Crew
reviews.text: This was a 3rd time to Cancun and we have always wanted to stay at this resort. In comparison to the other places we stayed it was just ok. Our experience at the other places were better. The resort itself is very beautiful. The food was ok, i did not like the layout of the buffet and the food was not the hottest. I did not realize till the last day that there was a menu at the buffet that you could order from and have a steak cooked to order, they don't tell you that. There was 24 hr room service that was included as well but they don't tell you that either, you have to figure it out for yourself. We tried most of the restaurants and the steakhouse and market grill were the best. The entertainment was not great, not much going on during they day to keep guests entertained. The nightly shows were basically a joke, the area where they put them on had no good place to sit and watch, you were always in someones way, it was the worst set up for shows that i have seen, very disappointed with that part of it, expected much more. Our group had the most fun entertaining ourselves with beach volley ball and then enjoying the pool bar in the afternoon. The pool bar was great (Bartenders Enrigue, Samuel, and Gerardo were the best A+++). The only problem at the pool bar was there were too many young kids splashing pool water in your drinks, no parental supervision. They should have a small pool bar for kids in the kid pool area. To sum it up it was great vacation with friends but i would probably not go back unless it was just my wife and i and we upgraded to royal service. We could not upgrade at the time as our group had 16 year old children and you have to be 18 to upgrade.

reviews.author: Katherine M
reviews.title: Best Vacation Ever
reviews.text: 5 Star experience.  The hotel was extremely clean, always a staff member asking if there was something they could do for you, very friendly.  Beach was amazing, blue water, plenty of beach cabanas if you get there by 7:30.

reviews.author: LLJJ0526
reviews.title: Love this place!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun in February this year for 8 days.  It was my first all-inclusive resort and my first time to Mexico.  My husband and I went with 6 other friends and we had an awesome time.  The staff were friendly and the resort was clean and the food was great.  We liked the buffet and the food at The Marketplace the most.  We also went to the Michelin chef restaurant called Tempo on Valentine's Day (you need to pay for this restaurant).  The food was oookkk, but the presentation of the plating of the food was beautiful.  The weather was perfect, the beach was beatiful and the staff were all just so friendly.  Our rooms were clean, there were no bugs, geckos or lizards.  Would definitely recommend to friends and family and will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Anita W
reviews.title: Butler Service
reviews.text: The employees are usually very friendly and attentive. The Butler service is a joke, it's better to handle it on your own the first day you arrive. Make your own reservations for dinner and Bali beds. The pool employees are very nice and helpful. I still loved the Royal Service but the Butler was a huge disappointment. Although all inclusive means gratuities are included you will get better service if you tip.

reviews.author: PecanSandy
reviews.title: Nice, standard all-inclusive
reviews.text:
My mom, aunt, cousin, and I had a girls' getaway at Paradisus Cancun. I have stayed at 3 other resorts in Riviera Maya, and, though the resort was very nice, it was not my favorite. 

The positives: We stayed in the main tower (tower three), and our room was great. It was clean and spacious, though there was no balcony furniture in either of our rooms. The Thierry Mugler toiletries are a nice touch. Staying in the main tower was key! We had wanted to upgrade to Royal Service, but it wasn't available, and I'm glad we didn't as the primary reason we wanted to do that was to get guaranteed seats at the private pool. But the main pool with the swim up bar was so much fun that I wouldn't have wanted to be in the private area! The resort had a diverse clientele which I appreciated, and they were all really fun and cordial. There weren't a lot of kids at the time I went. The nightclub/bar that opened late at night was super fun with a good DJ and a fun crowd. I also loved the make your own Bloody Mary bar (we put them in "to go" cups and took them to the pool!) and the juice bar at breakfast.
