The constructives: Most of the issues I had were around the pool b/c that's what I was there to do (swim and relax!). The biggest issue (which other reviewers have said) is that you literally need to get to the pool by 6:30am to get a good seat. Thankfully the moms are early risers and would get there at sunrise to reserve the seats. The main pool is extremely deep. There are no shallow areas (except near the kids area), and after a few drinks at the swim up bar, that's a struggle! The Zumba and  water aerobics were fun, though they were sometimes not offered with no notification. The pool water turned the white parts of our suits green, and we are still struggling to get it out using RIT and other whiteners. The food was average but as expected for an all-inclusive. We ate at the buffet most of the time b/c you can only make reservations for all the other restaurants one day in advance, and when the line opens at 7am, it is busy and reservations are often gone shortly after that. 

Bottom line is if you can get a good deal through Expedia or somewhere else, this is a solid hotel to stay in (just pack your alarm clock and a non-white bathing suit!).

reviews.author: Dayna P
reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: The hotel was wonderful from the service to the amenities.  However, you NEED a reservation at one of the 10 restaurants FAR in advance or you cannot get in anywhere but the buffet. This information was never relayed to us and we found out the hard way.  They booked by 2pm Friday for Saturday night reservations.

reviews.author: NELLY_77
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun was a delight
reviews.text: Really enjoyed my stay at this hotel. They have an amazing beach, pool and staff. Thanks so much to Efrain in the lobby!  Can't wait to go back!!! The staff was truly wonderful, always polite and helpful. I enjoyed my food, drinks and night shows at the Avenue Bar.

reviews.author: Cheri H
reviews.title: Exceeded Expectations
reviews.text: I stayed with two other girlfriends at the Paradisus in late April 2014 for a short girls getaway.  The resort is beautiful!  There are several restaurants, shops, spa, beach club, etc.  It was wonderful.  We did not even leave the resort.  We spend all day relaxing on the beach in our cabana in the Cocos beach club area being cared for by Gorge and Luis.  These gentlemen were amazing, genuinely sweet, and took great care to ensure we relaxed and were pampered on our vacation.  The food in the restaurants was very good.  The buffet food was fine, but after a couple of days we were ready for a change.  Make reservations to the restaurants as early as allowed because they fill up fast.  FYI - sunscreen in the hotel is excessively expensive, so plan ahead and bring plenty from home.  We had an oceanview junior suite that three of us shared.  It was roomy, the beds were comfortable, the view was beautiful.  This is one of the best resorts I have stayed at in Cancun and we found it to be a terrific value.  The service was amazing, and everyone was very attentive.  I would return.  And I would ask for Gorge and Luis.

reviews.author: Rafael B
reviews.title: Increible atmosfera...
reviews.text: Me quede sorprendido con la belleza de la playa... el hotel se ve muy diferente de dia y de noche...parece que estas en otro lugar ...los colores , los aromas , la comida , las bebidas , el servicio ,TODO ESTUPENDO...volveria muchas veces mas... Muchas gracias!!!

reviews.author: Gencas
reviews.title: Muchas gracias
reviews.text: Wooooow no lo puedo creer el servicio es excelente pero victor el mesero del pool bar s el mejor he hido a muchos hoteles pero nunca me habian prestado tanta atencion sin descuidar alos d mas huespedes el es muy amable ojala la empresa lo pudiera compensar del algunas forma  todos son muy anles desde q llegue al hotel siempre fui tratado como una persona importante muchas gracias exelente staf rompieron mis espectativas pero reirtero victor dio el plus q m faltaba !!!!!

reviews.author: Nicole G
reviews.title: Market Grill Birthday
reviews.text: Celebrated my wife's 45th birthday at the Market Grill on April 20th with our party of sixteen. An amazing night of food and entertainment. A wonderful "fire dancing" show, followed by excellent food, drinks, and capped off with the staff bringing our dessert and joining us in singing "Happy Birthday" to the surprised birthday girl. A night to remember! Many thanks to the staff for their exceptional service, including our waiters; Margalli & Wilbert and our hostess, Giovanna.

reviews.author: PatNirag
reviews.title: Tout simplement parfait !
reviews.text: Très bon hôtel, bien situé et d'une qualité irréprochable. Hall central grandiose. Grande chambre (Deluxe vue océan) avec grand balcon, bien équipée et agréable. Plage superbe. Plusieurs piscines à choix & des restaurants de cuisines différentes de grandes qualités dans l'offre all inclusive. Pour les fins gourmets, ne pas louper le menu gastronomique exceptionnel (payant) du restaurant Tempo by M. Berasategui. Le service que ce soit dans les restos ou sur la plage particulièrement au Coco's Bar d'une grande efficacité, et toujours avec le sourire et amabilité. SPA de qualité et efficace dans les choix des soins et des horaires. A son propre parcours de golf (9x par3) devant l'hotel. Seuls bémols, la qualité du wi-fi dans les chambres et aménagement du balcon (seul.1 chaise longue)

reviews.author: Liliane A
reviews.title: Maravilhoso
reviews.text:
Hotel fantástico, com um atendimento e infra estrutura espetacular..

Acomodações limpas e confortáveis.... o restaurante tem um buffet amplo e diversificado. E de madrugada faz um hambúrguer delicioso!!! 

A área da piscina é simplesmente maravilhosa,com um bar de bebidas deliciosas....

reviews.author: Ximena V
reviews.title: Buena experiencia n Cancún
reviews.text:
Estuve en reunión de negocios pero me quedé con amigas unos dias de relax... buena habitación, muy buen servicio. La comida muy rica en todos los restaurantes del hotel. 
Lo que no me gustó fue el cobro adicional por algunos servicios (estuve hace un mes en paradisus Punta Cana y no cobraban por ejemplo por las camas de playa), los tragos y la musica de la discoteca que debería ser apta para todos...

reviews.author: Dey F
reviews.title: Muy Bueno!!
reviews.text: Estuve con una amiga 5 dias parando en el hotel, personalmente me encanto.. La atencion es muy buena, desde la recepcion hasta gente q t cruzas q t saluda muy amablemente... En los restaurantes q estuvimos nos atendieron excelente, el mejor fue Mole, pero todos excelente calidad d comida y atencion!!! Y los mejor el barcito Coco's!! Antonio y Francisco q atienen alli unos maestros!! Te hacen probar diferentes tragos, t aconsejan d lugares, etc muy muy buenooo!!! Graciass Paadisuss!!!!!!

reviews.author: Srdoherty
reviews.title: April in Cancun❤️
reviews.text: The resort was gorgeous. The staff could not be more accommodating. Ocean and beach gorgeous. Food and restaurants were very good...want something not available..ask! They will get it for you,esp pizza and coconut ice cream. The rooms were clean and spacious. Shows at night were decent,not crazy like other resorts in Mexico I stayed at! Ride to downtown Cancun about 30 mins...closer to airport. Free internet wifi all over the resort and works well. All in all I'd go back. It was paradise! Lots of glass...views everywhere....

reviews.author: Elaine R
reviews.title: Hotel fantástico
reviews.text: Ótimo hotel, com um nível de atendimento fantástico, culinária muito boa e um nível de excelência excepcional.👍👍🔝🔝✌️✌️👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍

reviews.author: Richard G
reviews.title: Must Visit
reviews.text: My vacation at the paradisus was average. Upon arrival, the front desk offered an upgrade to their royal service for an additional $100 per night which I accepted. The main problem with this service was even after staying 5 nights I was yet to figure out what was the point of this Royal Service which they speak so highly about and recommended. Granted we received a butler service but was that all we paid for ? Im yet to figure that one out because no one could explain the purpose behind the royal service. We received bottled service which was "on the house." Supposedly we got top shelf liquor from the exclusive pool concierge. With all that being said there were some exception people who stood out and made my trip a memorable one. Namely, Erick who was one of the butlers that greeted us and took us for a drive to the royal service check in lounge. Aidee was an exceptional individual she made me feel like I was Royal. My Butler Hector Ibarra, who was distant and too busy for me eventually warmed up and delivered tremendous service. But by far Omar the towel concierge; words cant express his genuineness towards me, he eventually became a friend after our first encounter. Reluctant of the time share that Juan Pablo wanted to schedule turned out to be a great experience. Only because of the sales rep, Milly from club melia. Words cant describe how much I love this lady. Her sense of humor, her down to earth personality and just how sweet she was.  She made me walk out of the tour wanting to give her a gift. I would advise asking for her if your ever interested in the timeshare. My average stay became 4 stars, definitely a must visit. But only because of the people I came in contact with and the food they offered at the resort. When I do go back to cancun I will visit a different resort to see if the service compares.

reviews.author: Matt S
reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text: We(my wife and I and our 2 kids ages 2 and 4) stayed at the Paradisus Cancun from 3/19/14-3/24/14.  The accommodations were excellent.  Hervik our butler was awesome, he really made our stay that much more enjoyable.  We would definitely go back.  Next time we definitely would get an ocean view room.

reviews.author: Frenchy59430
reviews.title: À refaire sans aucune hésitation...
reviews.text: Nous avons séjourné 10 jours dans cet hôtel et se fut génial...nous n avons rien à redire tout était super, un staff compétent et très courtois.Je tiens tout particulièrement à saluer le professionnalisme de Fred ainsi que son amabilité tout comme le reste des membres de l hôtel...Je n'ai pas pour habitude de retourner 2 fois au même endroit mais je le referais l année prochaine à coup sur...See u.

reviews.author: Ross0305
reviews.title: good stay overall but 4* and not 5* hotel
reviews.text:
The positive things:
hotel appearance is good, the location is great and the staff (lobby, bar, restaurants and pool/beach tenders and activity staff very good overall.  Food is plenty and fresh (although if you stay like us for 10 days it gets a bit repetitive)
Te things that could be improved:
the housekeeping staff needs training and managements....there was always something missing each day...towels, soaps, toilet papaer etc although when reported was delivered in a timely manner!

I stayed at this hotel back in 1995 and it was superb......second time around overall still a good stay but the hotel is starting to look somewhat tired and lacks the 5* sparkle that once had!

reviews.author: Rafael P
reviews.title: Fantástico!!!!
reviews.text: O hotel é muuuuuito bom! Excelente estrutura, ótimo atendimento, várias opções de restaurantes dentro do hotel! Atendimento na praia e nas piscinas! Uma vista maravilhosa da praia de Cancun! O quarto é amplo e confortável, muito bonito! É muito fácil para ir até os shoppings pois passa ônibus toda hora em frente ao hotel! Com certeza eu recomendo o Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: Renata R
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Hotel maravilhoso, atendimento perfeito, todos funcionários bastante atenciosos e simpáticos. Excelente estrutura. Quarto amplo, arrumado, limpo, travesseiros e cama muito bons. Serviço de quarto muito bom.

reviews.author: BuenosAiresPrincess
reviews.title: Increíble estadía, infraestructura, Playa y magnifico Servicio!!
reviews.text: Es mi segunda estadía en Paradisus, me encanta alojarme alli, por todo,...aun con la inmensidad de su infraestructura, sentis que estas solo, tenes espacio en los restaurantes, en los bares, en las sillas, palapas, piscina...la verdad que es un hotel que vuelvo a elegir principalmente por sus increibles playas y servicio, hay mucha oferta en Cancun y es dificil elegir un hotel, pero esta cadena es maravillosa por donde se la mire. Gracias a toda la familia Melia por todo, volveremos!

reviews.author: Fernanda D
reviews.title: MARAVILHOSO
reviews.text:
O hotel é muito bom, quase perfeito. Sua estrutura é enorme, os restaurantes são ótimos!
Durante o dia, é servido um buffet na piscina de snacks muito bom, tem bares por todo canto.
O quarto é excelente, amplo, com uma vista maravilhosa para o mar. O banheiro também é otimo. o hotel é super limpo, os funcionarios muito prestativos e simpaticos. 
A piscina é o ponto forte, enorme, colada na praia.
O unico ponto que deixa a desejar é que não tem piscina aquecida, e que a noite nenhuma piscina funciona.
No mais é 10, super recomedo.

reviews.author: Carly L
reviews.title: The outside beat's all!!
reviews.text:
We went to stay at the Paradisus Cancun this last week and I will for beginners say the outside area was to die for! Between the extremely clean pool and one of the cleanest beaches I have ever stepped foot on, outside was where you want to be. Upon arriving, there was an extremely strong lavender smell that was outright overwhelming. The smell was meant to be relaxing, but in my opinion it was over the top the entire trip. The rooms were very clean and housekeeping did a great job the entire five days we were there. The towels and water wasn't always replenished upon getting back to the room each day, but the service in getting us those items quickly was fantastic! I recommend any building other than building 3. Building 3 overlooks everything in the main area, but the music during dinner and then when the club is open is out of control loud! Very annoying.

Food...the buffet was strong. Plenty of items to choose from each meal...the key to going to the buffet is going when it is during key hours so the food is fresh and warm. Went to three different restaurants and the Mediterranean restaurant was very good! The drinks were served quickly outside and they were good. I did however see the glasses be just hand washed with water while we were sitting at the pool bar and that was a HUGE turnoff! Not very clean!

Outside each day, the little mini tiki huts that sit over the lawn chairs are the most popular place to be. I had to get up at 6am to get one every morning and even then they were mostly claimed. However, they are worth it...the sun is SO POWERFUL we needed shade and they provide both. On that note, bring strong sunscreen...the sunscreen in the gift shop at the hotel was about $40. I repeat $40! Anything in the gift shop as far as the sunscreen, the snacks and little nick nacks were outrageous! Make sure you bring anything extra you need! All inclusive is great, unless you need something you didn't bring!

reviews.author: Anastasiya S
reviews.title: Not Impressed
reviews.text:
My friends and I stayed at Paradisus Cancun from March 1st to March 7th. We purchased the Royal Service Package and the service was not that royal at all. The hotel is huge and is divided into 5 pyramids. We stayed in Pyramid 5. 

The hotel itself is beautiful inside and out. However, the service -- not so much. Room service was slow and almost always unresponsive. The restaurants which we booked when we first moved in had good food but we waited for an hour and a half to get our food in Fuego and the sushi in Bana tasted like rubber. They weren't fresh and tasted horrible. For my friend's birthday we had dinner reservations at Tempo at 8pm, we waited for an hour to get our table and another hour for our food. The buffet food was the same everyday and was not always fresh. 

Having visited many resorts in Cancun, Los Cabos, and the Caribbean' we have witnessed exceptional service in almost all. However, we were disappointed at Paradisus. 

ONE Exception: At Naos buffet, we had one server that we stuck to the whole vacation because his service was EXCEPTIONAL!!! His name is Jesus Arzeta. What a great guy! He is very engaging and entertaining, always made jokes with us and made us laugh. Besides, he is very fast and helpful. Whatever we needed, he brought it within minutes. Really, the best service in the whole resort!!! Such a friendly and well-mannered individual!!! During our last day he even brought us souvenirs from Cancun to say thank you for staying there and wishing us a safe trip. It warms my heart to know there are people who actually love their jobs and wish to make others happy! THANK YOU JESUS! You rock!!!!!

-Anastasiya

reviews.author: Mishutka56
reviews.title: Great hotel! Amazing holidays
reviews.text: We were with friends in February 2014. Everything was just super! Nice and friendly staff, great food , good alcohol and a lot of entertainment programs in the evening. Also highly recommend to visit some cities close to Cancun, i.e. Tulum or playa del Carmen. We spent amazing 2 weeks in Mexico, so we will definitely come back there! P.S. if you are not lazy and like to keep fit even in all inclusive hotel , then you definitely need to go to the gym in hotel. They have a lot of machines and good choices of morning trainings (around 9 am). The instructor Aldo is just great! Very nice, friendly and a real professional in what he is doing! So just go and you will enjoy!

reviews.author: Jennifer A
reviews.title: Blown Away
reviews.text: First all inclusive we stayed at and I must say we were blown away. Servive waa outstanding and the beach and pool area was very clean. Rooms were beautiful and we had a gorgeous ocean view! Will return!

reviews.author: Toni Efiah R
reviews.title: Birthday trip to Cancun with Family & Friends
reviews.text: We stayed from February 17-21. The weather was great. We had a room that faced the bay in the front of the hotel. Room was clean and comfortable. When we checked in, it did take a while, but not terribly long. The staff was very friendly and explained the amenities. Had the pleasure of meeting Iran who was very gracious and helpful as well as friendly whenever he saw us always asked how we were doing and if there was anything we needed or that he could do for us. The greenery inside of the hotel is nice and refreshing. We did have poor wifi reception inside of the room which was the only issue we had with the hotel. Nothing that ruined the time there though. The breakfast was delicious and had such a nice variety of options. We had a great server named Isaias who took great care of us. I loved the fresh juice bar! When we were laying out on the beach, Miguel attended to us and continued to make sure we had water and whatever other beverages we wanted. We had our favorite meal inside of Fuego where Hector and Carolina had us laughing and eating great food. Hector explained the menu really well and we loved the version of ceviche from Fuego. We had such a great stay and will definitely come back in the future.

reviews.author: ZKSimone
reviews.title: excelente!!!
reviews.text: Que hotel lindo!!! Limpo, staff atencioso, comida muito boa!!!! O quarto era muito confortável e com uma vista maravilhosa para o mar azul turquesa de Cancun. A piscina também é um ponto fortíssimo do hotel. Recomendo!

reviews.author: wanttobetheir
reviews.title: Nice but not that nice
reviews.text: My friends and I stayed here Feb.15th to the 22nd. We used his time share. To get there we went on a shuttle I had not used before but I will use it all the time now. Canada Transfers was awesome, 3 of us pd when we got to the hotel, had ice cold beers for a buck each and a cold towel. When we arrived we were taken to a lounge and had to wait for a half hour then went to check in. At check in we were told the extra room was more money when they had told us it was included. Not a good start. The rooms were ok. But if your there just for a room and not all incl. stay at the Marriott next door much better rooms. This hotel has a great pool and looks nice inside. But make sure u go down and save a chair really early or u don't get one. The swim up bar gets real busy so the wait is long. They do have good shows at nite but u need to get there 1hr early or no good seats left. If u are not all incl. they treat u pretty bad. We did the all incl. the last 2days so it was a little better. The food was ok. The service at the buffet so so. But the steak resturant was very good and service great. The maid we had was the best, keep the rooms very clean. The weight room and spe were very good. This hotel is ok but I would not want to go back.  Doug (Ut.)

reviews.author: yyt777
reviews.title: Great food, drinks & service
reviews.text:
I just returned from my Cancun vacation at the Paradisus (3/1 - 3/9).  I traveled with a group of 8 adults and everyone was very impressed with the entire experience.   We travel two - three times per year and have stayed at many resorts.  The Paradisus is one of the top rated resort by far. The hotel is very clean, offers a great variety of foods, restaurants with quality liquor.  I've stayed at more pricier hotels for a lot less. The staff is wonderful, extremely hard working and always went out of their way for the customer.  Even the COO was out walking the pool area chatting with customers.  We asked him for a special request and he followed through immediately.  It was also impressive to hear the staff speak very highly of the hotel and the COO-  Which was evident by the service they provided.

I definitely recommend this resort and plan on returning next year.

I want to give praise to Edgar Fabian Perez, Jose, Guillermo, and the COO! 

Keep up the great job!

reviews.author: Joseph R
reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: We were very disappointed with the room we were given at check in. It looked like a garage and the view from the balcony was a wall. We received better accommodations after we expressed our displeasure with the reception desk. It was not the best way to start a relaxing vacation.

reviews.author: Janette300
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Just spend four nights at the Paradisus Cancun.  We did the Royal service.  Sigiro was our private butlet who was awesome.  The room was big great patio very large, service was excellent.  We had a phone that we could call our butler which we didn't even use but nice.  We ate at the Market Grill one night.  The hostess was Giovanna who was very nice and our waiter was Mesero-Nataneal, Luis was excellent.  Food was great.  We also ate at Mole and had 3 guys who came in and played at each table and sung which were awesome.  The beach is great and you can have your on Cabanna.  There is a bar and restaurant at the pool which you can eat at your cabanna or at a table.  Beautiful property and great service.  They also have a spa which we went to the hydo-spa which was relaxing.  Great trip very quiet at the adult pool.  There were children but we didn't see much of them.  Would definitely go back.  They also had entertainment every night.  Had a stocked bar and buffet in our section and room service was great.  Also had turn down service at night.

reviews.author: Donna C
reviews.title: What a vacation!
reviews.text: My sister and I had the best time!  The food was great and the service was excellent.  It was so relaxing sitting by the pool watching the amazing views.  I would definately recommend this hotel. There could have been more lounge chairs and shade areas.  Needed two chairs in the room patio which had a beautiful view of the ocean.

reviews.author: Laurenmari F
reviews.title: Recommended
reviews.text: Everything from the food, pool, beach, hospitality and atmosphere was excellent. It would've been nice to have somewhere to eat for breakfast and lunch outside of the buffet that was included. My only complaint is the bed was uncomfortable but not horrible. I definitely recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Nathy E
reviews.title: El paraíso
reviews.text: Excelente lugar, atención y comida realmente el paraíso!!!!!! La atención muy buena y los detalles en las habitaciones también. El lugar en la playa y los restaurantes de primer nivel, un lugar para disfrutar con la familia y amigos!!!!!!

reviews.author: gcathy g
reviews.title: Great fun in the sun
reviews.text:
This hotel is beautiful. The inside lobby area looked very tropical with a large atrium and hanging vines. A sushi restaurant is nestled right in the middle of the atrium! I think the rooms were very clean but a little dated. Bathroom was nice and updated with rain shower. The beds were lack luster however and so were the pillows. Little lumpy would be the best I could describe. Nice large balcony, only one lounge chair however. The food was fresh and plenty to satisfy every taste bud!
Be prepared to make reservations for all of the specialty restaurants with the exception of Blue Agave and the Buffet that has market grill located in the same area also. Mojitos were excellent and the staff was friendly. My only complaint is that they do not have enough lounge chairs by the pool areas. Every morning was a struggle to find a chair. One of the pool guys were nice enough to go and find us two. Next morning same thing. People must get up at the crack of dawn and secure their chairs with towels and such. Regardless, there still wasn't enough chairs and I also heard a lot of people complaining about the same thing! Overall this is a very nice stay for the price if you don't mind overlooking a couple of things!

reviews.author: Edison C
reviews.title: El hotel es un un paraiso en cancún!!!
reviews.text: El hotel es un paraiso, lo mejor que tiene es el servicio de sus empleados, las habitaciones realmente se descansa, adicional que la aromaterapia que hay en todo el lugar es super chevere, realmente descanse mucho!!!!!

reviews.author: Patricia M
reviews.title: Royal Service
reviews.text: En general muy bueno el servicio del hotel, aunque fui cuando estaban llenísimos y colapsaron en varios aspectos, limpieza de pasillos,  reponer mini bar, no había toldo para todos en la playa.  Favor mejorar conexión WIFI.  En los desayunos el agua hervida es servida tibia y en los almuerzos la comida está tibia casi fría. En las habitaciones hay una silla que generalmente la gente para moverla la arrastra y hace mucho ruido hacia las otras habitaciones.

reviews.author: btruitt
reviews.title: a wonderful experience in cancun
reviews.text: I just returned from a 6 day trip to Paradisus in Cancun, Each year 3 of us go to a different resort or cruise for our girls trip. This year we chose Paradisus in Cancun since neither one of us had been to Cancun. It was one of our best vacations as the people at this resort do everything to make it that way.  From our check-in to check-out it was great. We had a suite with our personal butler (Grace) who i can't say enough about, i thought she had a gps on us because she seemed to know where we were and checked on us through-out our stay making sure everything was up to our expectations. She was a delight to talk to and did an outstanding job. Then there was Juan at the pool who was always there to help with our cabana, towels, drinks etc. He would come around every day with cold towels, fruit kabobs, drinks, cold water, anything we needed. He is an asset to this resort in pool area. If you are thinking of a cancun vacation check out the Paradisus you won't be disappointed.   Truitt Family,   Carolyn Parsons, Jean Powell and Betty Truitt

reviews.author: Gazelle S
reviews.title: Merveilleux sejour
reviews.text:
J'ai logé dans cet hôtel pour une semaine, heureusement la météo était très favorable, 
Ma première fois à cancuń et elle fut inoubliable, la première chose qui m.a attiré est le service très chaleureux, toujours disponibles et ont répondu à toutes nos attentes, 
Spécialement au bord de la mer, je remercie tout le personnel de cet hôtel pour sa disponibilité et spécialement Fred Boutouba, un merci spécial pour son professionnalisme et son hospitalité 
Je vous recommande cet hôtel, une expérience à vivre

reviews.author: lorenahr
reviews.title: DE NUEVO EXCELENTE PARADISUS
reviews.text: Acabo de viajar por tercera vez a este hotel y cada vez me sorprende mas! El buffete que siempre ha sido muy bueno ahora es excelente... Y que decir del servicio...Lo mejor! a diferencia de otros hoteles todo incluido en los cuales el servicio es pesimo aqui se puede decir que el staff es detallista, amable y se anticipa a tus necesidades.Instalaciones modernas y el royal service un plus vale la pena pagarlo.

reviews.author: hiritos
reviews.title: Good-looking hotel from outside
reviews.text:
Hotel looks nice from outside and public area.
Once you are in the room, back to 80's.
Rooms are very old and tired infrastructure.
Water dosen't drain correctly, furniture very old and needs to be refurbished.
We had opted for royal service.
Only good thing about this was in that area, no kids are allowed. If you want to relax without hearing kids screaming, good choice. Otherwise quite useless.
Most of the staff are very helpful and welcoming.
Special thanks to Victor at royal service concierge and Asencio royal service manager who made our stay better than how it started.

reviews.author: mutzy44
reviews.title: vacation
reviews.text: Great time ..nice staff....very clean...I will go back for sure...There were 4 of us on this trip.The service was fantastic and Royal Service is the way to go.The food was good and a good selection of restaurants..The pools are very clean and beautiful.The beaches are great,just one problem,they need more shade.You got to get up early to save a spot.Been to many hotels and that seems to be the problem where ever we go.The rooms were always had a clean fresh sent when you walked in and the room service was fantastic.I am looking forward to going back next year...

reviews.author: 88granny
reviews.title: Awesome Vacation
reviews.text: This was my first trip to Paradisus Resort & it was one of the best vacations I've been on.  The beach & water were breath taking.  The service, food, & drinks were top notch.  I played golf on their 9 hole course & tho it's small I worked for me.  I'm a average golfer at best so won't complain.  The only restaurant I didn't care for was the Authentic Mexican one.   I can't say the food was bad, I'm just not a fan of authentic Mexican food.  My friend & I stayed on the Lagoon side in the main pyramid.  I was able to see several awesome sunsets.  If I had to complain about anything it would that we were asked numerous times to attend the "timeshare breakfast".  Even when we stated we were not interested, someone would ask again every time we walked by their station.  The booze was top shelf & we were able to get whatever we wanted.  I didn't have one bad drink.  Definitely would go back.

reviews.author: Mishutka56
reviews.title: Бомбический отпуск!!
reviews.text: Даже не буду пытаться описать вкратце как прекрасна Мексика и этот отель, лишь скажу, что нам безумно понравилось, поэтому вернемся обязательно еще раз!! Отель выше всех похвал! Две недели пролетели, как один день! Море теплое, но очень освежающее. Сильные волны, но они нисколечко не уменьшают райского удовольствия от плавания. Отель шикарный, персонал очень дружелюбный, отзывчивый и добрый. Мексиканцы, как народ , просто покорили своим гостеприимством и добротой! Мексика прекрасна! Всем рекомендуем и желаем прекрасного отпуска!

reviews.author: Joan M
reviews.title: Very Friendly and Accomodating Staff
reviews.text:
I have been going to this hotel for several years and have never been disappointed.  The entire staff really does go above and beyond to give you a very pleasant experience.

The grounds are beautiful and kept immaculate , and they take great pride in keeping the common areas the same.  The restaurants and the buffet are very good.  We ate at Mole twice and had two excellent meals.  However, the best meal was at Tempo!   Although there is an additional charge to dine at this restaurant, it is really worth the money spent.  We had the tasting menu (9 or ten courses), along with the wine pairing and it was truly a gourmet experience.  The wait staff (Webster and his assistants) and the manager, Fares, truly are professionals who made sure our service was 5 star.  After our dinner we had the opportunity to speak with the chefs, Ismael and Felipe, further exhancing our experience.  Be sure to stop by this restaurant to see the menu which is displayed in the window.

There are many acitivities each day but one you should not miss if you like wine is the wine tasting with the Sommelier, Carlos.  I subscribe to all the gourmet magazines and consider myself a foodie, however, I learned a great deal from him and it was a very interesting presentation and well worth your time.   He selected the wine pairings for our dinner at Tempo and they were all excellent.  He is very passionate about wine and very knowledgeable.

Paradisus is not one of the newer hotels in Cancun but in my opinion it is a cut above.

reviews.author: Ottertail24
reviews.title: Great experience at the Paradisus
reviews.text: A friend and I stayed at the Paradisus Cancun this past week and I can say it was one of my favorite resorts and I've been traveling to Mexico for 30 years.  We try different resorts and usually get different experiences.  The Paradisus offered great service, good food, and an outstanding beach.  The view when you walk out of the hotel doors toward the beach is just breathtaking.  There was 3 colors of blue waters to greet you.  Then there was the pools on both sides and what more could you ask for?  We stayed in Tower 3 and it was a perfect location.  I certainly can't complain about noise and late night music as it was practically non-existent.  I'm guessing if there is a special event pool side in the evening and you have a nearby ocean view room, I could understand hearing noise.  But I'm guessing those are few and far between.  From what I could see, most bars were closed by 11 and only the Red Lounge (disco) was open late.  (And it gets pretty loud inside there but doesn't seem to filter out into the rest of the hotel.)  The rooms themselves were a little dated and a tad bit musty.  But they were nice size and the views, even on the lagoon side were nice.  I really didn't see any reason to upgrade to royal service as we got plenty of good service in a basic room.  Ocean view would be nice but we were rarely in room except to change and sleep.  Beds were fine and sheet quality good.  Nice, huge bath towels.  Could have used a robe and slippers like we usually see in this quality of hotel.  The food was presented well and the buffet was above average.  Specialty restaurants were good.  Not outstanding but good.  We only noticed one night out of 7 that the service was a bit slow.  I'm a picky eater and found more than enough to make me happy.  The hotel offered free wi-fi which worked well most of the time.  It was spotty on the beach but when it's free, I certainly couldn't complain.  The best part of the hotel was the beach and the water.  It was just such a refreshing view.  The beach lounge chairs were reserved by towels by 8 am so you just have to work on getting a spot early.  The beach itself was large and not crowded.  The waves are strong and you need to be careful.  We saw several people rescued and heard of several more that week.  Staff was quick to respond and you could tell they were well trained to keep a watchful eye.  There are several "drop offs" of sand, both on the beach and in the water.  Nothing to worry about but just need to be careful.  If you have children, you can find a sandbar where this isn't a concern.  And I'm guessing it isn't always that windy.  The wind was welcomed though as it was in the mid to high eighties most of last week.  Weather was great.  Only one afternoon did we experience any clouds or drops of rain. If you are looking for a party hotel, you won't find it here.  Lots of people having fun but most are couples or families looking to get away and relax.  The only negative I really have to say about the hotel is the timeshare people never stopped asking.  When you arrive, you jump out to help you check in and "tell" you about the hotel and the amenities.  After a short time, it's easy to see they want you to participate in their sales pitch/breakfast.  We firmly said no thank you many times during the week.  Even when we made dinner reservations, we were asked again about attending.  (It's free.  You don't have to buy anything.  Don't you want $200 at the spa?)  It actually got to the point where I didn't want to make dinner reservations if I had to say no one more time.  I honestly think the hotel needs to ask ONCE and then if the guest says no, respect that.  We were even approached by staff as we were enjoying a drink and asked about our stay but as the conversation went on, you knew they were trying to get you to give enough information about yourself for the timeshare conversation.  Management really needs to work on this as I felt this was a big turn off. The entertainment at night was good to great but it would be more enjoyable if the space was larger and more people could view.  For a hotel of that size, I would like to think they have other alternatives.  The bar service was good and liquor was of good quality and not skimped on as you usually see.  It was a nice touch to be able to have a waiter on the beach.  It's so appreciated by the guests. I'm not sure there really is a reason to upgrade to royal service unless you can easily afford it.  We walked over to Royal section in the hotel and we didn't see a sole except some workers at a desk.  They have their own "lobby" and special treats but we didn't see anyone enjoying it.  I'm guessing having the pool and your own bar is a nice treat though.  Everything is just so convenient in building 3 that I'm not sure I'd want to be anyplace else.  Overall, it was a great hotel and one of the few I'd probably visit a second time.  We never once left the hotel in the 8 days were were there.  But we are beach people so that was the highlight for me.  My friend golfed at the hotel.  It's right out front.  I believe it was $10 to rent the clubs and another $8 for the pull cart.  It wasn't anything fancy but will give you a cheap place to golf in Mexico just so you can say you did.  We used USA Transfer for private shuttle and it was well worth it.  Our flight was late but they have drivers standing by it seems so once we found our guy with the USA Transfer sign, we were off on our way in about 5-10 minutes. They were right on time too, when we departed.  Friendly and reliable is what we experienced.  If you get the opportunity to stay at the Paradisus, I don't think you will be disappointed.

reviews.author: Kateenelson
reviews.title: Beautiful, but disappointing food
reviews.text: My husband and I have been to several resorts and this one was up there in how beautiful it was and the service was good, but the food was not great. The buffet was not very good, the mole a la carte was not good either. The sushi a la carte was very good though, as well as the market grill and fuego were pretty good. The entertainment shows were good, but the location is terrible. They don't have a stage, it's just in a bar and it's hard to get seats where you can see the whole show. The service was great, staff is very friendly and the snack bars were awesome!

reviews.author: GustaZugaro
reviews.title: Excelente estadía
reviews.text: Quiero agradecer mucho la atención que hemos tenido en el hotel, empezando por Orlando el mesero del buffet, hasta Daniel, el mesero de la alberca...una playa increíble, en un hotel, que a pesar de ser muy tranquilo, la hemos pasado de maravillas...

reviews.author: 129dea
reviews.title: Worth every penny!
reviews.text:
Recently stayed at Paradisus for 3 nights and it was a great stay!!  From the moment you reach the front doors you're treated great and you realize what you're paying for.  The environment is very zen and calming.  The views from all around the hotel (restaurants/rooms) are indescribable.  The beach and the pool - So Amazing!!

All the staff I came in contact with were very friendly and always willing to help!  The food was great in my opinion for an all inclusive spot.  It's nice that they have different restaurants you can go to, so you don't feel like you're eating the same food everyday.  Don't even get me started on the drinks..they were all great!  Although what was included in the "all inclusive" alcohol sometimes varied by restaurant/bar, which I guess is a little odd, but there were always some good options and more than I would expect!

The reason I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 was b/c there were little things here and there, like the phone in our room smelled AWFUL!  I also never asked anyone to clean it, so that's my fault it never got fixed, but it was literally repulsive and smelled like it hadn't been cleaned since it was first plugged in.  Also we asked for some towels which never showed.  Also the main reason for me taking away 1 star was that the lights went out on us on several occasions!!?  I'm not sure what the reason was, but it was a little frustrating when you're trying to get ready or taking a shower and the lights go out on you and you Can't get them back on.  It happened to us on at least 3 different occasions...but after I called they would come back on it at least 15ish minutes or so.

All that being said, I'd go back in a heartbeat...I wish I was there right now :)  I know I was hesitant when I was first booking/deciding where to stay because of the price and I haven't had the best "all inclusive" experiences in the past - but this was GREAT!!  If you try to keep most of your meals on the resort and get your drinks in when you want, it's definitely worth every penny!

reviews.author: Carlos F
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text: Nada como recarregar as baterias  para  começar o ano com alguns dias conhecendo a excelência dos serviços e do atendimento. Conhecendo o serviço você nem precisa sair para conhecer outros locais quando estiver por aqui. Parabéns

reviews.author: funz1915
reviews.title: Awesome weekend!
reviews.text: Went for the weekend with a friend. Loved it! Great beach (could not go in the water) too rough, good food, wonderful staff, good drinks, comfortable room.  We stayed at the resort and enjoyed the beach. Yes I would go back again to this resort with my family.

reviews.author: Rosimeire P
reviews.title: Sensacional
reviews.text:
Ambiente agradável, ótimo tratamento e as instalações muito confortáveis.
O lugar é um sonho, perfeito para férias ou lua de mel. O pacote all inclusive é perfeito e não tive nenhum problema com isso.

reviews.author: TFisha
reviews.title: Очень красивый и комфортный отель!
reviews.text:
Очень большой, красивый отель! Весь отель пахнет непонятно откуда доносящимися прекрасными ароматами! Очень много зелени и цветов!
Персонал на высшем уровне! 
Мы отдыхали с услугой "фэмели консьерж" и у нас был личный менеджер. Выдали телефон для связи с ним в любое время по любому вопросу! 
Идеально подходит для семей с детьми!
Наш личный помошник Hervik выше всех похвал!!! 
Готов помочь по любому вопросу! Когда хотели купить в подарки домой текилы, поехал с нами в свое свободное время в магазин, что бы мы не потерялись и он мог подсказать какая текила лучше, и рассказывал особенности разных видов! 
Всем рекомендуем именно этого менеджера! Hervik стал нам другом! 
Пляж чистый и хороший! 
В отеле много ресторанов включенных в стоимость проживания и есть один ресторан, не входящий в стоимость, там очень крутой шеф-повар, как везде говорят, у него 6 звезд Мишлена! 
Отельем мы довольны! Спокойно, красиво и комфортно!
По вечерам в главной пирамиде то живая музыка, то какие-то шоу и представления.

reviews.author: andres0926
reviews.title: Una gran experiencia! Solo unos pequeños detalles por mejorar.
reviews.text: En general el hotel lleno las expectativas de mi grupo familiar, excelentes instalaciones, los bares y la atencion de la gente estubo muy buena. Los restaurantes excelentes, excepto NAOS que no brindaba variedad en el desayuno, durante los 8 dias de estadia nos ofrecieron los mismos alimentos en los desayunos, cosa que dentro del grupo no nos gusto mucho.  En general el hotel es muy bueno y lo recomiendo para las personas que quieran visitar Cancun. Gracias por acoger a mi grupo familiar y esperamos visitarlos pronto.

reviews.author: Deborah B
reviews.title: My very best vacation yet!!
reviews.text: I truely must say this place is by far the best. Everyone was so friendly and helpful. from breakfast waiters to bar tenders. The swim up bar had  the greatest  personality and had us laughing so much.everyone everywhere was so attentive of you . we went with 7 friends and all of us will for sure want to go back again. And yes, the " Royal Service " is the way to go. that is how they treated us all.. Like Royals:)

reviews.author: Tina M
reviews.title: Good hotel!
reviews.text: The hotel was very nice.  Decent food and drinks.  The staff was very friendly.  We loved the bar in the center of the hotel in between the first floor and floor zero.  The bartenders were awesome!  Ask for the jellyfish shot!

reviews.author: lisakaj88
reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text: We went to the Paradisus Cancun for a friends birthday and had a wonderful time.  Antonio G., Octavio and Jose were very good to us and helped with all our needs.  We were greeted the moment we stepped out of the van from the airport.  Everyone was very friendly and always greeted us with smiles.  The pool is beautiful and the staff were always coming to ask us if we wanted anything to drink or eat.  The food and drinks were very good. Our ocean view room was just beautiful. It was so nice opening up the glass door in the morning to hear the ocean and feel the breeze.  Royal service is the way to go at this resort.  Our group is planning to return there next year as we really enjoyed ourselves.

reviews.author: Rocky49009
reviews.title: All Inclusive what a way to go
reviews.text:
Our trip was sooo relaxing. It was great to not have to worry about carrying around cash or credit cards at our stay. (Although, we did take extra for tips, even if it was included. Cuz its just the way we roll.) 
Shopped one day, did 2 excursions. Booked with Etienne, the friendly good looking Frenchman. We did the Tulum Jungle Maya and Israel was our funny informative guide. These two gentleman were 5 star in themselves. 
The other trip was right down the street from our hotel we drove speed boats out to the coral reef, Alex was our guide, he was quite the funny informative man also. 
Shopping is another story some of the store owners are very pushy but hey guess that's how they make there living. Probably will not go back to do that again.

The accommodations were 5 star. We would of did the spa thing but thought it was over price, even if they offered a special everyday. But of course I really have no idea what the going rate is for spa service these days.  Juanito was our go to dude for butler service, was a very interesting informative guy, if there is a return will most likely ask for him :)
David at the pool was awesome, even the one day of bad weather, he had a smile on his face and got our Bali bed ready, we put him in charge of getting the weather to straighten out, it didn't quite happen but he did put up a awesome rainbow out our 5th floor room facing the beautiful blue ocean. 
The whole staff was so accommodating, always a smile, and hey can I help you. 
Please if you get the chance book here and do it all inclusive. All eating places were good except the steak place the cuts of meat there aren't quite up to par, but the salad bar made up for it.
All places are casual dress except for one. If you plan to take your family they have separate place in the hotel for you. And it looks like the kids do have fun. There are a lot of activities for all ages during the day to do, along with exercises. Oh and you can't beat the weather. 
Enjoy

reviews.author: Dario Chiodi
reviews.title: Paradisus dove regna l'eccellenza
reviews.text:
E' da un giorno che siamo tornati dalla ns stupenda vacanza e già la nostalgia ci opprime.
Abbiamo trascorso una settimana al Paradisus insieme ai ns cari amici e compagni di mille avventure (Marco e Giovanna) in formula Royal alloggiando in junior suite fronte oceano.
Difficile descrivere l'atmosfera surreale appena giunti nella lobby, profumi, colori e suoni immersi in giardini tropicali incastonati nella struttura.
L'accoglienza da parte del personale è stata regale e nel contempo deliziosa e famigliare.
Colazione e pranzo a buffet al ristorante Naos veramente abbondante e di ottima qualità supportato da personale qualificato e simpatico sempre disponibilissimo.
Per quanto riguarda la cena i 6 ristoranti venivano prenotati a rotazione dal ns maggiordomo Sergio.
Il Mole ristorante messicano con degustazione di fantastici piatti locali, o al Blues Agave  dove assaggiare strepitose fagitas,tacos e tortillas accompagnate da salse e sopratutto l'immancabile pico de gallo, al Fuego
con piatti di carne e pesce di altissima qualità presentati al tavolo come vere e proprie opere d'arte e che dire del Bana ristorante giapponese con la location immersa nel giardino interno dove assaporate i piatti orientali consigliati da Roberto; Il Vento altro ristorante di altissimo pregio.
La pulizia sempre molto accurata in tutti i luoghi, nelle stanze il personale  passava anche 2/3 volte al giorno per verificare che tutto fosse in ordine; frigobar fornitissimo, macchina caffé Nespresso con rifornimento quotidiano di cialde,a disposizione pure borsa da spiaggia mentre dal balcone con vista mozzafiato sul mare del caribe si assiste a veri e propri spettacoli della natura come albe e tramonti da brividi.
Per gli ospiti in formula Royal  a disposizione una area riservata con piscina e spiaggia attrezzata di lettini e capanne con divani (cabane) e creme solari,personale sempre disponibile a risolvere richieste di snack e bibite dissetanti.
Nella struttura disponibili anche numerosi bar sia all'interno che all'esterno
dove barman simpaticissimi preparano cocktail a base di techila e rum una vera delizia e una piccola ma carina discoteca per due salti in allegria.
Scusatemi se mi sono dilungato, ma per descrivere un vero paradiso era proprio necessario.
Il nostro obiettivo futuro è di ritornarci al più presto.
Un plauso particolare a :
Arturo,David,Isaia,Gerardo,George del Ristorante Grill
Gabriel del Mole
Jonathan del Fuego
Roberto del Bana
E un grazie particolare al nostro maggiordomo Sergio che ci ha(sopportati)una settimana intera

reviews.author: Linda1321
reviews.title: Relaxing Vacation
reviews.text: Just returned from a great vacation at Paradisus.  Initially I was a little hesitant about staying at an "all inclusive" but this place was beyond our expectations.  The only thing that we didn't like was that if you don't reserve a chair with an umbrella by 8am you're not getting one.  Had to get up early every morning and put towels on chairs to reserve them, which you are not supposed to do. Miguel Quinones serves drinks on the beach and in the pool area.  His service was outstanding.  He went above and beyond to make sure we always had whatever we needed.  The room was clean and fully stocked daily.  Would love to come back.

reviews.author: customerconcern
reviews.title: Definitely Want to Return
reviews.text:
Located on the southern part of the hotel zone, Paradisus Cancun is a great resort with good food, wonderful modern decor/ambiance and excellent customer service, especially Mr. F. Boutouba, Mr. R. Flores Koh, Sergio - concierge, Gerardo (Jerry) and Melvin @ Market Grill, Valeria and David @ Naos, Roberto @ Blue Agave, Angel @ Mole, Martin @Fuego, Gal – guest services and Marisol – beach service.  Paradisus Cancun is lucky to have these dedicated and wonderful staff, one of the best customer service experiences we have encountered.  

FOOD 
It was a luxury to have 9 restaurants for dinner to choose from (8 of the 9 restaurants are included in the all-inclusive package), all opened from 6PM-11PM.  We liked that the restaurants stayed open later than other resorts that usually close at 9PM or so.  Only the buffet (Naos) and Blue Agave do not require reservations and the other a la carte restaurants do require reservations, which is a simple phone call from your room the day before you want to dine.  Reservation desk is conveniently open from 7AM-11PM to take reservation phone calls.  You can choose what time you want to dine, instead of fixed times and no need to stand in line early morning like some other resorts to make reservations.
1)  Mole – Mexican contemporary cuisine, gotta try the sea bass w/ the Veracruz sauce 
2) Bana – Asian fusion sushi bar
3) La Perla – steakhouse, try the rib eye steak
4) Fuego – Latin fusion from Peru & Chile, try the corn soup, coffee soup dessert, home-made butter is extremely delicious 
5) Vento – Mediterranean Tapas (appetizers) 
6) Market Grill – Brazilian and Argentinian Grill for dinner, also open from lunch
7) Blue Agrave – simple menu of yummy tacos, tortillas, quesadillas, soups, chips and guacamole and salsa
8) Naos – buffet with rotating options daily for breakfast, lunch and dinner so you don’t get bored eating the same buffet foods, there was always something new and interesting to eat, our favorite was meats/seafood being grilled right in front of you. 
9) Tempo – upscale cuisine, $90/person (not part of the all-inclusive package)

BEACH
Since the resort/hotel is spread out horizontally over 5 pyramid buildings, there is a lot of beach front real estate.  There are plenty of loungers in the sun and for palapas, guest would need to come early.  The beach service was prompt and friendly.  There were no rocks, barely any seaweed in the beach.  Just like all the hotels on the southern location of the hotel zone, the currents can be rough and wavy.  We loved that no towel cards were necessary and you can replace your towels as much as you wanted.  We didn’t use the swimming pools so we can’t comment, but we did see a lively swim up bar.

ROOMS/POOLS
We were in the main pyramid #3 (non-royal service) where all the restaurants, lounges, bars, shops, spa/gym, etc… were located.  Check-in was a breeze.  No pressure or long sells pitch for timeshare.  The room decor was nice (just like the pictures) w/ hot coffee maker, great quality extra long bath towels, good sized private balcony and the most comfortable bed ever (slept so well).  Room cleaning was 2x/day including an evening turn down service.  24-hours room service was prompt .  Some other reviewers mentioned loud music playing late night, but we didn’t encounter this problem.  One night, we did hear some music and luckily the AC tuned it out so we barely heard the music.  Another common question is if you should upgrade to Royal Service or not, we never tried the Royal Service so we can’t compare.  However, we did not feel we missed out by not upgrading to Royal Service and were extremely pleased with our experiences.

ENTERTAINMENT/GYM
Nightly entertainment was on the floor of the Avenue Bar starting at 8:30PM.  We watched the 70s show, circus show (our favorite) and Michael Jackson show, all were very entertaining and enjoyable.   As for the gym, located next to the spa, had a decent variety of Life Fitness machines,  flat screen TVs and satisfactory work out music.

LOCATION
Public bus right in front of hotel for 9.5 pesos or 1 USD one-way, across from Aqua World, and approx. 15-20 mins. from the airport.

INTERNET
Free Wi-Fi, good Wi-Fi signal in lobby, average Wi-Fi signal to room, okay Wi-Fi signal at beach.  We were told that the hotel is in the process of upgrading and improving their Wi-Fi strength.  

We vacation in the Cancun area often and have tried several hotels in the area.   Thank you again for your superior customer service.  We definitely want to come back this marvelous hotel and tell everyone we know you will be happy here.

reviews.author: Luxin88
reviews.title: Perfeito
reviews.text: Viagem perfeita, hotel perfeito, comida perfeita, praia perfeita, atendimento perfeito!!! Foi tudo maravilhoso, o lugar é incrivel, não tenho absolutamente nada para reclamar. O atendimento no hotel é incrivel, com destaque para os atendentes do NAOS, Isaias Vuzquez e Jesus, que ficam no café da manhã. Se tornaram amigos!!!! Com certeza voltarei!!!! Melhor viagem da minha vida!!!!

reviews.author: André D
reviews.title: Boa pedida!!!
reviews.text: Hotel bem localizado e ótima área de lazer, linda vista para o mar e um bom serviço de praia, incluindo um bar ali.Ótimo café da manhã com muitas opções e variado, tudo muito limpo e organizado, excelentes acomodações, recomendo.

reviews.author: Julie L
reviews.title: Great experience!
reviews.text: Hotel facilities are just great! The food is also beyond expectations.  I enjoyed my vacation there and would definitely recommend it to my friends and family! The only thing is the efficiency and accuracy of check-in service: they gave me the wrong key to the wrong room with other guests still in it..

reviews.author: TonyDM
reviews.title: Best Hotel we have visited
reviews.text:
The hotel is lovely, staff are lovely, food is lovely. If you are just a couple, go for the royal service - pyramid 5, private pools, cabanas, no children etc, massive private part of the beach. So many lovely restaurants and even the buffet food in the day was excellent - the steaks were gorgeous!

Extra special thanks goes to Sergio - our butler in pyramid 5 and the Cabana booking staff esp David and waiting staff in the royal service pool area - those guys work all day in the scorching heat to make your day perfect!

All of the staff there are lovely, we had one slight room issue at one point, we mentioned it to staff and had a team in the room within minutes sorting it out.

reviews.author: Ly T
reviews.title: BAD WEATHER GREAT SERVICES
reviews.text: We love our butler Hector and our pool server, Javier Salsazar.  We have bad weather but their services make up for it.  The shows was entertaining.  The staffs work very hard, we did not have to wait for anything.  It was worth it to get Royal services.  The only thing that I wish the hotel have better internet connection.

reviews.author: Hannouna2014
reviews.title: Maravilloso !!!!!
reviews.text:
Avant de partir à Paradisus hôtel, j'avais lu un commentaire sur TripAdvisor d'une personne qui avait écrit:  j'ai laissé mon cœur la bas et je dois repartir le récupérer.. alors c'était la même sensation pour moi...
Je viens de rentrer d'un merveilleux séjours à Paradisus Cancun, un Resort  qui a répondu à toutes mes exigences professionnelles ainsi que personnelles....
Personnels aux petits soins, souriants, chaleureux, attentionnés, serviables......
mon amie et moi nous avons eu la chance de résider (le Royale service) une partie de l'hôtel réservée aux clients VIP, 
Les avantages du Royal Service: Service plus personnalisé, intimité, check-in et check-out au sein du bâtiment Royal Service, Buffet servis tout au long de la journée, accès free au magnifique jacuzzi, massages aux jets d'eau, Sauna et salle à vapeur, plage privée sur laquelle vous ne sentirez surtout pas soif :) avant de finir ton cocktail tu trouveras le serveur qui te surprend souriant par un autre en se rappelant de tes préférences, au moment du repas il te recommande les suggestions du jour et le repas vous sera servis l'heure demandée sur la plage même...
Paradisus est un Resort romantique, intime, paradisiaque avec une magnifique plage turquoise, sable blanc frais et surtout très propre avec un service parfait soit pour la partie réservée au Royal Service ou la partie normale de l'hôtel...
Paradisus Chacun est un resort qui peut être visiter entre amis, en famille en amoureux et même en Solo sans sentir cette expression ;) le personnel est tellement chaleureux, il ne vous laisseront jamais vous sentir Solo ...
Parlant bouf: en plus du magnifique buffet international, l'hôtel possède 13 restaurants à la carte chacun avec une spécialité différente dont le restaurant Tempo  géré par un chef étoilé récompensé par Michelin à lesquels il faut effectuer des réservations avant 17H00 ... 

je suis un agent de voyage spécialisé en tourisme de luxe et d'affaire, Le Paradisus est un resort à lequel j'y reviendrai et je suggèrerai à mes clients VIP en toute confiance...

reviews.author: Mo A
reviews.title: Great Entertainment, Great Food, Great Vacation
reviews.text: This is my second time to Paradisus and I’m happy to say that I would never go to any other resort in Cancun besides this one.  I visited the resort with a group of friends and we all had an excellent time.  We ate delicious foods for every meal of every day and enjoyed fantastic activities on a daily basis.  The entertainment crew at Paradisus are second to none.  Each day they provide fun activities for guests to participate in.  One member of the crew, Diego went out of his way to ensure that the guests enjoyed their stay at the hotel by organizing fun filled activities such as sushi making classes, dance classes, volley ball games, etc.  With the weather not cooperating as much as we would of liked, Diego and team still did an outstanding job by ensuring the guests had the option to partake in fun filled indoor activities.  The room service crew also does an outstanding job by ensuring our rooms are kept tidy each and every day.  I truly enjoy staying at the Paradisus and would highly recommend it to anyone visiting Cancun.

reviews.author: 224Cheri
reviews.title: Girls Birthday Week in Cancun
reviews.text: Thanks to Carolos Lopez and Edgar Mesrios - morning servers at Naos Restaurant. Excellent service and great representatives of the property. Even though it rained for most of the trip, the hotel was of great quality and made the grey skies much more tolerable.

reviews.author: Ghizou08
reviews.title: Just amazing!!!!
reviews.text:
J'y étais du 29 déc au 04 janvier...j'ai passé le meilleur séjour de ma vie... L'hôtel est génial..spécialement le royal service...chambres très sympas..avec tout le confort...et la chose qui m'a marqué le plus était l'accueil a l'arrivée de l'hôtel...le personnel très sympa et accueillant.. Aux petits soins a tout moment de la journée..ils ont une manière très agréable pour nous saluer...une très agréable surprise pour moi qui visite le Mexique pour la première fois...j'ai bien profité des journées de soleil auxquelles j'ai eu droit au bord de la belle plage turquoise..sirotant les délicieux cocktails proposés par les serveurs toujours souriants..mon amie et moi n'avions même pas besoin de demander qu'il nous servait nos cocktails préférés, la touche personnalisée très importante lorsqu'on se trouve dans un hôtel en all inclusive.. 
Je salue tout le personnel de cet hôtel qui a fait de mon séjour un des plus agréable moments de ma vie..,

reviews.author: jetsetter82_11
reviews.title: DECENT for the price but never again
reviews.text:
- same ol' food, majority buffet
- minimal selection
- watered down liquor
- amazing beach front
- decent pool 
- no music
- very lame energy
- nice wait staff but no service at the pool unless we stood @ bar
- great scenery in hotel but we were 22 ppl and they had us spread out between the entire hotel
- def recommend coco bongo nightclub
- they also have cabana section w hookah to the left of the pool, def worth checking out

reviews.author: Kevin B
reviews.title: Should have stayed at moon palace
reviews.text:
Where do I begin?? When we arrived, we were greeted and taken to family concierge. After waiting for almost three hours, we finally had our rooms...the wrong rooms. The first room we were taken to was occupied and when they opened the door, there was a man laying on the bed. The second room was dirty and the third room was not even close to the room we had booked, not to mention that the pyramid shape of the hotel made your room a weird shape and space was hard to come by. 

The room service was so slow that by the time the food got to your room, it was cold. How did they know I like to eat cold eggs for breakfast? They didn't have the best food selection at any of the restaurants, I mean, if you like to eat the same thing for a week straight, this hotel is for you. Variety is obviously not a word that they know.

The staff overall sucked. If you had a question or problem & needed to address it, they would look at you like you were insane. It was a "do it yourself" attitude the staff had. The girls in the kids zone rarely interacted with the kids and when they did it was to yell at the kids. That's just what I want, someone yelling at my kids on their vacation because they want to have fun. If you don't like your job, quit!! Housekeeping was awful!! We left for the beach early one morning, a few hours later we headed back to our room. The beds were made nicely, the room had been picked up, but...there were no fresh towels in the room & after a day at the beach, you need clean dry towels. I will say that the female housekeepers did a better job than the guys!!

I could go on forever as to why you should spend your money elsewhere, but I won't. I will say that Karla in family concierge was a true blessing. She is one amazing lady and that hotel does not deserve her!! Love you Karla! Thank you for everything!!

reviews.author: eelacina
reviews.title: Excellent resort but one concern
reviews.text:
We visited Paradisus for one week starting 07-th December 2013. It was really an amazing place and I would definitely recommend this resort to any family with kids. 

AMAZING evening entertainment, among the best I’ve seen at any resort.  Especially noteworthy was the Flamenco dancer and her musical accompaniment.  I was truly in tears after watching this beautiful girl performing Flamenco dances.  I would go back to this resort just to see her dance again.  The other entertainment venues were also very good.  I especially enjoyed the acrobats, I felt they were as good as the acrobats in Cirque du Soleil.

I really liked this resort for wonderful people, the very good entertainment, the food and service.  There was one girl working at the lobby by the name of LLUVIA and in my opinion she was exceptional. I approached her many times with different questions and each time she answered with smile on her face. I also talked to the Operations Manager Fred Boutouba, he was very professional and willing to help any time and any way.

Thank you guys for such a great experience at your Hotel. You definitely have made a difference.

The only concern I had with my stay was with the pool-side bar.  I had a talk with the service desk because I was concerned that children ( 6 or 7 years old) were sitting at the swim up bar and being served by the bartender with non-alcoholic beverages alongside adults being served alcohol. The representative said that this was OK and that the parents are responsible to take care of their children. 

A few days later I am sitting at the poolside bar with my friend and on the opposite side were two young girls about 8 years old. The bar was not busy on the pool side so the bartender wasn’t paying much attention (in fact he wasn’t behind the bar for a few minutes).  There was an unfinished Pina Colada sitting on the bar that was about three quarter full. The girls became  interested and as I watched the first girl took a sip and made a face at the taste of alcohol, then both girls took another sip of the drink. 

It did not look like they were enjoying it but just being curious. I assumed the parents were watching because I would never leave my child unattended at an adult bar. I am not comfortable with underage children being served at the same bar that serves adults, even if they are given non-alcoholic beverages.  The chances of a child getting access to alcohol are too high, and having young children around intoxicated adults is not safe.  I have been to many resorts and normally children are kept separated from areas serving alcohol, especially for poolside bars.  I hope the Paradisus will review their policy and  encourage parents to keep their children in the designated family areas.

reviews.author: Marcela
reviews.title: Super recomendo!
reviews.text: Fui no réveillon de 2012/2013! O hotel não decepcionou em nenhum aspecto. O quarto era moderno, espaçoso e confortável. Nossa suite era de frente para o mar, a vista é magnifica! Os restaurantes são todos lindos (destaque para o japonês) e servem as mais variadas especialidades. A comida é boa! O serviço de praia e a área da piscina são ótimos e agradáveis. Há garçom até mesmo na praia - servindo bebidas e comidas do all inclusive. O lobby bar também é lindo!!!! Não dá vontade de sair do hotel! Voltarei com certeza!!!!

reviews.author: Juan L
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun is a excellent hotel!
reviews.text: We had a four days of conference in this hotel before Christmas and few days of vacation  after  Christmas . We are very happy to tell you: Paradisus Cancun is a excellent hotel ! The hotel has a beautiful beach site to enjoy ;The room was clean and big enough;  Most important thing is: the hotel staff  were very friendly and helpful. One day before our departure ,when we were waiting  bus to  pick up us at hotel lobby. we found out that our agent booked a wrong date for our whole day trip  . (on our departure date!) When we ask for help,hotel front desk stuff called agency right away and changed the trip date for us (We don't know how to deal with it ).He called a taxi for us and sent us to bus station of travel agent .Thanks again for your help! We liked the food in this hotel, specially ,the "Lao"  international buffet. Fresh, tasty and have a lot of kind of food to chose from.

reviews.author: Javier G
reviews.title: Paradisus cancun
reviews.text:
Se les olvidaron las personas mayores en el diseño del hotel. tiene un olor muy peculiar e intenso (como a incienso).
Por otro lado es muy grande... el servicio del personal es muy bueno, son muy amables (excepto los del bar de la alberca).

reviews.author: Andrea N
reviews.title: Paradisius Cancun
reviews.text: This place was beautiful. The staff is so sweet and will literally get you anything you need. My favorite part was the fact that you walk out the doors directly to the beach. The pools are also right next to the ocean which was really nice. I would definitely go back here again.

reviews.author: Ilysa R
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort and Incredible Service by Wonderful Staff
reviews.text: From top to bottom this resort is perfect for any vacation type.  The food was excellent, the beach was beautiful and there are a variety of pools to choose from.  The hotel is gorgeous during the day and at night and has everything you could need at your fingertips.  The staff is extremely welcoming and always at your service.

reviews.author: Eamon L
reviews.title: Power-disus!
reviews.text: We traveled here for a company holiday trip/party.  We had an excellent time.  The weather cleared up and remained beautiful for four days.  The pools were pristine and the beach was beautiful.  The service was great!

reviews.author: Christopher C
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: I enjoyed every minute of my 5 day trip to this resort and would recommend it to anyone. The restaurants were top notch and the service was better. Excellent experience!! I highly recommend  staying in the Royal Services section of the hotel and taking full advantage of their excellent hospitality!

reviews.author: AnttC21
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: The staff was incredible, the food was amazing and the hotel was pristine. I would definitely suggest going with an all inclusive plan as most meals were very pricey, but not short on taste. Overall great experience

reviews.author: PowerOM
reviews.title: Beautiful, clean, can't wait to go back
reviews.text:
I visited in December with my company, and we rented out almost the entire resort- that's right, 1200 of us.  The staff was very patient and courteous (albeit often a bit confused) and dealt with our large group graciously.  The rooms are spectacular and each one has at least one balcony with great views.  The rooms felt clean and were a nice size. 
A few people's rooms had electrical problems and the AC didn't work well/at all in a few others- the whole hotel is quite humid because of all the greenery inside.  I didn't mind but some might.  The food is where they lose one star.  It was okay, not bad, nothing special though.
Overall I definitely recommend this place!

reviews.author: Daniel S
reviews.title: This resort is STRONG
reviews.text: My Stay at this resort was simply incredible. I was surrounded by beautiful views excellent food and A+ staff, what a wonderful experience. I will definitely be back and would absolutely recommend staying here if traveling to Cancun!

reviews.author: Christopher L
reviews.title: All about the Service. 5 Stars.
reviews.text:
The staff is friendly, helpful, and fast. This resort has nightlife, amazing food, and is conveniently located only minutes away from downtown shopping and more nightlife. I will probably never in my life order 45 shots of tequila again let alone at a swim up bar. Samuel and Gerson need a raise!

Accommodating and relaxing, best vacation ever.  Room service chicken wings best I've ever had. That's saying A lot.

reviews.author: Dani A
reviews.title: Pelo preço atendimento pessimo e comida e atendimento dos restaurantes a desejar
reviews.text:
, o hotel é bem estruturado, quartos bons e limpos e impressiona a sua dimensão.

Mas seguem alguns pontos que não foram bons:

1-	Chegamos ao hotel e não tinha nosso quarto disponível, precisamos aguardar 1h30 a desocupação e limpeza do mesmo;
2-	Após viagem de 12 horas queria tomar um banho, mais 1 h para a bagagem ser entregue no quarto. Depois de muitas ligações na recepção foram entregues;
3-	Todos os restaurantes do hotel que exigiam reserva (ou seja todos, exceto o internacional), todos sem exceção fomos muito mal atendidos. Ofereciam de cara um cardápio pago, fora do nosso pacote previamente contratado, quando solicitávamos o menu do hotel, falávamos com os garçons e eles continuavam andando de costas ignorando nossa necessidade. Tratados como cachorro mesmo.
4-	Há no hotel um serviço de concierge, diferente do nome, são uns 10 profissionais que te barram diariamente nos corredores do hotel querendo vender proposta de clube. Isto acaba não deixando o hospede a vontade, incomodando a toda hora.
5-	A proposta de venda e pacotes da equipe da nascimento (best day) que conhecemos no transfer muito mais cara do que a da equipe da mesma empresa que fica no hotel.

Somente no restaurante internacional fomos muito bem atendidos. Nos demais uma porcaria, comida de péssima qualidade e tudo muito regulado. Pelo preço achei que deixou a desejar bastante.

reviews.author: irene
reviews.title: now I really know what "let yourself be pampered" means))
reviews.text:
excellent hotel (royal service)!, extremely friendly stuff, ha, after coming back home i stiil couldn't help greeting people around with "hola" and smiling, just like they did in Paradisus, Excellent beach bar (Octavio, the waiter, Hola))) Strongly recommend to try local mochito with basil (not traditional mint) from Francisco,  the barman.If you do go there, don't be stingy, get yourself an ocean view room (i had 3018, breathtaking!!!) 
Beach bar is excellent, no need to go to Naos - the mail restaurant - just in case you'll let your hair loose and won't be able to help overeating - you can enjoy a nice meal at the beach bar... - Alex, the chef, respect!
But the sea beats all - it's turquoise colour, rough, salty , but veeery clean.
Special thnks to the Pyramid 5  team - Victor, Aidee, hector and Natalia, very efficeint and just  nice guys))
Wnanna come back one day, Hola!

reviews.author: Mylynn J
reviews.title: Paradisus-beyond comparison.
reviews.text:
This place is beyond comparison.  We were a group of twelve, and more one problem with serving so many.  We felt like royalty.  
Hector and the activities crew were wonderful.  He made us feel like he was looking forward to seeing us daily.  He would take the time to visit and hang out with us.  Josie was also wonderful.  Played volleyball with our group daily.  Go Minnesota!
Miguel served us on the beach.  Fantastic.  He would arrive with water and drinks before we could ask.  He would remember all our favorites and have them in our hands before we could blink. Awesome! 
I've never been somewhere that I've seen such excellent working attitudes.  Not one employee was seen without a smile, not one! Makes Minnesota nice look a bit drab. 
I recommend this place like no other.

reviews.author: David F
reviews.title: Nice resort
reviews.text:
We had a nice week at the Paradisus Resort Club Melia. The staff in the restaurants and buffet where excellent. The food was very good at most eatery's with the 'Vento' being the least favorite and the 'Market Grill' for dinner was the favorite. The buffet was very good for breakfast and lunch. It would be nice if the resort offered a taco or small burrito by the pool area's. Hotdogs and hamburgers where good for the kids near the pool and the service around the pool was excellent. 
The resort offers non motorized water sports across the street, paddle boats and kayaks, not very convenient. It would have been nice if the resort offered a 'boogie board' to play in the surf. 
We had a large one bedroom two bath suite with nice amenities. We had to call twice for the mini bar to be restocked during our stay but they did respond quickly to correct the problem. 
We did have a problem receiving service from our concierge, she didn't respond to our requests for transportation information after stating she would "get back to us before noon". We didn't see her for the rest of our stay.
It would be nice if the hotel had a stage/theater for the shows they performed as they used a small open area in the Avenue bar and is not conducive to viewing.
This is a nice resort but needs to improve on their cleanliness of rooms and concierge service.

reviews.author: Pat A
reviews.title: Amazing and Friendly
reviews.text: My husband and I and my sister and bother-in-law spent a relaxing week at the Paradisus Resort Club Melia.  From the moment we arrived the staff was friendly and most accommodating.  The hotel is beautiful and as soon as you arrive the smell is amazing, like flowers!  We had a two bedroom unit with living room and kitchen.  It was very comfortable and way more space than we actually needed, but so nice.  We had the all inclusive and the food and beverages were very good.  We especially enjoyed the service of Jaime and Jaime at the NAOS Restaurant.  They were so friendly and attentive to us during our meals.  All of the restaurants were first class and the food at the Market Grill was excellent.  The pools are outstanding and the service provided was first rate!  I would definitely travel here again.

reviews.author: JCNavarrete80
reviews.title: No me gusto
reviews.text:
Tenía ciertas expectativas de la marca Paradisus pero en esta instalación creo que no se logró o será que así sean todas?.
