En nuestra llegada todo parecía muy bien pues lo primero que me llamo la atención fueron los aromas tanto de la recepción como de ciertas áreas públicas, mismos aromas que me relajaron al hacer cola en dos ocasiones para que me dijeran que mi habitación no estaba lista...tanta espera para que al ver la habitación tan simple y con detalles que delatan la edad/uso del hotel me desilusiono, debo admitir que la ropa de cama era de buena calidad y la cama me pareció cómoda pero el aire acondicionado emitía ruido, el baño tenía tina que además lucía vieja o no te invitaba a usarla, el minibar en la habitación tenía el stock de un hotel promedio y el área de la terraza se veía muy vieja, desgastada y con falta de mantenimiento sin omitir que sólo tenía un sólo camastro cuando deberían ser dos...les mencione que la decoración es muuuuy simple también e incluso uno de los 3 cuadros estaba mal colocado mismo que intente acomodar pero creo que estaba mal colocado el clavo en la tablaroca y mejor ya ni le moví.

El área de albercas estaba aún en trabajos de construcción, así que nos concentramos en el bar, tienen buena selección de bebidas que ofrecen -no la mejor, pero variada y de buena calidad- sin embargo cuando pides o te dicen ya se acabo y ya no tengo más o simple te dicen no hay, que no manejan un standar de bebidas en todos los bares??, que no hacen inventarios para ver que les falta??.

Nos toco ver que un colaborador del hotel tuviera una discusión con un huésped que venía dentro de un grupo de convención de una marca de autos nipones...resulta que el vuelo del huésped (varias personas) salía alrededor de las 7 pm pero habían entregado habitación y seguían en la piscina, recepción no te informa que tu ALL INCLUSIVE se termina a las 12:00 de tu día de salida pero tampoco te quita el brazalete del todo incluido, estas personas pidieron un snack, se los sirvieron y de inmediato les querían cobrar, era lógico que si no te informan un huésped puede reaccionar de diferentes maneras, pero que se pongan a discutir en un área pública frente a más huéspedes...deja mucho que desear, ya con este incidente teníamos antecedente y efectivamente si no preguntas a la hora de hacer check out no te dicen y puedes pasar un rato muy malo.

La parte central del hotel es muy bonita, le corresponde al Restaurant oriental llamado Bana, de inmediato hicimos reserva y llegamos 10 minutos antes de la hora...si mi reserva era a las 18:00 horas, llego a las 17:50, no vemos ningún/a host y preguntamos en el bar del lugar y nos dicen:..."no veo a la host aquí, debe de venir tarde"...si bien vimos que llego todo el personal a las 18:01 ya nuestro trago fue amargo, nos asignaron mesa y ordenamos...no ha sido el mejor sushi de mi vida ni el mejor sashimi además el tiempo de espera del servicio fue demasiado.

En The Market Grill también nos toco algo de desorganización por lo que se podía observar con el personal pero la señorita Dasia en el lunch y Gerardo durante la cena nos atendieron muy bien y de cierta manera su servicio nos hizo pasar una buena comida.

reviews.author: Deena M
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel and Beach
reviews.text: I went on a Girls trip and it was wonderful. We took the all inclusive package; it was like a cruise ship on land.  If you are looking to book this hotel do not hesitate.  I stayed from Nov 18th-22nd.  The weather was hot and sunny despite weather.com claiming clouds and rain.  The hotel is just beautiful, spacious with the palm trees and tiki huts on the ocean.  The beach is wide with powdery white sand.   The food was delicious with a lot of varieties.  The portions are small but this gives you the opportunity to try more things.  You never get bored since there are so many restaurants to choose from. We had no trouble getting reservations at any of the restaurants  but it was the low season.  Vento and Mole were our favorites; we didn't try Tempo.  We stayed in tower two which was a great location to all the restaurants and pool/beach.  The room was a little dated but it was clean and the beds were comfortable. The AC worked but the hotel itself was very warm to the point it was uncomfortable in the restaurants.  We can handle the heat but if you can't this can create an issue.  We didn't get sick on any of the  food; even drank the water in the restaurants. The service was wonderful; everyone is very friendly. When we entered our room the smell of the fragrance was overwhelming but we called the front desk and they took care of it.  We never smelled it again during our stay.  We did use bottle water for brushing our teeth in the room.  There should be more activities especially at night.  It would have been nice to have the outdoor bar open at night with music.  We did not do the Royal Service I think during the low season it is not needed.  I read a lot of the reviews before I booked and I don't agree with the negative reviews.  Everyone can find a problem to complain about but the overall experience was wonderful.

reviews.author: mexicolover131
reviews.title: ABSOLUTE PARADISE!!
reviews.text: This resort is top notch in every way. The hotel is gorgeous, the beach is stunning, the rooms are large, and the beds are very comfortable, food is delicious (even at the buffet), the decor in the hotel is serene and peaceful. Special thank you to Sandra at the buffet for all her hard work and service, Balthazar at the buffet, as well as to our favorite and best server on the beach, the one and only Luis. If you have a chance to hit up a club, I highly recommend Coco Bongo. Enjoy your stay at this amazing hotel, you will love every minute that you're there!

reviews.author: Claudia Monica V
reviews.title: hospitalidad increible
reviews.text: pasamos una semana increíble,no solo por lo lindo y espectacular que es el hotel, sino también por el personal que trabaja allí, desde la recepcion, pasando por los chicos de los restaurantes hasta los que te atendian en la playa,todos super amables, que dan muchas ganas de volver !!! muy recomendable.

reviews.author: Karen M
reviews.title: Our best sisters trip ever!!
reviews.text: Our recent week at Paradisus Cancun could not have been better in any way!!  Going monday to monday proved to be an added bonus as the resort seems to really ramp up with so many more people and kids on the weekends!  Royal service provided the three of us with the utmost in luxury and amenities we have not found in other resorts of this type. Our butler Sergio was amazing and seemed to be everywhere we happened to need him, and surprised us with many extras. He  never forgot even the smallest requests and was meticulous in making sure our chilled wine was in the room each night by 5pm.  David who managed things at the pool and beach greeted us every morning and made sure we reserved the chairs or bali bed of our choice for the next day!! He checked with us during the day to make sure we were happy and had everything we needed. Francisco brought us our food and beverages all day long and we looked forward to his smiling face and happy mood!  We had the dinner at Tempo to celebrate a birthday and it was fantastic. The tasting menu left nothing out and the presentation and timing of each of the six courses was perfect.  A must do at this resort. Each of these people stood out for us during our week, but every staff person we encountered treated us as if we were special and greeted us individually whether we were in the hallways, elevators, or just going from our room to the beach. Which brings me to the beach itself,  which is spectacular. You can walk for miles in either direction and the water is crystal clear for swimming or body surfing!  In all the years Cancun has been building up, they have managed to keep the beauty of the beach unspoiled.  We will be back for our annual sisters trip again next year!!!

reviews.author: Glory L
reviews.title: Holy amazing
reviews.text: This was one of the best vacations so far. The hotel is absolutely beautiful. The lobby is amazing the rooms are very spacious the food was great and the people couldn't have been more accommodating. I will definitely visit this location again. We had the best time.

reviews.author: Sarita K
reviews.title: wonderful service.  comfortable rooms.  great food options.  all inclusive plan is excellent.
reviews.text: spa facilities had lots of non working equipment which should be fixed asap,  but the staff is professional and friendly plus offer excellent spa services.  ask for Yareli for reflexology and hot rock massages and Moises for deep tissue massage.  both are excellent.

reviews.author: Aline v
reviews.title: Paradisus e servicos
reviews.text: Realmente maravilhoso... Paradisus e um paraíso. Adorei o atendimento prestado por Marisol, uma fofa. O hotel tem um cheiro maravilhoso, td muito limpo, garções super eficientes. tornou minhas ferias ainda mais especiais. A Marisol prestou tds as informações necessárias. Adoramos o restaurante de comida japonesa no lougue central maravilhoso.

reviews.author: Alfredo Axayaca... M
reviews.title: Buena Estancia
reviews.text: Bonito mar, excelentes instalaciones y confortable lugar, muy recomendable y familiarmente es una muy buena opcion para hospedarse, esta un poco lejos de la zona de bares pero existen muchos transportes para que te lleven.

reviews.author: Carolyn S
reviews.title: Amazing wk at Paradisus Cancun Royal Svce Oct27-Nov 3'13
reviews.text: We cannot say enough about our wonderful experience Oct 27-03Nov'13. Stayed in the Royal Service pavilion where everyone was so amazing, including Hector (our Butler), David + Octavio (Pool services), Nadia and all the others manning the Royal Service area.  Staff at the entire property all were so HAPPY to make us feel welcome and make sure we enjoyed our stay.  Highly recommend the Paradisus and we would definately go back.  Judy and Carolyn

reviews.author: Santeq629
reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: Cant say anything bad about this place. Food, beach, pool, staff, ALL restaurants and bars were excellent. We never left, if you want wild night life you would want to take the bus and go downtown. At know time were we approached to take a timeshare presentation. I was here on RCI timeshare trade.

reviews.author: s g
reviews.title: Friend and I  Nov 2-9
reviews.text:
Traveled with a friend and we had a great time. Everything went smoothly other then rain, wind, thunder & lightning all day Sunday. The lobby is just so very pretty with 8 floors and plants hanging off every floor growing down. We ate in every restaurant and all were good. Check out the Blue Agave and you can sit at a table or the bar for Tacos and Tequlia. The tacos are to die for and out of this world. Not what you think of if you order a taco in the states ! Free WiFi even on the beach. 

Beach is nice with bar servers and at the pool as well. My only complaint would be there really is not much to do in the evening. There was 3 shows but they do them in Avenue Bar and not much space. So we stayed on the beach until almost dark then did not have to rush as we made later dinner reservations to help pass the night.  Right across the street is Aqua World where you can rent small speed boats, jet skies and etc to use in the harbor. Also a 9 holes executive course right out front. You rent clubs in the store in lobby. Bring your own balls as they want to over charge you for theirs !  

I would like to thanks the following people who went above and beyond to help make our trip wonderful .... THANK YOU = Sofonia Castaneda, Enrigue Alcudia  and Lifeguard Oscar Sanchez (Beach) Guatalupe -(Vento)  Orlando Bello, Gerardo Barrios (Naos) Gabriel Uh Mahay, Alejandro Tuz (Blue Agave) Hector (Fuego) and Barmen Jose Alberto Velez 

Please remember to tip as these folks put in many hours and help to make your stay special               Thanks Paradisus Cancun Resort :0)

reviews.author: Maria Izabella L
reviews.title: O melhor Resort que já fui!
reviews.text: Eu fui quando o hotel ainda se chamava Gran Meliá Cancun. Foi uma experiência única. O hotel é gigante, tem 4 restaurantes, sistema all incluse, piscinas maravilhosas, quartos enormes. A comida era muuito boa também, verdadeiro sabor mexicano. Um ponto negativo: o perfil do hotel está mais para famílias e casais, quem vai com os amigos sente falta de uma programação mais jovem.

reviews.author: Laura S
reviews.title: Birthday!!!
reviews.text:
What fun!! For all ages...however more adults - very few kids. I was with a group of women and we thoroughly enjoyed ourselves. The dining was great, so were the drinks. The pools and beach side were fantastic, and so were the activities. The service was spot on, and so were the drinks. 

Word of caution: avoid the 30 minute tour when you arrive. Who needs a tour? Drop your bags and hit the pool! 

Very easy to get to. Very easy to get around the grounds. Not easy to leave.

reviews.author: Marlayna J
reviews.title: Celebrating 50th
reviews.text:
We are return customers that will not be returning. I have stayed at this same location 5 times, 3 of which were prior to it becoming an all inclusive hotel. This is the first time that I had a bad experience, but it was enough so that I will not return.

We just returned from Paradisus Cancun where we went to celebrate a friends 50th birthday. I hesitated to give service an average. While  our service in the restaurant, poolside, and room service was exceptional, the service at the front desk for check-out, check-in and room key issues was horrible. We arrived Thursday early afternoon and had to wait in the check-in line for 45 minutes to only be told that we had to come back at 3:00 because our room was not ready. We were told that we could go right to the front when we returned to just grab our room keys, but ended up having to wait another 45 minutes. Everyday after our room was serviced (EXCEPTIONALLY), we had to go back down to the front desk - WAIT again, for them to re-program our room keys. Check-out rain similarly. 

The bartenders, servers in the pool area and restaurant staff were as ALWAYS incredibly helpful, always attentive and deserving of tips. The front desk area needs MAJOR renovations in terms of efficiency.

reviews.author: GINA2014
reviews.title: Peace Of Mind...
reviews.text:
Do not hesitate about choosing Paradisus Cancun...Pack your bags and go !!
Just spent 7 days in the Royal Service section and it was all so magnificent.From the lovely "Lu-Lu" at check in, my smiley butler "Samuel" ((SAM)),the terrific servers,fantastic "Octavio" and his side kick "Rogelio" - top notch customer service from all.The rooms are great, grounds are spectacular and the inside decor is breathtaking, not the mention the wonderful pools and Bali beds.A special thank you to"David"at the pool concierge who always ensured our comfort was key.We even opted to stay at the pool daily rather than walk the few steps to the beautiful ocean..We dined at all the restaurants including the buffet and all were phenomenal...Even drank the water,no issues.If your looking for some R & R, Royal Service is a must.Do not adhere to any negative comments about Paradisus Cancun, for it is truly PARADISE.

reviews.author: Gregory L
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun is "hit and miss"
reviews.text: Although the resort is beautiful and the service is friendly, this all-inclusive did not live up to the expectations everyone seems to be giving for this resort. Over 40 members of a wedding party stayed there and we had several mishaps. Appoximately 1/3 of us got stomach sickness and we believe it was related to the buffet, possibly the fruit and lettuce that was washed. Bottles of water are in the room for your coffee and brushing your teeth, but if you are not made aware on DAY ONE that the sink water is not purified, you could end up using this water for drinking purposes-especially if you automatically put your toothbrush under the faucet every morning! Also, be aware that you may have a wait time of up to 15 minutes between 11:00am and 2:00pm at the Registration desk when people are checking in. I experienced this 4 times - once when I was locked out of my room as my key no longer worked and I had to go to Guest Services (and request immediate service since they told me to go to Registration) to prevent waiting in line again. I tried to order champagne and strawberries to be delivered to the bride and groom and it was an extreme effort to get this accomplished as I was sent to various departments and individuals. I was incorrectly informed about the use of a discount coupon and had to wait 15 minutes in line one morning to correct this, only to find out at checkout I had to go through the entire process again. Luckily, I had a printout from the day before and a voice mail on my room phone supporting my position. The spa is not recommended. The bride went for a makeup appointment for one of our dinners and the stylist did not even have eyeliner! One of us tried to show the stylist how the look should be and after the bride was almost in tears, the stylist walked OUT of the salon. We reported this to management. The service at the pool side bar and in some of the restaurants was very good, but I recommend staying away from the buffet and anything that may be washed and not cooked. This was our first all-inclusive resort for some of us and we said we would NOT do it again. I guess every experience is different so I recommend you read all the reviews to get a good idea about this resort. Maybe we just had the "unlucky" experience.

reviews.author: Grigory13
reviews.title: Самое лучшее море, что Я видел.
reviews.text:
Привет. Были в этом отеле зимой. Такого шикарного моря и волн Я не видел никогда и нигде. Кормили просто на убой. Но очень много малолетних американцев. Это очень мешает, когда не знаешь специальные места, где их не бывает. 
Все очень красиво. Флора и фауна просто обалденные. На улице гуляют ягуаны как в Москве кошки))). Ночные тусовки не заканчиваются никогда. 2 раза за 10 дней сгорали шатры на улице)))) приезжали пожарные. У кого окна были на сторону пожара, им не позавидуешь. Все черное. 
Всем советую этот город и этот отель.

reviews.author: Volkl1
reviews.title: We'll be going back!
reviews.text:
We traveled as group of 3 couples to meet at the 9th hotel we’ve visited in the Cancun/Riviera Maya area. As explained to us, Paradisus is an AAA 4 diamond brand in the Melia Resort Portfolio, and is conveniently located in the middle of the hotel zone on a beautiful stretch of beach a short 15 minute cab ride from the airport. Our check in was quick and pleasant with Efrain and two of the rooms were ready early.  Ours was not, but when I went back 2 hours later, Efrain greeted me by name. 

 Our oceanfront room was tastefully furnished, clean and comfortable with a mini bar that was serviced every day.  The view was excellent and the balconies are very private. Our one issue with a slow sink was promptly fixed.

One of the most outstanding features of the Paradisus has to be the attitude of the staff.  From the restaurants to housekeeping, everyone had the same terrific, genuine attitude that we’ve found is lacking at some other resorts.

 The hotel grounds and pool are beautiful with more than adequate chair space at the pool and beach and you don’t have to bother with the stupid towel cards at Paradisus.  We did not book Royal Service on this visit, though we will try it next visit, particularly if it’s a busier time of year. Early November is a great time of year to enjoy Cancun as it’s a slower time.

Restaurants.  We tried 4 of the restaurants for dinner and had good experiences in all of them. The general consensus was that Mole was our favorite as the food was superb. Vento for Tapas was superb as well and sampling different dishes was a treat.  If we had a particular favorite, they were happy to bring out more. Bana was great as well, though I’m not a huge sushi fan everyone else really enjoyed it. Blue Agave for tacos was relaxed and the dinner was excellent. We did the buffet at Naos for breakfast and found it to be excellent.  We enjoyed Market Grill for lunch and we also took advantage of the Naos lunch buffet.  We also ordered room service for coffee and for appetizers and found the service to be timely.

Gym.  The gym is nicely equipped with high end machines, clean and well maintained.  

Spa.  I enjoyed a great massage with a coupon, but I found the spa experience to be so-so, and I was told the hydrotherapy area was closed, even though it was obviously open.

Family Concierge.  We didn’t have any reason to use the Family Concierge, but we did visit with one well-traveled family who were enthusiastic about their Paradisus experience and I’m recommending the hotel to a friend who will be traveling with his kids.

A couple of minor negatives.  The hotel leaks like a sieve during heavy rains, though we weren’t inconvenienced at all and the staff was right on top of the cleanup.
Our room was 3455 and was above the Red Lounge and was very noisy even on the 4th floor. The music, particularly the bass, reverberates and isn’t acceptable. I would avoid building 3 with rooms in the 50’s. We probably would have been accommodated had we asked to be moved, but we were too tired and made due with just leaving the a/c fan running all of the time. There wasn’t a lot of entertainment in the evenings, though that may have had more to do with the slow time of year.

Overall, we found this to be an excellent resort, and we will almost certainly return as a group next March. For another point of view on our stay, check DKurt’s review posted earlier.

reviews.author: SLL240
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus
reviews.text:
Our group's only goal for this vacation was to relax. So we struck GOLD at the all inclusive Paradisus. We upgraded to the Royal Service - and felt like we had the place to ourselves. Our concierge Sameul seemed to always be nearby to offer assistance. Our server Francisco did his best to ensure our glasses were always full and cold regardless of whether we were outside or in the Royal Service lounge. Wine Sommelier Carlos Duarte showed us the wine room and talked about his travels around the world. As the week progressed, we saw Carlos in the various restaurants and he always came to our table to suggest the best wines for our meal. David made sure that our oceanside Bali beds were ready and waiting each morning! And Jesus was everywhere from poolside, in the buffet area and in the Royal Service building, checking to ensure that every single detail was perfect for all the guests. We had a good time with all of these wonderful people as we watched the World Series and our hometown team, the Boston Red Sox and then fielded questions from all of them the next day on the results of the previous night's game.

The rooms in our section were spacious and spotless. The service was immediate and friendly. The restaurants and buffets were wonderful.The meals at Tempo and Mole were our favorites. Carlos recommended the wine paring meal at Tempo and luckily we listened to him. This 8 course meal offered tastings of duck, fish, squid, and a variety of vegetables, sauces and heavenly wines. It was the best meal of our lives.

The beach is soft, powdered sand and clean. There are no rock or seaweed or anything to take away from the beauty of the ocean. And the crystal clear ocean is the color of blue topaz. It was breathtaking. Because the resort is on the hotel strip, it is possible to walk for a couple of miles in either direction on the beach. The surf was very rough at the beginning of the vacation due to winds, but it was very swimable at the end of the vacation. The Royal Service private pool was large and surrounded by Bali beds. It was also pretty much desserted during our stay.

As for evening entertainment..... We have been to resorts that offered some type of show or activity every night. We didn't find that here. There was a "Thriller" type of show on Halloween. There is a bar that opened at 10pm, but we only went there one night and left after 1 drink. However, we didn't feel that this took away from the vacation. After a long day on the beach and a great dinner, no one minded turning in early.

And what vacation to Mexico is complete without tequila?? We attended a tequila tasting session (with Carlos!) and learned that good quality tequila is sipped not slugged, and it is best right after a meal. He told us about the blue agava plants, the process to make tequila and how to read the labels so we know what we are buying. All of this information was probably the best souviner of our trip.

The resort is only about 15 minutes from the airport, which means your vacation starts almost as soon as you land!

We highly recommend the Paradisus for a relaxing vacation.

reviews.author: Linda M
reviews.title: A trip of a lifetime
reviews.text: This resort was WONDERFUL the pros are so many I don't know where to start, no cons to  mention.   Royal Services is what we booked, not really knowing what to expect....all I can say is we wanted for nothing! The atmosphere, our room was on the Lagoon Side and the magnification staff made our week of vacation just wonderful. I would like to say Gracias again to the following staff members, they all went out of there way to assure that we had a great time, Lulu & Natalia from Private Concierge made sure that we were comfortable with our rooms and always had a "hola" for us when we passed their way, our butler "Samuel" greeted us with a welcome drink that was perfect! he had a great personality and smiled all the time...he checked on us throughout his very busy day to make sure we were all doing okay, he would remind us everyday with our dinner reservations, Nancy and Debbie from housekeeping made our room so comfortable we were never short of anything not even a washcloth! David David David....the pool manager...what a great guy he is wonderful at what he does he makes sure that everybody is happy, had a great smile all the time for us, everyday at 12:30ish he would come around with refreshing scented washcloths, which we looked forward to, he would refresh our towels, he would come by again around 2:00 with fruit & confirm where would be sitting the next day, speaking of the pool area, what a relaxing area, we had such great lunches served by Octavio Gonzalez and Regelio Romera they work together very well and their suggestions for lunch were perfect and pairing it with a great wine made it even special. Throughout the week you can see that ALL of the STAFF here are all professionals and very attentive. I could go on and on...I will end my comments by saying "Royal Services" at Paradisus  was everything you could possible ask for and more....from the wonderful  aroma throughout the lobby to the candlelight surroundings at evening...to the turndown service .....as I said it was a trip of a life time!

reviews.author: WoJo
reviews.title: Impressive place
reviews.text:
The hotel is an expansive structure with 5 buildings (pyramids) among them one exclusively for visitors with children, and one exclusively for Royal Services  with private concierge, butler service, private pool, buffet, etc. The place is an all inclusive resort.
The building was constructed in the late 1980's / 1990's and shows some wear and tear (that's why only 4 stars) although still impressive.  Rooms are spacious and very well equipped.  Service professional and efficient.  There are several restaurants, bars, and variety of places to relax.
PROS: the place is huge so it takes you couple of days to orient yourself. There are several restaurants ranging from white table cloth TEMPO (not included in the deal but with a discount for hotel guests) to a buffet style one open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.  There is a night club, couple of bars, and more!
There is plenty of space so that you don't feel crowded (at least that was my impression when we were there).
The rooms are really spacious and comfortable. Royal Service rooms have Nespresso machines, mini bar with soft drinks and beer replenished daily. Bathrooms are very good size and well equipped. Each room has a large terrace with lawn chairs and nice views.
At Royal Service the concierge provides guests for the duration of their stay with a cell phone that will connect you quickly with your butler, concierge, room service or other guests.  The phone will work also anywhere in the city so you can communicate with the hotel or your friends without having to use your own cell phone.
The staff is very friendly and very helpful. There is always someone available to help and get you what you may possibly need.
The pool area, the beach, the cabanas... very nice. The bar / restaurant at the pool serves good lunch menu and endless drinks (!).

CONS: wear and tear in various areas i.e. fist day of our arrival it was raining bad. The skylights and various areas of the hotel had leaks so the staff had to place towels and "wet surface" signs.  The AC in public areas does not take all the heavy humidity out of the air so it may feel damp and tropical. 
One of our rooms had defective AC - it would work for a short period of time after being fixed and switch back to blowing warm humid air until the next fix.

I would definitely come back. You definitely get good value for the money.

reviews.author: Delia-iglesias
reviews.title: Hotel excelente!
reviews.text:
O hotel tem ótima estrutura, é grande, tem vários restaurantes! Os funcionários são muito agradáveis, destaque para o Efrain e para o Samuel, que nos atenderam no bar...
Quarto confortável, cama king, TV LCD, banheiro espaçoso com banheira, piso frio, espaço amplo.
Tem uma bancada de funcionários de empresas de passeios e serviço de atendimento ao hóspede. Nesse serviço, os rapazes atendem muito bem, se esforçam para falar nossa língua, e até ajudam se você precisa ligar em algum lugar e está com dificuldade.
Tem piscinas lindas, café da manhã farto e serviço de praia muito bom!

No geral, adorei!

Como sugestões, acho que precisariam melhorar um pouco a comida (não é ruim, mas também não é de hotel 5 estrelas), e o preço do spa era abusivo! Deveriam repensar.

E um conselho, fuja das épocas de chuva. Fui em setembro, acredito que seja o pior mês, mas eu não tinha opção...Não foi chuva o dia todo, nem posso reclamar, mas eu gosto de sol, então daria preferência a outras épocas.

reviews.author: dkurt
reviews.title: Our first trip to the Paradisus
reviews.text:
This was our group of 6 first trip to the Paridisus Cancun property. This resort is located in the hotel zone directly across from Aqua World. From the airport, it is about a 15 minute cab ride.  The property is made-up of 5 pyramid-styled towers with the restaurants and bars primarily located in the central tower. This resort has an upgraded Royal Service which provides for limited access to either end of the main pool area. One end is reserved for families any other is adult oriented.  A bit more about the Royal Service later in the review.

The property is well laid out and efficient relative to access to guestrooms, restaurants, bars as well as the pool and beach. Plenty of chairs were available around the pool although we did travel during low season. The main pool area has a swim up bar and drink and food services are available around the pool during the day.  

The beach was in very good shape and offered lounge chairs both in the sun as well as under numerous thatched tables.

The staff was very friendly and helpful. Some staff members had problems with English but this usually did not apply to servers and bartenders. There was no attempt at selling timeshares which was appreciated. We have found this to be an issue at a number of other properties in Cancun.

The drinks were good and the resort offered a number of top shelf liquors available for the asking including Cuervo, Stolichnaya, Absolute, Finlandia and Jack Daniels to name a few. The restaurants all did a very nice job. Here the restaurants were a bit untraditional relative to menu and food presentation. Options included Asian, traditional Mexican, Tapas and Brazilian steakhouse style. All the restaurants did a fine job with service and quality of food. Reservations were required at some of the restaurants although again we traveled during low season and this was not an issue.  One food quirk at this resort was an under appreciation for the hamburger/cheeseburger. These items were only available at on the menu at lunch and via room service. The addition of a  “burger bar” buffet during the day would be a great option.

All guest rooms have a private balcony, and I do mean private. No other balcony is visible from your private balcony. The pyramid design of the resort allows for this option. Ours overlooked the lagoon which offered awesome sunset views. The bed was very comfortable and the flat screen TVs offered a good channel selection including all four major American TV networks. ESPN and ESPN2 were available but keep in mind the programming will be different in Mexico than the United States. We were able to watch some NCAA college and professional football games.

The bathrooms were well decorated and included a full bathtub/shower. A separate room within the bathroom included the toilet and a bidet. An in-room coffee maker was provided and room service was available 24/7. The room service was generally quick and the food was very good. A small refrigerator was included in each guest room which included selections of beer, water and soft drinks. This minibar was serviced each day.

As previously mentioned, this resort offers an upgraded “Royal Service”. This includes various personal services available to members and access to restricted areas of the main pool area on either end. The family side included a kiddie pool and numerous toys for children to play with. The adult side offered more lounging options under cabanas along with whirlpools and expanded food service around the pool. The Royal service is available for an additional fee.

Entertainment was very limited at this resort. This included around the pool during the day and also in the evening. Most resorts provide some type of show or entertainment in the evening although this was not the case at the Paridisus. The addition of a live band or a sports bar would have made the evenings even better.

In general, we were very impressed with this resort and will certainly return in the future.

reviews.author: DrEthan725
reviews.title: It's nice enough, but there are better places for better prices
reviews.text: Overall we were very happy we stayed here. There was one BIG NEGATIVE: There is a big push when you first arrive to attend a 90 min screening for Club Melia- which isnt' a timeshare, but sort of is- and they'll give you a heavily discounted spa service for listening to the pitch. The pitch went over the 90 minutes- 2 hrs 10 minutes. When they told us it was 138K to joint the "Club" and we could finance it over 60 months at 16.9% interest we said, "no, thanks." That's when the hard push came in. It was offensive, actually.  We left annoyed but were looking forward to the massages & hydrotherapy we booked for having lost 2+ hours of vacation. Sadly, the hydrotherapy was COLD water and the massages were some of the worst we'd ever had. Not a good spa. The food was decent, though never spectacular. The facilities really need attention. It rained our first 2 days there and there were leaks ALL OVER THE HOTEL. Our room, which faced the ocean, took on water through the sliding door. I don't think it should rain indoors in a "Luxury all-inclusive resort". I also found it very 1980's to have unpotable water in the bathrooms. All of the good modern resorts have full water filtration systems. That said, the service was excellent. People were friendly and solicitous. Truly, some of the best Mexican hospitality. Would I go back?  Sure-- if I were under the gun, again.  The beach is lovely as is the pool.  But if I had time to plan it?  I'd probably go elsewhere.

reviews.author: Gabindy
reviews.title: Excelente servicio y comida
reviews.text: El servicio es excelente y muy recomendable en todas las areas incluyendo la playa, la comida es muy buena y muy abundante. Los restaurantes de especialidades son muy recomendables. Habitaciones comodas y limpias. Su disco es un poco aburrida y el salon rojo yo creo que deberian quitarlo, no invita a entrar.

reviews.author: ART082012
reviews.title: As maravilhas de Cancun
reviews.text: Além de sua arquitetura arrojada e muito bem cuidada, o hotel possui uma excelente infra-estrutura para atender aos mais exigentes hóspedes pois, suas limpas piscinas com vistas para o mar, seus mais diferentes bares, seus restaurantes temáticos integrados, a praia com um visual deslumbrante e, principalmente, seu quadro de funcionários atendendo a todos co muita simpatia e atenção, enfim,  o hotel oferece todas as condições para se ter um ótimo período de descanso. Recomendo!!!

reviews.author: Johnny9s
reviews.title: Excellent resort that doesn't sell itself well enough!
reviews.text:
This is a first for me however, I felt the need to help promote this hotel - Something I believe it doesn't do itself justice with.

I travelled on 12th October 2013 for 10 nights in a group of 6 friends/couples.
Hotel is ideally located about 15/20 mins from the airport and 10 mins from the main Cancun nightlife. The hotel sits on the main Hotel strip of which a great bus service runs every 5 mins to downtown Cancun for shopping at La Isla or main downtown Cancun where the clubs and bars are located. Bus prices are slightly less the 1 USD but a cab home was never more that 10-15 USD

We were initially a little anxious about this hotel as the hotel grounds pictures were a little unusual and as a result we were unsure how nice it actually was.

I am very glad we stayed at this wonderful hotel as it is spread over a quite wide bit of land unlike the others which can be quite narrow and more deep or high rise. The result of this meant that the pools were very wide and spacious and there is a beautiful wide part of the beach associated to this hotel. (beach is amazing). I appreciate that it was lower season and not packed but I would imagine this to be a huge plus should the hotel fill up in peak season.

We stayed in Pyramid 5 which was for adults Royal Service guests. This is a must upgrade if you can. Within the main part of this Pyramid (they are all connected) you have your own guest services/check in etc along with lovely grounds of bridges and walkways with rest areas to enjoy the open bar/drinks/coffee along with a selection of food/snacks that they keep replenished throughout the day. The walk back from the pool always ended with a lovely coffee and cake prior to returning to our room. 

Rooms numbers are made up of Pyramid-Floor-door number! Ours was 5311 which was the first of the ocean view rooms. The higher numbers 12,14,15,16 etc all have ocean views with 10,09,08 etc having lagoon views.

The hotel itself whilst not brilliantly lit, does have some wonderful scents and water features throughout which make for a very enjoyable experience. The main Pyramid 3 is where most things are located. 

The restaurants and food are top notch. I didn't have a bad experience in any restaurant. Most required a reservation which can be done the day before however at times we reserved same day and were even accommodated without a reservation though again remember the hotel wasn't at full capacity. Without reviewing each restaurant, I can tell you that all food was fantastic and very very fresh. The sushi was out of this world and I'm not a huge sushi fan. If you have any special requests or tastes the staff go out of their way to accommodate you.

With regards to the service within the hotel, this has to be one of its greatest assets. The staff could not do enough for you whether it be replacement drinks, towels on beds, reservations or just a general smile and hello as you walk by. The little extras in royal service included bali beds reserved and made for you before you arrive. fresh cool towels throughout the day to keep you cool. very attentive poolside services for any drinks or snacks that you may want. they even have a great lunchtime menu should you want to eat on your Bali bed. whilst not on the menu, the afternoon ice creams were a lovely little treat and the staff went out of their way to accommodate anything that was required. Sergio was joy to meet during out stay and ensured we had a very smooth and relaxing day by the pool. One of the most friendliest employees I met during our stay. He looked after us well and we thank him again for that.

I'll try not to go on but if you're thinking about booking this hotel, you wont be disappointed. Large spacious grounds/pools with impeccable service. Friendly staff, beautiful beach and prime location for any type of holiday whether it be a relaxing one or a lively one with access to downtown Cancun within 10 minutes by bus.

My only criticism of this hotel would be the lack of entertainment in the evenings. Whilst its nice to sit in Avenue bar (great 80s soundtracks) and have a drink before/after dinner, this was the only real place to do this. They do have Red bar next to this but like most hotel nightclub/bars this was not busy and so didn't attract the guests that were staying here. 
If this hotel employed an entertainment team to put the odd show on each night and had a designated area for this then it would fly up the TripAdvisor ratings. We thought simple changes like utilising its uniqueness and putting on a pyramid light show would be benefitial or maybe a bbq on the beach with music in the evening. My thoughts are that this wouldn't cost a lot but add huge value to guests. Its little improvements like this that can go a long way for enjoyment.
Either way, you have downtown Cancun 10 mins away with an array of bars/clubs that all do open bar for a reasonable price. Congo bar is by far the best there with ticker tape and air randomly sprayed on people as part of its mental atmosphere. 20 USD and you had open bar for as long as you want therefore the lack of evening entertainment wasn't a problem with this on hand.

If anyone would like to know more, please feel free to contact me.

reviews.author: Sally C
reviews.title: Fabulous place to 'just be'!
reviews.text:
I will be back to enjoy your wonderful hospitality and property next year, and I can barely wait till then already!
I spent my birthday week there and had a fantastic restful, enjoyable and fun time. Service is impeccable, I'm recommending Martin and Hector in the restaurant Fuego; and in restaurant Mole are Rigoberto and Carol. I fell in love with at least 3 bartenders for their warmth and great service, they are Israel, Margarito, and Henrique. Also, Salvatore and Flash!
One server asked me why I thought so many people from Fla come to visit Cancun when they have the beaches and similar climate. I said that the service is unparalleled and the cleanliness is so very refreshing. Both of which are so very much to be proud of.
Go with the best at Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: Tony B
reviews.title: Paradisus resort: Excellent Management!
reviews.text:
Paradisus resort was a great destination for my birthday. The hotel is beautiful and reflects the pictures. 
Upon your entry in the beautifully scented lobby you are nicely welcomed by the staff.
The check in was at 3pm but the agent checked me in earlier which was great as I was exhausted .

The suite looked great, cleaned everyday and the view was amazing.

I've tried all the restaurants and there is a great selection of food.If you are a big eater , you can literally eat there 24/7...

Finally I 'd like to give a 10+ to the management who was able to solve any issue I would bring to their attention. Fred Boutouba was an amazing interlocutor and made sure my stay exceeded my expectations.

I highly recommend Paradisus Cancun to anyone looking to spend some amazing quality time!

Myriam C.

reviews.author: tcm312
reviews.title: Very disappointing experience
reviews.text: Don't stay at this hotel! The rooms are ridiculously small, the staff is extremely unfriendly & unaccommodating, and the food is mediocre at best.  Our Deluxe Ocean View Junior Suite was anything but "deluxe"..and very "junior". The room is very crowded, minimal storage for clothing (only 3 small drawers), small bathroom....we had to store our suitcases on the balcony. Speaking of balcony... there was only one chair on the balcony. We requested 2 additional chairs and the front desk gave us an attitude about it. The pool side wait staff were very rude & unfriendly. Most of the hotel staff don't speak English. Ultimately, we met with the hotel manager Alberto to express our disappointment & request a larger room that we would pay extra for. Alberto was no help whatsoever, struggled to offer us a larger room (the hotel was only at 22% occupancy rate) & couldn't have cared less about our dissatisfaction with our experience. Needless to say, we will never stay here again. One last note: There are an endless amount of steep steps to get to the pool and beach with no hand rails. Pretty dangerous set up.

reviews.author: GIDRocks63
reviews.title: Excellent resort!
reviews.text: Best resort for your money. place is beautiful and five star from the moment we arrived and were greeted by Marisol who represents this resort with style and grace. the whole week we were there all the staff treated us like family. Sandra at the NAOS buffet was wonderful always greeting us with a smile and our favorite drink. The mager at Fuego, Hector, went out of his way several times for us and arranged a birthday surprise for me too. Top notch manager. Try all the ala catre restaurants but Mole was great. Our waiter Rigoberto and Veronica were above the best I have ever encountered. we ended the week eating at Tempo with

reviews.author: Sherry S
reviews.title: Perfect way to relax!
reviews.text: This resort was everything I hoped it would be and then some. The staff is top notch. Lots of choices. The resort is set on a spa theme, my goal was to disconnect and relax. With so many Breath taking views and choices totally perfect.

reviews.author: ADRIELE SORPILLE
reviews.title: Resort Paradisus em Cancun - Rede Meliá
reviews.text:
Viajei em setembro para Cancun e foi tudo maravilhoso.
Fiquei hospedada no Paradisus e eles são incríveis. 
Vários tipos de restaurantes (all inclusive), ambiente mega agradável, funcionários muito atenciosos e felizes em estarem ali. 
Quando eu estava na praia, os garçons ficavam ali à disposição caso quiséssemos alguma bebida (detalhe: o bar do hotel estava ali à poucos metros mas ele trazia para nós).
Foi realmente maravilhoso e com certeza se eu voltar para Cancun ficarei ali novamente.
Na piscina existe um bar (pool bar) e lá procurem pelo Enrique Diaz Perez, Eder Garcia e Jorge Maya. Eles são fantásticos, nos atenderem muito bem. 
Quero deixar aqui registrado o meu muito obrigada à eles também.
O ambiente do hotel é familiar, então se por acaso o seu interesse for para encontrar pessoas solteiras, eles indicaram o hotel ao lado, o Oasis. Este hotel tem a "fama" de irem mais pessoas solteiras.
Os passeios que fiz foi com a CVC e adorei. 
Atendimento impecável e foi tudo ótimo.

reviews.author: Travelangel16
reviews.title: klassische 5* am wunderschönen Strand von Cancun
reviews.text:
man sieht, dass dieses Paradisus vorher ein Melia Hotel gewesen ist und nicht als Paradisus erbaut wurde.
Zimmer sind 4*
Bad etwas zu klein und könnte in naher Zukunft mal wieder renoviert werden.
Lobby aussergewöhnlich.
Da wir in Nebensaison gereist sind, hatte das Buffetrestaurant nicht jeden Abend geöffnet, so dass man auf die à la carte Restaurants ausweichen musste.
Was allerdings nicht zum Nachteil gewesen ist. Gute Qualität, aufmerksames Personal, schöne Anrichtung.
Die Anlage wirkte stets sehr gepflegt, die Strand ist ein Traum. Sehr aufmerksamer, schneller Service am Strand, besonders hervor zu heben Sofonía. Immer gut gelaunt und ein Lächeln auf den Lippen.
Auch die Rezeption mit Guadalupe war immer sehr hilfsbereit.
Der Service und das wirklich aussergwöhnlich aufmerksame Personal (Danke auch an Espiridion) geben diesem Hotel den besonderen Charme.

reviews.author: Sue630
reviews.title: Royal Service, Very Nice!
reviews.text:
Everyone from the Paradisus Manager to the Royal Service Manger aimed to please in every way! No matter how  small or grand the request,  the staff was willing to accommodate. The only liaise faire employee was Samuel the Butler. We asked that he be replaced by Hector and our request was accommodated. Hector was 5 Star!!!!! The Royal Service pool area was outstanding and the food at the Royal Service luncheon area was out of this world! Especially the Mahi-Mahi. The area should be open till 8pm so folks can enjoy ocean front petite dinners!!! We would eat there every night! Our room had a beautiful ocean view. It was cool, however, we always travel with a small fan to ensure maximum air conditioning. The common areas are not air conditioned. They could use fans, especially in the Japanese Restaurant area. As far as cleanliness goes, the entire hotel was sparkling! We are very particular!  The spa treatments were very nice. A few areas need to be updated mechanically like the shower and pool. We never saw anyone selling anything like time share etc in 10 days. the weather was grand, only 1 day of rain in 10. All of the alcohol is top shelf. 
The bloody Mary's are the best anywhere.  All and all we had a fantastic time and look forward to returning next year. They are working furiously to improve every aspect of the property that needs improvement!

reviews.author: I N
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun ist atemberaubend!
reviews.text:
Das Hotel ist atemberaubend, der Strand wunderschön, das Essen unglaublich und das Personal fantastisch. Paradisus Cancun ist alles, das man sich erträumen kann, wenn man an Urlaub denkt. Von der Qualität des Services bis zur Sauberkeit der Räumlichkeiten gibt es nichts, das ich ändern würde. Ich bin an vielen Orten auf der Welt gewesen, aber nichts ist vergleichbar mit diesem Hotel, und das Tüpfelchen auf dem I ist das fabelhafte Tempo Restaurant. Ich freue mich darauf dieses Paradies nächstes Jahr wieder genießen zu können! 
Vielen Dank für diese wundervolle Erfahrung, die sich mit Worten nicht beschreiben lässt.

reviews.author: Hayat N
reviews.title: El paraiso !
reviews.text:
J'ai passe une semaine a cet hôtel avec ma meilleure amie, 

un hôtel agréable, très bien situé, un staff accueillant et très serviable.
Accès a la plage situe face a la piscine.. le tout y est pour passer de très bonnes vacances.

Pour notre part nous avions choisi le all inclusive mais malgré tout nous n'avons pas pu tester tous les plats car il y en avait beaucoup.

Petit plus pour le buffet international, avec une terrasse vue sur mer et aussi pour le restaurant Japonais ou les sushis sont délicieux.
Bar très agréable avec une vue panoramique piscine, plage idéal après une journée de bronzage.

Le valet service est tres complet, on nous amène même de la crème solaire! 

Enfin bref pour passer une agréable semaine n'hésitez pas a tester cet hôtel

reviews.author: Fernando Q
reviews.title: Sencillamente fabuloso
reviews.text:
En mi reciente visita a ese fabuloso resort solo puedo decir que sencillamente fabuloso, una experiencia para guardar en nuestra memoria como los sitios buenos de verdad buenos que hemos visitado en nuestras  vidas , les comento, me considero una persona exigente sobre todo cuando de  servicio y calidad  hablamos Y ese resort  aunque grande para mis gustos  de vacaciones , logro sobrepasar  todas mis expectativas , quiero destacar la calidez del servicio recibido además de discreto , puntual y sobre todo logrando hacernos  sentir que fuimos  los dueños durante nuestros nuestra estadía .
La alimentación sencillamente fabulosa , como la disfrute, todavía tengo en el paladar algunos de esos platillos sobre todo en Tempo , no deseo dejar pasar la oportunidad para felicitar a Mirian, Enrique,  Sofonia Eliseo,y Hervik solo para nombrar algunos de los muchachos que lograron hacer de nuestras vacaciones algo inolvidable gracias señores gracias .

reviews.author: Richardishka
reviews.title: И правда, рай!
reviews.text: Об этом удивительном месте можно рассказывать очень долго, фотографии лишь отчасти передают всю его красоту. Отель полностью оправдывает свое название: интересный дизайн внутреннего интерьера, создающий неповторимую атмосферу релакса в эдемском саду, ненавязчивая музыка, поддерживающая это настроение,  ухоженная территория с бассейнами с неизменно кружащими над ними пеликанами и другими экзотическими представителями пернатых,  бирюзовое море, не всегда спокойное, но неизменно чистое и манящее, нежнейший песок. Но особенно  хотелось бы отметить потрясающий персонал отеля: Асуньсьон, Хесуса, Игнасио, Хьюго, Мартина и многих других. Все очень приветливы, всегда улыбаются, открыты и доброжелательны, предупредительны и  готовы прийти на помощь в любую минуту. Сервис на самом высоком уровне! Отдельное им спасибо за практику английского и испанского. Общение получилось очень увлекательным:  очень интересно узнать о жизни мексиканцев непосредственно от них самих.  Было забавно наблюдать, как они достаточно легко воспроизводят наши слова. Еще немного русских туристов, и персонал отеля будет также бегло говорить по-русски, как девушки в дьюти фри в аэропорту Канкуна. Кстати, в этом плане еще очень запомнились продавцы сувениров в Чичен-Ице с  их «руссо туристо облико  морале», «почти даром» и т.д. Эти несколько дней, проведенных в Канкуне, навсегда оставят впечатления о нем как о рае, который не был бы возможен без таких прекрасных людей!

reviews.author: Annanunes
reviews.title: Execelente
reviews.text: Hotel maravilhoso, com quartos super confortáveis,diversos bares e restaurantes em seu interior, um melhor que o outro.O café da manhã muito sortido, de tudo que se pode imaginar. Conta ainda com boate dentro do hotel... enfim tudo de bom!!

reviews.author: Futia
reviews.title: Very peaceful
reviews.text: We arranged to stay at Paradisus Cancun after a ten day stay in NYC. It is certainly somewhere I would chose to stay again and the staff go beyond expectations to ensure your comfort and enjoyment. I was a little hesitant about the food in an all you can eat - the food shone. It was spectacular. The rooms are very roomy, however a little dated. The only negative I have and it's only one was we had a few inclusions in our package which included vouchers for the day spa. Our travel agent advised we had a certain amount to spend and this was refuted by the front desk. Eventually we got the vouchers, however we were informed that they had to be broken down and not used in one transaction. My massage was $220 USD and across the road it was $35USD. Can't compare the setting - but this is the one place in the hotel that they certainly see you coming.

reviews.author: Laura Cecilia G
reviews.title: Excelente hotel, excelente servicio!!!
reviews.text:
Me quede con 6 amigas en este hotel, pagamos el todo incluido, y valio la pena haber escogido este hotel. Todo estaba excelente, nos dieron habitaciones con vista al mar, la comida era muy buena incluso en el buffet, tienes que reservar para cenar en los restaurantes, especialmente recomiendo Fuego, y el de Tacos/Tequila, deliciosos !!. No esta muy cerca de los antros o de Plaza Caracol pero esta muy cerca en camión o taxi. ( 10 minutos ). El servicio era excelente, me había quedado en un all inclusive en playa del Carmen antes, y el servicio no fue tan bueno, asi que me gusto mucho la atención que nos dieron, iban dos veces a llevar toallas, rellenaban el minibar a diario, ( el minibar estaba incluido pero no era muy bueno lo que tenia, solo papas, sodas y un par de cervezas ) , los meseros muy muy amables, en la playa nos atendían muy bien y nos llevaban bebidas constantemente, y en especial Gilberto de recepción, se porto muy amable, nos dio habitaciones con vista al mar y a 3 de mis amigas les envio un regalo a la habitación porque cumplían anos en septiembre ( mes en el que viajamos ). Gracias Gilberto, Saludos !!!

El hotel tiene mucho que ver en como te la pasas en tu viaje a una playa, y definitivamente me volveria a quedar en Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: Hector O
reviews.title: EXCELENTE HOTEL CON INMEJORABLE ATENCION
reviews.text:
De manera personal,  de todos los hoteles que he visitado a nivel nacional (México) esté, es por mucho el mejor,quiero dar las gracias de manera personal al señor felipe cruz,quien en todo momento me apoyo y resolvió mis dudas.
En conclusión......recomiendo amplia mente este hotel, se que saldrán con una sonrisa al termino de sus vacaciones en tan hermoso lugar.

A toda la familia que integra el hotel Paradisus Cancun,...... mil gracias

reviews.author: Kahoz P
reviews.title: SATISFACCION TOTAL
reviews.text: Fuimos con el grupo semarnat felicidades, todos los empleados fueron muy amables y siempre te preguntaban cómo nos había ido en nuestros juegos, la camarista muy al pendiente, los alimentos deliciosos, la verdad toda hizo que nuestra estancia fuera placentera y nos dieran ganas de regresar posteriormente. El personal si les preguntabas algo te informaban y si no sabían te investigaban, pero nunca te dejaban con dudas. Felicidades nuevamente

reviews.author: ONE302
reviews.title: Loved this place...can't wait to go back!!!!
reviews.text: This hotel was wonderful.  I had a room in the "royal service" section and it was beautiful.  Can't think of anything negative to say about this place!  All the food was delicious, bars had top shelf liquor, rooms were beautiful!  Service was great too!  The crowd here was older, so if you're looking for a party resort...this probably isn't it.

reviews.author: nicole m
reviews.title: Cancun september 2013
reviews.text:
Great hotel, Food is amazing, The breakfast buffet has lots of variety. The restaurants a la carte are also very good. The decor is very tropical. The aromatherapy a bit too much for my sentive smell. The rooms are very comfortable. 

All in all great resort.

reviews.author: rfsalmoniv
reviews.title: A TRUELY SPECIAL PLACE
reviews.text:
Let me start by saying this is the first review I have ever written.  To be honest, I still don't know how I feel about reviews.  I agree that everyone is entitled to their own opinion, however the few odd balls that have written mediocre or bad reviews about Paradisus Cancun should have their heads examined.

My friends and I stayed at Paradisus Cancun from August 29th-September 1st.  We have been fortunate enough to travel and stay at many spectacular resorts around the world.  I believe I can speak for all five of us when I say that our experience staying at Paradisus Cancun rivals any of the resorts we have stayed at around the world (Ritz Carlton, Four Seasons, etc.).  The primary reason for this is the unbelievable service we received from the minute we arrived until the minute we left.

Almost a month before our arrival I was in constant contact via email with the hotel concierge, mostly with Ms. Lourdes Gutiérrez.  She was probably sick of me before we arrived, however she promptly responded to each of my emails with an amazing attitude and fulfilled all of our request.  Due to the time she spent working to fulfill our requests (my friends and I are very picky about our accommodations) even before our arrival was the first sign that we were in for a real treat.

I HIGHLY recommend booking or upgrading to the Royal Service.  The Royal Service is everything as advertised and much much more!  I read reviews that "the royal service is not worth it" and I honestly cannot think of a more outrageous statement.  Immediately upon arrival we were greeted by name and served the welcome cocktails each of us requested when we submitted our "pre-arrival" form.  We were promptly escorted to the check in area (which was a breeze) and greeted by numerous staff members as if we were kings.  Although this was our first time to Paradisus Cancun, the welcome we received by the staff made us feel like we were regulars.  I'm still in awe of how the staff at a resort of this size can pay so much attention and familiarize (even before arrival) themselves with every single guest.

We originally booked two Royal Service Ocean Front Suites.  Since we were celebrating my bachelor party, we decided to inquire about upgrading to a bigger suite. Ms. Lourdes Gutiérrez was kind enough to let us know that the Presidential Suite was available for the duration of our stay.  Of course, we figured we should at least take a look at it before making a decision so we asked to see it.  We were politely escorted to the 7th floor and as soon as we walked off the elevator we knew we had to upgrade!  The suite was absolutely stunning.

After check in we were provided with our cell phones to get in touch with the concierge or "butlers" 24 hours a day.  Personally, I don't like to use the term "butler service" because the "butlers" were far more than exceptional service providers, but they became our friends. Juan showed us to the rooms and familiarized us with the resort.  He made sure we felt at home and brought us a bottle of champagne to toast to our arrival.  Juan made sure that each of our bags were placed in the correct room and even offered to unpack for us.

Now let me tell you about the suite....!

The master bedroom has panoramic views of the ocean with on of the most amazing bathrooms I have ever seen.  The bathroom consist of 2 Jacuzzi tubs, one of which comfortably could fit 8-10 people in it, 2 showers (one that had jets shooting from every direction and a waterfall shower head, not to mention an amazing steam room), 2 walk in toilets with bidets, 2 huge sinks with marble counters, and a monster walk in closet complete with exceptionally soft waffle weave robes.  Also in the master bedroom is a sitting area with 2 flat screen TVs, surround sound speakers, and a private balcony (one of 4 in the suite).

Lets move on to the office.  Grand room with a very nice desk to handle any business you may need to tend to.  Of course there is a beautiful armoire in the office with yet again another TV (don't know why you would ever want to watch TV when you are in paradise, but to each is on)!

From there you walk into the entertainment room.  Floor to ceiling windows with views of the lagoon. A very modern feel to it with a glass dining room table with seating for 10.  Full free standing bar with stools to entertain.  Of course there are 2 chandeliers and yet again another balcony with views of the ocean and lagoon. 

Moving into the kitchen  you will be astonished at the full size refrigerator (stocked daily with the beverages and snacks of your choice), island, coffee and cappuccino machine, full cabinets with full sets of nice china, a stove, and again another balcony!  The balcony off the kitchen is the best place to watch the sunset over the lagoon.  We enjoyed a nice cigar and a refreshing cocktail each evening while watching a picturesque sunset! 

Don't get me wrong the suite was absolutely amazing, but again what really made the resort special was the service.  We had the privilege of Hector serving us as our "butler" aka friend for most of our stay.  I cannot express in words how helpful Hector was.  He went above and beyond what I would ever have expected.  He made SURE that our every request was promptly taken care of.  We actually didn't have to make many request because he took care of things before we had to ask.  He knew our drinks of choice at each time of the day.  Hector made sure we had fresh coffee and baileys in the morning and so on and so forth as the day moved on!  One of the things that was so nice about Hector is I could trust him 100%.  One day we were lounging in our beachfront cabana and we realized we left the camera in the room.  One call to Hector and he was immediately at the cabana asking how he could help.  We asked him to please go in our room and grab the camera.  Hector earned my trust so much that I gave him the code to my safe to bring me some cash down to the beach so I could tip the bartender.  Of course, hector brought the camera and cash just as we asked and then so he felt comfortable he politely requested for me to change the code to the safe just so there were no misunderstandings going forward.  I BARLEY WILL GIVE THE PASSWORD TO MY SAFE TO MY FIANCE, MUCH LESS SOMEONE I JUST MET, BUT HECTOR WAS THAT TRUSTWORTHY AND GENUINE.  He literally checked on us 24/7 and helped us with requests that I would never even have thought to make, but of course he offered!  This is what sets the Paradisus Cancun apart from a Ritz Carlton, St. Regis, or any other hotel.  Hector and Juan were there to serve us with ANY request for the duration of our stay.  One of my friends wanted to buy his mother a handmade cross from a local market.  We didn't feel like going into town, so without even asking, Juan shows up a few hours later with multiple crosses to chose from that he personally went into town and purchased!  My friend picked the one he liked and Juan took the others back.  I could talk for days about Hector and Juan's service, but you will have to experience it for yourself to believe it.

The unimaginable service didn't stop with Hector and Juan.  EVERYONE was amazing.  The cleaning staff made sure our room was spotless each day (we definitely didn't make it easy on them).   Not only did the room look like it had been scrubbed by a toothbrush, but we never saw the cleaning crew.  No one bothered us while we were asleep or in the room.  They waited until we were at the beach for the day, came in, did an amazing job, and got out!

The royal service pool and the regular pool are just like everything else, beautiful.  Each day we had a two tiki cabanas along with lounge chairs reserved oceanfront right above the beach (thanks to hector ensuring the reservations!).  The poolside and beachside concierge/servers are on top of their game.  There was not 1 minute that I didn't have a fresh cocktail in my hand.  As soon as I would think its about time for another, mysteriously the server would show up with another round.  It should be noted that the liquor is TOP SHELF.  Grey Goose (multiple flavors), Don Juilo Tequila, Tanqueray Gin, Bombay Safire, the list goes on and on...Beers are served in the can, no cheap keg beer like other all inclusive resorts.  The royal service poolside grill served great ceviche anytime you asked.  

The beach is the largest I've seen in Cancun.  I've stayed at other resorts in the "party" area of the hotel zone and there is little to no beach area.  Plenty of chairs for everyone with fresh towels provided throughout the day.

Each day after enjoying the cabana we would walk down to the beach bar in the main part of the hotel.  It is a hidden oasis that looks like a tiki hut.  I don't have to explain the service again you should have the idea by now....However, Alex had our cigars of choice ready each day and made sure we never went without one.

One of the coolest things about this resort is it caters to EVERYONE.  It is not a place to find spring breakers taking body shots or loud music and bingo by the pool.  Paradisus Cancun is complete relaxation that caters to everyone.  We met people on their honeymoon, family vacations, and of course we were on my bachelor party.  Usually it is hard to please such a wide range of age groups, but Paradisus has mastered it.

The food is great.  I recommend making reservations for each of the restaurants when you arrive so you can enjoy all of them.  However, we never had a problem getting a table anywhere.

The entire resort has vegetation everywhere and a wonderful modern feel.  The Avenue Bar stays open late and has a very cool lounge feel to it.  There is even a disco on site if that is your thing.

Overall, there is not enough I can say about this wonderful resort.  If you are considering traveling to Cancun, make your reservation at Paradisus Cancun now. You definitely will not regret it.  I will absolutely be returning for many years to come!  It should be noted that although the Presidential Suite was a great bonus, I would have been just as happy in a regular garden view room.  

On behalf of myself and my friends we would like to thank the entire staff at Paradisus Cancun for making our dreams come true by experiencing the best vacation we could ever have imagined!

I look forward to seeing everyone next time!   

.

reviews.author: Connie M
reviews.title: Another great time!
reviews.text: This was our second trip to this resort. We were there 3 years ago when it was Gran Melia and enjoyed ourselves so much that we decided to return.  This time other family members joined us.  Upon check in we did have some problems and a problem with one of the rooms losing power a couple of times, but when Fred, the director of operations, learned of this everything changed.  We (3 couples) were all moved to Royal Service and our wonderful vacation began.Fred personally check on us a few times, made reservation in one of the restaurants for us and even arranged our transportation back to the airport in one of the hotel vans.   The resort is simply beautiful and the staff at the pool area and restaurant (David and Sergio) could not have been nicer. We never had to look for them if we needed anything, they almost anticipated our every wish.  The only issue we did have was with the restaurants in the resort.  We like to do all inclusive so we can just order and not have to worry about extra fees.  Many of the restaurants had extra fees for certain meals. We did receive coupons upon check in for discounts but they did not cover the entire charge.  The last time we were there it was truly ALL INCLUSIVE I hope they return to their original policies.  All in all we had a wonderful time and do plan to return again.

reviews.author: rosamariac30
reviews.title: Descanso garantizado
reviews.text: Es un hotel perfecto para relajarse y olvidarse de la rutina. La comida es excelente. Tienes opciones de diferentes tipos de comida (mexicana, mediterránea, japonesa, brasileña). Además cuenta con un buffet. El personal es muy eficiente. No necesitas salir del hotel. Tiene todos los servicios.

reviews.author: Maria Antonia B
reviews.title: No volveria a ese hotel
reviews.text: Estuve de vacaciones en el Paradisus Cancun en el mes de Julio pasado. La atencion fue excelente. La comida bastante Buena pero de noche demasiado oscuros los jardines, alrededor de la piletas. Muchas escaleras de afuera, la de aceso a la playa sin ninguna baranda, dond es possible rebalarse ya que uno sube descalzo varias veces. La falta de luz y de barndas me parecio un desastre ya que no todas los huespedes del hotel no son jovenes. Adentro es un laberinto, como paraperderce muy facilmente. No pienso volver a ese hotel. Maria Antonia desde Los Angeles.

reviews.author: PAULAMDQ
reviews.title: Excelente!
reviews.text: El hotel es magnifico... la decoracion los sillones..los bares, el personal, la habitacion con terraza y jacuzzi, la vista al mar, los restaurantes todos muy buenos el de comida mexicana sobresaliente, el desayuno variado reposteria de super primera...el servicio a la habitacion es super recoemndable...la verdad es un cinco estrellas muy bueno... con todo lo que tienen que tener....lo unico que no me gusto...que habia que escaparse de los que quieren vender tiempo compartido...te persiguen por todo el hotel.....el spa...magnifico,,los masajes..el circuito de aguas, el masaje de piedras calientes...excelente...volveria!!!

reviews.author: Betty M
reviews.title: HEAVEN!
reviews.text: Last May I visited Paradusis for a week's stay and it was absolutely wonderful. We had the 'all inclusive' package and we could go anywhere, anytime and do whatever suited us- from the swim up bar, to parasailing, to lazing by the pool in a cabana to chillin on the beach under the straw umbrellas with a book and being served lunch, anytime snacks or frozen libations! The food was fantastic at  ALL of the 9 restaurants we had to choose from and we met wonderful people from all over. Our oceanfront room was spacious and beautiful so that we were able to enjoy coffee and breakfast looking over the beautiful white sand and turquoise water! Their staff was so friendly and helpful also and the Spa there- fabulous. Did I enjoy myself? Would I go back?? Not before tomorrow!!!!

reviews.author: antoniolisboa1019574
reviews.title: INTERESSANTE
reviews.text: Certamente quem vai para este hotel, vai á procura de sol e praia. As trazeiras do hotel dão acesso directo á praia. Desta minha 2ª viagem a CANCUN, apanhei muita chuva e só um dia usufrui da praia. O hotel é simpático, mas a pedir algumas obras, pois chovia em algumas partes do mesmo. A comida é razoável. O lobby é agradável, e há amiudadas vezes variedades. Pode utilizar os transportes publicos (paragem mesmo á entrada do hotel) para ir ao centro de cancun. Mas se vai a CANCUN...não deixe de ir visitar a RIVIERA MAYA. Será o mesmo que ir a ROMA, e...não ver o PAPA.

reviews.author: Tiago182
reviews.title: Perfeito
reviews.text: O hotel se parece com um shopping. É super luxuoso, possui vários restaurantes, é faraônico e tem tudo o que você pode vir a precisar. Conta com uma loja de conveniencia logo em frente (onde é possível comprar coisas para deixar no frigobar) e uma pizzaria e um MC Donalds.

reviews.author: Taralm13
reviews.title: Pretty hotel
reviews.text: Hotel was very pretty. Room was very nice also. Service was not what I expected. After reading reviews I was expecting the service to be amazing but it really wasn't. SOME of the service was amazing but a lot was bad. Our waiter at Bana was really bad...he delivered food and seemed very eager to be done working. We asked for things that were ignored such as another drink. It kind of ruined that dinner for us. We were consistently given bad directions to our room (this wasted a lot of our precious time) and even laughed at after asking directions. We were told there was no wifi in our room and this was not true it must have been told to everyone as there were entire families sitting in the hot lobby using the wifi. We asked for another chair to be put on our balcony as there was only one and they never did bring it.  This is not the place to go if you want nightlife. There is one club type place open until 2am with loud music. All the other places closed at 12 or earlier.  The beach was amazing! The pools are nice but very warm. Service was either non existent or really great at pools....never got any service on beach.  Overall the place was pretty good....but I think what ruined it for me was my first impression at check in...it just left me uneasy. Our room was not ready for an hour after arrival...we arrived after 4pm and check in time is supposed to be 3pm. I had to ask for my resort credits...the only coupon I wanted to use was to upgrade room to royal service and I was told I could not use it. I basically had no way to get the royal service. I was really upset by this and maybe if I was allowed to purchase it my trip would have been what I wanted. Even the man that we saw next told us it was not worth getting the royal service ( same man that told me no wifi in rooms). Everyone on tripadvisor advised getting the royal service but this place just would not sell it to me...I found this strange.  The driver service we used was really good, we used best day.  The food was good at Bana, Blue Agave, and Market Grill (the only 3 restaurants we were able to visit due to needing reservations ) but the buffet was pretty bad except breakfast was ok. Buffet was also hit or miss on service.  Everything was so inconsistent here. Room service was different every time even when you order the same thing.  I would probably return to hotel again if price was low enough and I was able to try the royal service, but I was not overly impressed. This hotel needs to try to be more consistent in service and food...and also have better people working at check in area. Also, if you lose your bracelet or it falls off you have to bring your passport to get another one...you will also need it to exchange money....knowing this will save you time so you don't have to go back to your room to get it).

reviews.author: Siquele
reviews.title: Descanso e agito em um só lugar
reviews.text: Não é preciso sair do hotel para se divertir. Uma variedade de restaurantes com diversos tipos de comida (9 restaurantes e 5 bares). Além de boate e apresentações  mexicanas e de outros tipos. Bar da praia e bar da piscina com refeições leves para passar o dia todo curtindo na água.

reviews.author: Dave R
reviews.title: Almost Perfect....
reviews.text:
First off, this is definitely a first class establishment.  The staff is wonderful and the grounds are very well maintained.  It, however, is too big for its own good.  It took my friend and I about three days to really get oriented to the facility.  I am going to ramble a little, because there was so much to take in and review....
If you do stay here, it is imperative that you have a room with an ocean view because it is well worth it.  The views from the other side are very dull and unimpressive.
The room and lobby decor is very plain and could use some updating.......and some color. For some reason, we could hear people moving furniture in the room above us.  Walking thru the lobbies is both pleasant and annoying because there is a continual scent of burning candles which can become not so pleasant after awhile.
The primary staff members are bilingual, so communication is not a problem and the maid service is excellent.
Okay...more.....    The gym (YHI Spa) has very good equipment for a full workout.  I, however, did not take advantage of the spa treatments that were available.  The offereings were very good, but very pricey.
I actually came here by invitation of a friend of mine who had timeshare privileges.  We did not purchase the all inclusive meal plan, but we are not sorry about that because the food in the Naos restaurant was not that wonderful.  A large selection of foods for each meal, but except for a few items, it was not very flavorful.  If you are not a heavy eater, you can eat out or go to a store and bring some items into your room.  If, however, you intend on remaining on the grounds for your entire stay......the all inclusive is an option.  (although, it appears that next year you will be required to stay as an all inclusive.)
I thouroughly enjoyed the Michael Jackson impersonation show that was part of the nightly entertainment.  It was a good rendering of a live show....with some energetic dancing.
Unfortunately....I became sick after a day of scuba diving and the medical staff on hand was excellent at examining my condition.  Suffered from dehydration and dizziness...and they were calm in asking questions and advising on what to do.
Hmmm....  Overall, a wonderful stay on a great beach.  Oh.....one important thing.....you must get out early in order to get a hut on the beach.  With the hut, you can stay out and relax for a long time.........without it.....it is hot!
Staff is great at recommending activities to participate in.
Well......like I said.....I am ramblilng.  Suffice to say that if you love the beach and resort accomodations...........you will not be disappointed!  Just be prepared to hand out a lot of tips to staff.

reviews.author: Daisinha
