reviews.title: Maravilhoso
reviews.text:
Resort muito bonito, em forma de piramides.
Quartos grandes, banheiro grande.
Possui três áreas de piscinas, área na praia, bar molhado, academia.
Limpeza até duas vezes ao dia.
Otimos drinks servidos em todos os bares

reviews.author: MichaelM76
reviews.title: Great Property with Pro's and Con's
reviews.text: I worked 10 years for hotel's in the food and beverage department and travel extensively around the world: This was our second stay at this hotel, December 2012  and July 1-5, 2013.  Both stays were great with good food and good service.  We upgraded to the Royal Service this past visit in order to stay in an ocean view room and it was worth every penny.  This service in the Royal area of the hotel is impeccable. Out butler, Samuel and the pool concierge Vincente were both superb and made our stay awesome. The only con I have is someone was allowing children into the Adult section and while it didn't bother me, I don't think its fair to people that pay extra money to have to feel bad for asking the staff to make children leave.  As for the restaurants, the food overall is great.  The sushi restaurant was outstanding, and our server Eddie was by far the best server we've had on both trips.  He was attentive and polite with a smile on his face.  La Palapa in the Royal service area has excellent food with great service  and an amazing ocean side view. While the food in other restaurants was good, the service was lacking.  We ate at the buffet, the Argentinian steak hose and Mole.  While not awful, the service was mediocre in these three restaurants.  Overall I recommend Paradisus as it is a luxury hotel with amazing pools, a beautiful beach and good food with premium beer and liquor available, make sure you ask!

reviews.author: Vinnie42003
reviews.title: “Beautiful and relaxing, definitely recommend”
reviews.text:
I stayed here last September for 3 nights. It was such a great experience. We were upgraded to a suite facing the ocean, initially we were gonna stay in the room facing the lagoon.

Right on the main street across from the ocean. Beautiful views, and very spacious. I was very modern looking and very comfortable. It was close to everything, and great to be able to walk right out to the beaches. The room was also a great bargain considering the location. I'd definitely stay again! Look on their website, they have really good pictures of the rooms.

We were looking over the beach & sea. The whole wing (Red Carpet) we stayed at is secure and gated. Staff were very friendly and Chef Levy is the very best Chef, I will return for sure..

reviews.author: Nicolas1955
reviews.title: PARAÍSO EN CANCÚN
reviews.text:
Me he hospedado en este gran hotel con mi esposa, desde el día 3 al 10 de julio. Queremos hacer constar nuestro agradecimiento por la excelente atención y trato recibido por los siguientes profesionales:
Restaurante Naos: Francisco Pacheco.
Toji Bar: Irving y Juan.
Responsables de la conservación de tortugas: Ángel, Rafael y Bibiana.
Personal de limpieza y mantenimiento en general.
Recepción: José María y Patricia.
Todos ellos nos han hecho muy agradable la estancia, tanto a nivel profesional como personal.
En cuanto a las instalaciones, el hotel cuenta con todos los servicios que un cliente exigente pueda demandar y la ambientación interior es magnífica. 
En definitiva, lo recomendamos para futuros visitantes y nos llevamos un grato recuerdo.
                                Nicolás Melo y Dory Díaz (Tenerife - Canarias).

reviews.author: Lori
reviews.title: Great beach, drinks and food
reviews.text: I recently returned from a 6 night girls getaway to Paradisus and had a good experience. The beach is one of the best in Cancun.  A long stretch of sand along the beautiful turquoise waters with plenty of room in either direction for a long walk.  Other beaches I've been too are rocky and not as fun, but this is perfect.  Ocean is perfect for swimming and playing in the waves as well and there is plenty of room and chairs for laying out.  Enrique at the center bar by the Sushi restaurant is AMAZING!! He is the best bartendar I have ever met and he will make you anything you can dream up and it will be delicious!!  He is definitely one of the shining stars of the resort.   Food is really great as well, sushi was amazing, as was the Mediterraean tapas restaurant and taco bar.   The staff was really helpful with everything and spa was pricey but a great experience.   Only negatives would be check-in and nightlife.  Check-in was a little disorganized and a long process.  Also the check in area is pretty small andd makes for a crowded experience.  Nightlife was great at the center bar with Enrique, but I would have really liked to have an outside bar that stays open later until 1 or 2 or so.  While you are near the ocean you want to be outside as much as possible.  A tiki bar with a band and dancing would be lots of fun or at least something fun outside to do at night.

reviews.author: nicole s
reviews.title: For the price, its ok
reviews.text: I just returned 3 days ago from a girls getaway to the Paradisus.    We stayed in building 3 and while we thought the interior of the hotel was amazing we felt the food and entertainment were a bit lacking.    A word of advance, make reservations as soon as you check in.   We paid for all inclusive but then were told more than once that all of the places to eat were booked.   So we had to eat in the cafateria type setting.    Also, they do not have a coffee "station" which was frustrating.   You can order room service but it took 45 minutes.   Again, it doesn't feel all inclusive if you can't eat and drink where you would like.   We weren't asking for coffee at odd times, it was the morning.   You could get coffee in Naos, which is the cafeteria basically but you couldn't take it out of the area.   The beach and view are amazing so I suppose you have to consider the trade off.   It was clean and reasonably priced so I guess the other things are minor.  We also were disappointed that they had zero entertainment.   After 9:00 we would desperate for something to do.   They did have a few bars open but nothing was going on.  In fact they had small children running around in them.   Again, nothing tragic just little frustrations.

reviews.author: MexiShrey
reviews.title: Amaze!
reviews.text: We read a lot about the hotel before we checked in. Our goal was to upgrade to their "Red Level" and did as soon as we checked in. Everyone was helpful and friendly. Food was great at all the a la carte restaurants. Unlimited drinks and food was a plus for sure. I went to the spa for a deep tissue massage, which was a nice time as well.

reviews.author: Ang1962
reviews.title: Paradisus IS a Paradise!!!!!
reviews.text:
I just got back last night from a girls trip with my daughter, Sister in law, and nieces!  Two ages 24, one age 22. I felt the need to write this review because of all the negative reviews!  All the hotels have good and bad reviews, so I was worried about this resort.  If you're planning on going to this one, rest assured that it's wonderful!  

The negative reviews are probably from people that are so picky, and probably run the staff ragged!!!

We had the most relaxing wonderful girls trip ever.  I don't know if we ever could top the experience we had!

We were in two ocean front ROYAL SERVICE rooms with a fabulous view! Probably my only negative is that I requested adjoining rooms and they told me it was wasn't available.  We were only one room away from each other so it was fine.  

Royal Service is an adults only area of the resort.   I was worried the girls would think it was boring, but assured them, we could use the whole resort if they wanted to go to the main areas.  We only went to the main area to do water aerobics.  It was so peaceful at our pool.  We switched between the pool and the beach all day until 7:00 every night.  At times we had the huge pool all to ourselves.  There was La Papalapa Restaurant with service staff that served us there, or  at our private bali bed!  We had drinks, water, food, towels, anything we wanted, at any time! The girls asked for chocolate ice cream that wasn't on the menu, and they went and got it for them! They even had reading materials and sunscreen available.  They came around at different times during the day to offer us, face mist, fruit screwer, and just to check to make sure we were ok.  I'm sorry I wasn't better with getting the names of the people that were out there.  Francisco was one, and the pool boy in the towel area was so sweet!!!  

This program won't allow me to go to the top. :o( We arrived and were escorted to a private waiting area, until our butler was available to take us to our room.  Hector! He offered to unpack for us!  We declined.  He told us anything we need just contact him and he would see to it.  We made all our reservations for dinners, that did get messed up! But, I would never let that dim my review.  That can happen.  It was a mistake and we just rearranged.  

Royal Service has a private dining area that serves continental breakfast, light snacks in the afternoon, and a premium bar and snacks from 4 till 9.  Premium bar with top shelf liquor that you self serve yourself with all mixers.  We never ate anywhere else for breakfast.  There was enough selection for us to be happy. And NO crowds to deal with.  There was always an egg dish, breakfast meat, and potatoes, and the other side had, fresh fruit, cereals, European breakfast things such as meats and cheeses.  They made cappuccino's, latte's, and expresso's to your liking.  

We ordered lunch outside every day but one we went to the Market Grill, and had a table overlooking one of the pools one day.  

We ate in Mole, very good, mexican.  Bana, very good, sushi restaurant.  Blue Agave, very good, mexican. Market Grill, very good, brazilian steakhouse.  We were able to order whatever we wanted on the menu.  

There were house wines but if you wanted a bottle there was an up charge, and we tried to get sake at Bana and they said it wasn't available at the time.  We were fine with what was included.  

The Royal Service offers a water ritual treatment, one per day per person, for free.  We didn't use it until the last day, and were sorry we didn't take advantage of it everyday.  It was so refreshing after a day in the sun!  

We did tip as we went along.  As per other reviewers, not much but, a small amount.  The service was spectacular. 

There were people cleaning at all times, all over the resort.  This resort has some flaws, but by no means anything big that would mar this review!

Some people said the beds were not comfortable.  Not so!!!  My only complaint would be they have standard size pillows, but in Royal Service there's a pillow menu to order more or other types of pillows!  I did not bother with this, but if it was a big enough deal I could have gotten more!  The bed linens were very soft, and beds nicely made, and sheets changed after 2 days, not necessary in my opinion, but nice.  

The bathroom is very nice and roomy.  My complaint in there is that the hairdryer was terrible. If you need one bring your own.   

They serviced the room twice a day, but we left our do not disturb sign on the door while at dinner.  I didn't need them to go in twice a day.  

During June, the turtles come up on the beach to lay eggs around 10:00 PM and we were lucky enough to see 3 on the beach the night we went.  We were told by the staff, that someone takes the eggs, and takes care of them, until maturity, and in July they return them to the resort and they let the guest let them go on the beach.  So if you go ask if that's happening while you're there.

This resort is beautiful inside!!!!  Plant life everywhere and water life also.  In the lobby areas it's extremely warm and humid.  It's a huge area, probably a fortune to AC.  The restaurants are air conditioned.  

I'm not sure about the water served at restaurants.  It was poured from pitchers, so I ordered sparkling water, and brushed with bottled water.  I'm sorry to say, we did get a little sick while there, but we ate all the mexican foods!  The buffet had plenty of american choices but we wanted to go to the restaurants.  

If you go, I would highly recommend spending the extra, for us it wasn't that much more with Bookit, and so well worth it!   We were also able to book a private van for our transfers, which was really nice, for the same price as going with other groups to other hotels.  This hotel is only about 15 minutes from airport.  

This is a wonderful resort!  The girls took one excursion, but otherwise we stayed at the resort.  I would highly recommend this hotel!

Please message me if you have any questions.

reviews.author: Nicole B
reviews.title: EXCELLENT HOTEL
reviews.text: Beautiful Hotel kept immaculate with a ton of staff ready to help.  Favourite à la carte restaurant is Bana.  Food was amazing here--try the calamari and specialty rolls!  Make sure to book your sittings (for all à la carte) early the day before to get a good time.  Direct access to beach--tons of towels, drinks were great, food was good, service was amazing, pools are lovely.  You might want to make sure your room is not above the lounge (due to disco/shows on the weekend).  Check out is a breeze and you can print boarding pass day before.  If you book without transport included to airport, a taxi will take you there for about $33 USD...nice and quick. Would recommend this hotel to everyone!

reviews.author: Josie P
reviews.title: Awesome Vacation!
reviews.text: It's been a month since I got back from my trip cancun and i wanna go back so bad. It was life changing experience. The hotel is amazing. Thank you to the staff, but I have to mention Jonathan, the gym instructor with a steal patience. I had an amazing time training with him. Xavier, the one with the super energy for the sport activities and lovely smile. Thx you for showing us Mamboo Cafe I had an amazing time. Also thx to Moise (sorry for the wrong spelling) he is one of the massotherapists he did an amazing massage. The whole spa treatment was amazing. Thank you for the wonderful treatment you guys are amazing.

reviews.author: Davalfher
reviews.title: Best hotel I've ever stayed
reviews.text:
This was my first time in Cancun, and quite rewarding!
We stayed in the Club Melia part (Pyramid 1), which consists of time share kind of rooms.
They are complete and full to the top of what you can ask for!
* Separate room and living/dining rooms
*  Full kitchen, including mini-fridge, microwave, toaster, coffe machine, 2 stove tops, full kitchen utensils and silverware. Pots, cutting board, etc.
* Lot of storage
* Dining table with 4 chairs
* Sofa-bed
* 40" flat panel TV with home theater!
* 40" flat panel TV in the bedroom
* King size bed
And the top of the cake:
* Jacuzzi in the balcony!
The staff is very kind and helpful.
The beach in front is pristine blue and have the right amount of waves to make it fun.
The long extensive pool has some concrete beds inside, and the usual reclining beds outside.
Thai beds around the pool and some facing the beach from some height make it special and ideal for romantic moments.
There's a pool bar as well.
Plenty of restaurants of different styles to choose from.
Parking is a little tight but OK. Valet parking is the standard.
I love the security, always checking whenever you arrive by car.
I enjoyed the external design, pyramid style, and the internal decor is quite spectacular with long plants hanging from very high floors, make it unique. Very luscious gardens all around.
Had the luck to enjoy a room with seaside view, unbeatable. Even at ground level had a spectacular view! and that is a plus for not having to take elevators.

reviews.author: Arlyn G
reviews.title: Great trip!!
reviews.text: This is our second time at this hotel, first time was in May of 2012  when it was gran melia. We were there from June 1-10th. We had 3 days of nonstop rain and thunder, but enjoyed the hotel and the spa. Most of the servers and staff are kind and very helpful, to name a few Joel at Mole and the hostess Margarita, Juan at Tempo(who accommodated a double portion of the fish since I don't eat meat), Ignacio Vasquez and Gerardo Cox at Naos, Natanael (who had the chef make me grilled fish, even though only meat is served at the Market Grill) and Jose. We had the all inclusive and the tips are included, but could not leave without tipping the servers as they went above and beyond to serve us in any way possible. Thank you for a great experience!

reviews.author: MariiaR
reviews.title: EXCELLENT TRIP! TRULY PARADISE!
reviews.text:
I have been to Cancun 3x, and have never written a review.  But for Paradisus, I felt I had to.  

We stayed in the resort May 19 to the 22nd.  First off, the resort itself is GORGEOUS.  As soon as you enter, it smells amazing and you are surrounded by the cascading vines that just look amazing.  We were greeted with drinks, and taken straight to our room despite the fact that we got there 4 hours before check in time.

The rooms were beautiful and the bathrooms were spotless.  We had an oceanview which was BEYOND gorgeous.  Bed was so comfortable, did not want to leave!

The pools and beach were great!  The best part of the trip was the staff.  I never felt so pampered and catered to.  They were they at your service and never felt as though I was bothering them.  Sofonia, Enrique, and Luis were EXCELLENT!!! The bartender at the swim up bar, Giovanni was amazingggg!! Best drinks ever!  

I must say, every other all inclusive resort, the food is anywhere from horrible to blah, but at Paradisus, the food was DELISHHH at every restaurant!

I know I probably forgot to write a lot, but please just go to this hotel, you will not regret it!!

reviews.author: Marielena C
reviews.title: El hotel es un sueño hecho realidad!!!!
reviews.text: Desde q te reciben, el lugar es un completo encanto, todo es hermoso, una`paz y un confort indescriptibles, las personas q atienden son un Amor, siempre con esa calidez Mexicana q caracteriza este país tan hermoso. Siempre dispuestos a ayudarte, y atenderte como t mereces. El lugar es bellisimo, adentro, pareciera q rapunzel lanzara sus cabellos q en vez d ser d oro, son enredaderas de arboles... es magico estar alli. Todo funciona d maravilla. Es perfecto!!!! lo recomiendo enormemente!

reviews.author: AngelaWashDC
reviews.title: Fabulous all-inclusive resort
reviews.text:
This was my first trip to Cancun and i couldn't have asked for a better vacation.  We were there for 7 days at the end of May, which seemed like a great time to go because the hotel wasn't full.  From what i could tell, the resort was the largest and nicest in Cancun.  An easy 20-minute ride from the airport (ask the hotel for a recommendation for airport transportation and pre-book it).  The rooms are nice and very clean.  The staff is friendly and helpful.  For an all-inclusive resort, we weren't sure how the food would be, but all of the restaurants are really quite good.  (Some of them require reservations, which can be made earlier in the day or the day before).  The pools are gorgeous.  The large pool has a swim up bar!  

The resort offers off-campus activities like snorkeling, scuba-diving, etc., and the prices didn't seem outrageous.

If you really want to pamper yourself, be sure to check out the spa.  They have daily specials on massages and other treatments, so ask about them.  You can get some good deals!

If you want to do nothing but relax on vacation, this is the perfect spot.

reviews.author: EBTravels
reviews.title: Great hospitality and a top notch staff..
reviews.text:
A friend and I stayed in the royal service area for a girls weekend from 5/25-6/1. Upon arrival we waited around 10 minutes before being escorted to our tower via golf cart with another couple. Our butler gave us a run down of the hotel amenities and general directions to the different facilities before we got keys to our room. We had an EXCELLENT view and the room was clean and huge. After reading some other reviews I'm surprised, Ives stayed in 5 star hotels all over the world and found this room very much as expected. Comfy beds, newer furnishings, spacious room and bath.

We took advantage of the reserved Bali beds about 4 of 7 days while there. Excellent service from the royal service team, cocktails were readily offered whether we were in the pool, on the beach chairs, or in our bali beds. Very impressed by the frequency with which they checked on us. We also had (infrequent but awesome) offerings of fruit on trays and even a butler spraying our faces with evian water and cold towels....nice little touch!!

We had a massage included in our package and it was great. We enjoyed the water "ritual" before the massage as it was fun to pop around to the different stations. The only downside is that there was a bit of construction and this was a little uncomfortable as the workers were staring at us while we lazed around in the pool. I would have complained if not fornthe fact that it would have been a burden to find someone.  But it was a bit disturbing.

Restaurants.....
Tempo was the best by far, we went there twice in 7 days
The meat market (market grill) was ok - chicken was delicious but I was turned off by the somewhat gritty clientele that just rolled off the beach in their tees and flip flops. Not very classy forma beach side atmosphere.

La palapa was great, we ate here most days for lunch. Guac was delicious. Great waitstaff.

Fuego was just ok. The tuna appetizer was a little off putting/not fresh so I could not eat it. The truffled potatoes were good but it was only two bites.

Buffet was good, lots of selections, hard to complain for a buffet.

Mole was also ok, food wise...as it was not he traditional Mexican we hoped for. But good service.

Loved the tacos at blue agave (and the guac was refilled as needed!).  We went here twice for lunch and both times delish.

The royal service perks were great. Open bar from 12ish until around 9pm (serve yourself, this was an awesome feature!). Not sure how people are saying the drinks are watered down here as it's serve-yourself....the bottles are left out unopened until you need them...so the grey goose we had was fresh from the bottle that I opened up mysel! On more than one occasion! The only compliants I'd have are that they need more glasses (styrofoam cups are not very royal), and they need to restock the snacks. I was sad that I'd we didn't get to the bar quickly the snacks might be gone. But having said that they had excellent night time apps (ceviche, nuts, cheese, mini wraps) that hit the spot.

I misplaced my phone case during my stay (left it on a lobby couch and it was gone 10 mins later when I dame back to check). I altered the front desk and they continued to look for it formthe final 3 days we were there. Fred B actually came out tot the pool to find me twice to ask if anyone had found it yet, and personally called tomtry another time to find it.  I was not that concerned since it was just a phone case, but he was so gracious to try to help above and beyond what was expected. The next morning when I was about to check out, I tried to mail some postcards. I didn't have any pesos for stamps, so I would have had to run around the hotel if I wanted to mail them before I left.  Fred recognized this and told me he'd tak care of it, it was his pleasure. I asked him how much...he said no problem.  I gave him 3 dollars and he almost threw it back at me, but I insisted.  I was shocked at how persistent but amazingly great customer service he provided!!!!!

The avenue/red lounge were not that exciting but sufficient for a cocktail before bed. I admit that I loved the gold hand chairs atbred lounge!!!!! And the bartender was not stingy with the drinks if you threw him a follor or two.

Overall, greet stay.  We'd come back with more friends next time!

reviews.author: teresa8_10
reviews.title: GREAT TIME AT THIS HOTEL
reviews.text: We were a group of 6 ladies celebrating a birthday in Cancun, we stayed at this hotel for a week, it is a  very large hotel which was a bit disorientating at first , we were in pyramid 1 . Check in was very slow and staff didn't seem to know were we were supposed to be, after a 10 hour flight this was a bit of a pain. when we settled in everyone thought it was great. Swimming pools were a bit deep for non-swimmers but lovely , beach was beautiful with waiter service for drinks, lots of sun beds and umbrellas, staff were excellent very friendly especially breakfast staff, Orlando worked very hard too please.  restaurants very good but have too be booked in advance except the buffet which had plenty of choice,  bars good too .Paradisus is a ride away from Cancun which was fine for us, we got a taxi in twice. overall i would recommend this hotel as we had a great time there

reviews.author: Azra B
reviews.title: Pretty good vacation, considering the circumstances!
reviews.text:
We stayed at this hotel for 7 days and we were satisfied with overall everything. The hotel offers a $1000 gift card to use at the hotel upon arrival, however, they dont tell you that it is coupons in certain denominations for specific things. We were hoping to use the "gift card" on massages, but once we got there, we realized we got 3 coupons for massages which were $50 each, yet the massages are $110 and up. Aside from this, everything else was fairly good. The rooms were clean and we didnt have any problems in there, although some patio furniture would be nice (there was only one chair). The restaurants are super easy to book, all you have to do is dial 0 from your room and you can book them right away. There was always availability when we phoned. The food was also very good; we quite enjoyed the Mexican restaurant and also the Tempo restaurant (the second one you have to pay for, but we ended up using the coupons I spoke of). The buffet is open until 11pm also and has a variety of foods and it was also delicious, so if you go for dinner at a restaurant and you dont enjoy it, you always have the option of going to the buffet. The Avenue Bar and the Red Lounge (the main bar and nightclub) were probably my favourite parts of this hotel. It is very modern and theres always good music and the service was impeccable! It is a great place to meet people as well. The beach and the pools are pretty nice, the staff brings you drinks AND food right to your chair regardless if you are royal service or not (I found the better you tip, the better the service...and its a good idea to tip first thing in the morning when you get to the pool so then they will take care of you). 

The one thing I must warn people about is: BE CAREFUL WHEN WASHING YOUR FEET OFF AT THE BEACH! When I said in the title "considering the circumstances', that is because I broke my ankle while I stayed at this hotel! On our second day here, I tripped and fell on the cement where you wash your feet before going into the hotel or the pool. It is usually covered in sand, and you cannot see there is a ledge so my foot ran into it and broke :( I ended up in a cast for the remainder of my trip. The life guards were very helpful once they saw me, but it was pretty difficult to get a wheelchair from the main desk for the rest of my trip. They wanted me to rent it, even though the accident happened at the hotel. I did end up getting it from them, but it was to the point where I had to cry in order for them to give it to me. They explained that they only had one wheelchair for the entire hotel, so if any other emergencies were to occur, they would need it for the other person. I understood this, but I also needed them to understand that it was difficult getting around the hotel with crutches all day everyday, especially with marble floors which were sometimes wet! (Very easy to break another leg!)

Despite all of this, I still had fun and I still came back with good memories. There were 4 staff members that I will never forget! They completely made this trip totally worth it and I cannot thank them anymore for their hospitality, amazing service, and their amazing personalities! German, Coral, Denisse and Antonio (who were all working at the Avenue Bar when I was there) were truly the reason that I enjoyed my trip as much as I did. We got to know each other on our first day here, they were extremely nice and entertaining! Everyday after that just kept getting better with them! Especially since I was in a cast, they were totally helpful and always paid attention to my needs. A special thank you goes out to them for everything they did and all the memories we shared. If I come back to this resort, it will definitely be because of these 4 people!

reviews.author: zneh
reviews.title: Best resort in Cancun hands down!!!
reviews.text: I am in love with this resort and will be returning with friends and family again. This has to be one if not the best resort on the island. I have stayed in many resorts in Cancun and in other Caribbean locations and this has to be my best. The service is WOW.... and the décor of the lobby with its amazon look is just so relaxing. Andre, the waiter in the buffet restaurant is the best along with everyone else. The rooms are extremely clean. And the Ocean view is just heavenly. I will be returning with others.

reviews.author: cookie10
reviews.title: love this hotel
reviews.text:
this hotel was wonderful, from the front security person(hector) to the royal service butler(Samuel) . quick check in, lovely rooms,. pool service with benson, Consuela,fransico, all made this trip one to remember. always ready to  assist you any way they could. beach cabana's were wonderful. food was great. this is from  four ladies that had a great 6 day vacation in paradise.

thank you to all of you again. wonderful people at this hotel.

reviews.author: Donya T
reviews.title: AMAZING RESORT!!!
reviews.text:
Me & 2 of my girlfriends went to Paradisus in Cancun and I have nothing but good things to say about this place. It was my first time in Mexico and I absolutely loved it. ALL of the hotel staff were friendly and gave us great service each time. Our favourites though were German (bartender at Avenue Bar) and Coral & Denisse (waitresses at Avenue Bar & Red Lounge). These people truly made our vacation so special. They always gave us incredible service! My friend had a broken ankle while we were in Cancun and these 3 definitely did everything in their power to help her out. They are such wonderful people and I'm so glad I got a chance to meet them. I would come definitely come back to the resort just to be able to see these guys again. If you get a chance to meet German, get him to make you an Electric Lemonade! He made the best ones!! 

The food at the resort was very good. We went to Vento, Blue Agave, Naos, Mole, Tempo, Bana, & Market Grill. Tempo was my favourite! I wasn't a huge fan of Market Grill for dinner, but for lunch it was amazing. If you go to the pool, order the chicken wings. They're sooo delicious!

This resort is perfect for you if you are trying to go somewhere that isn't too rowdy like Oasis but isn't also dead. Me and my girlfriends are in our early 20s and we love to party but we don't like people screaming and getting out of hand, which is why this resort was perfect for us.

Thank you so much to all the staff at Paradisus for making our vacation truly special, and I especially want to thank German, Denisse, and Coral for everything they did for us and for making our vacation that much better.

reviews.author: Nicole S
reviews.title: This place was OK
reviews.text:
I went here in January and forgot to review. The hotel itself was nice enough but I wouldnt call it 4 star. You have to walk half a mile to get to the lobby from your room if youre in any building other than the main building. At one point I slipped on the stairs and sprained my ankle because theres only 1 elevator per wing and countless floors. 
The buffet breakfast was good.Other than that the food was awful. I like to think of myself as a foodie, Im willing to try anything and there is no style food I will not eat.
The first night we went to the asian restaurant. We ordered tuna sushi and a curry dish. The tuna was warm, which if you eat sushi know that is kind of gross. The curry was by far the worst thing I ate there. It tasted like throw up. It was so bad we couldnt even eat it and had to order room service just for something somewhat decent.
The tapas restaurant they had wasnt the worst but anything that was fish related tasted fishy. The scallops were over cooked and reaked of fish to the point where I almost got sick at the table. 
The other two restaurants they have werent too bad, but they werent good. 
The pool was nice if a little cold. The beach was beautiful. We got yelled at for taking a late night stroll though, that wasnt very nice. 
Id say this was the worst part:
Check in time was at 3pm. I called before we left requesting early check in. By the time we got there we were told our room was almost ready and to just speak with a man and he will explain hte hotel to us and show us to our room. Well, this man was really telling us about a time share.There were excursions we wanted to take and he told us to go to the timeshare seminar and that it would take 2 hours and we would receive a discount. It took almost 4 hours, we lost an entire day of laying at the pool or doing anything and the guy that was speaking to us was annoyed that we werent really interested in the program that we just wanted the discounts. The worst part about this was that after spending the 4 hours to get a massage at half price, the massage was possibly the worst massage I ever had. I usually feel like passing out after a massage, after this one I felt like I was more tense. It was almost like they gave us a bad massage because we paid less.
I would definitely not recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: evaminarro
reviews.title: excelente servicio  en el restaurant NAOS, por Franciso Pacheco
reviews.text: Excelente servicio de recepción en el programa vacacional , excelente servicio en las habitaciones, excelente servicio en el área de Spa, el servicio amable y de alta calidad en todas las áreas del Hotel, la reemodelación quedó excelente. Quiero felicitar tambien al Chef Picazo por sus atenciones.

reviews.author: delreydick
reviews.title: Great beach, wonderful staff
reviews.text: Spent 7 great days at the Paradisus Cancun. The service could not have been better. It started with a call  two days before I arrived from my concierge Claudia asking if there was anything she could do before i arrived. I asked for a oceanfront room which was waiting when I arrived. Claudia met  me in the lobby to answer any questions I had. She was very helpful through out my stay with reservations for dinner. I live in South Florida, so the beach is important to me. Could not ask for better. The surf was great and it was nice to walk on sand that did not burn my feet. Also the beach and pool staff of Jona, Orlando, and Javier went out of their way to to make the guests have a great time. The food was very good, and the staff was was top notch. My only complaint is there are many stairs and only one place to get beach towels. This is a large resort and i have bad knees so it wasn't that easy getting around. I have been to many resorts and this resort is the best. i gladly recommend the Paradisus Cancun and look forward to going back next year.

reviews.author: Volleyjay
reviews.title: Awesome week
reviews.text:
I have traveled extensively throughout the Caribbean and have been to Cancun twice before however this resort's staff was the best I have come across.  I the past five years I have been several times to Punta Cana, also St Johns, Barbados, Cove Bahamas, P Rico,  St Thomas, Curacao, and Aruba to name a few.   This resort is finely designed and decorated throughout.
The crew of Jona, Orlando and Javier were exceptional at the beach and pool. The went out of their way to help the guests enjoy their time. We stayed at the Club section and the rooms was great. I asked for DVD player and it was hooked up 15 minutes later. My experience with the food has been very good to excellent ! I would recommend this hotel if you enjoy excellent service, great food and one beautiful beach.

reviews.author: Perspective Hospitality
reviews.title: VERY RUDE Reception/Bell Staff, Constant Smell of Mold....
reviews.text:
If you want to be treated like a second-class citizen, and you LOVE the smell of mold, this is the resort for you.

Also, it is AT LEAST a $20 USD cab ride to get anywhere. To get to the downtown area, its about $40 USD.

RECEPTION STAFF:
I was also in the group with the reviewer below. The hotel staff CLAIMS that they cannot not guarantee a room type, but this simply is not true. When we checked in, the hotel KNEW that they were being dishonest because when we entered the room, the extra bed was ALREADY SET IN THE ROOM!

This meant that the hotel was aware that they had sold the room type that we paid for. The front desk staff treated us like we were just trash. The Petrobras group that were at the hotel were great people, and very kind, and the hotel staff could have taken a lesson in courtesy and kindness from the Brazilians.

FOOD STAFF:
Amazingly helpful people. We always tipped them as much as we could because they gave us excellent service. One problem: they were always trying to sell us DRUGS AND PROSTITUTES! Invariably. I'm not joking. Maybe they were joking around with us, maybe not. Who knows. It was weird.

Food quality was excellent.

PUBLIC SPACE:
It was constantly being cleaned, which is excellent, because the hotel was always spotless. This however didn't seem to eliminate the constant smell of mold around the entire hotel. I have a very immediate and drastic reaction to mold, so I spent my entire stay with a swollen throat and inflamed sinuses.

BELL STAFF:
Bottom line: Petrobras was leaving at the same time as us, so needless to say, the front of the hotel was very crowded with people and bags. At one point I was standing on the sidewalk, minding my own business, and I got plowed down by a bell cart being pushed by a bellman. He didn't even ask me to get out of the way! He just rammed it straight into me!

Whoever responds to this review from the staff, if they even care to response, will probably respond with some stupid policy about the rooms, and some dishonest promise of their dedication to service. All of it is a farse.

STAY AWAY FROM THIS RESORT!

reviews.author: Luiz Alberto P
reviews.title: Simplesmente formidável
reviews.text: Excepcional. Tudo muito bom. Atendimento nota 1000. Localização ótima. Voltando a Cancun , certamente me hospedarei lá novamente. Fica em frente ao cais, que saem barcos para passeios. As refeições são excelentes.

reviews.author: Jovarro
reviews.title: Extraordinaria inmersión al caribe mexicano !
reviews.text: El servicio fue de primera. El atrio principal es un descanso lleno de naturaleza que te invita a admirarlo cada vez que pasas por él. El color del mar fue de ensueño ! Las habitaciones con terraza te permiten admirar el entorno del hotel. Estarás cautivado por los aromas, las luces y los diferentes estilos a lo largo del hotel. El SPA fue un descanso total con un servicio de maravilla

reviews.author: scarpenter949
reviews.title: Frist Class Resort
reviews.text: Just returned from Paradisus Cancun: Frist class resort all the way from check in to check out. They are great, room clean and great view, everyone was there to make your vacation experince the best. When you walk in the smell was relaxing and clam, check in the staff was warm and welcoming.  The resturants great selection of food and different venues for every taste.  The staff neat clean and professional, pool staff Miquel, Juan aka " Johnny Cuba", Sara the hostess at the resturant.  The thing that impresses me was the customer service, if you ask how to get somewhere on the resort they would escort you there, they went out of their way to make sure that you had a great experince.  Hats off to the staff of Paradisus they have been trained well and take great pride in their jobs.  If you have a chance go here you will not be dissapointed. AAA++.  Thank you for making this a trip of a lifetime and memories that will be with me forever.

reviews.author: ohnename
reviews.title: Zimmer mit unterschiedlicher Qualität
reviews.text:
Das Paradisus Cancun ist so manchem Reisenden vielleicht noch als das Melia Cancun bekannt. Es gibt einige Veränderungen, wie z.B. die neue Speiseterrasse die zum verweilen einlädt, dem !aufmerksamen! Personal und dem neu angelegtem Ruhebereich zwischen Pool und Strand. 
Etwas nervig sind die Gäste die in aller Herrgottsfrühe schon Ihre Handtücher verteilen um dann Stunden später erst die Liegen zu nutzen.
Die Zimmer sind leider von so unterschiedlicher Qualität, was Größe, Lage und Blick angeht, dass man schlecht eine Kritik oder Empfehlung aussprechen kann.
Das Buffet ist hervorragend und es bleiben keine Wünsche übrig.
Fazit: wer ein all-in Hotel in Cancun sucht ist hier mit Sicherheit gut aufgehoben.

reviews.author: anaportilo
reviews.title: es un hotel bueno para vacacionar
reviews.text: nos hospedamos el 14 de abril x 6 dias fueron excelentes sus trabajadores super amables juancarlos vargas, limber vazquez y veronica excelentes personas un trato amable como pocos lo unico malo del hotel es k t insisten mucho en la compra del tiempo compartido y k cierran muy temprano los bares de las albercas y playa todo lo demas muy bien si regresamos a este hotel felicidades

reviews.author: striker
reviews.title: Muy bueno, con detalles para mejorar!
reviews.text:
El hotel es muy bueno, muy bellamente decorado, super limpio, la comida en los restaurantes es de excelente calidad, las habitaciones son de buen tamaño y con camas muy comodas, en fin, un 8/10. 

Pero voy a dejar lo que me parece a mi,  puntos a mejorar:

- Atencion de los mozos en la playa: No se si habran reducido personal o que pero, a veces ni dando propina tenias un buen servicio! Preguntamos y nos respondieron que tenian un area muy grande que atender y era obvio, no daban abasto, por lo tanto nos teniamos que levantar de nuestra reposera en playa e ir a buscar una bebida al bar de playa.

- Mas opciones para el snack de playa: Si querias comer algo relativamente "sano" estando en la playa te tenias que ir e ir a buscar algo al restaurant Naos. Para comer algo en la playa te ofrecian toda comida chatarra (hamburguesas, hot dogs, papas fritas y creo que nada mas). Si bien la comida era muy rica, no dejaba de ser comida chatarra! Aumentaras de peso seguro!

- Atencion de los mozos en el salon desayunador: Estan tan ocupado limpiando las mesas para que otras personas desayunen que...no te prestan atencion! Un solo dia tuve un mozo que realmente nos atendio bien y fue atento, el resto fue rezar para que alguno te sirva el cafe o directamente tenias que levantarte y llamarlos, mal ahi.

- Cerveza: No puede ser que solo posean un tipo de cerveza en el restoran buffet (Naos) o en el bar de playa!! Solo sirven una cerveza tirada de regular calidad (creo que me dijeron que es  Dos Equis, a mi no me gustó). Estando en Mexico no pude probar en el hotel la cerveza Corona "no tenemos", la cerveza Negra Modelo "no tenemos"...no puede ser! Bebidas nacionales de Mexico y no las ofrecen!!!! Mal ahi!!! (solo habia Sol y Tecate en el frigobar de la habitacion)

- Detalles de la remodelacion: El hotel ha sido parcialmente remodelado, la verdad está muy lindo,  aunque dejaron detalles, quizas para renovarlos mas adelante, no lo se, pero es una lastima dejar sin remodelar, por ejemplo, el espejo del baño de la habitacion (con manchas de humedad muy visibles), la tapa del deposito de agua del inodoro partida y reparada "sin ganas" con pegamento, manchas de sellador en las paredes que no se limpiaban a pesar de la limpieza diaria, etc.

Me gustaria aclarar que la atencion de todos los empleados, en cualquiera de sus puestos, es super amable y bien predispuesta, algo que vale mucho y es muy valorable.

Volveria? SI!! Pero me gustaria que mejoren esos pequeños detalles que estoy seguro lo haran!

reviews.author: ZeSilva5
reviews.title: Estadia Excelente
reviews.text:
Bem por onde comecar esta aventura fantastica..... Fui com uma amiga a Paradisus Cancun passado dia 25.04.2013.... fomos passar o fim de semana... Resultado: Fim de semana FANTASTICO!!....Ficamos no Royal Service con uma vista mar espectacular...desde o check in super simpaticos, Mayordomo Samuel super atencioso com tudo.Fomos comer no BlueAgave, comida tipica mexicana, quesadillas, tacos.... muito bom.... a atencao deles muito boa!! Logo jantamos no Restaurante Fuego, optimo restaurante, a comida nem se fala, fomos recebidos por uma hostess e nos deu uma mesa super linda... resultado: saimos super contentes do jantar! Dia seguinte: praia, a praia è enorme, tem muito espaco, os empregados de mesa sempre com boa disposicao de servir, despois de almocar fomos ao SPA! Luis manager do SPA es 5 estrelas!!!!! Uma atencao especial "a personal del SPA" , a Merli que super simpatica e atenta a tudo, a Moises que da massagens espectaculares, y otra chica que comeca com Ye ou Ya (desculpa nao sei o nome) mas tambem foi muito simpatica. A atencao das pessoas que limpam os quartos suuuuuper bem merecem 5 estrelas!
Aconselho que disfrutem deste maravilhoso hotel!! Vamos voltar!

reviews.author: Sandro D
reviews.title: Semana em Paradisus
reviews.text: Ótimo hotel! Boa localização, boa praia, bom serviço! Muitos passeios disponíveis a partir do hotel. Quartos amplos, banheira, sacada para o mar. Restaurante japonês muito bom. Ótimas piscinas. Garçons muito atenciosos e a maioria fala bem portunhol.

reviews.author: Alejandro P
reviews.title: Otro concepto de alojamiento
reviews.text:
No suelo hacer este tipo de cosas (opinión) pero el hotel, la estancia, el trato y las experiencias en él vividas me llevaban/obligaban a la necesidad de compartirlo.

En mis diferentes viajes a Cancún, es decir, dispongo de criterio, para mí ha sido el destacable en cuanto a Hotel.

Comida excelente, variedad en la elección comida/restaurante y mi encanto/cita ineludible diaria: SPA. Conseguí un nivel de relajación que ningún otro SPA ha conseguido ofrecerme, trato del personal con magia. Gracias a éste...conocí las clases de YHI MOVES, deseando estoy volverlas a recibir.

Indiscutiblemente ya tengo hotel favorito para mis próximas y continuas visitas a Cancún.

reviews.author: Jane H
reviews.title: Para-Para-Paradisus Delivers!
reviews.text: Eight of us (some older than others, ahem) traveled to Cancun to celebrate some birthdays.  Our accommodations at the all-inclusive Paradisus were better than any of us expected.  Reading the few critical reviews on Trip Advisor gave us some hesitation, but after staying in PARADISE and being treated like the queens we believe we are, I am certain any negative comments were submitted by competitors.  The food was delicious and not like any of the other all-inclusive cafeteria cuisine I have experienced.  Enrique spoiled us by ensuring our glass was never half empty and always more than half full whether we were on the beach or poolside. Juan could not have been a more pleasant bellman; managing eight plus over-sized bags (no, not us but our luggage) and making us feel special.  Isabella at the front desk took care of our rowdy group with grace and charm.  I wish I wrote down the rest of the names of the extra special staff who gave us over-worked and under-paid carpool driving moms one of the nicest and most fun girls weekend we have had in a while.

reviews.author: marcelo_gzzb
reviews.title: EL MEJOR HOTEL PARA QUEDARSE
reviews.text:
El hotel Paradisus Cancun es el mejor hotel que pueda tener la ciudad de Cancun, es una mezcla de lujo y belleza de hotel. Es un hotel para que puedas descansar sin preocuparte de nada, solamente relajarse. Las personas del hotel son totalmente amables y se cercioran de que no faltan absolutamente nada al cliente. El servicio de Royal Service es lo mejor del mundo y con su exclusividad del mismo. Puedo decir que la calidad de los alimentos tanto en sus restaurantes como en su servicio al cuarto es magnifica. Las albercas son muy limpias. La limpieza del hotel es inmaculada y por ende, el servicio de limpieza es lo mejor. Porfavor, pregunten por Juan en Royal Service, es la persona mas amable, profesional, atenta y que se preocupa por el cliente que pueda conocer un servidor.

Marcelo González

reviews.author: andrec360
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text:
Bonjour! Je suis Belge et c'était ma première fois au Mexique. Je suis venue avec mes amis et j'en ai ete ravie. L'hôtel est superbe et les piscines sont superbes! Le personnel est merveilleux! Le spa magnifique! Service hôtelier excellent. Tout était impeccable de propre..
Je vous recommanderais surtout de ne pas manquer d'aller à la salle à muscule, je me suis fait des amis du personnel, ils sont super gentils! Merci à Adrian qui m'a aidée beaucoup :) il est magnifique et super souriant, comme tout les Mexicains <3
je me réjouis d'y retourner

reviews.author: 270LuisM
reviews.title: Grandiosa experiencia!!!
reviews.text:
Fue todo un descubrimiento el Paradisus Cancún, me había hospedado en otros hoteles y esta fue mi primera vez aquí. Fui con un grupo de amigos y la pasamos realmente bien. El servicio desde que llegamos fue excelente, el personal es muy atento y siempre está al pendiente de tus necesidades. 

Llegamos tiempo antes de la hora de check in y a pesar de que no estaba todavía disponible la habitación, nos permitieron dejar las maletas encargadas en lo que dimos un recorrido por el hotel para conocerlo.

Las instalaciones son padrísimas y muy acogedoras pero lo mejor es la vista del mar Caribe desde la habitacíón, es un espectáculo inolvidable. Me encanta toda la vegetación que hay tanto dentro como fuera del hotel, la parte del centro de la pirámide donde hay fuentes y jardines es genial.

Visité el YHI SPA y el servicio fue excelente, las instalaciones me gustaron mucho y se pasa un buen rato verdaderamente relajante. Recomiendo el ritual del agua, nada mejor para eliminar el estrés y pasar unas deliciosas vacaciones. 

Comimos en un par de restaurantes y la verdad es que todo muy rico, mi favorito fue el Market Grill. El servicio fue muy bueno y atento.

He leído en algunos otros reviews que el hotel fue remodelado, no lo conocí antes pero ahora me encanta y lo recomiendo.

reviews.author: QueenCharlotte05
reviews.title: Amazing Resort.
reviews.text: I have to visited some lovely resorts in Eastern Mexico ( Barcelo Maya Palace, Azul Beach,Riu Maya Palace, El Dorado Royale Casitas) and have to say that Paradisus Cancun is fantastic.  We stayed in Royal Service, Oceanview.  Three gals sharing a room and had an extra cot and had lots of room .  The service in this section is beyond expectation. Sergio at the pool was fantastic. we loved having a Bali bed each day.  I left my glasses on my chair and they called right away and delivered them to the room.. Any food, any drink, sunscreen, towels were all available from 7am on. Pool is great and water is warm.  Resort is very clean and updated. Buffet was fine but A la Cartes were lovely.  You can eat at Tempo for free and just pay for drinks if you stay there seven days.I loved Vento for the great Tapas.  Order lots since all portions are small.These people work so hard to make your vacation great so please give them a tip.Would recommend this resort to any of my friends.

reviews.author: Sue A
reviews.title: Melia turned Paradisus -- what's in a name!
reviews.text: This beautiful resort/hotel is trying to keep up with the current trend of being an all inclusive.  Don't believe it.  The Mexican restaurant is good and the breakfast buffet is outstanding but the rest of the restaurants are so-so.  I went of the ranch for all the rest of my meals. And they have now decided you have to wear a wrist band -- first year for that!  I felt like a dog being tagged.  Depending on your status it was a different color.  I have been coming to Cancun and the Melia for many years.  It is beginning to show its wear.  They need to put more into the physical place and less into the showy stuff like purple curtains in the bar.  As always the help are wonderful people.

reviews.author: alfredo t
reviews.title: Restaurant Tempo Paradisus Cancun: La joya de la Corona
reviews.text: Hemos concluído una semana santa espectacular en el Hotel Paradisus Cancun, sobre todo por lo que respecta al tema culinario. En efecto, el restaurant Tempo de Martin Berasategui es una fija para quienes desean experimentar el porqué a este chef vasco se la han otorgado 3 estrellas Michelin en su restaurant de San Sebastian, España. Aquí en Cancún, dos jóvenes muy talentosos, Felipe Quesada e Ismael Medina, alumnos aventajados de Berasategui, son los encargados de los fogones y han cocinado unos riquímos menús de degustación que no tienen desperdicio, hasta en tres oportunidades hemos comido en este altar de la alta cocina de Cancún y la Rivera Maya. Por cierto, son los habitantes de estas comunidades quienes se beneficiarán de este restaurant recientemente inaugurado porque pueden reservar y comer aún no estando alojados en el hotel a precios muy razonables. En fin, si vas de visita a Cancún, a vacacionar o vives en esta población, no dejer de ir a esta maravilla de restaurant, tu paladar te lo agradecerá por el resto de tu vida.

reviews.author: Regina M
reviews.title: A real paradise
reviews.text:
I went with a few friends to Cancun in March 2013 and stayed at H. Paradisus. It was the perfect choice; the hotel is amazing. Since the very first moment, you feel like in another world of peace and happiness. The first thing that stroke me once you enter was the nice smell. Then, the lobby is like a nice forest with plants, water, ... it's very relaxing. 

You can find a variety of restaurants; with excellent food and service. The employees are very nice and professional; they are there when you need them but not on top of you all the time (as you find in the US hotels).  It was specially nice the service at the swimming pool and beach area -where we spent most of our time! Overall, the service was excellent and the common areas are really enjoyable. The rooms are amazing as well but we did not spent much time in it because there were so many things we wanted to enjoy in the common areas, the spa, as well as the beach, that we did not have time! -)

We knew the hotel was good but it certainly exceeded our expectations. I highly recommend it if you go to Cancun!

reviews.author: Lourdes E
reviews.title: Un verdadero Paraiso!!
reviews.text: Estuvimos hace una semana de vacaciones con mis amigas en este hotel!! Lo mejor que nos pudo pasar!! es una verdadera maravilla! desde que llegas, el lobby es impresionante, y luego esa esencia que ponen, que nos contaron que es característica de la cadena, huele super!!! pasamos unos momentos inolvidables, la gente super amable, donde quiera una sonrisa. Comimos delicioso ya que el buffet era de lo mejor, había todo lo que hubiéramos deseado, de todo! Todas las instalaciones estaban en excelente estado, las habitaciones,  el servicio de toallas, las tumbonas, la playa es hermosa!!!! Pero si hay algo que nos impresiono, sin duda ha sido la atención del personal del hotel, es digno de destacarse, donde quiera una sonrisa, amables, resolviendote los problemas,  ayudandote, algo impresionante!!! así que hemos pasado unos momentos super bonitos! gracias a Paradisus!!

reviews.author: nikkicapri
reviews.title: Spring Break 2013
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful as well as the outside area. The rooms are spacious and nice once you figure out how to work the lights in the room and bathroom.  The tubs are high up and have an overhead shower spout as well as a handheld thing.  The buffet is a little to be desired...breakfast--no bacon or hash brown type potatoes.  It has a lot of odd type foods. Lunch - mediocore as well.  If you are not there by the time they put the food out, it becomes luke warm. They have the Market Grill ---which is pretty good (accept for the half done burgers). The best restaurant is the Asian place---not a hibachi grill. The Mexican and Med. are not what I expected. One downside to this hotel is that the club is located on the 1st floor.   You can hear the booming music throughout the hotel as well as your room.  Being on the 1st floor around the corner from the club didn't help any either.  The tequila tasting was good--Carlos Sommelser was very knowledgable on the tequila and very friendly. We had one rude waiter in the Market Grill--Rudy. He acted as if we were an inconvenience in placing orders for stuff.  Even took it upon himself to get the same drink for everyone.  When asked if he was having a bad day, he indicated that he was very busy.  The place wasn't even crowded.  The other wait staff were nice.

reviews.author: Katherine J
reviews.title: Great resort for all ages
reviews.text: I was at Pardisius Cancun for my spring break and loved every minute of it. Besides the beautiful beaches there was always something to do. The activities staff always had something fun planned and one of the guys Diego would come and personally invite us to the activities. I think my favorite was the tequila tasting and the wine tasting but there were also fun activities at night going on at the bar. This resort has everything, theres really no need to ever leave! Overall, a high quality resort and it is even better under the new name and management. All of the staff made me feel very welcomed and I can't wait to go back again next year!

reviews.author: Selim B
reviews.title: Couldn't ask for more !
reviews.text: My week at the Paradisus Cancun was just Awesome ! Friendly Staff, All of them, they are always here to give you a smile !! I felt like home since my first day ! High quality service !! Delicious diverse food everyday !! Wonderful beach, I had the best time ever to relax ! I would definitely advice this place for anyone who plan to visit Cancun .. Don't miss it !!!!

reviews.author: Amy1990_11
reviews.title: AMAZING!!
reviews.text: Im a 22 year old girl who went here for 10 days with one of my best friends, we had the most amazing time at this hotel. All of the staff are friendly and welcoming wherever you go, always willing to help you. The food at the hotel was lush, something for everyone and different everyday, was worried at first as had read bad comments on here before we went about the food. We went to coco bongo when was out there, would defiantly reccommend to anyone was an amazing night out! I would defiantly reccommend this hotel to all sorts of ages, young, old, familes. This hotel was by far one of the bestest i have ever stayed in!!

reviews.author: joy m
reviews.title: Beyond Amazing....
reviews.text: This is one of many trips we have taken to Mexico, and not our first to the Paradisus Cancun (formerly Gran Melia).  My husband and I were blown away by the renovations, quality of food, new restaurant choices and of course the staff.  From the moment we arrived, our check in was seamless and our room was beautiful.  Many thanks to Maria and Yvette.  What truly makes this hotel stand out from the rest is the staff.  Rody Marco at Fuego is alway there for us.  And our dear friends Carlos Duarte and Mario Vasquez (or should I say family) work so darn hard to attend to every detail! They welcome us with open arms and offer us the best service we have had anywhere in the world. We were nervous that our favorite  restaurant  "Tempo" had changed, but once again our dear friend Ignacio and the manager Olsen took great care of us.  The tasting menu by the new Spanish chef  (Martin B.) was unbelievable!  Better than any recent meal we have had in NYC.  Service at the beach/pool was spectacular as well. And the staff at Naos and  Market Grill...Victor, we sure miss your laugh and contagious smile!  At the Market Grill you will be greated by the nicest hostess anywhere..Ayerelli.  My husband and I also had a massage at the Yhi Spa and both were the best ever.  We will count the days until our next visit, and it will be your priviledge to be guests at the Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: elena
reviews.title: Su nombre lo dice, PARAISO
reviews.text:
Estoy recién llegada de Cancún, y no tengo más que buenas palabras para este hotelazo, estuve con unas amigas y todo resultó genial. Nada más entrar te llega un aroma increíble, a limpio, a bienestar, a relax, y por lo visto es una característica de esta cadena de hoteles.

Las instalaciones un diez, desde las habitaciones, la piscina, los restaurantes, etc bien cuidadas, limpias, el suelo brillante!!! La comida buenísima, recomiendo la sopa de lima por cierto. En cuanto a la playa a pesar de que no nos hizo muy buen tiempo la pudimos disfrutar tumbadas con unos cocteles en sus hamacas (ellos las llaman camastros o algo así), siempre con la atención de los empleados del hotel que se preocupaban de que todo estuviera ok.

Destacar la amabilidad de la gente de Cancún en general y de este hotel en particular, todos sus empleados y en especial Fred y Amauri, hicieron que nuestra estancia fuera perfecta

Si vuelvo no tengo duda que volveré a elegir este hotel, además está muy bien comunicado con la zona de bares, tiendas etc.

reviews.author: Roxanne A
reviews.title: 1 week stay
reviews.text: Traveled from March 3rd-9th. First I must say that this resort is breathtaking! The pictures don't do justice. My friend took me here for some much needed R&R, and I that is exactly what we found at Paradisus. The service staff was impecable. Anything you need, they are right there for you. We opted for the royal side which I must say is definately worth it. We had an amazing butler named Hector. He was so kind and polite and right there for any of our needs. We did not find it necessary to make reservations in the evenings because you can pretty much walk into any restaurant and get seated. Twice we went to Bento the sushi restauant and the hostess Victoria and our waiter Antonio were wonderful. Even though the restaurant was closing, they never tried to kick us out. They do not have a huge selection of sushi. Mostly tuna. Fair tasting. Our favorite restaurant was Vento. The food was outstanding and our waiter Jonathan was amazing! Another favorite waiter was Rogelio at La Palapa restaurant on the beach. Whenever he saw us coming, he already had our drinks ready for us to enjoy on the beach. The beach on the royal side was nice and quiet. Never too crowded which we liked. People walked around on the beach trying to sell you stuff all day, which we did get suckered into quite a bit! Got some great stuff. They are not pushy though, if you say no, they leave you alone. The pool water was pretty cold so opted to swim in the ocean everyday. It's too beautiful not to. We stayed in a 1 bedroom suite that had 2 bathrooms which is nice. A lot of the days there was a funky sewer smell coming out of the 2nd bathroom floor drain which they promptly came and fixed. Our room faced the lagoon which we loved because everyday after leaving the beach at 5:00, we got to watch the sunset from or balcony. It was beautiful. Staying at Paradisus truly makes you feel like you are in paradise!!!!!!

reviews.author: Kelly F
reviews.title: 2 weeks maybe too long
reviews.text:
My travel Dates :  Feb. 24,2013-March 10,2013
The hotel property and grounds are well maintained.  Pool areas and beachfront with ocean great.  There were 4 of us travelling together.  Check in went quickly but initially we didn't get the room requested.  Two of us had to fight for a room change that we were confirmed for.  Breakfast is limited to the buffet restaurant as well as lunch.  The poolside grill is not always available.  The restaurant variety is good.  8 in total.  Encouraged to do reservations for dinner.  Tempo restaurant is a charge of $45USD.  There is a late night buffet from midnight to 0400 hrs in the buffet restaurant which is poorly advertised.  Poolside activities minimal.  Nightlife at hotel quiet after the Avenue bar closes.  The disco goes until 0200 hrs and depending on the location of your room you can sing to Usher in your sleep.  The hotel shops only take pescos.  Bus service great.  Only 1USD and run every 5-10 min.  Safe to travel on.  Hotel caters to conference clients in large groups.  This hotel does not allow you to play in the Paradisus resorts in Playa de Carmen.  Not  a true Paradisus and not at all like the other Paradisus properties.  They really push the time share here.  We were approached on a daily basis to attend a session and declined.  The bartenders at the poolside bar were great especially Tona, Julio.  Wait staff were were great too.  Hats off to Mairsol, Loius, Antonio in the Avenue bar,  The deejay in the disco was great.  Poolside music needs to go or be changed.  Check out was fast.  We were in the My Time package and the guest services staff that we dealt with were not very friendly and took their time to serve you.  Overall, the trip was relaxing and had minimal stress.  The weather can be so so.  Bring a sweatshirt as can get cool at night.

reviews.author: GENE C
reviews.title: CLUB MEMBER OF THE GRAND MELIA (PARADISUS)
reviews.text:
THE PARADISUS CANCUN (THE OLD GRAND MELIA) What a beauiful place with awesome service.  We were greeted by Gaby from club membership and she treated us lke her family.  She was very helpful the whole trip..  The service we received from breakfast to dinner was the best:  Ruben & Jeremias (he is soooo funny) & Alfredo & Naos waited on us most of the time, they were just the best.. The beach & pool is beauiful.... (I'll be back for sure)

GENE C.

reviews.author: BDL67
reviews.title: Outstanding Service
reviews.text:
Outstanding service, good food, however a few things that are annoying to take it from 5 stars to 4. 
- pool water temperature cold, ocean is warmer
- there is no place to sit outside in the evening with bar 
- sometimes difficult to get reservations at restaurants but most of the time hey were only half full

reviews.author: 20octubre
reviews.title: Excelente paradisus Cancún
reviews.text: Acabo de llegar de Cancún ,he estado en este hotel 7dias y ha sido una estancia excelente.El hotel muy bueno,el trato de la gente q trabaja allí ha sido inmejorable,todos muy atentos y serviciales.La habitación muy limpia,los restaurantes estupendos,sobre todo el buffet dl desayuno q es buenísimo .L a playa dl hotel también genial con un servicio muy bueno.Hemos estado 4 personas y ha resultado fantástico .

reviews.author: BostonGirl2013
reviews.title: Boston Girls
reviews.text:
Upon arrival we told we booked Royalty Service, no idea what that meant but I guess we were assigned a butler.  He helped us to the room and we didn't hear from him again that day.  Seeing him the next day upon walking through the resort, he did get us a dinner reservation which was nice.  I witnessed a lot of butlers checking in on their guests around the resort and on the beach, not ours.  We never heard from or saw him again after day 2 of a 5 day encounter.  Even upon check out, other butlers were gathering people bags and bringing them to check out, not ours.  I guess maybe you need to ask for what you want.  

Resort overall was amazing, our view was just breathtaking from the balcony.  The room was just the right size although beds seemed a little stiff but overall not bad.  The bathroom was clean and a good size.  Beach was just great as our weather albiet windy was beautiful.  The food was a little different for us Boston folks however, it was okay.   

The restaurant Vento would have to be my favorite, although others complained about the food not being hot, I found it warm enough.  Our waiter, Jonathan was absolutely Amazing!!!  I was very impressed with the service I received, so impressed we ate there a second night!

The Avenue Bar has a great bartender, "Alexander the Great", he keeps the atmosphere lively and fun.

We meet amazing people from the UK, South Carolina, Florida, Minnesota and California.  It was so much fun and very entertaining.  

All in all, I would go back tomorrow!

reviews.author: CobraGT500
reviews.title: NOT what we were expecting
reviews.text:
For a resort on a beautiful beach and in an area where you can leave the resort to shop/explore, this is the place. However, if you are a vacation club member used to all of the pampering you get as part of the "perks" at other resorts, this is NOT the place for you! We were left to find the club member check in on our own after confusing directions and hand gestures to "help" us find our way through three buildings, then we were greeted with an attitude. The girl at check in was very condescending to the platinum Melia Club member we were traveling with. We have never encountered a rude person on ANY Melia Club properties until this trip. 
The food was unremarkable, usually cold and one note in flavor. Drinks were so slow that we began ordering doubles. Bana, the Asian fusion restaurant, had the best, most flavorful, fresh food. The sushi was excellent and the hot dishes came to the table hot. We were so impressed that we ate there two nights in a row. However, in the Brazilian restaurant, The Market,  I watched the waiter go to the buffet next door and "assemble" our appetizers and desserts-disappointing! I was told that another woman and I were laughing too loud in the Blue Agave bar, so everyone at the bar (17 of us) got up and left. The bartender was left without any customers thanks to the manager.
Our room was always clean, but I had to repeatedly ask to get the fridge restocked with water, then received a phone call telling me I only get one restock per day-that's all I wanted since it was never done to begin with!
Overall, this was an acceptable place to stay, but if you are a club member, the level of quality and service is not at the level that other Melia Club resorts offer. Playa Del Carmen was $6 more per night and 10x better in service, quality and dining.

reviews.author: Linda W
reviews.title: Royal Service is wonderful!
reviews.text:
We are leaving the Paradisus Cancun tomorrow.  We booked the royal service building, ocean view, and we have been very pleased with our stay here.  Basically the royal service is just that, ROYAL SERVICE!  From our personal butler Juan Jose, and butler Hector, to bartender Benito, server Consuelo, and Sergio at the pool.....everyone was just wonderful.  Our room is beautiful and clean.  

You can use the facilities at the entire hotel, but you also have your own, quiet, adults only area.  I would recommend royal service to staying anywhere else on the property if you can.  

The food on the buffet is not on the top of my list of places we've stayed.  Not that it isn't prepared well, just pretty generic.  The specialty restaurants were somewhat better.  The service in all restaurants was very good.   

The lobby's are very pretty and tropical, and there is a LOT of pool, a big plus.  All in all, a very nice place to stay.

reviews.author: slikmo22
reviews.title: Fun Activities, Good View, and Great People
reviews.text: A couple friends and I went to Paradisus Cancun in December and had an excellent time. During the day there is a BBQ going on next to the pool and activities like beach volleyball and soccer already set up. The event coordinators Diego and Jossie are the nicest people I have ever met and really made the vacation much more enjoyable. Other events like classes on how to make sushi and give massages were also offered in the resort. The food was amazing, there are many restaurants (I think around 7-8) throughout the resort and each offer their own variety of food. Nightlife is pretty good there as well there is a club/bar area as well as a lounge/bar area which is open through the night and into the morning. Paradisus is also about 5-10mins away from downtown on the bus. This resort is highly recommended by my friends and I. [If you go make sure to try the Sea Bass Soup]

reviews.author: Kelly23
reviews.title: Adequate Cancun "zone" hotel
reviews.text:
Hotel probably had it's heyday years ago.  i agree that rooms are tired and pillows did seem old and deflated.  It doesnt help that I stayed at La Esmeralda last year (new sister resort to this one) which was outstanding and same price.  But let's cut to the chase:

Pros:  Stunning and I mean stunning beach!  Color of the ocean is incredible here!!  Very close to airport so can get settled quickly and not eat up whole day in travel.  Plenty cabanas too.  Nice exercise room (although a bit tucked away). Staff seems to try and some are friendlier than others, dont really expect tips, but we Americans are trained so they benefit!

Cons:  Im sorry, but overall the food was mediocre at best.  Lacked taste and variety/freshness.  Even the guacolmole (which should be a no brainer), had very little seasonings or taste.  No pizza on buffet...really?  Dont you know your customers?  Food on hot buffets was never, ever hot, think lukewarm burger and fries!  And no food prepared at pool, so when your lunch came, it was warm at best, if not cool...so sad for such a stunning location!  Yes, rooms are a bit old but I can live with it.

To me, this is like staying at a chain beachfront hotel and not really a resort.  If you like the "resort" feel, which I prefer, then Playa Del Carmen or Riveria Maya is best and feels so much classier that this gradiose hotel on the strip next to the others.

I would probably not come back but that is because I've experienced more beautiful grounds and food at the true resorts that can be found south of here.

reviews.author: OJR
reviews.title: Decent grounds... Horrible customer service... Suited for Collegiate Spring Breakers, Not Seasoned World Travelers
reviews.text:
We stayed at Paradisus Cancún in February to celebrate the birthday of a friend. Our party consisted of 20 to friends from different parts of the US who all flew in to Mexico for this weekend celebration.

I generally don’t like to write unfavorable reviews about an establishment; I only do so when the experience is so horrible that I would not recommend it for a friend. Unfortunately, this is one of those instances. You may read the details below if you wish, but here’s the executive summary:

1. Check-in took 5 hours.
2. The resort’s “all-inclusive” doesn’t include room service sans pizza, quesadilla, and hamburgers. None of the other 50 items are available.
3. We were given “complimentary” upgrades that we never requested because the resort kept making it customer service mistakes. Once we checked out, we were asked to pay for a room type we never received because the resort gave us perks.
4. We were publicly asked in front of other guests to leave a restaurant in the elite “Royal Service” dining lounge in Tower 5 (where we were staying), because an uninformed server had her facts incorrect and had no training in customer experience.
5.  We were asked to leave one of the lobby bars because we were dressed inappropriately in shorts and tank tops at 2:00pm in the afternoon at beach resort, though we saw other guests in the same bar wearing two-piece bikinis and mesh cover-ups/sarongs while other guests were roaming the lobby shirtless, shoeless, and dripping wet from the pool or ocean.
6. When we asked to speak to the General Manager, the Front Desk personnel BLATANTLY LIED, and gave us the # to an Accounting Manager that they were attempting to pass off as the GM.

CHECK-IN: 
In a nutshell, it took us nearly 5 hours to be checked into our room. Two months in advance, we booked a Deluxe Ocean View King. When we arrived at 2:00 on a Friday, we signed our intake forms, gave them our credit card, and did the normal check-in activities. We were then told by the front desk to “come back in an hour, and we might have a room available.” We returned at 3:00 only to be handed the keys to a Deluxe Ocean View Double Bed Room. Of course, this is not what we requested, so the front desk told us to check back in another 90 minutes. 

Around 4:30, we returned to the front desk. We were given a “wonderful, ocean view room on the 6th floor in Tower One with a Jacuzzi on the terrace.”  BEWARE IF THEY OFFER YOU THIS ROOM. Once we walked in, we immediately turned and walked back out. It is an extremely dated room that looks like it was last redecorated circa “Golden Girls” Season 3. It had none of the appeal of the new rooms, and the jacuzzi was less than inviting. I returned to the front desk, and we were told to check back around 6:00 for another room. At this point, it had been 4 hours, and we still had not been given accommodations.

ROOM SERVICE: 
Finally, around 6:00, we were given a Deluxe Ocean View King on the 5th Floor in the main tower, Tower 3. It was exactly what we were looking for. We settled in and decided to order room service before meeting our friends for dinner. We wanted salads, but were told that salads were not included with the all-inclusive package. Livid, I returned to the front desk. I was told the wrong room service menu was placed in my room, but for my inconvenience, I could order anything I wanted at no cost. (I thought this was the entire point of all-inclusive.)

Minutes later, recognizing that I was nonplussed and completely displeased, the front desk manager offered to move us a one-bedroom suite in the “Royal Service” tower for no additional charge as our first day had been a horrendous affair thus far. This tower has additional amenities and limited access to only guests of this Tower. At the time, only Lagoon View rooms were available, but the following day, we would be free to move to an Ocean View room to have the view that we initially requested.

GROUND-FLOOR “OCEAN” VIEW: 
The following day, we were offered a one-bedroom suite with an ocean-facing view. But, given that the “terrace” was actually below ground, the only thing one could see was grass. This in no way parallels an actual ocean-view from a higher floor. We refused the room and decided to stay in our suite facing the Lagoon on the entrance side of the property. 

But, because the resort proactively recognized that, once again, they had messed up, we were given a “complimentary” couples massage.

CHECK-OUT
Upon checkout, I looked at the bill and asked that our charges be reduced to reflect that we had a Lagoon View and not an Ocean View. The Front Desk Manager argued with me about the fact that my suite did not have an Ocean View. He literally had to send someone down to check.

Well, in the end, the resort refused to lower the charges, citing “we were given a complimentary upgrade to Royal Service, and we were also given complimentary massages.” Come again? We never requested those services.

So, we were taken away from the view and room that we requested to be placed into a room and view that we never requested with the unfulfilled promise that we would have an Ocean View, but we should still pay because we were offered amenities that we actually never requested. Not a good way to do business.

GENERAL MANAGER FIASCO:
As world travelers who have stayed in some of the best hotels across the globe, we are accustomed to the occasional hiccup in customer experience.
