We always speak directly to a General Manager in these cases, and we are promptly given the service and attention we should have received from the start. We asked to speak to the GM for two days straight to no avail. Upon check-out, we asked THREE times, but the Front Desk refused. Finally, they acquiesced and gave us a phone name and number. Because I knew the GM’s name, I knew that the information they had given me was fake.

We asked them to confirm that this person was indeed the GM repeatedly. Finally, after the 4th or 5th ask, the Front Desk Manager admitted that the person was actually on the Accounting Manager. Flabbergasted at the blatant disrespect and lies, we left the resort having endured the worst weekend getaway we’ve ever experienced.

reviews.author: onthebayou1
reviews.title: Royal Service
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed here in 2004 when the hotel was called the Gran Melia.  They recently changed the name to Paradisus.  This trip we came with my wifes sister and brother in law.  This was our first time to do all inclusive and I wasn't sure what to expect. We paid for the Royal Service and upgraded from Lagoon Front to Beach front.

The view from the room was amazing and the room was very clean and compfortable. With the Royal Service Plan, you are in a separate pyramid with maybe 140 rooms.  It has its own private conceirage service with breakfast in the morning, snacks in the afternoon, and dessert in the evening. The staff was very attentive and we were truly treated like royalty.  2 staff members stood out as exceptional.  Consuela and Diana served us both at the concierge level and the pool and they were both wonderful to us.

The pool area was beautiful and with Royal Service we got private cabanas at the pool and next to tbe beach.  Sergio made sure our cabanas were  reserved and set up when we arrived.  He also brought by fruit at just the right times.  We never wanted for food or drink at the pool or on the beach. The Royal Service pool area is separated from the other pools and is a bit more relaxing.  We ventured over the main pool one day and sat at the pool bar. It was louder and the bartenders frequently made a variety of shots for the partrons. They also had organized games in this area.

In addition to the games, they had a nightly show in the Avenue Bar.  We went to 3 of these shows. These shows were very cool.  We especially enjoyed the Paris Circus and the Belly Dancers. They had afternoon activities and I participated in the Tequlla Tasting, The Mixology Class, and the Sushi class. These events were fun, but not as polished as the shows.  They could improve participation in these by a little daily marketing, but they were fun.

For Dining, my favorite by far was Bana.  Wonderful Sushi in a cool setting. We also ate at the Blue Agave and the Market Griill. Both had great service and good food.  Naos is the buffet. I liked it for lunch but for dinner, I am not a buffet fan.

Wireless internet was free and mostly reliable.

We truly had a wonderful time and I expect we  will return.  I do suggest Ocean View and Royal Service, both are worth the price.

reviews.author: Lucia D
reviews.title: Maravilloso
reviews.text: Preciosismo hotel me gusto mucho quedarme aquí todos muy atentos.  Fui con mi. Mejor amiga y la pasamos genial! Bebidas en la playa deliciosas. Recomendado para parejas! Tienes todo un panel de actividades  para hacer en el día aparte que la playa estuvo buenasa todo perfecto! Estas a 10 min de las principales discos y malls! Mucha seguridad en la puerta! Es un buen hotel obvio volvería a ir !

reviews.author: Olga K
reviews.title: Terrible reception, average service and food, plenty faults, night repairs
reviews.text:
On the 2nd of February we, together with our friends, came to Cancun, Mexico on vacation and were met by an Apple rep.
Usually it takes about 10-15 minutes to fill the bus with passengers and move to the hotels.
We know that it’s a dispatcher’s job to distribute different customers to different minibuses, however we don’t understand why we had to wait for over 40 minutes until the bus started moving.
We entered the beautifully designed hotel and were so much surprised to find out that we were not welcome, as it seemed that nobody expected our visit. And mind, we were over an hour late for check-in, way after 4 pm. Our rooms were not ready, the receptionist couldn’t find available rooms, then with the help of her supervisor Ramon tried to offer us rooms on different floors – 0, 1 or 8. To get rooms at least on the same floor we had to wait for another hour or two. Meanwhile we decided to have something to eat – it turned out to be a problem in a 6-stars all-inclusive resort: the buffet was closed at 5 pm, you could get no food till 6pm. We were asked out of the buffet and offered a room service. Tell me, please, how you can get room service without any room. Amazing logic! The only open option was a bar with drinks, thanks God, we at least could quench our thirst with some soda and juice. No complains here, there was some waitress who brought us some nuts and dried fruit.
When we finally got to our rooms, it was too late to go down to the Sea to take the first swim as our tradition.
Anyway, we got to a restaurant and had nice food. Good people, good staff, good quality. We thought – finally we can have a well deserved rest. No way, people! I was startled around midnight by the noise of drilling and somebody talking loud on a walkie-talkie in the hallway, somebody was running on the roof and doing something. The receptionist when I called stated that the manager is there to take care of the noise. Nothing of the kind. In  the flyer we got the next day it said that they were upgrading conditioning system. Wonderful! We are all for it! But should it be done in the middle of the night when everybody is sleeping? It wasn’t an emergency, it could be done during the day. And three nights on the row it’s too much. The call to the receptionist didn’t solve the problem, only the conversation with the supervisor in the morning did. The only thing we wanted to know is how long it was going to continue – should we stay or request another hotel.
In spite of human errors and some lack of organization we liked the place. And Mother Nature did her best, thanks to Her - the sand, the sea, the sun - our vacation wasn’t completely ruined.
As for the food, not much variety. Besides, for 3 days they were fixing something in the buffet, so everybody was served in the open air – picnic style from morning till evening.
Yes, and conditioning system in the building leaves much to be desired. 
So 3 stars at most. They need to fix the drawbacks first, then claim 5 or 6 star level.

reviews.author: Erich75
reviews.title: Magnificent service at a great price
reviews.text: We had a long weekend with a few friends at Paradisus. We "splurged" for the Deluxe Royal treatment in Pyramid 5.  There was a mix up with our reservations, but they made a few phone calls and remedied the issue promptly.  The staff at Paradisus is outstanding.  In our pyramid, we had happy hour every day with top shelf liquor (self serve, if you preferred) and exceptional service.  The restaurants served innovative and delicious food (especially the sushi at Bana), and the Red Lounge (with DJ Rolando) was where we ended up dancing and drinking each night.  The pyramid atria are beautifully adorned with plants, water features, and vines (Philodendron?) draping down from each floor.  We will definitely be back.

reviews.author: roben l
reviews.title: Big, clean but poor service and food
reviews.text:
Stayed 2 weeks from jan. 23-feb. 6 and after day 3 I went to Walmart to buy king size pillows. They refused to give more than 1 towel at the pool.Mini-bar staff forgot to replace the coffee almost every day- bad training. Internet is almost too slow to send a picture attached to an email. The buffet is the same warm food every night, the specialty restaurants except for Vento were not good- seems like the same kitchen cooks all the food.We ordered steaks on 4 occasions and although they asked us how we would like it cooked it always came out well done- which i can deal with and its probably safer too.The wine offering would make you cringe if you really were at a 4 star hotel. For the most part the staff are friendly but very poorly trained.The problem is the management, they were also very hard to reach. i would not recommend this place to anyone, unless you get an awesome rate and don't mind a 650 room 3 star hotel. i will say that it is very clean and the spa is great.
Its a shame because we've stayed at their property in Cuba and it is really a 4.5 - 5 star property.

reviews.author: Wahoowa97
reviews.title: Nice beach, great food, descent hotel
reviews.text:
Just about right for a 4 star hotel. We (4 adults) spent 4 days/3 night at the hotel.  The rooms were nice, had a lagoon view. Clean, modern style, very comfortable beds. Check-in process was rather seamless, checkout process was rather slow mainly due to staffing.  We had a concierge assigned to us who assisted with dinner reservations at the resort restaurants and provided some good tips. We had the all-inclusive package which covered all meals and drinks at all the restaurants except for Tempo (one of the restaurants).  The food overall was great. Blue Agave served Mexican appetizers and was absolutely delicious.  Mole was the fancy Mexican restaurant and was also fantastic.  We typically had breakfast and lunch at the buffet place - Naos, which was average. Had a nice juice bar, omelette station, and salad bar.  Ventos was the Mediterranean tapas place and was average.   Bana was an Asian place and had your typical sushi and asian curries.  The margarati's and mixed drinks were awesome, not watered down and very tasty. The beach was awesome. The towel service was not very good, the first day we had difficulty getting beach towels until the mid-afternoon. There are sales peoples at the towel shop selling various excursions. We did a parasailing excursion which was about $55 a person and descent. They advertised 10-12 minutes of parasailing but we only were on for about 6-7minutes.  

In summary,  good accomodations, great food and drinks, very nice beach.

reviews.author: jammal28
reviews.title: Wonderful Winter Get-Away
reviews.text: Definitely enjoyed our stay at the Paradisus Cancun.  Restaurants were top notch and it was nice having the ocean so close to our room.  Everyone on the staff was very friendly and helpful.  Liked that the shows started at 8:30 PM.  They had great talent, especially Circus D'Sol, and lasted just the right amount of time. Ocean waves were fun and warm.  Thank you to Avril, our concierge, and a big hello and thank you to Benito Galicic, our favorite bartender at Bar ToJi - great guy!!!

reviews.author: Keven C
reviews.title: One of the best Hotel
reviews.text:
Stayed there with 3 other friends.

Very nice hotel, but not much entertainment at night.  But it is good for stay with friends and have a quite time.

Food are great and the restaurants are excellent. The Mexican one is the best in my opinion.

Rooms are clean and room services are quick.

reviews.author: Vickie R
reviews.title: Far beyond AMAZING getaway!!!
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus the week of January 26th to February 2nd for our annual ladies getaway and were blown away by our experience! The resort is gorgeous, clean, and the service highly exceeded my expectations. Book the royal service!! It is well worth the extra money! Upon arrival we were quickly greeted and introduced to our butlers Francisco and Erik who made sure we had everything we needed for for the week. They were so accomodating and friendly! We found a tequilla at Blue Aguave that we wanted to purchase to bring home but wasnt for sale on the resort so Fransico offered to purchase it for us on his day off and bring it in for us!! Every single employee that we encountered on the royal side was amazing and always greeted us with a smile and went out of their way to make our stay special!  Our favorite servers were Karina and Consuelo! They made our stay so much fun!

As for the restaurants your definitely not going to leave this resort hungry or thirsty for that matter.We enjoyed all of them but our favorites were Vento, Bana, and Tacos. Juan Carlos and Victor were our servers at Vento and they made the dining experience a BLAST! Probably the best service I've ever recieved anywhere!! Anotonio at Bana was fantastic also! Make sure to check out the blue aguave for tacos and tequilla tastings. We vacation quite often and my biggest complaint about a lot of the resorts is the food! Definitely not the case at the Paradisus!

The nightlife at the resort is great and fairly laid back. The Avenue Bar is a lot of fun and you can expect to meet a lot of fun people! Look for the server Danielle! She was so friendly, remembered our names from day one, and never left us thirsty! The Red Lounge is a little small but a good place for dancing! Make sure you find Gabriel and order a Mexican Baby Maker!! He was such a fun bartender and always made sure our drinks were full!! 

When we first booked this resort we were a little weary because it was in a transition period from the Grand Melia to Paradisus but were so happy with the experience. The only thing I would suggest is playing a little more latin/vacation music throughout the resort! Thank you for a wonderful vacation!! We will definitely return!!

Side note!! Tip the employees!!! Yes it is all-inclusive but the employees work very hard and deserve a little extra!!

reviews.author: Jenny M
reviews.title: Paradise at the Paradisus
reviews.text:
Our yearly getaway of 4 close friends that live far away from each other was spent at the Paradisus Cancun. We stayed on the royal service side (which a highly recommend) and were blown away by the service we received.We stayed here from Jan 26th to Feb 2nd.. and if I knew how great it would be I would have booked a longer stay! It began with check in with Aidee who was extremely friendly and welcoming. We were then introduced to our butler(s) for the week.... Erik and Fransceso... who were amazing. They gave us cell phones to call them for anything we needed... they literally got us anything we needed and even found us on the beach to make sure that we had dinner reservations for that evening. I thank the two of them for making our stay extra special.

The beach was gorgeous, a little windy the week we were there but felt great on the hot days! Our servers for the beach/pool and "happy hour" in the royal service were Consuela and Karina. I want to give them a special thank you for their service...outstanding! They were sooo sweet and never let our drinks run dry! 

Now for the food, awesome!! Vento and Bana were our favorites! I want to thank Marcos and Victor from Vento and Antonio from Bana for their superb service. (We liked Bana so much we ate there twice..try the curry beef or chicken yum). Tacos were good but the tequila was even better. Moles was good too. La Palapa was great for lunch... try the spring rolls and chicken nachos. Our server there was Fransceso (I think) and he did an awesome job. Everyone always had smiles on there faces and were constantly asking if we needed anything!

Our rooms were nice... Erik even brought us aromatherapy pillows one night.. so nice! We got the lagoon view but I would recommend the ocean view. 

The Avenue bar was a great place to hang out and meet people at night.. the bartenders were so friendly but Danielle the server from the Ave bar was amazing. She was so nice and was always asking if we needed anything! Gabriel from the Red Lounge was so much fun and is an awesome bartender! Thank you for the mexican baby maker shots...delicious..lol. 

I hope I am not forgetting anyone... everyone of the staff was amazing. I would go back in a heart beat!

reviews.author: Peggy
reviews.title: Had a great time at the Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
We stayed from Jan 27 to Feb 2.  A GREAT vacation!!!
The hotel staff could not do enough...from the housekeepers to the maintenance staff. Not one person ever passed me without putting their hand over their heart and greeting me.
That is the warmest and most kind act of excellent customer service I have ever witnessed!!!!
The food was excellent and had a great variety. Favorite restaurant was Fuego which was Spanish Fusion.
The daily breakfast buffett was a wonderful source of nutrition and interesting offerings for such a diverse group.
Ernesto and his group at the Friendship Bar were outstanding. These men provided excellent customer service, and should be commended for their great teamwork and welcoming nature.
I experienced one negative act from a waiter (outside buffett) on the day of departure. We had an early breakfast and had our bags packed and ready to depart. Since we had several hours to wait for our transportation to the airport, we decided to go to return to the outside tables, for a cup of coffee. When I asked Manuel if we could sit at a table in his area he replied,  "weren't you over there earlier this morning?" 
I was embarrased by this unkind and unecessary comment. I think Manuel would beneft from some additional customer service training. 
While I would not want anyone to lose their job, this was the only person whom I felt was not in sinc with the hotel's mission of excellence.
I would recommend the Paradisus Cancun to everyone!

reviews.author: William H
reviews.title: Don't bother
reviews.text: It is a 3 star hotel and that's it. We are 10 days into 14 and are almost anxious to get back to Canada. The staff are horribly under trained. This place is too big there are too many deficiencies to post. Frankly ill be surprised if the internet here is even fast enough to send this review. We drove to Playa do Carmen and are a bit sad we didn't stay there, try the Aldea Thai hotel.

reviews.author: Karen C
reviews.title: MUY BUENAS VACACIONES
reviews.text: El hotel es una preciosidad, yo lo conoci aun con el nombre de Gran Melia, me fascino el hotel toda su estructura esta hermosa, me fascino la comida es deliciosa y de la mejor las bebidas de primera clidad en verdad volveria regresar a este hotel me fascino, el servicio excelente no cabe duda, le doy en un 100 de calificación a este excelendte hotel, maravillosa mi estancia.

reviews.author: SebelMontreal
reviews.title: Superbe Vacances !
reviews.text: Nous revenons d'une superbe semaine au Paradisus !  Nous étions un groupe de 16 personnes pour souligner un anniversaire.  Nous étions pour la plupart dans la Section Royale. Le service au delà de mes attentes Daniel notre concierge a été très attentif .Pour les restos nous n'étions pas en reste ! Tous les restos à la carte sont très bons.  Le midi nous avions le resto réservé au Royale mais le buffet offre aussi certains choix à la çarte. Seul reproche je trouvais le choix du buffet un peu limité.  Bana super Sushi ! Vento très bon Tapas ! Fuego cuisine latine différente ! il y a aussi un bon petit resto mexicain sans réservation ! La disco Red loundge et le petit bar 5 idem avenue très bel ambiance ! Resort tranquille peu d'animation mais en groupe ou pour se reposer Super ! Si vous croisez  Sandra du Bana ! Ricardo au Pool grill , Consuelo ma serveuse préférée :)  ( Pool Grill  et au service Royale)  et Karina pendant nos 5 à7 dans la section Royale, vous aurez un super service !

reviews.author: Lynzeelulu
reviews.title: "One of the best in Cancun"
reviews.text: I have been to Cancun a few times now.  This was my second time staying at the hotel.  We stayed from Jan 17th through 24th. It is an amazing resort! Check-in has never been a problem for us-I know there are time share people there-but we have always just stated we want to go straight to our room.  Rooms: Beautiful. We had a little kitchen area with coffee maker, toaster, blender and a fridge that was restocked daily with soda, beer and water.  There is also a jacuzzi tub on the patio. Food: Delicious! We did Fuego (recommend the beef tenderloin), Mole and Venga.  Did buffet and rooms service the rest of the time.  Bars: There is an indoor one that opens at 11 everyday, a night club, a pool bar and a beach bar.  We had amazing service at all.  The have staff that runs all over the beach passing out drinks and food.  Pool: 3 beautiful and large pools. Beach: Best by far! I went jogging up the beach for an hour and the Paradisus has the best.  There are a large number of little table/huts for shade when needed.  Most places didn't have any shade.  Entertainment: every night at 8pm there is a show in the common area.  Very fun place for singles, couples and families! Take the bus for 80cents to downtown.  Super easy!

reviews.author: Philip K
reviews.title: Beyond Expectations
reviews.text: Just returned from a six day stay at the Paradisus Cancun and what a GREAT stay it was! From the moment my friend and I stepped on the property we were treated so special. Check-in was a breeze. There was a minor incident with the "time share" folks but we just declined them promptly and they left us alone. We got to our room, a deluxe jr. ocean view suite. It was beautiful. Very well kept and spacious for two people. And when they say "OCEAN VIEW", WOW do they mean it!  The view from our balcony was STUNNING! And the beach at the resort has to be experienced to believe it. Absolutely BEAUTIFUL!     The food was great at any of the restaurants we tried. The reservation process can be a bit of a hassle but whenever we couldn't get a reservation, we'd just go to one of the several that don't require one. The entertainment there is also first rate. There was a different floor show every night we were there and the main lounge and RED lounge were very fun and entertaining. Which brings me to Rogerio, one of the bartenders in the main lounge. He is top notch at what he does. We  stopped at that bar every night and he was always so friendly, funny, and warm. And he always made sure we were well taken care of. Baltizar at NAOS restaurant is also a standout. We ate at NAOS for our very first meal and he made us feel very welcome and relaxed. One of the few things I could complain about is the WIFI. It can be inconsistant and spotty, depending on where you are at the resort. But overall, my stay at Paradisus Cancun was amazing. I really didn't want to leave when it was time to go. I highly recommend it to all and I will definitely go back for more!

reviews.author: louise c
reviews.title: Never Again!
reviews.text: Don't waste your money,one of the worst hotels I've stayed in.  This hotel is not about customer service, It's about selling tours and buying Time share.Took over 3 hrs. to check in,food at buffet is based on how many people are in the hotel. We were told there would be shows everynight but only 1 show in 1 wk. There was an employee in our room while we were sleeping. Only bar open during the day was outside at the pool.Our travel agent told us the travel agency bought into My Time therefore we were entitled to certain anemities,we went to our travel representative and they knew nothing about it and told us no. I found the staff to be cold and indifferent.  The do not have a clue and the hotel travel representative should know what is going on for his guests that he is suppose to be representing.

reviews.author: Virgep
reviews.title: Outstanding!!
reviews.text: 4 of my friends and I stayed in building 5 which included the royal service. Check in was a problem because they couldnt find one of the rooms reservations. After that, however, it was wonderful. the staff was incredibly helpful and nice. The restaurants were great and we had an outstanding time at the Red Lounge. The beach was clean, rooms were clean, and would definitely go back!! Beautiful resort!1

reviews.author: Luis V
reviews.title: ESPECTACULAR!!!
reviews.text:
La energia del hotel es grandiosa, su forma tan peculiar de 5 piramides me cautivó. se siente buena armonia ya que tiene una vegetacion abundante dentro del mismo.
El spa es una experiencia única que se debe repetir. Me agrado en general todo. El personal del mostrador o recepciónson muy accesibles y flexibles para algunos cambios que tuve que solicitar.

reviews.author: Christina M
reviews.title: Awesome Vacation!
reviews.text: The Paradisus Resort in Cancun was a wonderful experience form the moment we pulled up to the hotel. Everyone from the Concierges, the Entertainment Staff, the Waiters and Housekeepers kept a wonderful happy vibe the whole time we were there. Everyone made us feel so welcomed and kept us informed about all the activities that were going on through out our stay. We loved the entertainment at the Avenue bar each night as well as the Salsa lessons! Great stay, great memories and great friends, we will be back soon!

reviews.author: Lorena R
reviews.title: Una increible experiencia!!!
reviews.text: El lugar es hermoso y el servicio de todo el staff es magnifico. Seguros de regresar y volver a visitar este maravilloso lugar. Muchas gracias por la increible experiencia que Paradisus cancun nos hiizo vivir.

reviews.author: Jimboslice
reviews.title: Cant wait to go back...Everything was great!
reviews.text: Just returned yesterday from a 5 night getaway and it was so much fun.  I had stayed here a while back when it was Gran Melia and liked it a lot.  As a paradisus, I loved it all over again.  The lobby is gorgeous with the greenery, the rooms are nice, food was great (didnt have a single bad meal...we loved vento, fuego, and Bana), The service and staff were so nice and accommodating, we could go on and on.  Mauricio with the Entertainment and Activity staff does a great job with his team in making sure the shows and music are always fun and exciting (each ngiht at 8pm at Avenue bar there is a show.  One night was an amazing breakdancing show, another night they had the celebrity look-a-like performers from Coco Bongos come so we saw Michael Jackson, Beyonce, and LMFAO) and the activities during the day keep you entertained and busy if you choose to participate.  They aren't pushy in making you do anything you don't want too.   During the day, we did everything from beach volleyball and soccer with Diego,Jose, and Javier (they are with the entertainment staff and are awesome people) to Salsa dancing classes and sushi making classes.  The bars staff was great too.  Alexander in the pool bar is a great guy and does a good job!  Our room was really nice, Ocean View deluxe room, with a nice big balcony.  It was a great vacation and we cant wait to go back!

reviews.author: Am-Ray1
reviews.title: Splendid!
reviews.text: I've stayed at this resort numerous times in the past couple years (used to be called the Gran Melia).  Every stay is wonderful. The staff is super, rooms are always up-kept and in immaculate shape and is nice and quiet all the time.  The food in the restaurants is wonderful also.

reviews.author: Lisa R
reviews.title: Wonderful week in Paradise
reviews.text:
We spent a wonderful week at the "new" Paradisus Cancun. We have stayed previously at the following current and former Paradisus resorts: Playa del Carmen (La Perla), Palma Real, Punta Cana (3x) , Playa Conchal (2x) and Riviera Cancun. We have also stayed at Dreams, Secrets and Iberostar resorts among others. Paradisus remains our favourite all inclusive resort chain. 

We want luxury, gourmet food, great service and a fabulous beach and pool. The past few visits, including this one, we stayed in Royal Service so the comments apply to the RS rooms and pool/beach area in addition to the shared restaurants and facilities.

The resort, RS room and grounds:

This resort was upgraded to a Paradisus resort in November 2012 from a Gran Melia. We stayed there over New Years for 7 days. We did not see any construction and all restaurants were fully operational. Our room was nice, a good size and satisfied our needs. We were disappointed that although we had an ocean view room the hedge in front of our balcony blocked most of our view when sitting down. Unfortunately we were not able to change rooms. Also, we are big coffee lovers and really enjoy having coffee on the balcony but the coffee maker was old and unappealing. At Paradisus Playa del Carmen the RS rooms had Nespresso machines. We loved that. The room service menu was mostly pizza and snack foods and a continental breakfast. As a result, we did not order any room service. (Room Service is included in RS). 

We spent most of our time in our Bali Bed either at the pool or on the beach. We loved the Bali Beds. They were free of charge for RS guests, had gorgeous views, were incredibly comfortable and had both drink and food service all day long. The beds require a reservation and you are guaranteed a bed for two days. Although the resort  was full but we never had a problem reserving or getting a bed. Juan and Sergio worked hard to keep everyone happy.  We managed to get a fabulous bed each and every day. Thanks guys! The best beds were along the beach. We had a bed there our last two days and they were the best two days all week, although we loved the beds around the pool as well. Each bed comes with a chaise and a chair so you can also get some sun! We did notice that some people would reserve a bed and not show up. When this happened the bed was released at noon so someone else could have it. This is an excellent and fair idea. 

The resort is beautiful with multiple pools and a wide beach area. The RS area never felt crowded. It was very clean. They even scrub the pool decking with a rotary power washer at night!   The beach is also clean and wide with palapa tables. Drink service was frequent. Some resorts offer a drink of the day. That would have been a great extra touch. 

The resort appears huge and a bit confusing at first but was not at all. It took us less then 2 minutes to walk from our building (5) to the towering open main lobby (building 3) where most of the restaurants are clustered together among lush palms. flowers and hanging vines.  . 

The restaurants:

The poolside RS restaurant at lunch (La Palapa) was excellent  with wonderful food, beautifully presented and a gorgeous view of the ocean. The only suggestion would be to add a few more vegetarian options - especially a veggie burger! The guacamole was great everyday. Good variety of premium beverages with no additional charges.

We ate breakfast most days at the RS lounge which was "continental" but still served warm options including eggs. Great fruit selection and we loved the Nespresso. This beautiful area is in the centre of the RS pyramid (building 5) with vines hanging from the ceiling and koi swimming under our feet. The lounge also serves snacks, sushi and cocktails in the evening. The main buffet menu (Naos) for breakfast was typical of any resort but does have a lovely outdoor seating area. 

We did try lunch at the main buffet. Neither of us eat meat (but will eat fish and seafood). One day we had an amazing lunch with tons of fresh prawns, calamari and other seafood. It was fabulous but unfortunately when we went back other days the buffet was primarily meat so we returned to La Palapa. 

Our best meal was  an incredible 7 course, white glove meal at Tempo. Tempo has a fixed menu and a surcharge of $45 per person. It was so worth it. The restaurant quickly replaced the one meat course (veal)  with fish at our request. Portions were small, delicious, unique and beautifully presented.  This  amazing meal was the best we have had at an all inclusive and right up there with some of the best meals we have had anywhere. We travel a lot and have eaten in a lot of Michelin top rated restaurants. There is an additional charge for premium wine. You can also choose wine pairings with your meal at a fixed cost. Our only suggestions was that they turn the lighting down a bit in the evening .The room was a little bright for an evening dinner. Although the dress code for the whole resort is resort casual, we recommend dressing up for this place. It is a special place.. 

We went to Mole on New Years. We were not aware there was a standard fixed price menu in the resort that night. The food was good but we wanted Mexican! So we were disappointed that our concierge or butler did not inform us.

Bana is the Asian restaurant located in the middle of the main lobby pyramid (building 3). It is a beautiful restaurant built into lush gardens. Most of the restaurants are in building 3, right in the middle. The lobby/main building is gorgeous inside. The sushi was good, not inventive but very fresh. Curries were good as well. 

We also went to Fuego (Latin Fusion) and Vento (Tapas). Both were very nice and had good food. Again, we would love another veg option or two. Overall we enjoyed all the a la carte restaurants we went to except La Perla. It was a lovely location (open air, building one, you could see the ocean) but the service was incredibly slow and the food was only average. We did not linger.

Royal Service:

We loved the RS area and facilities. Both check in and check out were fast and efficient. Everyone is very friendly. However in RS you are assigned a butler when you arrive. You are supposed to get a cell phone to call him/her (we did not) and he is supposed to take care of your restaurant restaurants, Bali bed reservations, provide a pillow menu, assistance with check out, luggage, among other services. Our butler delivered our luggage but otherwise we did not hear from our butler all week and did not even know where to find him. At Playa del Carmen our butler was amazing and checked in on us daily to make sure we had everything we needed. Here we ended up doing most things ourselves. The concierge service was also disappointing as our restaurant reservations were often inaccurate or we had to go to the concierge multiple times to confirm whether we had a reservation at all. By the end of the trip we made our own reservations. So, in terms of RS service when it comes to the concierge and butler, this resort is not yet up to Paradisus standards. I am sure they will get there but they are not there yet.

Overall, this is a lovely resort with great potential. The RS service is not yet at the level of resorts like Paradisus La Perla in Playa del Carmen  where we stayed a year ago.  One thing that became a bit annoying was the presence of small children in the Royal Service area. We love children but RS is supposed to be 18 years and over, which is why we stay there. We mentioned this to staff but only once did we see anyone do anything about it . We also noticed non RS guests using the area reserved for  RS guests. RS guests have distinctive wristbands but no one monitored the situation.  RS guests do pay a premium for the extra service and it should be respected. Better signage, especially at the beach entrance would help solve this problem. We hope the concerns  noted in our review will be addressed so we can recommend this resort with enthusiasm to our friends, many of whom have become fans of Paradisus based on our recommendations.

reviews.author: Lovetotravelygc
reviews.title: Disappointed in Cancun
reviews.text: We stayed here in a group of 17 (friends and family), and everyone was hugely disappointed.  We have all been to Mexico countless of times.  This hotel was supposedly renovated, but it shows no signs of same.  The place is horrible.  The rooms smell of mold. The buffets and food everywhere was mediocre.  Upon checking out we were prevented from physically leaving in the car because we hadn't received what they call an exit voucher from the checkout staff even though we had prepaid in full and had a credit card on file.  Upon trying to receive the voucher, they made countless mistakes delaying our hotel departure unreasonably.  All 17 of us have traveled extensively, and we were all shocked at the low standards and bureaucracy at this hotel.

reviews.author: Eldudarino
reviews.title: Watch that step up to the bathroom
reviews.text:
I think I stubbed my toe a few times going to the bathroom but the view is hard to beat. 

The room numbers are a bit confusing since we were in room 3446 but the 3 is for the pyramid you are located in so once we figured that out we were good to go. 

The beds were more than adequate and the room was nicely appointed overall but charging for the coffee in room was a bit much for me. 

Be careful if you leave your balcony door open since if you try to open your room door the wind tunnel effect will cause that door to slam shut if you are not careful.

reviews.author: Nataly S
reviews.title: Красивый отель
reviews.text: Отдыхали вдвоем с подругой. Отель нам очень понравился. ВЕликолепный дизайн как самого отеля так и номеров, огромный бассейн вдоль всего отеля, ночью верхушки пирамид меняют цвет)) хол отеля  в стиле хай тек но утопает в зелени с верхних этажей обвивает плющ или что то похожее, смотрится интересно))) персонал очень приветлевый. Питание не могу сказать что сильно разнообразное но все вкусно. Коктейли в барах готовят хорошо. Рестораны по системе аля карт порадовали своими блюдами и обстановкой. Своего клуба в отеле нет ,живая музыка до 11 вечера но в принципе  больше и не надо так как и везде в Канкуне после этого времени все кто хотят по тусить выходят за Пределы отеля и окунаются в бурную ночную жизнь Канкуна)))!!! Что касается пляжа то конечно полоса не широкая но в принципе она такая там везде. В общем очень положительные впечатления, отель рекомендуем!!

reviews.author: Randy D
reviews.title: Not happy
reviews.text: Booked this resort 6 months ago and was told today this was not available because of the name change from the Gran Melia now we were suppose to be there in 2 weeks and was told they had a alternative place for us for 40.00 dollars a day more we are a group of 21 so this is not acceptable.
